A Hunter's Calling#231.src: You have seen loss. Destruction. Betrayal. All ends, to some other than you. Ends that never came to pass...
A Hunter's Calling#231.dst: 你见过失去。毁灭。背叛。全都是终结，属于你以外的人。那些从未真正发生的终结……

A Hunter's Calling#232.src: To end is a powerful thing. To find your end... You may never stop searching. You may find your end in but a day's time.
A Hunter's Calling#232.dst: 终结是强大的东西。要找到你的终结……你也许永远不会停止寻找。你也许一天之内就会找到你的终结。

A Hunter's Calling#233.src: ???: But here...you will gain the power to bring an end. To be brought yours.
A Hunter's Calling#233.dst: 但在这里……你将获得带来终结的力量。也将被带向你自己的终结。

A Hunter's Calling#235.src: However. Though the change is irrevocable...
A Hunter's Calling#235.dst: 然而。尽管这份改变无法撤回……

A Hunter's Calling#236.src: The power to bring an end. It is a choice. And that... Whether you will use that power, we cannot tell you.
A Hunter's Calling#236.dst: 带来终结的力量。那是一个选择。而那……你是否会使用那份力量，我们无法告诉你。

A Hunter's Calling#237.src: You must deign to take that choice.
A Hunter's Calling#237.dst: 你必须屈尊做出那个选择。

A Hunter's Calling#238.src: We may offer you not one more end.
A Hunter's Calling#238.dst: 我们无法再给你更多终结了。

A Hunter's Calling#239.src: You must find your final end yourself. We will remain... And offer others the same. And so...
A Hunter's Calling#239.dst: 你必须自己找到你最终的终结。我们会留下……并给其他人同样的东西。所以……

A Journey Beyond#000.src: Join Elphaba on a mission in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Journey Beyond#000.dst: 在 {p} [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与 Elphaba 一起执行任务。

A Journey Beyond#001.src: ...Hm? Oh- uh, hello there. Sorry, we have this space reserved for...
A Journey Beyond#001.dst: ……嗯？噢——呃，你好。抱歉，这个位子我们已经预订给……
A Journey Beyond#001.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#002.src: Wait. You might be just what we're looking for. You look like you're capable in combat. How would you like to join a dangerous top secret mission?
A Journey Beyond#002.dst: 等等。你可能正是我们在找的人。你看起来很能打。你愿不愿意加入一项危险的绝密任务？
A Journey Beyond#002.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#003.src: ...I could have phrased that better. Look, the point is- we need a fourth. Let me give you the briefing, and if you don't want to join us... then we'll find someone else. How does that sound? Alright, here, follow me.
A Journey Beyond#003.dst: ……我可以说得更好听一点的。听着，重点是——我们需要第四个人。我先给你做个简报，如果你不想加入……我们再找别人。怎么样？好，来，跟我来。
A Journey Beyond#003.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#004.src: And who's this? Did you really find a fourth? Come on, I told you we don't need one!
A Journey Beyond#004.dst: 这位是谁？你真的找到第四个人了？拜托，我跟你说过我们不需要！
A Journey Beyond#004.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#005.src: And we both keep telling you why you're wrong. This is... sorry. I didn't catch your name. {u}? .
A Journey Beyond#005.dst: 我们俩也一直在告诉你为什么你错了。这位是……抱歉。我没听清你的名字。{u}？ 。
A Journey Beyond#005.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#006.src: ... {u}, is that you? Wow, it's been a while. Sorry, I don't have time to chat right now. We're preparing for a dangerous mission, and...
A Journey Beyond#006.dst: ……{u}，是你吗？哇，好久不见了。抱歉，我现在没时间聊。我们正在准备一项危险的任务，而且……
A Journey Beyond#006.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#007.src: Well. Actually, we were looking for a fourth person to join us. And... you look like you fit the requirements for that position. If- if you'd like to join, that is.
A Journey Beyond#007.dst: 嗯。其实，我们正在找第四个人加入。而且……你看起来符合那个位置的条件。如果——如果你愿意加入的话。
A Journey Beyond#007.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#008.src: Tell you what. I'll give you the briefing, and if you don't want to join us... then we'll find someone else. How does that sound? Alright, here, follow me.
A Journey Beyond#008.dst: 这样吧。我先给你做个简报，如果你不想加入……我们再找别人。怎么样？好，来，跟我来。
A Journey Beyond#008.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#009.src: And who's this? Did you really find a fourth? Come on, I told you we don't need one!
A Journey Beyond#009.dst: 这位是谁？你真的找到第四个人了？拜托，我跟你说过我们不需要！
A Journey Beyond#009.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#010.src: And we both keep telling you why you're wrong. This is {u}, we've worked together before.
A Journey Beyond#010.dst: 我们俩一直在跟你说你错在哪。这位是 {u}，我们以前合作过。
A Journey Beyond#010.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#011.src: Anyway, I want to give them the briefing before we head
A Journey Beyond#011.dst: 总之，出发之前我想先给他们做个简报
A Journey Beyond#011.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#012.src: Elphie, I'm back! I finally managed to catch Aegis, but he's not... happy. He thinks we should
A Journey Beyond#012.dst: Elphie，我回来了！我终于逮到 Aegis 了，可他不太……高兴。他认为我们应该
A Journey Beyond#012.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#013.src: Oh. {u}? What are you doing here? Gods, it's been a while, hasn't it?
A Journey Beyond#013.dst: 噢。{u}？你在这里做什么？天啊，好久不见了，对吧？
A Journey Beyond#013.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#014.src: They're our fourth. What were you saying about the Admiral?
A Journey Beyond#014.dst: 他们是我们的第四个人。你刚才说上将怎么了？
A Journey Beyond#014.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#016.src: Nothing. If we have our fourth, we should be all set to go, shouldn't we?
A Journey Beyond#016.dst: 没什么。既然有了第四个人，我们应该都准备好出发了，对吧？
A Journey Beyond#016.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#017.src: Well... we are, but I'd like to brief on the details first. This is a dangerous mission, so... I think it's best to fill them in.
A Journey Beyond#017.dst: 嗯……是准备好了，但我想先说明细节。这是一项危险的任务，所以……我觉得最好让他们了解一下。
A Journey Beyond#017.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#018.src: So! You're aware of the {p}, yes? Hundreds of years ago, mining operations took place to extract emeralds from the earth. Until, for some unknown reason, they were halted.
A Journey Beyond#018.dst: 那么！你知道 {p} 吧？几百年前，那里曾经开采绿宝石。直到后来，因为某种不明原因，停工了。
A Journey Beyond#018.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#019.src: We don't know everything, but... evidence suggests they broke through to an undiscovered section of the Wynn province. There, they found... something.
A Journey Beyond#019.dst: 我们并不知道全部，但……有证据显示他们挖通了 Wynn 行省一个未被发现的区域。在那里，他们发现了……某样东西。
A Journey Beyond#019.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#020.src: The land itself was said to be cursed. Not corrupted they were very clear on that.
A Journey Beyond#020.dst: 据说那片土地本身受到了诅咒。不是腐化，他们对这点说得很清楚。
A Journey Beyond#020.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#021.src: Some other force makes its home in that place. The few reports we could find refer to it only as the Silent Expanse.
A Journey Beyond#021.dst: 某种别的力量盘踞在那个地方。我们找得到的少数报告只称它为寂静荒原。
A Journey Beyond#021.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#022.src: The mines were sealed to prevent the spread of this new threat, but the cracks are beginning to show.
A Journey Beyond#022.dst: 矿坑被封起来，以防这个新威胁扩散，但裂缝开始出现了。
A Journey Beyond#022.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#023.src: Strange and otherworldly creatures have begun to find their way through, threatening our province.
A Journey Beyond#023.dst: 奇异的异界生物已经开始钻出来，威胁我们的行省。
A Journey Beyond#023.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#024.src: The existence of this place has been kept on a strict need-to-know basis.
A Journey Beyond#024.dst: 这个地方的存在一直严格保密，只告诉需要知道的人。
A Journey Beyond#024.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#025.src: That's where we come in! We're to battle our way through the mines, and scout out the potential danger level.
A Journey Beyond#025.dst: 这就是我们出场的时候了！我们要一路杀穿矿坑，侦察潜在的危险程度。
A Journey Beyond#025.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#026.src: And we aren't going to be able to do it if we keep sitting around! The newbie's been briefed, let's get going already!
A Journey Beyond#026.dst: 要是我们一直坐着不动就办不到了！新人已经听完简报了，快出发吧！
A Journey Beyond#026.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#027.src: H-hey! What're you doing to my fine establishment!
A Journey Beyond#027.dst: 嘿、嘿！你们对我这间高级店干了什么！
A Journey Beyond#027.speaker: Rusty Bartender

A Journey Beyond#028.src: ...Shoot. Forgot he was still here. Sorry, barkeep! I'll fix it!
A Journey Beyond#028.dst: ……糟了。忘了他还在这里。抱歉，老板！我会修好的！
A Journey Beyond#028.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#029.src: Lucio, you can't keep... ugh, forget it. I'll gather our supplies... Aledar, can you get us to the mines?
A Journey Beyond#029.dst: Lucio，你不能老是……唉，算了。我去收拾补给……Aledar，你能带我们去矿坑吗？
A Journey Beyond#029.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#030.src: Yes, ma'am! {u}, when you're ready, let's get going.
A Journey Beyond#030.dst: 是，长官！{u}，准备好了我们就出发。
A Journey Beyond#030.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#031.src: Follow your team towards the Silent Expanse's entrance.
A Journey Beyond#031.dst: 跟着你的队伍前往寂静荒原的入口。

A Journey Beyond#032.dst: 大家都准备好了吗？我来带路。
A Journey Beyond#032.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#033.src: It's a twist of fate that our paths have converged here, {u}. We started our journey together and now...
A Journey Beyond#033.dst: 命运真奇妙，我们的路又在这里交会了，{u}。我们一起开始了旅程，而现在……
A Journey Beyond#033.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#036.src: Ah, no problem. I'll take care of these.
A Journey Beyond#036.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#037.src: No more running for us, huh ? Ah, we're here.
A Journey Beyond#037.dst: 我们再也不用逃了，是吧 ？啊，我们到了。
A Journey Beyond#037.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#038.src: This is actually our second attempt. The first time, it didn't go too well.
A Journey Beyond#038.dst: 这其实是我们第二次尝试了。第一次不太顺利。
A Journey Beyond#038.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#039.src: We have more numbers now, Lucio and yourself should help us overpower it.
A Journey Beyond#039.dst: 我们现在人更多了，有 Lucio 和你，应该能帮我们压制它。
A Journey Beyond#039.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#040.src: Can't be that strong, bet I can take it myself.
A Journey Beyond#040.dst: 不可能有多强，我打赌我一个人就搞得定。
A Journey Beyond#040.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#041.src: We managed to seal it in but with the {~} of us I'm sure we ca-
A Journey Beyond#041.dst: 我们成功把它封在里面了，不过有我们 {~} 个人，我相信我们一定能——
A Journey Beyond#041.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#045.src: What's the big deal? You said yourself we can take it!
A Journey Beyond#045.dst: 有什么大不了的？你自己也说我们打得过它！
A Journey Beyond#045.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#055.src: Is it just me or are our attacks doing NOTHING?
A Journey Beyond#055.dst: 是我的错觉，还是我们的攻击完全没用？
A Journey Beyond#055.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#056.src: Lucio's right! Change of plan. Lucio, help me hold it in place.
A Journey Beyond#056.dst: Lucio 说得对！改变计划。Lucio，帮我把它固定住。
A Journey Beyond#056.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#057.src: Aledar, you know what to do.
A Journey Beyond#057.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#058.src: {u}, come with me! Cast a spell to block the cave's entrance so the monster can't leave.
A Journey Beyond#058.dst: {u}，跟我来！施个法术把洞口封住，别让怪物跑出去。
A Journey Beyond#058.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#059.src: I'll block it from attacking, you block it up with a spell.
A Journey Beyond#059.dst: 我来挡住它的攻击，你用法术把入口封起来。
A Journey Beyond#059.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#060.src: They won't be able to hold it for long.
A Journey Beyond#060.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#061.dst: 准备好了吗？！随便施个法术！
A Journey Beyond#061.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#063.src: Plan a way of killing the beast.

A Journey Beyond#065.dst: 各位……谁来帮个忙？我卡住了！
A Journey Beyond#065.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#066.src: Phew, here. Let me get you out.
A Journey Beyond#066.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#067.src: I'm sorry, team. I've never seen a monster like that before.
A Journey Beyond#067.dst: 抱歉，各位。我从来没见过那样的怪物。
A Journey Beyond#067.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#068.src: It looks like our problem isn't fire power. It's something else. It's like our weapons just didn't affect it at all.
A Journey Beyond#068.dst: 看来我们的问题不是火力不足。是别的原因。我们的武器好像完全影响不了它。
A Journey Beyond#068.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#069.src: I know someone who might be able to help us. A blacksmith on {p}.
A Journey Beyond#069.dst: 我认识一个也许能帮我们的人。{p} 上的一位铁匠。
A Journey Beyond#069.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#070.src: {u}, I've written the house's coordinates on your book. Meet us there.
A Journey Beyond#070.dst: {u}，我把那栋房子的坐标写在你的书上了。我们在那里会合。
A Journey Beyond#070.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#072.src: Just in time. We're all here.
A Journey Beyond#072.dst: 来得正好。我们都到齐了。
A Journey Beyond#072.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#073.src: It looks like the Blacksmith knows what's wrong...
A Journey Beyond#073.dst: 看来铁匠知道问题出在哪里……
A Journey Beyond#073.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#074.src: So, Dren. Do you know why we can't damage the beast?
A Journey Beyond#074.dst: 那么，Dren。你知道为什么我们伤不了那头野兽吗？
A Journey Beyond#074.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#075.src: Certainly! Your issue is elemental. As you know, there are {~} elements...
A Journey Beyond#075.dst: 当然！你们的问题出在元素上。你们都知道，元素有 {~} 种……
A Journey Beyond#075.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#081.src: But.. There is a hidden element, Darkness .
A Journey Beyond#081.dst: 但是……还有一种隐藏的元素，❂暗……
A Journey Beyond#081.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#082.src: Thank grook for that. I was wondering if we'd ever be rid of this nightmare.
A Journey Beyond#082.dst: 谢天谢地。我还在想我们到底能不能摆脱这场噩梦。

A Journey Beyond#083.src: And we both keep telling you why you're wrong. This is... sorry, I didn't catch your name. {u}? {u}.
A Journey Beyond#083.dst: 我们俩一直在跟你说你错在哪。这位是……抱歉，我没听清你的名字。{u}？{u}。

A Journey Beyond#085.src: In order to damage a creature of Darkness, you must remove that influence from your soul.
A Journey Beyond#085.dst: 要伤害黑暗生物，你们必须把那股影响从自己的灵魂里去除。
A Journey Beyond#085.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#086.src: Some Dark creatures use a sort of synchronous barrier that prevents them being harmed by other creatures influenced with Darkness.
A Journey Beyond#086.dst: 有些黑暗生物会使用一种同步屏障，让它们不会被其他受黑暗影响的生物所伤。
A Journey Beyond#086.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#087.src: In order to purify you, I will need {~} powerful items.
A Journey Beyond#087.dst: 要净化你们，我需要 {~} 件强大的物品。
A Journey Beyond#087.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#088.src: Firstly, a shard from a Dernic Beast. There is one living in the depths of the {p}.
A Journey Beyond#088.dst: 首先，一块 Dernic 野兽的碎片。{p} 的深处就住着一只。
A Journey Beyond#088.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#089.src: I will use this to reveal the darkness element in you all.
A Journey Beyond#089.dst: 我会用它显现出你们所有人身上的暗元素。
A Journey Beyond#089.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#090.src: And then, of course, a Light item, to purify all of you...
A Journey Beyond#090.dst: 然后，当然还需要一件光之物品，来净化你们所有人……
A Journey Beyond#090.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#091.src: Wait... what do you mean a Light item?
A Journey Beyond#091.dst: 等等……你说光之物品是什么意思？
A Journey Beyond#091.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#092.src: Something from any Light creature would work, you could get some dust from Gavel fairies if you wanted.
A Journey Beyond#092.dst: 任何光之生物身上的东西都行，想要的话，你们可以去弄点 Gavel 仙子的粉尘……
A Journey Beyond#092.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#094.src: Alright. Aledar, you get the darkness item with {u}, and I'll go get the Light item with Lucio.
A Journey Beyond#094.dst: 好。Aledar，你跟 {u} 去拿黑暗物品，我跟 Lucio 去拿光明物品。
A Journey Beyond#094.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#096.dst: 与 Aledar 一起取得碎片。

A Journey Beyond#097.src: Here we are, the roots of Corruption. Let's go, {u}!
A Journey Beyond#097.dst: 我们到了，腐化之根。走吧，{u}！
A Journey Beyond#097.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#098.src: We found that the caves around the roots are far more complex than we thought...
A Journey Beyond#098.dst: 我们发现根部周围的洞穴比我们想的复杂得多……
A Journey Beyond#098.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#099.src: There's one with far more powerful creatures... Somewhere... Here!
A Journey Beyond#099.dst: 有一个洞穴里的生物强大得多……在某处……这里！
A Journey Beyond#099.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#100.src: What are you waiting for? Let's go!
A Journey Beyond#100.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#101.src: I don't think we can spell our way across, {u}! We need something like... Wings!
A Journey Beyond#101.dst: 我觉得我们没办法靠法术过去，{u}！我们需要像是……翅膀之类的东西！
A Journey Beyond#101.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#102.src: I've never used wings like this before...
A Journey Beyond#102.dst: 我从来没用过这样的翅膀……
A Journey Beyond#102.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#103.src: I think if we just hold them and walk normally, it should help us glide across.
A Journey Beyond#103.dst: 我想只要拿着它们照常走，应该就能帮我们滑翔过去。
A Journey Beyond#103.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#104.src: Don't drop them and don't get hit by the lava geysers, obviously.
A Journey Beyond#104.dst: 别弄掉它们，也别被熔岩喷泉打中，这不用说。
A Journey Beyond#104.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#105.src: Don't forget why we are here, we're looking for a creature of darkness. Shout for me if you find one.
A Journey Beyond#105.dst: 别忘了我们来这里的目的，我们在找一只黑暗生物。找到的话就喊我。
A Journey Beyond#105.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#106.src: Go deeper into the cave at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] for the Shard.

A Journey Beyond#107.src: That's our target! Go after it!
A Journey Beyond#107.dst: 那就是我们的目标！追上去！
A Journey Beyond#107.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#108.src: Wait, why isn't it fighting us here? Careful! It might be trapped!
A Journey Beyond#108.dst: 等等，它为什么不在这里跟我们打？小心！可能是陷阱！
A Journey Beyond#108.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#109.src: Chase the beast for the Shard.

A Journey Beyond#110.src: Kill the Progenitors to open up the entrance.

A Journey Beyond#111.src: Kill the Mangled Progeny for the [{~} Corrupted Pearl].
A Journey Beyond#111.dst: 杀死扭曲后裔，取得 [{~} 腐化珍珠]。

A Journey Beyond#112.src: Wow, I'm impressed . I honestly thought you would need my help.
A Journey Beyond#112.dst: 哇，我真佩服 。说实话我还以为你会需要我帮忙。
A Journey Beyond#112.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#113.src: Well, we got what we came for. Let's head back to Dren.
A Journey Beyond#113.dst: 好，我们拿到要的东西了。回去找 Dren 吧。
A Journey Beyond#113.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#114.src: Return to the Blacksmith with the Darkness Item.
A Journey Beyond#114.dst: 带着暗之物品回到铁匠那里。

A Journey Beyond#115.src: Looks like we lucked out on this one. Did you get an item of darkness?
A Journey Beyond#115.dst: 看来这次我们运气不错。拿到暗之物品了吗？
A Journey Beyond#115.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#116.src: That should do it. Let's see if this will work. Come here !
A Journey Beyond#116.dst: 这样应该就行了。来看看有没有用。过来 ！
A Journey Beyond#116.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#117.src: It's done! You ought to be free of the dark influence. You ought to be able to break through that barrier that was giving you trouble.
A Journey Beyond#117.dst: 完成了！你应该摆脱黑暗的影响了。你应该能突破之前让你头疼的那道屏障了。
A Journey Beyond#117.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#118.src: Are you sure? I don't feel that different. Well... I guess there's only one way to find out.
A Journey Beyond#118.dst: 你确定吗？我感觉没什么不同。嗯……我想只有一个办法能知道。
A Journey Beyond#118.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#119.src: Re-open the closed entrance with the other warriors.
A Journey Beyond#119.dst: 与其他战士一起重新打开封闭的入口。

A Journey Beyond#120.src: Everyone here? Great! Time to finish what I started!
A Journey Beyond#120.dst: 大家都到了吗？太好了！该把我开的头收个尾了！
A Journey Beyond#120.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#121.src: Lucio! No! When will you learn?
A Journey Beyond#121.dst: Lucio！不！你什么时候才学得乖？
A Journey Beyond#121.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#122.src: Right, yes. Sorry, what's the plan?
A Journey Beyond#122.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#123.src: We don't want that thing to escape, it could cause widespread panic.
A Journey Beyond#123.dst: 我们不能让那东西逃出去，它可能会引起大范围的恐慌。
A Journey Beyond#123.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#124.src: We'll open up a small entrance to get in, and fight it once inside.
A Journey Beyond#124.dst: 我们开一个小入口进去，在里面跟它打。
A Journey Beyond#124.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#129.src: We have an extremely old map of the mines to help us, but we have no idea what's waiting for us.
A Journey Beyond#129.dst: 我们有一张非常古老的矿坑地图可以帮忙，但我们完全不知道前面有什么在等着我们。
A Journey Beyond#129.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#130.src: I want to warn you, this may well be a one way ticket for all of us.
A Journey Beyond#130.dst: 我要提醒你们，这很可能是一张我们所有人的单程票。
A Journey Beyond#130.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#132.src: Rocks are one thing, Lucio. The creatures we're about to face require more than brute strength. You need force of mind.
A Journey Beyond#132.dst: 石头是一回事，Lucio。我们即将面对的生物需要的不只是蛮力。你需要的是心智的力量。
A Journey Beyond#132.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#133.src: Oh my. Maybe this isn't the best idea.
A Journey Beyond#133.dst: 天啊。也许这不是个好主意。
A Journey Beyond#133.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#134.src: It's too late now. We've got to finish this mission.
A Journey Beyond#134.dst: 现在太迟了。我们得完成这项任务。
A Journey Beyond#134.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#136.src: Remember the goal Elphie, we must reach the end of the expanse.
A Journey Beyond#136.dst: 记住目标，Elphie，我们必须抵达荒原的尽头。
A Journey Beyond#136.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#137.src: It's still empty here. But it looks like they were here only yesterday.
A Journey Beyond#137.dst: 这里还是空的。但看起来他们像是昨天才在这里。
A Journey Beyond#137.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#138.src: I thought you said the miners were here hundreds of years ago?
A Journey Beyond#138.dst: 你不是说那些矿工是几百年前在这里的吗？
A Journey Beyond#138.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#139.src: They were. I don't know why it would be so well presevered. It's as if nothing has touched it.
A Journey Beyond#139.dst: 他们是。我不知道为什么会保存得这么好。就好像什么都没碰过它一样。
A Journey Beyond#139.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#140.src: According to the documents, we need to make our way to the end of the road.
A Journey Beyond#140.dst: 根据文件，我们得走到这条路的尽头。
A Journey Beyond#140.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#142.src: So much for nothing being here.
A Journey Beyond#142.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#143.src: Why are they only going for me?
A Journey Beyond#143.dst: 为什么它们只冲着我来？
A Journey Beyond#143.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#144.src: Aledar, how far is it to the end?
A Journey Beyond#144.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#145.src: I read the same map as you. It didn't even have scale. There should be a bridge ahead, though.
A Journey Beyond#145.dst: 我看的地图跟你一样。上面连比例尺都没有。不过前面应该有座桥。
A Journey Beyond#145.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#146.src: Uhh... A destroyed one. And it wasn't cause I blew it up this time!
A Journey Beyond#146.dst: 呃……是座毁掉的桥。而且这次可不是我炸的！
A Journey Beyond#146.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#147.src: Hmm, well we will have to go around.
A Journey Beyond#147.dst: 嗯，那我们只好绕过去了。
A Journey Beyond#147.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#148.src: This doesn't really look like corruption, does it?
A Journey Beyond#148.dst: 这看起来不太像腐化，对吧？
A Journey Beyond#148.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#149.src: Uhhh... I'm not feeling very wel-... Aahhh!
A Journey Beyond#149.dst: 呃……我觉得不太舒——……啊啊啊！
A Journey Beyond#149.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#150.src: Aaahhh! My liver! It took my liver!
A Journey Beyond#150.dst: 啊啊啊！我的肝！它拿走了我的肝！
A Journey Beyond#150.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#153.src: Aledar, maybe we should just double back now?
A Journey Beyond#153.dst: Aledar，我们也许现在就该掉头回去？
A Journey Beyond#153.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#154.src: Elphaba is an extremely able warrior. We will fight on and find her.
A Journey Beyond#154.dst: Elphaba 是个非常能干的战士。我们会继续战斗，找到她。
A Journey Beyond#154.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#155.src: Do you really think it was just an illusion?
A Journey Beyond#155.dst: 你真觉得那只是幻觉吗？
A Journey Beyond#155.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#156.src: I'm not sure. I hope so.
A Journey Beyond#156.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#157.src: What if we're infected too? Shouldn't we just go back?
A Journey Beyond#157.dst: 要是我们也被感染了呢？难道不该直接回去吗？
A Journey Beyond#157.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#158.src: We can't, Lucio! We have a mission, as you very well know. We continue.
A Journey Beyond#158.dst: 不行，Lucio！你很清楚我们有任务在身。我们继续前进。
A Journey Beyond#158.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#159.src: Besides, we might be carrying some of those things too. We can't risk them infesting Wynn.
A Journey Beyond#159.dst: 况且，我们身上可能也带着那些东西。我们不能冒险让它们侵入 Wynn。
A Journey Beyond#159.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#160.src: Looks like we need to go around to the right, here?
A Journey Beyond#160.dst: 看来我们得往右边绕过去？
A Journey Beyond#160.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#161.src: It feels like something is watching us...
A Journey Beyond#161.dst: 感觉像是有什么东西在盯着我们……
A Journey Beyond#161.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#162.src: Aledar, what is this place? You didn't tell me there was a city here.
A Journey Beyond#162.dst: Aledar，这是什么地方？你没跟我说这里有座城市。
A Journey Beyond#162.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#163.src: There is. A big one, too; there's more ahead. But it doesn't look like anyone's home. The map doesn't have a name for it either.
A Journey Beyond#163.dst: 是有。而且很大，前面还有更多；但看起来没人在家 。地图上也没有标它的名字。
A Journey Beyond#163.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#164.src: Wait a sec, is that one of the miners? Is she hurt? HEEEEY! YOU OVER THERE!
A Journey Beyond#164.dst: 等一下，那是矿工之一吗？她受伤了吗？嘿——！那边那个！
A Journey Beyond#164.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#167.src: Wait, what's going on? Why can't I move?
A Journey Beyond#167.dst: 等等，怎么回事？我为什么动不了？
A Journey Beyond#167.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#170.src: We can't live alone like this!
A Journey Beyond#170.dst: 我们不能这样孤零零地活着！
A Journey Beyond#170.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#173.src: You need to come with us!
A Journey Beyond#173.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#174.src: It's the only way to keep you safe!
A Journey Beyond#174.dst: 这是保护你安全的唯一办法！
A Journey Beyond#174.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#175.src: It's the only way to make you happy here!
A Journey Beyond#175.dst: 这是让你在这里快乐的唯一办法！
A Journey Beyond#175.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#176.src: It's the only way to make us feel whole!
A Journey Beyond#176.dst: 这是让我们感到完整的唯一办法！
A Journey Beyond#176.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#177.src: IT'S THE ONLY WAY, DO YOU UNDERSTAND?!
A Journey Beyond#177.dst: 这是唯一的办法，你明白吗？！
A Journey Beyond#177.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#178.src: AAAH! S-Stop screaming at me! I can't understand!!
A Journey Beyond#178.dst: 啊啊啊！别、别对着我尖叫！我听不懂！！
A Journey Beyond#178.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#181.src: CAN'T YOU HEAR WHAT I'M SAYING?
A Journey Beyond#181.dst: 你听不见我在说什么吗？
A Journey Beyond#181.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#183.src: No! How did she disable my spell?!
A Journey Beyond#183.dst: 不！她怎么解除了我的法术？！
A Journey Beyond#183.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#185.src: YOU'LL BE SO MUCH HAPPIER IF YOU COME ALONG!
A Journey Beyond#185.dst: 你跟我们走会快乐得多！
A Journey Beyond#185.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#186.src: YOU'LL NEVER HAVE TO WORRY AGAIN!
A Journey Beyond#186.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#189.src: Just please, stand still a little longer!
A Journey Beyond#189.dst: 拜托，再站着别动一会儿！
A Journey Beyond#189.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#190.dst: 我们会带你去温暖的地方！
A Journey Beyond#190.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#191.src: You won't be hunted! We promise! No one hunts us!
A Journey Beyond#191.dst: 你不会被猎杀的！我们保证！没有人会猎杀我们！
A Journey Beyond#191.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#193.src: THANK YOU! WE WILL GO TOGETHER!
A Journey Beyond#193.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#194.dst: 跟我们在一起你会很安全！
A Journey Beyond#194.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#195.src: NO MORE FEAR! NO MORE CONCERN!
A Journey Beyond#195.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#197.src: No no no!! This is bad, really bad! We have to go ! Quick!
A Journey Beyond#197.dst: 不不不！！这下糟了，糟透了！我们得走了 ！快！
A Journey Beyond#197.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#200.src: Wait, you're just one of the miners. This doesn't feel like an illusion...
A Journey Beyond#200.dst: 等等，你只是矿工之一。这感觉不像幻觉……
A Journey Beyond#200.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#201.src: Look, you need to get out of here. It's not safe- Wait, what's that noise...?
A Journey Beyond#201.dst: 听着，你得离开这里。这里不安全——等等，那是什么声音……？
A Journey Beyond#201.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#204.src: Find Aledar, Lucio and Elphaba in the Fallen City.
A Journey Beyond#204.dst: 在陨落之城找到 Aledar、Lucio 和 Elphaba。

A Journey Beyond#205.src: {u}! She was completely right. You ought to come with us...
A Journey Beyond#205.dst: {u}！她说得完全没错。你应该跟我们走……
A Journey Beyond#205.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#206.src: Find Aledar and Elphaba in the Fallen City.
A Journey Beyond#206.dst: 在陨落之城找到 Aledar 和 Elphaba。

A Journey Beyond#207.src: Find Aledar in the Fallen City.

A Journey Beyond#209.src: I think my leg is broken. I have a potion to fix it, but I dropped it back up there.
A Journey Beyond#209.dst: 我想我的腿断了。我有药水能治，可是掉在上面了。
A Journey Beyond#209.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#210.src: I feel a bit better.. But something is still wrong.
A Journey Beyond#210.dst: 我感觉好一点了……但还是有什么不对劲。
A Journey Beyond#210.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#211.src: Let's just get out of here, soldier on. There's only one way out.
A Journey Beyond#211.dst: 我们快离开这里吧，继续前进。出路只有一条。
A Journey Beyond#211.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#213.dst: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！
A Journey Beyond#213.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#214.src: Urrrgh. {u}, this hasn't gone to plan. According to my map we aren't even half way.
A Journey Beyond#214.dst: 呃呃。{u}，事情没照计划走。照我的地图，我们连一半都还没到。
A Journey Beyond#214.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#215.src: I can't walk. But equally we can't stay here.
A Journey Beyond#215.dst: 我走不动了。但我们也不能待在这里。
A Journey Beyond#215.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#216.src: The mission must be carried out. The plan has changed, but it's imperative we get to the end of this expanse, together.
A Journey Beyond#216.dst: 任务必须完成。计划变了，但我们一定要一起抵达荒原的尽头。
A Journey Beyond#216.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#217.src: No more running for us, huh {u}? Ah, we're here.
A Journey Beyond#217.dst: 我们再也不用逃了，对吧 {u}？啊，到了。

A Journey Beyond#218.src: There has to be a way.. Even if you have to push me in this thing!
A Journey Beyond#218.dst: 一定有办法的……就算你得把我放在这东西里推着走！
A Journey Beyond#218.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#219.src: No, I'm not joking. You guard the cart, I'll lead the way.
A Journey Beyond#219.dst: 不，我不是在开玩笑。你保护推车，我来带路。
A Journey Beyond#219.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#220.src: Escort Aledar through the {p} to {p} at ({~}, -{~}).
A Journey Beyond#220.dst: 护送 Aledar 穿过 {p} 前往 {p}，位于 ({~}, -{~})。

A Journey Beyond#221.src: According to the map, the miners started a town a little ahead.
A Journey Beyond#221.dst: 根据地图，矿工们在前面不远处建了一座小镇。
A Journey Beyond#221.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#222.src: Who knows what's left, but it's got to be safer than here.
A Journey Beyond#222.dst: 谁知道还剩下什么，不过肯定比这里安全。
A Journey Beyond#222.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#223.src: I think the Small Monsters will try to Kill me.
A Journey Beyond#223.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#224.src: While the Big Monsters will try to Kill you.
A Journey Beyond#224.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#225.src: It's going to be on you to make sure we both get through this.
A Journey Beyond#225.dst: 要确保我们两个都能撑过去，就全靠你了。
A Journey Beyond#225.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#226.src: The fate of the mission relies on the two of us working together.
A Journey Beyond#226.dst: 任务的成败全靠我们两个合作。
A Journey Beyond#226.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#227.src: Are those... Eyes on the trees?
A Journey Beyond#227.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#229.src: Watch out, the small monsters are coming for me! I can't fight in this thing!
A Journey Beyond#229.dst: 小心，小怪物冲着我来了！我坐在这东西里没法打！
A Journey Beyond#229.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#231.src: Great job! It looks like they've stopped coming. Let's keep going.
A Journey Beyond#231.dst: 干得好！看来它们不再来了。我们继续走。
A Journey Beyond#231.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#233.src: Let's keep going! Before they come back.
A Journey Beyond#233.dst: 我们继续走！趁它们还没回来。
A Journey Beyond#233.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#234.src: A lot of those small ones are coming for me!
A Journey Beyond#234.dst: 好多小怪物冲着我来了！
A Journey Beyond#234.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#235.src: This one was close! We're getting close to the town.
A Journey Beyond#235.dst: 刚才好险！我们快到小镇了。
A Journey Beyond#235.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#236.src: We'll have to stop again! We can't go past so many monsters.
A Journey Beyond#236.dst: 我们又得停下来了！这么多怪物过不去。
A Journey Beyond#236.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#237.src: We're almost there! I can see the town from here!
A Journey Beyond#237.dst: 我们快到了！从这里就看得到小镇了！
A Journey Beyond#237.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#239.src: Great job! It looks like they've stopped coming. Let's keep going.
A Journey Beyond#239.dst: 干得好！看来它们不再来了。我们继续走。
A Journey Beyond#239.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#240.src: Ouch! I got hit! Be careful, {u}!
A Journey Beyond#240.dst: 哎哟！我被打中了！小心点，{u}！
A Journey Beyond#240.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#241.src: Finally, we've arrived... It's not exactly the town on the map.
A Journey Beyond#241.dst: 终于到了……这跟地图上的小镇不太一样。
A Journey Beyond#241.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#242.src: The lost miners are here... How? they must be hundreds of years old!
A Journey Beyond#242.dst: 失踪的矿工在这里……怎么会？他们应该有几百岁了！
A Journey Beyond#242.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#243.src: What is this obelisk? It's.. comforting. I recognise this feeling from my time in Gavel.
A Journey Beyond#243.dst: 这座方尖碑是什么？它……让人安心。我在 Gavel 的时候认得这种感觉。
A Journey Beyond#243.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#244.src: Maybe.. It's been touched by the light? If so.. It could heal me.
A Journey Beyond#244.dst: 也许……它被光触碰过？如果是这样……它也许能治好我。
A Journey Beyond#244.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#245.src: Let's see if it does anything to me...
A Journey Beyond#245.dst: 来看看它对我有没有什么作用……
A Journey Beyond#245.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#246.src: It worked... Kind of. I feel at least {~}.. We still have a ways to go.
A Journey Beyond#246.dst: 有用了……算是吧。我感觉至少恢复了 {~}……我们还有很长的路要走。
A Journey Beyond#246.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#247.src: Let's take some time to gather ourselves before we press on. I'll meet you on the other side of town.
A Journey Beyond#247.dst: 我们先花点时间整理一下再继续前进。我在小镇的另一头跟你会合。
A Journey Beyond#247.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#001.src: {u}, good news. I'm basically as recovered as I think I'll get.
A Journey Further#001.dst: {u}，好消息。我差不多已经恢复到极限了。

A Journey Further#002.src: >and the hero shall blind the ancient seer. good luck.
A Journey Further#002.dst: >而英雄将蒙蔽古老的先知。祝你好运。

A Journey Further#004.src: Alright, let's go. I'll tell you more about our journey on the way.
A Journey Further#004.dst: 好，我们出发吧。路上我再跟你多说说这趟旅程。
A Journey Further#004.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#005.dst: 与 Aledar 继续你们的旅程。

A Journey Further#006.src: We should try to follow the path as closely as we can. You lead, I'll follow.
A Journey Further#006.dst: 我们应该尽量沿着小路走。你带路，我跟着。
A Journey Further#006.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#011.src: Good work. Seems that killing the king made the other creatures run off. We’re lucky about that-
A Journey Further#011.dst: 干得好。看来杀了它们的王，其他怪物就跑了。我们运气不错——
A Journey Further#011.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#012.src: Wait, {u}, what's going on? Are you alright?
A Journey Further#012.dst: 等等，{u}，怎么回事？你还好吗？
A Journey Further#012.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#013.src: Oh, no no! I have a potion for this, where is it, where is it, aha! Here, drink!
A Journey Further#013.dst: 噢，不不不！我有治这个的药水，在哪、在哪，啊哈！来，喝下去！
A Journey Further#013.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#014.src: One of those things must have infected your wounds... Everything in this area looks completely hazardous and sickening.
A Journey Further#014.dst: 一定是那些东西感染了你的伤口……这一带的一切看起来都又危险又恶心。
A Journey Further#014.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#015.src: I expected the worst, so I tried to bring anything and everything that might help. Let's keep moving.
A Journey Further#015.dst: 我早就做了最坏的打算，所以能带的、可能派上用场的东西全都带上了。我们继续走吧。
A Journey Further#015.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#016.src: Continue on the main path with Aledar.
A Journey Further#016.dst: 与 Aledar 沿着主路继续前进。

A Journey Further#019.src: I'm... I'm going to lead us for now. At least for a little...while... I can't have you g-getting-
A Journey Further#019.dst: 我……接下来由我带路。至少一小……会儿……我不能让你受——
A Journey Further#019.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#021.src: ...urgh... I...sorry. I just... I need a moment.
A Journey Further#021.dst: ……呃……我……抱歉。我只是……需要缓一下。
A Journey Further#021.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#022.src: {u}, you just... you have to realize, I can't have you getting hurt.
A Journey Further#022.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#023.src: I want to stress this... We NEED to get to the end of this path, together.
A Journey Further#023.dst: 我要强调这一点……我们必须一起走到这条路的尽头。
A Journey Further#023.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#025.src: Okay. I'm as good as I can get right now. Let's move.
A Journey Further#025.dst: 好了。我现在只能恢复到这样了。走吧。
A Journey Further#025.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#026.src: Ah? What... What just... Why do I...
A Journey Further#026.dst: 啊？怎么……刚才怎么……为什么我会……
A Journey Further#026.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#027.src: I'll be fine, I just...why did I feel so empty all of the sudden...?
A Journey Further#027.dst: 我没事，我只是……为什么突然觉得这么空虚……？
A Journey Further#027.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#029.src: A mysterious force pushes you back...
A Journey Further#029.dst: 一股神秘的力量把你推了回去……

A Journey Further#030.src: Oh no, I think something is coming... {u}! Fight it off, I don't think I can defend myself right now!
A Journey Further#030.dst: 噢不，我觉得有东西来了……{u}！把它打退，我现在恐怕保护不了自己！
A Journey Further#030.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#031.src: Defend Aledar from the Radiated Spiders.
A Journey Further#031.dst: 保护 Aledar，击退辐射蜘蛛。

A Journey Further#032.src: Huff... Not feeling totally better, but... At least I can still defend myself.
A Journey Further#032.dst: 呼……还没完全好，不过……至少我还能保护自己。
A Journey Further#032.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#033.src: My stomach is empty, I can't even vomit... Why so I still feel so dizzy? Maybe a potion will help...
A Journey Further#033.dst: 我的胃都空了，想吐都吐不出来……为什么我还是这么晕？也许喝瓶药水会有用……
A Journey Further#033.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#035.src: Urgh, pfft! My vomit tasted better than that coming up...
A Journey Further#035.dst: 呃，呸！我吐出来的东西都比这个好喝……
A Journey Further#035.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#036.src: Hah...that's the ticket. Which potion was this anyways... ... hair loss treatment? Why did THAT work?
A Journey Further#036.dst: 哈……就是这个。这到底是哪瓶药水……生发药？为什么这个会有用？
A Journey Further#036.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#037.src: Though, you saw what happened to that beast I attacked? Follow me.
A Journey Further#037.dst: 话说回来，你看到我攻击的那头野兽怎么了吗？跟我来。
A Journey Further#037.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#038.src: This, from what I recall of the mission statements, is referred to as a "Void Hole." It's a sort of portal.
A Journey Further#038.dst: 照我记得的任务说明，这东西叫作“虚空洞”。算是一种传送门。
A Journey Further#038.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#039.src: They connect to each other in odd ways, but we saw the beast come out of that one when I knocked it in, so...
A Journey Further#039.dst: 它们彼此连接的方式很古怪，不过我把那头野兽打进去的时候，我们看到它从那个洞里出来，所以……
A Journey Further#039.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#040.src: Watch. I'll come out the other side.
A Journey Further#040.dst: 看好。我会从另一边出来。
A Journey Further#040.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#041.src: Alright, good! It does connect up consistently, at least. You try now.
A Journey Further#041.dst: 好，很好！至少它的连接是固定的。现在换你试试。
A Journey Further#041.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#043.src: Continue on the trail with Aledar.
A Journey Further#043.dst: 与 Aledar 沿着小路继续前进。

A Journey Further#044.src: I bring this up because if we're seeing one, we'll be seeing more soon. You'll need to adjust yourself to the sight of them.
A Journey Further#044.dst: 我提这个，是因为既然看到了一个，很快就会看到更多。你得习惯它们的样子。
A Journey Further#044.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#046.src: We grossly underestimated the difficulties we would have here. And, by that, I mean myself, Elphie, and Lucio did...
A Journey Further#046.dst: 我们严重低估了这里的难度。我是说，我、Elphie 和 Lucio 都低估了……
A Journey Further#046.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#047.src: We were each unprepared and cocky. If it weren't for you, I'd be dead now, for what it's worth.
A Journey Further#047.dst: 我们每个人都准备不足，又自以为是。不管怎么说，要不是有你，我现在已经死了。
A Journey Further#047.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#048.src: I wasn't certain at first about you coming along, but you've more than shown you were the right one for the job.
A Journey Further#048.dst: 一开始我还不确定该不该让你一起来，但你早就证明了你是这份工作的不二人选。
A Journey Further#048.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#049.src: ...I had to figure this map was outdated. This wall of spikes isn't listed on it, and the path goes through here!
A Journey Further#049.dst: ……我早该想到这张地图过时了。这面尖刺墙上面根本没标，可小路就是从这里穿过去的！
A Journey Further#049.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#050.src: I'll have to assume they're new...and if they're new, I might be able to bash through them.
A Journey Further#050.dst: 我只能假设它们是新长出来的……如果是新的，我也许能撞开它们。
A Journey Further#050.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#051.src: {u}, try throwing a spell at the same time! Let's crack through these things!
A Journey Further#051.dst: {u}，你同时放个法术！我们把这些东西打破！
A Journey Further#051.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#053.src: ...aagh... I... H-how are these so resilient...?
A Journey Further#053.dst: ……呃啊……我……这些东西怎、怎么这么坚固……？
A Journey Further#053.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#054.src: I'm an idiot... I nearly killed myself trying that. I nearly ruined the mission...
A Journey Further#054.dst: 我真是个白痴……刚才那样差点把自己弄死。我差点毁了整个任务……
A Journey Further#054.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#055.src: I'm sorry, but you'll have to go without me. I can't move another step for now.
A Journey Further#055.dst: 抱歉，你只能自己去了。我现在一步都走不动了。
A Journey Further#055.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#056.src: There's a lot of void holes around here, remember my warning... You can probably get past these spikes with one.
A Journey Further#056.dst: 这附近有很多虚空洞，记住我的警告……你大概能用其中一个绕过这些尖刺。
A Journey Further#056.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#057.src: If I'd been thinking I would have suggested it earlier... Once you're past, we'll...uh. We'll do something.
A Journey Further#057.dst: 我要是有动脑子，早就该提议了……等你过去之后，我们就……呃。我们再想办法。
A Journey Further#057.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#058.src: Just...be careful where you go. The void holes could lead anywhere. They might lead you someplace very, very dangerous, too dangerous even for you. I pray they won't...
A Journey Further#058.dst: 只是……去哪里都要小心。虚空洞可能通往任何地方。它们也可能把你带到非常、非常危险的地方，危险到连你都应付不了。我祈祷不会……
A Journey Further#058.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#059.src: There's a void hole right there to try out first. Get going, now. You have to do this.
A Journey Further#059.dst: 那边就有一个虚空洞，先去试试。快去吧。这件事非你不可。
A Journey Further#059.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#060.src: Use Void Holes to try and get behind the spike barrier
A Journey Further#060.dst: 利用虚空洞，想办法绕到尖刺屏障后面

A Journey Further#061.src: Find a way to help Aledar get to the other side of the spike barrier.
A Journey Further#061.dst: 想办法帮 Aledar 到达尖刺屏障的另一边。

A Journey Further#062.src: ...wait, {u}? You got to the other side then...? Good...
A Journey Further#062.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#063.src: I don't know what you did, but whatever it was, it's made cracks in the spikes that I can see from this side.
A Journey Further#063.dst: 我不知道你做了什么，但不管是什么，尖刺上都出现裂缝了，我从这边都看得到。
A Journey Further#063.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#064.src: I've got some of my energy back...let's try spellcasting again. If we do it at the same time, we might make some headway.
A Journey Further#064.dst: 我恢复了一点力气……我们再施一次法吧。如果同时施放，也许能有点进展。
A Journey Further#064.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#065.src: I won't crack my skull open on the spikes again though. Promise.
A Journey Further#065.dst: 不过我不会再拿头去撞那些尖刺了。我保证。
A Journey Further#065.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#066.src: You lead. I'll cast my spell as soon as I hear yours.
A Journey Further#066.dst: 你带路。一听到你施法，我就马上施放我的法术。
A Journey Further#066.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#067.src: Thank god it worked... That's our destination there, the Eldritch Outlook.
A Journey Further#067.dst: 谢天谢地，成功了……那就是我们的目的地，邪异瞭望台。
A Journey Further#067.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#068.src: Now comes the hardest part... Come along. I'll need you there for it.
A Journey Further#068.dst: 接下来是最难的部分……跟我来。这件事需要你在场。
A Journey Further#068.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#069.src: That blade there...it's made for sacrifice. See how that gate is shut?
A Journey Further#069.dst: 那边那把刀……是用来献祭的。看到那扇门关着吗？
A Journey Further#069.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#070.src: In order to open the doors to the Outlook, we need to sacrifice a powerful soul.
A Journey Further#070.dst: 要打开通往瞭望台的门，我们必须献祭一个强大的灵魂。
A Journey Further#070.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#071.src: We... we should have told you from the start. You and Lucio. Elphie and I, we knew. We knew this would be here.
A Journey Further#071.dst: 我们……我们应该一开始就告诉你的。你和 Lucio。我和 Elphie 都知道。我们知道这里会有这个。
A Journey Further#071.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#072.src: We didn't have... we didn't have a sacrifice in mind. We decided that it would be best decided once we reached that point. And I think we both knew it would have to be one of us.
A Journey Further#072.dst: 我们没有……我们心里并没有定下献祭的人选。我们决定等走到这一步再做决定。我想我们俩都知道，那会是我们其中一个。
A Journey Further#072.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#073.src: ...I think she would have insisted it be her. Even though both of us had something we would be le-...
A Journey Further#073.dst: ……我想她一定会坚持由她来。尽管我们俩都有要留下的……
A Journey Further#073.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#074.src: It doesn't matter now. It's just us left. And I've been mulling it over since we got to the town... you'll sacrifice me. I won't take no for an answer.
A Journey Further#074.dst: 现在都不重要了。只剩下我们了。从我们到镇上开始，我就一直在想这件事……你来献祭我。我不接受拒绝。
A Journey Further#074.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#075.src: I mean... look at the state I'm in, {u}! I'm on death's door already, and you've proven yourself far stronger than I am even at my best.
A Journey Further#075.dst: 我是说……看看我现在这副样子，{u}！我已经一只脚踏进鬼门关了，而你早就证明了你比全盛时期的我还要强得多。
A Journey Further#075.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#076.src: Here. You can take everything I had on me. My emeralds, and the key to the dungeon. I certainly won't be able to use them anymore.
A Journey Further#076.dst: 拿去。我身上的东西你全都拿走吧。我的绿宝石，还有地牢的钥匙。我肯定再也用不上了。
A Journey Further#076.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#077.src: Upon the top of the tower is... Well, something. We don't know for certain what it is, but it will prevent you from passing through.
A Journey Further#077.dst: 塔顶上有……嗯，某个东西。我们不确定那是什么，但它会挡住你的去路。
A Journey Further#077.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#078.src: You'll have to kill it to break the barrier. But... find other soldiers who can help you. It will be impossible to defeat alone.
A Journey Further#078.dst: 你得杀了它才能打破屏障。不过……去找其他能帮你的士兵。单靠你一个人不可能打败它。
A Journey Further#078.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#079.src: ...no more putting it off, then. I'm bleeding out.
A Journey Further#079.dst: ……那就别再拖了。我快流干血了。
A Journey Further#079.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#081.src: Right click to grab the blade in the altar.

A Journey Further#082.src: Now...strike me down. My soul will unlock the gate...
A Journey Further#082.dst: 现在……砍倒我。我的灵魂会打开那扇门……
A Journey Further#082.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#085.src: You...can do this. I know y-you can.
A Journey Further#085.dst: 你……做得到的。我知、知道你做得到。
A Journey Further#085.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#087.dst: 那个在监、监视我们的怪物……
A Journey Further#087.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Home#001.src: Is there anything I can do for you today?
A Journey Home#001.dst: 今天有什么我能帮你的吗？

A Journey Home#002.src: ...something's prickling at the back of your mind. Weren't you asleep like this when you first arrived, too?
A Journey Home#002.dst: ……你脑海深处隐隐有种刺痛感。你刚来的时候，不也是像这样睡着的吗？

A Journey Home#004.src: Explore near where you originally arrived in Wynn.
A Journey Home#004.dst: 在你最初抵达 Wynn 的地方附近探索。

A Journey Home#006.src: Continue back down the path to Fruma.
A Journey Home#006.dst: 沿着小路继续往回走向 Fruma。

A Journey Home#007.src: This job is impossible!! Why am I even here?!
A Journey Home#007.dst: 这份工作根本不可能完成！！我到底为什么会在这里？！
A Journey Home#007.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#008.src: Ah! You're a soldier, right? Look, I- It's, it's just a really difficult time right now.
A Journey Home#008.dst: 啊！你是士兵，对吧？听着，我——那个，现在真的是很困难的时候。
A Journey Home#008.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#009.src: This, this whole situation is definitely above my paygrade! I don't know how I'm going to deal with this...
A Journey Home#009.dst: 这、这整件事绝对超出我的职权范围了！我不知道该怎么处理……
A Journey Home#009.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#010.src: Enough of that, I, ah, I suppose. What is it you need?
A Journey Home#010.dst: 不说这个了，我，呃，我想。你需要什么？
A Journey Home#010.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#011.src: Oh. Oh no. Ah, I, you see, that'll be a problem, I think. What do you even need to do at the border anyway?
A Journey Home#011.dst: 噢。噢不。呃，我，你看，我想这会是个问题。你到底要去边境做什么？
A Journey Home#011.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#012.src: I can't really imagine what you could need there, but, whatever it is, it'll need to wait! This Corkian drill won't work, and Paxon's stuck, and
A Journey Home#012.dst: 我实在想象不出你在那里能有什么事，但不管是什么，都得等等了！这台 Corkus 钻机不能用，Paxon 又被困住了，而且
A Journey Home#012.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#013.src: Look, I'm...I'm sorry for snapping at you. I'm trained for military operation, not for cave-in clearance, but no one else was available!
A Journey Home#013.dst: 听着，我……我很抱歉对你发火。我受的是军事行动的训练，不是清理坍方的，可是没有别人能来了！
A Journey Home#013.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#014.src: Even the demolitions expert I hired is stuck, so it's all just, it's all going wrong and I don't know what to do.
A Journey Home#014.dst: 就连我请来的爆破专家都被困住了，所以一切都、一切都不顺，我也不知道该怎么办。
A Journey Home#014.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#015.src: You see that new entrance over there? The expert, Paxon, has been in there for almost as long as I was trying this dud machine.
A Journey Home#015.dst: 看到那边那个新的入口了吗？那位专家 Paxon 在里面待的时间，差不多跟我试这台废机器的时间一样久。
A Journey Home#015.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#016.src: If you think you can do a job better than an expert, go ahead and talk with them, but I'm pretty sure you'll have to cancel whatever plans you had.
A Journey Home#016.dst: 如果你觉得你能比专家做得更好，就去跟他们谈谈吧，不过我很确定你得取消原本的计划了。
A Journey Home#016.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#017.src: Talk to the Demolition Mage at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Journey Home#018.src: If you really need to get to the border, your best bet is to talk to Paxon in the new cave entrance.
A Journey Home#018.dst: 如果你真的得去边境，最好的办法是去新的洞穴入口找 Paxon 谈谈。
A Journey Home#018.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#019.src: But, they're an expert, so I think your business will have to wait. Really, really sorry about all this!
A Journey Home#019.dst: 不过，他们可是专家，所以我想你的事得先等等了。真的、真的很抱歉！
A Journey Home#019.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#020.src: Oh no, not another one I don't care what rank you are, what you're asking is impossible! Even for me, it
A Journey Home#020.dst: 噢不，又来一个，我不管你是什么军阶，你要求的事根本不可能！就算是我，也
A Journey Home#020.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#021.src: Wait, you aren't part of the... You're just a regular soldier. You're just trying to get through here, aren't you?
A Journey Home#021.dst: 等等，你不是那个……你只是个普通士兵。你只是想从这里过去，对吧？
A Journey Home#021.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#022.src: May as well give up now! Not happening. No way. You're wasting your time, and let me tell you exactly why.
A Journey Home#022.dst: 你还是现在就放弃吧！不可能的。门都没有。你是在浪费时间，我来告诉你到底为什么。
A Journey Home#022.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#023.src: You see that blue rock over there? It's a break point. If I could set off these explosives at it, it'd open a path.
A Journey Home#023.dst: 看到那边那块蓝色石头了吗？那是个突破点。如果我能在那里引爆炸药，就能打开一条路。
A Journey Home#023.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#024.src: They're gone. Hurry down the path!
A Journey Home#024.dst: 他们走了。快顺着小路下去！

A Journey Home#025.src: But apparently all these structures set up are so important that any of it being damaged, or MOVED, is unacceptable!
A Journey Home#025.dst: 可是这里搭的这些建筑显然重要得不得了，任何一样被弄坏，或者被移动，都不可接受！
A Journey Home#025.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#026.src: And to make sure I'm 'supervised' while the lieutenant is working on the drill, the detonator HAS to be here.
A Journey Home#026.dst: 而且为了确保中尉在弄钻机的时候我有人“监督”，引爆器必须放在这里。
A Journey Home#026.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#027.src: So I have to daisy-chain a limited amount of explosives all the way over to the stone, without blasting any structures!
A Journey Home#027.dst: 所以我得用有限的炸药一路串联到那块石头，还不能炸到任何建筑！
A Journey Home#027.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#028.src: I've been trying for hours and gotten absolutely nowhere! I'm one of the best in my field, even! It's ridiculous!!
A Journey Home#028.dst: 我试了好几个小时，一点进展都没有！我在这一行可是数一数二的！太离谱了！！
A Journey Home#028.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#029.src: If you feel like wasting your time, here's my stock of explosives. Feel free to try your hand at it, but you really should just go.
A Journey Home#029.dst: 如果你想浪费时间，这是我的炸药存货。尽管去试试身手吧，不过你真的应该直接走人。
A Journey Home#029.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#030.src: Use the TNT to open up a path through the cave.
A Journey Home#030.dst: 用 TNT 在洞穴里炸出一条路。

A Journey Home#031.src: Still at it? What, do you need a reminder? I've got nothing better to do.
A Journey Home#031.dst: 还在弄？怎么，要我再提醒你一次吗？反正我也没更好的事可做。
A Journey Home#031.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#032.src: So the blue rock is soft enough to crack with the explosives. But the detonator's stuck here.
A Journey Home#032.dst: 所以那块蓝色石头够软，炸药炸得裂。可是引爆器固定在这里。
A Journey Home#032.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#033.src: So we need to use the TNT Placer to daisy-chain blasts from the detonator, without blasting any tents, crates, or walls.
A Journey Home#033.dst: 所以我们得用 TNT 放置器从引爆器一路串联引爆，而且不能炸到任何帐篷、箱子或墙壁。
A Journey Home#033.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#034.src: You can look at placed TNT to see its blast radius, as well.
A Journey Home#034.dst: 你也可以看着放好的 TNT 查看它的爆炸范围。
A Journey Home#034.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#035.src: But given how tight the squeeze between some of those structures is, there's just no way it's happening.
A Journey Home#035.dst: 可是有些建筑之间的空隙窄成那样，根本不可能办到。
A Journey Home#035.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#036.src: Like I said, you really should just mosey on back to the castle. If I can't get anywhere, I don't think you'll fare better.
A Journey Home#036.dst: 就像我说的，你真的该慢慢晃回城堡去。连我都搞不定，我不认为你会比较好。
A Journey Home#036.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#039.src: Halt! Where did you come from? There was a cave-in past here, wasn't there?
A Journey Home#039.dst: 站住！你从哪里来的？这里过去不是坍方了吗？
A Journey Home#039.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#040.src: A new path, huh? I didn't think you'd have things to be doing back here, though I won't say I'm ungrateful.
A Journey Home#040.dst: 新的路，是吗？我没想到你在这后面还有事要做，不过我也不会说我不感激。
A Journey Home#040.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#041.src: It even crushed the grook's nest there. I've been working off field rations for a few days. So where are you headed?
A Journey Home#041.dst: 坍方连那边的 grook 巢都压垮了。我已经靠野战口粮撑了好几天。那么你要去哪里？
A Journey Home#041.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#042.src: The border? I suppose if you're headed there, it must be important, official business. Although, it might have to wait.
A Journey Home#042.dst: 边境？既然你要去那里，我想一定是重要的公务。不过，可能得等等了。
A Journey Home#042.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#043.src: The bridge repair was something of a hackjob. It may not bear up your weight. Now that the cave-in's clear, we might be able to get it fixed proper...
A Journey Home#043.dst: 那座桥修得很马虎。它可能撑不住你的重量。现在坍方清掉了，我们也许能把它好好修一修……
A Journey Home#043.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#044.src: But that'll take time. I'd just as soon turn back whatever business you have isn't worth your life, after all.
A Journey Home#044.dst: 不过那需要时间。换作是我就直接回头了，毕竟不管你有什么事，都不值得赔上性命。
A Journey Home#044.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#046.src: Say, I think I recognize you, actually. That's a rarity for this line of work.
A Journey Home#046.dst: 说起来，我好像认得你。干这一行这种事很少见。
A Journey Home#046.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#047.src: Are you sure that what you have to do is worth it? That bridge is awful rickety. Wouldn't want to lose you.
A Journey Home#047.dst: 你确定你要做的事值得吗？那座桥摇摇晃晃的。可不想失去你。
A Journey Home#047.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#048.src: Continue back down the path to Fruma.
A Journey Home#048.dst: 沿着小路继续往回走向 Fruma。

A Journey Home#049.src: Hey, you there! Come talk to me before you pass through.
A Journey Home#049.dst: 嘿，你！过去之前先来跟我谈谈。
A Journey Home#049.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#050.src: Hey, you! Come talk to me first, recruit!
A Journey Home#050.dst: 嘿，你！先来跟我谈谈，新兵！
A Journey Home#050.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#051.src: Coming or going, I'm under strict orders to intercept soldiers and make sure they're equipped before heading on.
A Journey Home#051.dst: 不管是来是去，我都奉命拦下士兵，确保他们装备齐全才能继续前进。
A Journey Home#051.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#052.src: No exceptions, not for any reason. Especially not since the cave-in across the river!
A Journey Home#052.dst: 没有例外，不管什么理由都一样。尤其是河对岸坍方之后更是如此！
A Journey Home#052.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#053.src: Nothing's more important than your life, and moving on without being suited up could cost you it!
A Journey Home#053.dst: 没有什么比你的性命更重要，没穿好装备就往前走，可能会让你丢了命！
A Journey Home#053.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#054.src: Well, let me take a look and see if this stuff is up to regulation.
A Journey Home#054.dst: 好，让我看看这些装备合不合规定。
A Journey Home#054.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#055.src: Hmm... Ah, yep, signs of wear all over... Armor not polished... Weapon looks liable to fall apart any second...
A Journey Home#055.dst: 嗯……啊，没错，到处都是磨损的痕迹……盔甲没擦亮……武器看起来随时都会散架……
A Journey Home#055.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#056.src: I'm surprised you made it ten feet out here with those rusty trinkets! This is no way to protect yourself!
A Journey Home#056.dst: 真没想到你带着这些生锈的玩意还能走出十英尺！这样根本保护不了自己！
A Journey Home#056.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#057.src: Look, there's a loot chest in the cave just there, so you need to head in and get yourself some proper equipment.
A Journey Home#057.dst: 听着，那边的洞穴里有个战利品箱，你得进去给自己弄套像样的装备。
A Journey Home#057.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#058.src: ...that so, huh? Well, I think you should take a second look up ahead.
A Journey Home#058.dst: ……是这样吗，嗯？好吧，我觉得你该再往前看一眼。
A Journey Home#058.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#059.src: See? Now no more guff about levels you either gear up properly, or you don't pass! I won't have you risking your life.
A Journey Home#059.dst: 看到了吧？现在别再跟我扯什么等级了，要么把装备穿好，要么就别过去！我不会让你拿命冒险。
A Journey Home#059.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#060.src: You can find good stuff in caves, like the one just next to me, so hop to it.
A Journey Home#060.dst: 在洞穴里能找到好东西，就像我旁边这个，所以快去吧。
A Journey Home#060.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#061.src: Like I said, coming or going. No matter what, you should gear up by looting the cave here before heading onwards.
A Journey Home#061.dst: 就像我说的，不管是来是去。无论如何，继续前进之前，你都该先搜刮这里的洞穴把装备穿好。
A Journey Home#061.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#062.src: Good stuff. There's a loot chest in that cave there, so you should find everything you need. Get to it!
A Journey Home#062.dst: 很好。那边的洞穴里有个战利品箱，你需要的东西应该都找得到。去吧！
A Journey Home#062.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#063.src: Explore the cave to find some loot.

A Journey Home#064.src: Enter the cave and open the loot chest.
A Journey Home#064.dst: 进入洞穴，打开战利品箱。
A Journey Home#064.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#065.src: Continue back down the path to Fruma.
A Journey Home#065.dst: 沿着小路继续往回走向 Fruma。

A Journey Home#066.src: That looks like the stuff. You can take that armor to an Item Identifier right there, and then you can wear it once identified.
A Journey Home#066.dst: 看起来就是那些了。你可以把那件盔甲拿给那边的物品鉴定师，鉴定完就能穿了。
A Journey Home#066.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#067.src: Though... since you seem to be heading back to the border... I have to ask why. It's pretty unusual. Probably best you head back to {p}.
A Journey Home#067.dst: 不过……既然你好像是要回边境……我得问问为什么。这很少见。你最好还是回 {p} 吧。
A Journey Home#067.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#068.src: If other recruits see you coming the other way, they might get confused, or discouraged. Wouldn't want to risk that, right?
A Journey Home#068.dst: 要是其他新兵看到你往反方向走，他们可能会困惑，或者泄气。我们可不想冒这个险，对吧？
A Journey Home#068.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#069.src: Are you sure whatever you're doing is worth it? Maybe you should just head back to town.
A Journey Home#069.dst: 你确定你在做的事值得吗？也许你该直接回镇上去。
A Journey Home#069.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#070.src: Avoid the Fruman recruits on the path.
A Journey Home#070.dst: 避开小路上的 Fruma 新兵。

A Journey Home#071.src: ...been recruiting Fruman soldiers for the war effort. Apparently things are really bad over there. Makes me nervous...
A Journey Home#071.dst: ……一直在为战事招募 Fruma 的士兵。听说那边的情况真的很糟。让我有点紧张……
A Journey Home#071.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#072.src: Walking corpses aren't anything I'm going to underestimate, but it can't be all doom and gloom, right?
A Journey Home#072.dst: 行尸走肉可不是我会小看的东西，不过总不会全是坏消息吧？
A Journey Home#072.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#073.src: I suppose we'll see once we pass this gate. It marks the border... Deep breaths, deep breaths...
A Journey Home#073.dst: 我想等我们过了这道门就知道了。这里就是边境……深呼吸，深呼吸……
A Journey Home#073.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#074.src: ...know anything about Wynn? I didn't get any debriefing.
A Journey Home#074.dst: ……对 Wynn 有什么了解吗？我没听到任何简报。
A Journey Home#074.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#075.src: I remember rumors... Something about a great hero. Name started with...and R?
A Journey Home#075.dst: 我记得有些传闻……关于一位伟大的英雄。名字开头是……R？
A Journey Home#075.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#076.src: We'll make it a point to ask as soon as we can. Information's key to fighting wars.
A Journey Home#076.dst: 我们一有机会就去问问。情报是打仗的关键。
A Journey Home#076.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#077.src: ...rotten driver. I feel for the man, but he said he always hits that boulder. Sounds like his own fault to me.
A Journey Home#077.dst: ……烂透了的车夫。我同情那个人，可他说他每次都会撞上那块大石头。在我听来是他自己的错。
A Journey Home#077.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#078.src: I'm thinking about meals more than wheels. I feel like I haven't eaten in days. Hope the walk's short...
A Journey Home#078.dst: 我现在想的是饭，不是车。我觉得我好几天没吃东西了。希望这段路不长……
A Journey Home#078.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#079.src: Well, if he was a more competent driver you wouldn't have to walk so far on an empty stomach! Let's hurry so we can get you a feast, huh?
A Journey Home#079.dst: 嗯，要是他是个更称职的车夫，你就不用空着肚子走这么远了！我们快点走，好让你吃顿大餐，嗯？
A Journey Home#079.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#080.src: Wait, who's that? Why are they coming from the border??
A Journey Home#080.dst: 等等，那是谁？他们为什么从边境那边过来？？
A Journey Home#080.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#082.src: ...and that's the last of them for today.
A Journey Home#082.dst: ……今天的最后一批就是他们了。
A Journey Home#082.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#083.src: Lot of pairs today. Eight more in the wings... But that's for tomorrow.
A Journey Home#083.dst: 今天两两一组的真多。还有八个在后面等着……不过那是明天的事了。
A Journey Home#083.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#084.src: Same darn boulder... Same darn line, too. Wonder if they'll let me shake it up one day. This is always a pain...
A Journey Home#084.dst: 又是那块该死的大石头……还是那句该死的台词。不知道他们哪天会不会让我换个说法。每次都烦死了……
A Journey Home#084.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#085.src: And that's that about that. And now, to be off...to the home I choose. And there's no troubles to follow me there.
A Journey Home#085.dst: 就这样，没别的了。现在，出发……回我选择的家。没有烦恼会跟着我到那里。
A Journey Home#085.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#086.dst: 探索 Fruma 大门的另一边。

A Journey Home#087.src: Just couldn't take the hint, huh?
A Journey Home#087.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#088.src: Bet you think you're slick. Didn't even notice me hang back to watch, huh? I wasn't born yesterday.
A Journey Home#088.dst: 我打赌你觉得自己很机灵。连我留在后面盯着都没发现，是吧？我可不是昨天才出生的。
A Journey Home#088.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#089.src: Listen, this isn't the first time something like this has happened Y'know. Someone gets curious, retraces their steps.
A Journey Home#089.dst: 听着，这种事已经不是第一次发生了，你知道吗。有人起了好奇心，就沿着原路走回来。
A Journey Home#089.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#090.src: If you couldn't tell, this whole thing's meant to be a one way trip. The bridge, the cave-in, everyone trying to discourage you.
A Journey Home#090.dst: 如果你还没看出来，这整趟本来就是单程的。那座桥、那场坍方、每个人都想劝退你。
A Journey Home#090.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#091.src: It's not wise to be here- After all, you weren't the one out of your group of three that got permission to stay. Yeah, I heard about the tournament results.
A Journey Home#091.dst: 来这里不是明智之举，毕竟你们三人一组里，获准留下的那个人不是你。对，我听说比赛结果了。
A Journey Home#091.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#092.src: So...you got two choices, buddy. We can let this slide between us. We can. You can go marching right back to {p} and my lips will be sealed.
A Journey Home#092.dst: 所以……你有两个选择，老兄。这件事我们可以就当没发生过。真的可以。你可以走回 {p}，我会守口如瓶。
A Journey Home#092.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#093.src: Alas, I am afraid my hands are quite tied here. There is little I can do- you recall what I said in the meeting.
A Journey Home#093.dst: 唉，恐怕我在这件事上实在无能为力。我能做的很少——你还记得我在会议上说的话。

A Journey Home#094.src: Or, you can live life dangerously and follow me on the train to {p}. Better make your choice quick, though it's leaving soon.
A Journey Home#094.dst: 或者，你可以冒险跟着我搭上前往 {p} 的列车。不过最好快点决定，车马上就要开了。
A Journey Home#094.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#095.src: If I see you in the passenger cabin, well...that'll be that, and you'll just have to wait and see what comes of it.
A Journey Home#095.dst: 要是我在乘客车厢里看到你，嗯……那就这样了，你只能等着看会有什么下场。
A Journey Home#095.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#096.src: Join the Caravan Driver in the passenger car at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Journey Home#096.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的乘客车厢与商队车夫会合。

A Journey Home#097.src: Last chance to back out. This your choice?
A Journey Home#097.dst: 最后一次反悔的机会。这是你的选择？
A Journey Home#097.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#098.src: Well, you better get headed on the long walk back to {p} then.
A Journey Home#098.dst: 嗯，那你最好开始走那段回 {p} 的长路了。
A Journey Home#098.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#102.src: You know what they say about curiosity, and how it killed the cat. You the type to believe satisfaction'll bring it back?
A Journey Home#102.dst: 你知道大家怎么说好奇心吧，好奇心会害死猫。你是那种相信满足了好奇心就能让猫复活的人吗？
A Journey Home#102.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#103.src: Well, 'kittycat,' you didn't find the cream just the hound dogs.
A Journey Home#103.dst: 好啊，“小猫咪”，你没找到奶油，只找到了猎犬。
A Journey Home#103.speaker: Fruman Guard

A Journey Home#104.src: Intruder to Fruma, you are under arrest! Now march!
A Journey Home#104.dst: 闯入 Fruma 的人，你被捕了！现在走！
A Journey Home#104.speaker: Fruman Guard

A Journey Home#105.src: You really thought the Driver was on your side, intruder? What a fool you are. We gave you every chance to quit this endeavor, but here you are. Let's go.
A Journey Home#105.dst: 你真以为车夫站在你这边吗，闯入者？你真是个傻瓜。我们给了你每一个放弃的机会，可你还是来了。走吧。
A Journey Home#105.speaker: Commander Lilles

A Journey Home#106.dst: 指挥官！我们必须马上谈谈！
A Journey Home#106.speaker: Guard Captain

A Journey Home#107.src: I have urgent news to report from the gate.
A Journey Home#107.dst: 我有紧急消息要从大门那边报告。
A Journey Home#107.speaker: Guard Captain

A Journey Home#108.src: If it is truly so urgent, let's speak.
A Journey Home#108.dst: 如果真的这么紧急，我们就谈吧。
A Journey Home#108.speaker: Commander Lilles

A Journey Home#109.src: Soldiers! Keep the intruder still. I've every faith in you.
A Journey Home#109.dst: 士兵们！看住闯入者。我完全信任你们。
A Journey Home#109.speaker: Commander Lilles

A Journey Home#113.src: Anythin' I can help you with?
A Journey Home#113.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#114.src: Hm. Suppose there's no harm. But watch yourself, alright?
A Journey Home#114.dst: 嗯。我想也无妨。不过你自己小心点，好吗？
A Journey Home#114.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#115.src: This here's our home. I wouldn't take too kindly to you messin' anything up, understand?
A Journey Home#115.dst: 这里是我们的家。你要是把什么东西弄乱了，我可不会客气，懂吗？
A Journey Home#115.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#116.src: ...doin' alright, all things considered. Weather's nice, I suppose. Festival comin' up.
A Journey Home#116.dst: ……还过得去，考虑到各种情况的话。天气不错，我想。节日快到了。
A Journey Home#116.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#117.src: But that ain't none of our business, really. If you didn't need anythin' else, I'll kindly ask you to take your leave.
A Journey Home#117.dst: 不过那真的不关我们的事。如果你没别的事，我就客气地请你离开了。
A Journey Home#117.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#118.src: Hm. Good. Have a nice day, now.
A Journey Home#118.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#119.src: Hmm? And who may you be?
A Journey Home#119.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#120.src: Hoh, oh well. Might I help you with something?
A Journey Home#120.dst: 呵，噢，好吧。有什么我能帮你的吗？
A Journey Home#120.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#121.src: Ah, completing some assorted metalworking projects. There always seems to be something to replace or maintain around here...
A Journey Home#121.dst: 啊，在做些零零碎碎的金属加工活。这附近好像总有东西要换或要修……
A Journey Home#121.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#122.src: Though, I certainly am no expert! But I can handle the tools well enough, and that is all that is needed for the task.
A Journey Home#122.dst: 不过我可算不上专家！但工具我还用得来，而这份工作需要的也就这些。
A Journey Home#122.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#123.src: Farewell, stranger! I hope that you will return home safely.
A Journey Home#123.dst: 再见了，陌生人！希望你能平安回家。
A Journey Home#123.speaker: Mora

A Marauder's Dues#000.src: The very sight of you offends me! Let this gust of wind relieve me of your presence. Take it as a warning- you are not welcome here!
A Marauder's Dues#000.dst: 光是看到你就让我不快！让这阵风把你从我眼前吹走吧。就当是警告——这里不欢迎你！

A Marauder's Dues#001.src: ...rrgh! The tunnels! Once again, humans try so hard to spoil my fun... But do you really think you've evaded me?
A Marauder's Dues#001.dst: ……呃！那些隧道！人类又一次拼命坏我的兴致……但你真以为你躲得过我？

A Marauder's Dues#002.src: A dullard to the end, walking to your obliteration. I'm going to savor this delectable moment...it's been decades since I've rendered a human to dust!
A Marauder's Dues#002.dst: 蠢到最后一刻，自己走向毁灭。我要好好品味这美妙的时刻……我已经几十年没把人类化为尘土了！

A Marauder's Dues#003.src: A shard of the crystal seems to have remained behind. Maybe you can use this to escape!
A Marauder's Dues#003.dst: 水晶似乎留下了一块碎片。也许你能用它逃出去！

A Marauder's Dues#004.src: ...fine. The defenses of my tower were absolute enough that I never needed to defend myself inside. I should have taken you seriously from the start.
A Marauder's Dues#004.dst: ……好吧。我这座塔的防御天衣无缝，我在里面从来不需要亲自防守。我一开始就该认真对待你。

A Marauder's Dues#005.src: HA! I still get the last laugh! Even at my most vulnerable, I've gracefully outwitted you! As if I would really surrender to a human.
A Marauder's Dues#005.dst: 哈！笑到最后的还是我！就算在我最脆弱的时候，我也优雅地智胜了你！我怎么可能真的向人类投降。

A Marauder's Dues#006.src: I'll just drain Norsten's vitality to refill my own if you attack! There's nothing you can do- can't jump after the gem, can't defeat me! It's hopeless for you!
A Marauder's Dues#006.dst: 你敢攻击，我就吸干 Norsten 的生命力来补充我自己！你什么也做不了——跳不到宝石那里，也打不过我！你没希望了！

A Marauder's Dues#007.src: There's the strange gem that Dramele threw away... You should take it with you, he said it would save Norsten.
A Marauder's Dues#007.dst: 那就是 Dramele 扔掉的奇怪宝石……你应该带上它，他说它能救 Norsten。

A Marauder's Dues#008.src: Although the strange beings are now gone, some parts of them were left behind. They look very unstable.
A Marauder's Dues#008.dst: 那些奇怪的生物虽然消失了，却留下了一些残骸。它们看起来非常不稳定。

A Marauder's Dues#009.src: Perhaps if you combine them in the right way you can cause an explosion and escape.
A Marauder's Dues#009.dst: 也许以正确的方式把它们组合起来，就能引发爆炸并逃出去。

A Marauder's Dues#010.src: Goal: Get {~} Explosive Power by combining the {~} different cores in the grid made of green particles.
A Marauder's Dues#010.dst: 目标：在绿色粒子组成的网格中组合 {~2} 种不同的核心，获得 {~1} 点爆炸威力。

A Marauder's Dues#011.src: Right Click a core to select it, then Right Click one of the {~} green spots in the grid to place it there.
A Marauder's Dues#011.dst: 右键选择一个核心，再右键点击网格中 {~} 个绿点之一，把核心放到那里。

A Marauder's Dues#012.src: Remember, you need to get {~} Explosive Power! If you need a hint, click on Hints and Rules and select "I want a hint."
A Marauder's Dues#012.dst: 记住，你需要获得 {~} 点爆炸威力！需要提示的话，点击“提示与规则”并选择“我想要提示”。

A Marauder's Dues#013.src: That terrible wizard must have captured you in his spell when you did. It was terrible, it was- Such a hard look you had in your eyes...
A Marauder's Dues#013.dst: 你那时一定是被那个可怕的巫师用法术困住了。太可怕了，真的——你的眼神那么凶……

A Marauder's Dues#014.src: ...I barely remember anything. Just...feelings of anger, and...disgust, I suppose, but... You wouldn't lie to me, Grand-Peli.
A Marauder's Dues#014.dst: ……我几乎什么都不记得了。只有……愤怒的感觉，还有……大概是厌恶吧，可是……Grand-Peli，你不会骗我的。

A Marauder's Dues#016.src: ...ugh. Disgusting. Utterly disgusting. I've had just about enough of your kind here. Humans...
A Marauder's Dues#016.dst: ……呃。恶心。简直恶心透顶。我受够你们这种人在这里晃了。人类……
A Marauder's Dues#016.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#017.src: Dreadfully drab, always getting in the way, wriggling through our province like worms! You're no heroes, you're pretenders!!
A Marauder's Dues#017.dst: 单调乏味，总是碍手碍脚，像虫子一样在我们行省里钻来钻去！你们才不是什么英雄，你们是冒牌货！！
A Marauder's Dues#017.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#018.src: Oh, you want through here? Well, I'm the gatekeeper. Let's call my toll...the abandonment of your ridiculous little heroics...and all your money besides. Sound fair?
A Marauder's Dues#018.dst: 噢，你想从这里过去？好啊，我是守门人。我来开个过路费……放弃你那可笑的英雄梦……外加你所有的钱。很公平吧？
A Marauder's Dues#018.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#019.src: Aha, Norsten my boy! We've been worried sick, it's been a week. What is it you're doing so far out into the canyon?
A Marauder's Dues#019.dst: 啊哈，Norsten 我的孩子！我们都担心死了，已经一个星期了。你跑到峡谷这么远的地方来干什么？
A Marauder's Dues#019.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#020.src: Wha- Who are you, and who gave you permission to use my toll road?! And can't you see I'm busy?
A Marauder's Dues#020.dst: 什——你是谁，谁准你走我的收费路了？！你没看到我正忙着吗？
A Marauder's Dues#020.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#021.src: Norsten?? Don't you recognize your own grandfather? What's that strange look in your eyes, and what's this about a toll road?
A Marauder's Dues#021.dst: Norsten？？你连自己的爷爷都认不出来了？你眼神怎么这么怪，还有什么收费路？
A Marauder's Dues#021.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#022.src: You're nothing to me at your age. I only care about what the young can do for me...and about the fee you're neglecting, you shriveled old fruit!
A Marauder's Dues#022.dst: 你这把年纪对我来说什么都不是。我只在乎年轻人能为我做什么……还有你想赖掉的过路费，你这颗干瘪的老果子！
A Marauder's Dues#022.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#023.src: What's gotten into you? Such a polite man, acting this way to your elders... Human, have you any idea what's-
A Marauder's Dues#023.dst: 你这是怎么了？你一向那么有礼貌，竟然这样对长辈……人类，你知不知道这是——
A Marauder's Dues#023.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#024.src: ...oh no. Oh, say it isn't so, is that what's happening? Is it HIS fault?
A Marauder's Dues#024.dst: ……噢不。噢，千万别是真的，难道是那么回事？是他干的？
A Marauder's Dues#024.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#025.src: Up there, on the cliff- that tower! The scourge of the canyon...has he truly returned? Has he...taken my grandson?!
A Marauder's Dues#025.dst: 在那上面，悬崖上——那座塔！峡谷的祸害……他真的回来了？他……夺走了我的孙子？！
A Marauder's Dues#025.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#027.src: My reputation, even after all this time, still precedes me!! Indeed, old man, I have taken your grandson as my puppet!
A Marauder's Dues#027.dst: 这么多年过去了，我的名声还是走在我前面！！没错，老头，我把你孙子当成了我的傀儡！
A Marauder's Dues#027.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#028.src: What should I care about the facade? For a hundred and fifty years I've stolen the vitality of others to maintain my beauty, and your grandson will be no different.
A Marauder's Dues#028.dst: 我何必在乎伪装？一百五十年来，我一直偷取别人的活力来维持我的美貌，你孙子也不例外。
A Marauder's Dues#028.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#029.src: Miserable dastard!! Cold-water eel!! Human, you must help, you MUST! I beg you, please, seek the sorcerer and save my poor Norsten!!
A Marauder's Dues#029.dst: 可恶的恶棍！！冷水里的滑溜长虫！！人类，你一定要帮忙，一定要！我求求你，去找那个巫师，救救我可怜的 Norsten！！
A Marauder's Dues#029.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#030.src: The southwest mountains have a shortcut past the bandits, time is of the essence!
A Marauder's Dues#030.dst: 西南边的山里有条绕过强盗的捷径，时间紧迫！
A Marauder's Dues#030.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#031.src: A veritable army fell before my magic! The bandits pay their tribute to my grace and obey my orders! You're as mad as I am called if you think one human can get through.
A Marauder's Dues#031.dst: 一整支大军都倒在我的魔法之下！强盗们向我的风采进贡，听从我的命令！你要是以为一个人类就能闯过去，那你跟他们口中的我一样疯。
A Marauder's Dues#031.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#032.src: I'll leave you a corpse, a husk! A withered pile of dust- or perhaps I'll take YOU as a slave too, human! So what will it be? Run...or face me?
A Marauder's Dues#032.dst: 我会让你变成一具尸体，一副空壳！一堆枯萎的尘土——或者我也把你收作奴隶，人类！那么你选哪个？逃跑……还是面对我？
A Marauder's Dues#032.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#033.src: Go up the path to the wizard's tower, at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Marauder's Dues#033.dst: 沿着小路上去，前往 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的巫师之塔。

A Marauder's Dues#034.src: Hoho... The worm comes wriggling in, it seems. What a horrid thing you are. Mismatched armor, courage of a fool all over your face... Inelegant and UGLY!!
A Marauder's Dues#034.dst: 呵呵……看来虫子钻进来了。你真是个丑陋的东西。盔甲东拼西凑，满脸都是蠢货的勇气……不优雅又丑陋！！

A Marauder's Dues#035.src: At least the last ones to face me had some coordination, and the sense to hide themselves. Come further and you'll share their fate!!
A Marauder's Dues#035.dst: 至少上一批来对付我的人还懂得配合，也知道要躲起来。再往前走，你就会跟他们一样下场！！

A Marauder's Dues#036.src: ..rrgh! The tunnels! Once again, humans try so hard to spoil my fun... But do you really think you've evaded me?
A Marauder's Dues#036.dst: ……呃啊！隧道！人类又一次拼命想坏我的好事……但你真以为你躲过我了？

A Marauder's Dues#037.src: You can never understand. The beauty of one like myself cannot be transient, it must be everlasting! I will never succumb to my mortality!
A Marauder's Dues#037.dst: 你永远不会懂。像我这样的美，不能是短暂的，必须是永恒的！我绝不会屈服于死亡！

A Marauder's Dues#038.src: As a matter of fact...you humans ARE good for one thing. Drab as you are, you're lively. So consider this an honor!
A Marauder's Dues#038.dst: 说真的……你们人类确实有一个用处。虽然单调，但你们很有活力。所以就当这是你的荣幸吧！

A Marauder's Dues#039.src: HAAAAAhahahaha!! Instead of destruction, I'll leave you trapped in this illusion, and chip away at your ugly mind until nothing remains. You'll join the rest who've prolonged my life!
A Marauder's Dues#039.dst: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！！我不毁掉你，而是把你困在这个幻象里，一点一点削掉你那丑陋的心智，直到什么都不剩。你会加入那些替我延长寿命的人！

A Marauder's Dues#041.src: I'll take pleasure in peeling away your most formative memories first- W-wait, what's this giant blank spot? It's interfering with my spell...!!
A Marauder's Dues#041.dst: 我要先慢慢剥掉你最重要的那些记忆——等、等等，这一大片空白是怎么回事？它在干扰我的法术……！！

A Marauder's Dues#042.src: Ugh, barely any memories to remove, hardly any personality... How much of a dull gray slate are you...and how is that making this more difficult?!
A Marauder's Dues#042.dst: 呃，几乎没有记忆可以删，也几乎没有个性……你到底是块多么无聊的灰白石板……而且为什么这样反而更难搞？！

A Marauder's Dues#043.src: Run away and confront the wizard.
A Marauder's Dues#043.dst: 逃离，然后去找巫师对质。

A Marauder's Dues#044.src: You escaped?! ...hmph. I suppose that trick works better for blinding a platoon than a person. When you only need to focus on what YOU see...rrgh.
A Marauder's Dues#044.dst: 你逃出来了？！……哼。我想那一招拿来蒙蔽一整队人比对付一个人有用。只需要专注于自己看到的东西时……呃啊。

A Marauder's Dues#045.src: Fine...you've forced my hand. I must sweep you aside, you so-called hero! Never darken my door again! Cease to exist!!
A Marauder's Dues#045.dst: 好吧……是你逼我的。我必须把你扫到一边，你这所谓的英雄！永远别再踏进我的门！消失吧！！

A Marauder's Dues#047.src: Ugh, what was it that raisin of a man said- Miserable runt?! Cold-water eel?! More fitting names for you than me!!
A Marauder's Dues#047.dst: 呃，那个葡萄干一样的老头是怎么说的——可恶的小矮子？！冷水里的滑溜长虫？！这些名字更适合你，而不是我！！
A Marauder's Dues#047.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#048.src: ...fine. The defenses of my tower were absolute enough that I never needed to defend myself inside. I should have taken you more seriously from the start.
A Marauder's Dues#048.dst: ……好吧。我这座塔的防御完美到我从来不需要在里面自卫。我从一开始就该认真对待你。
A Marauder's Dues#048.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#049.src: It's been so long since I've faced a threat, and now that you're here- RRGH! How could a HUMAN get the best of me?
