Celebrations in Smoke#327.dst: 而看他们对一个易形者的人偶都那样，我完全不想知道要是他们真以为我是易形者会发生什么。
Celebrations in Smoke#327.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#328.src: I'll take whatever punishment my thievery gets me and move on.
Celebrations in Smoke#328.dst: 偷窃该受什么惩罚，我都认了，然后继续过日子。
Celebrations in Smoke#328.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#329.src: Of course, I'll talk about whatever you want.
Celebrations in Smoke#329.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#331.src: Of course. I'll talk about whatever you want.
Celebrations in Smoke#331.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#332.src: Yes. Being outside of a clan, there's no one particularly trustworthy in the {p}.
Celebrations in Smoke#332.dst: 是的。在氏族以外，{p} 里没有什么特别值得信任的人。
Celebrations in Smoke#332.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#333.src: With the changelings, even if I were to find a partner, I don't know how to make medallions and so could never be sure they weren't killed and replaced.
Celebrations in Smoke#333.dst: 有易形者在，就算我找到伙伴，我也不知道怎么做徽章，所以永远没法确定对方没有被杀掉取代。
Celebrations in Smoke#333.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#334.src: It's much easier this way, I assure you.
Celebrations in Smoke#334.dst: 这样轻松多了，我向你保证。
Celebrations in Smoke#334.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#335.src: Whoever I can. For the most part it's the clans, they can be shockingly lazy if you know where you're looking.
Celebrations in Smoke#335.dst: 谁都偷。大多是偷氏族的，只要你知道往哪看，他们懒散得惊人。
Celebrations in Smoke#335.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#336.src: I have stolen a bit from the military when their watch lapses, although that's obviously much harder to pull off.
Celebrations in Smoke#336.dst: 军队松懈的时候我也偷过一点，不过那显然难得多。
Celebrations in Smoke#336.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#337.src: Not personally, no. I've heard some rumors though.
Celebrations in Smoke#337.dst: 亲眼见过的没有。不过听过一些传闻。
Celebrations in Smoke#337.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#338.src: Hard to tell fact from fiction, but they certainly seem to be a nasty bunch.
Celebrations in Smoke#338.dst: 很难分辨真假，不过他们看起来确实是一群可恶的家伙。
Celebrations in Smoke#338.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#339.src: I wouldn't be surprised to hear one tried to break into the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#339.dst: 要是听说有一个想闯进庆典，我也不会意外。
Celebrations in Smoke#339.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#340.src: Of course, I'll talk about whatever you want.
Celebrations in Smoke#340.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#341.src: Not directly, no. But of the three of us, I was the farthest from where the flame was kindled.
Celebrations in Smoke#341.dst: 没有直接看到。不过我们三个人里，我离起火的地方最远。
Celebrations in Smoke#341.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#342.src: I may have seen one of the other two suspects move, but I can't be positive about that.
Celebrations in Smoke#342.dst: 我可能看到另外两个嫌疑人其中一个动了一下，但我不能确定。
Celebrations in Smoke#342.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#343.src: If I had more information I would of course provide it.
Celebrations in Smoke#343.dst: 如果我有更多情报，当然会提供。
Celebrations in Smoke#343.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#344.src: Ah, have you decided to try and play confrontational?
Celebrations in Smoke#344.dst: 啊，你决定要试试咄咄逼人了？
Celebrations in Smoke#344.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#345.src: That's fine, I will reiterate that I didn't do it. Whether you believe me or not, that is the truth.
Celebrations in Smoke#345.dst: 没关系，我再说一次，不是我做的。不管你信不信，那都是事实。
Celebrations in Smoke#345.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#346.src: My fate lies entirely in your hands, so to speak. You don't have to engage in theatrics to intimidate me, you are exactly as scary as you were before.
Celebrations in Smoke#346.dst: 可以说，我的命运完全掌握在你手里。你不必演戏来吓唬我，你跟之前一样吓人。
Celebrations in Smoke#346.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#347.src: Find someone who might have been observant enough to see Cerisa sneak in.
Celebrations in Smoke#347.dst: 找一个可能眼尖到看见 Cerisa 偷溜进来的人。

Celebrations in Smoke#348.src: Isn't it nice to see kids having fun?
Celebrations in Smoke#348.dst: 看到孩子们玩得开心真好，对吧？
Celebrations in Smoke#348.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#349.src: I try to lighten his life when I can, but it's so hard to some days.
Celebrations in Smoke#349.dst: 只要有机会我就想让他的生活轻松一点，可是有些日子真的好难。
Celebrations in Smoke#349.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#350.src: That's why I love the festival. Makes my job easier!
Celebrations in Smoke#350.dst: 所以我才喜欢庆典。让我的工作轻松多了！
Celebrations in Smoke#350.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#351.src: He can entertain himself, I can watch for danger.
Celebrations in Smoke#351.dst: 他能自己玩，我就能留意危险。
Celebrations in Smoke#351.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#352.src: Nothing obviously dangerous, but I always keep in mind.
Celebrations in Smoke#352.dst: 没有明显危险的，不过我一直都放在心上。
Celebrations in Smoke#352.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#353.src: I did see something very odd a few hours ago though. By the entrance to {p}, it looked like someone hopped over the fence.
Celebrations in Smoke#353.dst: 不过几个小时前我确实看到了很奇怪的事。在 {p} 的入口旁，好像有人翻过了栅栏。
Celebrations in Smoke#353.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#354.src: It might have been a trick of the light, but I think I saw them change clothes and shove something under the bridge.
Celebrations in Smoke#354.dst: 可能是光线造成的错觉，但我好像看到他们换了衣服，还把什么东西塞到了桥底下。
Celebrations in Smoke#354.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#355.src: Those might just be the ramblings of a worried old parent though!
Celebrations in Smoke#355.dst: 不过那可能只是一个操心的老家长的胡言乱语啦！
Celebrations in Smoke#355.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#356.src: Oh really? That's a shame, I thought I was stealthier than that.
Celebrations in Smoke#356.dst: 噢真的吗？真可惜，我还以为自己更隐蔽一点。
Celebrations in Smoke#356.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#357.src: I'm not sure that's a real revelation though, I've been open to you that that's what I did.
Celebrations in Smoke#357.dst: 不过我不确定这算不算真正的新发现，我已经跟你坦白过我是这样进来的了。
Celebrations in Smoke#357.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#358.src: Is there anything else you wanted to call me to account for?
Celebrations in Smoke#358.dst: 还有什么别的事想追究我吗？
Celebrations in Smoke#358.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#359.src: Yes, I had a change in clothes. The clothes I wear on a daily basis are no fit for a cheerful atmosphere like the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#359.dst: 是的，我换了衣服。我平常穿的衣服不适合庆典这种欢乐的气氛。
Celebrations in Smoke#359.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#360.src: In that case, I appreciate you keeping me up to date on the progress of your investigation. Your commitment to transparency in the judicial process is admirable.
Celebrations in Smoke#360.dst: 既然这样，谢谢你随时让我知道调查的进展。你对司法过程透明的坚持令人钦佩。
Celebrations in Smoke#360.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#361.src: Search under the bridge around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] for something Cerisa may have left behind.
Celebrations in Smoke#361.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 附近的桥底下寻找 Cerisa 可能留下的东西。

Celebrations in Smoke#363.src: That would be because it's mine.
Celebrations in Smoke#363.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#364.src: Your investigation is quite impressive, I'll admit. I was not expecting anyone to find those, I must not have disposed of them properly.
Celebrations in Smoke#364.dst: 我承认，你的调查相当了不起。我没想到会有人找到那些，一定是我没处理好。
Celebrations in Smoke#364.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#365.src: Although you did get a bit lucky, didn't you. If no one had spotted me sneak in, you never would have found them.
Celebrations in Smoke#365.dst: 不过你也有点运气好，不是吗。要是没人看到我偷溜进来，你永远也找不到。
Celebrations in Smoke#365.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#366.src: I am a deserter from the military, as of a couple days ago. My stop here is a temporary respite to steal whatever I can before disappearing into the {p} as far as I can.
Celebrations in Smoke#366.dst: 我是个逃兵，几天前才从军队逃出来。我在这里停留只是暂时歇脚，能偷多少就偷多少，然后尽可能远地消失在 {p} 里。
Celebrations in Smoke#366.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#367.src: No I didn't. I am a thief who came to the festival in part to steal petty trinkets. Nothing I told you was a lie.
Celebrations in Smoke#367.dst: 不，我没有。我是个小偷，来庆典有一部分就是为了偷点小玩意儿。我跟你说的都不是谎话。
Celebrations in Smoke#367.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#368.src: I'll grant that I did not tell you things you might have been interested in knowing, but that is only because you never asked about them.
Celebrations in Smoke#368.dst: 我承认有些你可能感兴趣的事我没告诉你，但那只是因为你从来没问过。
Celebrations in Smoke#368.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#369.src: Had you asked me if I was a former soldier, I would have provided you with all the information you are being given right now.
Celebrations in Smoke#369.dst: 要是你问我是不是当过兵，我就会把你现在得到的所有情报都告诉你。
Celebrations in Smoke#369.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#370.src: Yes, it is to a degree. But you have to understand, you trusting me isn't my only strategy to get out of this.
Celebrations in Smoke#370.dst: 是的，某种程度上是。但你得明白，让你信任我并不是我脱身的唯一策略。
Celebrations in Smoke#370.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#371.src: It was a gamble to avoid mentioning my desertion. I had to weigh the odds of you finding evidence of my desertion with the danger I might be in by admitting to it.
Celebrations in Smoke#371.dst: 不提我逃兵的事是一场赌博。我得权衡你找到我逃兵证据的可能性，以及承认之后我可能面临的危险。
Celebrations in Smoke#371.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#372.src: With hindsight, I bet wrongly, but I don't think my bet was irrational.
Celebrations in Smoke#372.dst: 事后看来，我赌错了，但我不认为我的赌注不理智。
Celebrations in Smoke#372.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#373.src: Had you been a worse investigator or gotten a bit less lucky, it would have paid off immensely.
Celebrations in Smoke#373.dst: 要是你调查得差一点，或者运气再差一点，这一把就能大赚一笔。
Celebrations in Smoke#373.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#374.src: And I trust that even now, you are a fair enough judicator you will look at the facts and only the facts.
Celebrations in Smoke#374.dst: 而我相信即使到了现在，你也是个足够公正的裁判，会只看事实。
Celebrations in Smoke#374.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#375.src: The facts that show I had nothing to do with what you're investigating.
Celebrations in Smoke#375.dst: 那些证明我跟你在调查的事毫无关系的事实。
Celebrations in Smoke#375.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#376.src: You could. And if you did you would be personally and entirely responsible for my death.
Celebrations in Smoke#376.dst: 你可以。而如果你那样做，你就要为我的死负完全的个人责任。
Celebrations in Smoke#376.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#377.src: Should you choose to, I hope my face haunts your nightmares for the rest of your life.
Celebrations in Smoke#377.dst: 如果你选择那样做，我希望我的脸在你余生的噩梦里阴魂不散。
Celebrations in Smoke#377.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#378.src: But I don't think you will.
Celebrations in Smoke#378.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#379.src: I'll admit I struggle to express this in words, but you don't seem the type.
Celebrations in Smoke#379.dst: 我承认我很难用言语表达，但你看起来不是那种人。
Celebrations in Smoke#379.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#380.src: You couldn't really go through with something like that.
Celebrations in Smoke#380.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#381.src: Of course, I'll talk about whatever you want.
Celebrations in Smoke#381.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#382.src: Military life was too stifling for me. So many direct orders that I can do nothing but obey.
Celebrations in Smoke#382.dst: 军队生活对我来说太压抑了。那么多直接命令，我除了服从什么都做不了。
Celebrations in Smoke#382.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#383.src: And it was so boring. Most of my time was spent standing still, watching for threats that never came.
Celebrations in Smoke#383.dst: 而且太无聊了。我大部分时间都站着不动，警戒从来没出现过的威胁。
Celebrations in Smoke#383.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#384.src: So I left. I wish them all the best and apologize to Her Majesty for my inability to serve her as I wanted to, but my time soured me on the whole affair.
Celebrations in Smoke#384.dst: 所以我走了。我祝他们一切顺利，也为无法如我所愿地效忠女王陛下向她道歉，但那段日子让我对整件事心生厌倦。
Celebrations in Smoke#384.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#385.src: Oh, I see you're getting better at this.
Celebrations in Smoke#385.dst: 噢，看来你越来越会问了。
Celebrations in Smoke#385.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#386.src: Yes, the other reason I left was the brutality of it. I do not handle blood well and was unprepared for the amount of blood I would see.
Celebrations in Smoke#386.dst: 是的，我离开的另一个原因是太残酷。我见不得血，也没准备好会看到那么多血。
Celebrations in Smoke#386.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#387.src: Most of the time, being a soldier is dull. Mind numbingly so. But the few times it was not made me wish more than anything in the world that I could be bored.
Celebrations in Smoke#387.dst: 当兵大部分时候都很乏味。乏味到让人麻木。但少数不乏味的时候，让我比世上任何事都更希望自己能无聊。
Celebrations in Smoke#387.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#388.src: I'm not even sure the violence was wrong, I just cannot participate in it.
Celebrations in Smoke#388.dst: 我甚至不确定那些暴力是错的，我只是没法参与其中。
Celebrations in Smoke#388.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#389.src: Unpleasant life at home. There was nothing for me to stay behind for. The military seemed like my best way out.
Celebrations in Smoke#389.dst: 家里的日子不好过。没什么值得我留下的。当兵看起来是我最好的出路。
Celebrations in Smoke#389.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#390.src: I think I would make the same choice again, even knowing how it would end. There's no way I could stay there for much longer.
Celebrations in Smoke#390.dst: 我想就算知道结局会怎样，我还是会做同样的选择。我不可能在那里再多待多久。
Celebrations in Smoke#390.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#391.src: Of course, I'll talk about whatever you want.
Celebrations in Smoke#391.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#392.src: Let me look at that more closely.
Celebrations in Smoke#392.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#393.src: No, I don't. The residue smells far more pungent than any drink I recognize.
Celebrations in Smoke#393.dst: 不，我不认得。这残留物的气味比我认得的任何饮料都刺鼻得多。
Celebrations in Smoke#393.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#394.src: If you found it here, you could try asking around the festival to see if anyone else recognizes it.
Celebrations in Smoke#394.dst: 如果你是在这里找到的，可以在庆典里四处问问，看看有没有别人认得。
Celebrations in Smoke#394.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#396.src: Well, I can tell you it's not definitely not green tea. Not sure beyond that.
Celebrations in Smoke#396.dst: 嗯，我可以告诉你这肯定不是绿茶。其他的就不确定了。
Celebrations in Smoke#396.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#397.src: Hmm... neither of us have seen anyone carrying something that smells like that in.
Celebrations in Smoke#397.dst: 嗯……我们俩都没看到有人带着闻起来像那样的东西进来。
Celebrations in Smoke#397.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#398.src: It would have had to have already been in {p} or they would have had to have arrived even before us.
Celebrations in Smoke#398.dst: 那东西要么早就在 {p} 里，要么就是他们比我们还早到。
Celebrations in Smoke#398.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#399.src: A broken bottle? It looks kind of like the ones we use for our Bottles of Mist, but the smell is totally different.
Celebrations in Smoke#399.dst: 破瓶子？看起来有点像我们装迷雾瓶用的瓶子，但味道完全不一样。
Celebrations in Smoke#399.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#400.src: Whoa, that's super cool! I bet those pointy edges could hurt a changeling pretty bad...
Celebrations in Smoke#400.dst: 哇，好酷！我打赌那些尖尖的边能把易形者伤得很惨……
Celebrations in Smoke#400.speaker: Excited Child

Celebrations in Smoke#401.src: Recognize it? No, but I wish I did!
Celebrations in Smoke#401.dst: 认得？不认得，但我真希望我认得！
Celebrations in Smoke#401.speaker: Excited Child

Celebrations in Smoke#402.src: That smell... I don't recognize it, I'm afraid. It certainly doesn't smell safe!
Celebrations in Smoke#402.dst: 那个味道……恐怕我不认得。闻起来肯定不安全！
Celebrations in Smoke#402.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#403.src: I don't recognize it. Would you mind putting it away though? The smell appears to be bothering a couple of the foxes.
Celebrations in Smoke#403.dst: 我不认得。不过你能把它收起来吗？那味道好像让几只狐狸不太舒服。
Celebrations in Smoke#403.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#405.src: It's vaguely familiar to me, but I'm sorry to say I can't place where from.
Celebrations in Smoke#405.dst: 我觉得有点眼熟，但很抱歉，我想不起来是在哪里见过。
Celebrations in Smoke#405.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#406.src: Whatever it is though, I certainly didn't bring it here.
Celebrations in Smoke#406.dst: 不管那是什么，我可没把它带来这里。
Celebrations in Smoke#406.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#407.src: aUm, no, I don't think so.
Celebrations in Smoke#407.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#408.src: Sorry if you were hoping I had.
Celebrations in Smoke#408.dst: 抱歉，如果你本来希望我见过的话。
Celebrations in Smoke#408.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#411.src: There's not much distinctive about it though, except for that odor.
Celebrations in Smoke#411.dst: 不过除了那股气味，它也没什么特别的。
Celebrations in Smoke#411.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#412.src: No. And we're in the middle of a conversation, please don't interrupt us.
Celebrations in Smoke#412.dst: 没有。而且我们正在聊天，请不要打断我们。
Celebrations in Smoke#412.speaker: Clan Member

Celebrations in Smoke#413.src: That bottle? Absolutely not, that smell is much more than what this old body could take.
Celebrations in Smoke#413.dst: 那个瓶子？绝对不认得，那气味我这把老骨头可受不了。
Celebrations in Smoke#413.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#415.src: But they paid me pretty good not to say!
Celebrations in Smoke#415.dst: 不过他们给了我不少钱让我别说！
Celebrations in Smoke#415.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#416.src: The only way I would is if I were to really be impressed by someone.
Celebrations in Smoke#416.dst: 唯一能让我开口的办法，就是真的有人让我刮目相看。
Celebrations in Smoke#416.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#418.src: Ha! I knew you couldn't do it.
Celebrations in Smoke#418.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#419.src: No hard feelings, nobody can expect to beat me at fox racing though.
Celebrations in Smoke#419.dst: 别往心里去，谁都不能指望在狐狸赛跑上赢过我。
Celebrations in Smoke#419.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#420.src: Of course, if you want to try again, you're free to. Just don't be surprised when you get the same result.
Celebrations in Smoke#420.dst: 当然，如果你想再试一次，随时欢迎。只是得到同样的结果时别惊讶。
Celebrations in Smoke#420.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#422.src: You won!? I-I-I've never been beaten!
Celebrations in Smoke#422.dst: 你赢了！？我——我——我从来没输过！
Celebrations in Smoke#422.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#423.src: I don't even know how that's possible, you looked like you were just picking randomly!
Celebrations in Smoke#423.dst: 我根本不知道这怎么可能，你看起来就像随便乱挑的！
Celebrations in Smoke#423.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#424.src: Well, fair is fair. You gave me a good show, I'll tell you what I know.
Celebrations in Smoke#424.dst: 好吧，愿赌服输。你让我看了一场好戏，我就把我知道的告诉你。
Celebrations in Smoke#424.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#425.src: It's really not that big of a deal, I'm not sure why they paid me to stay quiet about it.
Celebrations in Smoke#425.dst: 其实没什么大不了的，我也不知道他们为什么要付钱让我保密。
Celebrations in Smoke#425.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#426.src: While studying the foxes before the races started, I caught some members of the Kalkalrah clan bringing in bottles like those.
Celebrations in Smoke#426.dst: 比赛开始前我在研究狐狸的时候，看到几个 Kalkalrah 族的人带着那样的瓶子进来。
Celebrations in Smoke#426.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#427.src: I thought they were just green tea, but clearly they're not!
Celebrations in Smoke#427.dst: 我还以为只是绿茶，但显然不是！
Celebrations in Smoke#427.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#428.src: I'm not positive where they are now, but I think I saw them head up the zipline to the second floor of {p}?
Celebrations in Smoke#428.dst: 我不确定他们现在在哪，不过我好像看到他们搭滑索上了 {p} 的二楼？
Celebrations in Smoke#428.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#429.src: And if you'd teach me your racing technique at some point, I'd really appreciate it!
Celebrations in Smoke#429.dst: 还有，要是你哪天能教我你的赛跑技巧，我会非常感激的！
Celebrations in Smoke#429.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#430.src: Be careful with the accusations you throw around.
Celebrations in Smoke#430.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#431.src: Not everyone has their guard down around this festival for those who stick their noses where they don't belong.
Celebrations in Smoke#431.dst: 对那些把鼻子伸到不该伸的地方的人，不是每个人在庆典上都会松懈。
Celebrations in Smoke#431.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#432.src: Give me that, let me look at what you were showing them more closely.
Celebrations in Smoke#432.dst: 给我，让我仔细看看你刚才给他们看的东西。
Celebrations in Smoke#432.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#433.src: Ahhh, yes, you know something about that group, don't you?
Celebrations in Smoke#433.dst: 啊——对，你知道那伙人的一些事，对吧？
Celebrations in Smoke#433.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#434.src: You don't need to tell me, I know as much as you do and more.
Celebrations in Smoke#434.dst: 你不必告诉我，你知道的我都知道，而且知道得更多。
Celebrations in Smoke#434.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#435.src: It's been many years since I was able to freely move about the city, my old age imprisoning me in my home.
Celebrations in Smoke#435.dst: 我已经很多年没法在城里自由走动了，年纪把我困在家里。
Celebrations in Smoke#435.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#436.src: But I can still sit and watch the scurrying people below. I can see what they all do when they think nobody is watching.
Celebrations in Smoke#436.dst: 但我还能坐着看底下忙碌的人们。我能看到他们以为没人在看的时候都在做什么。
Celebrations in Smoke#436.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#437.src: It's a sort of power. A way to keep myself grounded, hanging here in the canopy.
Celebrations in Smoke#437.dst: 这是一种力量。让我挂在这树冠上，还能保持脚踏实地的方式。
Celebrations in Smoke#437.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#438.src: I watched you scramble to extinguish the fire and I watched what that group did after the flame was lit.
Celebrations in Smoke#438.dst: 我看着你手忙脚乱地灭火，也看着那伙人在火点起来之后做了什么。
Celebrations in Smoke#438.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#439.src: I watched as those three outsiders were corralled into custody.
Celebrations in Smoke#439.dst: 我看着那三个外人被押走看管。
Celebrations in Smoke#439.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#440.src: However, I cannot hear the details. I do not know the specifics.
Celebrations in Smoke#440.dst: 不过，我听不到细节。我不知道具体情况。
Celebrations in Smoke#440.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#441.src: Tell me what your suspects have done and what you have found. Then, I will give you what you seek.
Celebrations in Smoke#441.dst: 告诉我你的嫌疑人做了什么、你发现了什么。然后，我就给你你要找的东西。
Celebrations in Smoke#441.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#442.src: A bunch of lying outsiders then. To be expected, it's a pity you can't say they all did it.
Celebrations in Smoke#442.dst: 那就是一群说谎的外人。意料之中，可惜你不能说是他们全部一起干的。
Celebrations in Smoke#442.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#443.src: As for that clique, I suspect they're secretly security for the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#443.dst: 至于那个小团体，我怀疑他们暗地里是庆典的保安。
Celebrations in Smoke#443.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#444.src: I didn't see who lit the flame, but moments after it was lit, one of them threw a bottle just like the one you're holding at it.
Celebrations in Smoke#444.dst: 我没看到是谁点的火，但火点起来没多久，他们其中一个就朝火扔了一个跟你手上那个一模一样的瓶子。
Celebrations in Smoke#444.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#445.src: It must have been filled with fuel, because after it hit the flame grew much larger.
Celebrations in Smoke#445.dst: 里面一定装满了燃料，因为瓶子砸中之后火势大了很多。
Celebrations in Smoke#445.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#446.src: Probably for the best, you never know what vermin you can roast if you're not afraid to burn the bush.
Celebrations in Smoke#446.dst: 也许这样最好，只要不怕烧掉灌木丛，谁知道能烤出什么害虫来。
Celebrations in Smoke#446.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#447.src: If you will entertain an old woman, then I have no use for you. Quit blocking my view.
Celebrations in Smoke#447.dst: 如果你愿意陪一个老太婆消遣，那我对你就没什么用处了。别挡着我的视线。
Celebrations in Smoke#447.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#448.src: My investigator has returned. Now, tell me what you know.
Celebrations in Smoke#448.dst: 我的调查员回来了。现在，告诉我你知道些什么。
Celebrations in Smoke#448.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#449.src: You look like you have something on your mind, what is it?
Celebrations in Smoke#449.dst: 你看起来有心事，是什么？
Celebrations in Smoke#449.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#450.src: Ah, I see your investigations have borne fruit.
Celebrations in Smoke#450.dst: 啊，看来你的调查有成果了。
Celebrations in Smoke#450.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#451.src: Yes. As you have seen, people tend to let their guard down at the festival in a way they normally wouldn't.
Celebrations in Smoke#451.dst: 是的。如你所见，人们在庆典上往往会以平时不会有的方式放松警惕。
Celebrations in Smoke#451.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#452.src: They are a necessity to ensure any unexpected guests are swiftly taken care of.
Celebrations in Smoke#452.dst: 他们是确保任何不速之客都能被迅速处理的必要存在。
Celebrations in Smoke#452.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#453.src: I suspect you're probably right. And yet, that is irrelevant.
Celebrations in Smoke#453.dst: 我想你大概说得对。然而，那无关紧要。
Celebrations in Smoke#453.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#454.src: You will tell me they are reckless and a danger to others. I don't disagree, but I encourage you to look at the wider picture.
Celebrations in Smoke#454.dst: 你会跟我说他们鲁莽，对别人很危险。我不反对，但我鼓励你看看更大的局面。
Celebrations in Smoke#454.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#455.src: If we let up our vigilance for even a moment, we have already lost our war. Our clans and families will be infiltrated within the day.
Celebrations in Smoke#455.dst: 只要我们有片刻松懈，就已经输掉了这场战争。我们的氏族和家庭一天之内就会被渗透。
Celebrations in Smoke#455.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#456.src: Their recklessness prevents this. In a case where the smallest failure would be a catastrophe, recklessness becomes necessity.
Celebrations in Smoke#456.dst: 他们的鲁莽防止了这种事。在最小的失误都会酿成灾难的情况下，鲁莽就成了必要。
Celebrations in Smoke#456.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#457.src: Imagine they had not acted rashly in throwing the bottle of fuel onto the already lit flame.
Celebrations in Smoke#457.dst: 想象一下，如果他们没有冒失地把那瓶燃料扔到已经点着的火上。
Celebrations in Smoke#457.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#458.src: They did not create the flame, someone else must have been hoping to gain from it.
Celebrations in Smoke#458.dst: 火不是他们放的，一定是别人想从中得利。
Celebrations in Smoke#458.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#459.src: Their actions, while dangerous, prevented any fiends from exploiting the opportunity. We took it out of their control.
Celebrations in Smoke#459.dst: 他们的行动虽然危险，却防止了任何恶徒利用这个机会。我们把局面从他们手中夺了回来。
Celebrations in Smoke#459.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#460.src: Whatever risk their actions created was worth the price.
Celebrations in Smoke#460.dst: 无论他们的行动带来什么风险，都值得这个代价。
Celebrations in Smoke#460.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#461.src: Apologies for rambling, I assure you though that safety is our top concern. Whatever the price.
Celebrations in Smoke#461.dst: 抱歉我说了这么多，不过我向你保证，安全是我们的首要考量。不惜任何代价。
Celebrations in Smoke#461.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#462.src: Return to the festival organizer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] or look into the suspects a bit more.
Celebrations in Smoke#462.dst: 回到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的庆典主办人那里，或再多调查一下嫌疑人。

Celebrations in Smoke#463.src: You think you know who the changeling is?
Celebrations in Smoke#463.dst: 你觉得你知道谁是易形者了？
Celebrations in Smoke#463.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#464.src: You've dug into them all and have found something? Excellent.
Celebrations in Smoke#464.dst: 你把他们全都查过一遍，发现了什么？太好了。
Celebrations in Smoke#464.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#465.src: So, who do you think tried to burn down the wickerman?
Celebrations in Smoke#465.dst: 那么，你认为是谁想烧掉柳条人？
Celebrations in Smoke#465.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#466.src: Suspect {~}? Very well. I will take care of things from here.
Celebrations in Smoke#466.dst: 嫌疑人 {~}？很好。接下来就交给我处理。
Celebrations in Smoke#466.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#467.src: Again, thank you so much for your help. I cannot emphasize enough how much you assisting in this matter for us allowed the festival to be a success.
Celebrations in Smoke#467.dst: 再次非常感谢你的帮忙。你在这件事上的协助让庆典得以成功举办，我怎么强调都不为过。
Celebrations in Smoke#467.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#468.src: Enjoy the rest of the festival, and make sure to watch the wickerman burn! I'll save a special seat for you near the front as a sign of our appreciation.
Celebrations in Smoke#468.dst: 好好享受剩下的庆典，一定要看柳条人燃烧！我会在前排为你留个特别的座位，聊表谢意。
Celebrations in Smoke#468.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#469.src: Suspect {~}? Very well. I will take care of things from here.
Celebrations in Smoke#469.dst: 嫌疑人 {~}？很好。接下来就交给我处理。
Celebrations in Smoke#469.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#470.src: Again, thank you so much for your help. I cannot emphasize enough how much you assisting in this matter for us allowed the festival to be a success.
Celebrations in Smoke#470.dst: 再次非常感谢你的帮忙。你在这件事上的协助让庆典得以成功举办，我怎么强调都不为过。
Celebrations in Smoke#470.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#471.src: Enjoy the rest of the festival, and make sure to watch the wickerman burn! I'll save a special seat for you near the front as a sign of our appreciation.
Celebrations in Smoke#471.dst: 好好享受剩下的庆典，一定要看柳条人燃烧！我会在前排为你留个特别的座位，聊表谢意。
Celebrations in Smoke#471.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#472.src: Suspect {~}? Very well. I will take care of things from here.
Celebrations in Smoke#472.dst: 嫌疑人 {~}？很好。接下来就交给我处理。
Celebrations in Smoke#472.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#473.src: Again, thank you so much for your help. I cannot emphasize enough how much you assisting in this matter for us allowed the festival to be a success.
Celebrations in Smoke#473.dst: 再次非常感谢你的帮忙。你在这件事上的协助让庆典得以成功举办，我怎么强调都不为过。
Celebrations in Smoke#473.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#474.src: Enjoy the rest of the festival, and make sure to watch the wickerman burn! I'll save a special seat for you near the front as a sign of our appreciation.
Celebrations in Smoke#474.dst: 好好享受剩下的庆典，一定要看柳条人燃烧！我会在前排为你留个特别的座位，聊表谢意。
Celebrations in Smoke#474.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#475.src: I understand your reticense to pick one. We don't have anything close to the information required to make a proper judgement.
Celebrations in Smoke#475.dst: 我理解你不愿意选一个。我们手上的情报远远不足以做出正确的判断。
Celebrations in Smoke#475.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#476.src: But you cannot allow that to stop you. We do not have the luxury to close our eyes and pretend it didn't happen.
Celebrations in Smoke#476.dst: 但你不能因此停下。我们没有闭上眼睛、假装什么都没发生的余裕。
Celebrations in Smoke#476.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#477.src: Please, from the inevitably incomplete investigation you conducted, tell me who you think lit that flame.
Celebrations in Smoke#477.dst: 拜托，根据你那必然不完整的调查，告诉我你认为是谁点的火。
Celebrations in Smoke#477.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#478.src: Very well then. I am disappointed, but understand.
Celebrations in Smoke#478.dst: 很好。我很失望，但我能理解。
Celebrations in Smoke#478.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#479.src: I will take care of things from this point forward.
Celebrations in Smoke#479.dst: 从现在起，这件事交给我处理。
Celebrations in Smoke#479.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#480.src: In thanks for saving the wickerman, there will be a seat saved for you when you are ready to watch it burn.
Celebrations in Smoke#480.dst: 为了感谢你救下柳条人，等你准备好观看它燃烧时，会有一个座位为你保留。
Celebrations in Smoke#480.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#481.src: Enjoy the rest of the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#481.dst: 好好享受剩下的庆典吧。
Celebrations in Smoke#481.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#482.src: Keep looking then. Return here once you've made a decision.
Celebrations in Smoke#482.dst: 那就继续调查吧。做好决定再回来这里。
Celebrations in Smoke#482.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#485.src: You children of the {p} gather round
Celebrations in Smoke#485.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#486.src: To gaze upon this relic from years past,
Celebrations in Smoke#486.dst: 凝望这件来自往昔岁月的遗物，
Celebrations in Smoke#486.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#487.src: This effigy, of ancient foes we fought—
Celebrations in Smoke#487.dst: 这尊人偶，是我们曾经对抗的古老宿敌——
Celebrations in Smoke#487.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#488.src: In memory, we will again ignite!
Celebrations in Smoke#488.dst: 为了铭记，我们将再次将它点燃！
Celebrations in Smoke#488.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#489.src: An ancient beast, rebuilt with plank and straw,
Celebrations in Smoke#489.dst: 一头古老的野兽，以草木与稻秆重塑，
Celebrations in Smoke#489.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#490.src: What once was flesh, reconstitute as wood;
Celebrations in Smoke#490.dst: 昔日的血肉，如今化作木头重生；
Celebrations in Smoke#490.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#491.src: All monsters, old and new, must meet their end—
Celebrations in Smoke#491.dst: 一切怪物，无论新旧，都必须迎来终结——
Celebrations in Smoke#491.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#492.src: All fiends must burn! Must broil and char and melt!
Celebrations in Smoke#492.dst: 一切恶徒都必须焚烧！必须炙烤、焦黑、熔化！
Celebrations in Smoke#492.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#493.src: Substance beside, all that remains persists...
Celebrations in Smoke#493.dst: 形体之外，残存的一切依然留存……
Celebrations in Smoke#493.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#494.src: ...as blackened corpse, no threat there can exist!
Celebrations in Smoke#494.dst: ……化作焦黑的尸骸，再不能构成威胁！
Celebrations in Smoke#494.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#495.src: Oh, hi, I never got the chance to thank you.
Celebrations in Smoke#495.dst: 噢，你好，我一直没机会谢谢你。
Celebrations in Smoke#495.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#496.src: I'm not sure what happened after you left.
Celebrations in Smoke#496.dst: 我不太清楚你走之后发生了什么。
Celebrations in Smoke#496.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#497.src: The festival organizer came back and took Burick/Cerisa away with him.
Celebrations in Smoke#497.dst: 庆典主办人回来，把 Burick/Cerisa 带走了。
Celebrations in Smoke#497.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#498.src: I'm not sure what happened but, um, I don't think it was good.
Celebrations in Smoke#498.dst: 我不知道发生了什么，不过，呃，我觉得不是好事。
Celebrations in Smoke#498.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#499.src: So, thank you again. I wasn't really in the right mind enough to show it then.
Celebrations in Smoke#499.dst: 所以，再次谢谢你。当时我脑子一团乱，没能好好表达。
Celebrations in Smoke#499.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#501.src: I'll see how long I can hang around here, but the locals are beginning to glare at me a bit.
Celebrations in Smoke#501.dst: 我会看看能在这附近待多久，不过当地人已经开始有点瞪我了。
Celebrations in Smoke#501.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#502.src: I might try to head deeper into the woods, see if there's anything I can find.
Celebrations in Smoke#502.dst: 我可能会试着往树林更深处去，看看能找到什么。
Celebrations in Smoke#502.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#503.src: Or join the military? I don't think I'd be very good at it and I don't even think they'd accept me, but it might be worth a shot.
Celebrations in Smoke#503.dst: 或者去参军？我觉得我不会很擅长，甚至不觉得他们会收我，但也许值得一试。
Celebrations in Smoke#503.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#504.src: Otherwise, all I can do is try to live off of what I can find. I, uh, don't like my chances with that.
Celebrations in Smoke#504.dst: 不然，我就只能靠找到的东西过活了。我，呃，不太看好自己的机会。
Celebrations in Smoke#504.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#505.src: I am! I'm always a, uh, little nervous. But a lot less than I was.
Celebrations in Smoke#505.dst: 我是！我一直都，呃，有点紧张。不过比那时候好多了。
Celebrations in Smoke#505.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#506.src: It felt like the axe that had been pressed against my neck was lifted, thanks to you.
Celebrations in Smoke#506.dst: 多亏了你，感觉就像压在我脖子上的斧头被拿开了。
Celebrations in Smoke#506.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#507.src: There's still a lot of uncertainty, but I no longer feel like I'm scrambling like a rabbit in a cage.
Celebrations in Smoke#507.dst: 还是有很多不确定，但我不再觉得自己像笼子里乱窜的兔子了。
Celebrations in Smoke#507.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#508.src: I was still in a bit of a daze, so not really, sorry.
Celebrations in Smoke#508.dst: 我那时候还有点恍惚，所以没怎么注意，抱歉。
Celebrations in Smoke#508.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#509.src: She left pretty quick though, she must have been in a hurry to get somewhere
Celebrations in Smoke#509.dst: 不过她走得很快，一定是急着去什么地方
Celebrations in Smoke#509.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#511.src: Hello. Please try not to come too close.
Celebrations in Smoke#511.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#512.src: We can talk from a distance.
Celebrations in Smoke#512.dst: 我们可以隔着距离说话。
Celebrations in Smoke#512.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#513.src: Apologies for the coolness, your help was appreciated.
Celebrations in Smoke#513.dst: 抱歉这么冷淡，你的帮忙我很感激。
Celebrations in Smoke#513.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#514.src: But I cannot be sure you are who you say you are.
Celebrations in Smoke#514.dst: 但我无法确定你就是你说的那个人。
Celebrations in Smoke#514.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#516.src: Since our run in at the festival, I have been laying lower than usual.
Celebrations in Smoke#516.dst: 自从我们在庆典上碰面之后，我一直比平常更低调。
Celebrations in Smoke#516.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#517.src: My life has not been much different than it usually is.
Celebrations in Smoke#517.dst: 我的生活跟平时没什么两样。
Celebrations in Smoke#517.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#518.src: It was a horrific mistake to even attend the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#518.dst: 去参加庆典本身就是个可怕的错误。
Celebrations in Smoke#518.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#519.src: I allowed myself to be controlled by my own humanity; that is a mistake the {p} rarely lets off easily.
Celebrations in Smoke#519.dst: 我让自己被人性左右了；在 {p}，这种错误很少能轻易了事。
Celebrations in Smoke#519.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#520.src: I will not make the same mistake again. Loneliness will hurt, but trust will kill.
Celebrations in Smoke#520.dst: 我不会再犯同样的错。寂寞会伤人，但信任会杀人。
Celebrations in Smoke#520.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#521.src: Last I saw, they were still in {p}.
Celebrations in Smoke#521.dst: 我最后一次看到的时候，他们还在 {p}。
Celebrations in Smoke#521.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#522.src: They don't seem cut out for the life of a scavenger, if they can't find any other way to live outside a clan they'll be dead within the week.
Celebrations in Smoke#522.dst: 他们看起来不是当拾荒者的料，要是找不到在氏族之外生活的其他办法，一个星期内就会没命。
Celebrations in Smoke#522.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#524.src: Yes, while everyone else was watching the wickerman burn she rustled through as many abandoned stalls, bags, and houses as she could.
Celebrations in Smoke#524.dst: 是的，趁大家都在看柳条人燃烧的时候，她把能翻的无人摊位、包包和房子都翻了个遍。
Celebrations in Smoke#524.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#525.src: I left before she was finished, but this morning I saw a figure walking south out of {p}, carrying several large bags.
Celebrations in Smoke#525.dst: 她还没翻完我就走了，不过今天早上我看到一个人影从 {p} 往南走，扛着好几个大包。
Celebrations in Smoke#525.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#526.src: Wherever she's headed, she's prepared for a long trek.
Celebrations in Smoke#526.dst: 不管她要去哪里，她都准备好走很远的路了。
Celebrations in Smoke#526.speaker: Burick

Clearing the Camps#000.src: Talk to Captain Kymer outside {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Clearing the Camps#000.dst: 与 {p} 外 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Kymer 队长对话

Clearing the Camps#001.src: Aha, another {p} soldier, eh? Well, a warm welcome to you.
Clearing the Camps#001.dst: 啊哈，又一个 {p} 的士兵，是吧？好啊，热烈欢迎。
Clearing the Camps#001.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#002.src: Did you hear about the requests from the Villagers we've gotten? They say these "Orcs" and "Goblins" are threatening their towns and cities.
Clearing the Camps#002.dst: 你听说我们收到的村民请求了吗？他们说那些“兽人”和“哥布林”正在威胁他们的城镇。
Clearing the Camps#002.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#003.src: Primitive, brutal creatures, apparently little better than the zombies we're used to, at least according to the {p} military.
Clearing the Camps#003.dst: 据说是些原始又野蛮的生物，比我们平常对付的僵尸好不了多少——至少 {p} 军方是这么说的。
Clearing the Camps#003.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#004.src: So, we figure if might makes right with them, then defeating their leaders should scare them into submission.
Clearing the Camps#004.dst: 所以我们想，既然对它们来说拳头大就是道理，那打败它们的首领应该就能把它们吓得服服帖帖。
Clearing the Camps#004.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#005.src: Our scouts have identified three "chief" orcs in the area- Elisu, Ceifko and Veltu. Though, strangely Veltu is always surrounded by goblins...
Clearing the Camps#005.dst: 我们的斥候在这一带找到了三个兽人“酋长”——Elisu、Ceifko 和 Veltu。不过奇怪的是，Veltu 身边总是围着哥布林……
Clearing the Camps#005.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#006.src: Well, whatever the case, we're needed to defend {p} here. Can you handle the chiefs? They seem to hide in the camps with green flags- search the plains, return once they're dealt with!
Clearing the Camps#006.dst: 好了，不管怎样，这里需要我们守着 {p}。那些酋长你能对付吗？它们好像躲在插着绿旗的营地里——去平原上搜一搜，解决之后再回来！
Clearing the Camps#006.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#007.src: Find and kill Orc Chieftains Elisu, Veltu, and Ceifko in the camps around {p}- look for green flags
Clearing the Camps#007.dst: 在 {p} 周围的营地找到并击杀兽人酋长 Elisu、Veltu 和 Ceifko——留意绿色旗帜

Clearing the Camps#008.src: Report back to Captain Kymer once you have the three heads.
Clearing the Camps#008.dst: 拿到三颗首级后，回去向 Kymer 队长报告。

Clearing the Camps#009.src: Ah, the soldier from earlier! You're back, I see. Any luck defeating those- ...yeesh. Are those their heads?
Clearing the Camps#009.dst: 啊，刚才那个士兵！看来你回来了。打败那些家伙的事顺利——……哎哟。那是它们的头？
Clearing the Camps#009.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#010.src: That's...harsher than I intended, but it works... Not like the Villagers care if they're dead of alive, as long as they're dealt with. I have your share of the reward here.
Clearing the Camps#010.dst: 这……比我预想的狠了点，不过也行……反正村民也不在乎它们是死是活，只要解决了就好。你那份奖励在我这儿。
Clearing the Camps#010.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#011.src: This kind of surgical strike should help prevent an all-out war with the Orcs. Not sure we'd want a full-scale war to deal with in each province, hah!
Clearing the Camps#011.dst: 这种精准打击应该能避免跟兽人全面开战。我们可不想每个行省都得打一场全面战争，哈！
Clearing the Camps#011.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#012.src: You saw that the creatures in Gavel aren't akin to Wynnic fare while you were out, yes? They're a bit, ah...livelier than usual. Better get used to it.
Clearing the Camps#012.dst: 你出去的时候发现了吧，Gavel 的生物跟 Wynn 那边的不太一样？它们有点，呃……比平常更有活力。最好早点习惯。
Clearing the Camps#012.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#013.src: The next major settlement is {p}, in the swamp up north, but I hear the swamp ogres are a lot tougher than the plains' fare. I'd stick around here and train up, first.
Clearing the Camps#013.dst: 下一个大聚落是北边沼泽里的 {p}，不过我听说沼泽食人魔比平原上的家伙难对付多了。我会先留在这附近练练。
Clearing the Camps#013.speaker: Captain Kymer

Cluck Cluck#001.src: Hey, you aren't a chicken! Wait, you're a human! You can help me! Maybe you are the guy who helped my brother Yahya, but who knows, you humans all look the same to me.
Cluck Cluck#001.dst: 嘿，你不是鸡！等等，你是人类！你能帮我！说不定你就是帮过我兄弟 Yahya 的那个人，不过谁知道呢，你们人类在我看来都长一个样。
Cluck Cluck#001.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#002.src: I really love my chickens, but there is one that I just cannot control...
Cluck Cluck#002.dst: 我真的很爱我的鸡，可是有一只我怎么也管不住……
Cluck Cluck#002.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#003.src: His name is Cluckles, he was given to me by a man named Bob before he went to war, but when Bob never came back, Cluckles got angry...
Cluck Cluck#003.dst: 它叫 Cluckles，是一个叫 Bob 的人上战场前送给我的。可是 Bob 一直没回来，Cluckles 就发怒了……
Cluck Cluck#003.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#004.src: He's really dangerous to keep on my lovely island, so I keep him in my basement...
Cluck Cluck#004.dst: 把它留在我可爱的小岛上太危险了，所以我把它关在地下室……
Cluck Cluck#004.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#005.src: I want to take care of him, but my wife says it's too dangerous. Where's my wife you say? Oh, I think she's around here eating some grain.
Cluck Cluck#005.dst: 我想好好照顾它，可我老婆说太危险了。你问我老婆在哪？噢，我想她就在这附近吃谷子吧。
Cluck Cluck#005.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#006.src: Anyway, I need you to go down there and... Take care of him for me. I would really appreciate it.
Cluck Cluck#006.dst: 总之，我需要你下去……帮我把它料理好。我会非常感激的。
Cluck Cluck#006.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#007.src: Bring back [{~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather] to Nohno.
Cluck Cluck#007.dst: 把 [{~} Cluckles 最爱的羽毛] 带回给 Nohno。

Cluck Cluck#008.src: What is this?! His feather? What did you do to Cluckles?! I wanted you to take care of him, not kill him!
Cluck Cluck#008.dst: 这是什么？！它的羽毛？你对 Cluckles 做了什么？！我是要你照顾它，不是要你杀了它！
Cluck Cluck#008.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#009.src: You monster! Leave this place now, and keep that feather to remind you of your hideous crime!
Cluck Cluck#009.dst: 你这个怪物！马上离开这里，留着那根羽毛，让它提醒你犯下的可怕罪行！
Cluck Cluck#009.speaker: Nohno

Cook Assistant#000.src: Talk to the Cook in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Cook Assistant#001.src: I can't believe what is happening to me.
Cook Assistant#001.dst: 真不敢相信这种事会落到我头上。
Cook Assistant#001.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#002.src: The King ordered me to bake cakes for all those new recruits!
Cook Assistant#002.dst: 国王命令我给所有新兵烤蛋糕！
Cook Assistant#002.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#003.src: Unfortunately, a Grook took my last cake, and I ran out of ingredients!
Cook Assistant#003.dst: 不幸的是，一只 Grook 拿走了我最后一个蛋糕，我的材料也用完了！
Cook Assistant#003.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#005.src: That's the Grook! Go chase it down and get my cake back!
Cook Assistant#005.dst: 就是那只 Grook！快去追，把我的蛋糕抢回来！
Cook Assistant#005.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#007.src: The Grook got away! Return to the Cook at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to figure out what to do.
Cook Assistant#007.dst: Grook 跑掉了！回到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的厨师那里，想想该怎么办。

Cook Assistant#008.src: What are you doing? Go after the Grook...
Cook Assistant#008.dst: 你在干什么？快去追那只 Grook……
Cook Assistant#008.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#010.src: Well, I guess you are going to have to help me find the ingredients and bake another...
Cook Assistant#010.dst: 好吧，看来你得帮我找材料，再烤一个……
Cook Assistant#010.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#011.src: There he is again! After him!
Cook Assistant#011.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#012.src: Find out where the Grook flew up to at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Cook Assistant#012.dst: 找出 Grook 飞到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的哪里去了。

Cook Assistant#013.src: Return to the cook at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. Use a Scroll to get there faster.
Cook Assistant#013.dst: 回到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的厨师那里。用卷轴能更快到达。

Cook Assistant#015.src: I can't thank you enough! Here, take these emeralds and armour for all your trouble.
Cook Assistant#015.dst: 真是太感谢你了！来，收下这些绿宝石和护甲，辛苦你了。
Cook Assistant#015.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#016.src: You should explore around to become stronger. I hear there might be work to do in {p}.
Cook Assistant#016.dst: 你应该到处探索，让自己变强。我听说 {p} 可能有活要干。
Cook Assistant#016.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#017.src: I can't believe what is happening to me...
Cook Assistant#017.dst: 我简直不敢相信我遇上了这种事……

Cook Assistant#018.dst: 那么，你能帮上什么忙呢……

Cook Assistant#019.src: Wait! That's the Grook! Go chase it down and get my cake back!
Cook Assistant#019.dst: 等等！就是那只 Grook！快去追，把我的蛋糕抢回来！

Corrupted Betrayal#001.src: Hey, soldier! Yeah, you! Got some spare time to lend a hand?
Corrupted Betrayal#001.dst: 嘿，士兵！对，就是你！有空搭把手吗？
Corrupted Betrayal#001.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#002.src: We've got a major issue with this old fortress. It keeps spewing out all these damned slimes, and their proximity to {p} is causing issues.
Corrupted Betrayal#002.dst: 这座老要塞出了个大问题。它不停地冒出一堆该死的史莱姆，而且离 {p} 太近，惹了不少麻烦。
Corrupted Betrayal#002.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#003.src: Soldiers are spending half their guard duty slicing the critters into sludge. Ideally we'd raid the cave, cut out the source, but...
Corrupted Betrayal#003.dst: 士兵们站岗的时间有一半都花在把这些小东西剁成烂泥上。最好是突袭洞窟，把源头除掉，可是……
Corrupted Betrayal#003.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#004.src: This place has some history. Nasty stuff. I'd prefer not to head in blind, so I've been checking for any clues to what we might find inside.
Corrupted Betrayal#004.dst: 这地方有些历史。不好的历史。我不想瞎闯进去，所以一直在找线索，看看里面可能有什么。
Corrupted Betrayal#004.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#005.src: Haven't found much... except this verse, 'scribed into the wall over there. Go on, check it out and let me know what you think.
Corrupted Betrayal#005.dst: 没找到多少……只有那边墙上刻的这首诗。去看看，然后告诉我你怎么想。
Corrupted Betrayal#005.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#006.src: Nonsense, if you ask me. Most likely kids from {p} messing about. But we haven't found anything else, so... if you've got any time, fancy checking it out for me?
Corrupted Betrayal#006.dst: 要我说全是胡扯。多半是 {p} 的小孩在瞎闹。可我们也没找到别的，所以……如果你有空，能帮我去查查吗？
Corrupted Betrayal#006.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#007.src: The first line is obviously talking about the Great Bridge, but I've no clue what the rest means. Head over there, take a look around, and tell me if you find anything interesting.
Corrupted Betrayal#007.dst: 第一句显然说的是大桥，可剩下的意思我完全摸不着头脑。去那边四处看看，找到什么有意思的就告诉我。
Corrupted Betrayal#007.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#008.src: Found anything interesting around the riddle yet? Do you need to hear it again?
Corrupted Betrayal#008.dst: 在谜题附近找到什么有意思的了吗？要不要再听一遍？
Corrupted Betrayal#008.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#009.src: Near a corrupted bridge, a ruin past its prime..
Corrupted Betrayal#009.dst: 腐化的桥边，废墟早已凋残..
Corrupted Betrayal#009.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#010.src: Lives a cursed sheep, with the color of lime...
Corrupted Betrayal#010.dst: 住着一只受诅的羊，颜色像青柠一般……
Corrupted Betrayal#010.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#011.src: Lead it down the trail, headed to the slime...
Corrupted Betrayal#011.dst: 领它沿着小路，走向史莱姆那边……
Corrupted Betrayal#011.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#012.src: Sacrifice its soul, in the blood and the grime.
Corrupted Betrayal#012.dst: 献上它的灵魂，在血与污秽之间。
Corrupted Betrayal#012.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#013.src: The first line is obviously talking about the Great Bridge, but I've no clue what the rest means. Head over there, take a look around, and tell me if you find anything interesting.
Corrupted Betrayal#013.dst: 第一句显然说的是大桥，可剩下的意思我完全摸不着头脑。去那边四处看看，找到什么有意思的就告诉我。
Corrupted Betrayal#013.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#014.src: Alrighty. Let me know what when you've got something then.
Corrupted Betrayal#014.dst: 好嘞。那等你有发现了再跟我说。
Corrupted Betrayal#014.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#015.src: Use the Mage's riddle to figure out where it leads
Corrupted Betrayal#015.dst: 用法师的谜题找出它指向哪里

Corrupted Betrayal#016.src: If you are heading towards the Great Bridge, be cautious in the plains around the jungle entrance.
Corrupted Betrayal#016.dst: 如果你要去大桥，在丛林入口附近的平原上要小心。
Corrupted Betrayal#016.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#017.src: I have received reports of a strange cursed sheep taking refuge in one of the more fortified ruins around there.
Corrupted Betrayal#017.dst: 我收到报告，说有一只奇怪的受诅之羊躲在那一带比较坚固的废墟里。
Corrupted Betrayal#017.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#018.src: As far as I know, it is trapped in the ruins by some jungle growth, though if it was cut down it might escape...
Corrupted Betrayal#018.dst: 据我所知，它被丛林的植物困在废墟里了，不过要是把那些植物砍掉，它可能就会逃出来……
Corrupted Betrayal#018.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#019.src: Explore the temple for a way to break the barrier.
Corrupted Betrayal#019.dst: 探索神殿，寻找打破屏障的方法。

Corrupted Betrayal#020.src: Go to Slykaar's residence at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find out what is hidden there.
Corrupted Betrayal#020.dst: 前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Slykaar 住所，查明那里藏着什么。

Corrupted Betrayal#021.src: By order of the city of {p}, I am here to keep other citizens from entering this house.
Corrupted Betrayal#021.dst: 奉 {p} 城之命，我在这里阻止其他市民进入这栋房子。
Corrupted Betrayal#021.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#022.src: From past experiences, everyone who has entered this house has vanished from existence...
Corrupted Betrayal#022.dst: 根据以往的经验，进过这栋房子的人全都凭空消失了……
Corrupted Betrayal#022.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#023.src: I would advise not going inside unless you know what you are doing.
Corrupted Betrayal#023.dst: 除非你知道自己在做什么，否则我劝你别进去。
Corrupted Betrayal#023.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#024.src: Well, I guess you must know who I am.
Corrupted Betrayal#024.dst: 好吧，我想你一定知道我是谁。

Corrupted Betrayal#025.src: Welcome to my domain. I am the hero of {p}, Slykaar.
Corrupted Betrayal#025.dst: 欢迎来到我的领域。我是 {p} 的英雄，Slykaar。

Corrupted Betrayal#026.src: Well, I used to be. Banished by the very people who asked for my help. Pathetic.
Corrupted Betrayal#026.dst: 嗯，曾经是。被当初求我帮忙的那群人放逐了。真可悲。
Corrupted Betrayal#026.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#027.src: They couldn't give me a few peasants for their safety? Weak.
Corrupted Betrayal#027.dst: 为了他们自己的安全，连几个农民都不肯给我？软弱。
Corrupted Betrayal#027.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#029.src: I experimented my shamanism for many years underground to create the perfect mix of monster.
Corrupted Betrayal#029.dst: 我在地下用我的萨满之术实验了很多年，想创造出完美的混合怪物。
Corrupted Betrayal#029.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#030.src: Most ended in horrific slimes. Aggressive and powerful, but alas, just slimes.
Corrupted Betrayal#030.dst: 大多数都成了可怕的史莱姆。凶猛又强大，可惜，终究只是史莱姆。
Corrupted Betrayal#030.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#031.src: Then I found this place. A dark land. A dark god. A source of power.
Corrupted Betrayal#031.dst: 然后我找到了这个地方。一片黑暗之地。一位黑暗之神。一个力量之源。
Corrupted Betrayal#031.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#032.src: You mediocre wielders of magic have no idea what this world holds.
Corrupted Betrayal#032.dst: 你们这些平庸的魔法使用者根本不知道这个世界藏着什么。
Corrupted Betrayal#032.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#033.src: You all strive to be that hero of heroes, “Bob”, but here's the truth. He's lost. You're lost.
Corrupted Betrayal#033.dst: 你们全都想成为那位英雄中的英雄，“Bob”，但真相是这样的。他迷失了。你们也迷失了。
Corrupted Betrayal#033.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#034.src: No one in the Wynn province is willing to make the sacrifices I am to gain power.
Corrupted Betrayal#034.dst: Wynn 行省没有一个人愿意像我一样为了力量做出牺牲。
Corrupted Betrayal#034.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#035.src: If you want power, you have to give some. Sacrifice a few to save many.
Corrupted Betrayal#035.dst: 想要力量，就得付出。牺牲少数，拯救多数。
Corrupted Betrayal#035.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#036.src: They were willing to give me a few peasants in {~}, when the hordes crossed the bridge.
Corrupted Betrayal#036.dst: {~} 年，大军越过大桥时，他们还愿意给我几个农民。
Corrupted Betrayal#036.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#037.src: The king was happy to throw away lives to save his. But then the hero of Wynn waltzed in a few years later.
Corrupted Betrayal#037.dst: 国王很乐意牺牲别人的命来保住自己的。可是几年后，Wynn 的英雄大摇大摆地来了。
Corrupted Betrayal#037.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#038.src: They banished me like a rotten fruit. Their hero, their protector. So what if a few hundred nobodies died for it.
Corrupted Betrayal#038.dst: 他们像扔烂水果一样把我放逐了。他们的英雄，他们的守护者。就算为此死了几百个无名小卒又怎样。
Corrupted Betrayal#038.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#039.src: Looks like we have a Bob aspirer. Pale imitation.
Corrupted Betrayal#039.dst: 看来又来了一个想当 Bob 的人。拙劣的模仿。
Corrupted Betrayal#039.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#040.src: So. Feel free to visit me down below, bring the entire might of the {p} army upon me. It will not be enough.
Corrupted Betrayal#040.dst: 那么。欢迎下来找我，把 {p} 军队的全部力量都带来吧。那也不够。
Corrupted Betrayal#040.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#041.src: I am ready. Soon, {p} will be in ruins. And I shall have my revenge.
Corrupted Betrayal#041.dst: 我已经准备好了。很快，{p} 就会化为废墟。而我将完成我的复仇。
Corrupted Betrayal#041.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#042.src: Go have fun in while you can. It's not like you have much of a life to live, anyways.
Corrupted Betrayal#042.dst: 趁还能玩就好好玩吧。反正你也没多少日子可活了。
Corrupted Betrayal#042.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#043.src: Report back to Lanu about what you've learned.
Corrupted Betrayal#043.dst: 回去向 Lanu 报告你发现的事。

Corrupted Betrayal#044.src: Ah, you're back. Find anything interesting? I've just been knocking back the occasional slime that pops up out of this cave.
Corrupted Betrayal#044.dst: 啊，你回来了。找到什么有意思的了吗？我一直在这里收拾偶尔从洞里冒出来的史莱姆。
Corrupted Betrayal#044.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#045.src: You... saw Slykaar? In another dimension?!
Corrupted Betrayal#045.dst: 你……看到了 Slykaar？在另一个维度？！
Corrupted Betrayal#045.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#046.src: This is bad. If he can materialise outside of this cave, even psychoactively... he's getting stronger. It explains the slimes, the attacks on {p}...
Corrupted Betrayal#046.dst: 这下糟了。如果他能在这个洞窟外面显形，哪怕只是精神上的……那说明他越来越强了。这就解释了那些史莱姆，还有对 {p} 的袭击……
Corrupted Betrayal#046.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#047.src: He's an incredibly powerful shaman, {u}. He has to be stopped, but it would take forever for {p} to mobile a force against him.
Corrupted Betrayal#047.dst: 他是个极其强大的萨满，{u}。必须阻止他，可 {p} 要调集部队对付他得花上好久。
Corrupted Betrayal#047.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#048.src: If you can, you should head in there and... finish him off. Gear up first, though, and find some friends watch your back.
Corrupted Betrayal#048.dst: 如果可以，你应该进去……把他解决掉。不过先把装备准备好，再找几个朋友帮你掩护。
Corrupted Betrayal#048.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#049.src: {u}, how's it going? Run into another shaman hallucination at all?
Corrupted Betrayal#049.dst: {u}，最近怎么样？又碰到萨满的幻象了吗？
Corrupted Betrayal#049.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#050.src: Anyway, good luck in the cave. If you choose to go in, be careful.
Corrupted Betrayal#050.dst: 总之，祝你在洞里好运。如果你决定进去，一定要小心。
Corrupted Betrayal#050.speaker: Lanu

Cowfusion#001.src: A Human, eh? All the way out 'ere at the end of the canyon? Yer a tough one.
Cowfusion#001.dst: 人类，是吧？大老远跑到这峡谷尽头来？你可真够强悍的。
Cowfusion#001.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#002.src: Perhaps I can give yer some work, if yer are lookin' for it? Someone's been coming and nabbing my cows!
Cowfusion#002.dst: 如果你在找活干，也许我能给你份工作？有人一直跑来偷我的牛！
Cowfusion#002.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#003.src: 'an I know exactly who it is - that blasted cow scientist that lives in the lab just north of 'ere.
Cowfusion#003.dst: 我很清楚是谁——就是住在这里北边实验室里那个该死的牛科学家。
Cowfusion#003.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#004.src: Anyway, yer up for the job? Can't let 'im just keep stealing them forever!
Cowfusion#004.dst: 总之，你愿意接这份活吗？不能让他一直这样偷下去！
Cowfusion#004.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#005.src: His cavern laboratory is just north from 'ere. Not too hard to find. Once yer there, get him to return my cows!
Cowfusion#005.dst: 他的洞穴实验室就在这里北边。不难找。到了那里，就叫他把我的牛还回来！
Cowfusion#005.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#006.src: There's one problem though. The door to the place is always shut, so you'll 'ave to find another way in.
Cowfusion#006.dst: 不过有个问题。那地方的门总是关着，所以你得找别的路进去。
Cowfusion#006.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#008.src: Find a way into the Laboratory

Cowfusion#009.src: Search the Laboratory for the missing cows
Cowfusion#009.dst: 在实验室里寻找失踪的牛

Cowfusion#010.src: Find a way to free the Cows.

Cowfusion#014.dst: 这是啥？我不信，是你吗？我的乖女儿，我就知道你会回到我身边！
Cowfusion#014.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#015.dst: 亏我还想雇个城里来的人类去把你找回来？哈！
Cowfusion#015.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#016.dst: 好了，回围栏里去吧。嘿咻！
Cowfusion#016.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#021.src: You're right, there is no password. Just seeing if you can understand me.
Cowfusion#021.dst: 你说得对，根本没有暗号。只是看看你听不听得懂我说话。
Cowfusion#021.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#022.src: You're one of us then, the oppressed? Want to break free from these farmers? Well aren't you in luck.
Cowfusion#022.dst: 所以你是我们的一员，被压迫的一方？想摆脱这些农夫？嗯，你运气可真好。
Cowfusion#022.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#023.src: I can help you with that. WE can help you with that.
Cowfusion#023.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#024.src: Our people have a secret hideout not far from here. It's located right under that barn just behind me.
Cowfusion#024.dst: 我们的族人在离这里不远的地方有个秘密藏身处。就在我后面那座谷仓底下。
Cowfusion#024.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#025.src: It may seem close, but unless you've been practicing your atheletics, you won't be able to get over these fences.
Cowfusion#025.dst: 看起来很近，不过除非你练过体能，不然你是翻不过这些栅栏的。
Cowfusion#025.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#026.src: See that haybale in the middle of our pen? I bet you could push and pull it into such a position that'd allow you to climb over the fence with your cow physique.
Cowfusion#026.dst: 看到我们围栏中间那捆干草了吗？我打赌你能把它推拉到某个位置，让你用这副牛的身体翻过栅栏。
Cowfusion#026.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#027.src: The second pen might have a similar problem, but I'm sure you can figure that out yourself.
Cowfusion#027.dst: 第二个围栏可能也有类似的问题，不过我相信你自己想得出办法。
Cowfusion#027.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#031.src: What? What does that even mean? There isn't actually a password! Or did no one tell me that there was? Ah, nevermind, at least you can understand me.
Cowfusion#031.dst: 什么？那到底是什么意思？根本就没有暗号！还是说有，只是没人告诉我？啊，算了，至少你听得懂我说话。
Cowfusion#031.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#032.src: You're one of us then, the oppressed? Want to break free from these farmers? Well aren't you in luck.
Cowfusion#032.dst: 所以你是我们的一员，被压迫的一方？想摆脱这些农夫？嗯，你运气可真好。
Cowfusion#032.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#033.src: I can help you with that. WE can help you with that.
Cowfusion#033.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#034.src: Our people have a secret hideout not far from here. It's located right under that barn just behind me.
Cowfusion#034.dst: 我们的族人在离这里不远的地方有个秘密藏身处。就在我后面那座谷仓底下。
Cowfusion#034.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#035.src: It may seem close, but unless you've been practicing your atheletics, you won't be able to get over these fences.
Cowfusion#035.dst: 看起来很近，不过除非你练过体能，不然你是翻不过这些栅栏的。
Cowfusion#035.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#036.src: See that haybale in the middle of our pen? I bet you could push and pull it into such a position that'd allow you to climb over the fence with your cow physique.
Cowfusion#036.dst: 看到我们围栏中间那捆干草了吗？我打赌你能把它推拉到某个位置，让你用这副牛的身体翻过栅栏。
Cowfusion#036.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#037.src: The second pen might have a similar problem, but I'm sure you can figure that out yourself.
Cowfusion#037.dst: 第二个围栏可能也有类似的问题，不过我相信你自己想得出办法。
Cowfusion#037.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#039.src: Find and enter the Secret Cow Hideout
Cowfusion#039.dst: 找到并进入秘密牛族藏身处

Cowfusion#041.src: Oh, a new recruit? We weren't expecting anyone at this time. How'd you find your way in?
Cowfusion#041.dst: 噢，新成员？我们没料到这个时候会有人来。你是怎么找到路进来的？
Cowfusion#041.speaker: Receptionist

Cowfusion#042.src: Wait, you're different. Something's off about you. Like you've never been in a cow's body before.
Cowfusion#042.dst: 等等，你不一样。你有点不对劲。好像你以前从没待过牛的身体。
Cowfusion#042.speaker: Receptionist

Cowfusion#043.src: Oh. Oh, this is not good. Uhm, you should talk to the boss. He'll probably know what to do with you.
Cowfusion#043.dst: 噢。噢，这可不妙。呃，你应该去跟老大谈谈。他大概知道该拿你怎么办。
Cowfusion#043.speaker: Receptionist

Cowfusion#044.src: You'll find him in the big office at the very end of this facility. Just stick to the path and don't be nosey, okay?
Cowfusion#044.dst: 他在这座设施最里面的大办公室。沿着路走就好，别到处乱看，好吗？
Cowfusion#044.speaker: Receptionist

Cowfusion#045.src: Find the one who's in charge of the hideout

Cowfusion#047.src: Whoop, alright! Don't want you going anywhere, buddy! Uh... What are you doing here, exactly...?
Cowfusion#047.dst: 哇哦，好了！可别乱跑，伙计！呃……你到底来这里干嘛……？
Cowfusion#047.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#048.src: You- what? Oh gosh, how is that even possible? I don't think I had anything that could...
Cowfusion#048.dst: 你——什么？天啊，这怎么可能？我不记得我有什么东西能……
Cowfusion#048.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#049.src: Oh! You must've been snooping through my laboratory. That's... okay, we can talk about that later. Did you step into my machine?
Cowfusion#049.dst: 噢！你一定是在我的实验室里乱翻了。那……没关系，我们之后再谈。你踏进我的机器了吗？
Cowfusion#049.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#050.src: It's not even meant to do that! Its purpose is to turn the exiles back into Wocs. So how does a Human become a cow...?
Cowfusion#050.dst: 它根本不是用来做这个的！它的用途是把流放者变回 Woc。那人类怎么会变成牛……？
Cowfusion#050.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#051.src: Right, right, sorry. Here, uh- I'll try and get this cage down. Darn controls... Why did I design these so poorly?
Cowfusion#051.dst: 对，对，抱歉。来，呃——我试着把这个笼子放下来。该死的操控台……我当初怎么会设计得这么烂？
Cowfusion#051.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#052.src: ...So while I try to figure out which lever to push, tell me about yourself! Anything interesting going on in your life?
Cowfusion#052.dst: ……那趁我研究该拉哪根拉杆的时候，跟我说说你自己吧！你的生活有什么有趣的事吗？
Cowfusion#052.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#053.src: You... You are? You are! Oh, wow, it's great to see you again! It's been so long since our escapades back in Wynn!
Cowfusion#053.dst: 你……你是？你是！噢，哇，真高兴又见到你！自从我们在 Wynn 那段冒险之后已经好久了！
Cowfusion#053.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#054.src: This is great, actually! I- I can show you around this place! Introduce you to some of the folks we freed together! Oh, what fantastic timing this has been.
Cowfusion#054.dst: 这其实太好了！我——我可以带你参观这里！介绍几个我们一起救出来的朋友给你认识！噢，时机真是太巧了。
Cowfusion#054.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#055.src: I just need to figure out which switch to pull... I think it's this one! Probably. I really need to label these things. Alright, here goes!
Cowfusion#055.dst: 我只需要搞清楚该拉哪个开关……我想是这个！大概吧。我真的该给这些东西贴标签了。好，来吧！
Cowfusion#055.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#057.src: I, uh... Hah. Very funny. Tell me you're a human, then pretend to be a cow.
Cowfusion#057.dst: 我，呃……哈。真好笑。跟我说你是人类，然后又装成牛。
Cowfusion#057.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#058.src: That's... fine. You know, I'm under quite a lot of stress right now. Working hard, day in and day out. I don't really need your attitude right now!
Cowfusion#058.dst: 那……没关系。你知道吗，我现在压力很大。日复一日地拼命工作。我现在真的不需要你这种态度！
Cowfusion#058.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#059.src: You know what? I don't need this attitude. I'm- I'm going to send you to The Pit. Where- where all my other mistakes lie.
Cowfusion#059.dst: 你知道吗？我不需要这种态度。我——我要把你送去深坑。那里——那里堆着我所有其他的失败品。
Cowfusion#059.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#060.src: ...You have a weapon. You can probably manage! You don't need anything from me! Here, see how you like it down there!
Cowfusion#060.dst: ……你有武器。你大概应付得来！你不需要我帮你什么！来，看看你喜不喜欢下面吧！
Cowfusion#060.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#062.src: Okay. So you are just a regular cow. Not a Woc. Uh... Who let you in, little pal? I'm going to need to have to have a word about closing the doors...
Cowfusion#062.dst: 好吧。所以你就只是一头普通的牛。不是 Woc。呃……谁放你进来的，小家伙？我得好好跟他们谈谈关门的事……
Cowfusion#062.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#063.src: Well, this is... awkward. So, then... cow. What's it like being... a cow?
Cowfusion#063.dst: 嗯，这真是……尴尬。那么……牛。当一头……牛是什么感觉？
Cowfusion#063.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#064.src: You- what? Oh gosh, how is that even possible? I don't think I had anything that could...
Cowfusion#064.dst: 你——什么？天啊，这怎么可能？我不记得我有什么东西能……
Cowfusion#064.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#065.src: Oh! You must've been snooping through my laboratory. That's... okay, we can talk about that later. Did you step into my machine?
Cowfusion#065.dst: 噢！你一定是在我的实验室里乱翻了。那……没关系，我们之后再谈。你踏进我的机器了吗？
Cowfusion#065.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#066.dst: 它根本不是用来做这个的！它的用途是把流放者变回 Woc。那人类怎么会变成牛……？
Cowfusion#066.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#067.src: Right, right, sorry. Here, uh- I'll try and get this cage down. Darn controls... Why did I design these so poorly?
Cowfusion#067.dst: 对，对，抱歉。来，呃——我试着把这个笼子放下来。该死的操控台……我当初怎么会设计得这么烂？
Cowfusion#067.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#068.src: ...So while I try to figure out which lever to push, tell me about yourself! Anything interesting going on in your life?
Cowfusion#068.dst: ……那趁我研究该拉哪根拉杆的时候，跟我说说你自己吧！你的生活有什么有趣的事吗？
Cowfusion#068.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#069.src: You... You are? You are! Oh, wow, it's great to see you again! It's been so long since our escapades back in Wynn!
Cowfusion#069.dst: 你……你是？你是！噢，哇，真高兴又见到你！自从我们在 Wynn 那段冒险之后已经好久了！
Cowfusion#069.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#070.src: This is great, actually! I- I can show you around this place! Introduce you to some of the folks we freed together! Oh, what fantastic timing this has been.
Cowfusion#070.dst: 这其实太好了！我——我可以带你参观这里！介绍几个我们一起救出来的朋友给你认识！噢，时机真是太巧了。
Cowfusion#070.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#071.src: I just need to figure out which switch to pull... I think it's this one! Probably. I really need to label these things. Alright, here goes!
Cowfusion#071.dst: 我只需要搞清楚该拉哪个开关……我想是这个！大概吧。我真的该给这些东西贴标签了。好，来吧！
Cowfusion#071.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#073.src: I, uh... Hah. Very funny. Tell me you're a human, then pretend to be a cow.
Cowfusion#073.dst: 我，呃……哈。真好笑。跟我说你是人类，然后又装成牛。
Cowfusion#073.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#074.src: That's... fine. You know, I'm under quite a lot of stress right now. Working hard, day in and day out. I don't really need your attitude right now!
Cowfusion#074.dst: 那……没关系。你知道吗，我现在压力很大。日复一日地拼命工作。我现在真的不需要你这种态度！
Cowfusion#074.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#075.src: You know what? I don't need this attitude. I'm- I'm going to send you to The Pit. Where- where all my other mistakes lie.
Cowfusion#075.dst: 你知道吗？我不需要这种态度。我——我要把你送去深坑。那里——那里堆着我所有其他的失败品。
Cowfusion#075.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#076.src: ...You have a weapon. You can probably manage! You don't need anything from me! Here, see how you like it down there!
Cowfusion#076.dst: ……你有武器。你大概应付得来！你不需要我帮你什么！来，看看你喜不喜欢下面吧！
Cowfusion#076.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#078.src: Right. Okay. Figure I'd best let you go free.
Cowfusion#078.dst: 好。好吧。我想我最好放你走。
Cowfusion#078.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#079.src: ...Unless. Unless. Nobody's... nobody's looking. I could just send you to The Pit... Nobody would know.
Cowfusion#079.dst: ……除非。除非。没有人……没有人在看。我可以直接把你送去深坑……没人会知道。
Cowfusion#079.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#080.src: It's... easier this way. It's fine. Maybe you'll even- maybe you'll even make your way out. Good luck, little buddy.
Cowfusion#080.dst: 这样……比较省事。没关系的。也许你甚至——也许你甚至能自己找到路出来。祝你好运，小伙伴。
Cowfusion#080.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#083.src: You fell into the incinerator? And defeated a mutant cow monster?
Cowfusion#083.dst: 你掉进焚化炉了？还打败了一只变异的牛怪？
Cowfusion#083.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#084.src: ...Oh! You're the one Drale told us to look out for. Accidentally dropped into the Pit, huh?
Cowfusion#084.dst: ……噢！你就是 Drale 叫我们留意的那个。不小心掉进深坑了，是吧？
Cowfusion#084.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#085.src: The boss said to apologize to ya for the inconvenience. We've all been workin' late hours recently... Some of us more than others.
Cowfusion#085.dst: 老大说要替他跟你道歉，给你添麻烦了。我们最近都在加班……有些人比其他人更严重。
Cowfusion#085.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#086.src: Anyhow, follow me. I'll take you back to him, and you can talk this out! You'll be back as a human in no time.
Cowfusion#086.dst: 总之，跟我来。我带你回去找他，你们可以把事情说清楚！你很快就会变回人类的。
Cowfusion#086.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#087.src: So... yeah. That's Drale for you. Absentminded as ever. He said something about labeling his levers from now on, so I reckon that's a positive.
Cowfusion#087.dst: 所以……是啊。Drale 就是这样。一如往常地心不在焉。他说从现在起要给他的拉杆贴标签，所以我想这算是个进步。
Cowfusion#087.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#088.src: ...You're a good friend of the boss, right? Would you be able to put in a good word for us? Gerald and I have been down here for a while, and we'd like to get back to our normal positions.
Cowfusion#088.dst: ……你是老大的好朋友，对吧？你能不能替我们说几句好话？我和 Gerald 在下面待了好一阵子了，我们想回到原本的岗位。
Cowfusion#088.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#089.src: Drale's alright on a good day, but we've been running out of good days lately! He keeps pulling late hours on this... wholly unnecessary project!
Cowfusion#089.dst: Drale 心情好的时候还行，可我们最近好日子越来越少了！他一直为了这个……完全没必要的计划加班到很晚！
Cowfusion#089.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#090.src: He insists we have to keep trying to find our original ship, instead of just building a new one with all the materials we have! It's ridiculous!
Cowfusion#090.dst: 他坚持我们必须继续找我们原本的那艘船，而不是用手上所有的材料直接造一艘新的！太荒唐了！
Cowfusion#090.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#091.src: Maybe you'll be able to get through to him, being his friend and all. We've all been stressed, and it's really just...
Cowfusion#091.dst: 也许你能说得动他，毕竟你是他的朋友嘛。我们大家压力都很大，而且真的就是……
Cowfusion#091.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#092.src: What ship? Oh, of course, you're not a Woc. See, our race isn't actually from- you know, maybe that's a story for another time.
Cowfusion#092.dst: 什么船？噢，对了，你不是 Woc。你看，我们这个种族其实不是来自——你知道吗，这个故事也许下次再说吧。
Cowfusion#092.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#093.src: For now let's get you back up to the main lab. Drale will be glad to see you in one piece! He sounded worried for your safety.
Cowfusion#093.dst: 现在先带你回主实验室。Drale 看到你完好无损一定会很高兴！他听起来很担心你的安危。
Cowfusion#093.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#095.src: You head on up that pipe and with a bit of luck it'll plonk you out right in front of Drale.
Cowfusion#095.dst: 你爬上那根管子，运气好的话，它会直接把你吐到 Drale 面前。
Cowfusion#095.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#096.src: Remember what I told you! Try to put in a good word for us, yeah?
Cowfusion#096.dst: 记住我跟你说的话！试着替我们说几句好话，好吗？
Cowfusion#096.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#097.src: If not, well... At least I tried. Let the record show I tried.
Cowfusion#097.dst: 如果不行，嗯……至少我试过了。请记下来我试过了。
Cowfusion#097.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#098.src: ...Alright! Go on, off you go! It was lovely to meet you.
Cowfusion#098.dst: ……好了！去吧，快去吧！很高兴认识你。
Cowfusion#098.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#100.src: You fell into the incinerator? And defeated a mutant cow monster?
Cowfusion#100.dst: 你掉进焚化炉了？还打败了一只变异的牛怪？
Cowfusion#100.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#101.src: Yeah that checks out. So what happened to get you thrown down here?
Cowfusion#101.dst: 嗯，说得通。那你是出了什么事才被扔下来的？
Cowfusion#101.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#102.src: Oh, angered him by pretending to be a cow after already speaking? Yeah, I feel ya. When the boss is in a mood, anything you say could get you thrown down here.
Cowfusion#102.dst: 噢，明明已经开口说话了还装成牛，把他惹火了？是啊，我懂。老大心情不好的时候，你说什么都可能被扔下来。
Cowfusion#102.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#103.src: Here, why don't you follow me? I'll take you back to him, you can straighten things out, and I'm sure you'll be back as a human in no time!
Cowfusion#103.dst: 来，你何不跟我走？我带你回去找他，你们可以把事情解释清楚，我相信你很快就会变回人类！
Cowfusion#103.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#104.src: So... yeah. Drale isn't the best at... conflict resolution. Catch him on a bad day, and he might just throw you in the Pit.
Cowfusion#104.dst: 所以……是啊。Drale 不太擅长……化解冲突。碰上他心情不好的时候，他可能直接把你扔进深坑。
Cowfusion#104.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#105.src: I got stationed down here for a week because I interrupted him during his daily yoga session.
Cowfusion#105.dst: 我就因为在他每天的瑜伽时间打断他，被派到下面待了一个星期。
Cowfusion#105.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#106.src: Gerald, over there? He used to be in accounting. Until he forgot to carry the two one day, and... Well, here he is now.
Cowfusion#106.dst: 那边那个 Gerald？他以前是做会计的。直到有一天他忘了进位，然后……嗯，他现在就在这里了。
Cowfusion#106.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#107.src: Drale's alright on a good day, but we've been running out of good days lately! He keeps pulling late hours on this... wholly unnecessary project!
Cowfusion#107.dst: Drale 心情好的时候还行，可我们最近好日子越来越少了！他一直为了这个……完全没必要的计划加班到很晚！
Cowfusion#107.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#108.src: He insists we have to keep trying to find our original ship, instead of just building a new one with all the materials we have! It's ridiculous!
Cowfusion#108.dst: 他坚持我们必须继续找我们原本的那艘船，而不是用手上所有的材料直接造一艘新的！太荒唐了！
Cowfusion#108.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#109.src: What ship? Oh, of course, you're not a Woc. See, our race isn't actually from- you know, maybe that's a story for another time.
Cowfusion#109.dst: 什么船？噢，对了，你不是 Woc。你看，我们这个种族其实不是来自——你知道吗，这个故事也许下次再说吧。
Cowfusion#109.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#110.src: For now let's get you back up to the main lab and hopefully Drale will be in a bit of a better mood!
Cowfusion#110.dst: 现在先带你回主实验室，希望 Drale 心情会好一点！
Cowfusion#110.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#112.src: You head on up that pipe and with a bit of luck it'll plonk you out right in front of Drale.
Cowfusion#112.dst: 你爬上那根管子，运气好的话，它会直接把你吐到 Drale 面前。
Cowfusion#112.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#113.src: If you try explaining the situation again I'm sure he'll be understanding.
Cowfusion#113.dst: 如果你再试着解释一次情况，我相信他会理解的。
Cowfusion#113.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#114.src: He usually is after he's had some time to cool off.
Cowfusion#114.dst: 他通常冷静一段时间之后就会理解了。
Cowfusion#114.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#115.src: Go on, off you go! It was lovely to meet you.
Cowfusion#115.dst: 去吧，快去吧！很高兴认识你。
Cowfusion#115.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#117.src: You fell into the incinerator? And defeated a mutant cow monster?
Cowfusion#117.dst: 你掉进焚化炉了？还打败了一只变异的牛怪？
Cowfusion#117.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#118.src: Yeah that checks out. So what happened to get you thrown down here?
Cowfusion#118.dst: 嗯，说得通。那你是出了什么事才被扔下来的？
Cowfusion#118.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#119.src: Pretended to be a cow when you're actually a human? Must have caught him on a rough day to get thrown down for that. Usually he'd just let a cow go.
Cowfusion#119.dst: 明明是人类却装成牛？一定是碰上他心情很差的时候，才会因为这样被扔下来。平常他遇到牛就直接放走了。
Cowfusion#119.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#120.src: Well here, why don't you follow me? I'll take you back to him, you can straighten things out, and I'm sure you'll be back as a human in no time!
Cowfusion#120.dst: 来，你何不跟我走？我带你回去找他，你们可以把事情解释清楚，我相信你很快就会变回人类！
Cowfusion#120.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#121.src: So... yeah. That's Drale. Catch him on a bad day, and he might just throw you into the Pit.
Cowfusion#121.dst: 所以……是啊。Drale 就是这样。碰上他心情不好的时候，他可能直接把你扔进深坑。
Cowfusion#121.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#122.src: I got stationed down here for a week because I interrupted him during his daily yoga session.
Cowfusion#122.dst: 我就因为在他每天的瑜伽时间打断他，被派到下面待了一个星期。
Cowfusion#122.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#123.src: Gerald, over there? He used to be in accounting. Until he forgot to carry the two one day, and... Well, here he is now.
Cowfusion#123.dst: 那边那个 Gerald？他以前是做会计的。直到有一天他忘了进位，然后……嗯，他现在就在这里了。
Cowfusion#123.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#124.src: Drale's alright on a good day, but we've been running out of good days lately! He keeps pulling late hours on this... wholly unnecessary project!
Cowfusion#124.dst: Drale 心情好的时候还行，可我们最近好日子越来越少了！他一直为了这个……完全没必要的计划加班到很晚！
Cowfusion#124.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#125.src: He insists we have to keep trying to find our original ship, instead of just building a new one with all the materials we have! It's ridiculous!
Cowfusion#125.dst: 他坚持我们必须继续找我们原本的那艘船，而不是用手上所有的材料直接造一艘新的！太荒唐了！
Cowfusion#125.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#126.src: What ship? Oh, of course, you're not a Woc. See, our race isn't actually from- you know, maybe that's a story for another time.
Cowfusion#126.dst: 什么船？噢，对了，你不是 Woc。你看，我们这个种族其实不是来自——你知道吗，这个故事也许下次再说吧。
Cowfusion#126.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#127.src: For now let's get you back up to the main lab and hopefully Drale will be in a bit of a better mood! Maybe mention the human thing this time, alright?
Cowfusion#127.dst: 现在先带你回主实验室，希望 Drale 心情会好一点！这次记得提一下你是人类的事，好吗？
Cowfusion#127.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#129.src: You head on up that pipe and with a bit of luck it'll plonk you out right in front of Drale.
Cowfusion#129.dst: 你爬上那根管子，运气好的话，它会直接把你吐到 Drale 面前。
Cowfusion#129.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#130.src: If you try explaining the situation again I'm sure he'll be understanding.
Cowfusion#130.dst: 如果你再试着解释一次情况，我相信他会理解的。
Cowfusion#130.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#131.src: He usually is after he's had some time to cool off.
Cowfusion#131.dst: 他通常冷静一段时间之后就会理解了。
Cowfusion#131.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#132.src: Go on, off you go! It was lovely to meet you.
Cowfusion#132.dst: 去吧，快去吧！很高兴认识你。
Cowfusion#132.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#134.src: Oh, this is- Oh! You're alive! I, ah- heh. Sorry about... all that. I really, really need to label these levers properly...
Cowfusion#134.dst: 噢，这是——噢！你还活着！我，呃——嘿。抱歉……那一切。我真的、真的该好好给这些拉杆贴标签了……
Cowfusion#134.speaker: Drale
