Dwarves and Doguns Part I#064.src: My people are tyrants and conquerors...but they are also good. The people have been brainwashed.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#064.dst: 我的族人是暴君和征服者……但他们也是善良的。人民被洗脑了。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#064.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#065.src: Many things are about to happen. If you want to know more, come to house number {~} in {p}. I'll be waiting.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#065.dst: 很多事就要发生了。如果你想知道更多，就来 {p} 的 {~} 号房子。我会等你。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#065.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#066.src: Search for house {~} in {p} like Axelus said.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#066.dst: 照 Axelus 说的，在 {p} 寻找 {~} 号房子。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#067.src: Talk to Axelus in the Coalition Base.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#067.dst: 在联盟基地与 Axelus 交谈。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#068.src: Ah, you made it. Come and meet Korzim
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#068.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#070.src: We...are those who...want peace. I am son...of the Dogun Chief... I have...been banished.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#070.dst: 我们……是那些……想要和平的人。我是……Dogun 族长的儿子……我已经……被放逐了。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#070.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#071.src: The coalition is a small group of believers in the truth. The Doguns aren't demons, and the Dwarves aren't all brainwashed.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#071.dst: 联盟是一小群相信真相的人。Dogun 不是恶魔，矮人也不是全都被洗脑了。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#071.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#072.src: But of course, we have to live in hiding. The Doguns won’t tolerate Dwarves and the Dwarves hunt traitors and "Demons".
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#072.dst: 不过我们当然只能躲起来生活。Dogun 容不下矮人，而矮人会追捕叛徒和“恶魔”。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#072.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#073.src: Right now, we're trying to convince the public. But it's proving difficult, if not impossible.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#073.dst: 我们现在正试着说服大众。但事实证明这很难，甚至根本不可能。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#073.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#074.src: It isn't {~} years ago. We have the technology and supply chains to live here peacefully, but they just won't listen!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#074.dst: 现在已经不是 {~} 年前了。我们有技术和补给链，能在这里和平生活，可他们就是不听！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#074.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#075.src: We have...a plan... To win over...my people...that is.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#075.dst: 我们有……一个计划……要赢得……我族人的……支持。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#075.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#076.src: Korzim has told us that dragon bone is sacred to his people. We had to make some connections, but we have a way to get it now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#076.dst: Korzim 告诉我们，龙骨对他的族人来说是神圣的。我们得打通一些关系，不过现在已经有办法弄到了。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#076.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#077.src: If you want, you could come with us. We can explain more of the situation later. Exit's through the back.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#077.dst: 如果你愿意，可以跟我们一起去。之后我们再多跟你解释情况。出口在后面。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#077.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#078.src: Follow the group on the mission.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#080.src: The others...are just up ahead. I'll let you through...our tunnel.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#080.dst: 其他人……就在前面。我让你……穿过我们的隧道。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#080.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#081.src: We use.. earth and.. fire.. elements. It is slow... like us.. but powerful.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#081.dst: 我们使用……土和……火……元素。它很慢……像我们一样……但很强大。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#081.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#083.src: We got this drill all the way from Corkus. Axelus had to pay a king's ransom to buy it, but this ought to work!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#083.dst: 我们这台钻机是大老远从 Corkus 弄来的。Axelus 花了一大笔钱才买到，不过这应该管用！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#083.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#085.src: AAAAGH! Idiot Corkus swindlers! Damn it all! How many emeralds did we waste?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#085.dst: 啊啊啊啊！Corkus 那些白痴骗子！该死！我们到底浪费了多少绿宝石？！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#085.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#086.src: Ugh, do you have any experience with machines? You might have some idea of how in the hell to fix this hunk of junk.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#086.dst: 呃，你有操作机器的经验吗？也许你知道到底该怎么修好这堆破铜烂铁。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#086.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#087.src: Fantastic, {u}! We got the bone! Couldn't have done it without you.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#087.dst: 太棒了，{u}！我们拿到骨头了！没有你我们办不到。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#087.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#088.src: You can take it back to the coalition base. Barden and I will need to pack up before we join you.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#088.dst: 你可以先把它带回联盟基地。我和 Barden 得先收拾东西再过去找你。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#088.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#089.src: Just knock on the black block in front of the cave we arrived in.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#089.dst: 敲一敲我们来时那个洞穴前面的黑色方块就行。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#089.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#090.src: Head back to the Coalition Base through the tunnel.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#090.dst: 穿过隧道回到联盟基地。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#093.src: Dragon bone is one of the hardest substances in all the provinces. It's extremely rare.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#093.dst: 龙骨是所有省份里最坚硬的物质之一。极为稀有。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#093.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#094.src: We're going to present this to the Dogun chief as tribute. We need to tidy it up.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#094.dst: 我们要把它当作贡品献给 Dogun 族长。得先把它整理干净。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#094.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#095.src: Could you get [{~} Repair Kit] from the eastern part of the base?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#095.dst: 你能去基地东边拿 [{~} 修理包] 吗？
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#095.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#096.src: Retrieve the [Repair Kit] in the eastern part of the base.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#096.dst: 到基地东边取回 [修理包]。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#098.src: There are voices behind this wall, and the trail ends here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#098.dst: 这面墙后面有人声，而且线索到这里就断了。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#099.src: We have no vaults here. Must be traitors... The King really wants to see Axelus.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#099.dst: 我们这里没有金库。一定是叛徒……国王很想见到 Axelus。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#100.src: Stand back! I'll ready the charges...

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#102.src: No, no, ignore the repair kit! There's no time to worry about that!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#102.dst: 不，不，别管修理包了！没时间顾那个了！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#102.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#103.src: Our position has been compromised, they blew our doors wide open! We have to evacuate immediately.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#103.dst: 我们的位置暴露了，他们把我们的门炸开了！我们必须马上撤离。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#103.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#104.src: We've never been caught like this before, they never knew we really had Doguns on our side.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#104.dst: 我们从来没被这样逮到过，他们从来不知道我们真的有 Dogun 站在我们这边。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#104.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#105.src: We need to get to safety right now! The least explored area is the Upper Heights.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#105.dst: 我们现在得马上去安全的地方！最少人探索过的区域是上高地。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#105.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#106.src: Everyone, out! Now! They won't follow through the rough terrain!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#106.dst: 所有人，出去！马上！他们不会穿过崎岖的地形追上来的！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#106.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#107.src: Find your way up to the Dogun Village through the tunnel.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#107.dst: 穿过隧道，找到通往 Dogun 村的路。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#108.src: We'll stay around here, we aren't welcome in the village.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#108.dst: 我们会留在这附近，村子不欢迎我们。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#108.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#109.src: But... bring them... the dragon bone as a gift... If they accept it... they might accept us.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#109.dst: 不过……把龙骨……当作礼物带给他们……如果他们收下……也许就会接纳我们。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#109.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#110.src: You are free to enter the village but we will stay back and wait until the coast is clear. Keep going.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#110.dst: 你可以自由进入村子，不过我们会留在后面，等确定安全再说。继续走吧。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#110.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#111.src: What is... that on the... cliff to the south?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#111.dst: 南边……悬崖上的……那是什么？
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#111.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#112.src: Hey, aren't those...Doguns?! A whole settlement...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#112.dst: 嘿，那些不是……Dogun 吗？！一整个聚落……
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#112.speaker: Dwarven Scout

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#113.src: They've been gathering forces! We must inform {p} immediately!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#113.dst: 他们一直在集结兵力！我们必须马上通知 {p}！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#113.speaker: Dwarven Scout

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#114.src: Human. Come talk to me... Now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#114.dst: 人类。过来跟我谈谈……马上。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#114.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#116.src: Human... That Dwarf, he saw us...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#116.dst: 人类……那个矮人，他看到我们了……
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#116.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#117.src: They will... destroy us... If he reports... back to {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#117.dst: 他们会……消灭我们……如果他回去……报告 {p}。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#117.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#118.src: We need to... prepare our defenses. We need all the... help we can get.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#118.dst: 我们需要……准备防御。我们需要所有……能得到的帮助。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#118.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#119.src: Wait... What are... you holding? Dragon bone...? Just what we need...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#119.dst: 等等……你拿着……什么？龙骨……？正是我们需要的……
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#119.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#120.src: Human... if you promise to help us... I will grant you access to... our secret elevators... You can get up and... down the heights with those.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#120.dst: 人类……如果你答应帮助我们……我就允许你使用……我们的秘密升降梯……你可以用它们在高地……上下移动。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#120.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#121.src: Please return to... us when you reach level {~}. Take this... badge so the... others recognize you... as an ally. One of the elevators is... to the south.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#121.dst: 等你到了 {~} 级……请回到……我们这里。收下这枚……徽章，这样……其他人就会认出你……是盟友。其中一座升降梯……在南边。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#121.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#000.src: Return to the Dogun village with a Dogun Badge of Trust and talk to the leader of the town
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#000.dst: 带着 Dogun 信任徽章回到 Dogun 村，与村子的首领交谈

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#001.src: You are so young.. to be fighting.. a war so old. Still... it is appreciated.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#001.dst: 你这么年轻..就在打..一场这么古老的战争。不过……我们很感激。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#001.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#002.src: The war... to you, it would be... ages ago. But... when one has lived for... {~} years...
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#002.dst: 那场战争……对你来说，大概是……很久以前的事。但是……当一个人活了……{~} 年……
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#002.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#003.src: We have... few options. We need to discuss... the few we have... available.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#003.dst: 我们的……选择不多。我们得商量一下……仅有的……那几条路。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#003.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#005.src: I am sorry... to welcome you all... in such troubled times.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#005.dst: 很抱歉……在这么艰难的时刻……欢迎你们。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#005.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#006.src: We thought... we could hide in safety... But there is... no place left to hide.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#006.dst: 我们原以为……能安全地躲起来……但已经……无处可躲了。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#006.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#007.src: Aval... would have us... leave the Heights... But we... would not survive.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#007.dst: Aval……希望我们……离开高地……但我们……活不下去。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#007.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#008.src: We must... evacuate the settlement... immediately. They... are coming... again.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#008.dst: 我们必须……立刻……撤离聚落。他们……又要来了。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#008.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#011.src: Please! You all know me, I'm not with the side of the government. Hear me out, we can fix this!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#011.dst: 拜托！你们都认识我，我不是政府那边的人。听我说，我们能解决这件事！
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#011.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#013.src: Stop! I have been hiding from the Dwarves just as much as anyone here, they've been after me too!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#013.dst: 住手！我跟这里的每个人一样一直在躲着矮人，他们也在追捕我！
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#013.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#014.src: Why... would we... trust you... of all Dwarves?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#014.dst: 为什么……我们要……相信你……偏偏是你这个矮人？
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#014.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#015.src: How...could you even help? They...won't listen to you.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#015.dst: 你……又能怎么帮忙？他们……不会听你的。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#015.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#016.src: I know all the war strategies and weapon cache locations.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#016.dst: 我知道所有的作战策略和武器储藏点的位置。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#016.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#017.src: Treason... against your own kind...? How will you... manage this?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#017.dst: 背叛……你自己的族人……？你要……怎么做到？
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#017.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#018.src: The human and I will sneak into the armoury and sabotage their equipment, Korzim will help you Doguns evacuate someplace safer.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#018.dst: 我跟这个人类会潜入军械库，破坏他们的装备，Korzim 会帮你们 Dogun 撤离到更安全的地方。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#018.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#019.src: I am... yet wary of you... but we will... follow your plan... Dwarf. Korzim... lead us... to safety.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#019.dst: 我……仍然信不过你……但我们会……照你的计划做……矮人。Korzim……带我们……去安全的地方。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#019.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#020.src: {u}, follow the southern road from {p}, towards the {p} entrance. I'll be waiting there for you near the armoury.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#020.dst: {u}，从 {p} 沿着南边的路走，前往 {p} 的入口。我会在军械库附近等你。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#020.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#021.dst: 在 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与 Axelus 会合。

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#022.src: Shh! Get behind here, and look towards the armoury doors.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#022.dst: 嘘！躲到这后面来，看着军械库的门。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#022.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#023.src: We need to sneak in when they aren't looking, got it? But we need to be fast.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#023.dst: 我们得趁他们不注意的时候溜进去，懂吗？但动作要快。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#023.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#024.src: If they close that door, we'll only have one option left, and it's a huge risk. Those Dwarven gates are almost unbreakable.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#024.dst: 如果他们关上那扇门，我们就只剩一个办法了，而且风险极大。那些矮人的大门几乎坚不可摧。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#024.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#025.src: Alright boys, let's close this up and head to base B.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#025.dst: 好了伙计们，把这里关上，去 B 基地。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#025.speaker: Rodoroc Commander

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#026.src: Aaah! Charge them! HEY, STOP RIGHT THERE, SOLDIERS!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#026.dst: 啊啊！冲上去！嘿，给我站住，士兵们！
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#026.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#027.src: Defeat the {p} Guards outside the armory.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#027.dst: 击败军械库外的 {p} 守卫。

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#028.src: It's the traitor! Capture them, now! There's only one reason they would be near the armoury!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#028.dst: 是那个叛徒！马上抓住他们！他们出现在军械库附近只可能有一个原因！
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#028.speaker: Commander

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#029.src: Is that all of them? We're out of danger, at least, but they still shut the door, damn it!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#029.dst: 都解决了吗？至少我们脱离危险了，可他们还是把门关上了，该死！
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#029.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#030.src: Gah, all that for nothing! You're not too banged up, are you?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#030.dst: 啊，全白忙了！你没伤得太重吧？
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#030.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#031.src: Well, I said there's another way, but it's not a guarantee. Hurry, follow me.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#031.dst: 嗯，我说过还有另一个办法，但不保证行得通。快，跟我来。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#031.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#032.src: Urgh, damn it. They almost never bother to close this door, and now of all times...
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#032.dst: 呃，该死。他们几乎从来懒得关这扇门，偏偏这个时候……
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#032.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#033.src: There's nothing for it. They'll be sending reinforcements soon, we need a way through here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#033.dst: 没办法了。他们很快就会派援兵来，我们得想办法从这里过去。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#033.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#034.src: Those black bricks look breakable...but that won't solve the door, will it?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#034.dst: 那些黑砖看起来能打破……但这解决不了门的问题，对吧？
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#034.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#035.src: Find a way to break through the black bricks outside the wooden door.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#035.dst: 想办法打破木门外的黑砖。

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#037.src: Alright, let's destroy these machines! You see the two cannons?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#037.dst: 好，我们来毁掉这些机器！你看到那两门大炮了吗？
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#037.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#038.src: If you use rocks as ammo, you'll destroy the machine it's aiming at, but if you use tnt, it'll selfdestruct. Good luck
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#038.dst: 如果你用石头当弹药，就会摧毁它瞄准的机器，但如果你用 TNT，它就会自爆。祝你好运
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#038.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#039.src: Follow Axelus deeper into {p} and destroy the power source of the city, the {p} Power Core.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#039.dst: 跟着 Axelus 深入 {p}，摧毁城市的能源来源——{p} 能源核心。

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#040.src: Nice work! That will slow them down. We're not done yet, we need to pay the king a visit. Let's head further into {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#040.dst: 干得好！这能拖慢他们。我们还没完，得去拜访国王。我们继续深入 {p}。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#040.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#041.src: Hurry! Through here, to the power core!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#041.dst: 快！穿过这里，去能源核心！
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#041.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#042.src: This is a geothermal power core. If we can disrupt it, it should slow them down.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#042.dst: 这是个地热能源核心。如果我们能干扰它，应该就能拖慢他们。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#042.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#043.src: The hypocrites used Dogun magic to make this... It's lucky, honestly. I know how to work it.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#043.dst: 那群伪君子用 Dogun 的魔法造了这个……说实话，这倒是走运。我知道怎么操作它。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#043.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#044.src: ...hell, they already rallied?! That's the army!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#044.dst: ……见鬼，他们已经集结了？！是军队！
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#044.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#045.src: That sounds like an entire battalion!! How did they know I was going after this?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#045.dst: 听起来像是整整一个营！！他们怎么知道我要来搞这个？
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#045.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#046.src: Dogun magic is slow! Keep me defended, this'll take awhile!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#046.dst: Dogun 的魔法很慢！保护好我，这得花点时间！
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#046.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#047.src: Grr, this is harder than I thought!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#047.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#048.src: Ah! Don't let them get too close!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#048.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#050.src: I hate that you're having to fight my people, but I wouldn't be asking for help if it weren't needed.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#050.dst: 我很不愿意让你跟我的族人战斗，但如果不是真的需要，我也不会找你帮忙。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#050.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#051.src: Hm...the slums should be behind this wall here. We'll lose them there.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#051.dst: 嗯……贫民窟应该就在这面墙后面。我们在那里能甩掉他们。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#051.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#052.src: The power's down, but...that cannon should do to get us through. You know how to operate it, right?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#052.dst: 能源断了，不过……那门大炮应该能帮我们打通。你知道怎么操作吧？
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#052.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#054.src: Dwarvern society isn't as great as they make it out to be. The poorest are hidden away.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#054.dst: 矮人社会没有他们说的那么美好。最穷的人都被藏起来了。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#054.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#055.src: The coalition has helped these people through some hard times, we can trust them.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#055.dst: 联盟帮这些人度过了一些难关，我们可以信任他们。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#055.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#056.src: There's a reason I brought us here. The sewer system is connected to the royal palace. All the way to the kings bathroom.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#056.dst: 我带我们来这里是有原因的。下水道系统连着王宫。一路通到国王的浴室。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#056.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#057.src: We need to find a way to ignite this explosive. Can you take a look around?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#057.dst: 我们得想办法点燃这个炸药。你能四处看看吗？
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#057.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#058.src: Find a way to enter the sewer system.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#058.dst: 想办法进入下水道系统。

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#059.src: If we can convince the king that it’s not worth the fight, he may back down.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#059.dst: 如果我们能说服国王这场仗不值得打，他也许会让步。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#059.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#060.src: I'm a little ashamed to admit I know my way round the sewers by now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#060.dst: 我有点不好意思承认，我现在对下水道已经熟门熟路了。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#060.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#061.src: You have to understand.. The people truly think the Doguns are evil incarnate. But the king knows better.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#061.dst: 你得明白..人民真的以为 Dogun 是邪恶的化身。但国王心里清楚。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#061.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#062.src: Enter the Royal Palace through the sewer pipe and find the king.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#062.dst: 从下水道管道进入王宫，找到国王。

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#063.src: Don't let the guards catch you. Stay out of sight, got it?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#063.dst: 别让守卫抓到你。躲好别被看到，懂吗？
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#063.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#064.src: Sneak past the guards and talk to the Dwarven King.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#064.dst: 偷偷溜过守卫，与矮人国王交谈。

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#065.src: I can't say I'm surprised, Axelus. Guards, let them be.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#065.dst: 我不能说我很意外，Axelus。守卫，放过他们。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#065.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#066.src: You know why I'm here, father. We haven't got any more chances to stop this.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#066.dst: 你知道我为什么来，父亲。我们已经没有别的机会阻止这一切了。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#066.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#067.src: Axelus, you know why we have to maintain the lie. Think about the people, how they would react.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#067.dst: Axelus，你知道我们为什么必须维持这个谎言。想想人民，想想他们会有什么反应。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#067.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#068.src: We can not be responsible for the lies of our ancestors! This is ridiculous and you know it!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#068.dst: 我们不能为祖先的谎言负责！这太荒唐了，你自己也知道！
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#068.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#069.src: Axelus, if the people found out, everything would descend to chaos. There would be riots, revolutions!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#069.dst: Axelus，如果人民发现了，一切都会陷入混乱。会有暴动，会有革命！
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#069.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#070.src: If you hadn't turned traitor and gone gallivanting off with the Doguns, you would be in a better position to convince me.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#070.dst: 要是你没有叛变、跟 Dogun 四处游荡，你现在会更有立场说服我。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#070.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#071.src: As it is now, you are too little and too late. The war has already begun.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#071.dst: 照现在这样，你太弱小，也太迟了。战争已经开始了。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#071.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#072.src: The armoury that a certain someone decided to sabotage won't make any difference.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#072.dst: 某人决定破坏的那座军械库改变不了什么。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#072.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#073.src: You will commit genocide so you don't have to face the consequences of your lies?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#073.dst: 你要进行种族灭绝，就为了不去面对你那些谎言的后果？
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#073.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#074.src: I will be the hero of our nation, and my name will forever be remembered as the King who brought peace.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#074.dst: 我会成为我们国家的英雄，我的名字会作为带来和平的国王被永远铭记。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#074.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#075.src: I have nothing left to say to you. See yourselves out behind the throne. I'll let you use the trading tunnel to {p} in the southern caves, if you just step back and let me handle things.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#075.dst: 我跟你没什么好说的了。从王座后面自己出去吧。只要你们退后让我处理，我就让你们使用南边洞穴里通往 {p} 的贸易隧道。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#075.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#077.src: I'm not giving up on this. I'm going back in, I know he can be reasoned with!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#077.dst: 我不会放弃的。我要回去，我知道他听得进道理！
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#077.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#078.src: Give this letter to Korzim in the Dogun village when you reach level {~}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#078.dst: 等你到了 {~} 级，把这封信交给 Dogun 村的 Korzim。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#078.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#079.src: I'm going to have one last talk with my father.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#079.dst: 我要跟我父亲进行最后一次谈话。
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#079.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#000.src: Return to the Dogun Village with the letter and speak to Korzim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#000.dst: 带着信回到 Dogun 村，与 Korzim 交谈。

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#001.src: We...have an issue. A dire one... Where is...Axelus at a time...like this?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#001.dst: 我们……有麻烦了。很严重的麻烦……在这种时候……Axelus 去哪了？
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#001.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#003.src: Oh... From Axelus, then...? He could not find...a stone? That...does not bode well.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#003.dst: 噢……那么是 Axelus 给的……？他找不到……石头？那……可不是好兆头。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#003.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#004.src: He is trying to...reason with the Dwarven King? There is...no one else...then. You... You will have to...help.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#004.dst: 他在试着……跟矮人国王讲道理？那……就没有别人了。你……你得……帮忙。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#004.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#005.src: The chieftain is...desperate. He has enacted a...terrible plan. They are planning on summoning Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#005.dst: 酋长……走投无路了。他启动了一个……可怕的计划。他们打算召唤 Garaheth。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#005.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#006.src: If they succeed...we all die. Dwarves... Doguns... Possibly even Villagers...and then... Humans as well.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#006.dst: 如果他们成功了……我们全都会死。矮人……Dogun……甚至可能连村民……然后……人类也一样。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#006.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#007.src: Garaheth is a...horrible demon. We used to worship him...thousands of years ago.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#007.dst: Garaheth 是个……可怕的恶魔。我们曾经……在几千年前崇拜过他。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#007.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#008.src: I only overheard parts... But enough to be certain. They are preparing...to the south. At a disused...ritual site.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#008.dst: 我只偷听到一部分……但足以确定。他们正在……南边准备。在一个废弃的……仪式场地。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#008.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#009.src: Meet me there... Do not just attack. We may be able to...resolve it peacefully. I will wait...by the staircase.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#009.dst: 在那里跟我会合……不要直接动手。我们也许能……和平解决。我会在……楼梯旁等你。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#009.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#010.src: Investigate the structure to the south.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#011.src: We shall take the east tower... Hide there...and watch.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#011.dst: 我们去东边的塔……躲在那里……观察。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#011.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#012.src: Interrupting...at this point will have...disastrous consequences. We must let them continue...and pray they fail.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#012.dst: 这个时候打断……会造成……灾难性的后果。我们只能让他们继续……祈祷他们失败。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#012.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#013.src: Reach into the darkness...and grasp the hand of Garaheth to purge the intruders...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#013.dst: 伸入黑暗……握住 Garaheth 之手，清除入侵者……
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#013.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#014.src: This is a worst-case scenario... Meet me in {p}. We will talk more there...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#014.dst: 这是最坏的情况……到 {p} 跟我会合。我们到那里再详谈……
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#014.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#015.src: Travel to {p} and meet Korzim at the entrance. [{~},-{~}]
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#015.dst: 前往 {p}，在入口与 Korzim 会合。[{~},-{~}]

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#016.src: Hoho...! Over here...fine traveler! Join me at the gates!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#016.dst: 呵呵……！这边……尊贵的旅人！到城门这里来找我！
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#016.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#017.src: This dwarf voice is...horrible on my throat...but it is an effective disguise...is it not?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#017.dst: 这矮人的嗓音……对我的喉咙真是折磨……不过这伪装……挺有效的……不是吗？
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#017.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#018.src: We are headed to...a blacksmith in town. Follow me...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#018.dst: 我们要去……镇上的一个铁匠那里。跟我来……
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#018.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#019.src: Talk to the blacksmith in {p} at {~} {~} -{~}

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#020.src: ...Korzim...what in the name of all that is holy is that disguise?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#020.dst: ……Korzim……以一切神圣之名，你这是什么伪装？
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#020.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#021.src: I'm flabbergasted you fooled anyone with that thing! How did you stop the beard from burning?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#021.dst: 你竟然能用那玩意骗过别人，我简直惊呆了！你是怎么让胡子不烧起来的？
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#021.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#022.src: But, erm...more importantly, who's the buck in the fancy armour there?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#022.dst: 不过，呃……更重要的是，那边穿着华丽盔甲的家伙是谁？
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#022.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#023.src: An ally...of the coalition. No time...Edula. Doguns... summoning... Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#023.dst: 一个盟友……联盟的。没时间了……Edula。Dogun……在召唤……Garaheth。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#023.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#024.src: So...so it's really down to that low, then. Burning your own house down to kill the rats.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#024.dst: 所以……所以真的到了这个地步了。为了杀老鼠，把自己的房子都烧了。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#024.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#025.src: Good thing we've got this prepared. One fallout will prevent the next. Soldier, I've got a list of materials we need!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#025.dst: 还好我们早有准备。一场灾难能防住下一场。士兵，我这里有一张我们需要的材料清单！
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#025.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#026.src: You will need [{~} Fire Webs]. The Heatscar Spiders under the town make them, there's a cave right by the entrance arch.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#026.dst: 你需要 [{~} 火焰蛛丝]。镇子底下的热疤蜘蛛会吐这种丝，入口拱门旁边就有个洞窟。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#026.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#027.src: Then, [{~} Magmatic Crystals] from the {p} mines. I'd get them myself, but...I'm banned from there since the rubber mallet incident.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#027.dst: 然后，从 {p} 矿坑拿 [{~} 岩浆水晶]。我本来可以自己去拿，可是……自从橡胶锤事件之后我就被禁止进去了。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#027.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#028.src: Lastly, [{~} Crystallized Lava]. The closest source is in the lava lake just outside {p}. There's a protruding crater in the lake.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#028.dst: 最后，[{~} 结晶熔岩]。最近的来源在 {p} 外面的熔岩湖里。湖里有个突起的火山口。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#028.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#029.src: Bring back [{~} Fire Webs], [{~} Magmatic Crystals], and [{~} Crystallized lava].
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#029.dst: 带回 [{~} 火焰蛛丝]、[{~} 岩浆水晶] 和 [{~} 结晶熔岩]。

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#030.src: The crystal formation... It is definitely here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#030.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#031.src: I will clear the lava... On my signal, move. And do not stop.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#031.dst: 我来清开熔岩……等我信号，就走。而且别停。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#031.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#033.src: Mhm, looks like everything's in order. Now, for a short explanation.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#033.dst: 嗯嗯，看起来都没问题。现在，简单解释一下。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#033.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#034.src: These materials go into crafting a special charm. It will allow you to resist demon fire.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#034.dst: 这些材料是用来打造一种特殊护符的。它能让你抵挡恶魔之火。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#034.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#035.src: We need to account for if they finish the summoning, so this'll help keep you safe if you end up having to square off with Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#035.dst: 我们得考虑到他们完成召唤的可能，所以万一你得跟 Garaheth 正面交锋，这能帮你保住性命。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#035.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#036.src: You will need to craft it yourself, so its magic will bond to you. I've got a station just for it.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#036.dst: 你得亲手打造它，这样它的魔法才会跟你结合。我有一个专门的工作台。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#036.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#037.src: Right-click the crafting table in the back and put it together.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#037.dst: 右键点击后面的工作台，把它组装起来。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#037.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#038.src: Craft the amulet in the crafting table.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#039.src: We must... visit... Sanba... the enchanter.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#039.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#040.src: Go to the enchanter and enchant the amulet.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#040.dst: 前往附魔师那里给护符附魔。

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#041.src: Erm...Korzim, what on earth are you doing here? It's not safe for you!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#041.dst: 呃……Korzim，你到底在这里干什么？这里对你不安全！
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#041.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#042.src: Wait, that amulet...oh no, really? Okay, I know what^s going on.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#042.dst: 等等，那个护符……噢不，真的吗？好，我知道是怎么回事了。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#042.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#043.src: We're going to need to give this a little extra kick if you're going to use this for what I think you are.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#043.dst: 如果你们要拿它去做我想的那件事，我们得给它再加点料。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#043.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#044.src: A pinch of fire scarab tail, splash of sulphur, exactly three ounces of old brimstone...!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#044.dst: 一撮火甲虫尾巴，一点硫磺，刚好三盎司的陈年硫磺石……！
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#044.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#045.src: Infunde hoc monile, alta intra monte. Magia!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#045.dst: Infunde hoc monile, alta intra monte. Magia!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#045.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#046.src: Meet me in the back, we can't talk out here. You never know who's listening...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#046.dst: 到后面来找我，在这里不能谈。你永远不知道谁在偷听……
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#046.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#047.src: Enter the storage room in the enchanter's house.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#047.dst: 进入附魔师家的储藏室。

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#048.src: Supposing you're here to help, Soldier. Garaheth's being summoned if you're getting this...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#048.dst: 我想你是来帮忙的吧，士兵。如果你拿到这个，就代表 Garaheth 正在被召唤……
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#048.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#049.src: Axelus prepped a contingency plan for this, but having to put it in action is surreal. Let me fill you in.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#049.dst: Axelus 为这种情况准备了应急计划，可真到了要执行的时候，还是觉得很不真实。我来给你讲讲。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#049.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#050.src: That dragon skeleton lying in the Heights belonged to an Ice Drake. Centuries ago, it was used in the Dogun wars.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#050.dst: 躺在高地的那具龙骨属于一头冰龙。几百年前，它在 Dogun 战争中被派上用场。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#050.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#051.src: It had incredibly potent magic, particularly in its icy breath. The area it hit is still frozen to this day, and shows no signs of thaw.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#051.dst: 它拥有极其强大的魔法，尤其是它冰冷的吐息。被它击中的地方至今仍然冰封，丝毫没有解冻的迹象。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#051.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#052.src: According to Axelus' stories, its breath travelled through the tunnels and coalesced someplace deep within...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#052.dst: 根据 Axelus 的说法，它的吐息穿过隧道，在深处某个地方凝聚了起来……
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#052.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#053.src: ...becoming True Ice, a potent mixture of sheer cold and magic energy. That's what we will need to combat Garaheth.'
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#053.dst: ……变成了真冰，一种极寒与魔法能量的强效混合物。那就是我们对付 Garaheth 需要的东西。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#053.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#054.src: If you bring me [{~} True Ice] I can make a staff capable of harnessing it...and we can freeze Garaheth in its tracks.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#054.dst: 如果你给我带来 [{~} 真冰]，我就能做一根能驾驭它的法杖……然后我们就能把 Garaheth 冻在原地。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#054.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#055.src: Head north to the Freezing Heights and make your way to the top, now! We've got no time at all!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#055.dst: 往北去冰冻高地，爬到最上面，快！我们一点时间都没有了！
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#055.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#056.src: Travel to the frozen heights and find {~} True Ice.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#056.dst: 前往冰冻高地，找到 {~} 块真冰。

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#057.src: ... This... This used to be...a Dogun town. The Dwarves rendered it barren.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#057.dst: ……这里……这里以前是……一个 Dogun 小镇。矮人把它变成了荒地。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#057.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#058.src: They used the Drake... They chained it up and...forced it to attack. We had to kill it...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#058.dst: 他们利用了那头冰龙……他们用锁链锁住它……逼它攻击。我们只好杀了它……
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#058.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#059.src: It... froze my town... as it died. I was there... {~} years ago.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#059.dst: 它……在死去时……冻住了我的小镇。我当时就在……{~} 年前。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#059.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#060.src: I know the way... into the caves.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#060.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#061.src: The True Ice...is deep inside. I will struggle to...stay warm here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#061.dst: 真冰……在很深的地方。在这里我很难……保持温暖。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#061.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#062.src: I will try to run through...as quickly as possible. The ice is...painful.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#062.dst: 我会尽量……快速跑过去。这冰……好痛。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#062.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#063.src: We must... move fast... or... we will both.... freeze.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#063.dst: 我们必须……快点走……否则……我们俩都会……冻住。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#063.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#064.src: Maybe... I am... hotter than... I thought... do you.. Hear that?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#064.dst: 也许……我比……我想的……还热……你……听到了吗？
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#064.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#065.src: Oh no... I think... It's... COLLAPSING.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#065.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#066.src: My... feet are... solid... Keep... running.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#066.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#067.src: This is it... The thing that... Killed my families... [{~} True Ice].
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#067.dst: 就是它……那个……杀死我家人的东西……[{~} 真冰]。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#067.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#068.src: Return to the enchanter with the True Ice.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#068.dst: 带着真冰回到附魔师那里。

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#069.src: Impressive, you two. Must've been tough to get that...doubly so for Korzim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#069.dst: 厉害，你们俩。拿到那个一定很辛苦……对 Korzim 来说更是加倍辛苦。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#069.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#070.src: Here is the staff, {u}. Keep it safe, and don't you go dying on us.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#070.dst: 法杖在这里，{u}。好好保管，可别死了。
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#070.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#071.src: My husband and I will round up the coalition and get them to act now. We need to get going before-
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#071.dst: 我和我丈夫会召集联盟，让他们马上行动。我们得赶紧出发，免得——
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#071.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#072.src: ...that's the barracks door. That's the barracks door!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#072.dst: ……那是兵营的门。那是兵营的门！！
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#072.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#073.src: Men! We have to meet for briefing on the surface, the war is due any hour now! Move faster!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#073.dst: 弟兄们！我们得到地面上集合听简报，战争随时都会开始！快点！
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#073.speaker: Maex Soldier

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#074.src: They're already going?! We're out of time! Korzim is waiting for you just upstairs when you reach level {~}. Go train! NOW!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#074.dst: 他们已经出发了？！我们没时间了！等你到了 {~} 级，Korzim 就在楼上等你。去练级！马上！
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#074.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#000.src: Return to Korzim on the second floor of the enchanter in {p} with the Amulet of Fire Resistance and the Staff of True Ice.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#000.dst: 带着抗火护符和真冰法杖，回到 {p} 附魔师二楼的 Korzim 那里。

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#001.src: ...Do you have...the staff? And the amulet...?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#001.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#002.src: The war is starting... and Axelus... He has not returned.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#002.dst: 战争要开始了……而 Axelus……他还没回来。
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#002.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#003.src: We can not go... Not without him. Find him... And bring him to the... Dogun village.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#003.dst: 我们不能去……没有他不行。找到他……带他到……Dogun 村。
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#003.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#004.src: I can not leave. The guard...it is on high alert. He was last at {p}...yes?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#004.dst: 我不能离开。守卫……处于高度戒备。他最后出现在 {p}……对吧？
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#004.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#005.src: Head to {p} and look for Axelus.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#006.src: The first group has already started their climb, let's hurry.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#006.dst: 第一批人已经开始往上爬了，我们快点。
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#006.speaker: Soldier

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#007.src: Hey! Everyone, the king has someone in the cage! It's been years since we used it!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#007.dst: 嘿！大家快看，国王把人关进笼子里了！那笼子好多年没用过了！
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#007.speaker: Rodoroc Citizen

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#008.src: Wait, that's Axelus up there!! The king locked up his son?! What in the world?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#008.dst: 等等，上面那个是 Axelus！！国王把自己的儿子关起来了？！这到底是怎么回事？
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#008.speaker: Rodoroc Citizen

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#009.src: I heard he was consorting with demons, but that can't possibly be true, can it?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#009.dst: 我听说他跟恶魔勾结，不过那不可能是真的吧？
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#009.speaker: Rodoroc Citizen

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#010.src: For the last time, they are not demons!! Gods, I've been telling you this whole time! Not even my father will listen to reason!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#010.dst: 我最后说一次，他们不是恶魔！！天哪，我从头到尾一直在跟你们说！连我父亲都不肯讲道理！
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#010.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#011.src: If I don't get freed we're doomed, you hear me?! We won't survive another war! As your prince I demand to be freed!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#011.dst: 如果我不被放出去，我们就完了，听到了吗？！我们撑不过另一场战争！我以王子的身份命令你们放我出去！
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#011.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#012.src: Listen, the statues are climbable and there's a control panel for the lava siphons near them! Now help me so we all don't die!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#012.dst: 听着，那些雕像可以爬，雕像旁边有熔岩虹吸管的控制面板！现在帮帮我，免得我们全都死掉！
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#012.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#013.src: Free Axelus and escape the city.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#014.src: Wait, that human just defaced the hero's monument!! Are they working with the demons too?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#014.dst: 等等，那个人类刚刚毁了英雄纪念碑！！他们也是跟恶魔一伙的吗？
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#014.speaker: Rodoroc Citizen

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#015.src: {u}! I didn't think you'd be back, but we need to leave, now! Meet me outside!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#015.dst: {u}！我没想到你会回来，不过我们得马上离开！在外面跟我会合！
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#015.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#016.src: {u}! Over here, to the right! By the cannon! I'm commandeering this thing.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#016.dst: {u}！这边，右边！大炮旁边！这东西我征用了。
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#016.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#017.src: We need to get up to the Doguns before the Dwarves begin their assault, or before the Doguns take their last resort.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#017.dst: 我们得在矮人发动进攻之前，或是 Dogun 采取最后手段之前，赶到 Dogun 那里。
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#017.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#018.src: Get in the cannon, now! You've got your armour, you might end up charred and covered in soot but you'll be fine!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#018.dst: 快进大炮！你有护甲，可能会被烧焦、沾满煤灰，但你不会有事的！
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#018.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#019.src: Don't tell anyone we shot ourselves out of a cannon, I'll never live it down. Now come on, to the Dogun village, hurry!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#019.dst: 别告诉任何人我们是用大炮把自己射出去的，不然我这辈子都抬不起头。好了，快，去 Dogun 村！
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#019.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#020.src: If the Doguns are taking their last resort and summoning Garaheth, then we've got two sides to stop at once...basically, the odds are astronomically against us.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#020.dst: 如果 Dogun 正在采取最后手段召唤 Garaheth，那我们就得同时阻止两边……说白了，我们的胜算低得离谱。
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#020.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#021.src: That means you do what you need to do, no matter what. Understood? If we can stop this madness then the casualties won't have died for nothing! Now move!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#021.dst: 这代表你该做什么就做什么，不管怎样。明白吗？如果我们能阻止这场疯狂，那些牺牲就不会白费！现在快走！
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#021.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#022.src: Reach the portal and stop Garaheth.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#024.src: Quiet. Dwarven whelp...we will not go quietly. AWAKEN.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#024.dst: 安静。矮人小崽子……我们不会乖乖就范。苏醒吧。
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#024.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#025.src: I can't believe this... That bone was part of the ritual?! Agh, how could we have been so STUPID! You're all lucky we prepared for this!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#025.dst: 真不敢相信……那根骨头是仪式的一部分？！啊，我们怎么会这么蠢！还好我们为此做了准备，你们都走运了！！
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#025.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#026.src: You need to get inside him. He's still chained! The amulet will protect you from the heat! Freeze him from the inside out!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#026.dst: 你得进到他体内。他还被锁着！护符会保护你不被烫伤！从里面把他冻住！！
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#026.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#028.src: Find all {~} organs and destroy them.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#028.dst: 找到全部 {~} 个器官并摧毁它们。

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#029.src: Leave Garaheth and exit his realm.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#029.dst: 离开 Garaheth，走出他的领域。

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#030.src: EVERYONE, STOP THIS! RIGHT NOW!! IT'S OVER!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#030.dst: 所有人，住手！马上！！结束了！！
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#030.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#031.src: Open your eyes for once in your lives!! You see that?! Behind me! THAT was going to be the end result!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#031.dst: 这辈子就睁开眼睛看一次吧！！你们看到了吗？！我身后！那本来就会是最后的结局！
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#031.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#032.src: Garaheth would have killed every one of us, damn it! Are you that short-sighted that you can't see this?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#032.dst: Garaheth 会杀光我们每一个人，该死！你们难道短视到连这都看不出来吗？！
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#032.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#033.src: Everyone here is to blame, except the human who helped stop this! The Doguns were already exiled, they wouldn't have hurt anyone!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#033.dst: 这里的每一个人都有责任，除了帮忙阻止这一切的人类！Dogun 早就被放逐了，他们不会伤害任何人！
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#033.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#034.src: But we couldn't just let ANYTHING be! You always need more glory, more, more, MORE! Don't you, Draani? I'm ashamed to be your lineage!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#034.dst: 可我们就是什么都放不下！你们永远需要更多的荣耀，更多，更多，更多！对吧，Draani？身为你的血脉让我感到羞耻！
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#034.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#035.src: And you, Doguns! I...I pitied you. You were wronged, but you resort to this? You'd doom the world over to spite the Dwarves? Is that it?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#035.dst: 还有你们，Dogun！我……我同情过你们。你们被冤枉了，可你们竟然采取这种手段？为了报复矮人，你们要毁灭整个世界？就是这样吗？！
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#035.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#036.src: Whelp. You do not understand. To be persecuted...and see your people tortured...hunted.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#036.dst: 小崽子。你不懂。被迫害……看着你的族人被折磨……被猎杀。
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#036.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#037.src: You all deserve it! You attacked out ancestors for sport! Eye for an eye, have you heard of it? It's only fair!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#037.dst: 你们都活该！你们为了取乐攻击我没 [原文如此] 的祖先！以眼还眼，听过没有？这很公平！
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#037.speaker: Dwarven Commander

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#038.src: Imbeciles...your stories are not true. We... We lived through the war. You took everything...and suffered none.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#038.dst: 蠢货……你们的故事不是真的。我们……我们亲历过那场战争。你们夺走了一切……却什么苦都没受。
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#038.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#039.src: I've been trying to tell BOTH of you that the monarchy has been spreading lies for centuries! One bad king doesn't mean the whole species is a loss!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#039.dst: 我一直想告诉你们双方，王室几百年来一直在散播谎言！一个坏国王不代表整个种族都没救了！
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#039.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#040.src: Shut your mouth. Even now...you trample on the bones of our god... You have taken everything from us...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#040.dst: 闭上你的嘴。即使到了现在……你们还在践踏我们神明的骸骨……你们夺走了我们的一切……
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#040.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#041.src: This earth is stained by you. We...we shall burn you...and scatter your ash to the wind.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#041.dst: 这片土地被你们玷污了。我们……我们要烧死你们……把你们的骨灰撒向风中。
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#041.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#042.src: DON'T YOU DARE! STOP, RIGHT NOW!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#042.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#045.src: You would... You would kill a savior...?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#045.dst: 你们竟然……你们竟然会杀死一位救世主……？
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#045.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#046.src: No, no! No no no, this can't be happening! H-Hang on, we'll save you, I...I'll do something, I...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#046.dst: 不，不！不不不，这不可能！撑、撑住，我们会救你的，我……我会想办法，我……
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#046.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#047.src: Y-You DEMONS! MONSTERS! I'll avenge you, Axelus, j-just give me time-
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#047.dst: 你、你们这些恶魔！怪物！我会替你报仇的，Axelus，只、只要给我时间——
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#047.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#048.src: AGH, SHUT UP! SHUT...ack... Q-Quiet. Listen to one damn word from my mouth, Draani... For once in your miserable life
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#048.dst: 啊，闭嘴！闭……呃……安、安静。就听我说一句该死的话吧，Draani……你那悲惨的一生就听这一次
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#048.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#049.src: Tell. The. TRUTH!! G-gaagh...you know that's th...the only way to stop this. Swallow your pride, you...old fool...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#049.dst: 说。出。真相！！呃、呃啊……你知道那是……唯一能阻止这一切的办法。放下你的骄傲吧，你这……老糊涂……
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#049.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#050.src: I...I... Axelus... He...he called me Draani...why did...?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#050.dst: 我……我……Axelus……他……他叫我 Draani……为什么……？
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#050.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#051.src: Men, stand down. This... This war is over! I will not have one more life lost! Touch the Doguns and I'll personally behead you!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#051.dst: 所有人，停手。这……这场战争结束了！我不会再让任何一条生命逝去！谁敢碰 Dogun，我就亲手砍了他的头！
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#051.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#052.src: Chief, I...I ask of you but an hour of your time. If you are willing to negotiate...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#052.dst: 酋长，我……我只求你给我一个小时。如果你愿意谈判……
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#052.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#053.src: Speak with the King of {p} and the Dogun Chieftain.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#053.dst: 与 {p} 国王和 Dogun 酋长交谈。

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#054.src: Ah, you've arrived. I...actually remember you from earlier. So you and...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#054.dst: 啊，你来了。我……其实记得之前见过你。所以你和……
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#054.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#056.src: ...you knew my son. Were helping him try to put an end to this, before everything was too far gone. Heh...apologies, for that.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#056.dst: ……你认识我儿子。在一切无法挽回之前，你一直在帮他想办法结束这一切。呵……为此，我很抱歉。
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#056.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#057.src: Paku and I have had a long discussion about the wisdom of youth over the old. You all were right. I needed to swallow my pride.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#057.dst: Paku 和我长谈了一番，谈的是年轻人比老人更有智慧。你们都是对的。我需要放下我的骄傲。
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#057.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#058.src: We agreed upon a peace treaty... A new city... The Dwarves will aid us in building it.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#058.dst: 我们达成了和平条约……一座新城……矮人会帮我们建造。
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#058.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#059.src: All hostilities...will end. My people will...be free to roam the caverns. It has been...too long.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#059.dst: 所有敌对……都会结束。我的族人……将能自由地在洞穴中漫游。已经……太久了。
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#059.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#060.src: And the entombed Doguns at Courag will be reconstituted, as well, supposing that is a possibility.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#060.dst: 而被封存在 Courag 的 Dogun 也会被复原，如果有可能的话。
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#060.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#061.src: Every king, since my so-far-great grandfather, Draani Thunderwill, has battled with their morality over the lies told to my people.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#061.dst: 自从我的曾曾祖父 Draani Thunderwill 以来，每一位国王都为向我的人民撒谎一事而在良心上挣扎。
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#061.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#062.src: It ends here, with the name Draani VIII. It will take time, but the bloodshed has proven things must begin to change now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#062.dst: 这一切就到此为止，止于 Draani 八世这个名字。这需要时间，但这场流血已经证明，改变必须从现在开始。
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#062.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#063.src: You and the coalition have saved the Heights, and Gavel. In {p}, you will find a stall to trade valuable minerals. You will be granted special Dwarven privileges to purchase it now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#063.dst: 你和联盟拯救了高地，也拯救了 Gavel。在 {p}，你会找到一个交易珍贵矿物的摊位。你将获得矮人的特别许可，现在就能在那里购买。
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#063.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#064.src: Though that is...almost certainly not enough a reward for everything you have done...sincerely. Thank you, Wynn soldier.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#064.dst: 虽然对于你所做的一切，这……几乎肯定算不上足够的回报……真心地。谢谢你，Wynn 的士兵。
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#064.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwelling Walls#000.dst: 与 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Leucsaa 对话

Dwelling Walls#001.src: Let's see here... mother's old vase... check!
Dwelling Walls#001.dst: 我看看……母亲的旧花瓶……有了！
Dwelling Walls#001.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#002.src: Dining room table... got it here, check!
Dwelling Walls#002.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#003.src: Finally, the journal. It's out here somewhere, I assume. I'll look around.
Dwelling Walls#003.dst: 最后是日志。我想应该就在外面哪里吧。我找找看。
Dwelling Walls#003.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#005.src: Hold on, what? The journal! I must have forgotten it inside the mansion!
Dwelling Walls#005.dst: 等等，什么？日志！我一定是把它忘在宅邸里了！
Dwelling Walls#005.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#006.src: You there! Would you mind doing me a deed?
Dwelling Walls#006.dst: 那边的你！能帮我个忙吗？
Dwelling Walls#006.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#007.src: I left a very precious journal inside this mansion, a hell within walls. It was my great grandfather's!
Dwelling Walls#007.dst: 我把一本非常珍贵的日志忘在这座宅邸里了，这里简直是四面墙围起来的地狱。那是我曾祖父的！
Dwelling Walls#007.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#008.src: The mansion was designed by a Corkian architect, and I was scammed into buying it.
Dwelling Walls#008.dst: 这座宅邸是一位 Corkus 建筑师设计的，我是被骗才买下它的。
Dwelling Walls#008.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#009.src: If you step inside the mansion just for a few moments, you'll understand why the sellers had to trick someone into investing in their god forsaken real estate!
Dwelling Walls#009.dst: 你只要进去待上一小会儿，就会明白卖家为什么非得骗人来买他们这块鬼地方了！
Dwelling Walls#009.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#010.src: Navigating from room to room is nearly impossible, the rooms move around. I've only been in the mansion for a week and I'm already packing my bags and moving to {p}.
Dwelling Walls#010.dst: 在房间之间走动几乎不可能，房间会自己移动。我才住了一个星期，就已经在打包行李准备搬去 {p} 了。
Dwelling Walls#010.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#012.src: Navigate the mansion to the room holding the journal
Dwelling Walls#012.dst: 在宅邸里找路，前往放着日志的房间

Dwelling Walls#014.src: The journal! You outsmarted the mansion!
Dwelling Walls#014.dst: 日志！你智胜了这座宅邸！
Dwelling Walls#014.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#015.src: I must thank you, that journal was priceless to my family.
Dwelling Walls#015.dst: 我得谢谢你，那本日志对我家来说是无价之宝。
Dwelling Walls#015.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#016.src: Let this be a life lesson to you. Never buy a house from a Corkian architect.
Dwelling Walls#016.dst: 就当是给你的人生教训吧。千万别买 Corkus 建筑师盖的房子。
Dwelling Walls#016.speaker: Leucsaa

Echoes of Change#001.src: The painting has a note attached to it.
Echoes of Change#001.dst: 这幅画上附着一张纸条。

Echoes of Change#002.src: Attend the meeting to prepare for the plan in the Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#002.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的钢羽参加会议，为计划做准备。

Echoes of Change#004.src: I trust everyone has taken the time to process last night's announcement? I will let Syndra take over shortly, but first, I would like to thank each and every one of you.
Echoes of Change#004.dst: 我相信大家都花时间消化昨晚的宣布了吧？我等一下会让 Syndra 接手，但首先，我想感谢在座的每一位。
Echoes of Change#004.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#005.src: I won't mince words. This is dangerous work. What we are planning puts us at great risk. But this is what it takes to change Fruma, to put an end to the crown's oppression!
Echoes of Change#005.dst: 我就直说了。这是危险的工作。我们计划的事会让我们身陷险境。但要改变 Fruma、终结王室的压迫，就得这么做！
Echoes of Change#005.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#006.src: We will kill a God! And we will all be free. Now, Syndra?
Echoes of Change#006.dst: 我们要杀死一位神！然后我们都将获得自由。好了，Syndra？
Echoes of Change#006.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#007.src: Thank you, Quill. To begin, allow me to give each group their assignment.
Echoes of Change#007.dst: 谢谢你，Quill。首先，我来分配各组的任务。
Echoes of Change#007.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#008.src: Mora and Yuman, you will be infiltrating the guards' outpost in {p} to retrieve their schedules. Get in, note down the formations, and get out.
Echoes of Change#008.dst: Mora 和 Yuman，你们负责潜入 {p} 的守卫哨所，取得他们的排班表。进去，记下部署，然后出来。
Echoes of Change#008.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#009.src: Mora, you're familiar with military structure, and Yuman knows his way around {p}. I expect you two should be able to make it work.
Echoes of Change#009.dst: Mora，你熟悉军队的编制，而 Yuman 对 {p} 很熟。我想你们两个应该能搞定。
Echoes of Change#009.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#011.src: Understood. However, I have a few concerns with the overall plans... I'll speak with you later.
Echoes of Change#011.dst: 明白。不过，我对整体计划有些顾虑……之后再跟你谈。
Echoes of Change#011.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#012.src: Yusanu and Sui, you'll be constructing explosives that we can use as distractions during the festival to draw guards away from the main stage.
Echoes of Change#012.dst: Yusanu 和 Sui，你们负责制作炸药，在庆典期间用来声东击西，把守卫从主舞台引开。
Echoes of Change#012.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#013.src: I trust Yusanu knows what he's doing, so Sui, you'll be acting as an assistant.
Echoes of Change#013.dst: 我相信 Yusanu 知道自己在做什么，所以 Sui，你来当助手。
Echoes of Change#013.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#015.src: Works for me. I might already have some blueprints lying around somewhere...
Echoes of Change#015.dst: 我没问题。我这里说不定已经有些设计图丢在哪了……
Echoes of Change#015.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#016.src: Zeph and Rex, I want you to scout the city rooftops for potential spots where Rex and Yulie can provide aerial support... in case it's necessary.
Echoes of Change#016.dst: Zeph 和 Rex，我要你们去侦察城里的屋顶，找出 Rex 和 Yulie 能提供空中支援的位置……以防万一需要。
Echoes of Change#016.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#017.src: Yeah, I c- c- can do that.
Echoes of Change#017.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#019.src: Quill and Yulie, you two know your way around the city. I'll need you to scout out potential escape routes from the city... again, in case things go badly.
Echoes of Change#019.dst: Quill 和 Yulie，你们两个熟悉这座城市。我需要你们侦察出城的逃生路线……同样，以防情况不妙。
Echoes of Change#019.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#020.src: Ah, that should be a breeze.
Echoes of Change#020.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#021.src: ...yes. I think I have a few places in mind already.
Echoes of Change#021.dst: ……好。我心里已经有几个地方了。
Echoes of Change#021.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#022.src: Finally. {u}, I want you to be adaptable. Help out wherever it's needed - I'm sure your skills will come in handy.
Echoes of Change#022.dst: 最后。{u}，我要你随机应变。哪里需要就去帮哪里——我相信你的本事会派上用场。
Echoes of Change#022.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#023.src: Hey, if you're helping out wherever, you should come with me and Mora! Guard positions would be handy to know before finding escape routes.
Echoes of Change#023.dst: 嘿，既然你哪里都帮，那就跟我和 Mora 一起吧！找逃生路线之前先知道守卫的位置会很有用。
Echoes of Change#023.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#024.src: I was about to suggest the same thing. Then let us adjourn this meeting. Good luck, everyone.
Echoes of Change#024.dst: 我正想这么建议。那就散会吧。祝大家好运。
Echoes of Change#024.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#025.src: Hum. {u} and Yuman, let us go our plans then.
Echoes of Change#025.dst: 嗯。{u} 和 Yuman，那我们就去执行计划吧。
Echoes of Change#025.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#026.src: Meet up with Mora and Yuman at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#026.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与 Mora 和 Yuman 会合。

Echoes of Change#027.src: Alright, guys! So, any plans? What're we cooking with here?
Echoes of Change#027.dst: 好了，各位！所以，有什么计划？我们手上有什么招？
Echoes of Change#027.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#029.src: Hey, man, everything good? I'm uh, not that horrible to work with, am I? Haha.
Echoes of Change#029.dst: 嘿，老兄，你还好吧？我，呃，没那么难合作吧？哈哈。
Echoes of Change#029.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#030.src: Ah! My apologies. No, it is not you... I simply do not like Syndra's plan.
Echoes of Change#030.dst: 啊！抱歉。不，不是因为你……我只是不喜欢 Syndra 的计划。
Echoes of Change#030.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#031.src: You must understand, I would trust her with my life... but that is precisely the issue. She will do anything to avoid putting us in danger.
Echoes of Change#031.dst: 你要明白，我愿意把性命托付给她……但问题正在于此。她会不惜一切避免让我们陷入危险。
Echoes of Change#031.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#032.src: She treats us as her own children, but she is only a decade older than I am! She would put herself through all the suffering in the world, if only to avoid letting us help where it is most needed!
Echoes of Change#032.dst: 她把我们当成自己的孩子，可她只比我大十岁！她宁愿自己承受世上所有的苦，也不肯让我们在最需要的地方帮忙！
Echoes of Change#032.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#033.src: She is willing to take the fall if the plan goes awry. But, this time... this time, I will not back off. I am not allowing her to put herself through that danger alone.
Echoes of Change#033.dst: 如果计划出了差错，她愿意一个人扛下。但是，这一次……这一次，我不会退让。我不会让她独自面对那种危险。
Echoes of Change#033.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#034.src: Yeesh. Didn't think you guys were that messy! I think I get it though.
Echoes of Change#034.dst: 哎哟。没想到你们之间这么复杂！不过我想我懂。
Echoes of Change#034.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#035.src: My bros... they mean well, yeah, but they never ask for help. They're always trying to do everything themselves, and... and it drives me nuts!
Echoes of Change#035.dst: 我哥哥们……他们是好意，没错，但他们从不开口求助。他们总想什么事都自己扛，然后……然后快把我逼疯了！
Echoes of Change#035.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#036.src: Like, man, just let me do something!! Anything!! It's so frustrating.
Echoes of Change#036.dst: 就是说，天啊，让我做点什么吧！！什么都行！！真的很让人火大。
Echoes of Change#036.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#037.src: Ha! I did not think we had this in common. Well then... perhaps we can both prove ourselves to our families, eh?
Echoes of Change#037.dst: 哈！没想到我们有这个共同点。那么……也许我们都能向家人证明自己，嗯？
Echoes of Change#037.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#038.src: Yeah!! I like the sound of that!!
Echoes of Change#038.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#039.src: Okay, well, I know where the guards' outpost is in {p}. Let's just go to it and take it from there!
Echoes of Change#039.dst: 好，我知道 {p} 的守卫哨所在哪。我们直接过去，到了再说！
Echoes of Change#039.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#040.src: Ha, settle down a little. I think we need to be a bit more prepared than that. But, yes, time is of the essence, so let us head there first. I will attempt to think of a plan on the way.
Echoes of Change#040.dst: 哈，冷静点。我想我们得准备得比那更充分。不过，没错，时间紧迫，所以我们先过去吧。我会在路上想个计划。
Echoes of Change#040.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#041.src: Whatever, man! Too much planning often spoils the results... but, sure! Let's meet outside the tallest building in {p}. First tunnel to the right leads there!
Echoes of Change#041.dst: 随便啦，老兄！计划太多往往会坏事……不过，好吧！我们在 {p} 最高的建筑外面碰头。右边第一条隧道通往那里！
Echoes of Change#041.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#042.src: Meet up with Yuman and Mora in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#042.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 {p} 与 Yuman 和 Mora 会合。

Echoes of Change#044.src: Good grief, this town's a mess. How does anyone live here?
Echoes of Change#044.dst: 天哪，这座城真是乱七八糟。怎么会有人住在这里？
Echoes of Change#044.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#045.src: Eh, ya get used to it. Here, follow me.
Echoes of Change#045.dst: 嗯，住久了就习惯了。来，跟我走。
Echoes of Change#045.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#046.src: See, {p} utilizes all the space it has... stacking things atop each other. For example, this so-called "skyscraper" is mainly an apartment building!
Echoes of Change#046.dst: 你看，{p} 把所有空间都用上了……把东西一层层往上叠。比如说，这栋所谓的“摩天楼”主要是公寓楼！
Echoes of Change#046.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#047.src: Then... what exactly are we doing here?
Echoes of Change#047.dst: 那……我们到底来这里做什么？
Echoes of Change#047.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#048.src: I said mainly, man. The top floors serve as the offices for the local commander and constables. That's also why we've got to climb this staircase!
Echoes of Change#048.dst: 我说的是主要啦，老兄。顶楼是当地指挥官和警备兵的办公室。所以我们才得爬这道楼梯！
Echoes of Change#048.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#049.src: Hope you guys are in shape!
Echoes of Change#049.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#051.src: Uh... we're on a mission, right? Trying to prove ourselves? Schedules are up there, so...
Echoes of Change#051.dst: 呃……我们在执行任务，对吧？要证明自己？排班表就在上面，所以……
Echoes of Change#051.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#052.src: We cannot just... walk in there and grab the schedules! You do realize that, right? {u} and I are wanted by the crown! Even showing ourselves here at all is a risk.
Echoes of Change#052.dst: 我们不能就这样……走进去拿排班表！你明白吧？{u} 和我都被王室通缉！光是在这里露面就已经很冒险了。
Echoes of Change#052.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#053.src: Hey man, these soldiers see hundreds of people every day! If you don't give 'em a reason to pay attention, your faces won't stick out at all.
Echoes of Change#053.dst: 嘿老兄，这些士兵每天看几百个人！只要你不给他们注意你的理由，你们的脸根本不会显眼。
Echoes of Change#053.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#054.src: Yuman, we were going to make a plan before rushing in. Did you forget about that?
Echoes of Change#054.dst: Yuman，我们本来要先订好计划再冲进去。你忘了吗？
Echoes of Change#054.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#055.src: Riiight. Right. Sorry, I got excited. I am right though - it wouldn't be hard for me to just talk us through this!
Echoes of Change#055.dst: 对——对。抱歉，我太兴奋了。不过我说得没错——要靠嘴把我们混过去一点都不难！
Echoes of Change#055.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#056.src: Sigh... here, I have a better plan. Let us take some guard uniforms and put them on, and reach the schedules that way. We'll stand out even less, then.
Echoes of Change#056.dst: 唉……听着，我有个更好的计划。我们去拿几套守卫制服穿上，用这种方式拿到排班表。这样我们就更不显眼了。
Echoes of Change#056.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#057.src: Ohh. A sneak mission! That's good. They should definitely have some spare uniforms in the tower... *and*, it should be pretty empty this time of day. Everyone's out patrolling.
Echoes of Change#057.dst: 哦哦。潜入任务！不错。塔里肯定有备用制服……而且，这个时段那里应该挺空的。大家都出去巡逻了。
Echoes of Change#057.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#058.src: So, good plan, man! I like it! Let's get to it!
Echoes of Change#058.dst: 所以，好计划，老兄！我喜欢！开工吧！
Echoes of Change#058.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#059.src: Find guard uniforms inside of the guard tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#059.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的守卫塔里找到守卫制服。

Echoes of Change#060.src: See? I told you, nobody's here!
Echoes of Change#060.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#061.src: Ha. I suppose I should have faith in your knowledge. My apologies.
Echoes of Change#061.dst: 哈。我想我应该相信你的判断。抱歉。
Echoes of Change#061.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#062.src: ...ah, is that really all? I thought they would be harder to find.
Echoes of Change#062.dst: ……啊，就这样？我还以为会更难找。
Echoes of Change#062.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#063.src: With how many guards have to come through here every day for uniform exchanges, this is just the easiest way. More efficient having it out here.
Echoes of Change#063.dst: 每天有那么多守卫要来这里换制服，这是最方便的办法。放在外面比较有效率。
Echoes of Change#063.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#066.src: Oh, you are just going for it... I see. {u}, let's wait outside until he's done.
Echoes of Change#066.dst: 哦，你就直接换啊……好吧。{u}，我们到外面等他换好。
Echoes of Change#066.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#067.src: Well? Thoughts? How do I look?
Echoes of Change#067.dst: 怎么样？有什么想法？我看起来如何？
Echoes of Change#067.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#068.src: Like an average Roughworks soldier, I suppose.
Echoes of Change#068.dst: 我想，就像个普通的 Roughworks 士兵吧。
Echoes of Change#068.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#069.dst: 不知道 Zeph 会怎么想……
Echoes of Change#069.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#071.src: Ah- haha, uh, n- nothin! Your turn!
Echoes of Change#071.dst: 啊——哈哈，呃，没、没什么！换你了！
Echoes of Change#071.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#072.src: This uniform is so... uncomfortable. And to think, I nearly signed up for this...
Echoes of Change#072.dst: 这制服真是……不舒服。想想看，我差点就加入这行了……
Echoes of Change#072.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#073.src: Yeah, you'd think they'd complain about it more! But nah, they're all... stoic.
Echoes of Change#073.dst: 是啊，你会以为他们会多抱怨几句！但没有，他们全都……一声不吭。
Echoes of Change#073.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#074.src: Yes... well, {u}, it's your turn. Hurry, please. Someone could come up here at any time.
Echoes of Change#074.dst: 是啊……好了，{u}，换你了。请快点。随时可能有人上来。
Echoes of Change#074.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#075.src: Find guard schedules inside the guard tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#075.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的守卫塔里找到守卫排班表。

Echoes of Change#076.src: Very well. Let us get this over with.
Echoes of Change#076.dst: 很好。我们赶快把这件事办完吧。
Echoes of Change#076.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#077.src: From what I heard from Yulie, the commander usually keeps the schedules in the top office. Let's get looking!
Echoes of Change#077.dst: 我听 Yulie 说，指挥官通常把排班表放在顶楼的办公室。我们去找找！
Echoes of Change#077.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#078.src: So, you? A soldier? What's the story there?
Echoes of Change#078.dst: 所以，你？当过兵？这是怎么回事？
Echoes of Change#078.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#079.src: Sigh... the story is it was a choice between joining the military, and following in my parents' footsteps. And I did not especially want to do the latter.
Echoes of Change#079.dst: 唉……事情是这样的，当时我只能在参军和继承父母的衣钵之间选一个。而我不太想选后者。
Echoes of Change#079.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#081.src: They worked as woodcutters. A relatively common job in the {p}, but... I simply wanted to distance myself from them.
Echoes of Change#081.dst: 他们是伐木工。在 {p} 算是很常见的工作，但是……我只是想跟他们保持距离。
Echoes of Change#081.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#082.src: The military seemed my best option... until I met Syndra, that is. Still... I regret I could not do more for Sui. She did not take my departure well.
Echoes of Change#082.dst: 当兵似乎是我最好的选择……直到我遇见 Syndra。不过……我很遗憾没能为 Sui 多做些什么。她很难接受我离开。
Echoes of Change#082.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#083.src: Hey, you were doing what was best for you, right? And it looks like you and Sui are all good now, so it turned out alright in the end.
Echoes of Change#083.dst: 嘿，你做的是对你最好的事，对吧？而且看起来你跟 Sui 现在已经没事了，所以最后结果还不错。
Echoes of Change#083.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#085.src: Woah there! Eheh, sorry folks, didn't see-
Echoes of Change#085.dst: 哇喔！嘿嘿，抱歉各位，没看到——
Echoes of Change#085.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#086.src: Wait. You three - if you have your equipment, you should be out on the streets. State your business here.
Echoes of Change#086.dst: 等等。你们三个——既然装备在身，就该在街上。说明你们来这里干什么。
Echoes of Change#086.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#087.src: ... Well? I'm not hearing an answer. State. Your. Business.
Echoes of Change#087.dst: ……怎么样？我没听到回答。说。明。来。意。
Echoes of Change#087.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#088.src: I- ah. We... we were looking for...
Echoes of Change#088.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#090.dst: 兄弟们，别跟我搭档计较！
Echoes of Change#090.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#091.src: Ya know how the stress gets. Festival's coming up, lots to worry about! Not getting much sleep - all that.
Echoes of Change#091.dst: 你们也知道压力有多大。庆典快到了，一堆事要操心！觉都睡不好——就那样。
Echoes of Change#091.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#092.src: Heck, I don't even remember what I last ate, hahaha!
Echoes of Change#092.dst: 见鬼，我连上一餐吃了什么都不记得了，哈哈哈！
Echoes of Change#092.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#093.src: Ha! Yeah, I've been feeling that. Commander's got us working overtime, it's a whole mess.
Echoes of Change#093.dst: 哈！是啊，我也有同感。指挥官要我们加班，整个乱成一团。
Echoes of Change#093.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#094.src: Oh, hey, why don't y'all join us for some drinks after the shift?
Echoes of Change#094.dst: 哦，嘿，下了班要不要一起去喝几杯？
Echoes of Change#094.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#095.src: Sounds great, man! Guess we'll meet you boys then! You got the night shift too, right?
Echoes of Change#095.dst: 好啊，老兄！那我们到时候见啦！你们也是夜班，对吧？
Echoes of Change#095.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#096.src: Yeah. Drew the short straw, unfortunately. The commander has us doing them the next few days...
Echoes of Change#096.dst: 对。倒霉抽到了。指挥官接下来几天都要我们值夜班……
Echoes of Change#096.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#097.src: At this rate, we'll be too damn tired to enjoy the festival! Like... give us a break, right?
Echoes of Change#097.dst: 照这样下去，我们会累到没法享受庆典！拜托……让我们喘口气吧，对吧？
Echoes of Change#097.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#098.src: Yeah, yeah. Same sorta thing here! I got paired up with these newbies, and the commander's got us on festival shift.
Echoes of Change#098.dst: 是啊是啊。我这边也差不多！我被分配带这几个新人，指挥官还把我们排进庆典班。
Echoes of Change#098.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#099.src: Ouch. That's rough. Good luck out there.
Echoes of Change#099.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#100.src: Ey, thanks! But yeah, I'm still showin' them the ropes, and all that. We only got the news, like, an hour ago, so we're going to check the schedules.
Echoes of Change#100.dst: 嘿，谢啦！不过是啊，我还在教他们门道什么的。我们大概一个小时前才收到消息，所以要去看看排班表。
Echoes of Change#100.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#101.src: Ah, management... putting newbies on festival shift? I wonder what the commander's thinking? Well, good luck with that.
Echoes of Change#101.dst: 啊，管理层……把新人排进庆典班？不知道指挥官在想什么？嗯，祝你们好运。
Echoes of Change#101.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#103.src: ...told ya I could talk us through it.
Echoes of Change#103.dst: ……就说我能靠嘴把我们混过去吧。
Echoes of Change#103.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#104.src: That was... impressive. I did not think it could be done.
Echoes of Change#104.dst: 那……真厉害。我没想到能办到。
Echoes of Change#104.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#105.src: Ah, y'know... they're still people at the end of the day.
Echoes of Change#105.dst: 啊，你知道的……说到底他们也是人嘛。
Echoes of Change#105.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#106.src: I... suppose. I apologize, I do not know why I... froze up there. I should know what I'm doing...
Echoes of Change#106.dst: 我……想是吧。抱歉，我不知道自己为什么……在那里僵住了。我应该知道自己在做什么的……
Echoes of Change#106.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#107.src: Hey, it happens. For the record, I'm sorry for bein' a bit rough with ya. Had to convince them somehow.
Echoes of Change#107.dst: 嘿，这种事难免。说真的，刚才对你有点凶，抱歉啦。总得想办法说服他们。
Echoes of Change#107.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#108.src: No worries, Yuman, I understand. Now, ah... let us find the schedules before someone else notices we are not supposed to be here.
Echoes of Change#108.dst: 没关系，Yuman，我明白。好了，啊……我们赶在别人发现我们不该在这里之前找到排班表吧。
Echoes of Change#108.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#110.src: The schedules were further up, yes?
Echoes of Change#110.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#112.src: Start writing them down, would you?
Echoes of Change#112.dst: 开始把它们抄下来，好吗？
Echoes of Change#112.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#113.src: It's more guards than we typically see in Auburn festivals, that's for certain... I hope Syndra anticipated this.
Echoes of Change#113.dst: 守卫比我们平常在 Auburn 庆典上看到的多，这是肯定的……希望 Syndra 预料到了。
Echoes of Change#113.speaker: Mora
