Echoes of Change#114.src: She seems like the kind of lady to have back-up plans for her back-up plans... I wouldn't worry too much.
Echoes of Change#114.dst: 她看起来就是那种备用计划还有备用计划的人……我不会太担心。
Echoes of Change#114.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#115.src: I suppose you're right. Now, we should make our way out of here before anyone else arrives.
Echoes of Change#115.dst: 我想你说得对。好了，我们该在其他人到之前离开这里了。
Echoes of Change#115.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#116.src: Return to The Steel Feather using the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and find Yusanu and Sui.
Echoes of Change#116.dst: 经由 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的隧道返回钢羽，找到 Yusanu 和 Sui。

Echoes of Change#117.src: I could really use a nap after that.
Echoes of Change#117.dst: 经历那一趟，我真需要睡个午觉。
Echoes of Change#117.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#118.src: Seems like our mission is done. Let's head back.
Echoes of Change#118.dst: 看来我们的任务完成了。回去吧。
Echoes of Change#118.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#119.src: ...and we'll need to keep things calm back here while we're gone.
Echoes of Change#119.dst: ……而我们不在的时候，得让这里保持平静。
Echoes of Change#119.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#120.src: Of course, of course. Wouldn't want anyone to panic.
Echoes of Change#120.dst: 当然，当然。可不能让任何人恐慌。
Echoes of Change#120.speaker: Jiro

Echoes of Change#121.src: I'm less concerned about panic, and more about stress. I know Quill will stay behind during the festival itself, but it'll be good to have additional help.
Echoes of Change#121.dst: 我比较不担心恐慌，更担心压力。我知道庆典当天 Quill 会留下来，但多个人帮忙总是好的。
Echoes of Change#121.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#122.src: Yes, ma'am. I can handle it.
Echoes of Change#122.speaker: Jiro

Echoes of Change#124.src: Ah, I should get going. I'll see if I can track down Quill.
Echoes of Change#124.dst: 啊，我该走了。我去看看能不能找到 Quill。
Echoes of Change#124.speaker: Jiro

Echoes of Change#127.src: Oh, Jiro was asking if there was anything he could do to help. I told him he could help Quill keep the peace down here while we're... performing the plan.
Echoes of Change#127.dst: 哦，Jiro 刚才问有没有什么他能帮忙的。我跟他说，我们……执行计划的时候，他可以帮 Quill 维持这里的秩序。
Echoes of Change#127.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#128.src: He's... been acting a little out of character, truth be told... though it might just be the stress of the upcoming festival causing it.
Echoes of Change#128.dst: 说实话，他……最近有点反常……不过也可能只是即将到来的庆典带来的压力。
Echoes of Change#128.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#129.src: But either way - how are things going?
Echoes of Change#129.dst: 不管怎样——事情进行得如何？
Echoes of Change#129.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#130.src: That's good to hear. I know I placed a lot of responsibility on your shoulders...
Echoes of Change#130.dst: 那就好。我知道我把很多责任压在你肩上……
Echoes of Change#130.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#131.src: In truth, you have the most experience out of all the youngsters. And to ensure this plan succeeds... it's good to have you keep an eye on things.
Echoes of Change#131.dst: 说真的，在所有年轻人里，你最有经验。而为了确保这个计划成功……有你帮忙盯着很好。
Echoes of Change#131.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#132.src: Mmn. I apologize for placing so much on your shoulders.
Echoes of Change#132.dst: 嗯。抱歉把这么多事压在你肩上。
Echoes of Change#132.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#133.src: But you have the most experience out of all the youngsters, and we need to ensure this plan works... we have no choice.
Echoes of Change#133.dst: 但在所有年轻人里你最有经验，而我们必须确保这个计划成功……我们别无选择。
Echoes of Change#133.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#134.src: But, regardless - Mora gave me the guard positions you retrieved. I was working with Rex and Zeph on our next steps, based off that information.
Echoes of Change#134.dst: 不过，总之——Mora 把你们拿到的守卫位置给我了。我刚才正根据这些情报，跟 Rex 和 Zeph 商量下一步。
Echoes of Change#134.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#135.src: They've gone off... somewhere, I don't know where. Until they return, you should go see if Sui and Yusanu need anything.
Echoes of Change#135.dst: 他们去了……某个地方，我不知道去哪。在他们回来之前，你去看看 Sui 和 Yusanu 需不需要帮忙。
Echoes of Change#135.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#136.src: Until Rex and Zeph return, you should go see if Sui and Yusanu need anything.
Echoes of Change#136.dst: 在 Rex 和 Zeph 回来之前，你去看看 Sui 和 Yusanu 需不需要帮忙。
Echoes of Change#136.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#137.src: Oh! {u}, you're back! How did it, um, go?
Echoes of Change#137.dst: 哦！{u}，你回来了！事情，嗯，进行得怎么样？
Echoes of Change#137.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#138.src: Oh! Good! It, um, went smoothly, I hope? Mora and Yuman got along?
Echoes of Change#138.dst: 哦！太好了！希望，嗯，一切顺利？Mora 和 Yuman 处得来吗？
Echoes of Change#138.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#139.src: If they got the schedules, it was probably fine. So, {u}, are you here to help us out too?
Echoes of Change#139.dst: 既然拿到排班表了，大概没问题。所以，{u}，你也是来帮我们的吗？
Echoes of Change#139.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#140.src: Hehe, I guess that's what happens when you show off all those skills of yours!
Echoes of Change#140.dst: 嘿嘿，我想这就是你老是展现那些本事的下场吧！
Echoes of Change#140.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#141.src: Yep! Oh, speaking of... {u}, are you here to help us out too?
Echoes of Change#141.dst: 对！哦，说到这个……{u}，你也是来帮我们的吗？
Echoes of Change#141.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#142.src: We've been putting together those explosives Syndra requested. I think we've decided on an easily produced model.
Echoes of Change#142.dst: 我们一直在组装 Syndra 要的炸药。我想我们已经定好一个容易生产的型号了。
Echoes of Change#142.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#143.src: By, um, "we," he mostly means him. I can, ha, barely understand what he's going on about.
Echoes of Change#143.dst: 他说的，嗯，“我们”，主要是指他自己。我，哈，几乎听不懂他在说什么。
Echoes of Change#143.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#144.src: Hey, don't sell yourself short! You've been helpful! I would've never thought to utilize water in the design if it weren't for your suggestion.
Echoes of Change#144.dst: 嘿，别小看自己！你帮了很大的忙！要不是你的建议，我根本想不到在设计里用水。
Echoes of Change#144.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#145.src: Oh... thank you. {u}, we were playing around with the idea of hiding magical water inside the, um, explosive... but I, ah, don't know how to hold its power when I can't... see it.
Echoes of Change#145.dst: 哦……谢谢你。{u}，我们在考虑把魔法水藏在，嗯，炸药里……但我，啊，不知道在看不见它的时候……要怎么控制它的力量。
Echoes of Change#145.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#146.src: Magic or not, using water in the design will make the explosion look more dangerous and powerful than it actually is! It's genius!
Echoes of Change#146.dst: 不管有没有魔法，在设计里用水都会让爆炸看起来比实际上更危险、更强大！这简直是天才！
Echoes of Change#146.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#147.src: Now, we just need to put it together...
Echoes of Change#147.dst: 现在，我们只需要把它组装起来……
Echoes of Change#147.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#148.src: Eheh. Maybe? I need to run some tests while it's being assembled, and Sui needs to stand guard in case it's about to actually explode.
Echoes of Change#148.dst: 嘿嘿。也许吧？组装的时候我得做些测试，Sui 要在旁边戒备，以防它真的要爆炸。
Echoes of Change#148.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#149.src: If things go awry, I'll, um, surround it in a ball of water.
Echoes of Change#149.dst: 要是出了差错，我会，嗯，用一团水把它包起来。
Echoes of Change#149.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#150.src: Yep! Okay, no more questions, we've got to get to it! Click the explosive parts whenever you're ready.
Echoes of Change#150.dst: 对！好，别再问了，我们得动手了！准备好就点击炸药零件。
Echoes of Change#150.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#151.src: Help assemble the explosives inside the workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#151.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的工坊里帮忙组装炸药。

Echoes of Change#152.src: (Coal Block): Can only be placed on the outer tiles.
Echoes of Change#152.dst: (煤炭块)：只能放在外圈的格子上。
Echoes of Change#152.speaker: Casing

Echoes of Change#153.src: (Dark Gray Concrete Powder): Can only be placed on the inner tiles.
Echoes of Change#153.dst: (深灰色混凝土粉末)：只能放在内圈的格子上。
Echoes of Change#153.speaker: Gunpowder

Echoes of Change#154.src: (White Wool Block): Must touch the orange chemical.
Echoes of Change#154.dst: (白色羊毛)：必须接触橙色化学物。
Echoes of Change#154.speaker: Fuse

Echoes of Change#156.src: (Bone): Can remove any block from the board.
Echoes of Change#156.dst: (骨头)：可以移除板上的任何方块。
Echoes of Change#156.speaker: Wrench

Echoes of Change#157.src: Collect all pieces by finishing {~} puzzles!
Echoes of Change#157.dst: 完成 {~} 个谜题，收集所有零件！
Echoes of Change#157.speaker: Bomb Piece

Echoes of Change#159.src: I think Sui and I will perform a few more tests... maybe a test run or two... but the construction went okay, so I should be able to produce some more.
Echoes of Change#159.dst: 我想 Sui 和我会再做几次测试……也许试爆一两次……不过组装还算顺利，所以我应该能再做一些。
Echoes of Change#159.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#160.src: And, eheh, hopefully not blow up my workshop...
Echoes of Change#160.dst: 而且，嘿嘿，希望别把我的工坊炸了……
Echoes of Change#160.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#161.src: Oh, no... {u}, are you sure you, um, can't stick around, a bit longer? Just, in case?
Echoes of Change#161.dst: 哦，不……{u}，你确定你，嗯，不能再多待一会儿吗？就，以防万一？
Echoes of Change#161.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#162.src: Nope, there's still stuff to do! On that subject - {u}, Rex was looking for you earlier.
Echoes of Change#162.dst: 不行，还有事要做！说到这个——{u}，Rex 刚才在找你。
Echoes of Change#162.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#163.src: Meet up with Zeph and Rex for the next assignment at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#163.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与 Zeph 和 Rex 会合，接受下一项任务。

Echoes of Change#164.src: {u}, finally! There you are! I was getting restless.
Echoes of Change#164.dst: {u}，终于！你来了！我都等得坐不住了。
Echoes of Change#164.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#165.src: I w- was quite comfortable... actually.
Echoes of Change#165.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#166.src: Oh, are the nerves getting to you Zeph?
Echoes of Change#166.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#167.src: I- I know... But it f- fe- feels like everyone else is doing okay, while I- I'm not even doing an- any- anything, and I'm a- al- already panicking.
Echoes of Change#167.dst: 我、我知道……可是感、感觉其他人都做得很好，而我、我什么都还没做，就、就已经慌了。
Echoes of Change#167.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#168.src: Hey, everyone else is also feeling nervous, Zeph. Some of us are just... better at hiding it than others.
Echoes of Change#168.dst: 嘿，其他人也都很紧张，Zeph。只是我们有些人……比较会藏而已。
Echoes of Change#168.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#169.src: Re- really? For some reason, that m- ma- makes me feel a lot better... uh, n- no offense!
Echoes of Change#169.dst: 真、真的吗？不知道为什么，这让、让我觉得好多了……呃，没、没有冒犯的意思！
Echoes of Change#169.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#170.src: We're all nervous, Zeph. It's a risky plan. But we know what we're doing. We have to trust we'll succeed.
Echoes of Change#170.dst: 我们都很紧张，Zeph。这是个冒险的计划。但我们知道自己在做什么。我们得相信我们会成功。
Echoes of Change#170.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#171.src: Ha ha, v- ver- very funny, {u}. I- I- I'm trying. I am! It's just... hard not to be an- anxious.
Echoes of Change#171.dst: 哈哈，真、真好笑，{u}。我、我、我在努力了。真的！只是……很难不紧、紧张。
Echoes of Change#171.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#172.src: You're fine, Zeph. I'd be surprised if you weren't anxious, honestly. Given what we're planning on doing...
Echoes of Change#172.dst: 你没事的，Zeph。说实话，你要是不紧张我才会意外。考虑到我们打算做的事……
Echoes of Change#172.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#173.src: I g- guess... It's all just st- st- starting to sink in.
Echoes of Change#173.dst: 大、大概吧……一切都开、开始变得真实了。
Echoes of Change#173.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#174.src: Look, the more you think about it, the worse it'll get. Accept the feeling for what it is, then put it aside for now.
Echoes of Change#174.dst: 听着，你越想只会越糟。接受那种感觉，然后先把它放一边。
Echoes of Change#174.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#175.src: We've got work to do, and... we really can't afford to screw it up.
Echoes of Change#175.dst: 我们还有事要做，而且……我们真的不能搞砸。
Echoes of Change#175.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#177.src: That's all I ask. Anyway, {u}, Zeph and I looked over the schedules with Syndra earlier. We've marked a couple of spots we want to check out.
Echoes of Change#177.dst: 我要的就是这样。总之，{u}，Zeph 和我刚才跟 Syndra 看过排班表了。我们标出了几个想去看看的地点。
Echoes of Change#177.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#178.src: So- s- so let's go see them in person! Uh, Rex, I c- ca- can carry the arrows and electric ch- charges for you.
Echoes of Change#178.dst: 所、所以我们去实地看看吧！呃，Rex，我可、可以帮你拿箭和电击充、充能。
Echoes of Change#178.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#180.src: ...and those are the faces I usually see around, so-
Echoes of Change#180.dst: ……而那些是我平常会看到的面孔，所以——
Echoes of Change#180.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#181.src: Ah- Rex, Zeph, and {u}! Rather auspicious timing.
Echoes of Change#181.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#182.src: Oh. hey! Have you seen the guard schedules yet?
Echoes of Change#182.dst: 哦。嘿！你们看过守卫排班表了吗？
Echoes of Change#182.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#183.src: We have, yep. Quill and I were just talking about some of the escape routes I had in mind.
Echoes of Change#183.dst: 看过了，对。Quill 和我正在讨论我想到的几条逃生路线。
Echoes of Change#183.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#184.src: Are you heading out for your assignment then?
Echoes of Change#184.dst: 那你们要出发去执行任务了吗？
Echoes of Change#184.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#185.src: We were j- just about to head to {p} for ours, too. P- per- perhaps we could go there together?
Echoes of Change#185.dst: 我们也正要去 {p} 执行我们的任务。也、也许我们可以一起去？
Echoes of Change#185.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#186.src: Hmm... yes, I suppose we could- though, I'll want {u}'s opinion on our ideas as well. Once you finish with Rex and Zeph, would you care to join us?
Echoes of Change#186.dst: 嗯……好，我想可以——不过，我也想听听 {u} 对我们想法的意见。你跟 Rex 和 Zeph 忙完之后，愿意来找我们吗？
Echoes of Change#186.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#187.src: Then let's get going. No time to waste.
Echoes of Change#187.dst: 那就出发吧。没时间浪费了。
Echoes of Change#187.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#188.src: Find Zeph and Rex in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#188.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 {p} 找到 Zeph 和 Rex。

Echoes of Change#189.src: Rex, please don't pick the highest rooftops.
Echoes of Change#189.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#190.src: You better not pick out the highest roof tops. I'm not sure I can get up that far.
Echoes of Change#190.dst: 你最好别挑最高的屋顶。我不确定我爬得上去。
Echoes of Change#190.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#191.src: I'm just not sure I'd be able to climb up to them.
Echoes of Change#191.dst: 我只是不确定我爬不爬得上去。
Echoes of Change#191.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#192.src: Well, Yuman seems to do it just fine! But okay, I'll pick out something more accessible for you.
Echoes of Change#192.dst: 嗯，Yuman 就爬得好好的！不过好吧，我会帮你挑个比较好上去的。
Echoes of Change#192.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#194.src: Hm... {u}, I don't suppose you would happen to have seen Jiro?
Echoes of Change#194.dst: 嗯……{u}，你该不会刚好看到 Jiro 了吧？
Echoes of Change#194.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#195.src: Syndra told me he had gone looking for me, but I haven't seen him all day!
Echoes of Change#195.dst: Syndra 跟我说他去找我了，可是我一整天都没看到他！
Echoes of Change#195.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#196.src: Well, I suppose I can always find him after we're done here. No need to delay this any longer.
Echoes of Change#196.dst: 嗯，我想等我们这边忙完再去找他也行。没必要再拖了。
Echoes of Change#196.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#197.src: Just one more day... a- a- and then it'll be done. I can m- make it that far.
Echoes of Change#197.dst: 就剩一天……然、然、然后就结束了。我撑、撑得到的。
Echoes of Change#197.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#198.src: T- took you a bit, huh?
Echoes of Change#198.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#199.src: Great! You're here! Slowpoke. I thought Zeph's races in the {p} would've prepared you for this!
Echoes of Change#199.dst: 太好了！你来了！慢吞吞的。我还以为 Zeph 在 {p} 的赛跑已经让你练出来了！
Echoes of Change#199.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#200.src: Quill and Yulie? They've started on their assignment already. Quill said to tell you to just join up with them once you're done here.
Echoes of Change#200.dst: Quill 和 Yulie？他们已经开始执行任务了。Quill 说要告诉你，你这边忙完就去跟他们会合。
Echoes of Change#200.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#201.src: Ha! Or m- ma- maybe you're too slow!
Echoes of Change#201.dst: 哈！或、或、或许是你太慢了！
Echoes of Change#201.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#202.src: We should get started, before we draw any attention towards ourselves... I've got the map here. Zeph and I have marked out two locations.
Echoes of Change#202.dst: 我们该开始了，免得引人注意……地图在我这。Zeph 和我标出了两个地点。
Echoes of Change#202.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#203.src: We're ch- checking both, since we wanted to sp- split Rex and Yulie on two different v- vantage points.
Echoes of Change#203.dst: 我们两个都要检、检查，因为我们想把 Rex 和 Yulie 分、分到两个不同的制、制高点。
Echoes of Change#203.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#204.src: I'll p- point them out for you. Ready?
Echoes of Change#204.dst: 我来指、指给你看。准备好了吗？
Echoes of Change#204.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#206.src: Always a second with you... fine, just let us know when you are ready.
Echoes of Change#206.dst: 跟你在一起总要等一下……好吧，准备好就跟我们说。
Echoes of Change#206.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#208.src: And there's the s- sec- second one!
Echoes of Change#208.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#209.src: Okay. Let's g- get to work!
Echoes of Change#209.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#210.src: Here, Zeph, hand me those arrows. Keep the charges though, I think your point would be better for Yulie.
Echoes of Change#210.dst: 来，Zeph，把那些箭给我。充能你留着，我觉得你那个点比较适合 Yulie。
Echoes of Change#210.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#211.src: Sure... w- wait, why do we need {u} for this?
Echoes of Change#211.dst: 好……等、等等，这件事为什么需要 {u}？
Echoes of Change#211.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#212.src: To check our work, I guess? They can help assess the vantage points. Maybe they'll spot some potential issues we missed.
Echoes of Change#212.dst: 帮我们检查吧，我想？他们可以帮忙评估制高点。说不定能发现我们漏掉的问题。
Echoes of Change#212.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#214.src: Just make your way up however you can!
Echoes of Change#214.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#215.src: Get to the top of the two buildings at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#216.src: Yeah, hey. Not much fer conversation today, 'm afraid.
Echoes of Change#216.dst: 嗯，嘿。今天没什么心情聊天，恐怕。
Echoes of Change#216.speaker: Timasca Mason

Echoes of Change#217.src: This job's gonna be the death a' me eventually. If it's not slippin off the ledge, 's gonna be breakin' my damn back.
Echoes of Change#217.dst: 这份活迟早会要了我的命。不是从边上滑下去，就是把我的腰给弄断。
Echoes of Change#217.speaker: Timasca Mason

Echoes of Change#218.src: Beggars can't be choosers though, huh? Literally, in my case...
Echoes of Change#218.dst: 不过乞丐没得挑，是吧？对我来说还真是字面上的意思……
Echoes of Change#218.speaker: Timasca Mason

Echoes of Change#220.src: Ha! Well, o- of course I am! I can't let y- you start beating me... I ha- have an image to maintain!
Echoes of Change#220.dst: 哈！嗯，当、当然啦！我不能让你、你开始赢我……我得维、维持形象！
Echoes of Change#220.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#221.src: B- but you didn't! Maybe next time... wh- what are we at now? Zeph {~}... {u} {~}?
Echoes of Change#221.dst: 可、可是你没赢！也许下次吧……我、我们现在比数多少了？Zeph {~}……{u} {~}？
Echoes of Change#221.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#222.src: Ha... so, th- this is the spot.
Echoes of Change#222.dst: 哈……所以，这、这就是那个位置。
Echoes of Change#222.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#223.src: This should c- co- cover Rex's blind spots well enough...
Echoes of Change#223.dst: 这里应该足以掩、掩护 Rex 的死角……
Echoes of Change#223.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#224.src: What do you th- think? Does it look okay?
Echoes of Change#224.dst: 你觉、觉得怎么样？看起来还行吗？
Echoes of Change#224.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#225.src: Perfect! So are we g- good then?
Echoes of Change#225.dst: 太好了！那我们没问、问题了吧？
Echoes of Change#225.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#226.src: Well... I- I guess it is a little high up for Y- Yulie... but I think it's fine.
Echoes of Change#226.dst: 嗯……我、我想对 Y、Yulie 来说是有点高……不过我觉得没关系。
Echoes of Change#226.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#227.src: Let me p- put down the equipment here...
Echoes of Change#227.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#228.src: Hey... if you h- hurry, you can make it to the other spot be- before Rex does!
Echoes of Change#228.dst: 嘿……如果你快、快点，就能比 Rex 先、先到另一个点！
Echoes of Change#228.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#229.src: She's n-never been the most agile...
Echoes of Change#229.dst: 她从、从来就不是最灵活的……
Echoes of Change#229.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#230.src: Uh, d- don't tell her I said that!!!
Echoes of Change#230.dst: 呃，别、别跟她说是我说的！！！
Echoes of Change#230.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#232.src: I saw you beat R- Rex earlier! Not like that's hard, th- though!
Echoes of Change#232.dst: 我刚才看到你赢了 R、Rex！不过那也、也不难啦！
Echoes of Change#232.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#233.src: But since we're done here... it's t- time for you to assist Quill and Yulie, Superhero.
Echoes of Change#233.dst: 不过既然我们这边完成了……该、该去帮 Quill 和 Yulie 了，超级英雄。
Echoes of Change#233.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#234.src: ...heh. I- I should go get some more pr- practice in, though... before tomorrow.
Echoes of Change#234.dst: ……嘿。不过我、我该去再多练、练习一下……在明天之前。
Echoes of Change#234.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#235.src: Quill and Yulie are out- outside Sovereign Soosu's mansion, by the way.
Echoes of Change#235.dst: 顺便说一下，Quill 和 Yulie 在 Soosu 统、统领的宅邸外面。
Echoes of Change#235.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#236.src: I'll be there in a second!
Echoes of Change#236.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#237.src: Phew... well, seems like you got here before me.
Echoes of Change#237.dst: 呼……嗯，看来你比我先到了。
Echoes of Change#237.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#238.src: Oh. Thanks. But you've seen me do better!
Echoes of Change#238.dst: 哦。谢了。不过你看过我表现得更好！
Echoes of Change#238.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#240.src: Hm... would you agree this spot overlooks the whole square?
Echoes of Change#240.dst: 嗯……你同意这个位置能俯瞰整个广场吗？
Echoes of Change#240.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#241.src: From what I've heard, the festival always takes place right here. And this looks like it gives us a pretty good coverage of the area...
Echoes of Change#241.dst: 我听说，庆典每年都在这里举行。而这里看起来能很好地覆盖整个区域……
Echoes of Change#241.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#243.src: Just... okay? You're sure? If you have any concerns, speak up.
Echoes of Change#243.dst: 只是……还行？你确定？如果有什么顾虑，就说出来。
Echoes of Change#243.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#244.src: ...no? You're just gonna go mute? Okay. Sure.
Echoes of Change#244.dst: ……不说？你就这样闷不吭声？好啊。行。
Echoes of Change#244.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#245.src: Really? Well, if you say so.
Echoes of Change#245.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#246.src: I guess that means our work here is done!
Echoes of Change#246.dst: 我想这代表我们这边完成了！
Echoes of Change#246.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#247.src: Just gotta leave the equipment here...
Echoes of Change#247.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#248.src: Alright! That's my part done, but you've still got to assess Zeph's location.
Echoes of Change#248.dst: 好！我的部分完成了，不过你还得去评估 Zeph 那个位置。
Echoes of Change#248.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#249.src: I'll head down and wait for him to be done. I'll see you back at the Steel Feather, I guess.
Echoes of Change#249.dst: 我先下去等他弄完。我想我们钢羽见吧。
Echoes of Change#249.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#250.src: Good luck with Quill and Yulie. That's the last bit of preparation we have to do, right?
Echoes of Change#250.dst: 跟 Quill 和 Yulie 那边加油。那是我们最后一项准备工作了，对吧？
Echoes of Change#250.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#252.src: Alright! That's my part done... and I saw you over with Zeph earlier, too.
Echoes of Change#252.dst: 好！我的部分完成了……而且我刚才也看到你在 Zeph 那边了。
Echoes of Change#252.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#253.src: So I think that means we're done. I'll go get Zeph and head back to the Steel Feather.
Echoes of Change#253.dst: 所以我想我们完成了。我去找 Zeph，然后回钢羽。
Echoes of Change#253.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#254.src: I need to get some practice in before tomorrow... I know the plan shouldn't involve any fighting, but... in case things go wrong, I need to be sure I can hit my shots when it counts.
Echoes of Change#254.dst: 我得在明天之前多练习……我知道计划里应该不会有战斗，但是……万一出了差错，我得确保关键时刻能射中。
Echoes of Change#254.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#255.src: I think I saw Quill and Yulie out by Sovereign Soosu's mansion. So, go find them! Don't keep them waiting!
Echoes of Change#255.dst: 我好像看到 Quill 和 Yulie 在 Soosu 统领的宅邸那边。所以，去找他们吧！别让他们等！
Echoes of Change#255.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#256.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 找到 Yulie 和 Quill。

Echoes of Change#257.src: Ah, {u}! I take it you have finished up with Rex and Zeph?
Echoes of Change#257.dst: 啊，{u}！我猜你已经跟 Rex 和 Zeph 忙完了？
Echoes of Change#257.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#258.src: We've been trying to get an idea of the general feel of the coming festival.
Echoes of Change#258.dst: 我们一直在试着了解大家对这次庆典的整体感觉。
Echoes of Change#258.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#259.src: As with every year, people usually just see it as a day off of work. That's all it really is for them.
Echoes of Change#259.dst: 跟每年一样，人们通常只把它当成放一天假。对他们来说也就只是这样。
Echoes of Change#259.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#260.src: Rather different from what you had experienced in the {p}, yes? The people there see their festival as a way to celebrate their culture.
Echoes of Change#260.dst: 跟你在 {p} 经历的很不一样，对吧？那里的人把庆典视为庆祝自身文化的方式。
Echoes of Change#260.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#261.src: Hm... that's hard to imagine. Though, in a way, I guess the Roughworks festival also celebrates our culture... just, only the part of it about working hard.
Echoes of Change#261.dst: 嗯……那很难想象。不过，某方面来说，我想 Roughworks 的庆典也在庆祝我们的文化……只是，只庆祝其中关于努力工作的那部分。
Echoes of Change#261.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#262.src: Indeed... indeed. Well, as we are all here, let us begin the task. According to the map, we have three possible escape routes to scout out.
Echoes of Change#262.dst: 的确……的确。好，既然大家都到了，我们开始吧。根据地图，我们有三条可能的逃生路线要侦察。
Echoes of Change#262.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#263.src: And they're the ones most likely to be optimal, with the information from the guard schedules... alright. Let's head to the first location then.
Echoes of Change#263.dst: 而根据排班表的情报，这几条最有可能是最佳路线……好。那我们先去第一个地点。
Echoes of Change#263.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#264.dst: 跟着 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Yulie 和 Quill。

Echoes of Change#265.src: First on the list... our tunnel.
Echoes of Change#265.dst: 清单上第一个……我们的隧道。
Echoes of Change#265.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#266.src: The reason it's been so safe for us all this time is 'cause the place is always empty.
Echoes of Change#266.dst: 这地方一直以来都这么安全，是因为这里总是空无一人。
Echoes of Change#266.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#267.src: It's still a developing area in the city, so people rarely come here.
Echoes of Change#267.dst: 这里还是城里正在开发的区域，所以很少有人来。
Echoes of Change#267.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#268.src: And according to our guard schedules... it should remain unguarded during the festival, as well.
Echoes of Change#268.dst: 而根据我们的守卫排班表……庆典期间这里应该也不会有人把守。
Echoes of Change#268.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#269.src: {u}, why don't you have a look around?
Echoes of Change#269.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#270.src: Assess the first escape route at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#271.dst: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！！！！！
Echoes of Change#271.speaker: Construction Worker

Echoes of Change#275.src: Why are you even here? Don't you have work to do? Tomorrow is a VERY special day.
Echoes of Change#275.dst: 你到底来这里干嘛？你没工作要做吗？明天可是非常特别的日子。
Echoes of Change#275.speaker: Construction Worker

Echoes of Change#277.src: Well LUCKY you!!!!!! But SOME of us have work to do!!!!! What do you want?!
Echoes of Change#277.dst: 嗯，你可真走运！！！！！！可是我们有些人还有活要干！！！！！你想怎样？！
Echoes of Change#277.speaker: Construction Worker

Echoes of Change#278.src: Thoughts? You interrupted my work to ask about my THOUGHTS?
Echoes of Change#278.dst: 想法？你打断我干活，就为了问我的想法？
Echoes of Change#278.speaker: Construction Worker

Echoes of Change#279.src: I mean... if you really want to know. It's great! A day of NO work. You know what that means!
Echoes of Change#279.dst: 我是说……如果你真想知道。棒极了！一整天不用干活。你知道那代表什么！
Echoes of Change#279.speaker: Construction Worker

Echoes of Change#280.src: I get to dust off my Roughworks Vodka and not worry for {~} hours! Great days ahead, I tell ya!
Echoes of Change#280.dst: 我可以把我的 Roughworks 伏特加拿出来掸掸灰，然后 {~} 个小时什么都不用烦！好日子在前头啊，我跟你说！
Echoes of Change#280.speaker: Construction Worker

Echoes of Change#281.src: Have a look around, {u}. Perhaps you'll find something which compromises this option.
Echoes of Change#281.dst: 四处看看吧，{u}。也许你会发现什么让这个选项行不通的东西。
Echoes of Change#281.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#283.src: Hm... seems fine, all things considered. Let's get to the next option. It's on the other side of the city.
Echoes of Change#283.dst: 嗯……整体来看似乎没问题。我们去下一个选项吧。在城市的另一头。
Echoes of Change#283.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#284.src: Head to the second escape point at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#285.src: Hm... the map tells me it should be around here somewhere, but... Yulie?
Echoes of Change#285.dst: 嗯……地图上说应该就在这附近，但是……Yulie？
Echoes of Change#285.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#286.src: Right, this one. The plan was to escape using the underground river.
Echoes of Change#286.dst: 对，就是这个。计划是利用地下河逃走。
Echoes of Change#286.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#287.src: This path should lead us to it, I think.
Echoes of Change#287.dst: 我想这条路应该能通到那里。
Echoes of Change#287.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#289.src: It... might require us to, ah, dive through a small underwater section.
Echoes of Change#289.dst: 这……可能需要我们，啊，潜水穿过一小段水下通道。
Echoes of Change#289.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#291.src: Look, it's perfectly safe! Mostly. I've tried it before, it works!
Echoes of Change#291.dst: 放心，绝对安全！大致上啦。我试过，行得通！
Echoes of Change#291.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#292.src: Oh, dear. Do I want to know why?
Echoes of Change#292.dst: 哦，天哪。我想知道为什么吗？
Echoes of Change#292.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#293.src: Work stuff... an investigation led me to it. A thief had used it to escape the city- it's not important.
Echoes of Change#293.dst: 工作上的事……一次调查让我找到这里。有个小偷利用这里逃出城——不重要。
Echoes of Change#293.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#294.src: I see. Let's mark this one as our lowest priority. Only to be used in case of emergencies.
Echoes of Change#294.dst: 我明白了。我们把这条列为最后的选择吧。只在紧急情况下使用。
Echoes of Change#294.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#295.src: But it would be worth taking a look around, either way. {u}, maybe you'll find something.
Echoes of Change#295.dst: 不过不管怎样，都值得四处看看。{u}，也许你会发现什么。
Echoes of Change#295.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#296.src: Assess the second escape route at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#297.src: Bless you, child. I hope her Majesty brings you health.
Echoes of Change#297.dst: 愿你蒙福，孩子。愿女王陛下赐你健康。
Echoes of Change#297.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#298.src: Her Majesty sure is powerful. And tomorrow... it's her big day.
Echoes of Change#298.dst: 女王陛下真是强大啊。而明天……是她的大日子。
Echoes of Change#298.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#299.src: And I get to see her! Bless us all.
Echoes of Change#299.dst: 而且我能见到她！愿我们都蒙福。
Echoes of Change#299.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#300.dst: 是什么风把你吹来的，孩子。
Echoes of Change#300.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#302.src: Do you like how I have decorated my palace. And my most priced posetion... my own personal symbol of her Majesty of Fruma!
Echoes of Change#302.dst: 你喜欢我布置宫殿的方式吗？还有我最珍贵的宝物……我专属的 Fruma 女王陛下象征！
Echoes of Change#302.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#303.src: She is great, don't you agree. And all that she has done for us, her children.
Echoes of Change#303.dst: 她很伟大，你不觉得吗？还有她为我们，她的孩子们，所做的一切。
Echoes of Change#303.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#304.src: Unfortunately I am a bad subject, a very very bad subject! I couldn't work due to my illness... And... I lost my original home - the much worse version.
Echoes of Change#304.dst: 可惜我是个坏子民，非常非常坏的子民！我因为生病没办法工作……然后……我失去了原来的家——那个差劲多了的版本。
Echoes of Change#304.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#305.src: This home is much more homely.
Echoes of Change#305.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#307.src: That was my own fault for being lazy and worthless. But now! Now I've devoted myself to her Majesty.
Echoes of Change#307.dst: 那是我自己的错，因为我又懒又没用。但现在！现在我已经把自己奉献给女王陛下了。
Echoes of Change#307.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#308.src: She is the reason I'm alive and well! She even cured my mental illness. I feel much better now.
Echoes of Change#308.dst: 多亏了她，我才能活得好好的！她甚至治好了我的心病。我现在感觉好多了。
Echoes of Change#308.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#309.src: It's absolutely splendid! A whole day of getting to celebrate her majesty... Nothing could beat that.
Echoes of Change#309.dst: 太棒了！一整天都能庆祝女王陛下……没有什么比这更好的了。
Echoes of Change#309.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#310.src: Every festival brings me closer to her. I even feel like I will soon join her in the capital!
Echoes of Change#310.dst: 每一次庆典都让我离她更近。我甚至觉得我很快就能去首都陪在她身边！
Echoes of Change#310.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#311.src: Join her as her right hand by the throne!
Echoes of Change#311.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#314.src: Hah... Since when did you tu - turn - turn into two people!
Echoes of Change#314.dst: 哈……你什么时候变、变——变成两个人了！
Echoes of Change#314.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#315.src: Well yeees... Of course it is! *hic*
Echoes of Change#315.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#316.src: Do - d- do you like it? Smells quite freshhhh.
Echoes of Change#316.dst: 你、你、你喜欢吗？闻起来挺清——新——的。
Echoes of Change#316.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#317.src: Oh I feel like I ne- need to... hurl... *burp*
Echoes of Change#317.dst: 哦我觉得我需、需要……吐……*嗝*
Echoes of Change#317.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#319.src: Oh! That one... Ya know, I don't even know what year it is anymore.
Echoes of Change#319.dst: 哦！那个啊……你知道吗，我连现在是哪一年都不知道了。
Echoes of Change#319.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#320.src: None of of it matters anymore. This is my life n-now!
Echoes of Change#320.dst: 那些全、全都不重要了。这就是我现、现在的人生！
Echoes of Change#320.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#321.src: But it would be worth taking a look around, either way. {u}, maybe you'll find something.
Echoes of Change#321.dst: 不过不管怎样，都值得四处看看。{u}，也许你会发现什么。
Echoes of Change#321.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#322.src: Wow... When did your twin appear?
Echoes of Change#322.dst: 哇……你那个双胞胎什么时候冒出来的？
Echoes of Change#322.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#323.src: Wow... When did your twin appear?
Echoes of Change#323.dst: 哇……你那个双胞胎什么时候冒出来的？
Echoes of Change#323.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#324.src: Alright... to the final spot, then. The gate to the {p}.
Echoes of Change#324.dst: 好……那就去最后一个地点。通往 {p} 的城门。
Echoes of Change#324.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#325.src: Head to the third escape route at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#326.src: Sigh... our last stop. That wall, always looming over me...
Echoes of Change#326.dst: 唉……我们的最后一站。那道墙，总是压在我头上……
Echoes of Change#326.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#328.src: Yes, yes. I'm alright. {u}... is something on your mind?
Echoes of Change#328.dst: 是，是。我没事。{u}……你有什么心事吗？
Echoes of Change#328.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#329.src: Ah... yes. I understand your meaning.
Echoes of Change#329.dst: 啊……是的。我明白你的意思。
Echoes of Change#329.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#330.src: But... we do not have the space to house all of these people. No matter how much I wish we could.
Echoes of Change#330.dst: 但是……我们没有地方安置这么多人。无论我多么希望能做到。
Echoes of Change#330.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#331.src: Some of these people also refuse to accept our help. They're too deeply rooted in the Roughworks' work culture.
Echoes of Change#331.dst: 有些人也不肯接受我们的帮助。他们太深陷在 Roughworks 的工作文化里了。
Echoes of Change#331.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#332.src: I was one of them, once. My brothers and I, we used to live around there. After... well, we didn't have anywhere else to go.
Echoes of Change#332.dst: 我以前也是其中之一。我和哥哥们，以前就住在那一带。在……之后，嗯，我们没有别的地方可去。
Echoes of Change#332.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#333.src: When Quill offered to take us off the street, I... almost declined the offer. I didn't need his pity, I thought. I was supporting our family just fine.
Echoes of Change#333.dst: 当 Quill 提出要让我们离开街头的时候，我……差点拒绝了。我当时想，我不需要他的怜悯。我把家里撑得好好的。
Echoes of Change#333.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#334.src: ...but I remembered our parents. How our mother worked three jobs just to keep our house. How even those jobs weren't enough, and eventually... she fell ill.
Echoes of Change#334.dst: ……但我想起了我们的父母。我妈妈怎样打三份工只为了保住我们的房子。就连那些工作都不够，最后……她病倒了。
Echoes of Change#334.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#336.src: I realized... that was where I was heading. Working myself to death, and- and for what? Then they'd be left on their own anyway.
Echoes of Change#336.dst: 我意识到……那就是我正在走的路。把自己累死，然后——然后为了什么？到头来他们还是只能靠自己。
Echoes of Change#336.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#337.src: For what it is worth, I am deeply glad you chose to come with me, Yulie.
Echoes of Change#337.dst: 不管有没有用，我真的很高兴你选择跟我走，Yulie。
Echoes of Change#337.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#338.src: ...yeah. It's hard accepting help when you're in that position, is all. It's easier to turn to substances to keep working, to survive...
Echoes of Change#338.dst: ……嗯。只是在那种处境下要接受帮助很难而已。靠那些东西撑着继续工作、活下去，还比较容易……
Echoes of Change#338.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#339.src: But that's what we're doing all this for, isn't it? To build a better Fruma.
Echoes of Change#339.dst: 但我们做这一切，不就是为了这个吗？为了建立一个更好的 Fruma。
Echoes of Change#339.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#340.src: ...hm. I believe someone is about to pass through the gate.
Echoes of Change#340.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#341.src: What? More guards for the festival? Or-
Echoes of Change#341.dst: 什么？庆典增派的守卫？还是——
Echoes of Change#341.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#342.src: I'm not certain, Yulie. But we should avoid being spotted.
Echoes of Change#342.dst: 我不确定，Yulie。但我们应该避免被发现。
Echoes of Change#342.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#344.src: You're the newest addition to our set, then. Good punctuality- You've made a good first impression.
Echoes of Change#344.dst: 那么，你就是我们这组集合里最新的成员了。很守时——你留下了很好的第一印象。
Echoes of Change#344.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#345.src: Sovereign Zhiraok. I was... told I would be meeting Sovereign Soosu here?
Echoes of Change#345.dst: Zhiraok 统领。我……听说我会在这里见到 Soosu 统领？
Echoes of Change#345.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#346.src: Attention to formalities is good too, but no need to stand on ceremony right now, alright? Soosu, we'll meet in a short while.
Echoes of Change#346.dst: 注重礼节也很好，不过现在不必拘泥，好吗？Soosu 那边，我们等一下就会见到。
Echoes of Change#346.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#347.src: But as for you- Tasim, correct? This'll be your first time visiting {p}? It's the province's central hub for technological development. Needs work, but what do you think?
Echoes of Change#347.dst: 至于你——Tasim，对吧？这是你第一次来 {p}？这里是本行省的科技发展中枢。还需要改进，不过你觉得怎么样？
Echoes of Change#347.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#348.src: It is, yes...ah, to both your questions. I don't think I've ever seen anything this... densely packed! It definitely leaves an impression.
Echoes of Change#348.dst: 是的，嗯……两个问题的答案都是。我想我从没见过这么……密集的地方！确实让人印象深刻。
Echoes of Change#348.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#349.src: I, ah... appreciate the help getting adjusted to all this. I'm still getting used to... holding this authority, I guess. I'm not sure I'm comfortable having the soldiers defer to me yet.
Echoes of Change#349.dst: 我，啊……很感谢你帮我适应这一切。我还在习惯……拥有这份权力，我想。士兵们听从我，我还不太自在。
Echoes of Change#349.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#350.src: I was in the same position as you once too. {~} years seems long, especially to me, but compared to the rest? I'm barely on the board. You'll get used to it, so don't worry.
Echoes of Change#350.dst: 我以前也跟你处境一样。{~} 年听起来很长，尤其对我来说，但跟其他人比起来？我几乎还排不上号。你会习惯的，别担心。
Echoes of Change#350.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#351.src: On that tangent... How's your recovery been? I remember how taxing ascension was for me... But you look like you're taking to it naturally.
Echoes of Change#351.dst: 说到这个……你恢复得怎么样？我记得飞升对我来说有多折腾……但你看起来适应得很自然。
Echoes of Change#351.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#352.src: I'm getting there. The blessing's a little strange, but it's not unlike what I was already able to do. I just need to practice using it.
Echoes of Change#352.dst: 快好了。那份祝福有点奇怪，但跟我原本就能做到的事差不多。我只需要练习怎么用。
Echoes of Change#352.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#353.src: Golden! I know how tough being the newest can be, so don't be afraid to ask me if you need help solving for your own problems.
Echoes of Change#353.dst: 太好了！我知道当新人有多难，所以需要帮忙解你自己的难题时，尽管来问我。
Echoes of Change#353.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#354.src: Speaking of... How's that project you were scouted for? Her Majesty and the Spymaster haven't shown their work to the rest of the class yet.
Echoes of Change#354.dst: 说到这个……你被挑来参与的那个项目怎么样了？女王陛下和间谍首领还没把她们的解题过程给班上其他人看呢。
Echoes of Change#354.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#355.src: I've been filled in on the details already, but Her Majesty wants me to fully recover before we start.
Echoes of Change#355.dst: 细节我已经知道了，不过女王陛下要我完全恢复之后才开始。
Echoes of Change#355.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#356.src: I can tell you more later. You said you'd be able to bring me to Sovereign Soosu?
Echoes of Change#356.dst: 我之后可以再跟你多说。你说你能带我去见 Soosu 统领？
Echoes of Change#356.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#357.src: I'll put a pin in that, then. I think she'll be reaching the end of her sequence on whatever she was working on by now... Follow me, her mansion's this way.
Echoes of Change#357.dst: 那这件事就先搁着。我想她手上不管在做什么，现在应该快运算到尾声了……跟我来，她的宅邸在这边。
Echoes of Change#357.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#358.src: Talk to Yulie and Quill at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#358.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与 Yulie 和 Quill 交谈。

Echoes of Change#360.src: Indeed... we already had two Sovereigns to concern ourselves with. And now, a third.
Echoes of Change#360.dst: 的确……我们原本就已经有两位统领要担心了。现在又多了第三位。
Echoes of Change#360.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#361.src: He's not one of the Sovereigns I know about... is he new?
Echoes of Change#361.dst: 他不是我知道的那几位统领之一……他是新来的吗？
Echoes of Change#361.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#362.src: Perhaps... but this could be a problem. We know nothing about this new Sovereign...
Echoes of Change#362.dst: 也许吧……但这可能是个问题。我们对这位新统领一无所知……
Echoes of Change#362.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#364.src: Hm... no, Syndra would have mentioned him if he were from the {p}.
Echoes of Change#364.dst: 嗯……不，如果他来自 {p}，Syndra 应该会提过他。
Echoes of Change#364.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#365.src: You have Sovereign friends...? Why? How?
Echoes of Change#365.dst: 你有统领朋友……？为什么？怎么会？
Echoes of Change#365.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#366.src: There could be any number of explanations... but it does not matter.
Echoes of Change#366.dst: 可能有各种各样的解释……但那不重要。
Echoes of Change#366.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#367.src: If you know him, we need information. What can you tell us?
Echoes of Change#367.dst: 如果你认识他，我们需要情报。你能告诉我们什么？
Echoes of Change#367.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#368.src: Really. Because from my perspective, working directly under the Crown doesn't sound like something a good person would do!
Echoes of Change#368.dst: 是吗。因为在我看来，直接替王室工作听起来可不像好人会做的事！
Echoes of Change#368.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#369.src: That could certainly be a concern... though, we were not expecting to fight any Sovereigns, regardless.
Echoes of Change#369.dst: 那确实可能是个隐忧……不过，我们本来就没打算跟任何统领交手。
Echoes of Change#369.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#370.src: Ah... so you knew him before his ascension, then.
Echoes of Change#370.dst: 啊……所以你在他飞升之前就认识他了。
Echoes of Change#370.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#371.src: This could be a good thing for us. If he only recently ascended, he's likely to lack experience with the Queen's blessing.
Echoes of Change#371.dst: 这对我们来说可能是好事。如果他才刚飞升，大概还不熟悉怎么运用女王的祝福。
Echoes of Change#371.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#372.src: We need to report back to Syndra about this... this changes things.
Echoes of Change#372.dst: 我们得回去跟 Syndra 报告这件事……这会改变情况。
Echoes of Change#372.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#373.src: Come on, let's head back to the Steel Feather.
Echoes of Change#373.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#375.src: If it comes down to it... and you are forced to face him. Would you be ready to kill your former friend, if necessary?
Echoes of Change#375.dst: 如果到了那一步……你被迫要面对他。必要的时候，你准备好杀掉你以前的朋友了吗？
Echoes of Change#375.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#376.src: ...think on it, for now. If we are lucky, you won't need the answer.
Echoes of Change#376.dst: ……现在先想想吧。如果我们运气好，你不会需要这个答案。
Echoes of Change#376.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#377.src: Return to The Steel Feather and discuss the final steps at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#377.dst: 返回 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的钢羽，讨论最后的步骤。

Echoes of Change#378.src: Everyone! Gather around, we return with... news. Both good and bad.
Echoes of Change#378.dst: 各位！集合一下，我们带回了……消息。有好有坏。
Echoes of Change#378.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#379.src: Welcome back. I hesitate to ask, but what are the news?
Echoes of Change#379.dst: 欢迎回来。我有点不敢问，不过是什么消息？
Echoes of Change#379.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#380.src: We can begin with the good news. We have properly assessed each of our escape routes, and ordered them from most to least preferable..
Echoes of Change#380.dst: 我们先说好消息。我们已经仔细评估了每一条逃生路线，并按优先顺序排好了。
Echoes of Change#380.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#381.src: That's good. With that, we should have completed all the necessary preparations for the festival... then what are the bad news?
Echoes of Change#381.dst: 很好。这样一来，庆典所需的准备应该都完成了……那坏消息是什么？
Echoes of Change#381.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#382.src: We've learned of a third Sovereign who will be present at the festival. A new one, by the name of Tasim.
Echoes of Change#382.dst: 我们得知有第三位统领会出席庆典。是一位新任的，名叫 Tasim。
Echoes of Change#382.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#383.src: Oh, great. As if having both Sovereigns Zhiraok and Soosu to deal with wasn't bad enough... and now there's another one?
Echoes of Change#383.dst: 哦，好极了。好像应付 Zhiraok 和 Soosu 两位统领还不够糟似的……现在又来一个？
Echoes of Change#383.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#384.src: This doesn't change anything. We'll proceed as planned.
Echoes of Change#384.dst: 这改变不了什么。我们照计划进行。
Echoes of Change#384.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#385.src: Er... with all due respect, we'd stand no chance facing three Sovereigns wielding the Queen's blessing. I doubt we could even defeat one!
Echoes of Change#385.dst: 呃……恕我直言，面对三位掌握女王祝福的统领，我们毫无胜算。我怀疑我们连一位都打不过！
Echoes of Change#385.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#386.src: We have all the necessary steps prepared. We know what we need to do. The plan doesn't involve facing the Sovereigns at all - the only target is Her Majesty.
Echoes of Change#386.dst: 所有必要的步骤我们都准备好了。我们知道该做什么。计划根本不需要跟统领交手——唯一的目标是女王陛下。
Echoes of Change#386.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#387.src: Syndra... I agree with the young ones. It's incredibly risky, and the risk factor has only increased. Perhaps we... wait for next year?
Echoes of Change#387.dst: Syndra……我同意年轻人的看法。这非常冒险，而且风险只增不减。也许我们……等明年？
Echoes of Change#387.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#389.src: Yes, the outlook of this fight is not great. Yes, the odds are against us. As I have said previously, I will be the face of the operation.
Echoes of Change#389.dst: 是的，这场战斗前景不妙。是的，胜算不在我们这边。就像我之前说过的，我会是这次行动的门面。
Echoes of Change#389.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#390.src: I will deal the final blow, and I alone will draw the wrath of the crown and the people. The rest of you will work from the shadows. No one will even know you're involved.
Echoes of Change#390.dst: 我会给出致命一击，而王室与人民的怒火也只会落在我一个人身上。你们其他人会在暗处行动。没有人会知道你们也参与了。
Echoes of Change#390.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#391.src: Syndra, old friend... are you certain your judgement isn't... clouded? I understand your troubled history, I do... but is it worth burning yourself to ash? What would Eli-
Echoes of Change#391.dst: Syndra，老朋友……你确定你的判断没有被……蒙蔽吗？我理解你那段痛苦的过去，真的……但值得把自己烧成灰烬吗？Eli 会怎么——
Echoes of Change#391.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#392.src: Enough, Quill. My judgment is clear. I do not believe an additional Sovereign changes anything. Now, are you still ready to proceed?
Echoes of Change#392.dst: 够了，Quill。我的判断很清楚。我不认为多一位统领会改变什么。现在，你们还准备好继续了吗？
Echoes of Change#392.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#393.src: ... Well, the explosives are already made and ready... so I guess we might as well use 'em.
Echoes of Change#393.dst: ……嗯，炸药都已经做好备妥了……所以我想不用也是浪费。
Echoes of Change#393.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#395.src: After seeing the state of our citizens today... we've waited long enough. I'm ready to take action.
Echoes of Change#395.dst: 看过今天我们百姓的处境之后……我们已经等得够久了。我准备好行动了。
Echoes of Change#395.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#396.src: So long as Zeph joins, I'm in.
Echoes of Change#396.dst: 只要 Zeph 参加，我就参加。
Echoes of Change#396.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#397.src: Wh- what? Why w- wo- would my choice matter to you...? Uh, an- anyway, I already pr- pro- promised to help Syndra, no m- matter what.
Echoes of Change#397.dst: 什、什么？我的选择为什、什么对你很重要……？呃，总、总之，我已经答、答应要帮 Syndra 了，不、不管怎样。
Echoes of Change#397.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#398.src: Sigh. Fine, I'm outvoted. But I don't like this.
Echoes of Change#398.dst: 唉。好吧，我被投票否决了。但我不喜欢这样。
Echoes of Change#398.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#401.src: I am fighting. But I will not allow you to take the fall for it entirely by yourself.
Echoes of Change#401.dst: 我会战斗。但我不会让你一个人扛下所有后果。
Echoes of Change#401.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#402.src: You don't need to protect me, Mora. This is my decision, and-
Echoes of Change#402.dst: 你不需要保护我，Mora。这是我的决定，而且——
Echoes of Change#402.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#403.src: And my decision, Syndra, is to follow you into battle.
Echoes of Change#403.dst: 而我的决定，Syndra，就是跟随你上战场。
Echoes of Change#403.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#406.src: That will be all I ask from most of you. Try to rest and relax before tomorrow's festival. I'll do a final briefing before we head out in the morning.
Echoes of Change#406.dst: 我对你们大多数人的要求就这些了。明天庆典之前，尽量休息放松。明早出发前我会做最后一次简报。
Echoes of Change#406.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#407.src: {u}, I have one final request to make of you. I'd like to duel you again... this time, I'll give it my all, and I expect the same of you.
Echoes of Change#407.dst: {u}，我还有最后一个请求。我想再跟你决斗一次……这一次，我会全力以赴，也希望你同样如此。
Echoes of Change#407.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#408.src: Meet me by the north-eastern tracks.
Echoes of Change#408.dst: 到东北边的铁轨旁找我。
Echoes of Change#408.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#409.src: My water magic has gotten a lot better. I will help, no matter what!
Echoes of Change#409.dst: 我的水魔法进步了很多。不管怎样，我都会帮忙！
Echoes of Change#409.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#411.src: U-uh, yeah. I was just a-about to go there myself.
Echoes of Change#411.dst: 呃、嗯，好啊。我正、正要去那边。
Echoes of Change#411.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#412.src: I- I can't rest now. I n-need to practice.
Echoes of Change#412.dst: 我、我现在没办法休息。我得、得练习。
Echoes of Change#412.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#413.src: All things considered, I am excited to find out how my explosives will perform.
Echoes of Change#413.dst: 综合来看，我很期待看看我的炸药表现如何。
Echoes of Change#413.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#415.src: I hope Yus' tech doesn't let me down...
Echoes of Change#415.dst: 希望 Yus 的技术不会让我失望……
Echoes of Change#415.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#416.src: I have a really bad feeling about tomorrow. Syndra better know what she's doing.
Echoes of Change#416.dst: 我对明天有很不好的预感。Syndra 最好知道自己在做什么。
Echoes of Change#416.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#417.src: Resistance will always come with a cost. I just hope the cost isn't too great.
Echoes of Change#417.dst: 反抗总要付出代价。我只希望代价不会太大。
Echoes of Change#417.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#418.src: Meet up with Syndra for your duel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#418.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与 Syndra 会合进行决斗。

Echoes of Change#419.src: We don't know what tomorrow will hold. We might succeed without any issues - and I really, truly hope that'll be the case.
Echoes of Change#419.dst: 我们不知道明天会怎样。也许我们会顺利成功——我真的、真心希望会是那样。
Echoes of Change#419.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#420.src: However... We need to be ready for anything. That's why I want to challenge you.
Echoes of Change#420.dst: 不过……我们必须做好应对一切的准备。所以我才要挑战你。
Echoes of Change#420.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#421.src: Of everyone here, you and I are the closest to the power level of a Sovereign. If we can each hold our own in this duel... we might stand a chance.
Echoes of Change#421.dst: 在所有人之中，你和我的实力最接近统领。如果我们都能在这场决斗中撑住……也许我们还有机会。
Echoes of Change#421.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#422.src: As I said, I won't be holding back. I expect you to do the same.
Echoes of Change#422.dst: 就像我说的，我不会手下留情。我希望你也一样。
Echoes of Change#422.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#423.src: ... I haven't told you the most important part of my plan yet, have I?
Echoes of Change#423.dst: ……我还没告诉过你我计划里最重要的部分，对吧？
Echoes of Change#423.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#424.src: I've said that I'll deal the final blow on Her Majesty. In order to do that... I will use my blessing from above, and kill her in one strike.
Echoes of Change#424.dst: 我说过我会对女王陛下给出致命一击。为了做到这点……我会使用来自上天的祝福，一击杀死她。
Echoes of Change#424.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#425.src: I'll let everyone else know tomorrow morning... But do you understand why I need this duel? I... I need to be certain I can do it.
Echoes of Change#425.dst: 我明早会告诉其他人……但你明白我为什么需要这场决斗吗？我……我需要确定我做得到。
Echoes of Change#425.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#426.src: Alright. When you're ready, speak to me again, and we shall proceed.
Echoes of Change#426.dst: 好。准备好了就再跟我说话，我们就开始。
Echoes of Change#426.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#429.src: Alright. Let the best soldier win!
Echoes of Change#429.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#431.src: Truthfully, I didn't expect to be able to best you. You've been able to hone your skills and train your magic far more than I ever could have.
Echoes of Change#431.dst: 说实话，我没指望能赢你。你磨练技巧、锻炼魔法的机会，比我以往能有的多太多了。
Echoes of Change#431.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#432.src: So many years... and the solution was right in front of me. But I didn't know to look!
Echoes of Change#432.dst: 这么多年……答案就在我眼前。但我却不知道该去看！
Echoes of Change#432.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#433.src: ...it doesn't matter now. We've come this far already. We'll have to work with what we have.
Echoes of Change#433.dst: ……现在都不重要了。我们已经走到这一步。只能用手上有的东西了。
Echoes of Change#433.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#434.src: Listen... there is one other reason I asked for this. I have... something of a hard truth I need to share, and I need you to keep it to yourself.
Echoes of Change#434.dst: 听着……我要这场决斗还有另一个原因。我有……一个残酷的事实要告诉你，而且需要你替我保密。
Echoes of Change#434.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#435.src: There is a significant chance I will fail to land the initial strike. If that happens... I will not make it out of that confrontation alive.
Echoes of Change#435.dst: 我很有可能没办法命中第一击。如果发生那种情况……我不会活着离开那场对峙。
Echoes of Change#435.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#436.src: A battle with Her Majesty is no fight at all. How could it be? Could any one person make a dent in such overwhelming strength?
Echoes of Change#436.dst: 跟女王陛下交手根本算不上战斗。怎么可能算？单凭一个人，怎么可能撼动那种压倒性的力量？
Echoes of Change#436.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#437.src: This pile of trash has a strong stench of alcohol and other... unpleasantries.
Echoes of Change#437.dst: 这堆垃圾散发着浓烈的酒味，还有其他……令人不快的气味。

Echoes of Change#438.src: This must be the underwater route Yulie was talking about...
Echoes of Change#438.dst: 这一定就是 Yulie 说的水下通道……

Echoes of Change#439.src: Second Division - Stationed by the gate to the {p}. Low risk - will assist in case of commotion.
Echoes of Change#439.dst: 第二分队——驻守在通往 {p} 的大门旁。低风险——发生骚乱时前往支援。

Echoes of Change#440.src: - Tip! Hover over a piece and it will tell you its shape.
Echoes of Change#440.dst: - 提示！把鼠标悬停在拼块上，就会显示它的形状。

Echoes of Change#441.src: ... So I must do this alone. If anyone must take the fall, it *will* be me.
Echoes of Change#441.dst: ……所以我必须独自去做。如果非得有人承担后果，那“一定”是我。
Echoes of Change#441.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#442.src: Because there is no other choice! Because if I am forced to bear yet another year without her by my side, then... then... then I think my spark would finally go out.
Echoes of Change#442.dst: 因为别无选择！因为如果我被迫再熬过一年没有她在身边的日子，那……那……那我想我心中的火花终究会熄灭。
Echoes of Change#442.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#444.src: I suppose I may as well tell you. An anger without context must seem strange to an outside observer.
Echoes of Change#444.dst: 我想我还是告诉你吧。一股没头没尾的怒火，在旁观者眼里一定很奇怪。
Echoes of Change#444.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#445.src: I was once in the military, as you know. But I was no mere soldier, no... I'd risen so far as to approach Her Majesty's inner circle. One of her Wings.
Echoes of Change#445.dst: 你知道的，我以前从军。但我可不是普通的士兵，不……我一路升到接近女王陛下的核心圈子。她的羽翼之一。
Echoes of Change#445.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#446.src: You know, that was the year after Sovereign Selium died. The position for Sovereign of the {p} had opened up. If things had gone differently, could I have...?
Echoes of Change#446.dst: 你知道吗，那是 Selium 统领死去的隔年。{p} 统领的位置空了出来。如果当时事情走向不同，我会不会……？
Echoes of Change#446.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#447.src: Maybe that's why she did it. She was always sending me on difficult assignments, but...
Echoes of Change#447.dst: 也许那就是她那么做的原因。她总是派给我困难的任务，但是……
Echoes of Change#447.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#448.src: This time, I was ordered to deal with several cursed ones in the Roughworks. Capture if possible, but... well, they wouldn't always come quietly.
Echoes of Change#448.dst: 这一次，我奉命去处理 Roughworks 的几个受诅者。能活捉就活捉，但是……嗯，他们不一定会乖乖就范。
Echoes of Change#448.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#449.src: I've done this before, of course. So I wouldn't have thought much of it, except... except, one of the names I received... I recognized it. Of course I recognized it.
Echoes of Change#449.dst: 我当然以前也做过这种事。所以我本来不会多想，只是……只是，我收到的名单里有一个名字……我认得。我当然认得。
Echoes of Change#449.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#451.src: I refused! Of course I did - I was asked to kill the love of my life!!
Echoes of Change#451.dst: 我拒绝了！我当然拒绝了——他们要我杀掉我这辈子的挚爱！！
Echoes of Change#451.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#452.src: She wasn't even cursed. And here and now, we understand the truth of that label... but back then, it was a shock! A normal, working citizen...
Echoes of Change#452.dst: 她根本不是受诅者。而现在我们明白那个标签的真相了……但在当时，那让我震惊不已！一个普通的、在工作的百姓……
Echoes of Change#452.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#453.src: I was brought back to the citadel. As I stood before Her Majesty, she told me it was a test. A TEST!! A test of my loyalty to the crown.
Echoes of Change#453.dst: 我被带回城塞。当我站在女王陛下面前时，她告诉我那是一场测试。一场测试！！一场对王室忠诚度的测试。
Echoes of Change#453.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#454.src: Disgraced, I had my rank and status removed. I was disposed of, sent to {p}, forbidden from ever leaving.
Echoes of Change#454.dst: 我名誉扫地，被剥夺了军衔和地位。我被打发掉，送到 {p}，永远不准离开。
Echoes of Change#454.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#455.src: Of course he knew! Offered condolences and helped get me back up once he became Sovereign.
Echoes of Change#455.dst: 他当然知道！还表达了慰问，在他成为统领后帮我重新站起来。
Echoes of Change#455.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#456.src: He gave me an assignment. To infiltrate the local resistance groups, and keep an eye on them. If I did that... I could restore my honour.
Echoes of Change#456.dst: 他给了我一项任务。潜入当地的反抗团体，盯着他们。如果我做到了……就能恢复我的名誉。
Echoes of Change#456.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#457.src: Ironically, it's thanks to him that we're here right now. But I can't ever forgive him for standing by and letting the crown keep me trapped there.
Echoes of Change#457.dst: 讽刺的是，多亏了他，我们现在才会在这里。但我永远无法原谅他袖手旁观，任由王室把我困在那里。
Echoes of Change#457.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#458.src: ... But he isn't important. Not really. It's who he serves.
Echoes of Change#458.dst: ……但他不重要。其实不重要。重要的是他效忠的人。
Echoes of Change#458.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#459.src: Her Majesty... I need her to die. I need to do it myself. Only then, can I finally be at peace...
Echoes of Change#459.dst: 女王陛下……我需要她死。我需要亲手杀了她。只有那样，我才能终于得到安宁……
Echoes of Change#459.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#460.src: {u}. If I don't survive... I need you to do something for me.
Echoes of Change#460.dst: {u}。如果我没能活下来……我需要你替我做一件事。
Echoes of Change#460.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#461.src: Keep my children safe. They're all I have left.
Echoes of Change#461.dst: 保护好我的孩子们。他们是我仅剩的一切了。
Echoes of Change#461.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#462.src: ... Try and get some rest. We have a massive challenge ahead of us tomorrow.
Echoes of Change#462.dst: ……试着去休息一下。明天我们面前有一场巨大的挑战。
Echoes of Change#462.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#464.src: I did... When we first got into contact with Quill, I asked him to find her.
Echoes of Change#464.dst: 我有……我们刚跟 Quill 联系上的时候，我请他去找她。
Echoes of Change#464.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#465.src: And... he did. But... she didn't recognize him. She didn't... remember me.
Echoes of Change#465.dst: 而……他找到了。但是……她没认出他。她没……记得我。
Echoes of Change#465.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#466.src: Ha... knowing she was still alive past that wall, but that I could never see here again, and that she didn't even... remember me...?
Echoes of Change#466.dst: 哈……知道她还活在那道墙后面，但我再也见不到她，而她甚至不……记得我……？
Echoes of Change#466.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#468.src: I tried sending her letters, with Quill's help. I don't know if any of them ever reached her.
Echoes of Change#468.dst: 我试着在 Quill 的帮助下寄信给她。我不知道有没有任何一封送到她手上。
Echoes of Change#468.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#470.src: It doesn't matter now. It's been... {~} years. Nearly half of my whole life. So long as she's safe... that's all that matters.
Echoes of Change#470.dst: 那些现在都不重要了。已经……{~} 年了。几乎是我半辈子。只要她平安……那就够了。
Echoes of Change#470.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#471.src: And if we succeed tomorrow... then...
Echoes of Change#471.dst: 而如果我们明天成功了……那……
Echoes of Change#471.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#472.src: Then... maybe we can finally be at peace. Together.
Echoes of Change#472.dst: 那……也许我们终于能得到安宁。一起。
Echoes of Change#472.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#473.src: It was... during a larger assignment. I'd risen through the ranks of the military at a rapid pace, becoming a Wing only three years after joining.
Echoes of Change#473.dst: 那是……在一项较大的任务期间。我在军中晋升得很快，入伍才三年就成了羽翼的一员。
Echoes of Change#473.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#474.src: In {~} IA, Her Majesty was looking into more long-term solutions for managing the {p}. She requested a team of Wings most suited to the task, and I was selected for it.
Echoes of Change#474.dst: IA {~} 年，女王陛下在寻找管理 {p} 的长期方案。她要求组一支最适任的羽翼小队，而我被选中了。
Echoes of Change#474.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#475.src: We worked to establish a more centralized management structure... I ended up taking charge, and was later promoted to Captain.
Echoes of Change#475.dst: 我们致力于建立一套更集中的管理结构……最后由我负责，之后还升为队长。
Echoes of Change#475.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#476.src: But one of my first ideas was to go undercover and work at the factories, for a time. I believed I would be able to get a better insight into the situation that way.
Echoes of Change#476.dst: 但我最早的想法之一，是暂时卧底到工厂工作。我相信那样能更深入了解实际情况。
Echoes of Change#476.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#478.src: I wasn't supposed to get attached. It was just a job, and I'd be visiting many factories...
Echoes of Change#478.dst: 我本不该产生感情的。那只是一份工作，而且我要去很多家工厂……
Echoes of Change#478.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#479.src: But I did. And it was the best mistake of my life.
Echoes of Change#479.dst: 但我还是动了情。那是我这辈子犯过最美好的错误。
Echoes of Change#479.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#480.src: Even after I moved on, and throughout the whole three years of that assignment, I continued meeting up with her.
Echoes of Change#480.dst: 即使我换了地方，在那项任务整整三年里，我都一直跟她见面。
Echoes of Change#480.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#481.src: ...even after the assignment ended, and I was recalled to the Citadel... even after I was inducted into the Gendarme... I continued meeting up with her.
Echoes of Change#481.dst: ……即使任务结束、我被召回城塞……即使我被编入宪兵队……我依然跟她见面。
Echoes of Change#481.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#482.src: I... never told her what I really was. I thought it would be safe, for both of us... ha. And how did that turn out...?
Echoes of Change#482.dst: 我……从来没告诉她我真正的身份。我以为那样对我们两个都安全……哈。结果又怎么样呢……？
Echoes of Change#482.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#486.src: Syndra's about to give her final speech before the festival. Come on, let's get going.
Echoes of Change#486.dst: Syndra 要在庆典前做最后的演讲了。快点，我们走。
Echoes of Change#486.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#487.src: Listen to Syndra's last speech before the festival at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#487.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 聆听 Syndra 在庆典前的最后演讲。

Echoes of Change#489.src: Today is the day we set our plan into motion. In a few hours, the festival will begin... and that's when we'll strike!
Echoes of Change#489.dst: 今天就是我们把计划付诸行动的日子。再过几个小时，庆典就会开始……那就是我们出手的时候！
Echoes of Change#489.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#490.src: I'll now be handing out assignments. They're different from yesterday's pairings, as they're focused on what we need *during* the festival.
Echoes of Change#490.dst: 现在我来分配任务。这跟昨天的分组不同，因为这是针对我们在庆典“期间”需要做的事。
Echoes of Change#490.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#491.src: Zeph and Yuman, you're in charge of placing and detonating the explosives. Yusanu will show you where they are.
Echoes of Change#491.dst: Zeph 和 Yuman，你们负责放置并引爆炸药。Yusanu 会告诉你们炸药在哪。
Echoes of Change#491.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#492.src: Rex and Yulie, you're aerial support. Take your positions on the buildings we scouted out yesterday. Provide support for everyone else as needed.
Echoes of Change#492.dst: Rex 和 Yulie，你们负责空中支援。到我们昨天侦察过的建筑上就位。视需要为其他人提供支援。
Echoes of Change#492.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#493.src: Sui, Yusanu, and {u}. I want you three to stay put on a roof nearby. Once the Queen is dead, chaos is going to break out.
Echoes of Change#493.dst: Sui、Yusanu，还有 {u}。我要你们三个待在附近的一个屋顶上。女王一死，场面就会大乱。
Echoes of Change#493.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#494.src: I need you three to help calm down the people, and to help fight off any soldiers that oppose us.
Echoes of Change#494.dst: 我需要你们三个帮忙安抚民众，并帮忙击退任何与我们作对的士兵。
Echoes of Change#494.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#495.src: Quill will remain here with the rest of the Steel Feather, and will prepare for the aftermath.
Echoes of Change#495.dst: Quill 会跟钢羽其他人留在这里，为善后做准备。
Echoes of Change#495.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#496.src: I'm no good in a fight, I fear. I'd only slow you down on the battlefield.
Echoes of Change#496.dst: 恐怕我不擅长战斗。在战场上我只会拖慢你们。
Echoes of Change#496.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#497.src: Mora will be lurking in the crowd, and will help me if necessary.
Echoes of Change#497.dst: Mora 会潜伏在人群中，必要时协助我。
Echoes of Change#497.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#498.src: Finally... I'll be stationed on a building above Her Majesty. When the time is right, I will strike her down!
Echoes of Change#498.dst: 最后……我会待在女王陛下上方的一栋建筑上。时机一到，我就会击倒她！
Echoes of Change#498.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#499.src: I hope you're all ready to make history. This won't be easy... but I believe we can pull through.
Echoes of Change#499.dst: 希望你们都准备好创造历史了。这不会容易……但我相信我们能挺过去。
Echoes of Change#499.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#500.src: I cannot ensure everyone's safety. It is likely civilians will be injured, and some of us may be hurt as well... or... worse.
Echoes of Change#500.dst: 我无法保证每个人的安全。很可能会有平民受伤，我们之中也可能有人受伤……甚至……更糟。
Echoes of Change#500.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#502.src: Resistance and revolution comes at a cost. We need to accept that. I... pray it will not come to that, though.
Echoes of Change#502.dst: 反抗与革命都有代价。我们必须接受这一点。不过，我……祈祷不会走到那一步。
Echoes of Change#502.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#503.src: Some of you are scared, nervous. You're right to be. This is dangerous, and risky... but know that I am so, so proud of each and every one of you here today.
Echoes of Change#503.dst: 你们有些人很害怕、很紧张。这是理所当然的。这很危险、很冒险……但要知道，今天在这里的每一个人，我都非常、非常为你们骄傲。
Echoes of Change#503.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#504.src: We will change Fruma for the better! We will tear down the crown's tyrannical rule, and we will free the people!!
Echoes of Change#504.dst: 我们会让 Fruma 变得更好！我们会推翻王室的暴政，我们会解放人民！！
Echoes of Change#504.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#505.src: Alright! Let us get to work! Find your teams, and meet up at your designated positions at the festival.
Echoes of Change#505.dst: 好了！开工吧！找到你们的队伍，到庆典上各自的指定位置会合。
Echoes of Change#505.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#507.src: Meet up with your group at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and discuss before heading to the festival.
Echoes of Change#507.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与你的小组会合，在前往庆典前讨论一下。

Echoes of Change#509.src: Yeah. Got an extra battery as well.
Echoes of Change#509.dst: 带了。还多带了一颗电池。
Echoes of Change#509.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#510.src: Perfect. I left charges for you at each spot so when we get to {p} we can pick our positions.
Echoes of Change#510.dst: 太好了。我在每个点都给你留了充能，所以等我们到 {p} 就能挑位置。
Echoes of Change#510.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#514.src: Rex, I've never seen a better shot. You won't miss.
Echoes of Change#514.dst: Rex，我从没见过比你更准的射手。你不会射偏的。
Echoes of Change#514.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#515.src: Thank you, Yulie. I wish you the best of luck out there.
Echoes of Change#515.dst: 谢谢你，Yulie。祝你在外面一切顺利。
Echoes of Change#515.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#518.src: Syndra m- marked out some good spots for us, huh?
Echoes of Change#518.dst: Syndra 帮我、我们标了些不错的位置，对吧？
Echoes of Change#518.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#519.src: She did. I'll make sure we stay out of danger! I know my way around those alleyways.
Echoes of Change#519.dst: 是啊。我会确保我们远离危险！那些小巷我很熟。
Echoes of Change#519.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#520.src: Thank you... But I d- don't need a babysitter! I'll be f- fine.
Echoes of Change#520.dst: 谢谢你……不过我不、不需要保姆！我会没、没事的。
Echoes of Change#520.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#521.src: I know you can handle yourself. But seriously, Zeph. I'm not playing around.
Echoes of Change#521.dst: 我知道你能照顾好自己。但说真的，Zeph。我不是在开玩笑。
Echoes of Change#521.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#522.src: I need you to be safe. We can't afford to get caught here.
Echoes of Change#522.dst: 我需要你平安。我们不能在这里被抓。
Echoes of Change#522.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#523.src: I've never s- seen you this serious before...
Echoes of Change#523.dst: 我从没、没见过你这么认真……
Echoes of Change#523.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#524.src: I'm just nervous. I've never done anything like this before.
Echoes of Change#524.dst: 我只是紧张。我从来没做过这种事。
Echoes of Change#524.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#525.src: Good thing I h- have then, p- pr- princess.
Echoes of Change#525.dst: 还好我、我做过，公、公、公主。
Echoes of Change#525.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#526.src: Hi... are you two, um, ready?
Echoes of Change#526.dst: 嗨……你们两个，嗯，准备好了吗？
Echoes of Change#526.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#527.src: I... ha, I'm not sure! It's... a lot, isn't it?
Echoes of Change#527.dst: 我……哈，我不确定！这……太多了，对吧？
Echoes of Change#527.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#528.src: I've been worrying about this new Sovereign... Tasim. {u}, I know you... know him.
Echoes of Change#528.dst: 我一直在担心那位新统领……Tasim。{u}，我知道你……认识他。
Echoes of Change#528.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#529.src: It's... it's like Rex said the other day. The Sovereigns aren't our friends. If he joined the crown, then... I'm not sure we can trust him to do the right thing.
Echoes of Change#529.dst: 这……这就像 Rex 前几天说的。统领不是我们的朋友。如果他投靠了王室，那……我不确定我们能相信他会做对的事。
Echoes of Change#529.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#530.src: We can't just... sit around worrying about what could happen. We need to, um, stay focused.
Echoes of Change#530.dst: 我们不能就……坐在这里担心可能发生的事。我们得，嗯，保持专注。
Echoes of Change#530.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#531.src: Syndra trusts us! We need to have faith in her plan.
Echoes of Change#531.dst: Syndra 信任我们！我们得相信她的计划。
Echoes of Change#531.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#532.src: Yeah... you're right. Let's take our positions then.
Echoes of Change#532.dst: 嗯……你说得对。那我们就位吧。
Echoes of Change#532.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#533.src: The map says we're supposed to be stationed on top of a building...
Echoes of Change#533.dst: 地图上说我们应该待在一栋建筑的顶上……
Echoes of Change#533.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#534.src: Head to your designated spot at the festival at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#534.dst: 前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 你在庆典上的指定位置。

Echoes of Change#535.src: So... this is our spot, then?
Echoes of Change#535.dst: 所以……这里就是我们的位置了？
Echoes of Change#535.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#536.src: I think so, if I read the map correctly...
Echoes of Change#536.dst: 我想是，如果我地图没看错……
Echoes of Change#536.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#537.src: ... It feels weird. Just, um, standing by. Like... like we're not really, um, doing anything to, to help.
Echoes of Change#537.dst: ……感觉好奇怪。就，嗯，在旁边待命。好像……好像我们没有真的，嗯，在帮、帮上什么忙。
Echoes of Change#537.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#538.src: A bit... yeah. But like Syndra said, we'll be needed to help in the aftermath. Even if we're not really doing anything until then...
Echoes of Change#538.dst: 有一点……对。不过就像 Syndra 说的，善后的时候会需要我们帮忙。就算在那之前我们其实没做什么……
Echoes of Change#538.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#540.src: What's wrong? Something caught your eye?
Echoes of Change#540.dst: 怎么了？有什么东西引起你的注意吗？
Echoes of Change#540.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#541.src: Oh, uh... just- it is the festival day, right? The city looks exactly the same as it did when we, um, arrived. No festivities? No stalls, no attractions?
Echoes of Change#541.dst: 哦，呃……就是——今天是庆典日，对吧？城市看起来跟我们，嗯，刚到的时候一模一样。没有庆祝活动？没有摊位，没有游乐设施？
Echoes of Change#541.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#542.src: Oh! Hahaha, you people have attractions in Auburn?
Echoes of Change#542.dst: 哦！哈哈哈，你们在 Auburn 还有游乐设施啊？
Echoes of Change#542.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#543.src: Um... yeah! Isn't that... the point of the festival?
Echoes of Change#543.dst: 嗯……对啊！那不就是……庆典的意义吗？
Echoes of Change#543.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#544.src: Maybe for you. Here... well, nobody has the time for any of that. The point, for most residents, is having a day off from work.
Echoes of Change#544.dst: 对你们来说也许是。在这里……嗯，没人有时间搞那些。对大多数居民来说，重点是能放一天假。
Echoes of Change#544.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#545.src: Oh! That's... nice, I guess. A little sad, though, that that's why, ha, people get excited about it...?
Echoes of Change#545.dst: 哦！那……挺好的，我想。不过有点难过，那竟然是，哈，大家期待它的原因……？
Echoes of Change#545.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#546.src: Yeah, a bit. That's the Roughworks for you, though.
Echoes of Change#546.dst: 是啊，有一点。不过 Roughworks 就是这样。
Echoes of Change#546.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#550.src: Working for the crown is complicated? Helping them oppress to people of Fruma is complicated?!
Echoes of Change#550.dst: 替王室工作很复杂？帮他们压迫 Fruma 的人民很复杂？！
Echoes of Change#550.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#551.src: Yes! I'd explain it to you, but we don't have time for it now- {u}, you need to listen to me-
Echoes of Change#551.dst: 对！我很想跟你解释，但我们现在没时间——{u}，你得听我说——
Echoes of Change#551.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#552.src: Sigh. You didn't need to do that. I'm not... being forced into anything, I'm just-
Echoes of Change#552.dst: 唉。你不必那样做。我不是……被逼着做任何事，我只是——
Echoes of Change#552.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#553.src: So you chose to work for the crown? Why?!
Echoes of Change#553.dst: 所以你是自己选择替王室工作的？为什么？！
Echoes of Change#553.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#554.src: I... have my reasons, trust me. Look, there's no time to explain right now- {u}, you need to listen to me-
Echoes of Change#554.dst: 我……有我的理由，相信我。听着，现在没时间解释——{u}，你得听我说——
Echoes of Change#554.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#555.src: Sui, what are you doing?! You're just going to draw more attention towards us.
Echoes of Change#555.dst: Sui，你在做什么？！你这样只会让我们更引人注意。
Echoes of Change#555.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#557.src: If you would just let me finish... I'm here to warn you. Your group is compromised- I don't know how, exactly, but we know what you're planning to do today.
Echoes of Change#557.dst: 你们能不能让我把话说完……我是来警告你们的。你们的组织暴露了——我不知道确切是怎么暴露的，但我们知道你们今天打算做什么。
Echoes of Change#557.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#559.src: It is. You need to call it off, or else-
Echoes of Change#559.dst: 是真的。你们得取消，否则——
Echoes of Change#559.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#560.src: ... Because we're still friends, at the end of the day. I don't want you to get hurt.
Echoes of Change#560.dst: ……因为说到底，我们还是朋友。我不想看到你受伤。
Echoes of Change#560.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#561.src: If only you hadn't been hiding... well, it doesn't matter now. We're out of time. If you're still safe after this, then... I'll find a way to reach out to you.
Echoes of Change#561.dst: 要是你没有躲起来……算了，现在都不重要了。我们没时间了。如果这之后你还平安，那……我会想办法联系你。
Echoes of Change#561.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#564.src: There's... something bigger than Fruma at stake.
Echoes of Change#564.dst: 有……比 Fruma 更重大的事攸关成败。
Echoes of Change#564.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#565.src: It doesn't matter. Not now, at least
Echoes of Change#565.dst: 那不重要。至少现在不重要
Echoes of Change#565.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#566.src: Of course it matters! There's real people getting hurt by the crown, and you think it doesn't matter?!
Echoes of Change#566.dst: 当然重要！有真真切切的人正在被王室伤害，而你觉得那不重要？！
Echoes of Change#566.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#567.src: That's not what I said. I... we don't have time for this. {u}, you have to
Echoes of Change#567.dst: 我不是那个意思。我……我们没时间说这个。{u}，你必须
Echoes of Change#567.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#569.src: I asked you not to. I don't need saving.
Echoes of Change#569.dst: 我叫你别这么做的。我不需要人拯救。
Echoes of Change#569.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#570.src: You being here, it's... making things harder things harder than they need to be.
Echoes of Change#570.dst: 你出现在这里，只是……让事情变得比必要的更、更难。
Echoes of Change#570.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#571.src: Harder for you?! You're the one siding with the crown, man!
Echoes of Change#571.dst: 对你来说更难？！你才是站在王室那边的人，老兄！
Echoes of Change#571.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#572.src: I...I don't have time for this right now. {u}, you have to
Echoes of Change#572.dst: 我……我现在没时间说这个。{u}，你必须
Echoes of Change#572.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#573.src: Sui, what are you doing?! You're just going to draw more attention towards us.
Echoes of Change#573.dst: Sui，你在做什么？！你这样只会让我们更引人注意。
Echoes of Change#573.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#576.src: I'm here to warn you. Your group is compromised how, exactly, I don't know, but... the Crown knowns what you're planning to do today.
Echoes of Change#576.dst: 我是来警告你们的。你们的组织暴露了——怎么暴露的我不确定，但是……王室知道你们今天打算做什么。
Echoes of Change#576.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#578.src: It is. Choose to believe me, or not, but
Echoes of Change#578.dst: 是真的。信不信由你，但是
Echoes of Change#578.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#580.src: We're still friends, aren't we? I don't want you to get hurt.
Echoes of Change#580.dst: 我们还是朋友，不是吗？我不想看到你受伤。
Echoes of Change#580.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#581.src: If only you hadn't come after me, then... well, it doesn't matter now. You're here anyway. If you're still safe after this, then... I'll find a way to reach out to you.
Echoes of Change#581.dst: 要是你没有追着我来……算了，现在都不重要了。反正你已经来了。如果这之后你还平安，那……我会想办法联系你。
Echoes of Change#581.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#582.src: Just... please, don't proceed with your plan. Find a way to stop it. I just don't want to see anyone get hurt.
Echoes of Change#582.dst: 就……拜托，别执行你们的计划。想办法阻止它。我只是不想看到任何人受伤。
Echoes of Change#582.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#583.src: I need to go, even finding an excuse to step away for this long was difficult. Stay safe.
Echoes of Change#583.dst: 我得走了，光是找个借口离开这么久就已经很难了。注意安全。
Echoes of Change#583.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#585.src: What- what do we do? We need to, to get a message out! Where's Syndra, we have to-
Echoes of Change#585.dst: 怎——怎么办？我们得，得把消息传出去！Syndra 在哪，我们得——
Echoes of Change#585.speaker: Sui
