Forbidden Prison (Quest)#047.dst: 他说的是真的，新来的。我们这里大部分人只是普通老百姓。我在 {p} 的一家运输公司工作，正要把几箱货送到 {p}，刚出城就被他们抓了。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#047.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#048.src: Me too! I don't even know why I was put here at all! I wasn't even given a trial in court, or anything! They just plucked me off the streets and threw me in here!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#048.dst: 我也是！我连自己为什么被关进来都不知道！连审判都没有，什么都没有！他们就直接把我从街上拖走，丢进这里！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#048.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#049.src: They wanna kill you, that's why. Did ya hear about Revan? He got taken away a couple of days ago, after he accidentally stumbled during roll call. Nobody's heard or seen 'em since.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#049.dst: 他们想杀了你，就是这么回事。你听说 Revan 的事了吗？他几天前点名时不小心绊了一下，就被带走了。从那以后没人再听过、见过他。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#049.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#050.src: I… you're probably right... I just dont understand any of this anymore... I just want to escape this damn place for good...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#050.dst: 我……你大概说得对……我已经什么都搞不懂了……我只想永远逃出这个该死的地方……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#050.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#051.src: ...Good luck with that.. Only way out is through that exit door, and even then you gotta get into the Control Room, as well. It's...just impossible, y'know?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#051.dst: ……祝你好运吧……唯一的出路是那扇出口门，就算这样你还得进得了控制室。这……根本不可能，懂吗？
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#051.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#052.src: Alright, meal time's over! Get to your cells, filth!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#052.dst: 好，吃饭时间结束！回你们的牢房去，垃圾！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#052.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#053.src: ...Well… That's this place in a nutshell for you, human. Just try not to get in anyone's way or step out of line, and you should be alright until they end up taking you.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#053.dst: ……嗯……这地方大概就是这样，人类。尽量别挡任何人的路，也别出格，在他们把你带走之前你应该都还好。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#053.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#054.src: Oi, who’s this guy right ‘ere? We don’t know ya. Move it!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#054.dst: 喂，这家伙是谁？我们不认识你。滚开！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#054.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#055.src: ‘Ey, ‘ey, let it rest, Don. They're not hurtin’ nobody.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#055.dst: 嘿，嘿，算了吧，Don。他们又没伤害谁。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#055.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#057.src: Don’t worry about it. So... You know who we are, novello?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#057.dst: 别在意。那么……你知道我们是谁吗，新来的？
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#057.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#058.src: We’re part of the Placido Crime Family. We do business across the entire world; all parts of it, you know what I’m saying?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#058.dst: 我们是 Placido 犯罪家族的人。我们的生意遍布全世界；每个角落都有，懂我意思吧？
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#058.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#059.src: Almost all of us at this table got caught for running with the family-... Ah, bet you’re surprised to hear that there are some guilty people up in this slaughterhouse, yeah?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#059.dst: 我们这桌几乎所有人都是因为替家族办事被抓的——……啊，我敢打赌你很意外，这座屠宰场里居然也有真的有罪的人，是吧？
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#059.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#060.src: It’s alright, you don’t have to worry about us getting plucked and killed like those other piacevole here. Guards keep on sayin’ something about “our souls are too tainted”, whatever they mean.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#060.dst: 没关系，你不用担心我们会像这里其他那些老好人一样被拖走杀掉。守卫老是说什么“我们的灵魂太脏了”，天知道是什么意思。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#060.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#061.src: Hah! Maybe you’ll get the same treatment too, novello. I saw it the minute I laid eyes on ya. You’re a killer too, ain't ya? Hey, gotta be one to know you're dealin' with one..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#061.dst: 哈！说不定你也会受到同样的待遇，新来的。我第一眼看到你就看出来了。你也是个杀手，对吧？嘿，要是同类才认得出同类……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#061.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#062.src: ..Anyways... You thinkin’ about staying in this prison, fratello? Word of advice: Don’t. If you can, you gotta escape. You might think it’s impossible for someone to escape here, or whatnot...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#062.dst: ……总之……你在想要不要待在这座监狱吗，兄弟？给你个忠告：别待。能逃就得逃。你可能觉得在这里不可能逃得出去，或者之类的……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#062.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#063.src: Alright, meal time’s over! Get to your cells, filth!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#063.dst: 好，吃饭时间结束！回你们的牢房去，垃圾！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#063.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#064.src: But no, you're different. I can see it in those eyes. You just gotta find a way into that Control Room, somehow. And hey, if you do get outta here, go and raise some hell in the Levtus Black Market for us, yeah?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#064.dst: 不过不，你不一样。我从那双眼睛里就看得出来。你只要想办法进到那个控制室就行。还有，嘿，如果你真的逃出去了，替我们去 Letvus 黑市闹一闹，好吗？
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#064.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#066.src: Alright! Everyone, get up! Out of your cells, NOW! It's time for rollcall!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#066.dst: 好了！所有人，起来！马上出牢房！点名时间到了！

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#067.src: Alright, look straight, scum! Morning rollcall is about to start.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#067.dst: 好，站直了，人渣！早上点名马上开始。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#067.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#069.src: ...you’re all here...? Hm... Disappointing, honestly. Rollcall is over. All of you, head to wherever your job is, and get to work!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#069.dst: ……你们全都在……？嗯……说真的，挺让人失望的。点名结束。你们全都去自己的工作岗位，干活去！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#069.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#070.src: Search the hallways for possible escape routes, and find a guard outfit
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#070.dst: 在走廊里寻找可能的逃生路线，并找到一套守卫制服

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#071.src: Report to the Prison Guard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}]

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#072.src: You're done? Alright, now follow me. Rollcall is about to start.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#072.dst: 弄完了？好，跟我来。点名马上开始。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#072.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#073.src: What with you all, showing up late like this?? It's time for rollcall!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#073.dst: 你们怎么回事，一个个都这么晚才到？？点名时间到了！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#073.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#075.src: You're all here, huh? Alright then, head on to dinn-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#075.dst: 你们全都在，是吧？好，那就去吃晚——
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#075.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#076.src: Oi! Quit steppin' on my shoes, cretino!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#076.dst: 喂！别再踩我的鞋了，白痴！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#076.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#077.src: Hey! What the hell are you talkin' about, making up something like that! I didn't do anythin'!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#077.dst: 嘿！你他妈在说什么，编出这种事！我什么都没做！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#077.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#078.src: Shut it, fat-nose! You know what you were doin'! Now stay out of my way!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#078.dst: 闭嘴，大鼻子！你自己知道你干了什么！现在给我滚远点！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#078.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#079.src: OI! Are you blind, or something?!? Get those lowlifes under control, guards!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#079.dst: 喂！你们瞎了还是怎样？！？把那些下三滥管好，守卫们！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#079.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#080.src: You two got some damn nerve, fightin' during rollcall!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#080.dst: 你们两个胆子可真大，敢在点名的时候打架！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#080.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#081.src: W-Woah, HEY! This maggot has a shank! Back up!!!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#081.dst: 哇、哇，喂！这只蛆虫有把自制刀！退后！！！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#081.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#082.src: LOCKDOWN! LOCKDOWN! ALL OF YOU, IN YOUR CELLS, NOW!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#082.dst: 封锁！封锁！你们所有人，马上回牢房！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#082.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#083.src: You two really are stupid, huh? Fighting in the midst of all of these guards? And you got a shank, too...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#083.dst: 你们两个还真是蠢，是吧？在这么多守卫面前打架？而且还带着自制刀……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#083.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#084.src: Well, looks like it's game over for you two outcasts. You're heading straight to the hole!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#084.dst: 嗯，看来你们两个弃民完蛋了。你们直接进禁闭洞！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#084.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#085.src: You, take these two cretins to the hole, and you, go to my office and get one of the spare control room keys. Now, LIGHTS OUT!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#085.dst: 你，把这两个白痴带去禁闭洞，还有你，去我的办公室拿一把备用的控制室钥匙。现在，熄灯！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#085.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#087.src: Alright! Everyone, get up! Out of your cells, NOW! It's time for rollcall!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#087.dst: 好了！所有人，起来！马上出牢房！点名时间到了！

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#088.src: Alright, everyone get in line, and stand straight! Don't move, or it's game over for you!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#088.dst: 好，所有人排好队，站直！谁敢动，谁就完蛋！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#088.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#090.src: H-hey! Stop pushing me, mate! Seriou-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#090.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#091.src: Well, well, well... Another peon thought it was wise to step off course..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#091.dst: 哟哟哟……又有个贱民以为出列是聪明的做法……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#091.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#092.src: W-wait a minute, miss! Someone pushed me out of line! I swear!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#092.dst: 等、等一下，女士！有人把我推出队伍的！我发誓！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#092.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#093.src: BE QUIET! I didn't say you could speak, filth!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#093.dst: 闭嘴！我没说你可以讲话，垃圾！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#093.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#094.src: Get back in line! Once this is over, you're out, slime!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#094.dst: 回到队伍里！等这结束，你就完了，烂泥！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#094.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#095.src: Alright, now, the rest of you, get to work! Rollcall is over for you all!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#095.dst: 好，现在，你们其他人，干活去！你们的点名结束了！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#095.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#096.src: Steal the key from the warden's office, and head to the control room
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#096.dst: 从典狱长办公室偷走钥匙，前往控制室

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#097.src: Find a way to open the exit door

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#098.src: Head through the exit door at [-{~}, {~}, {~}]

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#099.src: Sneak past the guards and find a way to the Records Room
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#099.dst: 偷偷避开守卫，找到通往记录室的路

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#101.src: Oh, thank the bovine! There's a friendly face around here..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#101.dst: 噢，感谢神牛！这里总算有张友善的脸了……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#101.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#102.src: Listen, human, you gotta get me out of here! They've been killin' people in here all day! If you don't help me out, I'll be next!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#102.dst: 听着，人类，你得把我弄出去！他们一整天都在这里杀人！你要是不帮我，下一个就是我！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#102.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#103.src: Look, next to my cell, on that desk! There's a key! Grab it and hand it to me!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#103.dst: 看，我牢房旁边那张桌子上！有把钥匙！拿过来给我！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#103.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#104.src: Yes, perfect, PERFECT! That's the key, hand it to me!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#104.dst: 对，太好了，太好了！就是那把钥匙，给我！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#104.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#105.src: I can't explain the debt I owe you, human... You have no idea how grateful I am..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#105.dst: 我欠你的人情说都说不清，人类……你不知道我有多感激……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#105.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#106.src: Say, what's your name, human? {u}? Alright, my name's Kaetan. Go on ahead and get out of here, I'll catch up. If you do get out of this chop-shop, meet me in {p}, I want to give you something there.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#106.dst: 喂，你叫什么名字，人类？{u}？好，我叫 Kaetan。你先走，离开这里，我随后跟上。如果你真的逃出了这间屠宰场，到 {p} 来找我，我想在那里给你一样东西。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#106.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#107.dst: 救、救、救……救命……求、求……求你了！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#107.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#108.src: Huh...? Oh- HEY! The table caught on fire, someone get over 'ere and help me put it out!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#108.dst: 嗯……？噢——嘿！桌子着火了，快来个人帮我把火扑灭！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#108.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#109.src: Find and destroy your criminal records
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#109.dst: 找到并销毁你的犯罪记录

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#111.src: Who are you? Can I help you, human?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#111.dst: 你是谁？有什么我能帮你的吗，人类？
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#111.speaker: Lexdale Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#112.src: WHAT?? Taron, he-he's alive?? And you... made sure he didn't starve in that prison...?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#112.dst: 什么？？Taron，他、他还活着？？而你……让他没在那座监狱里饿死……？
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#112.speaker: Lexdale Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#113.src: I... human, I can't thank you enough. Even if he doesn't get out of there, just knowing he's alive is... please, I know it's not a lot, but take this.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#113.dst: 我……人类，我真不知道该怎么谢你。就算他出不来，光是知道他还活着就……拜托，我知道这不多，但请收下这个。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#113.speaker: Lexdale Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#114.src: Good evening. Can I help you with anything?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#114.dst: 晚上好。有什么需要帮忙的吗？
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#114.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#115.src: M-my son? He's alive?!? Oh, sweet baby bovine, that's...! Where is he??
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#115.dst: 我、我的儿子？他还活着？！？噢，我亲爱的小神牛啊，这真是……！他在哪里？？
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#115.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#116.src: ...the prison, huh? Well... It's good to know that he'll be able to hold on a little longer... Thank you so much, human. Here, take this!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#116.dst: ……监狱，是吗？嗯……知道他还能多撑一阵子也好……太谢谢你了，人类。来，收下这个！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#116.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#117.src: The only way to escape is by heading through the exit door. You'll need to access the control room in order to open it...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#117.dst: 唯一的逃生方法是穿过出口的门。要打开它，你得先进入控制室……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#118.src: The Prison appears to be lying about almost everything they do to the government, and they appear to buy into it, despite all the rumors about this place.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#118.dst: 监狱似乎在几乎所有事情上都对政府撒了谎，而政府似乎也信了，尽管关于这个地方的传闻满天飞。

From the Bottom#000.src: An'! The best part! The idiot came back with a crumpled wrist and this HORRIFIED look- Musta gotten on the Hive witch's bad side!
From the Bottom#000.dst: 还有！最精彩的来了！那个白痴回来时手腕都折了，一脸惊恐——肯定是惹恼了 Hive 的女巫！

From the Bottom#001.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy [{~} Troll Hair]. Nakoba is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#001.dst: 在 {p} 找到想买 [{~} 巨魔毛发] 的人。Nakoba 在 {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#002.src: Ah, hey there, human! I'm certain you've noticed the bazaar down here. It's a point of pride for the Dwarves- biggest marketplace of all the Dwarf cities!
From the Bottom#002.dst: 啊，嘿，人类！我相信你已经注意到下面这里的集市了。这可是矮人的骄傲——所有矮人城市里最大的市场！
From the Bottom#002.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#003.src: Specialty items you can't find anywhere else- All sorts of strange, wonderful, unique things. I've been looking for a few sundry items myself here.
From the Bottom#003.dst: 有别处找不到的特产——各种奇怪、美妙又独特的东西。我自己也在这里找几样杂货。
From the Bottom#003.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#004.src: It's almost all barter, unlike the merchants above that deal in that shiny stuff. Which is...a little unfortunate for me, in a way.
From the Bottom#004.dst: 这里几乎全是以物易物，不像上面那些商人用那种亮晶晶的东西交易。这对我来说……某方面有点不走运。
From the Bottom#004.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#005.src: You see, I'm a historian by trade, but what I'm really after now is some Troll Hair. See, I really like the sme- er. It's good and sturdy for binding books- wait a second!
From the Bottom#005.dst: 你看，我本行是历史学家，但我现在真正想要的是巨魔毛发。你知道，我真的很喜欢那个味——呃。它很结实，拿来装订书很好用——等一下！
From the Bottom#005.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#006.src: YOU have some? Phenomenal! I can never get it myself- was never much of a fighter. Um, here! Let me trade you that, for...this!
From the Bottom#006.dst: 你有？太棒了！我自己怎么也弄不到——我从来就不太会打架。嗯，来！我用……这个跟你换！
From the Bottom#006.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#007.src: A Decorative Bottlecap Set! These were hard to come by, but I've got two sets of them anyways. Check them out! You'll learn a lot. Thank you very much, by the way!
From the Bottom#007.dst: 一套装饰瓶盖！这些很难弄到，不过我反正有两套。看看吧！你会学到很多。对了，非常感谢你！
From the Bottom#007.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#008.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy a [Decorative Bottlecap Collection]. Dobile is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#008.dst: 在 {p} 找到想买 [装饰瓶盖收藏] 的人。Dobile 在 {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#009.src: Minerals for sale! Minerals for sale! Come get your rare metals! We've got Kanderstone, Wynnic Copper, genuine {p} Sandstone, real Voidstone from the {p}!
From the Bottom#009.dst: 矿物大拍卖！矿物大拍卖！快来买稀有金属！我们有 Kanderstone、Wynn 铜、正宗 {p} 砂岩，还有来自 {p} 的真正虚空石！
From the Bottom#009.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#010.src: Human, you there! If you're interested in smithing, you've found the right place! ...so long as you like drinking Dwarven drinks. I'm looking for bottlecap sets in exchange for these.
From the Bottom#010.dst: 人类，就是你！如果你对锻造有兴趣，那你来对地方了！……只要你喜欢喝矮人的酒。我想用这些换瓶盖套组。
From the Bottom#010.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#011.src: What's that look for? Are you new here or something? Never seen a bottlecap collector before? Or is that just your face?
From the Bottom#011.dst: 那是什么表情？你是新来的还是怎样？没见过瓶盖收藏家？还是你本来就长那样？
From the Bottom#011.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#012.src: Wh- That! That's! I! How did you! It...It's in pristine condition! There's not a single cap missing! There's not even any dents from the bottle openers!!!
From the Bottom#012.dst: 什——那个！那是！我！你怎么会！它……它的状况完美无缺！一个瓶盖都没少！连开瓶器留下的凹痕都没有！！！
From the Bottom#012.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#013.src: There's no way you got those in person! You can't possibly understand the significance of what you're holding!! I! NEED! THEM!
From the Bottom#013.dst: 你不可能是亲手收集到的！你根本不懂你手上拿的东西有多重要！！我！需要！它们！
From the Bottom#013.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#014.src: Here! My rarest metal! Take them! Take them and give me those bottlecaps! I've got to complete my collection!! Give it! Give it! Give it give it give it give it NOW!
From the Bottom#014.dst: 来！我最稀有的金属！拿去！拿去然后把那些瓶盖给我！我得把我的收藏凑齐！！给我！给我！给我给我给我给我，马上！
From the Bottom#014.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#015.src: ...er. Ahem. I got carried away there. But...those bottlecaps are from the very first Dogun Festival. It wasn't even held in Courag at the time these were made!
From the Bottom#015.dst: ……呃。咳咳。我刚才太激动了。不过……那些瓶盖来自第一届 Dogun 节。这些瓶盖做出来的时候，节日甚至还不是在 Courag 办的！
From the Bottom#015.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#016.src: I'd love to talk about them more, but I can't spend too long on the sale, or other customers might go away. But you got a good deal with that Jasplite I gave you!
From the Bottom#016.dst: 我很想多聊聊它们，但我不能在这笔买卖上花太多时间，不然其他客人可能会走掉。不过我给你的那些 Jasplite 可让你赚到了！
From the Bottom#016.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#017.src: Come to think of it, some guy wanted that stuff, but he didn't even have a plain ol' sodapop cap on him! I think he's right close by. Maybe you'd have some interest in what you're selling instead.
From the Bottom#017.dst: 这么一说，之前有个家伙想要那东西，可他身上连个普通的汽水瓶盖都没有！我想他就在这附近。也许你卖的东西他会感兴趣。
From the Bottom#017.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#018.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy some [Molten Jasplite Ingots]. Dorroc is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#018.dst: 在 {p} 找到想买 [熔融 Jasplite 锭] 的人。Dorroc 在 {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#019.src: Hm...a human trader? Well, I've heard of you, but I hope it isn't just the standard fare from you.
From the Bottom#019.dst: 嗯……一个人类商人？嗯，我听说过你们，但希望你拿出来的不只是那些普通货色。
From the Bottom#019.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#020.src: Yes, I've seen quite a few of your type to this bazaar- Using the community forges and smithing tables in all. You seem to have metals in bulk...
From the Bottom#020.dst: 是啊，我在这个集市见过不少你们这种人——用着公共熔炉和锻造台之类的。你看起来有一大堆金属……
From the Bottom#020.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#021.src: ...but probably ninety-eight out of a hundred of the metal ingots I've seen humans use have been trash quality! Worthless only for practice! I seek only the finest metals, you see.
From the Bottom#021.dst: ……不过我看过人类用的金属锭，一百块里大概有九十八块是垃圾货！除了练手一文不值！你知道，我只要最上等的金属。
From the Bottom#021.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#022.src: ...so, of course, you have to prove me wrong by having MOLTEN JASPLITE?! Oh, you must have gotten that from Dobile. Wouldn't have taken you as a bottlecap collector!
From the Bottom#022.dst: ……所以，你当然得拿出熔融 Jasplite 来证明我错了？！噢，你一定是从 Dobile 那里拿到的。真没看出来你是瓶盖收藏家！
From the Bottom#022.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#023.src: I've been pestering him for a while about his stock. The metal of the Unseen Blade is very valuable, you see. It's fragile, yes...
From the Bottom#023.dst: 我缠着他问他的存货好一阵子了。你知道，无形之刃的金属非常珍贵。它是很脆，没错……
From the Bottom#023.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#024.src: ...but to wield it is to channel the power of Ockar the Unseen Blade himself! The wartime taskmaster who cowed a hundred demons with a mere dagger!
From the Bottom#024.dst: ……但挥舞它，就能引导无形之刃 Ockar 本人的力量！那位战时的监军，只凭一把匕首就震慑了上百个恶魔！
From the Bottom#024.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#025.src: Sneaking behind the lines of the enemy, braving blistering heat! Remaining as a shadow, and cutting through sheer earth and magma without flinching!!
From the Bottom#025.dst: 潜入敌人的后方，冒着灼人的高温！化身为影，面不改色地劈开坚硬的岩土和岩浆！！
From the Bottom#025.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#026.src: ...erm, yes. Anyways! For that, I can give you nothing less than my rarest stock. A Golemlus Power Core. If Qira found out I had this, I'd be worse off than a dead man.
From the Bottom#026.dst: ……呃，对。总之！为了这个，我只能拿我最稀有的存货跟你换。一枚 Golemlus 能源核心。要是 Qira 发现我有这东西，我的下场会比死还惨。
From the Bottom#026.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#027.src: She keeps the secrets of those creatures under lock and key- and it must be the ticket to unlocking that particular mystery. Treasure this, human! It is no mere Corkian battery.
From the Bottom#027.dst: 她把那些生物的秘密锁得严严实实——而这肯定是解开那个谜团的关键。好好珍惜它，人类！这可不是普通的 Corkus 电池。
From the Bottom#027.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#028.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy a [Golemlus Power Cell]. Lodog is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#028.dst: 在 {p} 找到想买 [Golemlus 能源电池] 的人。Lodog 在 {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#029.src: Right chief, what can I do ya for? I got all kinds'a machines here. One of 'em's gotta catch your eye, y'hear?
From the Bottom#029.dst: 好嘞老大，有啥能为你效劳的？我这里各种机器都有。总有一样会合你眼缘的，听见没？
From the Bottom#029.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#030.src: I jury-rigged this juicer! Put a lemon inside, give it some, heheh, juice, and you'll get yourself lemon juice in a jiff!
From the Bottom#030.dst: 这台榨汁机是我临时拼出来的！放个柠檬进去，给它加点，嘿嘿，劲儿，一眨眼你就有柠檬汁了！
From the Bottom#030.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#031.src: Or how 'bout this coin-shooter? Turn the crank and this'll spit out any coin-sized object like nobody's business. Just, uh, don't aim it at any windows, unless you really hate that window.
From the Bottom#031.dst: 还是来看看这台硬币发射器？转一下曲柄，它就能把任何硬币大小的东西喷得飞快。只是，呃，别对着窗户，除非你真的很讨厌那扇窗。
From the Bottom#031.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#032.src: ...what? Oh, I see. You think you got somethin' that'll interest ME instead of the other way round. I gotcha. Well, lemme see it a sec.
From the Bottom#032.dst: ……什么？噢，我懂了。你觉得你有东西能让我感兴趣，而不是反过来。明白了。好，让我看一下。
From the Bottom#032.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#033.src: ...okay. I can't make heads or tails a' this thing. What'd you say it was again? Don't tell me this is some Corkus gadget from that not-so-{p}!
From the Bottom#033.dst: ……好吧。这玩意我完全摸不着头脑。你刚说这是什么来着？别跟我说这是从那个一点都不{p}的地方来的 Corkus 小玩意！
From the Bottom#033.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#034.src: ...a... A Golemlus Power Core...? This... hot DOG! Yahaaah, I'd heard about these wacko golem thingies ages ago, I always wanted to take 'em apart! Aw hell, but this is an opportunity!
From the Bottom#034.dst: ……一……一枚 Golemlus 能源核心……？这……我的老天！呀哈！我老早就听说过这些古怪的魔像玩意，一直想把它们拆开来看看！见鬼，这可是个好机会！
From the Bottom#034.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#035.src: Gotta say, for something that came from that Hive it's a lot less purple and black and spidery-all-over than I expected. The complexity...this has gotta be the real deal, but...
From the Bottom#035.dst: 不得不说，从那个蜂巢来的东西，没我想的那么紫、那么黑、那么浑身都是蜘蛛。这复杂程度……这肯定是真货，不过……
From the Bottom#035.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#036.src: Feels like someone else made this. That Qira lady doesn't seem like the handsy type, and this is something like {~} mechanics, {~} magic. Just seems out of character.
From the Bottom#036.dst: 感觉像是别人做的。那个 Qira 小姐看起来不像会动手做东西的人，而这东西大概是 {~} 机械、{~} 魔法。跟她的作风不太搭。
From the Bottom#036.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#037.src: Ah, but I'm gettin' away from myself. Tell ya what- prob'ly went through a lotta trouble ta get this, and that means you got guts. You got bravery. You got STONES, human!
From the Bottom#037.dst: 啊，我扯远了。这样吧——你为了弄到这个大概吃了不少苦头，这就代表你有胆量。你有勇气。你够种，人类！
From the Bottom#037.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#038.src: So, how 'bout these Ice Drake Scales then? It fits a brave soul like you, it does! Take 'em with pride, there!
From the Bottom#038.dst: 那么，这些冰龙鳞片怎么样？很配你这样勇敢的人，真的！骄傲地收下吧！
From the Bottom#038.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#039.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy the Ice Drake Scales. Mastro is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#039.dst: 在 {p} 找到想买冰龙鳞片的人。Mastro 在 {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#040.src: Ardent Magma Crystals for sale! Pure, {~}! Accept no substitutes, unless you're paying in emeralds, in which case kindly substitute...a lot of them!!
From the Bottom#040.dst: 炽热岩浆水晶大拍卖！纯度 {~}！拒绝替代品，除非你付的是绿宝石，那就请用……很多很多绿宝石来替代！！
From the Bottom#040.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#041.src: Human! You have a keen eye for prices and values! I can tell by that glint in your eye- a real MAN's spirit! Even if you aren't a man, your spirit shines all the same as a man...!
From the Bottom#041.dst: 人类！你对价格和价值眼光独到！我从你眼里的光芒就看得出来——真正的男子汉气概！就算你不是男人，你的灵魂也跟男人一样闪耀……！
From the Bottom#041.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#042.src: A SALES MAN! YES! Macho and brave! Chiseled and strong! Strong enough to carry {~} Liquid Emeralds to trade for this brilliant Ardent Magma Crystal!
From the Bottom#042.dst: 推销男子汉！没错！雄壮又勇敢！轮廓分明又强壮！强壮到能扛着 {~} 个液态绿宝石来换这颗耀眼的炽热岩浆水晶！
From the Bottom#042.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#043.src: ...but hold on a moment. Hold on just one moment. Do I detect...a vein of ICE in that manly aura? A chill, pushing against that spirit of market machismo?
From the Bottom#043.dst: ……不过等一下。就等一下。我是不是在那股男子汉气场里察觉到……一丝冰冷？一股寒意，正在对抗那股市场雄风？
From the Bottom#043.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#044.src: YES, I DO! Human, you have Ice Drake Scales! I needn't see them to be sure! I was right about you from the start- Such burning passion!!
From the Bottom#044.dst: 没错，我察觉到了！人类，你有冰龙鳞片！我不用看就能确定！我从一开始就没看错你——多么炽热的激情！！
From the Bottom#044.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#045.src: AND SUCH NAIVETE! Let me strengthen your MIND! Ice Drake Scales are indicative of a great challenge having been overcome! A truly macho trophy of accomplishment!
From the Bottom#045.dst: 还有多么天真！让我来强化你的心智！冰龙鳞片象征着克服了巨大的挑战！是真正雄壮的成就战利品！
From the Bottom#045.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#046.src: To tame Ice Drakes required UNBREAKABLE will! To overcome the sheerest cold with MACHO HEAT! And to outshine demons of lava and flame with that same determination! Those scales represent such resilience!
From the Bottom#046.dst: 驯服冰龙需要坚不可摧的意志！要用雄壮的热血战胜最刺骨的严寒！还要用同样的决心压过熔岩与火焰的恶魔！那些鳞片代表的正是这样的坚韧！
From the Bottom#046.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#047.src: And yet...I must wonder. Such a fiery spirit you have- THOSE SCALES HOLD YOU BACK! Your spirit cannot be contained in such a manner!
From the Bottom#047.dst: 然而……我不禁要问。你有这样火热的灵魂——那些鳞片却在拖累你！你的灵魂不能被这样束缚！
From the Bottom#047.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#048.src: DISRESPECT YOURSELF NO LONGER! I DEMAND YOU HAND OVER THOSE SCALES! But you will not leave empty-handed, no no, friend!
From the Bottom#048.dst: 别再委屈自己了！我要求你把那些鳞片交出来！不过你不会空手而归的，不不不，朋友！
From the Bottom#048.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#049.src: You have ignited my passion as a salesman, so I shall present you with one of my own greatest accomplishments! For a spirit so WHITE HOT, only an ARDENT MAGMA CRYSTAL is fitting!
From the Bottom#049.dst: 你点燃了我身为推销员的热情，所以我要把我最伟大的成就之一献给你！对于如此炽白的灵魂，只有炽热岩浆水晶才配得上！
From the Bottom#049.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#050.src: YES! Your soul shines brighter than the shimmer of EIGHT-HUNDRED-MILLION EMERALDS! Forever may your spirit BURN, human!
From the Bottom#050.dst: 没错！你的灵魂比八亿颗绿宝石的光芒还要耀眼！愿你的灵魂永远燃烧，人类！
From the Bottom#050.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#051.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy an [Ardent Magma Crystal]. Dohstaj is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#051.dst: 在 {p} 找到想买 [炽热岩浆水晶] 的人。Dohstaj 在 {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#053.dst: ……我听到 Mastro 在喊。他……好有激情。
From the Bottom#053.speaker: Dohstaj

From the Bottom#054.src: ...he's married to his work. Would I were his.
From the Bottom#054.dst: ……他跟工作结婚了。要是我是他的就好了。
From the Bottom#054.speaker: Dohstaj

From the Bottom#055.src: ...but business first. Wartime artifacts for sale.
From the Bottom#055.dst: ……不过生意优先。出售战时文物。
From the Bottom#055.speaker: Dohstaj

From the Bottom#056.src: ...priciest thing is a Dogun Flameshooter. Practically invaluable. You want it?
From the Bottom#056.dst: ……最贵的是一把 Dogun 喷火器。几乎是无价之宝。你要吗？
From the Bottom#056.speaker: Dohstaj

From the Bottom#059.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy the [Dogun Flameshooter]. Syni is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#059.dst: 在 {p} 找到想买 [Dogun 喷火器] 的人。Syni 在 {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#060.src: I can't stand this. I can't stand this! SHUT UP, MASTRO! NO ONE CARES ABOUT YOUR SWEATY SPIRIT OR WHATEVER!
From the Bottom#060.dst: 我受不了了。我受不了了！闭嘴，Mastro！没人在乎你那满身大汗的灵魂还是什么的！
From the Bottom#060.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#061.src: MY MACHISMO CANNOT BE CONTAINED! Your aversion only inspires my salesman's spirit! Ardent Magma Crystals! Pure, {~} gold! {~} Liquid Emeralds, {~} off! STRONG bargains!
From the Bottom#061.dst: 我的男子汉气概无法被束缚！你的反感只会激发我的推销员魂！炽热岩浆水晶！纯度 {~} 黄金！{~} 个液态绿宝石，优惠 {~}！超强特价！
From the Bottom#061.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#062.src: AAAGH! Stupid, stupid, stupid Dohstaj! I just need him to fork over that stupid Flameshooter and then I can get away from this tripe but he just! Won't! DO IT!
From the Bottom#062.dst: 啊啊啊！笨蛋、笨蛋、笨蛋 Dohstaj！我只要他交出那把蠢喷火器，我就能离开这堆垃圾，可他就是！不！肯！
From the Bottom#062.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#063.src: No, look, human! Can't you see the kind of stress I'm under?! I don't care about your Flameshooter, I need to get my hands on Dohstaj's Flameshooter!
From the Bottom#063.dst: 不，听着，人类！你看不出我压力有多大吗？！我才不管你的喷火器，我要的是 Dohstaj 的喷火器！
From the Bottom#063.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#065.src: ...wait. Wait wait wait that's Dohstaj's Flameshooter how in the world did you get it what what WHAT! How did you snap him out of his...emotions?!
From the Bottom#065.dst: ……等等。等等等等那是 Dohstaj 的喷火器你到底是怎么弄到的什么什么什么！你是怎么让他从那种……情绪里清醒过来的？！
From the Bottom#065.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#066.src: I've been trying to get a hold of that for a week straight! I already have the perfect trade lined up! Please, hear me out!
From the Bottom#066.dst: 我已经连续一个星期想弄到它了！我连完美的交换条件都准备好了！拜托，听我说！
From the Bottom#066.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#067.src: I have here the Scepter of Draani Thunderwill I! Dohstaj only WISHES he could salvage something this juicy! The real, honest-to-goodness staff of the Wartime King!
From the Bottom#067.dst: 我这里有 Draani Thunderwill 一世的权杖！Dohstaj 做梦都想淘到这么好的东西！货真价实的战时国王之杖！
From the Bottom#067.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#068.src: A war relic for a war relic. It's only a fair trade! Just be real careful- a theif's been skulking in the yellow stall by the bank trying to steal it from me.
From the Bottom#068.dst: 战争遗物换战争遗物。这再公平不过了！不过要千万小心——有个小偷一直躲在银行旁边的黄色摊位，想从我这里偷走它。
From the Bottom#068.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#069.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy [Draani Thunderwill's Scepter]. Yobon is behind the stone walls at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#069.dst: 在 {p} 找到想买 [Draani Thunderwill 的权杖] 的人。Yobon 在石墙后面的 {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#070.src: ...so. I saw you talking with Syni.
From the Bottom#070.dst: ……所以。我看到你在跟 Syni 说话。
From the Bottom#070.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#071.src: Pfft. Thief? I'm an honest man. Just following the old footsteps.
From the Bottom#071.dst: 哼。小偷？我是个老实人。只是在追随前人的脚步罢了。
From the Bottom#071.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#072.src: I know you have the Scepter. I'd have thumped you and taken you if you were a Dwarf.
From the Bottom#072.dst: 我知道权杖在你手上。要是你是矮人，我早就揍你一顿抢过来了。
From the Bottom#072.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#073.src: But how 'bout we work out a deal, instead? Take this tablet.
From the Bottom#073.dst: 不过，我们不如来谈个交易吧？收下这块石板。
From the Bottom#073.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#074.src: It'll explain everything. Dwarven History...if you can read it. I can. Won't let loose my secrets for free though.
From the Bottom#074.dst: 它会解释一切。矮人的历史……前提是你看得懂。我看得懂。不过我不会白白透露我的秘密。
From the Bottom#074.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#075.src: Hand over the Scepter, and I'll hand over the tablet.
From the Bottom#075.dst: 把权杖交出来，我就把石板交给你。
From the Bottom#075.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#076.src: I won't translate it for you, but I'm sure there's some egghead who'll get back to you on what it means in...ten years or so.
From the Bottom#076.dst: 我不会帮你翻译，不过我相信总会有哪个书呆子在……十年左右之后告诉你它是什么意思。
From the Bottom#076.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#077.src: Good things come to those who wait for others to do the work for 'em, as they say.
From the Bottom#077.dst: 俗话说，好东西总会留给那些等别人帮忙干活的人。
From the Bottom#077.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#078.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy your [Eons-Lost Dwarven History Tablet]. Nakoba is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#078.dst: 在 {p} 找到想买你的 [失落万古的矮人历史石板] 的人。Nakoba 在 {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#079.src: Well, you've been busy, I see! You've been working this bazaar like a champion!
From the Bottom#079.dst: 哎呀，看来你一直很忙嘛！你在这个集市里简直是如鱼得水！
From the Bottom#079.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#080.src: I ought to tell my friends up at the topside shops- they really respect traders who know their way around a deal. You should be able to buy and use more items from the armories!
From the Bottom#080.dst: 我该跟上面商店的朋友们说一声——他们很尊重懂得做买卖的商人。你应该能从军械库买到并使用更多物品了！
From the Bottom#080.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#081.src: I... haven't had such luck unfortunately. I think you might've picked the place clean, eheh. Don't suppose you've got one last deal up your sleeve, huh?
From the Bottom#081.dst: 我……可惜没这么好运。我想这地方大概被你扫光了，呵呵。你该不会还藏着最后一笔交易吧？
From the Bottom#081.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#082.src: Oh, really? Hah, I was just joking about that, but if you really do have an offer, go ahead and lay it on me!
From the Bottom#082.dst: 噢，真的？哈，我只是开个玩笑，不过如果你真的有东西要卖，尽管拿出来吧！
From the Bottom#082.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#087.src: THAT'S ANCIENT HISTORY! FORMATIVE ANCIENT HISTORY!
From the Bottom#087.dst: 这是远古的历史！奠定一切的远古历史！
From the Bottom#087.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#088.src: I recognize those runes, they're ancient Dwarven glyphs! This is slab number three! We already have the first, second, and fourth tablets, my team and I- this would finish the collection!
From the Bottom#088.dst: 我认得这些符文，这是古代矮人的文字！这是第三块石板！我和我的团队已经有第一、第二和第四块了——有了这块就能凑齐了！
From the Bottom#088.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#089.src: I! I! I! Take! TAKE EVERYTHING I HAVE! TAKE IT ALL, I NEED THAT! I NEED TO DISCOVER THOSE ANCIENT SECRETS!
From the Bottom#089.dst: 我！我！我！拿去！把我所有的东西都拿去！全部拿去，我需要它！我需要揭开那些远古的秘密！
From the Bottom#089.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#090.src: AH! AHAHAHAHA! THE HISTORY! THE STORIES! THE EVERYTHING! IT'S BETTER THAN THE SMELL OF TROLL HAIR! AHAHAHAAAHAHHAHHAHAAAAAH!
From the Bottom#090.dst: 啊！啊哈哈哈哈！历史！故事！一切的一切！这比巨魔毛发的味道还棒！啊哈哈哈哈啊哈哈哈哈哈啊！
From the Bottom#090.speaker: Nakoba

From the Mountains#000.src: Find out what's going on at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

From the Mountains#001.src: Mmph! Humnym! Mah houfhs fhs on fifhre! Gft hfrelp, tiff brafze womd strfp!
From the Mountains#001.dst: 唔唔！人唔类！我唔房子唔着火唔了！快唔找唔人唔，快唔去唔灭火！
From the Mountains#001.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#002.src: Ouh hff do hflp! I hff nho glue wfhtsh doon fifs!
From the Mountains#002.dst: 唔唔唔帮唔忙！我唔知唔道唔怎么唔灭唔这火！
From the Mountains#002.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#003.src: Find what Arnod wants inside of the house.
From the Mountains#003.dst: 进屋找到 Arnod 想要的东西。

From the Mountains#004.src: ...well, that explains why you didn't help. But, uh, did the RAGING FIRE escape your notice somehow?!
From the Mountains#004.dst: ……好吧，这就解释了你为什么不帮忙。可是，呃，那熊熊大火你怎么就没注意到呢？！
From the Mountains#004.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#005.src: I don't care who it is, get me help!! I don't care if you do it, I don't care if you get someone to do it, but someone's got to help with this crazy re-igniting fire!
From the Mountains#005.dst: 我不管是谁，快找人帮我！！我不管是你来，还是你找别人来，总之得有人帮忙对付这场一直重新烧起来的疯狂大火！
From the Mountains#005.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#006.src: Check around {p} if you need to, but hurry up already! My house is going to burn to ashes if you don't hurry!
From the Mountains#006.dst: 有需要就去 {p} 附近找找，但快点！再不快点，我的房子就要烧成灰了！
From the Mountains#006.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#007.src: Find someone in {p} who can help you with the fires.
From the Mountains#007.dst: 在 {p} 找一个能帮你对付大火的人。

From the Mountains#008.src: Hm... where am I going to get help now- Mh? You're one of those human types, right? Do you have-
From the Mountains#008.dst: 嗯……我现在要去哪找帮手——嗯？你是人类那种人，对吧？你有没有——
From the Mountains#008.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#009.src: Huh? Someone's house is on fire? Guess that's a little more pressing than what I was going to ask. Where is it?
From the Mountains#009.dst: 嗯？有人的房子着火了？看来这比我要问的事急。在哪里？
From the Mountains#009.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#010.src: Oh, that valley by the gate? I think I know where you mean. Let's walk together. So, tell me what exactly happened?
From the Mountains#010.dst: 噢，大门旁边那个山谷？我想我知道你说的地方。我们一起走吧。那么，跟我说说到底发生了什么事？
From the Mountains#010.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#011.src: Ah, so you're like a mercenary then, and you found this man's house on fire. He said... what? It re-ignited itself? Well, that doesn't make any sense.
From the Mountains#011.dst: 啊，所以你算是个佣兵，然后发现这个人的房子着火了。他说……什么？火自己重新烧起来了？嗯，这说不通啊。
From the Mountains#011.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#012.src: Eh, I'll see when we get there. Oh, what am I doing over here? Yeah, I suppose I do look different from the fare you'd have seen. Well, I'm a dwarf.
From the Mountains#012.dst: 呃，到了再看吧。噢，我在这边干什么？是啊，我想我看起来跟你平常见到的家伙不太一样。嗯，我是矮人。
From the Mountains#012.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#013.src: Normally I live in the {p}, past the canyons to the east. Guess for yourself what the land is like, considering the name.
From the Mountains#013.dst: 我平常住在东边峡谷过去的 {p}。看名字你自己猜猜那片土地是什么样子吧。
From the Mountains#013.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#014.src: Without getting into too much detail, there's... A few problems, with how it's being governed, and I was trying to drum up support over in {p}.
From the Mountains#014.dst: 不讲太多细节的话，那里的治理方式有……一些问题，我本来想去 {p} 争取点支持。
From the Mountains#014.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#015.src: It, uh. Well, I'm used to getting laughed out of the room back home, but I wasn't expecting to see the same thing over there, just with quartz wallpaper.
From the Mountains#015.dst: 结果，呃。嗯，在老家被人笑着赶出门我已经习惯了，可没想到在那边也是一样的情况，只是墙纸换成了石英。
From the Mountains#015.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#016.src: I was going to ask if you had any way that you might've been able to help, but...well, I can smell the smoke from here. One thing at a time.
From the Mountains#016.dst: 我本来想问你有没有办法帮上忙，不过……嗯，我在这里就闻得到烟味了。一件一件来吧。
From the Mountains#016.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#017.src: ...and where there's smoke, there's fire. This is, uh... that's looking a little more like home, and I'm fairly certain that it isn't supposed to be.
From the Mountains#017.dst: ……有烟的地方就有火。这个，呃……这看起来越来越像我老家了，而我很确定不应该是这样。
From the Mountains#017.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#018.src: Yep, this fire isn't natural at all... Hell, this almost looks like arson to me!
From the Mountains#018.dst: 没错，这火一点都不自然……见鬼，这简直像是纵火！
From the Mountains#018.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#019.src: So that's the house, hm? Alright, I'll see what I can do. Might not be able to put it out, but if it's re-igniting, then maybe...
From the Mountains#019.dst: 那就是那栋房子，嗯？好吧，我看看能做些什么。也许灭不了火，但如果它一直重新烧起来，那也许……
From the Mountains#019.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#020.src: Hm... didn't think they'd be this far out, but it'd make sense if...
From the Mountains#020.dst: 嗯……没想到它们会跑到这么远，不过如果……那就说得通了。
From the Mountains#020.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#021.src: Aha! Here's the problem. It's just a little Fleris. Ehm, to explain, they normally live in the Heights.
From the Mountains#021.dst: 啊哈！问题就在这。只是一只小火灵。呃，解释一下，它们平常住在高地。
From the Mountains#021.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#022.src: Pretty affectionate, good if you can stand the heat, but if you take them away from their mounds they get spooked.
From the Mountains#022.dst: 很亲人，如果你受得了热的话是好伙伴，但如果把它们带离它们的土堆，它们就会受惊。
From the Mountains#022.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#023.src: One fleris could have kept setting this man's house on fire, but all the other fallout... there's certainly more where this one came from.
From the Mountains#023.dst: 一只火灵就能让这个人的房子一直着火，可是其他那些灾情……肯定还有更多同类在附近。
From the Mountains#023.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#024.src: Let's go talk to the villager outside. He might've seen where the others got off to, or where they came from.
From the Mountains#024.dst: 我们去跟外面的村民谈谈吧。他也许看到其他的跑去哪了，或者是从哪来的。
From the Mountains#024.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#025.src: Sir, I figured out why your house kept re-igniting and solved that issue, but tell me, have you seen any moving sludgy things around here?
From the Mountains#025.dst: 先生，我查出你的房子为什么一直重新着火，也把问题解决了，不过请告诉我，你有没有在附近看到什么会动的泥浆状东西？
From the Mountains#025.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#026.src: Uhm, I don't really know. I've been trying to douse my house so many times over that I haven't really paid attention!
From the Mountains#026.dst: 呃，我不太清楚。我一直忙着一遍又一遍地给房子浇水，根本没注意！
From the Mountains#026.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#027.src: I remember seeing some tar-looking stuff dripping from the mountains behind my house, but that's it!
From the Mountains#027.dst: 我只记得看到有些像焦油的东西从我家后面的山上滴下来，就这样！
From the Mountains#027.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#028.src: Sounds concrete enough to me. Let's check out what's going on on top of the mountain ridge. Check that book of yours if you need directions.
From the Mountains#028.dst: 对我来说够具体了。我们去山脊顶上看看是怎么回事。需要方向的话就看看你那本书。
From the Mountains#028.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#029.src: Go to the path at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], and follow it up to the top of the mountain.
From the Mountains#029.dst: 前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的小路，沿着它爬上山顶。

From the Mountains#030.src: Hm, you're a pretty quick climber. I thought I'd get ahead of you. Well, this looks like the scorched area down in the valley... Hm! I thought so.
From the Mountains#030.dst: 嗯，你爬得挺快的。我还以为我会比你先到。嗯，这里看起来就像山谷下面那片烧焦的区域……嗯！我就知道。
From the Mountains#030.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#031.src: There's only one reason I can think of that there would be so many Flerisi around here... If that wagon's reinforced, then...
From the Mountains#031.dst: 我只想得到一个原因，会让这里有这么多火灵……如果那辆货车是加固过的，那……
From the Mountains#031.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#032.src: Gah, I knew it. Traffickers! And incompetent ones, too, considering they couldn't hold the things.
From the Mountains#032.dst: 啊，我就知道。走私贩！而且还是无能的走私贩，连这些东西都看不住。
From the Mountains#032.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#033.src: There's a black market issue in the {p}. Things that you can't find anywhere else is harvested in the Heights for their high value.
From the Mountains#033.dst: {p} 有黑市问题。那些在别处找不到的东西，因为价值高而在高地被大肆捕采。
From the Mountains#033.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#034.src: Flerisi are one of them. In the Heights, they're kept as pets. They're relatively friendly, keep your house warm, and don't need much care...
From the Mountains#034.dst: 火灵就是其中之一。在高地，人们把它们当宠物养。它们相对友善，能让屋子保暖，也不需要怎么照顾……
From the Mountains#034.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#035.src: ...But if you take them away from a warm place, they burn everything. To think- Some people use the things as weapons. Can't leave well enough alone...
From the Mountains#035.dst: ……可是如果把它们带离温暖的地方，它们就会把一切都烧了。想想看——有些人还拿它们当武器。就是不肯安分……
From the Mountains#035.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#036.src: We'll need to catch these Flerisi. Here, take this net. While you catch them, I'll repair the cart so we can put them in there later.
From the Mountains#036.dst: 我们得抓住这些火灵。来，拿着这张网。你去抓的时候，我来修货车，之后好把它们放进去。
From the Mountains#036.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#037.src: Capture all of the rogue Flerisi and bring them to Axelus.
From the Mountains#037.dst: 抓住所有失控的火灵，带去给 Axelus。

From the Mountains#038.src: I've got the cart all repaired and ready, did you get all the Flerisi? Come over to the cart then. There's still have work to do.
From the Mountains#038.dst: 货车我修好了，你把火灵都抓到了吗？那到货车这边来吧。还有活要干。
From the Mountains#038.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#039.src: I'll keep the Flerisi in a smaller fire to keep them calm, see if I can't get them back to the Heights when this is done.
From the Mountains#039.dst: 我会把火灵放在小一点的火里让它们保持冷静，看看等这件事结束后能不能把它们送回高地。
From the Mountains#039.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#040.src: For now, I want to see if I can find anything on who these traffickers were. Let's see if they left anything in the front of the cart.
From the Mountains#040.dst: 现在，我想看看能不能找到关于这些走私贩的线索。看看他们有没有在货车前面留下什么。
From the Mountains#040.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#041.src: ...oh. Well, didn't notice that the fire went THAT far earlier. That's a problem, isn't it?
From the Mountains#041.dst: ……噢。嗯，刚才没注意到火烧到那么远了。这是个问题，对吧？
From the Mountains#041.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#042.src: To explain, Flerisi aren't all as tiny as the ones we've found here. They feed of cinders and fire... And for this much damage to be caused, well...
From the Mountains#042.dst: 解释一下，火灵不是全都像我们在这里找到的这么小。它们靠余烬和火为食……而要造成这么大的破坏，嗯……
From the Mountains#042.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#043.src: Methinks this one's getting a bit out of control. This is right next to that big forest, too. Could be a problem if we leave this one be.
From the Mountains#043.dst: 我看这一只有点失控了。这里还紧挨着那片大森林。如果我们放着不管，可能会出问题。
From the Mountains#043.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#044.src: We're going to have to track it down and subdue it. Here, follow me. I'll dig us down to the valley. Watch a dwarf at work!
From the Mountains#044.dst: 我们得追踪它，把它制服。来，跟我来。我挖条路下到山谷。看看矮人干活吧！
From the Mountains#044.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#047.src: Not bad, eh? Anyways, dunno what that huge gate's for, but it looks like our Fleris friend has commandeered it for a bonfire.
From the Mountains#047.dst: 不错吧，嗯？总之，不知道那扇大门是干嘛的，不过看来我们的火灵朋友把它占来当篝火了。
From the Mountains#047.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#048.src: At least it's a little more contained than I thought, being in that cave, but we still have to catch it. Lead the way. I'm right with you.
From the Mountains#048.dst: 至少它在那个洞窟里，比我想的更好控制一些，不过我们还是得抓住它。你带路。我就跟在你身边。
From the Mountains#048.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#049.src: What the...?! It inflamed the creatures in this cave! Fend 'em off!
From the Mountains#049.dst: 什么……？！它把这个洞窟里的生物都点着了！把它们打退！
From the Mountains#049.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#050.src: There are more of them coming! Get to the end of the cave!
From the Mountains#050.dst: 还有更多过来了！冲到洞窟尽头！
From the Mountains#050.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#052.src: Both of us stopping is going to make it take too much time, the traffickers might come back!
From the Mountains#052.dst: 我们俩都停下来会拖太久，走私贩可能会回来！
From the Mountains#052.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#053.src: Listen up. I'll handle these things, while you go after the Fleris. If it's a big one like we think, it'll be a downhill battle- It should shrink if you attack it!
From the Mountains#053.dst: 听好了。这些东西我来对付，你去追火灵。如果它真像我们想的那么大，那会是场越打越轻松的仗——你攻击它，它应该就会变小！
From the Mountains#053.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#054.src: Alright, time for a little royal rumble!
From the Mountains#054.dst: 好了，来场小小的大乱斗吧！
From the Mountains#054.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#056.src: Phew, you're alright! Charred and covered in soot, but that's to be expected. Subdued the Fleris, too! I have the net with me, so allow me.
From the Mountains#056.dst: 呼，你没事！全身烧焦、沾满煤灰，不过这也在意料之中。火灵也制服了！网在我这里，让我来吧。
From the Mountains#056.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#057.src: Well, this is probably a bit of thankless work we just did, but so is a lot of work. Let's get out of here. We can talk outside.
From the Mountains#057.dst: 嗯，我们刚才干的大概是没人会感谢的活，不过很多活都是这样。我们离开这里吧。出去再聊。
From the Mountains#057.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#058.src: Exit the cave and talk with Axelus at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
From the Mountains#058.dst: 离开洞窟，到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与 Axelus 交谈。

From the Mountains#059.src: Well, I say the work is thankless, but that won't stop me, anyways. Thank you for the help, human- This would've been overwhelming alone.
From the Mountains#059.dst: 嗯，我是说这活没人感谢，不过那也拦不住我。谢谢你的帮忙，人类——要是我一个人，肯定应付不过来。
From the Mountains#059.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#060.src: I'll ask the local police force if they've found the traffickers. If they cut and run, well... I got a free cart for the ride home. There's thing for me to attend to there.
From the Mountains#060.dst: 我会去问问本地警方有没有抓到那些走私贩。如果他们跑了，嗯……我就白得一辆回家的货车。我在老家还有事要处理。
From the Mountains#060.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#061.src: Oh, where are my manners? Never even introduced myself this whole time. The name is Axelus. And yours?
From the Mountains#061.dst: 噢，我的礼貌呢？我从头到尾都没自我介绍。我叫 Axelus。你呢？
From the Mountains#061.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#062.src: {u}, huh? I'll try and remember that. For now, take this armor for the trouble. Safe travels, {u}!
From the Mountains#062.dst: {u}，是吧？我会记住的。这件盔甲你先拿着，算是辛苦费。一路平安，{u}！
From the Mountains#062.speaker: Axelus

Frost Bite#000.src: Find Eppo at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. The entrance to his cave can be found at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Frost Bite#003.src: Darn. The drill just won't start.
Frost Bite#003.dst: 可恶。钻机就是启动不了。
Frost Bite#003.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#004.src: Hey, Guard! Do you know anything about Electromagic? Come up here to the drill, maybe you can take a look?
Frost Bite#004.dst: 嘿，守卫！你懂电磁魔法吗？上来钻机这边，也许你能看看？
Frost Bite#004.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#005.src: Oh! Never mind, it lit up, back up!
Frost Bite#005.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#006.src: For the love of Bob... Why won't you just break?
Frost Bite#006.dst: 看在 Bob 的份上……你为什么就是不碎？
Frost Bite#006.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#007.src: This ice was created by Theorick, a Twain who defended this area many many years ago.
Frost Bite#007.dst: 这冰是 Theorick 造出来的，他是很多很多年前守护这一带的一位 Twain。
Frost Bite#007.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#008.src: When the corruption got too much... He froze everything, including the people. Do you see them in there?
Frost Bite#008.dst: 当腐化变得太严重时……他把一切都冻住了，包括人。你看到里面的他们了吗？
Frost Bite#008.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#009.src: We've tried desperately to get them out, but we've tried all the equipment we had, including this Corkian drill.
Frost Bite#009.dst: 我们拼命想把他们弄出来，可我们所有的设备都试过了，包括这台 Corkus 钻机。
Frost Bite#009.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#010.src: Maybe we should get more destructive... The demolition expert, Rhudya, is further down the cave.
Frost Bite#010.dst: 也许我们该用更有破坏力的东西……爆破专家 Rhudya 就在洞窟更深处。
Frost Bite#010.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#011.src: It's a long shot, but worth a try. Would you be able to get it while I clear this space?
Frost Bite#011.dst: 希望不大，但值得一试。我清理这块地方的时候，你能去拿来吗？
Frost Bite#011.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#012.src: Go deeper into the cave and speak to Rhudya.
Frost Bite#012.dst: 深入洞窟，与 Rhudya 交谈。

Frost Bite#013.src: Whup! You're on private property, y'know! Oh, Eppo sent ya? That's fair enough.
Frost Bite#013.dst: 嚯！你闯进私人地盘了，知道吧！噢，是 Eppo 叫你来的？那就没问题。
Frost Bite#013.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#014.src: You'll be needing this TNT then, make sure not to drop it though, whup!
Frost Bite#014.dst: 那你需要这包 TNT，可千万别掉了，嚯！
Frost Bite#014.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#015.src: Just travel through this cave and you'll be returned to Eppo easy-peasy!
Frost Bite#015.dst: 穿过这个洞窟，你就能轻轻松松回到 Eppo 那里！
Frost Bite#015.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#016.src: Return to Eppo with the tnt.
Frost Bite#016.dst: 带着 TNT 回到 Eppo 那里。

Frost Bite#017.src: Very nice, this might do the trick.
Frost Bite#017.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#018.src: Back up, I'll ignite the explosive.
Frost Bite#018.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#020.src: NOTHING? Not even a scratch. I don't understand Theoricks ice.. It's not real.
Frost Bite#020.dst: 一点用都没有？连个刮痕都没有。我搞不懂 Theorick 的冰.. 它不是真的冰。
Frost Bite#020.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#021.src: I'm not sure what else we can do then...
Frost Bite#021.dst: 那我也不知道还能怎么办了……
Frost Bite#021.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#022.src: HEY. Eppo, over here! Near the cave!
Frost Bite#022.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#023.src: Did the explosive not work? I found this old mineshaft on the way back from the cave, it leads to an old lava cavern.
Frost Bite#023.dst: 炸药没用吗？我从洞窟回来的路上发现了一条旧矿井，它通往一个旧熔岩洞。
Frost Bite#023.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#024.src: Might be a long shot, but this lava looks different. Why not give it a try?
Frost Bite#024.dst: 希望也许不大，但那里的熔岩看起来不太一样。何不试试看？
Frost Bite#024.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#025.src: Travel to the lava springs through the mineshaft.

Frost Bite#026.src: Complete the puzzle and bring the lava back to Eppo.
Frost Bite#026.dst: 解开谜题，把熔岩带回给 Eppo。

Frost Bite#027.src: I don't understand how you can hold lava in a bucket.. But here we are.
Frost Bite#027.dst: 我搞不懂你是怎么用桶装熔岩的.. 不过总之拿来了。
Frost Bite#027.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#028.src: Truth is.. We're not retrieving these bodies for no reason.
Frost Bite#028.dst: 老实说.. 我们不是无缘无故要取回这些遗体的。
Frost Bite#028.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#029.src: We believe one of these people worked for Theorick, and has a key to his mansion
Frost Bite#029.dst: 我们相信这些人里有一个替 Theorick 做事，身上有他宅邸的钥匙
Frost Bite#029.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#030.src: We in {p} think Theorick has a lot to answer for. We want to redistribute his wealth among those he hurt.
Frost Bite#030.dst: 我们 {p} 的人认为 Theorick 有很多账要算。我们想把他的财富重新分给那些被他伤害的人。
Frost Bite#030.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#031.src: Right, I've dipped this stick in the magical lava. Just hold the rod and walk into the ice to melt it.
Frost Bite#031.dst: 好了，我已经把这根棍子浸过魔法熔岩了。握着棍子走进冰里就能融化它。
Frost Bite#031.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#032.src: Look for the corpse with a key, it might be above you. Good luck!
Frost Bite#032.dst: 找那具带着钥匙的尸体，可能在你上方。祝你好运！
Frost Bite#032.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#033.src: Melt the ice and find the Servant's corpse.
Frost Bite#033.dst: 融化冰块，找到仆人的尸体。

Frost Bite#034.src: Is that the right one? You got it? Brilliant! Now come back down.
Frost Bite#034.dst: 是那一具吗？你拿到了？太棒了！现在下来吧。
Frost Bite#034.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#035.src: Lets travel to the mansion together. Here, lets take my horse.
Frost Bite#035.dst: 我们一起去宅邸吧。来，骑我的马。
Frost Bite#035.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#036.src: While we ride, let me explain a little more about what we're doing. Let's go.
Frost Bite#036.dst: 路上我再多跟你讲讲我们在做的事。走吧。
Frost Bite#036.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#037.src: As I mentioned before, there is a reason this land is frozen, and it's not natural.
Frost Bite#037.dst: 我之前说过，这片土地被冻住是有原因的，而且不是自然形成的。
Frost Bite#037.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#038.src: Many years before Bob was around, Wynn was in ruins due to the corruption war.
Frost Bite#038.dst: 在 Bob 出现的很多年前，Wynn 因为腐化战争而一片废墟。
Frost Bite#038.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#039.src: In those times there used to be a group of naturally gifted individuals called the Twains. They defended us all with elemental magic.
Frost Bite#039.dst: 那个年代有一群天赋异禀的人，叫作 Twain。他们用元素魔法保护着我们所有人。
Frost Bite#039.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#040.src: Theorick was one of those Twains. He harnessed unnaturally powerful ice based magic. He used it to protect the land surrounding the mansion.
Frost Bite#040.dst: Theorick 就是其中一位 Twain。他掌握着强大到不自然的冰系魔法，用来保护宅邸周围的土地。
Frost Bite#040.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#041.src: Theorick.. Wasn't like the other Twains. He wanted the people he protected to pay and feed him as way of thanks.
Frost Bite#041.dst: Theorick.. 跟其他 Twain 不一样。他要他保护的人付钱、养活他，作为谢礼。
Frost Bite#041.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#042.src: After years, Theorick was rich while the people he protected lived in poverty and fear - not only of the monsters, but in fear of Theorick himself.
Frost Bite#042.dst: 几年过去，Theorick 富了，而他保护的人却活在贫困与恐惧之中——不只怕怪物，也怕 Theorick 本人。
Frost Bite#042.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#043.src: He punished those who disobeyed his curfews and would get angry if anyone tried to move away. The people felt trapped.
Frost Bite#043.dst: 他惩罚违反他宵禁令的人，谁想搬走他就发火。人们觉得自己被困住了。
Frost Bite#043.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#044.src: Eventually, just like the other Twains - Theorick fell to the corruption. Not before he had the last word.
Frost Bite#044.dst: 最后，就跟其他 Twain 一样——Theorick 也被腐化吞噬了。但在那之前，他留下了最后的一手。
Frost Bite#044.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#045.src: He froze the land entirely, killing almost everything and everyone left outside in it. Hundreds of lives were lost.
Frost Bite#045.dst: 他把整片土地冻住，几乎杀死了留在外面的一切。数百条生命就此逝去。
Frost Bite#045.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#046.src: It turns out the ice slowed the spread of corruption across the land to almost a standstill. It's been this way ever since.
Frost Bite#046.dst: 结果冰让腐化在这片土地上的蔓延几乎停滞了。从那以后就一直是这样。
Frost Bite#046.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#047.src: Now that we can get in his mansion we hope to uncover the secrets of his ice magic so we may undo it, and share the wealth he hoarded from the people. Ah, we're here.
Frost Bite#047.dst: 现在我们能进他的宅邸了，希望能揭开他冰魔法的秘密，好把它解除，再把他从人们身上搜刮来的财富分出去。啊，我们到了。
Frost Bite#047.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#049.src: This place looks frozen in time.. The grandure.. Well he did just take and take from everyone around him.
Frost Bite#049.dst: 这地方看起来像时间被冻结了.. 这么富丽堂皇.. 好吧，他就是一直从身边的人那里拿了又拿。
Frost Bite#049.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#050.src: So, I'm not sure where to start, but I'm guessing he has some protection in place.
Frost Bite#050.dst: 那么，我不确定该从哪里开始，不过我猜他设了一些防护措施。
Frost Bite#050.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#051.src: This is unbelievable.. He was such a greedy- AAAAH.
Frost Bite#051.dst: 真令人难以置信.. 他真是个贪婪的——啊啊啊啊。
Frost Bite#051.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#052.src: ... I don't think we should insult him..
Frost Bite#052.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#053.src: Find the riches in Theorick's mansion.
Frost Bite#053.dst: 在 Theorick 的宅邸里找到财宝。

Frost Bite#054.src: Oof! Wasn't expecting that. That just proves everything I said about him. Punishing people who insult him.
Frost Bite#054.dst: 哎哟！没想到会这样。这正好证明了我说的他的一切。惩罚骂他的人。
Frost Bite#054.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#055.src: Anyway, we should look around for some kind of secret entrance.
Frost Bite#055.dst: 总之，我们应该四处找找有没有什么秘密入口。
Frost Bite#055.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#056.src: Trust Theorick to booby trap his own house the paranoid frozen gro-
Frost Bite#056.dst: 果然是 Theorick，连自己家都设陷阱，这个多疑的冰冻老——
Frost Bite#056.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#057.src: That really isn't fun at all. I can't see a thing. Where are we now, a dead end?
Frost Bite#057.dst: 这可一点都不好玩。我什么都看不见。我们现在在哪，死路吗？
Frost Bite#057.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#058.src: Well we know that insults result in punishment. Maybe a compliment will make him happy?
Frost Bite#058.dst: 好吧，我们知道骂他会受惩罚。也许夸他会让他高兴？
Frost Bite#058.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#059.src: Oh Theorick, strongest of all the Twains, you really are a hero.
Frost Bite#059.dst: 噢 Theorick，所有 Twain 中最强大的，你真是位英雄。
Frost Bite#059.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#061.src: Looks like we finally found his private quarters, look at that vault door.
Frost Bite#061.dst: 看来我们终于找到他的私人房间了，看那扇金库门。
Frost Bite#061.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#062.src: There must be a way to open it. Look around and see what you can find.
Frost Bite#062.dst: 一定有办法打开它。四处看看你能找到什么。
Frost Bite#062.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#063.src: Find your way into the vault.

Frost Bite#064.src: You did it! We have access to the vault.
Frost Bite#064.dst: 你办到了！我们能进金库了。
Frost Bite#064.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#065.src: Wow, even by today's standards, this is a huge amount of money. Just think how much this was hundreds of years ago.
Frost Bite#065.dst: 哇，就算以今天的标准来看，这也是一大笔钱。想想几百年前这得值多少。
Frost Bite#065.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#066.src: Grab a little for yourself, too, we wouldn't have been able to get here without you.
Frost Bite#066.dst: 你自己也拿一点吧，没有你我们到不了这里。
Frost Bite#066.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#067.src: Wait, look at this. It seems to be a piece of Theoricks armour.
Frost Bite#067.dst: 等等，你看这个。好像是 Theorick 的一件护甲。
Frost Bite#067.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#068.src: Surprised it even managed to fit over his fat head.
Frost Bite#068.dst: 真意外这东西竟然套得进他那颗大胖头。
Frost Bite#068.speaker: Eppo

General's Orders#000.src: Speak to Private Tylas outside of Kitrios Barracks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
General's Orders#000.dst: 与 Kitrios 兵营外 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Tylas 列兵交谈

General's Orders#001.dst: ……呼噜噜……………咪咪咪咪咪……………呼噜噜……………咪咪咪咪咪……
General's Orders#001.speaker: Tylas

General's Orders#002.dst: ……呼噜噜……嗯呼。……再五分钟……呼噜噜……
General's Orders#002.speaker: Tylas

General's Orders#003.src: ...wh...? Oh...OH! Oh oh oh! Ahem! Yes, um! Absolutely sir! Right away sir! I don't think you're crazy at all sir!
General's Orders#003.dst: ……什……？噢……噢！噢噢噢！咳咳！是，呃！没问题，长官！马上办，长官！我一点都不觉得您疯了，长官！
General's Orders#003.speaker: Tylas

General's Orders#004.src: ...oh. Wait, you're just one of those heavily armored human types. Cripes, I thought you were Lecade... Even nuts as he's gotten I'd get the thumbscrews if he caught me napping.
General's Orders#004.dst: ……噢。等等，你只是个穿着重甲的人类。天啊，我还以为你是 Lecade……就算他现在疯成那样，要是被他逮到我在打瞌睡，我还是得挨夹手指的刑。
General's Orders#004.speaker: Tylas

General's Orders#005.src: Hum...well, hey. You humans like doing work, right? I hear about it from folks in the army that you lot are pretty zealous about your favors.
General's Orders#005.dst: 嗯……好吧，嘿。你们人类喜欢干活，对吧？我听军队里的人说，你们这帮人帮起忙来可热心了。
General's Orders#005.speaker: Tylas

General's Orders#006.src: Then I think today might be your lucky day, because General Lecade is running out of free hands to push asinine tasks onto. No one knows what in the world's gotten into him.
General's Orders#006.dst: 那今天可能是你的幸运日，因为 Lecade 将军快找不到闲人来塞那些莫名其妙的任务了。没人知道他到底中了什么邪。
General's Orders#006.speaker: Tylas

General's Orders#007.src: Between you and me, I'm using this time to work on sleep instead. I mean, honestly! He wants me to dance with the other privates to greet visitors! We don't even ALLOW visitors normally.
General's Orders#007.dst: 我跟你说，我在用这段时间补觉。我是说，说真的！他要我跟其他列兵一起跳舞迎接访客！我们平常根本就不准有访客。
General's Orders#007.speaker: Tylas

General's Orders#008.src: So if you want to eat up a few hours, talk with Lecade. Up the hill and into the barracks. I'm going to try and do my actual guard duty here instead of doing the funky Grook.
General's Orders#008.dst: 所以如果你想打发几个小时，就去找 Lecade 谈谈。往山上走进兵营。我要在这里好好站我的岗，才不去跳什么怪咖 Grook 舞。
General's Orders#008.speaker: Tylas

General's Orders#010.src: Hey, hey, hey! What is this person? Why is it in my administrator's? New work! New work! Get this person out of the administrator's!
General's Orders#010.dst: 嘿、嘿、嘿！这个人是什么？为什么它在我的管理者的里？新工作！新工作！把这个人弄出管理者的！
General's Orders#010.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#011.src: Wait. Wait, you. Wait right there. Don't move until someone comes to get you. Order! I order it!
General's Orders#011.dst: 等等。等等，你。在那里等着。有人来带你之前不许动。命令！我命令它！
General's Orders#011.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#013.src: ...okay, person. No one wants to bring you from administrator's, so instead I will give you another orders! Listen, listen, listen!
General's Orders#013.dst: ……好，人。没人想把你从管理者的带走，所以我改给你另一个命令们！听、听、听着！
General's Orders#013.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#014.src: You intended to firstly? Convenient! Here is my order then- Check the war tools. They need to be maintained for use!
General's Orders#014.dst: 你本来就打算首先？方便！那这是我的命令——检查战争工具。它们必须被保养以便使用！
General's Orders#014.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#015.src: Cannons and catapults, fortifications and barriers. A barracks needs to be armed to the tooth! I order it! Bad weapons are no weapons!
General's Orders#015.dst: 大炮和投石机，工事和路障。兵营必须武装到牙齿！我命令它！坏的武器就是没有武器！
General's Orders#015.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#016.src: Armaments are to be stored outside fort walls at all times. To the left path leaving the walls. There will be Smithy stationed.
General's Orders#016.dst: 军备必须随时存放在要塞城墙外面。离开城墙走左边的路。那里会驻有铁匠。
General's Orders#016.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#017.src: Move along! I have many orders to make! Return when the task is concluded!
General's Orders#017.dst: 快走！我有很多命令要下！任务结束了就回来！
General's Orders#017.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#018.src: Go check on the malfunctioning equipment at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

General's Orders#019.dst: 回到 Lecade 将军那里。

General's Orders#020.src: Hey, hey, hey! Person is in my administrator's again! This means the armaments are maintained! That is right?
General's Orders#020.dst: 嘿、嘿、嘿！人又在我的管理者的里了！这表示军备保养好了！是这样没错吧？
General's Orders#020.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#021.src: Convenient! Very convenient! Now I will give you another orders! I must ponder for a moment.
General's Orders#021.dst: 方便！非常方便！现在我要给你另一个命令们！我必须思考一下。
General's Orders#021.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#023.src: Here is my new work then- Find the coin. A soldier has dropped a lucky coin in the wastewater!
General's Orders#023.dst: 那这是我的新工作——找到硬币。一个士兵把幸运硬币掉进污水里了！
General's Orders#023.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#024.src: All is confused without fortune. Soldiers must not be confused, or else I cannot give orders! Generally orders must be given!
General's Orders#024.dst: 没有好运，一切都会混乱。士兵不能混乱，不然我就不能下命令！将军地必须下命令！
General's Orders#024.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#025.src: The coin has been pushed into the sewage. My orders are convenient, as there is accessibility! The aqua ducts have means of entrance.
General's Orders#025.dst: 硬币被冲进了污水里。我的命令很方便，因为有可达性！水、渠有入口的手段。
General's Orders#025.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#026.src: Outside, the cracked aqua ducts have Sergeant nearby. It shall mark accessibility for you. Return when the charm is gotten!
General's Orders#026.dst: 外面，裂开的水、渠旁边有中士。它会为你标出可达性。拿到护身符就回来！
General's Orders#026.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#027.src: Recover the Good-Luck Charm from the sewers at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
General's Orders#027.dst: 从 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的下水道找回幸运护身符

General's Orders#028.src: My, what an odd task to give to the chief advisor of the general...
General's Orders#028.dst: 天啊，把这种任务交给将军的首席顾问，也太奇怪了……
General's Orders#028.speaker: Advisor

General's Orders#029.src: You see, human, I was told to dig an extension to the sewer with my own hands.
General's Orders#029.dst: 你看，人类，他要我亲手给下水道挖一条延伸管道。
General's Orders#029.speaker: Advisor

General's Orders#030.src: And at that, it's supposed to just loop right around back in to the pipe.
General's Orders#030.dst: 而且，它还应该绕一圈直接接回管道里。
General's Orders#030.speaker: Advisor

General's Orders#031.src: I think the General is starting to snap under the stress. If you need to return to the fort, just follow along.
General's Orders#031.dst: 我觉得将军快被压力逼疯了。如果你需要回要塞，跟着走就行。
General's Orders#031.speaker: Advisor

General's Orders#032.src: Return to General Lecade with the Good-Luck Charm.
General's Orders#032.dst: 带着幸运护身符回到 Lecade 将军那里。

General's Orders#033.src: Hey, hey, hey! Administrator's has person once more! The charm has been gotten! That is right?
General's Orders#033.dst: 嘿、嘿、嘿！管理者的又有人了！护身符被拿到了！是这样没错吧？
General's Orders#033.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#034.src: Yipy! Soldier will get returned the coin very soon! Person, the actions you take are convenient! I appreciate your help. I must ponder for a moment.
General's Orders#034.dst: 耶比！士兵很快就会被还硬币了！人，你采取的行动很方便！我感谢你的帮忙。我必须思考一下。
General's Orders#034.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#036.src: Here is my new work then- Show your love. You have made me smile wide through your tasks! The other soldier would appreciate you too!
General's Orders#036.dst: 那这是我的新工作——展现你的爱。你的任务让我笑得好开！另一个士兵也会感激你的！
General's Orders#036.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#037.src: Walk jauntily across the tight rope, and make the other soldier smile as well! Soldiers must be happy at life.
General's Orders#037.dst: 轻快地走过钢索，让另一个士兵也笑！士兵必须对人生快乐。
General's Orders#037.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#038.src: The tight rope is right from administrator's- stairs are nearby the passage. Return when the soldier is happy!
General's Orders#038.dst: 钢索就在管理者的右边——楼梯在通道附近。士兵快乐了就回来！
General's Orders#038.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#040.src: Well I'll be, the soldier's crossing the tightrope.
General's Orders#040.dst: 哎哟，那个士兵在走钢索呢。
General's Orders#040.speaker: Barkeeper

General's Orders#041.src: Convenient! So convenient! Many cheers for person!
General's Orders#041.dst: 方便！太方便了！为人欢呼！
General's Orders#041.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#042.src: I think he might actually make it across...
General's Orders#042.dst: 我觉得他说不定真的走得过去……
General's Orders#042.speaker: Advisor

General's Orders#043.src: Gah, what in blazes are you thinking, Lecade?! First this confounded contraption, then...grumble, grumble...
General's Orders#043.dst: 啊，你到底在想什么，Lecade？！先是这个该死的玩意，然后……嘟囔、嘟囔……
General's Orders#043.speaker: Lieutenant Gren

General's Orders#044.dst: 回到 Lecade 将军那里。

General's Orders#045.src: Very, very, very happy! The tight rope has been walked! I saw the task!
General's Orders#045.dst: 非常、非常、非常快乐！钢索被走过了！我看到任务了！
General's Orders#045.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#046.src: The soldier is very happy now! A smile is brightening the room! Yet the day still is dark. Why this is, I must ponder for a moment.
General's Orders#046.dst: 士兵现在很快乐！笑容照亮了房间！可是今天还是很暗。为什么是这样，我必须思考一下。
General's Orders#046.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#048.src: I have devised my plan! I have observed the hills are naked. That must be why the soldiers become upset.
General's Orders#048.dst: 我想出计划了！我观察到山丘是光溜溜的。士兵们一定就是因为这样才不开心。
General's Orders#048.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#049.src: Here is my new work then- Dress the hill. It is bare and trashy. No good! Trashy hills mean our day is trashy.
General's Orders#049.dst: 那这是我的新工作——打扮山丘。它光秃又垃圾。不好！垃圾的山丘表示我们的一天很垃圾。
General's Orders#049.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#050.src: Turn the hill purple! I order it! Purple is King's color! The fortress will feel a castle and we will feast for a hundred!
General's Orders#050.dst: 把山丘变成紫色！我命令它！紫色是国王的颜色！要塞会感觉一座城堡，我们会为一百人设宴！
General's Orders#050.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#051.src: Previously, Springy were introduced. They will make easy accessibility! Person will find Springy past the tight rope.
General's Orders#051.dst: 之前，弹弹被引进了。它们会让可达性变容易！人会在钢索的另一边找到弹弹。
General's Orders#051.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#052.src: Paint the mountain by using the trampolines at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
General's Orders#052.dst: 用 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的弹跳床把山涂上颜色

General's Orders#053.dst: 回到 Lecade 将军那里。

General's Orders#054.src: WOOO!! Finally! Someone to help- Hey, look over here!!
General's Orders#054.dst: 呜呼！！终于！有人可以帮忙了——嘿，看这边！！
General's Orders#054.speaker: Rescuer

General's Orders#055.src: Gosh, what a stroke of luck! I finally beat the Bantisu monks to one of you lost fellas!
General's Orders#055.dst: 天啊，运气真好！我终于抢在 Bantisu 僧侣前面找到你们其中一个迷路的家伙了！
General's Orders#055.speaker: Rescuer

General's Orders#056.src: I'm here searching for soldiers lost in the canyon, you're the first person I've found!
General's Orders#056.dst: 我在这里搜索在峡谷里迷路的士兵，你是我找到的第一个人！
General's Orders#056.speaker: Rescuer

General's Orders#057.src: This propeller hat is great, by the way. At first it seemed sort of silly, but it works a treat, and it's real fun, too!
General's Orders#057.dst: 顺带一提，这顶螺旋桨帽子超棒。一开始看起来有点蠢，但它好用得很，而且真的很好玩！
General's Orders#057.speaker: Rescuer

General's Orders#058.src: That aside, just stand under me, and I'll lift you down! Come on now!
General's Orders#058.dst: 先不说这个，站到我下面，我载你下去！快点！
General's Orders#058.speaker: Rescuer

General's Orders#060.src: There you go, fella! It's back to the skies for me! Best orders ever!! WOOO!!
General's Orders#060.dst: 到啦，伙计！我要回天上去了！史上最棒的命令！！呜呼！！
General's Orders#060.speaker: Rescuer

General's Orders#061.src: Hey, hey, hey! Person has returned to Administrator's! The hill is King's color now! That is right?
General's Orders#061.dst: 嘿、嘿、嘿！人回到管理者的了！山丘现在是国王的颜色了！是这样没错吧？
General's Orders#061.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#062.src: Convenient, convenient, convenient! Our day will no longer be trashy. Good tasks have been concluded!
General's Orders#062.dst: 方便、方便、方便！我们的一天不会再垃圾了。好任务被结束了！
General's Orders#062.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#063.src: However, tasks must be serious. Person's next work is very important. Mister "Gren" needs of help.
General's Orders#063.dst: 不过，任务必须认真。人的下一个工作非常重要。“Gren”先生需要的帮忙。
General's Orders#063.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#064.src: "Gren" Lieutenant has worked on task for many days. He needs assistance, fast- Time is required of a machine!
General's Orders#064.dst: “Gren”中尉已经做任务很多天了。他需要协助，要快——一台机器需要时间！
General's Orders#064.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#065.src: Here is my new work then- Assist "Gren." It is important work. Science machines are complicating.
General's Orders#065.dst: 那这是我的新工作——协助“Gren”。这是重要的工作。科学机器很复杂化。
General's Orders#065.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#066.src: Build the machine with time! "Gren" is left outside Administrator's. Assist Lieutenant!
General's Orders#066.dst: 用时间造出机器！“Gren”被留在管理者的外面。协助中尉！
General's Orders#066.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#067.dst: 与 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Gren 中尉交谈。

General's Orders#068.src: ...hm? Oh, the madman's roped you into this too?! I asked for a Corkian engineer, not- Urgh. Look, have you got any technical knowhow?
General's Orders#068.dst: ……嗯？噢，那个疯子也把你拖进来了？！我要的是 Corkus 的工程师，不是——呃。听着，你懂什么技术吗？
General's Orders#068.speaker: Lieutenant Gren

General's Orders#069.src: He wants me to construct him a time machine!! Why does he even need more time when there's plenty about?
General's Orders#069.dst: 他要我给他造一台时光机！！时间多的是，他到底为什么还需要更多时间？
General's Orders#069.speaker: Lieutenant Gren

General's Orders#070.src: Well, beggars can't be choosers. If you think you have any ideas on how to get it functioning, step inside and see what you can do.
General's Orders#070.dst: 嗯，有总比没有好。如果你觉得有什么让它运转的主意，就进去看看你能做什么。
General's Orders#070.speaker: Lieutenant Gren

General's Orders#071.src: ...wait. It's ticking. Does that mean- Wait, no! HUMAN! GET OUT OF THERE-
General's Orders#071.dst: ……等等。它在滴答响。难道说——等等，不！人类！快出来——
General's Orders#071.speaker: Lieutenant Gren

General's Orders#073.src: Investigate the mysterious prison within the fort.
General's Orders#073.dst: 调查要塞里神秘的监狱。

General's Orders#074.src: Who goes there?! What, come and try to finish the job, you beast?! ...wait...a human?! Whatever reason you're down here for, you need to listen!
General's Orders#074.dst: 谁在那里？！怎么，来把事情做个了结吗，你这畜生？！……等等……人类？！不管你为什么来这下面，你都得听我说！

General's Orders#075.src: I am General Lecade of the Kitrios Barracks! While you are on my ground, you must follow my orders!
General's Orders#075.dst: 我是 Kitrios 兵营的 Lecade 将军！你在我的地盘上，就得听从我的命令！
General's Orders#075.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#076.src: Soldier, I order you to unlock this door! They tossed the key behind that desk; we'll be able to discuss this once I'm out.
General's Orders#076.dst: 士兵，我命令你打开这扇门！他们把钥匙扔到那张桌子后面了；等我出去我们再谈。
General's Orders#076.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#077.src: Good. Thank you, soldier. There's a lot to explain. I'll tell you everything along the way.
General's Orders#077.dst: 很好。谢谢你，士兵。有很多事要解释。我们边走我边告诉你。
General's Orders#077.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#078.src: For now, though, we should get out of this dilapidated prison. Let's go.
General's Orders#078.dst: 不过现在，我们得先离开这座破败的监狱。走吧。
General's Orders#078.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#081.src: You...! You're... What is the meaning of this, why do you look like me?!
General's Orders#081.dst: 你……！你是……这是什么意思，你为什么长得跟我一样？！
General's Orders#081.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#082.src: Trashy liar! No escape! I order it! Generally orders must be done! Return to the room!
General's Orders#082.dst: 垃圾骗子！不许逃！我命令它！将军地命令必须被做！回房间去！
General's Orders#082.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#083.src: What nonsense...! I'll wrestle that costume off of you, you impostor!
General's Orders#083.dst: 胡说八道……！我要把你那身伪装扒下来，你这冒牌货！
General's Orders#083.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#084.src: Agh... As insane as you sound, you're a tough fight... Human, you need to finish this thing off!
General's Orders#084.dst: 呃……你说话虽然疯疯癫癫，打起来倒是很难缠……人类，你得把这东西解决掉！
General's Orders#084.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#085.src: Person! I have new work for you- Knock down the fake soldier! Assist fast!
General's Orders#085.dst: 人！我有新工作给你——打倒假的士兵！协助快！
General's Orders#085.speaker: Lecade 1

General's Orders#086.src: What folly! A doppelganger calling ME a fake! How about you go ahead and prove yourself!
General's Orders#086.dst: 荒唐！一个冒牌货说我是假的！不如你先证明你自己！
General's Orders#086.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#087.src: Hey, hey, hey! Smart thoughts from fakeman! Our home- we called it Gravel!
General's Orders#087.dst: 嘿、嘿、嘿！假人有聪明的想法！我们的家——我们叫它 Gravel！
General's Orders#087.speaker: Lecade 1

General's Orders#088.src: Gravel? I've never heard something more outlandish, it's called Gavel!
General's Orders#088.dst: Gravel？我从没听过这么离谱的说法，那叫 Gavel！
General's Orders#088.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#089.src: Are the rumors about humans being brainless mercenaries REALLY true?!
General's Orders#089.dst: 关于人类是没脑子的佣兵那些传闻，难道是真的吗？！
General's Orders#089.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#090.src: What!? Books have told me this home is hilly and crumbly!
General's Orders#090.dst: 什么！？书告诉我这个家是多山又碎碎的！
General's Orders#090.speaker: Lecade 1

General's Orders#091.src: Do you even know where we are...? How about this then, who's the private that guards the entrance?
General's Orders#091.dst: 你到底知不知道我们在哪……？那这个呢，看守入口的列兵是谁？
General's Orders#091.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#092.src: Tiger! The soldier with dance is Tiger!
General's Orders#092.speaker: Lecade 1

General's Orders#093.src: Tiger?! His name is Tylas!! A tiger is an exotic animal, not some drowsy private!
General's Orders#093.dst: Tiger？！他叫 Tylas！！老虎是异国的动物，不是什么打瞌睡的列兵！
General's Orders#093.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#094.src: No wonder he was asleep, it seems he was even too lazy to give you his name!
General's Orders#094.dst: 难怪他在睡觉，看来他连把名字告诉你都懒！
General's Orders#094.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#095.src: Weak worm!! Person has been convenient with work- Why do stupid things?!
General's Orders#095.dst: 软弱的虫！！人一直在工作上很方便——为什么做蠢事？！
General's Orders#095.speaker: Lecade 1

General's Orders#096.src: AHA! I have pondered- say where Springy is held!
General's Orders#096.dst: 啊哈！我思考过了——说出弹弹被放在哪里！
General's Orders#096.speaker: Lecade 1

General's Orders#097.src: What in the... Springy- What in the world are you talking about?! We don't store springs in the fort!!
General's Orders#097.dst: 这是什么……弹弹——你到底在说什么？！我们要塞里才不放弹簧！！
General's Orders#097.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#098.src: Weak fake soldier!! Springy is held to sleep! Springy is held on top of the pillar!!
General's Orders#098.dst: 软弱的假士兵！！弹弹被放着睡觉！弹弹被放在柱子顶上！！
General's Orders#098.speaker: Lecade 1

General's Orders#099.src: Human!! What are you thinking?! He's speaking utter nonsense!!
General's Orders#099.dst: 人类！！你在想什么？！他说的全是胡言乱语！！
General's Orders#099.speaker: Lecade 2
