General's Orders#100.src: What even is a springy?! He's speaking utter nonsense!
General's Orders#100.dst: 弹弹到底是什么东西？！他说的全是胡言乱语！
General's Orders#100.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#101.src: Enough of this! Soldier, you can't possibly believe that fraud, we have to team up on him!
General's Orders#101.dst: 够了！士兵，你不可能相信那个骗子吧，我们得联手对付他！
General's Orders#101.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#102.src: Fine then- If I'm alone on this, it's time for the classic Lecade Power Play!!
General's Orders#102.dst: 好吧——既然只有我一个，那就是经典的 Lecade 强势出击的时候了！！
General's Orders#102.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#103.dst: 很好！我们让他付出代价！
General's Orders#103.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#104.src: Inconvenient! Person is trashy! Terrible fake! I will not intend the victim on returning to home!
General's Orders#104.dst: 不方便！人很垃圾！糟糕的假货！我不会打算让受害者回到家！

General's Orders#106.src: I did fine work! I generally performed tasks to soldiers! There's nothing wrong!
General's Orders#106.dst: 我做了好工作！我将军地对士兵们执行了任务！没有任何错！

General's Orders#107.src: Too much! Too much! Too much! Escape! Need escape! Too strong!
General's Orders#107.dst: 太多了！太多了！太多了！逃跑！需要逃跑！太强了！

General's Orders#108.src: Damn! He's gone... I don't think we'll be able to catch him on foot at this rate.
General's Orders#108.dst: 该死！他跑了……照这样子，我想我们徒步是追不上他了。
General's Orders#108.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#109.src: I can't believe you actually trusted him, but I couldn't hold a grudge about it. The thing's gone, anyways.
General's Orders#109.dst: 真不敢相信你居然信了他，不过我也不会为此记恨。反正那东西已经跑了。
General's Orders#109.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#110.src: It wouldn't be right to leave you empty handed over it. Perhaps you can find a use for that odd slime it left behind.
General's Orders#110.dst: 为了这件事让你空手而归不太对。也许你能找到它留下的那团怪史莱姆的用处。
General's Orders#110.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#111.src: Well soldier, I'll be checking out what degree of havoc he's wrecked on this fort.
General's Orders#111.dst: 好了，士兵，我要去看看他把这座要塞搞得有多乱。
General's Orders#111.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#112.src: I couldn't leave you unrewarded for your efforts though. You seem resourceful- Perhaps you can find a use for that odd slime it left behind.
General's Orders#112.dst: 不过我不能不奖励你的努力。你看起来很机灵——也许你能找到它留下的那团怪史莱姆的用处。
General's Orders#112.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#113.src: Some clay I see! I'll take that off of you. Not without compensation of course!
General's Orders#113.dst: 我看到一些黏土！我帮你收下吧。当然不会让你白给！
General's Orders#113.speaker: Private

Grand Youth#001.src: Oh, what am I to do...? How am I to be our next elder if I cannot even help him... Oh? Ehm, hello, stranger.
Grand Youth#001.dst: 噢，我该怎么办……？我连他都帮不了，要怎么当我们的下一任长老……噢？呃，你好，陌生人。
Grand Youth#001.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#002.src: You most likely heard me. Our elder has fallen ill of some vile disease... I am to be our next elder, but I am not yet ready.
Grand Youth#002.dst: 你大概听到了。我们的长老染上了某种恶疾……我是下一任长老，但我还没准备好。
Grand Youth#002.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#003.src: We have tried everything we can think of, but our healers and shamans have failed to cure him. We had some hope, however...
Grand Youth#003.dst: 我们能想到的办法都试过了，但我们的医者和萨满都治不好他。不过，我们原本还抱着一丝希望……
Grand Youth#003.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#004.src: A man in your city, {p}, insists that he sells healing water that could cure him, but he is selling it for an exorbitant price that we cannot afford!
Grand Youth#004.dst: 你们城里，{p}，有个人一口咬定他卖的治愈之水能治好长老，可他开的价高得离谱，我们根本付不起！
Grand Youth#004.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#005.src: I do not know where else to turn. I must ask you for help. If you can purchase it, I am sure that we could find a way to repay you.
Grand Youth#005.dst: 我不知道还能找谁了。我只能请你帮忙。如果你能把它买下来，我相信我们一定能想办法报答你。
Grand Youth#005.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#006.src: I have written directions for you in your content book...please help our village.
Grand Youth#006.dst: 我已经在你的内容书里写下了路线……请帮帮我们的村子。
Grand Youth#006.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#007.src: Visit the Salesman in {p} near the fountain.
Grand Youth#007.dst: 去 {p} 喷泉附近找推销员。

Grand Youth#008.src: Oh, why hello there! Come for my patented healing water, have you? Any problem instantly cured! Sniffles beware!
Grand Youth#008.dst: 噢，你好啊！是来买我的专利治愈之水的吧？什么毛病都能马上治好！流鼻涕的小心了！
Grand Youth#008.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#009.src: You're quite lucky, I only have a couple of bottles left, so it won't go cheap, but this is the good stuff! Only [{~} Liquified Emeralds]!
Grand Youth#009.dst: 你运气真好，我只剩几瓶了，所以不便宜，但这可是好东西！只要 [{~} 液态绿宝石]！
Grand Youth#009.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#010.src: What? Don't give me that look! This is the real stuff, very valuable and rare! What do ya take me for, some guy who'd sell lake water for a fortune?!
Grand Youth#010.dst: 什么？别那样看我！这可是真货，非常贵重又稀有！你把我当什么了，拿湖水卖天价的家伙吗？！
Grand Youth#010.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#011.src: Agh, agh! Put away the weapon! Put it away! Jeez, buddy! Alright, I admit it, I'm a fraudster! But, I do know where you get the real stuff, I ain't lying about that much.
Grand Youth#011.dst: 啊，啊！把武器收起来！收起来！天哪，老兄！好啦，我承认，我是骗子！不过我确实知道真货从哪里弄，这点我没说谎。
Grand Youth#011.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#012.src: There's this group of mages out in Dernel who know how to get the stuff. They're a bunch of tightwads and wouldn't get give me any real healing water to sell.
Grand Youth#012.dst: Dernel 那边有一群法师知道怎么弄到那东西。他们一个个都是铁公鸡，死活不肯给我真的治愈之水来卖。
Grand Youth#012.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#013.src: I doubt you'll have any better luck with it, but go on, try your luck.
Grand Youth#013.dst: 我看你也不会比我运气好，不过去吧，碰碰运气。
Grand Youth#013.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#014.src: Those tightwad mages are out in Dernel, on the lake with the big island. I doubt you'll convince them to give you any healing water, though.
Grand Youth#014.dst: 那些铁公鸡法师在 Dernel，就在有座大岛的湖上。不过我看你是说服不了他们给你治愈之水的。
Grand Youth#014.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#015.src: Talk to Isfurus in Dernel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Grand Youth#015.dst: 与 Dernel [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Isfurus 对话。

Grand Youth#016.src: Hm, hm...if it really does that, then...oh, is someone there? Erisk?
Grand Youth#016.dst: 嗯，嗯……如果它真的能那样，那……噢，有人在吗？Erisk？
Grand Youth#016.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#017.src: Oh, a tourist. Heard about the healing water, I presume? Well, if you are here to make a quick buck, you can turn right back around from where you came.
Grand Youth#017.dst: 噢，是游客。我猜你是听说了治愈之水吧？好吧，如果你是来赚快钱的，可以原路回去了。
Grand Youth#017.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#018.src: Hm...ah. Iboju's sister settlement...I see. I will trust this is an honest venture, then. The tribesmen are honourable.
Grand Youth#018.dst: 嗯……啊。Iboju 的姐妹聚落……我明白了。那我就相信这是件正当的事。那些部落民是讲道义的。
Grand Youth#018.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#019.src: I will provide you a specially-prepared bottle to hold the water in. My colleague, Erisk, is within the fountain here. He can fill up the bottle for you.
Grand Youth#019.dst: 我会给你一个特制的瓶子来装水。我的同事 Erisk 就在这座喷泉里面，他可以帮你把瓶子装满。
Grand Youth#019.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#020.src: There are a few animals in the fountain, however. They're wild and will most likely attack, but you look well-armoured. I doubt you'll have trouble.
Grand Youth#020.dst: 不过喷泉里有几只动物。它们很野，多半会攻击你，不过你的护甲看起来很好。我想你不会有麻烦的。
Grand Youth#020.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#021.src: The entrance to the heart of the fountain is right below us. Take a deep breath and dive right in.
Grand Youth#021.dst: 通往喷泉核心的入口就在我们正下方。深吸一口气，直接潜下去。
Grand Youth#021.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#022.src: Your directions are in your content book, friend. Always consult it if you are in a bind.
Grand Youth#022.dst: 路线在你的内容书里，朋友。遇到困难时随时查看。
Grand Youth#022.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#023.src: Get the bottles filled by Erisk in the heart of the fountain to give Isfurus.
Grand Youth#023.dst: 在喷泉核心让 Erisk 把瓶子装满，交给 Isfurus。

Grand Youth#024.src: And who might you be? We certainly don't get many visitors down here.
Grand Youth#024.dst: 你是谁？我们这下面可很少有访客。
Grand Youth#024.speaker: Erisk

Grand Youth#025.src: Aha, Isfurus referred you. Yes, let me bottle this up for you, then. Once I do, make sure you don't drop them! Both the bottles and the water are valuable and difficult to replace.
Grand Youth#025.dst: 啊哈，是 Isfurus 介绍你来的。好，那我帮你把这个装瓶。装好之后可千万别摔了！瓶子和水都很贵重，很难再弄到。
Grand Youth#025.speaker: Erisk

Grand Youth#026.src: But what a marvel this place is...water to cure all ailments, even aging! I even hear there is a similar fountain someplace in Gavel, can you believe?
Grand Youth#026.dst: 不过这地方真是奇妙……能治百病的水，连衰老都能治！我甚至听说 Gavel 某处也有一座类似的喷泉，你敢相信吗？
Grand Youth#026.speaker: Erisk

Grand Youth#027.src: Oh, I nearly forgot. Just make sure to check back in with Isfurus before you leave! There is just one more step to the process he has to take care of.
Grand Youth#027.dst: 噢，我差点忘了。离开之前一定要回去找 Isfurus！还有最后一道程序得由他来处理。
Grand Youth#027.speaker: Erisk

Grand Youth#028.src: Just make sure to check back in with Isfurus before you leave!
Grand Youth#028.dst: 离开之前一定要回去找 Isfurus！
Grand Youth#028.speaker: Erisk

Grand Youth#029.dst: 替 Erisk 去跟 Isfurus 对话。

Grand Youth#030.src: Aha. You had no trouble, I assume? Hand the bottle here, I'll finish the seal and remove the impurities...
Grand Youth#030.dst: 啊哈。我猜你没遇到什么麻烦吧？把瓶子给我，我来封好瓶口，去除杂质……
Grand Youth#030.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#031.src: ...done. There is much potential here...ancient tribal markings repeat the word "youth" over and again. It could be used, or abused...
Grand Youth#031.dst: ……好了。这里潜力无穷……古老的部落刻纹一遍又一遍地重复着“青春”这个词。它可以被善用，也可以被滥用……
Grand Youth#031.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#032.src: Anyways, you have your water. Not to be rude, but I must ask that you leave me to my research now. You have your delivery to make anyway, correct?
Grand Youth#032.dst: 总之，你拿到水了。不是我无礼，但现在我得请你让我继续研究了。反正你还要去送货，对吧？
Grand Youth#032.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#033.src: Your directions are in your content book, friend. Always consult it if you are in a bind.
Grand Youth#033.dst: 路线在你的内容书里，朋友。遇到困难时随时查看。
Grand Youth#033.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#034.src: Bring back the bottle of healing water to Monte.
Grand Youth#034.dst: 把那瓶治愈之水带回给 Monte。

Grand Youth#035.src: You have returned, I see. Have you the healing water?
Grand Youth#035.dst: 看来你回来了。治愈之水拿到了吗？
Grand Youth#035.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#036.src: Aha, perfect! If this not work, then...no, I must have faith.
Grand Youth#036.dst: 啊哈，太好了！要是这也不管用，那……不，我必须有信心。
Grand Youth#036.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#037.src: From the bottom of my heart, thank you. I know we surely will not be able to compensate you for the price of the water...
Grand Youth#037.dst: 我打心底里感谢你。我知道我们肯定没办法补偿你买水的钱……
Grand Youth#037.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#038.src: ...but here. This is the summation of our village's riches. For aiding us, consider it yours.
Grand Youth#038.dst: ……不过，给你。这是我们村子全部的财富。你帮了我们，这些就归你了。
Grand Youth#038.speaker: Monte

Green Gloop#000.dst: 与 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Eluzterp 对话

Green Gloop#001.src: Oh, hey! You, adventurer over there! Would you mind helping me?
Green Gloop#001.dst: 噢，嘿！那边的冒险者！能帮我个忙吗？
Green Gloop#001.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#002.src: You see, this cave behind me has been troubling me for the past while now.
Green Gloop#002.dst: 你看，我身后这个洞窟最近一直让我很头疼。
Green Gloop#002.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#003.src: There are special slimes that live in there, and they drop a certain goo that is quite a delicacy when brewed into a drink!
Green Gloop#003.dst: 里面住着一种特别的史莱姆，它们会掉一种黏液，酿成饮料可是难得的美味！
Green Gloop#003.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#004.src: They are called Gooey Slimes, and should be at the very back. A friend of mine drinks the stuff like water, and he refuses to work without it.
Green Gloop#004.dst: 它们叫黏糊史莱姆，应该就在洞窟最里面。我有个朋友把那东西当水喝，没有它就不肯干活。
Green Gloop#004.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#005.src: However, the slimes have gotten stronger about a month ago. I'm unable to retrieve it any more, I've come close to getting killed a few times!
Green Gloop#005.dst: 可是大约一个月前，那些史莱姆变强了。我再也拿不到了，还差点被打死好几次！
Green Gloop#005.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#006.src: You, however, seem much better equipped than I. Hopefully you can do it.
Green Gloop#006.dst: 不过，你的装备看起来比我好多了。希望你能办到。
Green Gloop#006.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#007.src: If you decide to help me, you'll need to obtain a special device for retrieving it, as the slime will dry up quickly in the air.
Green Gloop#007.dst: 如果你决定帮我，就得先弄一个专门用来装黏液的工具，因为黏液在空气里很快就会干掉。
Green Gloop#007.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#008.src: A...less fickle glassblower, Yodbon, can make it for you. He should be living in a house in front of the {p} bank.
Green Gloop#008.dst: 一位……没那么难搞的玻璃匠 Yodbon 能帮你做。他应该住在 {p} 银行前面的一栋房子里。
Green Gloop#008.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#009.src: I'll need [{~} Slimey Goo] since we'll need a big batch of drinks. If you help, I'll be sure to tell my friend, and he'll probably let you into his shop.
Green Gloop#009.dst: 我需要 [{~} 史莱姆黏液]，因为我们要酿一大批饮料。如果你帮忙，我一定会跟我朋友说，他多半会让你进他的店。
Green Gloop#009.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#010.src: Find Yodbon near the {p} Bank at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Green Gloop#010.dst: 在 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 {p} 银行附近找到 Yodbon

Green Gloop#011.src: Welcome to Yodbon's Glass Blowery, what can I do f-
Green Gloop#011.dst: 欢迎光临 Yodbon 玻璃坊，有什么能为您——
Green Gloop#011.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#012.dst: 噢，又是个臭烘烘的冒险者，是吧……
Green Gloop#012.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#013.src: So many've been coming up to me recently, askin' for a bloody Slime Scooper...
Green Gloop#013.dst: 最近好多人跑来找我，要什么该死的史莱姆舀子……
Green Gloop#013.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#014.src: Izzat brother o' mine stopped workin' again? I swear, he's addicted to that slop...
Green Gloop#014.dst: 我那个兄弟又不干活了？我发誓，他对那种糊糊上瘾了……
Green Gloop#014.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#015.src: Anyways, for me to make you a scooper you'll need to get [{~} Soft Sand].
Green Gloop#015.dst: 总之，要我给你做舀子，你得先弄来 [{~} 软沙]。
Green Gloop#015.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#016.src: Come back to me once you've gotten ahold of it. You can dig it up from those sand piles 'round the desert.
Green Gloop#016.dst: 拿到了再回来找我。沙漠一带那些沙堆里就挖得到。
Green Gloop#016.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#017.src: Bring [{~} Soft Sand] from enemies in the desert to Yodbon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Green Gloop#017.dst: 从沙漠里的敌人身上取得 [{~} 软沙]，带给 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Yodbon

Green Gloop#019.src: A'ight, fork 'em over and I'll make you the scooper.
Green Gloop#019.dst: 好嘞，交出来，我给你做舀子。
Green Gloop#019.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#020.src: ..There you go. No idea why he wants that stuff though. Maybe it's an acquired taste...
Green Gloop#020.dst: ..做好了。真不知道他为什么要那种东西。也许是越喝越上瘾吧……
Green Gloop#020.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#021.dst: 不管你要干什么，祝你好运。
Green Gloop#021.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#022.src: Fetch [{~} Slimey Goo] for Eluzterp from the cave at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Green Gloop#022.dst: 从 [{~2}, {~3}, -{~4}] 的洞窟里帮 Eluzterp 取来 [{~1} 史莱姆黏液]

Green Gloop#023.src: Oh, you're back! Good to see you were able to get through there. Have you got a full Slime Scooper?
Green Gloop#023.dst: 噢，你回来了！看到你顺利闯过去真好。史莱姆舀子装满了吗？
Green Gloop#023.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#024.src: Hmm, yes, everything seems to be in order. Perfect!
Green Gloop#024.dst: 嗯，没错，一切都没问题。太好了！
Green Gloop#024.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#025.src: Thank you very much. Finally, I'll be able to get him in gear again... Why are all Villagers so fickle like that?
Green Gloop#025.dst: 非常感谢。终于能让他重新开工了……为什么村民都这么难搞？
Green Gloop#025.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#026.src: Well, I suppose that's beside the point. I'll be sure to let him know you got him his most recent fix.
Green Gloop#026.dst: 好吧，这不是重点。我一定会跟他说，他最近这一口是你帮他弄来的。
Green Gloop#026.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#027.src: He hangs around in a little black stall in the bazaar, there's a basement to it. He should let you inside now.
Green Gloop#027.dst: 他常待在集市里一个黑色的小摊子，摊子底下有个地下室。他现在应该会让你进去了。
Green Gloop#027.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#028.src: And, for your troubles, a little something from me as well.
Green Gloop#028.dst: 还有，辛苦你了，我也有点小东西给你。
Green Gloop#028.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#029.src: Ah, hello again. This latest batch of drinks apparently really revitalized him. He said he's looking to make some great craft.
Green Gloop#029.dst: 啊，又见面了。这批饮料好像真的让他恢复了活力。他说想做点了不起的手工艺品。
Green Gloop#029.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#030.src: Those Villagers are a little bit crazy though... I have no idea what kind of material it is that he insists he needs for it.
Green Gloop#030.dst: 不过那些村民有点疯疯癫癫的……我完全不知道他坚持说需要的是什么材料。
Green Gloop#030.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#031.src: Oh, it's you again. Yes, my brother there just loves makin' his little trinkets. He oughta make somethin' useful out of his glass instead...
Green Gloop#031.dst: 噢，又是你。对，我那个兄弟就爱做他那些小玩意儿。他应该用玻璃做点有用的东西才对……
Green Gloop#031.speaker: Yodbon

Haven Antiquity#000.src: Talk to {p} on the docks at {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Haven Antiquity#001.src: Hey there adventurer, can I speak with you for a second? I need you to do a spot of detective work for me.
Haven Antiquity#001.dst: 嘿，冒险者，能跟你说几句话吗？我需要你帮我做点侦探工作。
Haven Antiquity#001.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#002.src: My grandfather once told me how beautiful this place was, and how to visit here if I wanted to relax.
Haven Antiquity#002.dst: 我祖父曾经跟我说这地方有多美，还说如果我想放松，就来这里走走。
Haven Antiquity#002.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#003.src: But as you can see, this island is the least bit relaxing. It is a sorrowful place, corrupted and dark.
Haven Antiquity#003.dst: 可你也看到了，这座岛一点都不让人放松。这是个悲伤的地方，腐化又阴暗。
Haven Antiquity#003.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#004.src: This can't be right. My grandfather was an honest man, he wouldn't have lied.
Haven Antiquity#004.dst: 这不对劲。我祖父是个诚实的人，他不会说谎的。
Haven Antiquity#004.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#005.src: I figure something must have happened. I really want to know how it got like this.
Haven Antiquity#005.dst: 我想一定是发生了什么事。我真的很想知道这里怎么会变成这样。
Haven Antiquity#005.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#006.src: There's an old creepy man living up on that hill in a big mansion who seems just old enough to know what happened. It might be a good place to start.
Haven Antiquity#006.dst: 山上那栋大宅里住着一个阴森的老头，年纪看起来刚好大到知道发生过什么。那里也许是个好起点。
Haven Antiquity#006.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#007.src: Investigate Old Siwel in the dead Mansion at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Haven Antiquity#007.dst: 调查 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 死寂宅邸里的老 Siwel

Haven Antiquity#008.src: What do you want? I'm busy. Brewing potions takes focus, you know....
Haven Antiquity#008.dst: 你想干什么？我很忙。调制药水需要专注，你知道的……
Haven Antiquity#008.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#009.src: Oh, you want to know about the island's history? Well you certainly came to the right man. I've lived here for a very long time.
Haven Antiquity#009.dst: 噢，你想知道这座岛的历史？那你可真是找对人了。我在这里住了非常久。
Haven Antiquity#009.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#010.src: There is a way for you to see for yourself what happened here. It's quite... an interesting tale, too.
Haven Antiquity#010.dst: 有个办法能让你亲眼看看这里发生了什么。那也是个……相当有意思的故事。
Haven Antiquity#010.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#011.src: I'd sit and tell you, but I think you might get a better experience first hand....
Haven Antiquity#011.dst: 我可以坐下来讲给你听，但我想你亲身经历一次会更好……
Haven Antiquity#011.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#012.src: Using some of the more... frowned upon methods in the alchemists library I am able to send you into the 'memory' of a dead person that lived here at the time.
Haven Antiquity#012.dst: 用炼金术士图书馆里一些……不太被认可的方法，我能把你送进当年住在这里的一个死者的“记忆”里。
Haven Antiquity#012.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#013.src: It will require a little work from you though, if you wish to proceed....
Haven Antiquity#013.dst: 不过，如果你想继续，得先出点力……
Haven Antiquity#013.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#014.src: Bring me [{~} Umbral Essences] and I will be able to cast a spell on you which will allow you to pass into the 'memory' of the deceased.
Haven Antiquity#014.dst: 给我带来 [{~} 暗影精华]，我就能对你施法，让你进入死者的“记忆”。
Haven Antiquity#014.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#015.src: Acquire [{~} Umbral Essences] for Old Siwel
Haven Antiquity#015.dst: 为老 Siwel 取得 [{~} 暗影精华]

Haven Antiquity#016.src: Excellent. You acquired the ingredients. Just give me a second and I'll prepare you for your journey into the mind of the dead.
Haven Antiquity#016.dst: 很好。你拿到材料了。稍等一下，我来为你进入死者心智的旅程做准备。
Haven Antiquity#016.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#017.dst: 喃喃念着一种古怪的、死去的语言……
Haven Antiquity#017.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#018.dst: 喃喃念着一种古怪的、死去的语言..
Haven Antiquity#018.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#019.src: There, look into my eyes. Yes, you're ready. Ah, there is a drawback though....
Haven Antiquity#019.dst: 好了，看着我的眼睛。对，你准备好了。啊，不过有个缺点……
Haven Antiquity#019.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#020.src: Once you are inside the memory, it will feel like you are actually there. You won't be able to return until you have succeeded in your task.
Haven Antiquity#020.dst: 一旦进入记忆，你会觉得自己真的身在其中。在完成任务之前，你回不来。
Haven Antiquity#020.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#021.src: To enter the memory, you need to find the dead man at the end of the crypt in the graveyard.
Haven Antiquity#021.dst: 要进入记忆，你得找到墓地里墓穴尽头的那个死人。
Haven Antiquity#021.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#022.src: The dead roam those caves in heavy numbers, so watch your step.
Haven Antiquity#022.dst: 那些洞里游荡着大量亡灵，走路小心点。
Haven Antiquity#022.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#023.src: Oh and one more thing, If you die in the memory, you die in reality too....
Haven Antiquity#023.dst: 噢，还有一件事，如果你在记忆里死了，现实中也会死……
Haven Antiquity#023.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#025.src: Locate the Crypt under the church at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and pass through a dead man's memory
Haven Antiquity#025.dst: 找到 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 教堂下方的墓穴，穿过死者的记忆

Haven Antiquity#026.src: Investigate Siwel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] on Alive Island
Haven Antiquity#026.dst: 调查活之岛上 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Siwel

Haven Antiquity#027.src: Oh, hello there. Would you mind helping me with something for a second?
Haven Antiquity#027.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#028.src: Recently, some strange things have been happening to the miners around here. New diseases, unexplained disappearances, and things like that.
Haven Antiquity#028.dst: 最近，这一带的矿工身上发生了一些怪事。新的疾病、莫名其妙的失踪之类的。
Haven Antiquity#028.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#029.src: The villagers have been getting very worried. So, in an attempt to protect the island, I bought a strange egg and placed it in a cave close to town.
Haven Antiquity#029.dst: 村民们非常担心。所以，为了保护这座岛，我买了一颗奇怪的蛋，放在镇子附近的一个洞窟里。
Haven Antiquity#029.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#030.src: The egg, however, isn't what I thought it was. It is producing monsters and giving off some sort of dark aura.
Haven Antiquity#030.dst: 可是那颗蛋并不是我以为的东西。它正在制造怪物，还散发着某种黑暗的气息。
Haven Antiquity#030.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#031.src: I want you to go check out that egg. See if you can get rid of whatever it is producing. Bring me [{~} Monster Hides] as evidence.
Haven Antiquity#031.dst: 我想请你去看看那颗蛋。看看你能不能除掉它制造出来的东西。带 [{~} 怪物皮] 回来当证据。
Haven Antiquity#031.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#032.src: Confront the cave under the mansion at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and retrieve [{~} Monster Hides] for Siwel from the monsters within
Haven Antiquity#032.dst: 前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 宅邸下方的洞窟，从里面的怪物身上为 Siwel 取得 [{~} 怪物皮]

Haven Antiquity#033.src: You're back! Were you able to stop that egg?
Haven Antiquity#033.dst: 你回来了！你阻止那颗蛋了吗？
Haven Antiquity#033.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#034.src: No? Well, I guess we'll have to wait and see what it hatches into.
Haven Antiquity#034.dst: 没有？好吧，看来我们只能等着看它会孵出什么了。
Haven Antiquity#034.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#035.src: I see you got some rather rare dark monster hide. Maybe I could use those in a potion for something, maybe to prolong life.
Haven Antiquity#035.dst: 看来你拿到了一些相当稀有的黑暗怪物皮。也许我能拿来做药水，也许能用来延长寿命。
Haven Antiquity#035.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#036.src: Some of the villagers believe that it is unwise for myself to dabble in the dark arts, dealing with mysterious eggs and brewing potions of death.
Haven Antiquity#036.dst: 有些村民认为我不该涉足黑暗之术，摆弄神秘的蛋，调制死亡的药水。
Haven Antiquity#036.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#037.src: I'll outlive them all, you'll see!
Haven Antiquity#037.dst: 我会活得比他们所有人都久，你等着瞧！
Haven Antiquity#037.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#038.src: As for you, you have done what I asked. You may return to your personal affairs now.
Haven Antiquity#038.dst: 至于你，你已经完成了我交代的事。现在可以回去忙你自己的事了。
Haven Antiquity#038.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#039.src: Thank you for your work, though. Only time will tell what that egg will hatch into.
Haven Antiquity#039.dst: 不过还是谢谢你的帮忙。那颗蛋会孵出什么，只有时间才知道。
Haven Antiquity#039.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#040.src: Return to Old Siwel in the dead Mansion at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Haven Antiquity#040.dst: 回到 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 死寂宅邸里的老 Siwel 那里

Haven Antiquity#041.src: What? You... you made it back? Oh... Very well. Alchemy can be a... dangerous practice.
Haven Antiquity#041.dst: 什么？你……你回来了？噢……好吧。炼金术可能是……一门危险的技艺。
Haven Antiquity#041.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#042.src: Anyone who tried to find out the island's history came to me at some point, and I sent them on a one way street to a memory. But not you....
Haven Antiquity#042.dst: 每个想查清这座岛历史的人，最后都来找过我，而我把他们送上了一条通往记忆的不归路。可你没有……
Haven Antiquity#042.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#043.src: So now you know my dreadful secret, I am racked with guilt and cursed with eternal life.
Haven Antiquity#043.dst: 现在你知道我可怕的秘密了，我被愧疚折磨，还被诅咒得永生不死。
Haven Antiquity#043.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#044.src: There is no need to fight me, I am suffering enough for what I... wrought on this island.
Haven Antiquity#044.dst: 你不必跟我打，我为自己……在这座岛上造成的一切，受的苦已经够多了。
Haven Antiquity#044.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#045.src: I could not destroy the egg. It hatched into a... monstrous beast that cursed this island until this very day.
Haven Antiquity#045.dst: 我没能毁掉那颗蛋。它孵出了一头……怪物般的巨兽，诅咒这座岛直到今天。
Haven Antiquity#045.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#046.src: A powerful warrior from... {p} slew the beast, yet the island did not rejuvenate....
Haven Antiquity#046.dst: 一位来自……{p} 的强大战士杀了那头巨兽，可这座岛却没有恢复生机……
Haven Antiquity#046.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#047.src: I leave the bones of the beast as a reminder of my failure, the destruction it brought still... lingers in the monsters it left behind.
Haven Antiquity#047.dst: 我留着那头巨兽的骨头，提醒自己的失败，它带来的毁灭至今……仍残留在它留下的怪物身上。
Haven Antiquity#047.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#048.src: So adventurer, now you have the knowledge of what I have done. You may tell the others down in the village, as it is no longer a secret.
Haven Antiquity#048.dst: 所以，冒险者，现在你知道我做了什么了。你可以告诉下面村子里的其他人，这已经不再是秘密了。
Haven Antiquity#048.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#049.src: Talk to {p} on the docks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] about the mystery
Haven Antiquity#049.dst: 到 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的码头与 {p} 谈谈这个谜团

Haven Antiquity#050.src: So, did you find out what happened?
Haven Antiquity#050.dst: 那么，你查到发生了什么事吗？
Haven Antiquity#050.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#051.src: Siwel was the one who caused this sorrow? He does have a very dark presence about him, doesn't he?
Haven Antiquity#051.dst: 是 Siwel 造成了这一切悲伤？他身上确实散发着很阴暗的气息，是吧？
Haven Antiquity#051.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#052.src: Thank you for your work! I know it must have been tough getting that out of him.
Haven Antiquity#052.dst: 谢谢你的帮忙！我知道从他嘴里问出这些一定很不容易。
Haven Antiquity#052.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#053.src: Now that this mystery is solved I will be returning home. I hope we will meet again!
Haven Antiquity#053.dst: 既然谜团解开了，我也要回家了。希望我们还能再见！
Haven Antiquity#053.speaker: Cinfras

Heart of Llevigar#000.src: Find Zenam in the {p} power control center at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Heart of Llevigar#000.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 {p} 电力控制中心找到 Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#001.src: Aaah, no no no! This doesn't make any sense, what in the world is going on?! Nothing's working!
Heart of Llevigar#001.dst: 啊啊，不不不！这完全说不通，到底是怎么回事？！什么都不能用了！
Heart of Llevigar#001.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#002.src: Gweh, a visitor? Get out of here! The plant is shut down for maintenance- wait, are you the electromagic expert we're paying for?
Heart of Llevigar#002.dst: 呃，有访客？出去！电厂停机检修中——等等，你是我们花钱请的电磁魔法专家吗？
Heart of Llevigar#002.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#003.src: You are, right? Right?! Cause we can't wait any longer! This system was supposed to be unbreakable, a flawless design!
Heart of Llevigar#003.dst: 你是吧？是吧？！因为我们等不下去了！这套系统本来应该坚不可摧，是个完美无缺的设计！
Heart of Llevigar#003.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#004.src: We didn't even need to get Corkian consultation on this, we had this system all figured out ourselves, but now nothing's working right!
Heart of Llevigar#004.dst: 我们甚至不需要找 Corkus 人来咨询，这套系统我们自己全都搞明白了，可现在什么都不对劲！
Heart of Llevigar#004.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#005.src: You're seeing all these sparks and hearing all this crackling? We have no idea what could possibly be going wrong with this! That's why you're needed here!
Heart of Llevigar#005.dst: 你看到这些火花、听到这些噼啪声了吗？我们完全不知道到底出了什么问题！所以才需要你来！
Heart of Llevigar#005.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#006.src: We don't have much time until full meltdown! There is an entrance to the power plant opposite the bank, go there and meet with the Head Engineer!
Heart of Llevigar#006.dst: 离全面熔毁没多少时间了！银行对面有个电厂入口，去那里找总工程师！
Heart of Llevigar#006.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#007.src: Enter the sewers opposite of the bank of {p}.
Heart of Llevigar#007.dst: 进入 {p} 银行对面的下水道。

Heart of Llevigar#008.src: Find the head engineer at the {p} power plant
Heart of Llevigar#008.dst: 在 {p} 电厂找到总工程师

Heart of Llevigar#009.src: Whew, finally Zeman found a guy for the job. I told him weeks ago this was a two-person task...
Heart of Llevigar#009.dst: 呼，Zeman 总算找到人来干这活了。我几个星期前就跟他说过这是两个人的工作……
Heart of Llevigar#009.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#010.src: Wait, it's Zenam? Eh, what does it matter? You knew who I was talkin' about. Lemme give you the lowdown real fast.
Heart of Llevigar#010.dst: 等等，是 Zenam？呃，有什么关系？你知道我在说谁就行。我快速跟你讲一下情况。
Heart of Llevigar#010.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#011.src: About a month ago, there was a big blackout, and the generator here started acting up. Power surges, appliances overloading...heck, some of our lights turned purple!
Heart of Llevigar#011.dst: 大概一个月前，这里大停电，发电机就开始出毛病。电涌、电器过载……见鬼，有些灯还变成紫色了！
Heart of Llevigar#011.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#012.src: My grandfather and his engineers jury-rigged the whole system. A reset should fix all this, but as a security measure, I need to be here to oversee the reset.
Heart of Llevigar#012.dst: 我爷爷和他手下的工程师当年把整套系统临时拼凑了起来。重置一下应该就能解决，不过为了安全起见，我得在这里监督重置过程。
Heart of Llevigar#012.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#013.src: So that's your job- get through the system and find the reset button. These holes'll lead you around the generator rooms. Better get going!
Heart of Llevigar#013.dst: 所以你的工作是——穿过系统，找到重置按钮。这些洞会带你绕着发电机房走。快出发吧！
Heart of Llevigar#013.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#014.src: Try to find a way into the machine

Heart of Llevigar#015.src: Find a way to proceed to the inner parts of the machinery
Heart of Llevigar#015.dst: 想办法前往机器的内部结构

Heart of Llevigar#016.src: Reach the center of the restricted area

Heart of Llevigar#018.src: Report back to the Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#019.src: Alright, that should do it- Ah, you're back. The system reset just fine, like I said. Everything should be winding down now.
Heart of Llevigar#019.dst: 好了，这样应该就行了——啊，你回来了。就像我说的，系统顺利重置了。现在一切都应该慢慢平稳下来了。
Heart of Llevigar#019.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#020.src: It's purging the excess energy now- might have a few more power surges and crackles for a while, but it'll go back to normal soon enough.
Heart of Llevigar#020.dst: 它正在排出多余的能量——可能还会有一阵子电涌和噼啪声，不过很快就会恢复正常。
Heart of Llevigar#020.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#021.src: Hm? What, there was a bug in the system? ...what, are you asleep or something? Of course there was a bug, we just fixed it!
Heart of Llevigar#021.dst: 嗯？什么，系统里有故障？……怎么，你睡着了还是怎样？当然有故障，我们刚修好啊！
Heart of Llevigar#021.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#022.src: Well, anyways, Zebra should have our payment all settled. You go on ahead- I still need to stay down here to make sure everything stays smooth.
Heart of Llevigar#022.dst: 好了，总之，Zebra 应该已经把我们的酬劳准备好了。你先走吧——我还得留在下面确保一切顺利。
Heart of Llevigar#022.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#023.src: ...oh, it's Zenam? D'you really care about getting his name right, or what? Anyways, the exit's through the water cooling system, it hooks up to the sewer exit.
Heart of Llevigar#023.dst: ……噢，是 Zenam？你真的那么在乎把他名字叫对吗？总之，出口要穿过水冷系统，它连着下水道出口。
Heart of Llevigar#023.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#025.src: Whew...welcome back. The power is back online- Everything is running at full capacity again. I think the system is just running excess through right now.
Heart of Llevigar#025.dst: 呼……欢迎回来。电力恢复了——一切又满负荷运转了。我想系统现在只是在排掉多余的能量。
Heart of Llevigar#025.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#026.src: Glad you got here when you did though- some phony came through saying he was the expert. Clearly he was just here to take your contract money...
Heart of Llevigar#026.dst: 还好你来得及时——有个骗子跑来说他是专家。他显然只是想来拿走你的合同酬劳……
Heart of Llevigar#026.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#027.src: Though, I was panicking so much I probably would've believed him... Speaking of which, here's your cut of the pay, and something extra for the trouble.
Heart of Llevigar#027.dst: 不过，我当时慌成那样，大概会信了他……说到这个，这是你那份酬劳，还有一点额外的辛苦费。
Heart of Llevigar#027.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#028.src: Here's to hoping that the system won't run into any more trouble in the future. I don't want to be faced with an impending cataclysm like that again...
Heart of Llevigar#028.dst: 但愿这套系统以后别再出问题。我可不想再面对一次那样迫在眉睫的大灾难了……
Heart of Llevigar#028.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#029.src: Aah, this is bad, where's the keys to my toolbox?! Zenam said it was important, I need to find them!
Heart of Llevigar#029.dst: 啊啊，糟了，我工具箱的钥匙呢？！Zenam 说这件事很重要，我得把它们找出来！
Heart of Llevigar#029.speaker: Electromagic Expert

Heart of Llevigar#030.src: I still can't believe it, a human has done my job and taken my emeralds... Just because I lost my keys...
Heart of Llevigar#030.dst: 我还是不敢相信，一个人类干了我的活，还拿走了我的绿宝石……就因为我把钥匙弄丢了……
Heart of Llevigar#030.speaker: Electromagic Expert

Hollow Serenity#000.src: Something seems off in the abandoned manor at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Hollow Serenity#000.dst: 位于 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的废弃庄园似乎有些不对劲

Hollow Serenity#005.src: Head to the forest village east of the manor at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and ask its residents about a man named Garvan.
Hollow Serenity#005.dst: 前往庄园东边 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的森林村庄，向村民打听一个叫 Garvan 的男人。

Hollow Serenity#006.src: Hello soldier! Welcome to this... hick village. I presume the neighbor's kid has been stealing apples again, hmm?
Hollow Serenity#006.dst: 你好啊士兵！欢迎来到这个……乡下村子。我猜邻居家的小孩又在偷苹果了，嗯？
Hollow Serenity#006.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#007.src: Oh, Ann... Your voice is so delicate, so soothing that- Ah, soldier! Are you here for something... or someone?
Hollow Serenity#007.dst: 噢，Ann……你的声音如此柔美，如此抚慰人心——啊，士兵！你来这里是为了什么事……还是为了什么人？
Hollow Serenity#007.speaker: Qunit

Hollow Serenity#011.src: We're the best couple in the entire forest! Nobody can match our love!
Hollow Serenity#011.dst: 我们是整片森林里最恩爱的一对！没人比得上我们的爱！
Hollow Serenity#011.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#012.src: Do you have someone special to you like we are, human? A handsome little man? Or a pretty little woman? Or... neither? We won't judge.
Hollow Serenity#012.dst: 你也有像我们这样的特别的人吗，人类？一个英俊的小伙子？还是一个漂亮的小姑娘？还是……都不是？我们不会评判的。
Hollow Serenity#012.speaker: Qunit

Hollow Serenity#013.src: Absolutely we're married! Everyone finds it very hard to believe, but I don't blame them! It's a tough would... we... live in, yes!
Hollow Serenity#013.dst: 我们当然结婚了！大家都觉得很难相信，但我不怪他们！我们……生活的……这个世界，很艰难的，是啊！
Hollow Serenity#013.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#014.src: Four years it has been, since we kissed under the starry sky amidst the blossoming fields near {p}. I can still see it in my dreams...
Hollow Serenity#014.dst: 已经四年了，自从我们在 {p} 附近盛开的花田里，在星空下接吻。我在梦里还能看见那一幕……
Hollow Serenity#014.speaker: Qunit

Hollow Serenity#015.src: Yeah, what Qunit said! We've been married for {~} years! And soon that number is gonna go up to infinity!
Hollow Serenity#015.dst: 对，就像 Qunit 说的！我们已经结婚 {~} 年了！而且这个数字很快就会涨到无限！
Hollow Serenity#015.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#017.src: Oh! Sorry about Qunit, he doesn't like thinking about our... circumstances.
Hollow Serenity#017.dst: 噢！Qunit 失礼了，他不喜欢去想我们的……处境。
Hollow Serenity#017.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#018.src: We're in heavy debt to the government. We can't afford to live anywhere else.
Hollow Serenity#018.dst: 我们欠了政府一大笔债。住不起别的地方。
Hollow Serenity#018.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#019.src: This forest is also safe from their prying eyes, which has inarguably caused certain... opinions to fester here...
Hollow Serenity#019.dst: 这片森林也避开了他们的窥探，这无可否认地让某些……想法在这里滋长……
Hollow Serenity#019.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#020.src: Yeah, yeah! It doesn't matter why we're here, soldier! Haha! We're here, and we love each other! That's all that matters. Yes.
Hollow Serenity#020.dst: 对啦，对啦！我们为什么在这里不重要，士兵！哈哈！我们在这里，而且我们彼此相爱！这才是最重要的。是的。
Hollow Serenity#020.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#021.src: Yes, actually. There's something dark to the north. There are parasites in it. It's dangerous.
Hollow Serenity#021.dst: 有的，其实。北边有个黑暗的东西。里面有寄生虫。很危险。
Hollow Serenity#021.speaker: Qunit

Hollow Serenity#022.src: O-oh! Don't worry about what Qunit's saying. He's been having this recurring dream of a big worm creature laying dark eggs inside of a weird cave. He won't let it go, either!
Hollow Serenity#022.dst: 噢、噢！别管 Qunit 说的。他一直反复做一个梦，梦到一只巨大的蠕虫在一个怪洞穴里产下黑色的卵。他就是放不下！
Hollow Serenity#022.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#023.src: It's not a fantasy, Ann. I've told you this.
Hollow Serenity#023.dst: 那不是幻想，Ann。我跟你说过了。
Hollow Serenity#023.speaker: Qunit

Hollow Serenity#024.src: Shh, honey... we'll talk about this later, not in front of the soldier... Who probably has much more important things to do, hah!
Hollow Serenity#024.dst: 嘘，亲爱的……我们晚点再谈这个，别在士兵面前……人家肯定有更重要的事要做，哈！
Hollow Serenity#024.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#027.src: See? We're both on the same wavelength! Neither of us have met this person! We're... so in love, darling...
Hollow Serenity#027.dst: 看吧？我们俩心有灵犀！我们谁都没见过这个人！我们……真是太相爱了，亲爱的……
Hollow Serenity#027.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#029.src: An outsider? Here? We don't get many of you people often...
Hollow Serenity#029.dst: 外人？在这里？你们这种人可不常来……
Hollow Serenity#029.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#031.src: The name's Aunoa. I'm a farmer. Not much else to say.
Hollow Serenity#031.dst: 我叫 Aunoa。是个农夫。没什么别的好说的。
Hollow Serenity#031.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#032.src: I've got a kid, but he doesn't live here. His mother took him away to live in {p} a while back. Don't have any other family.
Hollow Serenity#032.dst: 我有个孩子，但他不住这里。他妈妈前阵子把他带去 {p} 住了。我没有别的家人。
Hollow Serenity#032.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#033.src: This village is the only family I have.
Hollow Serenity#033.dst: 这个村子就是我唯一的家人。
Hollow Serenity#033.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#034.src: It's my home. The people I know and trust live here. It's a dump, but it's still my damn home.
Hollow Serenity#034.dst: 这是我的家。我认识、信任的人都住在这里。这地方是个破烂窝，但它还是我该死的家。
Hollow Serenity#034.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#035.src: Wish I could leave, though. This forest is awful. The crops are in horrible condition. Government doesn't give a damn about us either.
Hollow Serenity#035.dst: 不过我真希望能离开。这片森林糟透了。庄稼长得惨不忍睹。政府也根本不管我们死活。
Hollow Serenity#035.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#036.src: Apparently the House of Talor has a massive crypt somewhere underneath its floors. Rich people used to be buried there.
Hollow Serenity#036.dst: 听说 Talor 宅邸的地板底下有一座巨大的地下墓室。以前有钱人都葬在那里。
Hollow Serenity#036.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#037.src: There's probably some rare artifacts down there. Go take a look if you want, but everyone here has tried and failed to find it.
Hollow Serenity#037.dst: 下面大概有些稀有的古物。想去就去看看吧，不过这里每个人都试过，谁都没找到。
Hollow Serenity#037.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#038.src: Yes, I do. But I probably can't stop you. Humans like you have a thing for invading privacy whenever you feel like it.
Hollow Serenity#038.dst: 对，我介意。但我大概拦不住你。像你这样的人类，想侵犯别人隐私的时候就会侵犯。
Hollow Serenity#038.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#039.src: And I'm too weak to stop you. You've got all of that strong gear on you, and I barely know a lick of magic. We're not on equal footing.
Hollow Serenity#039.dst: 而且我太弱了，拦不住你。你身上穿着那么强的装备，我连一点魔法都不太会。我们根本不对等。
Hollow Serenity#039.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#040.src: So... don't go in, but I won't stop you if you do anyways.
Hollow Serenity#040.dst: 所以……别进去，但你硬要进去我也不会拦你。
Hollow Serenity#040.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#041.src: No clue who that is. If someone like that lived here, then they're dead.
Hollow Serenity#041.dst: 不知道那是谁。如果有这么个人住过这里，那他已经死了。
Hollow Serenity#041.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#042.src: Ask someone else about him if you want; I don't really care about this Garvan guy you're looking for.
Hollow Serenity#042.dst: 想问的话就去问别人吧；你要找的这个 Garvan 我根本不在乎。
Hollow Serenity#042.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#043.src: Hey, you! Got any money? If you give me {~} Liquified Emeralds, I'll give you a spot of dust from the underside of my floorboards!
Hollow Serenity#043.dst: 嘿，你！有钱吗？只要给我 {~} 液态绿宝石，我就给你一撮我地板底下的灰尘！
Hollow Serenity#043.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#046.src: I'm Bip! Yeah, Bip! The greatest guy to ever grace the entertainment industry!
Hollow Serenity#046.dst: 我是 Bip！没错，Bip！娱乐圈有史以来最伟大的人物！
Hollow Serenity#046.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#047.src: Oh... I was... Man, I miss my glory days! I used to be a big time man, you know? I was living it up in {p}, but now I have to live in this dump!
Hollow Serenity#047.dst: 噢……我以前……唉，真怀念我的辉煌岁月！我以前可是个大人物，你知道吗？我在 {p} 风光得很，现在却得住在这个破烂窝！
Hollow Serenity#047.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#048.src: Damn this world! I blame them for all of this! Everything has been nothing but trouble after trouble. Now everyone can't see how much of an honest guy I am!
Hollow Serenity#048.dst: 该死的世界！这一切都怪他们！每件事都是麻烦接着麻烦。现在大家都看不出我是个多老实的人了！
Hollow Serenity#048.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#049.src: B-BE QUIET! I don't like living here, so don't remind me!
Hollow Serenity#049.dst: 闭、闭嘴！我不喜欢住在这里，别提醒我！
Hollow Serenity#049.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#050.src: I don't even truly have my own place! I've gotta live with some crony who owns the house I'm staying in right now.
Hollow Serenity#050.dst: 我连属于自己的地方都没有！我得跟某个跟班住，现在住的房子是他的。
Hollow Serenity#050.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#051.src: One day, I'll get out of here, though! I'll be a big time man again, and I'll reclaim my status in society, just you wait!
Hollow Serenity#051.dst: 不过总有一天，我会离开这里的！我会再当回大人物，重新夺回我的社会地位，你等着瞧！
Hollow Serenity#051.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#052.src: Rumors? Do I look like a gossiper to you??
Hollow Serenity#052.dst: 传闻？我看起来像是爱嚼舌根的人吗？？
Hollow Serenity#052.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#053.src: Well, human... I'm an honest entertainer, so don't worry. Good 'ole Bip will tell you a bit of something!
Hollow Serenity#053.dst: 嗯，人类……我是个老实的艺人，所以放心吧。好老 Bip 会给你讲一点东西！
Hollow Serenity#053.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#054.src: So, apparently there's a WITCH... living in LEXDALE! OOOOOO, spooky...
Hollow Serenity#054.dst: 听说啊，有个女巫……住在 LEXDALE！呜呜呜呜，好吓人……
Hollow Serenity#054.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#055.src: But the thing is, she's causing... the Decay... dun dun DUUUN!!! Uhh... I don't know, her house is decaying, or something.
Hollow Serenity#055.dst: 但问题是，她正在引发……衰败……噔噔噔——！！！呃……我也不知道，她的房子在腐朽还是什么的。
Hollow Serenity#055.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#056.src: So now, she's gonna die. The end! Didja like that story, human? Every relation to in-real life people was {~} intentional, 'cuz this is actually happening.
Hollow Serenity#056.dst: 所以现在，她要死了。完！喜欢这个故事吗，人类？如有雷同，{~} 纯属故意，因为这是真的正在发生的事。
Hollow Serenity#056.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#057.src: Oh yeah! That's the name of the guy who FIRED ME! DAMMIT!!!-
Hollow Serenity#057.dst: 噢对！那就是把我炒鱿鱼的那家伙的名字！该死！！！——
Hollow Serenity#057.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#058.src: ...Oh, wait, no. Sorry human, I was thinking about Gavin. I don't know who this Garvan guy is! Ask someone else; I can't entertain you with that knowledge.
Hollow Serenity#058.dst: ……噢，等等，不对。抱歉人类，我想成 Gavin 了。我不知道这个 Garvan 是谁！去问别人吧；这方面的知识我没法娱乐你。
Hollow Serenity#058.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#066.src: {p} apparently has something hidden inside of it.
Hollow Serenity#066.dst: 听说 {p} 里面藏着什么东西。
Hollow Serenity#066.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#067.src: The chains have something to do with it.
Hollow Serenity#067.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#068.src: I dunno what else to say.
Hollow Serenity#068.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#069.src: ...You know what? Neither do you! You've said, like, {~} sentences in the last {~} minutes!
Hollow Serenity#069.dst: ……你知道吗？你也没说什么啊！你在过去 {~} 分钟里大概只说了 {~} 句话！
Hollow Serenity#069.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#070.src: I just don't like talking, sheesh! My voice gets way more tense if I don't keep my words short. And it hurts.
Hollow Serenity#070.dst: 我就是不喜欢说话，真是的！话一说长，我的嗓子就会绷得很紧。而且会痛。
Hollow Serenity#070.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#071.src: What, are you offended? Well, I am, too! You'd be mad if some random human walked into your village and egged you into damaging your vocal chords!
Hollow Serenity#071.dst: 怎样，你生气了？哼，我也生气！要是有个不认识的人类跑进你的村子，怂恿你伤害自己的声带，你也会火大的！
Hollow Serenity#071.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#073.src: ...You poor soul. Go buy one. Unless you're one of those guys who owns those flying land bits.
Hollow Serenity#073.dst: ……可怜的家伙。去买一间吧。除非你是那种拥有飞天小岛的人。
Hollow Serenity#073.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#075.src: He knows most of the things here.
Hollow Serenity#075.dst: 这里的事他大部分都知道。
Hollow Serenity#075.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#076.src: Huh, weird. Whatcha doing all the way out here, human? We don't see a lot of your kind often.
Hollow Serenity#076.dst: 嗯，奇怪。你跑到这么远的地方来干嘛，人类？我们不常见到你们这种人。
Hollow Serenity#076.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#078.src: My name's Vera. I'm a farmer, but you probably already guessed that. That's all this damn village is good for anyways.
Hollow Serenity#078.dst: 我叫 Vera。是个农夫，不过你大概已经猜到了。反正这个该死的村子也就只有种地这点用处。
Hollow Serenity#078.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#079.src: I also deal with getting supplies from other towns! Pretty cool, huh?
Hollow Serenity#079.dst: 我还负责从别的城镇运补给过来！挺酷的吧？
Hollow Serenity#079.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#080.src: Uhh... all my life, actually! Too damn poor to go anywhere else, so I've just hunkered down here and decided to stick it out until I'm dead.
Hollow Serenity#080.dst: 呃……其实是一辈子！穷得要命，哪都去不了，所以我就窝在这里，打算一直熬到死。
Hollow Serenity#080.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#081.src: It's bad, living out here, but once you get used to it some of the edge is taken off. This village is all I've really known, and I owe it to everyone here to stick around, you know what I mean?
Hollow Serenity#081.dst: 住在这里很苦，但习惯之后就没那么难受了。这个村子差不多是我唯一了解的地方，我欠这里每个人一份情，得留下来，你懂我的意思吧？
Hollow Serenity#081.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#082.src: Still... adventuring sounds like fun, sometimes... The furthest I've ever gone from here is halfway through {p} County.
Hollow Serenity#082.dst: 不过……有时候冒险听起来挺好玩的……我去过最远的地方也就是 {p} 郡的一半。
Hollow Serenity#082.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#083.src: I bet you have some pretty good stories to tell from adventuring, ain't that right human?
Hollow Serenity#083.dst: 我打赌你冒险的时候有不少精彩的故事可讲，对吧人类？
Hollow Serenity#083.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#084.src: You know the massive prison near {p}? Yeah, the {p} Penitentiary.
Hollow Serenity#084.dst: 你知道 {p} 附近那座巨大的监狱吗？对，就是 {p} 监狱。
Hollow Serenity#084.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#085.src: So, apparently... the place is actually really corrupt. They arrest innocent people every other day, and they never come back out.
Hollow Serenity#085.dst: 听说……那地方其实黑幕重重。他们三天两头就抓无辜的人，而且那些人再也没出来过。
Hollow Serenity#085.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#086.src: Gavel's government hasn't done anything about it, but everyone in the forest knows damn well something shady is going on there. I'd watch myself around that place if I were you!
Hollow Serenity#086.dst: Gavel 的政府什么也没做，但森林里每个人都心知肚明那里有见不得人的勾当。换作是我，靠近那地方的时候一定会小心！
Hollow Serenity#086.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#088.src: Get to talking, human! You can't just leave off like that! Tell me, are the rumors about that place true?
Hollow Serenity#088.dst: 快说啊，人类！你不能话说一半就停！告诉我，关于那地方的传闻是真的吗？
Hollow Serenity#088.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#091.src: Oh my word... and you saw it with your own eyes?
Hollow Serenity#091.dst: 我的天……你还亲眼看到了？
Hollow Serenity#091.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#092.src: Human... thanks for letting me know. You gotta tell more people about this, though! You could probably publish a book about it once you spread the word! You'd be rich!
Hollow Serenity#092.dst: 人类……谢谢你告诉我。不过你得告诉更多人才行！等消息传开，你大概还能出本书！你会发财的！
Hollow Serenity#092.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#093.src: ...Well, I'm not gonna believe you if you're saying it all forced like that, you know.
Hollow Serenity#093.dst: ……嗯，你这样说得那么勉强，我可不会相信你，你知道的。
Hollow Serenity#093.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#094.src: I won't push it, though; it was probably just too awful to talk about, right? You don't have to go into detail if you don't wanna.
Hollow Serenity#094.dst: 不过我不会逼你；大概是太可怕了说不出口吧？不想讲细节的话就不用讲。
Hollow Serenity#094.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#095.src: Just stay well away from that place, and make sure nobody else goes near there, alright?
Hollow Serenity#095.dst: 离那地方远远的就对了，也别让其他人靠近，好吗？
Hollow Serenity#095.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#096.src: Uh... no. That doesn't ring a single bell.
Hollow Serenity#096.dst: 呃……没有。一点印象都没有。
Hollow Serenity#096.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#097.src: You could probably ask some other people, though! I'm only the youngest guy in the village, so the older people here would probably know who this Garvan guy is!
Hollow Serenity#097.dst: 不过你可以去问问其他人！我是村里最年轻的，这里年纪大的人可能会知道这个 Garvan 是谁！
Hollow Serenity#097.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#098.src: S-Sheesh! You scared me, human! Don't you know that you shouldn't walk into people's houses out of nowhere?
Hollow Serenity#098.dst: 吓、吓死我了！你吓到我了，人类！你不知道不该突然闯进别人家里吗？
Hollow Serenity#098.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#099.src: You know there are creepy guys out here who rob people like that? You should be more careful!
Hollow Serenity#099.dst: 你知道这附近有专门这样抢劫的怪人吗？你该小心点！
Hollow Serenity#099.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#101.src: I'm nobody. No, I'm serious, I literally don't have a name. Parents just didn't bother to name me.
Hollow Serenity#101.dst: 我谁都不是。不，我是认真的，我真的没有名字。我爸妈就是懒得给我取名。
Hollow Serenity#101.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#102.src: Apparently that's considered sacrilegious around here, so I was taken away from them and I now work for Pastor Arwes.
Hollow Serenity#102.dst: 听说在这里那算是亵渎神明，所以我被从他们身边带走，现在在 Arwes 牧师手下做事。
Hollow Serenity#102.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#103.src: What do the others call me? Uhh... Big-nosed girl. Yeah, I know, a bit on the nose–
Hollow Serenity#103.dst: 其他人叫我什么？呃……大鼻子姑娘。对，我知道，有点一针见血——
Hollow Serenity#103.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#104.src: ...That sailed right over my head. But it's true, though! I have the biggest nose in the village.
Hollow Serenity#104.dst: ……那句我完全没听懂。不过这是真的！我的鼻子是全村最大的。
Hollow Serenity#104.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#105.src: What should you call me? Hm... I don't know... maybe... Eua?
Hollow Serenity#105.dst: 你该叫我什么？嗯……我也不知道……也许……Eua？
Hollow Serenity#105.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#106.src: I know it won't matter anymore, but sure. Call me Eua. That sounds like a nice name.
Hollow Serenity#106.dst: 我知道已经无所谓了，但好吧。叫我 Eua。听起来是个好名字。
Hollow Serenity#106.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#107.src: This one's not necessarily a rumor, but... have you ever heard of someone that they call the Wanderer?
Hollow Serenity#107.dst: 这不算是传闻，不过……你听说过一个被称为流浪者的人吗？
Hollow Serenity#107.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#108.src: He's a weird guy who just... wanders. He's completely despondent, and doesn't really interact with anyone. Even a lot of the dangerous creatures around here just tend to ignore his presence. He's almost like... a ghost.
Hollow Serenity#108.dst: 他是个怪人，就只是……到处游荡。他完全心灰意冷，也不怎么跟人来往。连这附近很多危险的生物都常常无视他的存在。他简直就像……一个幽灵。
Hollow Serenity#108.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#109.src: You've probably seen him before in the forest. Hooded guy, doesn't talk at all? That's who they call the Wanderer.
Hollow Serenity#109.dst: 你在森林里大概见过他。戴着兜帽、一句话都不说的家伙？那就是被称为流浪者的人。
Hollow Serenity#109.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#110.src: Well, he doesn't really hurt anyone, so I don't really worry about him too much, but still... it's spooky...
Hollow Serenity#110.dst: 嗯，他其实没伤害过任何人，所以我不太担心他，但还是……挺吓人的……
Hollow Serenity#110.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#111.src: Wait, THAT manor? Nah. No one goes near there anymore, not since it was abandoned. What, do you not know what happened there?
Hollow Serenity#111.dst: 等等，那座庄园？不。自从它废弃之后就没人靠近那里了。怎么，你不知道那里发生过什么事？
Hollow Serenity#111.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#112.src: It used to be owned by a family of nobles called the Faltachs. Big, important people in the forest, very rich.
Hollow Serenity#112.dst: 那里以前属于一个叫 Faltach 的贵族家族。在森林里是很有地位的大人物，非常有钱。
Hollow Serenity#112.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#113.src: Well... a lot of stuff happened with them. The mistress of the family supposedly went insane and killed her husband at some point, or something like that...
Hollow Serenity#113.dst: 嗯……他们家发生过很多事。据说那家的女主人某天发了疯，杀了她丈夫，大概是那样……
Hollow Serenity#113.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#114.src: There's a lot to unpack there, human. And you honestly shouldn't unpack it.
Hollow Serenity#114.dst: 那里头的事一言难尽，人类。而且说真的，你不该去深究。
Hollow Serenity#114.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#115.src: Hmm... No, can't say I have. Whoever this person is, they certainly don't live here.
Hollow Serenity#115.dst: 嗯……没有，没见过。不管这人是谁，肯定不住在这里。
Hollow Serenity#115.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#116.src: And nah, it's not me, either, even if I don't have a real name. I wouldn't even be here if my parents had named me something manly like Garvan anyways.
Hollow Serenity#116.dst: 而且不，也不是我，就算我没有真名。要是我爸妈给我取个像 Garvan 这么有男子气概的名字，我根本就不会在这里了。
Hollow Serenity#116.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#117.src: Ask around, though! I'm sure others probably know him.
Hollow Serenity#117.dst: 不过去问问看吧！我相信其他人应该认识他。
Hollow Serenity#117.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#118.src: You're new... we don't see a lot of youngsters around these days... especially humans.
Hollow Serenity#118.dst: 你是新面孔……这年头这附近很少见到年轻人了……尤其是人类。
Hollow Serenity#118.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#120.src: Very on the nose, whippersnapper. My name is Lokno. I'm what's left of this town during its olden days...
Hollow Serenity#120.dst: 说得真一针见血，小毛头。我叫 Lokno。这镇子在往昔岁月里留下来的，就剩我了……
Hollow Serenity#120.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#121.src: Mhm. This village... has definitely seen better days. This Decay stuff has ruined us, just take a look around! Nothing here has been suitable for living for over {~} years...
Hollow Serenity#121.dst: 嗯。这个村子……确实见过更好的日子。这衰败把我们毁了，你看看四周就知道！已经超过 {~} 年，这里没有一样东西适合住人……
Hollow Serenity#121.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#122.src: Hah... well, right now, it's a crowd of shacks, but before the Decay came along, we used to do great...
Hollow Serenity#122.dst: 哈……嗯，现在这里是一堆破棚子，但在衰败来之前，我们过得很好……
Hollow Serenity#122.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#123.src: We always had enough food to go around, we could sell off what we didn't need to eat, and everything was thriving.
Hollow Serenity#123.dst: 我们总是有足够的粮食，吃不完的还能卖掉，一切都欣欣向荣。
Hollow Serenity#123.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#124.src: My great-grandmother, Aki, always told me stories about this place. Our little village. I wish I could have been around to live in it then.
Hollow Serenity#124.dst: 我的曾祖母 Aki 总是给我讲这个地方的故事。我们的小村子。真希望我能活在那个时候。
Hollow Serenity#124.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#125.src: She was always convinced though... that if the rightful rulers of Gavel returned, all of these issues could easily be squashed.
Hollow Serenity#125.dst: 不过她一直深信……只要 Gavel 真正的统治者回来，这些问题都能轻易解决。
Hollow Serenity#125.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#126.src: To be honest... I believe the same. The government has abandoned us. So... why not bring back the old one?
Hollow Serenity#126.dst: 老实说……我也这么相信。政府抛弃了我们。那么……为什么不把旧的请回来呢？
Hollow Serenity#126.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#127.src: I may not be the most religious villager around here, but it would feel more right to be ruled by someone who has the heavens' approval.
Hollow Serenity#127.dst: 我也许不是这里最虔诚的村民，但由受上天认可的人来统治，感觉会更对。
Hollow Serenity#127.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#128.src: Nope. I don't deal with that kind of stuff, bahaha! Sorry human; you're out of luck.
Hollow Serenity#128.dst: 没有。我不碰那种东西，哇哈哈！抱歉人类；你运气不好。
Hollow Serenity#128.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#129.src: G... Garvan... yes. I know that name.
Hollow Serenity#129.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#130.src: He isn't here, though. I don't know his whereabouts, what he's doing, or if he's even alive. He's... just nonexistant.
Hollow Serenity#130.dst: 不过他不在这里。我不知道他在哪、在做什么，甚至不知道他是不是还活着。他……就好像不存在。
Hollow Serenity#130.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#131.src: I don't know why you're chasing after him, but... if you want a place to start, look at the abandoned laboratory on top of that hill, just west to the of here.
Hollow Serenity#131.dst: 我不知道你为什么要追查他，不过……如果你想找个地方开始，就去看看这里西边那座山丘上的废弃实验室。
Hollow Serenity#131.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#132.src: Fair warning, though... My great-grandmother is the only reason I know about him, and even then... she was always put off by him, and told me to stay away from him. I'd be wary, if I were you.
Hollow Serenity#132.dst: 不过我先提醒你……我知道他全是因为我的曾祖母，而且就算那样……她一直很讨厌他，叫我离他远一点。换作是我，我会小心。
Hollow Serenity#132.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#133.src: Or don't. He sounds like a nice man. You're strong, as well. I'm sure you'll be fine.
Hollow Serenity#133.dst: 或者别小心。他听起来是个好人。你也很强。我相信你不会有事的。
Hollow Serenity#133.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#134.src: Investigate the contents of the abandoned laboratory at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Hollow Serenity#134.dst: 调查位于 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的废弃实验室里的东西

Hollow Serenity#136.src: Return to the Faltach Manor and find the entrance to the secret study at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hollow Serenity#136.dst: 回到 Faltach 庄园，找到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的秘密书房入口。

Hollow Serenity#137.src: Uncover the secrets of the study.

Hollow Serenity#138.src: Investigate the unlocked room in the study.
Hollow Serenity#138.dst: 调查书房里解锁的房间。

Hollow Serenity#140.src: Dammit, Katarin! I'm not dealing with that loonie anymore! It's been years since I hired that scientist, and he STILL has nothing! If he doesn't find a cure soon, then I'll just get rid of him!
Hollow Serenity#140.dst: 该死，Katarin！我不想再跟那个疯子打交道了！我雇那个科学家已经好几年了，他到现在还是一无所获！要是他再不赶快找到解药，我就把他处理掉！
Hollow Serenity#140.speaker: Yorman

Hollow Serenity#141.src: Y-Yorman, you can't be serious! What we're asking him to do is heavily unresearched, firing him for taking time on that wouldn't be a good idea!
Hollow Serenity#141.dst: Y-Yorman，你不是认真的吧！我们要他做的事几乎没人研究过，因为他花时间就把他赶走，可不是好主意！
Hollow Serenity#141.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#142.src: Woman, have you SEEN the state that cretin is in?? Even if it does take long, he's in no damn shape to deal with it! Now, stop arguing with me, and help me get rid of him-
Hollow Serenity#142.dst: 女人，你看过那个蠢货现在是什么样子吗？？就算真的要花很久，他那副样子也根本应付不了！好了，别跟我争了，帮我把他处理掉——
Hollow Serenity#142.speaker: Yorman

Hollow Serenity#144.src: This is too far, Yorman! Garvan MUST stay! You will do this if you still love me!
Hollow Serenity#144.dst: 这太过分了，Yorman！Garvan 一定得留下！如果你还爱我，你就得这么做！
Hollow Serenity#144.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#145.src: ...Why do you even care so much?? Some lunatic scientist like him isn't good for anybody! We both know that we'd save more time and money by letting him run off!
Hollow Serenity#145.dst: ……你为什么这么在乎他？？像他那种疯科学家对谁都没好处！我们都知道，让他滚蛋能省下更多时间和钱！
Hollow Serenity#145.speaker: Yorman

Hollow Serenity#146.src: I still have faith in him, unlike you! I'll talk to him to see what's going on if I must, but I will NOT tolerate you throwing him out simply because you're too eager for results!
Hollow Serenity#146.dst: 我还信任他，不像你！必要的话我会去跟他谈谈，看看是怎么回事，但我绝不允许你只因为急着要结果就把他扫地出门！
Hollow Serenity#146.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#147.src: Fine. But know this; I will see it to MYSELF that his head is taken off of his shoulders if that man continues to waste my time, understand??
Hollow Serenity#147.dst: 好。但你给我记住；要是那家伙继续浪费我的时间，我会亲自确保他人头落地，懂吗？？
Hollow Serenity#147.speaker: Yorman

Hollow Serenity#148.src: ...I'm leaving to take care of some matters in {p}. Ask one of the maids to make sure that Eileen goes to bed. I'll be back before midnight.
Hollow Serenity#148.dst: ……我要去 {p} 处理些事情。叫一个女仆确保 Eileen 上床睡觉。我午夜前回来。
Hollow Serenity#148.speaker: Yorman

Hollow Serenity#149.src: ...That... was close... I can't have him getting between us anymore.
Hollow Serenity#149.dst: ……刚才……好险……我不能再让他挡在我们之间了。
Hollow Serenity#149.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#150.src: I-I am here, Katarin. You wished to s- speak with me...?
Hollow Serenity#150.dst: 我、我来了，Katarin。你想跟我谈、谈谈……？
Hollow Serenity#150.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#151.src: Yes, love. Yorman is becoming suspicious of you. He thinks you're not making any progress on the cure and wasting his time. Any more of this, and he may attempt to get rid of you.
Hollow Serenity#151.dst: 是的，亲爱的。Yorman 开始怀疑你了。他觉得你在解药上毫无进展，还浪费他的时间。再这样下去，他可能会想办法除掉你。
Hollow Serenity#151.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#152.src: I just wanted to check on you, love. Are... you doing alright? Is your work coming along well?
Hollow Serenity#152.dst: 我只是想来看看你，亲爱的。你……还好吗？你的研究进展顺利吗？
Hollow Serenity#152.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#165.src: F-Fine. I am fine. I appreciate the concern, but... It truly is u-unwarranted. I'm q-quite close to finding a cure to the disease, y-yes.
Hollow Serenity#165.dst: 很、很好。我很好。谢谢关心，但是……真、真的不必。我离找到这种病的解药已经相、相当接近了，是、是的。
Hollow Serenity#165.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#166.src: Ah! That is good to hear. Now then... How are things? We haven't had many chances to catch up recently.
Hollow Serenity#166.dst: 啊！真高兴听你这么说。那么……最近怎么样？我们好久没机会好好聊聊了。
Hollow Serenity#166.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#167.src: ...Wonderful. I've met... many peers. Recently. They give me the strength I need to advance my progress. Now... how is our daughter, Eileen?
Hollow Serenity#167.dst: ……很好。我认识了……很多同伴。最近。他们给了我推进研究所需的力量。那么……我们的女儿 Eileen 怎么样了？
Hollow Serenity#167.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#168.src: She's doing great. She takes a lot after you, actually. Intelligent, beautiful, an inquisitive mind. I just hope this Decay can be dealt with and we don't need to live in fear any longer.
Hollow Serenity#168.dst: 她很好。其实她很像你。聪明、漂亮、好奇心强。我只希望这衰败能被解决，我们不用再活在恐惧里。
Hollow Serenity#168.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#169.src: Wonderful. And... is our eternal bond safe? The gemstone? Has... Yorman found out about it?
Hollow Serenity#169.dst: 很好。还有……我们永恒的羁绊安全吗？那颗宝石？Yorman……发现了吗？
Hollow Serenity#169.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#170.src: Yes, it has stayed hidden. As long as it's kept intact, our souls will stay bound to it. You just need to take care of your little project and we'll ride into the sunset, just like you said, mhm?
Hollow Serenity#170.dst: 安全，一直藏得好好的。只要它完好无损，我们的灵魂就会一直与它相系。你只需要搞定你那个小项目，我们就能一起远走高飞，就像你说的，嗯？
Hollow Serenity#170.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#172.src: We... I will not risk her life for our love. She has a future in {p}, Garvan! She isn't a part of this, and I don't think she-
Hollow Serenity#172.dst: 我们……我不会为了我们的爱拿她的性命冒险。她在 {p} 有大好前程，Garvan！她跟这件事无关，我不认为她——
Hollow Serenity#172.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#173.src: Eileen... She is a shining star in this world. Her noble blood and natural talent makes her something truly special.
Hollow Serenity#173.dst: Eileen……她是这世上一颗闪耀的星星。她高贵的血统和天生的才华让她真正与众不同。
Hollow Serenity#173.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#174.src: Do you realize, Katarin? Our daughter is a gift from the heavens! Once she has matured, she will accomplish things that Gavel has never seen! Bring back the holy and royal that was lost-
Hollow Serenity#174.dst: 你明白吗，Katarin？我们的女儿是上天的恩赐！等她长大，她会成就 Gavel 前所未见的事！让失落的神圣与王权重新归来——
Hollow Serenity#174.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#175.src: ...Forgive me, I-I'm rambling once more. I... must leave now, research calls. Goodbye, my love. Great things will happen, sooner or later.
Hollow Serenity#175.dst: ……原谅我，我、我又在胡言乱语了。我……得走了，研究在召唤我。再见，我的爱人。伟大的事迟早会发生的。
Hollow Serenity#175.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#177.src: Make your way to Garvan's old research outpost at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hollow Serenity#177.dst: 前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Garvan 旧研究前哨。

Hollow Serenity#178.src: Gather as much pieces of evidence as you can in the research outpost.
Hollow Serenity#178.dst: 在研究前哨里尽可能收集证据。

Hollow Serenity#180.src: Ah... N-now you're finally here. I... need you, my darling. We- no... I can cure this Decay with you.
Hollow Serenity#180.dst: 啊……你、你终于来了。我……需要你，我亲爱的。我们——不……我能用你治好这衰败。
Hollow Serenity#180.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#181.src: W-What do you mean...? I-I don't like this... I-I w-wanna go home. It's getting late and mother-
Hollow Serenity#181.dst: 你、你是什么意思……？我、我不喜欢这样……我、我想回家。天快黑了，妈妈她——
Hollow Serenity#181.speaker: Eileen

Hollow Serenity#182.src: Ssshhh... This will only take a moment.
Hollow Serenity#182.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#183.src: W-What is that thing?? M-Mister Garvan, I-I don't understand...
Hollow Serenity#183.dst: 那、那是什么东西？？G、Garvan 先生，我、我不明白……
Hollow Serenity#183.speaker: Eileen

Hollow Serenity#184.src: Hush, my daughter. I-I'm doing this for your s-sake... You'll t-thank me later, once it... g-grows acclimated to you.
Hollow Serenity#184.dst: 安静，我的女儿。我、我这么做是为了你好……等它……适、适应了你，你以、以后会感谢我的。
Hollow Serenity#184.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#186.src: Hello, my love. I-It's... been a while.
Hollow Serenity#186.dst: 你好，我的爱人。好、好久……不见了。
Hollow Serenity#186.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#187.src: You... G-Garvan... Why are you here? And what's happened to Eileen? She has been sick for days!
Hollow Serenity#187.dst: 你……G、Garvan……你怎么在这里？Eileen 到底怎么了？她已经病了好几天了！
Hollow Serenity#187.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#188.src: Mmmm... I... Ha-a-have a bit of a... how should I phrase this... a confession to make.
Hollow Serenity#188.dst: 嗯……我……有、有、有件……该怎么说呢……有件事要坦白。
Hollow Serenity#188.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#189.src: W-Well... I-I've done... I've...done Eileen a great service... she will live forever, just like we do. Thanks to what I have done.
Hollow Serenity#189.dst: 嗯、嗯……我、我为……我为 Eileen 做了件大好事……她会永远活着，就像我们一样。多亏了我做的事。
Hollow Serenity#189.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#190.src: Y-you... Bound her soul?? Garvan, no, I told you she wasn't part of this!! WHY??
Hollow Serenity#190.dst: 你、你……把她的灵魂绑定了？？Garvan，不，我跟你说过她跟这件事无关！！为什么？？
Hollow Serenity#190.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#191.src: No, no no no no. I've done much b-b-better. She has something now. In her brain... Don't worry about the s-sorry state she's in now. The parasite will need time to acclimate to her flesh.
Hollow Serenity#191.dst: 不，不不不不不。我做得好、好、好得多。她现在身上有了某样东西。在她脑子里……别担心她现在这副可怜的样子。寄生虫需要时间适应她的血肉。
Hollow Serenity#191.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#192.src: I-I realized... a cure. My work is done, love... Eileen will be cured. The Decay can be s-stopped. It's wonderful-
Hollow Serenity#192.dst: 我、我领悟了……一种解药。我的研究完成了，亲爱的……Eileen 会被治好。衰败可以被阻、阻止。太美妙了——
Hollow Serenity#192.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#193.src: WHAT DID YOU DO TO MY DAUGHTER?? WHAT IS WRONG WITH YOU??
Hollow Serenity#193.dst: 你对我女儿做了什么？？你到底有什么毛病？？
Hollow Serenity#193.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#194.src: Aaaahhhmmmm... True... I might have stepped out of line. But it's for the best.
Hollow Serenity#194.dst: 啊啊嗯嗯嗯……确实……我可能有点越界了。但这是为了大家好。
Hollow Serenity#194.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#195.src: OUT OF LINE?? This is too far, Garvan! What even happened to you?? You've been acting like this for so, so long! I-I can't take it anymore!
Hollow Serenity#195.dst: 越界？？这太过分了，Garvan！你到底怎么了？？你这个样子已经好久好久了！我、我受不了了！
Hollow Serenity#195.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#196.src: You've changed, Garvan! I-I can't even recognize you anymore!! I'm... I'm DONE! GET OUT! STAY AWAY FROM MY FAMILY!
Hollow Serenity#196.dst: 你变了，Garvan！我、我都认不出你了！！我……我受够了！滚出去！离我的家人远一点！
Hollow Serenity#196.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#197.src: You again... W-What do you want from me this time...? You've... already ruined me.
Hollow Serenity#197.dst: 又是你……你、你这次又想从我这里要什么……？你……已经毁了我。
Hollow Serenity#197.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#198.src: It doesn't matter. You've accomplished what we've planned for, and that is perfect. The girl will grow into a suitale leader... Now then, we have some questions for you.
Hollow Serenity#198.dst: 那不重要。你完成了我们计划的事，这就再好不过了。那女孩会成长为合格的领袖……那么，我们有些问题要问你。
Hollow Serenity#198.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#199.src: Tell me Garvan... Where is the heir?
Hollow Serenity#199.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#200.src: I... will not tell you. I have lost Eileen and my love thanks to you. If I am to lose her... then you shall lose her as well.
Hollow Serenity#200.dst: 我……不会告诉你。因为你们，我失去了 Eileen 和我的爱人。如果我注定要失去她……那你们也休想得到她。
Hollow Serenity#200.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#201.src: ...Lunatic. You; take him in. Keep him alive.
Hollow Serenity#201.dst: ……疯子。你；把他带走。留他一条命。
Hollow Serenity#201.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#203.src: Garvan. Garvan, Garvan. I think there's a misunderstanding here. You are in no place to defy us.
Hollow Serenity#203.dst: Garvan。Garvan 啊 Garvan。我想这里有点误会。你没有资格违抗我们。
Hollow Serenity#203.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#204.src: Now then... You will tell us where the rightful heir to the throne is... No matter the cost.
Hollow Serenity#204.dst: 那么……你会告诉我们王位的正统继承人在哪里……不惜任何代价。
Hollow Serenity#204.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#205.src: Return to the Manor and search for any clues as to Eileen's whereabouts at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hollow Serenity#205.dst: 回到位于 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的庄园，寻找任何关于 Eileen 下落的线索。

Hollow Serenity#206.src: It seems you've arrived. F-Forgive me... I-I'm not quite used to talking anymore. It's been quite a while.
Hollow Serenity#206.dst: 看来你来了。原、原谅我……我、我已经不太习惯说话了。已经很久了。

Hollow Serenity#207.src: ...Nevermind. I d-don't want your forgiveness in particular. In fact, w-why do you even care? The forest has died, generations have lived on... and yet... You just had to tear the scar open, didn't you?
Hollow Serenity#207.dst: ……算了。我、我不需要你的原谅。说真的，你、你为什么要在乎？森林已经死了，世世代代都过去了……然而……你偏偏要把伤疤撕开，是吧？

Hollow Serenity#208.src: My sins... You do not need to see them... all the things I've done wrong. H-How I destroyed the bonds tying me and my love together.
Hollow Serenity#208.dst: 我的罪孽……你不需要看见……我做错的所有事。我、我是如何毁掉了我与爱人之间的羁绊。

Hollow Serenity#209.src: ...Y-Yes... I mean her. Katarin. She's watching us as we speak, no? A-and with that, I suppose it's obvious what lies under this veil.
Hollow Serenity#209.dst: ……是、是的……我说的是她。Katarin。我们说话的时候，她正看着我们，不是吗？那、那么，我想这面纱底下是什么已经很明显了。

Hollow Serenity#210.src: Greetings... I-I'm s-sure you're well acquainted with me, by now. I-It was me all along. Quite the- well, it was a predictable twist, I suppose...
Hollow Serenity#210.dst: 你好……我、我相信你现、现在已经很了解我了。一、一直都是我。真是个——嗯，我想这转折挺好猜的……
Hollow Serenity#210.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#211.src: ...B-But... I take it you don't have the full story. So... so so so so so so... Let me explain to you, human... The bitter end to our shared tale.
Hollow Serenity#211.dst: ……但、但是……我猜你还不知道完整的故事。那么……那么那么那么那么那么……让我告诉你吧，人类……我们共同故事的苦涩结局。
Hollow Serenity#211.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#212.src: AAAAAAAGGGHHH!!!! F-FINE! I-I'll tell you... I-I'll tell y-you where Eileen is...
Hollow Serenity#212.dst: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！好、好！我、我告诉你……我、我告诉你 Eileen 在哪……
Hollow Serenity#212.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#213.src: S-She... is with her mother. At the Faltach Manor. T-That is all. Just s-stop...
Hollow Serenity#213.dst: 她、她……跟她妈妈在一起。在 Faltach 庄园。就、就这些。快、快住手……
Hollow Serenity#213.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#214.src: ...Good. This had better not be a lie. You; tell the others that we are heading there now. Kill everyone at the manor and any witnesses; leave the heir alive.
Hollow Serenity#214.dst: ……很好。最好不是谎话。你；通知其他人我们现在就过去。杀光庄园里所有人和目击者；留继承人活口。
Hollow Serenity#214.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#216.src: N-NO! GET BACK HERE! DON'T YOU DARE HARM THEM! I'LL KILL YOU!! DO YOU HEAR ME???
Hollow Serenity#216.dst: 不、不！给我回来！你敢伤害她们！我会杀了你！！听到没有？？？
Hollow Serenity#216.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#217.src: ...M-Mother... why d-do I have to stay here?
Hollow Serenity#217.dst: ……妈、妈妈……我为、为什么要待在这里？
Hollow Serenity#217.speaker: Eileen

Hollow Serenity#218.src: It's for your own good dear. Now, remember to stay put. Garvan won't be able to use you if you're kept inside of here...
Hollow Serenity#218.dst: 这是为你好，亲爱的。记住，乖乖待着别动。只要你待在这里面，Garvan 就没办法利用你……
Hollow Serenity#218.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#220.src: Yorman won't be bothering us anymore, sweetheart. He wouldn't understand, so... J- just don't worry about what happened to him. It's irrelevant-
Hollow Serenity#220.dst: Yorman 不会再来烦我们了，宝贝。他不会明白的，所以……别、别去想他怎么了。那不重要——
Hollow Serenity#220.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#221.src: L-LADY KATARIN! T-THERE ARE INTRUDERS- AAAAAAHHHHHH!!!
Hollow Serenity#221.dst: K-Katarin 夫人！有、有入侵者——啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！
Hollow Serenity#221.speaker: Servant

Hollow Serenity#223.src: Step aside, Katarin Faltach. This will be much simpler if you just stand down and tell us where your daughter is.
Hollow Serenity#223.dst: 让开，Katarin·Faltach。只要你乖乖退下，告诉我们你女儿在哪，事情会简单得多。
Hollow Serenity#223.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#224.src: ...Come again? No. YOU WON'T TOUCH HER! GET OUT OF MY SIGHT-
Hollow Serenity#224.dst: ……你说什么？不。你休想碰她！给我滚——
Hollow Serenity#224.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#225.src: You're not the one making demands here... You all, search the house and find the child.
Hollow Serenity#225.dst: 这里轮不到你提要求……你们，搜查整栋房子，把孩子找出来。
Hollow Serenity#225.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#226.src: There she is. Hmm... it seems that the parasite injection worked well. Garvan wasn't so useless after all.
Hollow Serenity#226.dst: 她在那里。嗯……看来寄生虫注射很成功。Garvan 终究不是那么没用。
Hollow Serenity#226.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#227.src: Oh? Too terrified to speak? Worry not, Eileen Faltach. You won't be harmed... too much. You're quite important to us, you see.
Hollow Serenity#227.dst: 噢？吓得说不出话了？别担心，Eileen·Faltach。你不会受伤的……不会伤得太重。你看，你对我们来说相当重要。
Hollow Serenity#227.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#228.src: N-NO! STAY AWAY FROM MY DAUGHTER!
Hollow Serenity#228.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#229.src: You have little choice in the matter, Miss Faltach. Stand your ground.
Hollow Serenity#229.dst: 这件事由不得你，Faltach 小姐。守住阵地。
Hollow Serenity#229.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#230.src: GET AWAY FROM HER, DO YOU HEAR ME??? RAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAGGGGGGGGHHHHHH!!!!
Hollow Serenity#230.dst: 离她远一点，听到没有？？？啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！
Hollow Serenity#230.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#231.src: Tch... Some people will never understand what we do for the world. Thank you for protecting us from her, Aki.
Hollow Serenity#231.dst: 啧……有些人永远不会明白我们为这个世界做了什么。谢谢你帮我们挡住她，Aki。
Hollow Serenity#231.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#232.src: I will deal with the heir myself. You all can head back to our village. Thank you for your help today.
Hollow Serenity#232.dst: 继承人我亲自处理。你们都可以回我们的村子了。谢谢你们今天的帮忙。
Hollow Serenity#232.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#233.src: ...I should have known. I-I... my love... y-you're gone.
Hollow Serenity#233.dst: ……我早该知道的。我、我……我的爱人……你、你走了。
Hollow Serenity#233.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#234.src: DAMN IT! DAMN IT DAMN IT DAMN IT AAAAALLLL!!!!
Hollow Serenity#234.dst: 该死！该死该死该死全都该死！！！！
Hollow Serenity#234.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#235.src: This is... W-why did this have to happen? ...I-I can't... this can't end like this...
Hollow Serenity#235.dst: 这……为、为什么会变成这样？……我、我不能……不能就这样结束……
Hollow Serenity#235.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#236.src: T-This will be enough. You have a wonderful grave, m-my love...
Hollow Serenity#236.dst: 这、这样就够了。你的坟墓很美，我、我的爱人……
Hollow Serenity#236.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#237.src: W-We won't be separated, though. I-I will leave our true selves here, as well.
Hollow Serenity#237.dst: 不过我、我们不会分开的。我、我也会把我们真正的自我留在这里。
Hollow Serenity#237.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#239.src: T-This is our final act of love, K-Katarin... This stone will keep us here. Eternal, and in bliss.
Hollow Serenity#239.dst: 这、这是我们最后的爱之举，K-Katarin……这块宝石会把我们留在这里。永恒，而且幸福。
Hollow Serenity#239.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#240.src: I-It's like nothing ever h-happened, right?
Hollow Serenity#240.dst: 就、就好像什么都没发、发生过，对吧？
Hollow Serenity#240.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#241.dst: 但现在这一切要改变了。
Hollow Serenity#241.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#242.src: N-Now you understand. T-this is... all my fault. I have ruined everything. E-everything I touched, I destroyed.
Hollow Serenity#242.dst: 现、现在你明白了。这、这……全都是我的错。我毁了一切。我、我碰过的每样东西，都被我毁了。
Hollow Serenity#242.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#243.src: Have I not repented enough? Have I not suffered enough for decades in this god-forsaken forest?? And why did you have to-
Hollow Serenity#243.dst: 我忏悔得还不够吗？我在这被神遗弃的森林里受了几十年的苦还不够吗？？而你为什么偏偏要——
Hollow Serenity#243.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#244.src: No... You know too much. B-But I can't kill, not again. I-I can make things right. I-I'm going to fix this. I'm going to fix this. I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to...
Hollow Serenity#244.dst: 不……你知道得太多了。但、但我不能杀人，不能再杀了。我、我可以弥补。我、我要把这一切修正。我要把这一切修正。我要我要我要我要我要……
Hollow Serenity#244.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#245.src: I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to-
Hollow Serenity#245.dst: 我要我要我要我要我要我要我要我要我要我要我要我要我要我要我要我要我要我要——
Hollow Serenity#245.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#247.src: Get to the Master Bedroom at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Hollow Serenity#248.src: K-Katarin! My l-love... is that you?
Hollow Serenity#248.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#249.src: My word... I-It is you! I missed you, love... and I'm s-so sorry... for all of this!
Hollow Serenity#249.dst: 我的天……真、真的是你！我好想你，亲爱的……我好、好抱歉……为了这一切！
Hollow Serenity#249.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#250.src: I realize n-now, thanks to this h-human's efforts. What I've done has t-torn us apart... I hurt you and our l-little girl so much...
Hollow Serenity#250.dst: 多、多亏了这个人类的努力，我现、现在明白了。我所做的事把我、我们拆散了……我深深伤害了你和我们的小、小女儿……
Hollow Serenity#250.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#251.src: I-I'm so sorry, Katarin! P-Please, forgive me! Let us f-fix all of thi-
Hollow Serenity#251.dst: 我、我真的很抱歉，Katarin！求、求你，原谅我！让我们一起弥补这一、一切——
Hollow Serenity#251.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#255.src: What... What do you mean?? Speak, my love! I don't understand.
Hollow Serenity#255.dst: 什么……你是什么意思？？说话啊，我的爱人！我不明白。
Hollow Serenity#255.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#256.src: ...Forgiveness...? You... beg for me... to forgive... you?
Hollow Serenity#256.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#257.src: I... Yes, yes! P-Please, my love! I-I know I've have spent the last century and a half running away from u-us, but...
Hollow Serenity#257.dst: 我……是的，是的！求、求你，我的爱人！我、我知道过去一个半世纪我一直在逃避我、我们，但是……
Hollow Serenity#257.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#258.src: It was all my fault, from the beginning! I was wrong! W-We can fix this...! We can make everything go back to normal, j-just like it was before!
Hollow Serenity#258.dst: 从一开始就全是我的错！是我错了！我、我们可以弥补……！我们可以让一切回到正轨，就、就像以前一样！
Hollow Serenity#258.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#259.src: Please, Katarin! A-all I ask is that you forgive me!
Hollow Serenity#259.dst: 求你了，Katarin！我、我只求你原谅我！
Hollow Serenity#259.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#260.src: ...You... You must really have a deathwish-
