Hollow Serenity#260.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#261.src: ...Maybe I can... Forgive this. But I need something from you, as well...
Hollow Serenity#261.dst: ……也许我可以……原谅这件事。但我也需要你给我一样东西……
Hollow Serenity#261.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#262.src: ...Where is the gemstone? I'd... I'd like to know. And then... I could... forgive... this.
Hollow Serenity#262.dst: ……宝石在哪里？我……我想知道。然后……我就能……原谅……这件事。
Hollow Serenity#262.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#263.src: O-Oh! Is that all? Of course, my love, I can tell you!
Hollow Serenity#263.dst: 噢、噢！就这样？当然，我的爱人，我可以告诉你！
Hollow Serenity#263.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#264.src: I-I placed it in the catacombs, right next to where-
Hollow Serenity#264.dst: 我、我把它放在地下墓穴里，就在——旁边
Hollow Serenity#264.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#265.src: W-What... W-WHAT I-IS THISS?? I-I C-CAN'T B-BREATHE! P-PLEASE!!
Hollow Serenity#265.dst: 这、这……这、这是什么？？我、我没、没法呼吸！求、求你！！
Hollow Serenity#265.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#266.src: NO!! NO, NO NO NO NO. HUMAN, H-HELP ME!! KATARIN... K-KATARIIIIINNNNN!!!!
Hollow Serenity#266.dst: 不！！不，不不不不不。人类，救、救我！！KATARIN……K-KATARIIIIINNNNN！！！！
Hollow Serenity#266.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#270.src: Head to the Manor's catacombs at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hollow Serenity#270.dst: 前往位于 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的庄园地下墓穴。

Hollow Serenity#272.src: TELL ME WHERE IT IS, GARVAN! I KNOW YOU'RE STILL LISTENING!
Hollow Serenity#272.dst: 告诉我它在哪里，Garvan！我知道你还在听！
Hollow Serenity#272.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#273.src: You knew where it was- Hmm... what did Garvan call you things...?
Hollow Serenity#273.dst: 你知道它在哪——嗯……Garvan 管你们这种东西叫什么来着……？
Hollow Serenity#273.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#274.src: Right, a human. You knew... that it was just beneath this rubble?
Hollow Serenity#274.dst: 对，人类。你早就知道……它就在这堆瓦砾底下？
Hollow Serenity#274.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#275.src: There it is... Thank you... Now this eternal hell will finally end. After so long...
Hollow Serenity#275.dst: 在那里……谢谢你……这永恒的地狱终于要结束了。过了这么久……
Hollow Serenity#275.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#276.src: Do you hear that? It's the ocean waves... The heavens... They're calling for me-
Hollow Serenity#276.dst: 你听到了吗？是海浪声……天堂……在呼唤我——
Hollow Serenity#276.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#280.src: He's gone... All of this will finally be done...
Hollow Serenity#280.dst: 他走了……这一切终于要结束了……
Hollow Serenity#280.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#281.src: Thank you, stranger. Thank you for... everything.
Hollow Serenity#281.dst: 谢谢你，陌生人。谢谢你做的……一切。
Hollow Serenity#281.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#282.src: Now I'm... finally free. But... I suppose I still have unfinished business. Before I leave, I must know something.
Hollow Serenity#282.dst: 现在我……终于自由了。但是……我想我还有未了的心愿。离开之前，我必须知道一件事。
Hollow Serenity#282.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#283.src: ...What has become of my daughter, Eileen? Has she suffered any more? Or did she escape?
Hollow Serenity#283.dst: ……我的女儿 Eileen 后来怎么样了？她还受过更多苦吗？还是她逃掉了？
Hollow Serenity#283.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#284.src: I must know. Is she okay?
Hollow Serenity#284.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#285.src: ...I see. That is... wonderful news. Thank you, human.
Hollow Serenity#285.dst: ……原来如此。那真是……好消息。谢谢你，人类。
Hollow Serenity#285.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#286.dst: 我必须……离开了……那份痛苦……
Hollow Serenity#286.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#287.src: ...The pain is receding... The heavens are calling... for the final time...
Hollow Serenity#287.dst: ……痛苦正在消退……天堂在呼唤……最后一次……
Hollow Serenity#287.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#288.src: Goodbye... Thank you human, from the bottom of my heart.
Hollow Serenity#288.dst: 再见了……谢谢你，人类，发自我的内心。
Hollow Serenity#288.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#292.src: NO NO NO NO NO NO NO NOOOOO!!!!!!
Hollow Serenity#292.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#293.src: TRAITOR!! I WILL MAKE YOU ALL SUFFFEEERRRR!!! (In High Gavellian)
Hollow Serenity#293.dst: 叛徒！！我要让你们全都受尽折磨！！！(高等 Gavel 语)
Hollow Serenity#293.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#294.src: Bury Garvan's body in Katarin's incomplete grave.
Hollow Serenity#294.dst: 把 Garvan 的尸体埋进 Katarin 未完成的坟墓。

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#000.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#001.src: Oh, ho ho. What is this? A Human? What brings you to Gylia Watch - want to let your hair down a bit, I bet!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#001.dst: 噢，呵呵呵。这是什么？人类？什么风把你吹到 Gylia 守望队来了——我打赌是想来放松一下吧！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#001.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#001.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#002.src: Of course you know who we are! The Gylia Watch was founded over {~} years ago in wake of the Villager victory in the war.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#002.dst: 你当然知道我们是谁！Gylia 守望队是在村民打赢那场战争之后成立的，已经有 {~} 多年了。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#002.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#002.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#003.src: The Gerten war! Only the most famous war in all of modern Gavel! The might of the Villagers crushed those blasted Gerts - not that they were particularly hard to beat, heh.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#003.dst: Gert 战争！现代 Gavel 最有名的战争！村民的力量把那些该死的 Gert 族打得落花流水——倒也不是说他们有多难打，嘿。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#003.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#003.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#004.src: Gerts are stupid brutes, you see. The only thing they ever think about is food.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#004.dst: 你看，Gert 族都是些愚蠢的蛮子。他们脑子里除了吃什么都没有。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#004.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#004.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#005.src: Get too close to one and it'll chomp your fingers off, quick as you like. And then the rest of you as well!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#005.dst: 离他们太近，他们眨眼间就会把你的手指咬掉。然后把你整个人也吃了！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#005.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#005.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#006.src: The peace treaty keeps them inside their borders, and we get a delivery of supplies every month from {p} to send over to them.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#006.dst: 和平条约让他们待在自己的边界内，我们每个月会从 {p} 收到一批补给，再转送给他们。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#006.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#006.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#007.src: Of course, we have to keep some of the supplies for ourselves - you've seen how hard these men are working, they deserve a bit of a party!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#007.dst: 当然，我们得留一些补给给自己——你也看到这些人工作多辛苦了，他们值得开个派对！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#007.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#007.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#008.src: The Watch keeps a lookout over the Gerten borders day and night... well, maybe not on poker nights!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#008.dst: 守望队日夜监视着 Gert 的边界……嗯，打扑克的晚上可能不算！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#008.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#008.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#009.src: Although... we have heard a couple of nasty rumors floating about - farmers disappearing from their houses and the such.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#009.dst: 不过……我们确实听到了一些不太好的传闻——农夫从家里失踪之类的。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#009.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#009.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#010.src: If I really can't tempt you with a glass of wine and a round of poker, maybe you could go and check them out for us?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#010.dst: 如果一杯葡萄酒加一局扑克真的打动不了你，也许你可以帮我们去查查看？
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#010.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#010.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#011.src: I'd send the men, but... well, I'd feel bad if one of them went and missed all the partying!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#011.dst: 我是可以派手下去，可是……嗯，要是他们哪个错过了派对，我会过意不去的！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#011.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#011.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#012.src: Here, you should head over and talk to Jitak, they're one of the farmers that lodged a complaint. Their house is west of here, I'll write down the co-ordinates.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#012.dst: 来，你该去找 Jitak 谈谈，他们是提出投诉的农夫之一。他们家在这里西边，我把坐标写给你。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#012.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#012.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#013.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#014.src: If you are looking for a suit or something, I can't help you. Now is a very bad time.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#014.dst: 如果你是来找西装之类的，我帮不了你。现在很不是时候。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#014.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#014.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#015.src: Oh, you're here on behalf of the Watch? Ha, even sending Humans to do their work is not beneath them.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#015.dst: 噢，你是替守望队来的？哈，他们连派人类来替他们干活都做得出来。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#015.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#015.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#016.src: All they do is sit up in that tower playing drinking games and act like they own this region!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#016.dst: 他们就只会坐在那座塔上玩喝酒游戏，还表现得好像这片地区是他们的！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#016.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#016.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#017.src: I reported the fact there is clearly a Gert camp right in front of my house and they just ignored me! Now look, my pigs are all gone!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#017.dst: 我报告说我家门前明明就有个 Gert 营地，他们却不理我！现在你看，我的猪全没了！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#017.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#017.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#018.src: I knew it was a mistake getting this property so close to gerten borders. See, gerts aren't the 'brutes' people insist, but...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#018.dst: 我就知道把房子买在离 Gert 边界这么近的地方是个错误。你看，Gert 族并不像大家说的是“蛮子”，但是……
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#018.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#018.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#019.src: Well, they'll eat anything! Animals, fish, monsters, villagers, even humans! Biologically, they're just constantly hungry.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#019.dst: 嗯，他们什么都吃！动物、鱼、怪物、村民，连人类都吃！从生物学上来说，他们就是一直在饿。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#019.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#019.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#020.src: The watch is meant to keep them behind their borders...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#020.dst: 守望队本该把他们挡在边界里面……
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#020.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#020.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#021.src: I even bought a golem to watch over them - Got it for a good price because of some incident down at the {p} factory.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#021.dst: 我甚至买了一台魔像来盯着他们——因为 {p} 工厂出了些事故，买得挺便宜的。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#021.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#021.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#022.src: But somehow the gerts are managing to avoid it! Look, if you're here from the watch, could you help me out?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#022.dst: 可 Gert 族不知怎么就是能避开它！听着，如果你是守望队派来的，能帮帮我吗？
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#022.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#022.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#023.src: Go to the gert camp west of here and find out how they are doing all of this!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#023.dst: 去这里西边的 Gert 营地，查出他们是怎么做到这一切的！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#023.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#023.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#024.src: Inspect the Gerten Forwarding Camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#024.dst: 调查 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Gert 前哨营地。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#024.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#025.src: Investigate the cave in the back of the camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#025.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#026.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#027.src: -Good job to all of you! I am proud to say we made the cave road very well.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#027.dst: ——大家都干得好！我很骄傲地说，我们把洞穴路挖得很好。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#027.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#027.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#028.src: The town folk at Gylia steal the stuff meant for us for their party, and leave us high and dry!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#028.dst: Gylia 的镇民拿走给我们的东西去开派对，让我们什么都拿不到！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#028.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#028.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#029.src: But those dumb over fed town folk did not catch us when we dug our cave road right under their watch house.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#029.dst: 可是那些吃太饱的笨镇民，没发现我们就在他们的守望屋底下挖了洞穴路。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#029.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#029.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.src: With our new way to get to Gylia land we have more stuff than ever!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.dst: 有了去 Gylia 地盘的新路，我们的东西比以前都多！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#031.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#032.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#033.src: Human! You're back... and haven't been eaten by a Gert!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#033.dst: 人类！你回来了……而且没被 Gert 吃掉！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#033.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#033.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#034.src: What did you discover in the camp?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#034.dst: 你在营地里发现了什么？
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#034.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#034.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#035.src: A tunnel?! Past Gerten borders? That must be how they're managing to get in and steal my livestock.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#035.dst: 隧道？！穿过 Gert 边界？他们一定就是这样溜进来偷我的牲畜的。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#035.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#035.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.src: Look, human. The Watch aren't gonna do anything about this. Please... maybe you can help me.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.dst: 听着，人类。守望队是不会管这件事的。拜托……也许你能帮我。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.src: If you can disguise yourself as a Gert maybe you could sneak into their main camp and check out this tunnel?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.dst: 如果你能伪装成 Gert，也许就能偷偷溜进他们的主营地，查查这条隧道？
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.src: Okay! As you can see, all Gerts wear a carved pumpkin on their head - something to do with their culture.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.dst: 好！你也看到了，所有 Gert 头上都戴着雕刻过的南瓜——跟他们的文化有关。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.src: There's a pumpkin farm near here at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]... maybe you could get one from there?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.dst: 这附近 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 有个南瓜田……也许你可以从那里弄一个？
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#040.src: Go to the gerten pumpkin farm at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#040.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#041.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#041.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#042.src: Oh good, were you sent here to be my lunch?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#042.dst: 噢太好了，你是被派来当我午饭的吗？
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#042.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#042.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#043.src: Are you here to be my lunch?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#043.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#043.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#044.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#044.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#045.src: Oh. What are you then, some kind of snack?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#045.dst: 噢。那你是什么，某种点心吗？
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#045.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#045.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#046.src: ... Is that a joke? What are you, some kind of snack?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#046.dst: ……那是在开玩笑吗？你是什么，某种点心吗？
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#046.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#046.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#047.src: A who.. man? Oh, you mean new folk! All the way here in gerten lands? I have not seen one of you here.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#047.dst: 一个人……类？噢，你是说新来的人！大老远跑到 Gert 的地盘来？我在这里还没见过你们这种人。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#047.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#047.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#048.src: I do want to know how you taste...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#048.dst: 我真的很想知道你是什么味道……
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#048.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#048.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#049.src: Doing? I am here to guard the orange gourd farm, of course!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#049.dst: 在做什么？我当然是在这里看守橙色葫芦田啊！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#049.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#049.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#050.src: This farm right here is where all the gerts get their day mask from!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#050.dst: 所有 Gert 的白天面具都是从这片田里来的！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#050.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#050.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#051.src: No, new folk. Gerts only in this farm.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#051.dst: 不行，新来的人。这片田只让 Gert 进。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#051.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#051.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#052.src: That is why I am put here. To make sure no one gets in.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#052.dst: 所以才派我在这里。确保没有人进去。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#052.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#052.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#053.src: But but I get so bored... and I really want to eat...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#053.dst: 可是可是我好无聊……而且我真的好想吃东西……
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#053.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#053.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#054.src: Like, with the clear green rocks?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#054.dst: 像是，那种透明的绿石头？
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#054.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#054.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#055.src: No new folk, gerts do not have any need for green rocks. But...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#055.dst: 不要，新来的人，Gert 不需要绿石头。可是……
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#055.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#055.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#056.src: How about this - I will just eat you!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#056.dst: 不如这样——我直接把你吃了！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#056.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#056.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#057.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#057.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#058.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#058.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#059.src: Well, I think I will still eat you. Just how it is!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#059.dst: 嗯，我想我还是要吃你。就是这样！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#059.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#059.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#060.src: Oh, it is a thing gerts have been doing for as long as we know.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#060.dst: 噢，那是 Gert 从我们记得的时候就一直在做的事。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#060.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#060.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#061.src: At wake time each day a gert takes an orange gourd and eats into it a shape that shows their mood!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#061.dst: 每天起床的时候，Gert 会拿一个橙色葫芦，在上面咬出代表自己心情的形状！
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#061.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#061.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#062.src: It is really nice, is it not?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#062.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#062.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#063.src: We all want to eat all the time!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#063.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#063.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#064.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#064.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#065.src: Oh... goodbye. Come back soon? With some food?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#065.dst: 噢……再见。快点回来好吗？带点吃的？
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#065.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#065.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#066.src: Find a way to distract the Gert Guard with some food nearby.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#066.dst: 在附近找些食物引开 Gert 守卫的注意。
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#066.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#067.src: Oh man, a red tree fruit! I should not leave my post... but I want to eat...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#067.dst: 噢天啊，红色的树果！我不该离开岗位……可是我想吃……
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#067.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#067.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#068.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#041.src: And no shot I'm leaving today! We are having our daily game night tonight!
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#041.dst: 而且我今天绝对不走！我们今晚有每天一次的游戏之夜！
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#041.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#041.speaker: Bory

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#042.src: Yes. Indeed. Meaning, I'm very busy.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#042.dst: 是的。没错。也就是说，我很忙。
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#042.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#042.speaker: Bory

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#043.src: Every day is a party here. But you. Are. Not. Invited!
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#043.dst: 这里每天都是派对。但是你。不。受。邀！
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#043.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#043.speaker: Bory

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#044.src: We here at the Gylia Watch are ready to give up our lives!
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#044.dst: 我们 Gylia 哨站随时准备献出生命！
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#044.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#044.speaker: Bory

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#045.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#045.speaker: Bory

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#046.src: Now, if you'll excuse me, I have business to attend to.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#046.dst: 好了，失陪了，我还有事要忙。
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#046.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#046.speaker: Bory

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#047.src: I'm just patrolling. Someone has to look at the mountains for signs of an ambush.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#047.dst: 我只是在巡逻。总得有人盯着山那边，看有没有埋伏的迹象。
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#047.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#047.speaker: Bory

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#048.src: Well... even though I doubt Gerts can climb...
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#048.dst: 嗯……虽然我很怀疑 Gert 会爬山……
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#048.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#048.speaker: Bory

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#049.src: The details aren't that important. I am doing my job, anyway.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#049.dst: 细节不重要。反正我在尽忠职守。
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#049.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#049.speaker: Bory

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#055.src: It is our duty to protect the public from the Gerts!
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#055.dst: 保护民众不受 Gert 伤害是我们的职责！
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#055.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#055.speaker: Bory

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#056.src: If what you are saying is true, we need to stay here!
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#056.dst: 如果你说的是真的，我们更得留在这里！
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#056.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#056.speaker: Bory

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#057.src: I don’t even think anyone would miss the Gerts they were to die, hah!
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#057.dst: 我觉得就算 Gert 都死光了，也没人会想念他们，哈！
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#057.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#057.speaker: Bory

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#058.src: I can never say no to a snack!
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#058.dst: 零食我可从来拒绝不了！
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#058.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#058.speaker: Bory

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#059.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#059.speaker: Bory

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#060.src: Ooh! It sounds like you've prepared a whole feast out there!
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#060.dst: 哦！听起来你在外面准备了一整桌大餐！

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#068.src: Return to the Gylia Watch at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and check if everyone is safe.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#068.dst: 回到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Gylia 哨站，确认大家是否安全。
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#068.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#069.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#069.speaker: Winie

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#070.src: Good job on emptying the tower. I explained the situation to the {p} Military and they followed me here.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#070.dst: 塔里的人都撤空了，干得好。我向 {p} 军队说明了情况，他们跟着我来了。
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#070.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#070.speaker: Winie

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#071.src: Good thing you came to us. There is something wrong with this place because I swear... everyone seems to go coockoo.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#071.dst: 还好你来找我们了。这地方肯定有问题，因为我敢发誓……每个人好像都变得疯疯癫癫的。
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#071.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#071.speaker: Cinfras Military

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#072.src: Either way. Due to the workers breaking the treaty we have no choice but to charge them for their crimes and fire them on the spot.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#072.dst: 不管怎样。由于这里的员工违反了条约，我们别无选择，只能控告他们的罪行，并当场开除。
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#072.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#072.speaker: Cinfras Military

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#073.src: Us three have been put in place as a replacement until further notice.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#073.dst: 在另行通知之前，由我们三个人接替他们。
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#073.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#073.speaker: Winie

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#074.src: We will also return the stolen food to the Gerts, and hopefully calm them down.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#074.dst: 我们也会把偷来的食物还给 Gert，希望能让他们平静下来。
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#074.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#074.speaker: Winie

Hunger of the Gerts Part II#075.src: Your job is finished here, Wynnian. Thank you on behalf of {p}.
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#075.dst: 你在这里的工作结束了，Wynn 人。我代表 {p} 感谢你。
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#075.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part II
Hunger of the Gerts Part II#075.speaker: Winie

Ice Nations#000.src: Talk to Adigard on the {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Ice Nations#000.dst: 与 {p} [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Adigard 对话

Ice Nations#001.src: Welcome traveler, to our humble island...
Ice Nations#001.dst: 欢迎你，旅人，来到我们简陋的小岛……
Ice Nations#001.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#002.src: My people and I landed here many years ago. Unfortunately, our ship didn't make it...
Ice Nations#002.dst: 很多年前，我和我的族人在这里登陆。不幸的是，我们的船没能撑住……
Ice Nations#002.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#003.src: We tried to build a nation on these islands but became divided through the years.
Ice Nations#003.dst: 我们试着在这些岛上建立一个国家，但这些年来渐渐分裂了。
Ice Nations#003.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#004.src: Because of this, we are fighting a useless war with our neighbours.
Ice Nations#004.dst: 正因如此，我们正在跟邻居打一场毫无意义的战争。
Ice Nations#004.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#005.src: I believe we should try to pass a peace treaty, but I am afraid of getting killed if I leave the island...
Ice Nations#005.dst: 我认为我们应该试着签订和平条约，可是我怕一离开这座岛就会被杀……
Ice Nations#005.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#006.src: Would you mind helping us? Talk to Hallfred about this treaty. He lives on another ice island nearby.
Ice Nations#006.dst: 你愿意帮帮我们吗？去跟 Hallfred 谈谈这份条约。他住在附近的另一座冰岛上。
Ice Nations#006.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#007.src: Talk to Hallfred about the peace treaty
Ice Nations#007.dst: 与 Hallfred 谈谈和平条约

Ice Nations#008.src: Welcome traveler! What brings you to our island?
Ice Nations#008.dst: 欢迎你，旅人！是什么风把你吹到我们岛上来的？
Ice Nations#008.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#009.src: Oh, I see that Adigard now sends strangers through his cowardice! Worried he'll get killed?
Ice Nations#009.dst: 噢，原来 Adigard 胆小到派陌生人来了！怕被杀吗？
Ice Nations#009.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#010.src: This is the last time I'll repeat it: We will sign the peace treaty the day Adigard and his nation will return to us... the treasure.
Ice Nations#010.dst: 这是我最后一次重复：Adigard 和他的国家把东西还给我们的那一天，我们就签和平条约……那份宝藏。
Ice Nations#010.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#011.src: The one that they kept and hid from us after the shipwreck.
Ice Nations#011.dst: 就是沉船之后他们留下来、瞒着我们藏起来的那份。
Ice Nations#011.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#012.src: Pure gold, very valuable and rare! Tell him I'll be waiting for it. And none of that silly story again.
Ice Nations#012.dst: 纯金的，非常贵重又稀有！告诉他我等着。别再跟我讲那套可笑的故事了。
Ice Nations#012.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#013.src: Talk back to Adigard about Hallfred's response
Ice Nations#013.dst: 回去把 Hallfred 的答复告诉 Adigard

Ice Nations#014.src: I should have expected that. Hallfred was always very greedy...
Ice Nations#014.dst: 我早该料到的。Hallfred 一向很贪心……
Ice Nations#014.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#015.src: We tried to make him understand that we do not have the treasure, without much success.
Ice Nations#015.dst: 我们试过让他明白宝藏不在我们手上，可是没什么用。
Ice Nations#015.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#016.src: ... You see, the reason why we became shipwrecked wasn't natural cause. We were attacked...
Ice Nations#016.dst: ……你知道吗，我们会沉船并不是天灾。我们是被袭击了……
Ice Nations#016.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#017.src: By whom? The undead. Ghosts and demons navigating a monstrous ship. They got us by surprise.
Ice Nations#017.dst: 被谁？亡灵。驾驶着一艘怪物般巨船的幽灵和恶魔。他们打了我们个措手不及。
Ice Nations#017.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#018.src: I believe they also stole our treasure during the attack.
Ice Nations#018.dst: 我相信宝藏也是他们在袭击时偷走的。
Ice Nations#018.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#019.src: Would you help our nation come back together? Find this ship, and bring the treasure back to Hallfred so we can finally live in peace.
Ice Nations#019.dst: 你愿意帮我们的国家重新团结起来吗？找到那艘船，把宝藏带给 Hallfred，让我们终于能和平生活。
Ice Nations#019.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#020.src: Sail north. That is where they attacked us many years ago. It should be easy to find, I'm sure they are anchored there in glory... Thank you.
Ice Nations#020.dst: 往北航行。多年前他们就是在那里袭击我们的。应该很好找，我敢肯定他们正耀武扬威地停泊在那里……谢谢你。
Ice Nations#020.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#021.src: Find the ghost ship and bring back [Ancient Treasure] to Hallfred
Ice Nations#021.dst: 找到幽灵船，把 [古代宝藏] 带回给 Hallfred

Ice Nations#022.src: Incredible! He actually delivered the treasure!
Ice Nations#022.dst: 难以置信！他真的把宝藏送来了！
Ice Nations#022.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#023.src: I suppose that means the end of the war between our nations!
Ice Nations#023.dst: 我想这意味着我们两国之间的战争结束了！
Ice Nations#023.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#024.src: This is a great day! Here, take this as a reward for helping our nation.
Ice Nations#024.dst: 今天真是个好日子！来，收下这个，当作你帮助我们国家的奖励。
Ice Nations#024.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#025.src: I'm sure you'll find a use for this helmet one day!
Ice Nations#025.dst: 我相信总有一天你会用得上这顶头盔！
Ice Nations#025.speaker: Hallfred

Infested Plants#003.src: Meet up with Tasim at the entrance to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Infested Plants#003.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 {p} 入口与 Tasim 会合。

Infested Plants#004.src: Oh, {u}! There you are. It's good to see you. Are you ready to continue on towards {p}?
Infested Plants#004.dst: 噢，{u}！你来了。见到你真好。准备好继续往 {p} 出发了吗？
Infested Plants#004.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#006.src: H-hey! You two! You're soldiers, right? I can tell from your weird fashion sense. You folk are supposed to help people! So. Help!
Infested Plants#006.dst: 嘿、嘿！你们两个！你们是士兵吧？看你们那奇怪的穿搭就知道。你们这些人应该帮助别人的！所以。救命！

Infested Plants#007.src: Huh? Oh- yes, of course! What's your name? What do you need help with?
Infested Plants#007.dst: 嗯？噢——当然，当然！你叫什么名字？需要什么帮助？
Infested Plants#007.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#008.src: I'm Ope! I was recently... uh... bit by a spider! And now I need your help to get a rare medicinal herb to heal me!
Infested Plants#008.dst: 我是 Ope！我最近……呃……被蜘蛛咬了！现在需要你们帮我弄一种稀有的草药来治伤！
Infested Plants#008.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#009.src: It only grows in an infested cave filled with creepy crawlies. And I'm clearly in no condition to go get it myself!
Infested Plants#009.dst: 它只长在一个爬满了虫子的洞窟里。而我这状况显然没法自己去拿！
Infested Plants#009.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#010.src: Well, alright! We're here to help, after all, so... We'll get you that herb!
Infested Plants#010.dst: 好吧，没问题！毕竟我们就是来帮忙的，所以……我们会帮你拿到草药！
Infested Plants#010.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#012.src: Follow Ope to the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#014.src: Hm... There's two of you. Good! One of your can climb up into that cave, and the other can protect me from the crawly spiders down here!
Infested Plants#014.dst: 嗯……你们有两个人。很好！一个人爬进洞窟，另一个在下面保护我不被蜘蛛咬！
Infested Plants#014.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#015.src: Alright! {u}, you can go into the cave, and I can defend Ope here while you do that.
Infested Plants#015.dst: 好！{u}，你进洞窟，我在这里保护 Ope。
Infested Plants#015.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#017.src: Locate the medicine in the spider cave behind Ope at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Infested Plants#017.dst: 在 Ope 身后 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的蜘蛛洞里找到草药。

Infested Plants#018.src: Exit the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with the medicinal herb.

Infested Plants#019.src: There you are! It feels like we've been waiting for hours.
Infested Plants#019.dst: 你来了！感觉我们等了好几个小时。
Infested Plants#019.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#020.src: It... really hasn't been that long. Maybe ten minutes at most.
Infested Plants#020.dst: 这……真的没那么久。顶多十分钟吧。
Infested Plants#020.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#021.src: Well-... Anyway! Do you have the herb? It's very- uh, important! To cure me. Yep.
Infested Plants#021.dst: 嗯——……总之！草药拿到了吗？它非常——呃，重要！能治好我。对。
Infested Plants#021.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#023.src: Oh. I seem to be out of emeralds. Well- I can, uh, offer some advice! There's lots to find in this forest. Plenty of caves with valuables to explore! Might be worth your time.
Infested Plants#023.dst: 噢。我好像没有绿宝石了。那——我可以，呃，给点建议！这片森林里有很多东西可以找。有很多藏着宝物的洞窟可以探索！也许值得你们花点时间。
Infested Plants#023.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#025.src: It has been a time, soldiers, but I truly must be going! We're near {p}, you should stop on by! Just keep going east down the main road! Go and speak to the mayor! He can cover my expenses!
Infested Plants#025.dst: 跟你们相处很愉快，士兵们，但我真的得走了！我们离 {p} 很近，你们应该去逛逛！沿着大路一直往东走就到了！去找镇长谈谈！他能替我付钱！
Infested Plants#025.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#028.src: That's... frustrating. He seemed shady from the start, I should have-... Well. What's done is done. Let's go speak to that mayor.
Infested Plants#028.dst: 这……真让人窝火。他从一开始就很可疑，我早该——……算了。事已至此。我们去找那个镇长吧。
Infested Plants#028.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#029.src: Speak to Mayor Alvin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Infested Plants#029.dst: 与 {p} [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Alvin 镇长交谈。

Infested Plants#030.src: Ah, travelers... welcome to our humble forest town. Have you come to stay, or are you simply passing through?
Infested Plants#030.dst: 啊，旅人们……欢迎来到我们简朴的森林小镇。你们是来住下的，还是只是路过？
Infested Plants#030.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#031.src: Probably the latter. Though, we ran into a man named Ope, who directed us to speak with you.
Infested Plants#031.dst: 大概是后者吧。不过，我们遇到一个叫 Ope 的人，是他叫我们来找您的。
Infested Plants#031.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#032.src: Oh, Ope... I take it your meeting with him went poorly? I must apologize for him, he is... a tough man to deal with.
Infested Plants#032.dst: 噢，Ope……看来你们跟他打交道不太愉快吧？我得替他向你们道歉，他是个……很难应付的人。
Infested Plants#032.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#033.src: Here, I may offer you a small sum of emeralds as an apology. I hope he has not soured your opinion of our small town, here...
Infested Plants#033.dst: 来，我可以给你们一小笔绿宝石当作赔礼。希望他没让你们对我们这个小镇印象变差……
Infested Plants#033.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#034.src: Oh... Thank you. That's very kind of you. We'll probably stay for a while, before we continue towards {p}.
Infested Plants#034.dst: 噢……谢谢您。您真好心。我们大概会在这里待一阵子，再继续往 {p} 出发。
Infested Plants#034.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#035.src: Then feel free to make yourselves at home! We welcome all travelers here, no matter how long their stay is.
Infested Plants#035.dst: 那就请把这里当自己家吧！不管待多久，我们都欢迎所有旅人。
Infested Plants#035.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#036.src: Oh, {u}! There you are. It's good to see you. I'd say we should keep heading towards {p}, but...
Infested Plants#036.dst: 哦，{u}！你在这儿。见到你真好。按理说我们应该继续往 {p} 走，但是……

Infested Plants#037.src: It looks like we'll need to pass through the {p} first. I've heard the forest is crawling with spiders... and the undead are a danger, as always... but between you and me, we should be-
Infested Plants#037.dst: 看来我们得先穿过 {p}。听说那片森林里到处都是蜘蛛……亡灵也一如往常地危险……不过就我们俩来说，应该——

Infested Plants#038.src: H-hey! You two! You're soldiers, right?
Infested Plants#038.dst: 喂、喂！你们俩！你们是士兵吧？

Infested Plants#040.src: Yep, I could tell from your weird fashion sense! You folk are supposed to help people, right? So. Help!
Infested Plants#040.dst: 果然，看你们那奇怪的打扮就知道！你们这些人应该帮助别人，对吧？那就。帮帮我！

Infested Plants#041.src: Well, sure- but who are you? Why are you out on your own, isn't it dangerous? Aren't the undead...
Infested Plants#041.dst: 嗯，当然——不过你是谁？为什么一个人在外面，不危险吗？亡灵不是……

Infested Plants#042.src: I'm Ope! And the undead... eh, there's not as many of them around here. The spiders aren't picky 'bout who they go for.
Infested Plants#042.dst: 我是 Ope！至于亡灵……嗯，这一带没那么多。倒是蜘蛛不挑对象，逮谁咬谁。

Infested Plants#043.src: Right... okay. That makes sense. What did you need help with?
Infested Plants#043.dst: 这样啊……好吧。说得通。你需要帮什么忙？

Infested Plants#044.src: I... uh... so, there's this rare medicinal herb that grows in these woods, right? And it's important. But the only place I know to find it is an infested cave, filled with creepy crawly spiders.
Infested Plants#044.dst: 我……呃……是这样，这片树林里长着一种稀有的药草，对吧？它很重要。可我知道的唯一产地是个被占据的洞穴，里面爬满了吓人的蜘蛛。

Infested Plants#045.src: And, y'know, I- I'm no soldier! Can't just go in there and get it myself! So, I was hoping you could help me out.
Infested Plants#045.dst: 而且，你知道，我、我又不是士兵！总不能自己进去拿吧！所以我希望你们能帮帮我。

Infested Plants#046.src: Well... we came to Wynn to help out, after all. So... we can get you that herb!
Infested Plants#046.dst: 嗯……毕竟我们来 Wynn 就是为了帮忙。所以……那株药草我们帮你拿！

Infested Plants#047.src: Great. Great! I'll bring you to the cave, and you can do the rest from there. Follow me!
Infested Plants#047.dst: 太好了。太好了！我带你们到洞口，剩下的就交给你们。跟我来！

Infested Plants#048.src: Well, here we are! That's the cave right over there- just climb up the rocks and jump into it. It's safe! Uh, probably.
Infested Plants#048.dst: 好，到了！洞口就在那边——爬上岩石跳进去就行。很安全的！呃，大概吧。

Infested Plants#049.src: ...eek. There's a lot of spiders even up here... hey, since there's two of you- one of you can go get the herb, and the other can, uh... protect me from the crawly spiders?
Infested Plants#049.dst: ……哎呀。连这上面都有好多蜘蛛……喂，既然你们有两个人——一个去拿药草，另一个就，呃……保护我不被蜘蛛咬？

Infested Plants#050.src: That works for me. {u}, you go into the cave, and I'll defend Ope up here while you do that.
Infested Plants#050.dst: 我没意见。{u}，你进洞里去，我在上面保护 Ope。

Infested Plants#051.src: Yep... good! Good, good! Good, uh, luck up there! Try not to get bitten too much by the spiders!
Infested Plants#051.dst: 好……很好！好，好！呃，祝你好运！尽量别被蜘蛛咬太多口！

Infested Plants#052.src: ...ah- there you are!! What took you so long, it feels like we've been waiting for hours!
Infested Plants#052.dst: ……啊——你出来了！！怎么这么久，感觉我们等了好几个小时！

Infested Plants#053.src: It-... mm. A-anyway! Do you have the herb? It's very important, yep.
Infested Plants#053.dst: 那个——……嗯。总、总之！药草拿到了吗？它很重要，没错。

Infested Plants#054.src: Come to think of it... I don't think you ever mentioned what you needed it for.
Infested Plants#054.dst: 说起来……你好像从来没说过你要它做什么。

Infested Plants#055.src: Oh, I- eheh, it... I... uh, it's n-none of your business, actually.
Infested Plants#055.dst: 哦，我——嘿嘿，那个……我……呃，其实这、这不关你们的事。

Infested Plants#056.src: I- I thank you kindly for your work, soldiers! Now, about your payment... let's see, what do I have...
Infested Plants#056.dst: 我、我衷心感谢你们的帮助，士兵们！那么，关于报酬……我看看，我身上有什么……

Infested Plants#057.src: Oh. I seem to be out of emeralds. Well- then, I- I can offer some advice! There's lots to find in this forest. Plenty of other caves with valuables to explore! Might be worth your time!
Infested Plants#057.dst: 哦。我好像没有绿宝石了。那——那我、我可以给你们一些建议！这片森林里有很多东西可找。还有很多藏着宝物的洞穴等你们探索！说不定值得跑一趟！

Infested Plants#058.src: Wait, what? Hey, are you seriously not going to-
Infested Plants#058.dst: 等等，什么？喂，你该不会真的不打算——

Infested Plants#059.src: It has been a time soldiers, but I- I truly must be going! Important things to get to! We're near {p}, you should stop on by! Just keep going east down the main road!
Infested Plants#059.dst: 和你们相处很愉快，士兵们，但我、我真的得走了！还有要紧事要办！这里离 {p} 不远，你们可以顺路去看看！沿着大路一直往东走就到了！

Infested Plants#060.src: You can, uh, go speak to the mayor! He can cover my expenses!
Infested Plants#060.dst: 你们可以，呃，去找镇长！我的开销让他来付！

Infested Plants#062.src: That's... frustrating. I really did just want to know... well. What's done is done. Let's just go talk to that mayor he mentioned.
Infested Plants#062.dst: 真是……让人窝火。我只是真的想知道而已……算了。事已至此。我们就去找他说的那位镇长吧。

Infested Plants#063.src: I'm going to go on ahead. I'll meet you in {p}, it's just down the main road to the east.
Infested Plants#063.dst: 我先走一步。我们在 {p} 碰头，沿着大路往东走就到了。

Infested Plants#064.src: Ah, recruits... welcome to our humble forest town. Have you come to stay, or are you simply passing through?
Infested Plants#064.dst: 啊，新兵们……欢迎来到我们这座简朴的森林小镇。你们是来住下的，还是只是路过？

Infested Plants#065.src: Just passing through, our destination is {p}. Though... we ran into a man named Ope, who directed us to speak with you.
Infested Plants#065.dst: 只是路过，我们的目的地是 {p}。不过……我们遇到了一个叫 Ope 的人，他让我们来找您。

Infested Plants#066.src: Oh, Ope... I take it your meeting with him went poorly? I must apologize for him, he is... a tough man to deal with sometimes.
Infested Plants#066.dst: 哦，Ope 啊……看来你们和他打交道不太愉快？我得替他道个歉，他这个人……有时候确实不好对付。

Infested Plants#067.src: Oh... thank you. That's very kind of you. We'll probably stay a while, before we continue towards {p}.
Infested Plants#067.dst: 哦……谢谢。您真是太好了。我们大概会待一阵子，再继续前往 {p}。

Infested Plants#068.src: Then feel free to make yourselves at home! We welcome all travelers here, no matter how long their stay.
Infested Plants#068.dst: 那就请把这里当自己家吧！无论待多久，我们都欢迎所有旅人。

Jungle Fever#000.src: Talk to Worid in the jungle village at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Jungle Fever#000.dst: 与 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 丛林村落里的 Worid 对话

Jungle Fever#001.src: Oh, I am so happy to see you! *cough*, I caught a very bad fever, and I really need help! *cough*
Jungle Fever#001.dst: 噢，见到你真是太高兴了！*咳咳*，我发了很严重的高烧，真的需要帮忙！*咳咳*
Jungle Fever#001.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#002.src: The only cure against this fever is to drink Liquid Emeralds! Yes, exactly! *cough*
Jungle Fever#002.dst: 治这种烧唯一的办法就是喝液态绿宝石！对，没错！*咳咳*
Jungle Fever#002.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#003.src: Do you think you could ask the Banker at {p} if he could give me, oh I don't know, [{~} Liquified Emeralds]?
Jungle Fever#003.dst: 你能不能去问问 {p} 的银行家，看他能不能给我，噢我也不知道，[{~} 液态绿宝石]？
Jungle Fever#003.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#004.src: If he has the audacity to *cough* say no... you will have to use brute force...
Jungle Fever#004.dst: 如果他胆敢 *咳咳* 拒绝……你就只好用蛮力了……
Jungle Fever#004.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#005.src: Break into *cough* to the emerald storage, but don't take anything... come back to me immediately after, if you make it out alive, heheh...
Jungle Fever#005.dst: 闯进 *咳咳* 绿宝石仓库，但什么都别拿……如果你能活着出来，马上回来找我，嘿嘿……
Jungle Fever#005.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#007.src: Talk to {p}'s Banker about the cure for Worid at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Jungle Fever#007.dst: 向 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 {p} 银行家询问 Worid 的解药

Jungle Fever#008.src: [{~} Liquified Emeralds]? He is crazy! Liquified Emeralds cannot cure anyone from anything, except being poor!
Jungle Fever#008.dst: [{~} 液态绿宝石]？他疯了！液态绿宝石什么病都治不了，除了穷病！
Jungle Fever#008.speaker: The Banker

Jungle Fever#009.src: I will not participate in this pathetic fraud attempt!
Jungle Fever#009.dst: 我才不会参与这种可悲的诈骗！
Jungle Fever#009.speaker: The Banker

Jungle Fever#011.src: Oh no! How will I ever cure my sickness without any Liquified Emeralds?... *cough*
Jungle Fever#011.dst: 噢不！没有液态绿宝石，我的病要怎么治啊？……*咳咳*
Jungle Fever#011.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#012.src: We'll have to change our strategy, we won't ask for permission. It's to help me after all.
Jungle Fever#012.dst: 我们得改变策略，不去征求许可了。反正是为了帮我嘛。
Jungle Fever#012.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#013.src: First, I need to make sure you can easily break into a bank. Try to enter {p}' Secret Stash.
Jungle Fever#013.dst: 首先，我得确认你能轻松闯进银行。试着进入 {p} 的秘密藏库。
Jungle Fever#013.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#014.src: When you're done, talk to me again. Be careful too, they might have some Guards.
Jungle Fever#014.dst: 办完了再来找我。小心点，他们可能有守卫。
Jungle Fever#014.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#016.src: What? You're here already. I thought you would take too long so I just went myself.
Jungle Fever#016.dst: 什么？你已经回来了。我以为你会花太久，所以我就自己去了。
Jungle Fever#016.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#017.src: My sickness? RIGHT. *cough* You should feel bad for forcing a sick man to do your job.
Jungle Fever#017.dst: 我的病？对哦。*咳咳* 你应该感到愧疚，竟然逼一个病人去干你的活。
Jungle Fever#017.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#018.src: Anyway I see you proved yourself, we can start the real thing now.
Jungle Fever#018.dst: 总之，看来你证明了自己，我们现在可以开始干真正的事了。
Jungle Fever#018.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#019.src: You see, {p} has a very well guarded emerald vault named "The Emerald Labyrinth".
Jungle Fever#019.dst: 你看，{p} 有一座戒备森严的绿宝石金库，叫作“绿宝石迷宫”。
Jungle Fever#019.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#020.src: It is guarded with tons of well trained Guard Golem, who can easily kill any adventurer.
Jungle Fever#020.dst: 那里有大量训练有素的守卫魔像把守，杀掉任何冒险者都不费吹灰之力。
Jungle Fever#020.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#021.src: The Banker in the secret vault must be completely bored out of his mind, and won't mind if you find him.
Jungle Fever#021.dst: 秘密金库里的银行家一定无聊透顶了，你找到他他也不会介意的。
Jungle Fever#021.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#022.src: Good luck with that. Haha.. I mean, *cough*.
Jungle Fever#022.dst: 祝你好运。哈哈.. 我是说，*咳咳*。
Jungle Fever#022.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#023.src: Infiltrate {p}'s Secret Emerald Labyrinth at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] underground and find the Banker in the Emerald Room
Jungle Fever#023.dst: 潜入 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 地下的 {p} 秘密绿宝石迷宫，在绿宝石室找到银行家

Jungle Fever#024.src: Oh, uh! Somebody! It has been so long since I've seen someone!
Jungle Fever#024.dst: 噢，呃！有人！我好久没见过人了！
Jungle Fever#024.speaker: Almuj Banker

Jungle Fever#025.src: Liquified Emeralds? Of course, of course! I've got tons! Here, take them.
Jungle Fever#025.dst: 液态绿宝石？当然，当然！我多的是！来，拿去吧。
Jungle Fever#025.speaker: Almuj Banker

Jungle Fever#028.src: That is a lot of money, thank you very much, I will finally be able to... *cough* to cure myself!
Jungle Fever#028.dst: 这可是一大笔钱，太谢谢你了，我终于可以……*咳咳* 把病治好了！
Jungle Fever#028.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#029.src: Here, take this part, you deserve it. I have to use most of the... *cough* money so I can heal, so I've instead paid you with a key.
Jungle Fever#029.dst: 来，这部分给你，是你应得的。大部分的……*咳咳* 钱我得拿去治病，所以我改用一把钥匙当你的报酬。
Jungle Fever#029.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#030.src: I stole- *cough* I mean, borrowed it, from our tribe's leader. Apparently it was used to lock up a great evil.
Jungle Fever#030.dst: 我偷——*咳咳* 我是说，借来的，从我们部落首领那里。据说它是用来封印一个大恶魔的。
Jungle Fever#030.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#031.src: Good ridda- *cough* Er... luck. Yes, good luck, adventurer!
Jungle Fever#031.dst: 终于摆脱——*咳咳* 呃……祝你好运。对，祝你好运，冒险者！
Jungle Fever#031.speaker: Worid

King's Recruit#002.src: Hey, {u}! You alright in there? Looks like we hit something.
King's Recruit#002.dst: 嘿，{u}！你在里面没事吧？看来我们撞到什么东西了。

King's Recruit#003.src: Exit the caravan and talk to the Caravan Driver at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#003.dst: 离开商队马车，与 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的商队车夫交谈。

King's Recruit#004.src: Hm... I swear I hit this same darn boulder every time I make this trip. Sorry folks.
King's Recruit#004.dst: 嗯……我发誓每次走这趟路都会撞上这块该死的大石头。抱歉了，各位。
King's Recruit#004.speaker: Caravan Driver

King's Recruit#005.src: Ah. Does this mean we have to walk all the way to {p} from here?
King's Recruit#005.dst: 啊。这是说我们得从这里一路走到 {p} 吗？
King's Recruit#005.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#006.src: Unfortunately so. Luckily, it's not that far from here. Just a straight path forward.
King's Recruit#006.dst: 很遗憾，是的。幸好离这里不算远。一直往前走就到了。
King's Recruit#006.speaker: Caravan Driver

King's Recruit#007.src: Well, nothing to do but keep moving! Tasim, {u}, I'll race you to the gate!
King's Recruit#007.dst: 好吧，只能继续前进了！Tasim、{u}，比比看谁先跑到大门！
King's Recruit#007.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#009.src: ... He's already gone. We'll have to catch up to him. {u}, lead the way.
King's Recruit#009.dst: ……他已经跑了。我们得追上他。{u}，你带路。
King's Recruit#009.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#010.src: Walk down the path towards the gate to the Wynn Province at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#010.dst: 沿着小路走向 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Wynn 行省大门。

King's Recruit#011.src: I don't suppose you know much about Wynn either, do you?
King's Recruit#011.dst: 我想你对 Wynn 也不太了解吧？
King's Recruit#011.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#012.src: Of course, the King of {p}'s been recruiting Fruma soldiers, but...
King's Recruit#012.dst: 当然，{p} 的国王一直在招募 Fruma 的士兵，可是……
King's Recruit#012.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#013.src: That war of theirs must be getting pretty bad if they need this much support.
King's Recruit#013.dst: 他们需要这么多支援，那场战争一定已经很糟了。
King's Recruit#013.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#014.src: Oh, there's Aledar! And the gate, by the looks of it.
King's Recruit#014.dst: 噢，Aledar 在那里！看样子，那就是大门了。
King's Recruit#014.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#015.src: There you two are! You'll have to be faster than that if you want to stand a chance against the undead.
King's Recruit#015.dst: 你们两个总算来了！要是想跟不死生物有一拼之力，你们得比这快才行。
King's Recruit#015.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#016.src: Yes, yes, we'll be faster next time. So, is this the gate marking the border between Wynn and Fruma?
King's Recruit#016.dst: 好好好，下次我们会快一点。那么，这就是 Wynn 与 Fruma 之间的边界大门？
King's Recruit#016.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#017.src: It looks like it, yep! Are you two ready for the start of our new lives?
King's Recruit#017.dst: 看起来是，没错！你们两个准备好开始我们的新生活了吗？
King's Recruit#017.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#018.src: {u}, why don't you do the honours? Go ahead and open that gate.
King's Recruit#018.dst: {u}，不如由你来吧？去把那扇大门打开。
King's Recruit#018.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#019.src: Enter the Province of Wynn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#020.src: Well, what are we waiting for? Let's go ahead and explore this province.
King's Recruit#020.dst: 好了，还等什么？我们去探索这个行省吧。
King's Recruit#020.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#021.src: Continue through the Wynn Province to the castle
King's Recruit#021.dst: 穿过 Wynn 行省，继续前往城堡

King's Recruit#022.src: So this is Wynn we've all been hearing about... It's beautiful.
King's Recruit#022.dst: 原来这就是我们一直听说的 Wynn……真美。
King's Recruit#022.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#023.src: I guess the war hasn't made it this far. This is what we'll be fighting to protect.
King's Recruit#023.dst: 看来战争还没打到这里。这就是我们要奋战守护的地方。
King's Recruit#023.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#024.src: Hey, recruits! Come over here, I have something to tell you.
King's Recruit#024.dst: 嘿，新兵们！过来这边，我有话要跟你们说。
King's Recruit#024.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#026.src: A soldier? What are you doing all the way out here?
King's Recruit#026.dst: 士兵？你怎么跑到这么远的地方来？
King's Recruit#026.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#027.src: There's a bit of trouble up ahead. They sent me out here to intercept new recruits.
King's Recruit#027.dst: 前面出了点麻烦。他们派我来这里拦下新兵。
King's Recruit#027.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#028.src: If you want to survive out here, you're going to need this.
King's Recruit#028.dst: 如果你想在外面活下来，你会需要这个。
King's Recruit#028.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#031.src: Hopefully we won't have to use these just yet.
King's Recruit#031.dst: 希望我们暂时还用不到这些。
King's Recruit#031.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#032.src: Good luck out there, recruits! Just follow this path, and there will be a bridge up ahead.
King's Recruit#032.dst: 祝你们好运，新兵们！沿着这条路走，前面会有一座桥。
King's Recruit#032.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#034.src: Ah, this must be the bridge the soldier was talking about. But it certainly looks very...
King's Recruit#034.dst: 啊，这一定就是那个士兵说的桥。不过它看起来实在很……
King's Recruit#034.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#035.src: Well, let's not keep the King of {p} waiting!
King's Recruit#035.dst: 好了，别让 {p} 的国王等太久！
King's Recruit#035.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#039.src: That's what I was trying to warn you about! Let's just get off this bridge before the rest of it collapses...
King's Recruit#039.dst: 我刚才就是想警告你这个！我们快离开这座桥吧，免得剩下的部分也塌了……
King's Recruit#039.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#040.src: Well, how are we meant to get to the other side of this ravine now? Ugh. Another thing gone wrong, just like-...
King's Recruit#040.dst: 那现在我们要怎么到这道峡谷的另一边？呃。又一件事出了差错，就像——……
King's Recruit#040.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#042.src: That's... weird. I was just thinking about something from before Wynn, but... it's gone. I can't remember.
King's Recruit#042.dst: 这……真奇怪。我刚才正在想来 Wynn 之前的一件事，可是……它不见了。我想不起来。
King's Recruit#042.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#043.src: Hm. I can't remember anything from Fruma either... {u}, how about you?
King's Recruit#043.dst: 嗯。我也想不起在 Fruma 的任何事……{u}，你呢？
King's Recruit#043.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#044.src: Nothing. It can't be a coincidence we all lost our memories at the same time, right?
King's Recruit#044.dst: 什么都想不起来。我们所有人同时失去记忆，不可能是巧合，对吧？
King's Recruit#044.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#045.src: No, but... We can worry about that later. For now, we need to find a way past this ravine. Aledar, {u}, you should look around for a way across. I'll keep looking here.
King's Recruit#045.dst: 不是，但是……这个晚点再担心。现在我们得想办法过这道峡谷。Aledar、{u}，你们去找过去的路。我继续在这里找。
King's Recruit#045.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#047.src: Search for another way across the ravine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#047.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 寻找另一条越过峡谷的路。

King's Recruit#048.src: Woah! That sure did the trick, {u}. Good thinking!
King's Recruit#048.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#049.src: Hey, Tasim! Come over here, {u} found a way over!
King's Recruit#049.dst: 嘿，Tasim！过来这边，{u} 找到过去的路了！
King's Recruit#049.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#051.src: Phew! We made it over safely this time at least.
King's Recruit#051.dst: 呼！至少这次我们平安过来了。
King's Recruit#051.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#052.src: If we just continue forward, we should make it to {p} in no time!
King's Recruit#052.dst: 只要一直往前走，我们很快就能到 {p}！
King's Recruit#052.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#053.src: Hmm? What's that guard doing here? We should probably talk to them if we want to pass through.
King's Recruit#053.dst: 嗯？那个守卫在这里做什么？想过去的话，我们大概得跟他谈谈。
King's Recruit#053.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#057.src: A group of corrupted have sieged this underpass. I can't let you enter without any armour.
King's Recruit#057.dst: 一群腐化者占领了这条地下通道。你们没有盔甲，我不能让你们进去。
King's Recruit#057.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#058.src: Then what do we do? We have to get to {p}!
King's Recruit#058.dst: 那我们该怎么办？我们得去 {p}！
King's Recruit#058.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#059.src: Do you see that cave over there? Caves such as those often contain useful loot that can help keep you alive.
King's Recruit#059.dst: 看到那边那个洞穴了吗？像那样的洞穴里常常有能帮你们活下去的战利品。
King's Recruit#059.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#060.src: If you enter the cave, you should be able to find some armour to protect you. After that return to me.
King's Recruit#060.dst: 进洞穴的话，你们应该能找到保护自己的盔甲。然后回来找我。
King's Recruit#060.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#061.src: What do you say {u}? Let's go see what's in that cave.
King's Recruit#061.dst: 你觉得呢，{u}？我们去看看洞穴里有什么。
King's Recruit#061.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#062.src: Enter the cave and find some armour at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#063.src: We should return to the guard to see if he'll let us through now!
King's Recruit#063.dst: 我们该回去找守卫，看看他现在肯不肯让我们过去！
King's Recruit#063.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#065.src: So you found some armor, huh?
King's Recruit#065.dst: 所以你们找到盔甲了，是吗？
King's Recruit#065.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#066.src: Yes, a helmet! Will you let us pass now?
King's Recruit#066.dst: 对，一顶头盔！现在可以让我们过去了吗？
King's Recruit#066.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#067.src: Hold on there, recruit. Before you can equip a piece of armor you first have to identify it.
King's Recruit#067.dst: 等一下，新兵。装备盔甲之前，你得先鉴定它。
King's Recruit#067.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#068.src: And how do we do that?
King's Recruit#068.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#069.src: You can identify items at Item Identifiers. They exist in every city across the whole world, and we keep one here for convenience.
King's Recruit#069.dst: 你可以到物品鉴定师那里鉴定物品。世界上每座城市都有，为了方便，我们这里也放了一位。
King's Recruit#069.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#070.src: Identify your helmet at the Item Identifier and then return to me with it equipped. After you've done that I'll let you pass.
King's Recruit#070.dst: 去物品鉴定师那里鉴定你的头盔，戴上之后再来找我。做完这些我就让你们过去。
King's Recruit#070.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#072.src: I see you have your helmet on. Fantastic, you may now pass. Let me open this door for you.
King's Recruit#072.dst: 我看到你戴上头盔了。太好了，你们可以过去了。我来帮你们开门。
King's Recruit#072.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#073.src: Good luck in there recruits! Even with your armour it won't be so easy!
King's Recruit#073.dst: 进去之后祝你们好运，新兵们！就算穿了盔甲也不会那么容易！
King's Recruit#073.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#076.src: Wow, that guard wasn't joking. This place is crawling with the corrupt.
King's Recruit#076.dst: 哇，那个守卫可不是在开玩笑。这地方到处都是腐化者。
King's Recruit#076.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#077.src: Well, we've got no choice but to make it through! Finally time for us to use these weapons we got. Let's go, {u}.
King's Recruit#077.dst: 好吧，我们别无选择，只能杀过去！终于轮到我们用上这些武器了。走吧，{u}。
King's Recruit#077.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#078.src: {u}, you take the skeleton in the front. We'll handle the two zombies in the back!
King's Recruit#078.dst: {u}，前面那具骷髅交给你。后面那两只僵尸我们来对付！
King's Recruit#078.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#081.src: This path opened up, let's continue through the underpass.
King's Recruit#081.dst: 这条路打开了，我们继续穿过地下通道吧。
King's Recruit#081.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#083.src: Over here! You're just what I needed!
King's Recruit#083.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#085.src: Finally, some backup! Wait a second... you're straight from Fruma aren't you?
King's Recruit#085.dst: 总算来援兵了！等一下……你们是刚从 Fruma 来的，对吧？
King's Recruit#085.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#086.src: Oh well, this area should be clear by now. {p} is just up ahead, after all.
King's Recruit#086.dst: 嗯，算了，这一带现在应该已经清干净了。毕竟 {p} 就在前面。
King's Recruit#086.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#088.src: Quick, you have to use an ability!
King's Recruit#088.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#090.src: Wait, it's running away! We have to save the Lieutenant!
King's Recruit#090.dst: 等等，它要逃了！我们得救中尉！
King's Recruit#090.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#092.src: Defeat the Goliath and free the Lieutenant.

King's Recruit#093.src: That sure was close... Thanks for the save, {u}!
King's Recruit#093.dst: 真是好险……谢谢你救了我，{u}！
King's Recruit#093.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#094.src: I think you three are going to make good soldiers - not many can handle themselves like you just did.
King's Recruit#094.dst: 我想你们三个会成为好士兵——没多少人能像你们刚才那样应付得来。
King's Recruit#094.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#095.src: It seems that beast dropped something, you should check it out before heading to {p}.
King's Recruit#095.dst: 那头野兽好像掉了什么东西，去 {p} 之前你们该去看看。
King's Recruit#095.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#096.src: Pick up the loot dropped by the Goliath.
King's Recruit#096.dst: 捡起巨人掉落的战利品。

King's Recruit#097.src: That item looks rare! Maybe there's an identifier around here.
King's Recruit#097.dst: 那件物品看起来很稀有！也许这附近有鉴定师。
King's Recruit#097.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#098.dst: 向 {p} 前进！我们快到了。
King's Recruit#098.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#100.src: We... we made it! We really made it! Sure was a close call at the end.
King's Recruit#100.dst: 我们……我们到了！我们真的到了！最后那一下可真是千钧一发。
King's Recruit#100.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#101.src: ... Still think those corrupted don't stand a chance against you?
King's Recruit#101.dst: ……还觉得那些腐化者在你面前毫无胜算吗？
King's Recruit#101.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#102.src: Ha ha. Very funny. Ah, {u}, there seems to be an identifier here for you to identify that rare helmet.
King's Recruit#102.dst: 哈哈。真好笑。啊，{u}，这里好像有位鉴定师，可以帮你鉴定那顶稀有头盔。
King's Recruit#102.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#103.src: And a blacksmith too, you can sell your old helmet there for some emeralds.
King's Recruit#103.dst: 还有铁匠，你可以把旧头盔卖给他换些绿宝石。
King's Recruit#103.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#104.src: Here it is, the end of our journey.
King's Recruit#104.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#105.src: The end of one adventure, but the beginning of another! Let's go inside and talk to the King!
King's Recruit#105.dst: 一段冒险的结束，也是另一段冒险的开始！我们进去跟国王谈谈吧！
King's Recruit#105.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#107.src: Welcome to the Province of Wynn! By your ragged appearance, I gather your journey here must have been quite the adventure.
King's Recruit#107.dst: 欢迎来到 Wynn 行省！看你们这一身狼狈，我想你们来这里的路上一定经历了不少冒险。
King's Recruit#107.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#108.src: This, recruits, is the noble fort of {p}, one of the great cities of our province!
King's Recruit#108.dst: 新兵们，这里就是崇高的 {p} 要塞，我们行省的伟大城市之一！
King's Recruit#108.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#109.src: As soldiers of Wynn, it is your duty to stem the tide of corrupted monsters ravaging this land.
King's Recruit#109.dst: 身为 Wynn 的士兵，你们的职责是阻挡蹂躏这片土地的腐化怪物浪潮。
King's Recruit#109.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#110.src: Although, you may want to gain some experience beforehand. Many lives are tragically lost every day...
King's Recruit#110.dst: 不过，你们最好先累积一些经验。每天都有许多人不幸丧命……
King's Recruit#110.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#111.src: Take this [{p} Teleportation Scroll] to aid you in your journey. Upon use, it will instantly bring you back to this city, wherever you may be.
King's Recruit#111.dst: 带上这个 [{p} Teleportation Scroll] 助你一路顺风。使用后，无论你身在何处都会立刻回到这座城市。
King's Recruit#111.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#112.src: With that, I must bid you farewell, more recruits may arrive at any time. Good luck out there, soldiers of Wynn!
King's Recruit#112.dst: 就这样，我得跟你们道别了，随时可能有更多新兵抵达。祝你们好运，Wynn 的士兵们！
King's Recruit#112.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#113.src: So! Wynn, huh? It's pretty exciting to finally be here.
King's Recruit#113.dst: 所以！这就是 Wynn，是吧？终于来到这里，真让人兴奋。
King's Recruit#113.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#114.src: I can't wait to discover what it looks like for myself!
King's Recruit#114.dst: 我等不及要亲眼看看它是什么样子了！
King's Recruit#114.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#115.src: Ha, well, I think I'm going to head in the direction of {p} soon, although there seems to be something called {p} on the way...
King's Recruit#115.dst: 哈，嗯，我想我很快就会往 {p} 的方向去，不过路上好像有个叫 {p} 的地方……
King's Recruit#115.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#116.src: Enough talking already! Let's get out there and help some people!
King's Recruit#116.dst: 别再聊了！我们出去帮助大家吧！
King's Recruit#116.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#117.src: And he's gone again... Well, I'm sure we'll be seeing him soon enough. For now, let's just see what Wynn really is like.
King's Recruit#117.dst: 他又跑了……嗯，我相信很快就会再见到他。现在，我们就去看看 Wynn 到底是什么样子吧。
King's Recruit#117.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#118.src: It's beautiful... Oh! I almost forgot to tell you, {u}.
King's Recruit#118.dst: 真美……噢！我差点忘了告诉你，{u}。
King's Recruit#118.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#119.src: There's this handy item we were all given on our way here, the Content Book. It displays most things you can do in this world; Quests, Caves, and much, much more.
King's Recruit#119.dst: 我们来这里的路上都拿到了一件很方便的物品，内容手册。它会显示你在这个世界里能做的大部分事情：任务、洞穴，还有很多很多。
King's Recruit#119.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#120.src: It also lets you track any content you want, which will create beacons for you to follow.
King's Recruit#120.dst: 它还能让你追踪任何你想要的内容，会产生信标让你跟着走。
King's Recruit#120.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#121.src: Here, why don't you try it out? Use your Content Book, and click on the highlighted quest.
King's Recruit#121.dst: 来，你何不试试看？打开你的内容手册，点击高亮的任务。
King's Recruit#121.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#122.src: There you go! I'm going to head towards {p}, at the end of the {p}.
King's Recruit#122.dst: 就是这样！我要往 {p} 去，就在 {p} 的尽头。
King's Recruit#122.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#123.src: You should meet me there once you've gotten a little stronger. Well, see you around, {u}.
King's Recruit#123.dst: 等你变强一点就来那里找我。好了，回头见，{u}。
King's Recruit#123.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#124.src: What are you waiting for recruits? Go identify your helmet at the  Item Identifier and then equip it in your helmet slot!
King's Recruit#124.dst: 新兵们还在等什么？快去物品鉴定师那里鉴定你的头盔，然后把它装备到头盔槽位上！

King's Recruit#125.src: Unless you'd rather stand around here all day, that's fine by me too.
King's Recruit#125.dst: 除非你想在这里站一整天，那我也无所谓。

King's Recruit#126.src: Well, what are we waiting for?

King's Recruit#127.src: Good luck in there, recruits! You're gonna need it...
King's Recruit#127.dst: 祝你们好运，新兵们！你们会需要的……
King's Recruit#127.speaker: Guard

Kingdom of Sand#001.src: A {p} soldier! I imagine you're here to investigate the tomb up the hill?
Kingdom of Sand#001.dst: 一位 {p} 的士兵！我猜你是来调查山上那座古墓的吧？
Kingdom of Sand#001.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#002.src: It's believed to house the remains of Prince Hashr, the son of the old Desert Emperor, but it's far too dangerous for me to explore personally.
Kingdom of Sand#002.dst: 据说那里葬着 Hashr 王子，也就是古代沙漠皇帝的儿子，但我自己去探索实在太危险了。
Kingdom of Sand#002.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#003.src: Instead I've been looking into a related legend - the Emperor's Sceptre.
Kingdom of Sand#003.dst: 所以我一直在研究一个相关的传说——皇帝的权杖。
Kingdom of Sand#003.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#004.src: It was the source of his power, and potentially one of the most important artifacts in history.
Kingdom of Sand#004.dst: 那是他力量的来源，也可能是史上最重要的文物之一。
Kingdom of Sand#004.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#005.src: When the Emperor was slain by his son, Hashr, it is said that the sceptre was lost amongst the raging sandstorm that followed.
Kingdom of Sand#005.dst: 据说皇帝被他的儿子 Hashr 杀死之后，权杖就在随之而来的狂暴沙暴中失落了。
Kingdom of Sand#005.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#006.src: ... Until now. I believe I have been able to trace its possession to a nearby group of bandits. They probably have no idea what they're sitting on.
Kingdom of Sand#006.dst: ……直到现在。我相信我已经查到它落在附近一伙强盗手里。他们大概根本不知道自己手上有什么。
Kingdom of Sand#006.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#007.src: I'm not prepared to confront them myself, but... this artifact belongs in a museum, in the hands of careful and respectful researchers.
Kingdom of Sand#007.dst: 我还没准备好亲自去找他们对质，不过……这件文物应该放在博物馆里，交给细心又尊重它的研究者。
Kingdom of Sand#007.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#008.src: I would be in your debt if you could try to retrieve it, for the sake of history.
Kingdom of Sand#008.dst: 为了历史，如果你能试着把它取回来，我会欠你一份人情。
Kingdom of Sand#008.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#009.src: Attempt to enter the bandit hideout at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Kingdom of Sand#009.dst: 设法进入 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的强盗藏身处。

Kingdom of Sand#011.src: Even if yer a crooked soldier, we can't jus let yer in.
Kingdom of Sand#011.dst: 就算你是个黑心的士兵，我们也不能就这样放你进去。
Kingdom of Sand#011.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#012.src: That is, unless yer got the password?
Kingdom of Sand#012.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#013.src: Didn’t think so. Now get lost, wasted enough of my t-
Kingdom of Sand#013.dst: 我就知道你不知道。现在滚吧，浪费了我够多时——
Kingdom of Sand#013.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#014.src: Now would you look at that... Even soldiers think they can waltz in ere.
Kingdom of Sand#014.dst: 哟，你看看……连士兵都以为能大摇大摆地走进来。
Kingdom of Sand#014.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#015.src: Having fun thinking of a password? Sorry to spoil your lunch, but there isn’t one!
Kingdom of Sand#015.dst: 想暗号想得开心吗？抱歉扫你的兴，根本没有暗号！
Kingdom of Sand#015.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#016.src: We could use a few more officials on the roster.
Kingdom of Sand#016.dst: 我们名单上正缺几个官方的人。
Kingdom of Sand#016.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#017.src: If yer are on the liberal side of the law, talk to us outside.
Kingdom of Sand#017.dst: 如果你对法律没那么死板，到外面来跟我们谈谈。
Kingdom of Sand#017.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#018.dst: 在 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与 Geo 和 Tarek 会合。

Kingdom of Sand#019.src: Looks like yer in. Look, there ain't a password cause we're meant to be the best thieves in the land, right?
Kingdom of Sand#019.dst: 看来你加入了。听着，没有暗号，是因为我们应该是这片土地上最厉害的小偷，对吧？
Kingdom of Sand#019.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#020.src: So what good are words? Yer gotta give the guard somethin' stolen, aintcha!
Kingdom of Sand#020.dst: 所以话有什么用？你得给守卫一样偷来的东西，懂不懂！
Kingdom of Sand#020.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#021.src: And we just so happen to have the opportunity of a lifetime for you. {p} has gone soft see, a new Mayor is cleaning things up.
Kingdom of Sand#021.dst: 而我们正好有个千载难逢的机会给你。你看，{p} 变软弱了，新来的镇长正在整顿。
Kingdom of Sand#021.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#022.src: Well, we can't have government not under our control. {p} will always be bandit capital.
Kingdom of Sand#022.dst: 嗯，我们可不能让政府脱离我们的掌控。{p} 永远都是强盗之都。
Kingdom of Sand#022.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#023.src: So how about we give him a taste of his own medicine, and get hold of that journal he keeps? I'm sure that’ll dig up some dirt on him.
Kingdom of Sand#023.dst: 所以我们让他尝尝自己的苦头，把他那本日志弄到手怎么样？我敢肯定能从里面挖出他的黑料。
Kingdom of Sand#023.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#024.src: And by "we", we mean you. You'll have to sneak through the mansion and avoid guards.
Kingdom of Sand#024.dst: 我们说的“我们”，指的是你。你得偷偷穿过宅邸，避开守卫。
Kingdom of Sand#024.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#025.src: He keeps his journal in the highest room. Might need to distract some guards too. It's the biggest mansion in {p}, can't miss it.
Kingdom of Sand#025.dst: 他把日志放在最高的房间里。可能还得引开几个守卫。那是 {p} 最大的宅邸，不会找错的。
Kingdom of Sand#025.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#026.src: Sneak into the highest room of the {p} Mansion at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Kingdom of Sand#027.src: Arh, there's the thief I saw a-sneakin' round the Mansion! Get them!
Kingdom of Sand#027.dst: 啊，就是我看到在宅邸附近鬼鬼祟祟的那个小偷！抓住他！
Kingdom of Sand#027.speaker: Mansion Guard

Kingdom of Sand#028.src: Yer know you could get kicked out of the army fer this.
Kingdom of Sand#028.dst: 你知道你可能会因为这个被踢出军队吧。
Kingdom of Sand#028.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#029.src: Heh, guess yer the real thing. Hop in, lets get out of ‘ere.
Kingdom of Sand#029.dst: 呵，看来你是玩真的。上车，我们离开这里。
Kingdom of Sand#029.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#030.src: That journal is more valuable than any gem, you'll be able to get in fer sure.
Kingdom of Sand#030.dst: 那本日志比任何宝石都值钱，你肯定进得去。
Kingdom of Sand#030.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#031.src: Bring the journal from the {p} Mansion to the Vault Guard to enter the hideout.
Kingdom of Sand#031.dst: 把 {p} 宅邸的日志带给金库守卫，进入藏身处。

Kingdom of Sand#034.src: Oh, this is quite the password, "soldier". I think this will do nicely, on you go.
Kingdom of Sand#034.dst: 噢，这可真是个好暗号，“士兵”。我想这就行了，进去吧。
Kingdom of Sand#034.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#035.src: Look for the sceptre within the bandit hideout at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Kingdom of Sand#035.dst: 在 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的强盗藏身处里寻找权杖。

Kingdom of Sand#036.src: Right, then, you lot. Give me your reports.
Kingdom of Sand#036.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#037.src: Gold relieved from Mesa travellers last week counted just over {~} bars.
Kingdom of Sand#037.dst: 上周从台地旅人那里“收”来的金子，清点下来刚过 {~} 条。
Kingdom of Sand#037.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#039.src: We're working on exposing that blasted {p} Mayor with a stolen journal. {p} should be back under Creden Tibus control within the week.
Kingdom of Sand#039.dst: 我们正在用偷来的日志揭发那个该死的 {p} 镇长。一周之内，{p} 就会回到 Creden Tibus 的掌控之下。
Kingdom of Sand#039.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#041.src: Well... someone's been hanging around the old tomb. An archaeologist, looks like. I reckon she's lookin' for the sceptre.
Kingdom of Sand#041.dst: 嗯……有人一直在那座古墓附近转悠。看起来是个考古学家。我估计她在找那根权杖。
Kingdom of Sand#041.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#042.src: Ah... that sceptre's too valuable for us to lose. Maybe we pay 'er a visit, persuade her to... stop lookin'.
Kingdom of Sand#042.dst: 啊……那根权杖太值钱了，我们不能丢。也许我们该去拜访她，说服她……别再找了。
Kingdom of Sand#042.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#043.src: Right you are, boss. Good thing no one will think to look for it in that broken cart by the river, ey?!
Kingdom of Sand#043.dst: 您说得对，老大。还好没人会想到去河边那辆破车里找，是吧？！
Kingdom of Sand#043.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#044.src: Shut it, you fool! What did I just say? Anyway, I'll decide what to do with this archaeologist. Dismissed!
Kingdom of Sand#044.dst: 闭嘴，你这蠢货！我刚才说什么来着？总之，这个考古学家怎么处理由我决定。解散！
Kingdom of Sand#044.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#047.src: We might be bandits, but we’re not stupid. That sceptre is left better off alone.
Kingdom of Sand#047.dst: 我们也许是强盗，但我们可不笨。那根权杖最好别去碰。
Kingdom of Sand#047.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#050.src: Return to the tomb and give Junes the sceptre at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Kingdom of Sand#050.dst: 回到 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的古墓，把权杖交给 Junes。

Kingdom of Sand#051.src: Ah, {u}. I couldn't help myself - I simply had to see the tomb up close.
Kingdom of Sand#051.dst: 啊，{u}。我忍不住了——我就是得近距离看看这座古墓。
Kingdom of Sand#051.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#052.src: You have no idea how tempted I am to go inside, but I doubt I'd make it out alive.
Kingdom of Sand#052.dst: 你不知道我有多想进去，不过我怀疑我没法活着出来。
Kingdom of Sand#052.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#053.src: You... you found the sceptre? Oh! This is incredible! I can't believe it!
Kingdom of Sand#053.dst: 你……你找到权杖了？噢！这太不可思议了！真不敢相信！
Kingdom of Sand#053.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#054.src: This artifact, it witnessed the rise and fall of the Empire, thousands of years ago. And you've just been... holding it, without gloves...
Kingdom of Sand#054.dst: 这件文物见证了几千年前帝国的兴衰。而你就这样……拿着它，连手套都没戴……
Kingdom of Sand#054.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#055.src: Under the circumstances, I think I can let that slide. But the things I could learn from studying it...
Kingdom of Sand#055.dst: 考虑到情况特殊，我想这点可以不计较。不过研究它能学到的东西……
Kingdom of Sand#055.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#056.src: I should get to {p} right away. Thank you, {u}. You have my eternal gratitude.
Kingdom of Sand#056.dst: 我应该马上去 {p}。谢谢你，{u}。我会永远感激你。
Kingdom of Sand#056.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#057.src: Are you thinking of exploring the tomb? I'm sure you can learn so much about the Empire... but you best be careful.
Kingdom of Sand#057.dst: 你打算去探索古墓吗？我相信你能了解很多关于帝国的事……不过最好小心点。
Kingdom of Sand#057.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#058.src: There are nasty legends of what it holds. Silverfish, skeletons... even Prince Hashr himself. Make sure to gear up!
Kingdom of Sand#058.dst: 关于里面有什么，有很多可怕的传说。蠹虫、骷髅……甚至是 Hashr 王子本人。一定要把装备准备好！
Kingdom of Sand#058.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#059.src: I have little to offer you for your help, but please accept these emeralds, and a fossil bone I found around here.
Kingdom of Sand#059.dst: 我没什么能报答你的，不过请收下这些绿宝石，还有我在这附近找到的一块化石骨头。
Kingdom of Sand#059.speaker: Junes

Lava Springs#000.dst: 与 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Gailard 上校对话

Lava Springs#001.src: Oh, good, good! I bet'cha you're a {p} soldier, aren't ya? Listen up, soldier! I've got a task here that 'ye can help out with.
Lava Springs#001.dst: 噢，好，好！我敢打赌你是 {p} 的士兵，对吧？听好了，士兵！我这里有个任务，你能帮上忙。
Lava Springs#001.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#002.src: Ya see that lava spring right there? It just went and popped up out of nowhere! The brass is real concerned about it, mhm?
Lava Springs#002.dst: 看到那边那口熔岩泉了吗？它就这么莫名其妙冒出来了！上头对这件事非常担心，嗯？
Lava Springs#002.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#003.src: They've been yappin' about it bein' related to the Corruption, and 'ye can bet that that means trouble. BAD trouble.
Lava Springs#003.dst: 他们一直嚷嚷说这跟腐化有关，你可以打包票，那就代表麻烦。大麻烦。
Lava Springs#003.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#004.src: Now, this here Savannah has always had some Corruption lurkin' about, but not to the point where it can do this! It won't be safe around here if we don't do somethin' about it!
Lava Springs#004.dst: 这片稀树草原一直都有些腐化潜伏着，但从来没到能搞出这种事的地步！我们要是不想想办法，这一带就不安全了！
Lava Springs#004.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#005.src: Anyways, high command ain't gonna provide support for this until they know there's actual Corruption, so we've gotta find some evidence around the springs, understand?
Lava Springs#005.dst: 总之，最高指挥部在确认真的有腐化之前是不会派支援的，所以我们得在泉水周围找点证据，明白吗？
Lava Springs#005.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#006.src: Take a look around the springs, soldier! Find me some damn evidence around here! [{~} Pieces of Evidence] should be enough! Now, get movin'!
Lava Springs#006.dst: 去泉水周围看看，士兵！给我找点该死的证据来！[{~} 份证据] 应该就够了！好了，快行动！
Lava Springs#006.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#007.src: Look for three pieces of corrupted evidence around the Lava Spring at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lava Springs#007.dst: 在 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的熔岩泉周围寻找三份腐化证据

Lava Springs#008.src: Go back to Colonel Gailard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lava Springs#008.dst: 回到 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Gailard 上校那里

Lava Springs#009.src: Alright, good! Ya found some evidence, let me take a look at that!
Lava Springs#009.dst: 好，很好！你找到证据了，让我看看！
Lava Springs#009.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#010.src: Oh... This is bad... very, VERY bad...
Lava Springs#010.dst: 噢……这下糟了……非常、非常糟……
Lava Springs#010.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#011.src: This here is some physical corruption. If it's gettin' onto the surface, then 'ye can bet one of those weeds is spreadin' underground, right beneath the springs...
Lava Springs#011.dst: 这是实体的腐化。如果它都冒到地表来了，你可以打包票，那些杂草里有一株正在地下蔓延，就在泉水正下方……
Lava Springs#011.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#012.src: If ya could get underneath the spring, 'ye could probably sever whatever damn root is causing this, but... the heat would be sure to fry your skin off...
Lava Springs#012.dst: 如果你能到泉水底下，大概就能把惹出这事的那条该死的根砍断，可是……那热度肯定会把你的皮烤掉……
Lava Springs#012.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#013.src: Wait... I've got an idea... Alright, listen up soldier! There's a lil' town North of here called {p}, yeah? There's a healer person there that can help us out.
Lava Springs#013.dst: 等等……我有个主意……好，听好了，士兵！这里北边有个叫 {p} 的小镇，对吧？那里有个医者能帮我们。
Lava Springs#013.speaker: Colonel Gailard
