One Thousand Meters Under#049.dst: 给我 [{~} 沙子替代品] 和 [{~} 胶水替代品]，应该就够了。
One Thousand Meters Under#049.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#050.src: Find [{~} Sand] and [{~} Glue] on the void island.
One Thousand Meters Under#050.dst: 在虚空岛屿上找到 [{~} 沙子] 和 [{~} 胶水]。

One Thousand Meters Under#051.src: Ech! What is this stuff? Well, this should do the trick.
One Thousand Meters Under#051.dst: 呃！这是什么玩意？嗯，这应该能用。
One Thousand Meters Under#051.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#052.src: Me and the mechanic will start repairing. It'll take a while, so enter the submarine and rest up.
One Thousand Meters Under#052.dst: 我和机械师要开始修理了。这会花点时间，所以进潜艇里休息吧。
One Thousand Meters Under#052.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#053.src: We'll continue the trip when we've repaired the ship.
One Thousand Meters Under#053.dst: 等船修好了我们就继续航行。
One Thousand Meters Under#053.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#055.src: This is the mechanic, requesting urgent assistence in the basement!
One Thousand Meters Under#055.dst: 我是机械师，底舱需要紧急支援！
One Thousand Meters Under#055.speaker: Jesp

One Thousand Meters Under#056.src: Toxic gas has leaked in through the submarine's vents, someone will have to manually close them.
One Thousand Meters Under#056.dst: 毒气从潜艇的通风口漏进来了，得有人手动把它们关上。
One Thousand Meters Under#056.speaker: Jesp

One Thousand Meters Under#057.src: I'll control things from here, someone get down to the lowest level and close those vents!
One Thousand Meters Under#057.dst: 我在这里控制，快派人下到最底层去关通风口！
One Thousand Meters Under#057.speaker: Jesp

One Thousand Meters Under#058.src: Attention crew. We have arrived at the next island {~}m down.
One Thousand Meters Under#058.dst: 各位船员请注意。我们抵达了下一座岛，深度 {~} 米。
One Thousand Meters Under#058.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#059.src: Disembark and start the search for the crystal.
One Thousand Meters Under#059.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#060.src: Let's hope it's here... I don't know how much more void my body can handle.
One Thousand Meters Under#060.dst: 希望它就在这里……我不知道我的身体还能承受多少虚空。
One Thousand Meters Under#060.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#061.src: Look out! {u}, we'll build a bridge to the other island whilst you defend us from the mobs!
One Thousand Meters Under#061.dst: 小心！{u}，我们来搭一座通往另一座岛的桥，你负责挡住怪物！
One Thousand Meters Under#061.speaker: Rex

One Thousand Meters Under#063.src: Keep fighting! We're almost halfway to the other side!
One Thousand Meters Under#063.dst: 继续战斗！我们快搭到一半了！
One Thousand Meters Under#063.speaker: Jesp

One Thousand Meters Under#066.src: Return to the submarine and continue the journey.

One Thousand Meters Under#067.src: We didn't find the crystal here either. Maybe it just fell in the void?
One Thousand Meters Under#067.dst: 这里也没找到水晶。也许它直接掉进虚空里了？
One Thousand Meters Under#067.speaker: Rex

One Thousand Meters Under#068.src: No, it must have hit an island. The scientist said he detected a collision.
One Thousand Meters Under#068.dst: 不，它一定撞到了某座岛。科学家说他侦测到了撞击。
One Thousand Meters Under#068.speaker: Manny

One Thousand Meters Under#070.src: The ropes are snapping! Quick! Abandon ship!
One Thousand Meters Under#070.speaker: Manny

One Thousand Meters Under#071.src: Find a way out of the void.

One Thousand Meters Under#073.dst: 一个……人类呜呜呜！？在虚空里？
One Thousand Meters Under#073.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#074.src: Someone dropped a boooook about you people! Warriors! Workers!
One Thousand Meters Under#074.dst: 有人掉下来一本关于你们的书呜呜！战士！工人！
One Thousand Meters Under#074.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#075.src: Ah. Yoooou want to know about this place?
One Thousand Meters Under#075.dst: 啊。你呜呜想了解这个地方？
One Thousand Meters Under#075.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#076.src: Well... We were once Villagers. I think we still are, a bit.
One Thousand Meters Under#076.dst: 嗯……我们以前是村民。我想我们多少还算是吧。
One Thousand Meters Under#076.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#077.src: For some reason, {~} years agoooo. The sky islands ruptured.
One Thousand Meters Under#077.dst: 不知道为什么，{~} 年前呜呜呜。天空群岛裂开了。
One Thousand Meters Under#077.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#078.src: Some stayed. Others fell. We somehow survived the fall into the vooooid.
One Thousand Meters Under#078.dst: 有些留了下来。其他的掉了下去。我们不知怎么的在坠入虚空呜呜时活了下来。
One Thousand Meters Under#078.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#079.src: How we have lived for so long, I doooo not know. But one thing we know for sure. The void provides.
One Thousand Meters Under#079.dst: 我们是怎么活了这么久的，我呜呜也不知道。但有一件事我们很确定。虚空会供给一切。
One Thousand Meters Under#079.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#080.src: We are stuck here now. The void has forever changed our physiology.
One Thousand Meters Under#080.dst: 我们现在被困在这里了。虚空永远改变了我们的身体。
One Thousand Meters Under#080.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#081.src: The crystal yoooou are looking for fell on this island. But...
One Thousand Meters Under#081.dst: 你呜呜在找的水晶掉在了这座岛上。可是……
One Thousand Meters Under#081.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#082.src: We need it. It will aid us for years.
One Thousand Meters Under#082.dst: 我们需要它。它能帮我们撑好多年。
One Thousand Meters Under#082.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#083.src: We have very limited resources here. That's why a power source like this is soooo valuable.
One Thousand Meters Under#083.dst: 我们这里的资源非常有限。所以像这样的能源才会这么呜呜珍贵。
One Thousand Meters Under#083.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#084.src: If you go to the east, you will find Rontaid, our chief scientist. He'll know what to doooo.
One Thousand Meters Under#084.dst: 如果你往东走，就会找到我们的首席科学家 Rontaid。他会知道该怎么办呜呜。
One Thousand Meters Under#084.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#085.src: Talk to Rontaid outside the town at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
One Thousand Meters Under#085.dst: 在 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的镇外与 Rontaid 交谈。

One Thousand Meters Under#087.src: Well, looks like the book we found wasn't fiction after all!
One Thousand Meters Under#087.dst: 嗯，看来我们找到的那本书终究不是虚构的！
One Thousand Meters Under#087.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#088.src: This crystal is going toooo be our saviour. I was trying to create one of my own, you know.
One Thousand Meters Under#088.dst: 这块水晶将会呜呜成为我们的救星。你知道吗，我本来想自己造一块。
One Thousand Meters Under#088.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#089.src: I think I have the formula, but we don't have what we need to make it.
One Thousand Meters Under#089.dst: 我想我已经有配方了，可是我们没有造它需要的材料。
One Thousand Meters Under#089.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#090.src: Instead of taking this crystal back, why don't I exchange it for the recipe?
One Thousand Meters Under#090.dst: 与其让你把这块水晶带回去，不如我用配方跟你换？
One Thousand Meters Under#090.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#091.src: That way, you can make however many crystals youuuu want, and we can keep this one.
One Thousand Meters Under#091.dst: 这样你呜呜想造多少块水晶都行，而我们也能留下这一块。
One Thousand Meters Under#091.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#092.src: Here's the recipe, give it to a scientist or someone a bit...smarter than yourself. No offense.
One Thousand Meters Under#092.dst: 配方给你，拿去给科学家或是比你……聪明一点的人吧。无意冒犯。
One Thousand Meters Under#092.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#093.src: A platform was lowered from the surface a while ago at your crash site, as well. If youuuu wish to return, follow this path, I made a shortcut.
One Thousand Meters Under#093.dst: 对了，前阵子地面上也往你们坠毁的地方放下来一座平台。如果你呜呜想回去，就沿着这条路走，我开了一条捷径。
One Thousand Meters Under#093.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#094.src: Return to the crash site by following the road.
One Thousand Meters Under#094.dst: 沿着道路回到坠毁地点。

One Thousand Meters Under#095.src: Return to the scientist and tell him the news.
One Thousand Meters Under#095.dst: 回到科学家那里，告诉他这个消息。

One Thousand Meters Under#096.src: You survived! Where is everyone else?
One Thousand Meters Under#096.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#098.src: I knew some must have died... But all of them?
One Thousand Meters Under#098.dst: 我知道一定会有人死……可是全部？
One Thousand Meters Under#098.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#099.src: Well... At least I don't have to pay them! Hah!
One Thousand Meters Under#099.dst: 嗯……至少我不用付他们钱了！哈！
One Thousand Meters Under#099.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#100.src: ...That was heartless of me, I'm sorry. The rope we used was too weak to hold you down there.
One Thousand Meters Under#100.dst: ……我这话太没良心了，对不起。我们用的绳子太弱，撑不住下到那么深的你们。
One Thousand Meters Under#100.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#101.src: My calculations didn't account for the void's physics, it seems.
One Thousand Meters Under#101.dst: 看来我的计算没有考虑到虚空的物理法则。
One Thousand Meters Under#101.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#102.src: At least we got you back in one piece. You can tell us what happened.
One Thousand Meters Under#102.dst: 至少你完好无损地回来了。你可以告诉我们发生了什么事。
One Thousand Meters Under#102.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#104.src: Well I'll be damned. I'll start sending post down there! We can work together.
One Thousand Meters Under#104.dst: 哎呀，真是见鬼了。我要开始往下面寄信了！我们可以合作。
One Thousand Meters Under#104.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#105.src: Better to keep everything that happened here a secret. I don't want to lose what little funding I have. This recipe is genius! Here, take this as well as your money.
One Thousand Meters Under#105.dst: 这里发生的一切最好保密。我可不想失去我仅剩的那点资金。这配方真是天才！来，这个也拿去，还有你的酬劳。
One Thousand Meters Under#105.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

Out of my Mind#000.src: You tell the group of kids your experiences of strange creatures, even stranger men as well as a hazy memory about... a coconut?
Out of my Mind#000.dst: 你向那群孩子讲述了你遇到的奇怪生物、更奇怪的人，还有一段模糊的记忆……关于一个椰子？

Out of my Mind#001.src: Speak with the {p} children in the treehouse.
Out of my Mind#001.dst: 与树屋里的 {p} 孩子们交谈。

Out of my Mind#002.src: Did ye two hear about some guy wandering around town? I've heard strange rumours about him...
Out of my Mind#002.dst: 你们俩听说有个家伙在镇上到处晃吗？我听到一些关于他的怪传闻……
Out of my Mind#002.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#003.src: Of course I have, he's the talk of the town! I heard he only brushes his teeth once a day and that he enjoys books about gardening!
Out of my Mind#003.dst: 当然听说了，全镇都在讲他！我听说他一天只刷一次牙，还喜欢看园艺书！
Out of my Mind#003.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#004.src: I don't know, you guys, all these rumors seem a little far-fetched. What next? Will he suddenly turn out to be a mad scientist?
Out of my Mind#004.dst: 我不知道，你们俩，这些传闻好像有点离谱。接下来呢？他突然变成一个疯狂科学家？
Out of my Mind#004.speaker: Viola

Out of my Mind#005.src: Oh shush you, we're not living inside some storybook! Besides, if he *was* a mad scientist, wouldn't he be trying to take over the city like all mad scientists in stories do?
Out of my Mind#005.dst: 噢，你闭嘴，我们又不是活在故事书里！再说，如果他*真的*是疯狂科学家，不是应该像故事里所有疯狂科学家那样想占领城市吗？
Out of my Mind#005.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#006.src: To me that doesn't sound all that strange compared to these other things I've been hearing, anyway... Something about labs and a "hermit".
Out of my Mind#006.dst: 反正在我看来，跟我听到的其他事比起来，那也没那么奇怪……好像跟什么实验室和“隐士”有关。
Out of my Mind#006.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#007.src: I think that's a type of crab or something. Adults are right old weirdos sometimes.
Out of my Mind#007.dst: 我觉得那应该是某种螃蟹吧。大人有时候真是怪人。
Out of my Mind#007.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#008.src: Hey, a stranger! How long have you been listening to us? Didn't your mom teach you any manners?
Out of my Mind#008.dst: 嘿，有陌生人！你偷听我们多久了？你妈妈没教过你礼貌吗？
Out of my Mind#008.speaker: Viola

Out of my Mind#009.src: Wait Viola, this is our chance! This stranger sure seems like they could tackle anything, even evil hermit crabs! We could just ask them to see if these rumours are true!
Out of my Mind#009.dst: 等等 Viola，这是我们的机会！这个陌生人看起来什么都对付得了，连邪恶的寄居蟹都行！我们可以请他们去查查这些传闻是不是真的！
Out of my Mind#009.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#010.src: Ignore my friends over there, they're always like that, but what Prentiss said was true. This might be our only chance to really know who this mystery man really is!
Out of my Mind#010.dst: 别理那边我的朋友们，他们一直都那样，不过 Prentiss 说得对。这可能是我们唯一能真正弄清楚那个神秘人是谁的机会！
Out of my Mind#010.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#011.src: It might be a good idea to look at that weird house next to those spooky ruins just south-east of the city. We found this key you could try out, but if you lose it there are some spares in our base.
Out of my Mind#011.dst: 也许可以去看看城市东南边那片阴森废墟旁边的怪房子。我们找到了这把钥匙，你可以试试，要是弄丢了，我们基地里还有备用的。
Out of my Mind#011.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#012.src: Find the hidden door next to the gate near the Undergrowth Ruins outside {p}
Out of my Mind#012.dst: 在 {p} 外的灌木废墟附近，找到大门旁边的暗门

Out of my Mind#013.src: Find a way inside the house at [-{~},-{~}]
Out of my Mind#013.dst: 想办法进入 [-{~},-{~}] 的房子

Out of my Mind#014.src: Explore the hidden lab in search of information
Out of my Mind#014.dst: 探索隐秘的实验室，寻找情报

Out of my Mind#015.src: Hello stranger! Welcome to my humble wooden abode. Comfy, isn't it? I bet you'd like a cup of this coff-
Out of my Mind#015.dst: 你好啊，陌生人！欢迎来到我简朴的木屋。很舒服吧？我敢打赌你想来一杯这咖——
Out of my Mind#015.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#016.src: Oh yes, I am the affable Ariodo, friendly neighbourhood neighbour. What do you need me for?
Out of my Mind#016.dst: 噢对，我就是和蔼可亲的 Ariodo，友善的邻里好邻居。你找我有什么事？
Out of my Mind#016.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#017.src: Kidnappings? Poaching? Not brushing my teeth?! Who is this lowly person you're talking about... they don't seem like a nice fellow such as myself.
Out of my Mind#017.dst: 绑架？偷猎？不刷牙？！你说的是哪个卑鄙的家伙……听起来可不像我这样的好人。
Out of my Mind#017.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#018.src: Lets go, I'll take you to the exit so that I don't waste your time any longer!
Out of my Mind#018.dst: 走吧，我带你去出口，免得再浪费你的时间！
Out of my Mind#018.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#019.src: This is the room you came from. I call it the "Vivarium", creative name I came up with, right? It keeps my pets that aren't quite ready.
Out of my Mind#019.dst: 这就是你刚才进来的房间。我叫它“饲育室”，这名字很有创意吧？里面养着我那些还没准备好的宠物。
Out of my Mind#019.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#020.src: Ready for what? Well that would ruin the surprise, wouldn't it? Can't have anyone finding out before the big event!
Out of my Mind#020.dst: 准备好做什么？那样就没惊喜了，不是吗？大事发生之前可不能让任何人发现！
Out of my Mind#020.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#021.src: Let us go now, time is precious.
Out of my Mind#021.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#022.src: So you must be thinking, how have you never met a fine fellow such as myself until now? To be quite honest, you must have been terribly unlucky, I used to travel the world, you know!
Out of my Mind#022.dst: 所以你一定在想，怎么到现在才遇见我这样的好人？说实话，那一定是你运气太差了，你知道吗，我以前可是周游世界的！
Out of my Mind#022.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#023.src: Oh, the places I've been were wonderful! From the depths of the jungle to the lesser depths of the jungle to even my back garden, I've done my fair share of exploring, if I do say so myself!
Out of my Mind#023.dst: 噢，我去过的地方都太美妙了！从丛林深处，到丛林没那么深的地方，甚至到我家后花园，要我说，我可是探索过不少地方！
Out of my Mind#023.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#024.src: You are the first normal person I've seen recently, {PlayerName}. I went out recently and was met with some very rude remarks by some very rude townsfolk!
Out of my Mind#024.dst: 你是我最近见过的第一个正常人，{PlayerName}。我前阵子出门，结果被一些很没礼貌的镇民说了一些很没礼貌的话！
Out of my Mind#024.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#025.src: The last time I visited the town it was all empty too, but I could feel people were hiding in their homes, even on such a lovely day as then. There was no one even to hide from! Strange people.
Out of my Mind#025.dst: 上次我去镇上的时候也是空荡荡的，但我感觉得到大家都躲在家里，就算那天天气那么好也一样。根本没什么好躲的！怪人。
Out of my Mind#025.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#026.src: I'm just a normal guy, so why can't anyone appreciate me for once? I'm sure you do, right?
Out of my Mind#026.dst: 我只是个普通人，为什么就没人能欣赏我一次呢？我相信你会的，对吧？
Out of my Mind#026.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#027.src: Here we are, the library! I could spend years in here, but who has time for that? I could talk about books hours too! Here's one right now.
Out of my Mind#027.dst: 到了，图书馆！我可以在这里待上好几年，可谁有那个时间呢？我聊书也能聊上好几个小时！现在就有一本。
Out of my Mind#027.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#028.src: This is 'The Long-Winded and Painful Death of Sweeney S. Greenville' and I must say it is a hidden gem among books! One day it just suddenly appeared in here so I couldn't resist reading it. So it starts off with Sweeney S. Greenville...
Out of my Mind#028.dst: 这本是《Sweeney S. Greenville 冗长又痛苦的死亡》，我得说这是书中的遗珠！有一天它突然就出现在这里，我忍不住就读了。故事开头是 Sweeney S. Greenville……
Out of my Mind#028.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#029.src: We're here now! Take the exit right in front of you, don't mind the corridor to the right, it's only decoration!
Out of my Mind#029.dst: 我们到了！走你正前方的出口，别管右边的走廊，那只是装饰！
Out of my Mind#029.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#030.src: Maybe you can come back some day for a tea or coffee and a long talk about books, since I noticed you were very interested in my long-winded review! Have fun out there and don't forget, I'm always here for you!
Out of my Mind#030.dst: 也许你哪天可以回来喝杯茶或咖啡，好好聊聊书，我看得出来你对我那篇冗长的书评很感兴趣！出去玩得开心，别忘了，我永远在这里等你！
Out of my Mind#030.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#031.src: The ground is shaking... I thought that was supposed to happen later! Come back, friend, I can't do this alone!
Out of my Mind#031.dst: 地面在震动……我还以为那应该晚点才发生！回来，朋友，我一个人办不到！
Out of my Mind#031.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#032.src: Build a machine to hit your head and get back to normal
Out of my Mind#032.dst: 造一台机器砸你的头，让你恢复正常

Out of my Mind#033.src: Help me keep this door shut, or else my surprise will be ruined!
Out of my Mind#033.dst: 帮我把这扇门顶住，不然我的惊喜就要被毁了！
Out of my Mind#033.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#034.src: Just keep to the sides, it's safer that way.
Out of my Mind#034.dst: 靠边站就好，那样比较安全。
Out of my Mind#034.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#035.src: Just stay here for one more momen...
Out of my Mind#035.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#036.src: Oh my, a ghost? Wait, is this just you, my trusty friend, playing a prank on me? No? Well that certainly is a problem!
Out of my Mind#036.dst: 天哪，鬼？等等，是你吗，我可靠的朋友，在跟我恶作剧？不是？那可真是个问题！
Out of my Mind#036.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#037.src: If you remember, we were talking about keeping the door shut when suddenly something heavy fell off a shell hitting you square in the head!
Out of my Mind#037.dst: 你还记得的话，我们刚才在说要顶住门，结果突然有个重东西从架子上掉下来，正好砸中你的头！
Out of my Mind#037.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#038.src: I think I heard something about fighting fire with fire, so I think I have a way to get you back! You are a bit too heavy for me, so we need to think of a workaround.
Out of my Mind#038.dst: 我好像听过以火攻火的说法，所以我想我有办法让你回来！你对我来说太重了，所以我们得想个变通的办法。
Out of my Mind#038.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#039.src: During the shaking, some of my machines broke apart, but we could use these to build something capable of dropping someting heavier on your head for the second time.
Out of my Mind#039.dst: 震动的时候，我有些机器坏掉了，不过我们可以用这些零件造个东西，能把更重的东西第二次砸到你头上。
Out of my Mind#039.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#040.src: Surely by that logic everything has to go well, you know. Now let me explain how we can do this. First, choose what part you want to use to make our machine, then choose where you want it to go and face.
Out of my Mind#040.dst: 照这个逻辑，一切肯定都会顺利的，你懂吧。现在我来解释怎么做。首先，选你要用来造机器的零件，然后选它要放在哪、朝哪个方向。
Out of my Mind#040.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#041.src: The [Cart] can carry the coconut from one end of the platform to another for a few tiles, while the [Fan] can push the coconut even further.
Out of my Mind#041.dst: [推车] 可以把椰子从平台的一端运到另一端，走上几格；[风扇] 则能把椰子推得更远。
Out of my Mind#041.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#042.src: The [Hammer] is able to knock the coconut over a one space gap while the [Cannon] can shoot the coconut one grid up diagonally in the direction it is facing.
Out of my Mind#042.dst: [锤子] 能把椰子敲过一格的空隙，[大炮] 则能把椰子朝它面对的方向往斜上方射一格。
Out of my Mind#042.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#043.src: I think I hit my head too, so I'll need your help deciding where to place each part. You want to get the coconut across to the green tile, remember?
Out of my Mind#043.dst: 我好像也撞到头了，所以需要你帮我决定每个零件放在哪。你要把椰子送到绿色的格子上，记得吗？
Out of my Mind#043.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#044.src: You're back! To be quite honest, I didn't think that would work, but I'm glad it did!
Out of my Mind#044.dst: 你回来了！说实话，我没想到那会管用，不过真高兴成功了！
Out of my Mind#044.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#045.src: Quick, head through the large door and stop the cause of all this shaking!
Out of my Mind#045.dst: 快，穿过那扇大门，阻止这场震动的源头！
Out of my Mind#045.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#046.src: Find a way to destroy the plant monster, then return to the group in {p} at [-{~},-{~}] to report your findings
Out of my Mind#046.dst: 想办法消灭植物怪物，然后回到 {p} [-{~},-{~}] 的孩子们那里报告你的发现

Out of my Mind#047.src: Oh no no, this is not good! If I had known that my little pet has grown so much I would have rushed you out sooner. Now it is wilted...
Out of my Mind#047.dst: 噢不不，这可不妙！要是我早知道我的小宠物长这么大了，我就会早点把你赶出去。现在它枯萎了……
Out of my Mind#047.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#048.src: You did what you had to, though. I am sorry to say this friend, but I think I'll stay inside a little longer. Sorry, my only friend.
Out of my Mind#048.dst: 不过你也是不得不这么做。朋友，很抱歉这么说，但我想我还是在屋里多待一阵子吧。对不起，我唯一的朋友。
Out of my Mind#048.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#049.src: We'll surely meet again in the future, so don't be sad. I'll still be the one and only friendly neighbourhood neighbour when that moment comes, I promise. Goodbye now!
Out of my Mind#049.dst: 我们以后一定还会再见的，所以别难过。到那时我还会是那个独一无二的友善邻里好邻居，我保证。再见啦！
Out of my Mind#049.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#050.src: You're back! You were gone for ages too, and what happened to your head? Who did the mystery man turn out to be?
Out of my Mind#050.dst: 你回来了！你去了好久，你的头怎么了？那个神秘人到底是谁？
Out of my Mind#050.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#051.src: That sounds ridiculous! Who could ever belie-
Out of my Mind#051.dst: 这听起来太荒唐了！谁会相——
Out of my Mind#051.speaker: Viola

Out of my Mind#052.src: Wow that sounded just like in the stories, but it came from you, so it must be true!
Out of my Mind#052.dst: 哇，听起来就跟故事里一样，不过是你说的，所以一定是真的！
Out of my Mind#052.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#053.src: I don't know about you, Todd, but I fell like we should make them our honorary club member for finding such amazing things!
Out of my Mind#053.dst: 我不知道你怎么想，Todd，但我觉得我们应该让他们当我们俱乐部的荣誉会员，因为他们发现了这么了不起的事！
Out of my Mind#053.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#054.src: Why do I even try... You two would believe anything.
Out of my Mind#054.dst: 我干嘛还要费劲……你们俩什么都信。
Out of my Mind#054.speaker: Viola

Out of my Mind#055.src: I'm pretty sure they mentioned something about being hit by coconut crabs, and just look at their head. One... two... two huge bumps!
Out of my Mind#055.dst: 我很确定他们提到被椰子蟹砸到，你看他们的头。一个……两个……两个大包！
Out of my Mind#055.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#056.src: Oh fine... whatever you say, Prentiss. I'm sure they'll bring you on some wacky adventures next time around!
Out of my Mind#056.dst: 噢好吧……你说什么都对，Prentiss。我相信他们下次会带你去什么古怪的冒险！
Out of my Mind#056.speaker: Viola

Out of my Mind#057.src: Ignore Viola, she's acting up today, probably because you're got the spotlight this time. However, I agree with Prentiss.
Out of my Mind#057.dst: 别理 Viola，她今天在闹别扭，大概是因为这次风头被你抢走了。不过，我同意 Prentiss。
Out of my Mind#057.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#058.src: Thanks to you, we solved the case of the mystery man as well as the mystery house! For this I'd like to...
Out of my Mind#058.dst: 多亏了你，我们解开了神秘人和神秘房子的谜团！为此，我要……
Out of my Mind#058.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#059.src: Welcome you to the club, new member! Here is your shiny new badge that you can parade around town to show off how cool you are to the other with style.
Out of my Mind#059.dst: 欢迎你加入俱乐部，新会员！这是你闪亮的新徽章，你可以戴着它在镇上神气地走来走去，让大家看看你有多酷。
Out of my Mind#059.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#060.src: Also since all the adults do it, we'll give you some emeralds that you rightly deserve for such an achievement. We all pitched in!
Out of my Mind#060.dst: 还有，因为大人都这么做，所以我们也给你一些绿宝石，这是你立下这种功劳应得的。我们大家一起凑的！
Out of my Mind#060.speaker: Prentiss

Overture to Despair#000.src: Meet up with Sui outside {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#001.src: ...{p}. Ha, the... the tourists really weren't lying when they kept saying it was a work of art.
Overture to Despair#001.dst: ……{p}。哈，那……那些游客一直说这里是件艺术品，还真没骗人。
Overture to Despair#001.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#002.src: It must be nice, living here... being able to ignore everything going on everywhere else...
Overture to Despair#002.dst: 住在这里一定很好吧……可以无视其他地方发生的一切……
Overture to Despair#002.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#003.src: {u}, we need to find that... that so-called "number one" Sovereign! If we can do that, then... ha, then we can save Rex and Zeph.
Overture to Despair#003.dst: {u}，我们得找到那个……那个所谓的“第一”统领！只要找到他，那……哈，那我们就能救出 Rex 和 Zeph。
Overture to Despair#003.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#004.src: Why not?! You're the one who wanted to- to rush into Deraj and free everyone without even stopping to think about it!
Overture to Despair#004.dst: 为什么不行？！当初想——想冲进 Deraj、连想都不想就要救出所有人的不就是你吗！
Overture to Despair#004.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#005.src: So why can't I?! The longer we wait, the more chances there are for s-something to happen!! We need to go already!
Overture to Despair#005.dst: 那我为什么不行？！我们等得越久，就越可能会出、出事！！我们得快点出发！
Overture to Despair#005.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#006.src: Yeah, I have one. Find the Sovereign. Free Rex and Zeph. And get out of there!
Overture to Despair#006.dst: 对，我有计划。找到统领。救出 Rex 和 Zeph。然后离开那里！
Overture to Despair#006.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#007.src: I'll... f-fill in the details as we go. I will! We just need to go already!
Overture to Despair#007.dst: 细节我……我边走边补、补上。我会的！我们只要赶快出发就好！
Overture to Despair#007.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#010.src: I guess... the Canopy? We can bring them to the Canopy! That... that works...
Overture to Despair#010.dst: 我想……树冠会？我们可以把他们带去树冠会！那……那样可以……
Overture to Despair#010.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#011.src: Um... n-no, I guess not. But- but we can find someone who does, and- and force the information out of them!
Overture to Despair#011.dst: 呃……不、不知道，我想不知道。可——可是我们可以找到知道的人，然后——然后逼他说出来！
Overture to Despair#011.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#012.src: We can do that. Captain Fuhue, she... told me about some of her methods! I just... need to find someone who... knows...
Overture to Despair#012.dst: 我们做得到。Fuhue 队长，她……跟我说过她的一些手段！我只是……需要找到一个……知道的人……
Overture to Despair#012.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#013.src: If- if that's what it takes!! We were able to k-kill Gikyo, weren't we?
Overture to Despair#013.dst: 如——如果非得那样的话！！我们都能杀、杀了 Gikyo，不是吗？
Overture to Despair#013.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#014.src: Even if it was hard... and Majin is... probably stronger...
Overture to Despair#014.dst: 就算很难……而且 Majin……大概更强……
Overture to Despair#014.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#015.src: Good. Okay! To start with, we...
Overture to Despair#015.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#018.src: Okay, fine, maybe you're right! Just... ugh!! We have to do something!
Overture to Despair#018.dst: 好吧，行，也许你说得对！只是……唉！！我们总得做点什么！
Overture to Despair#018.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#019.src: ...right. That's... smart. Word's probably spread from, um, {p}, hasn't it...? We'll need to blend in better.
Overture to Despair#019.dst: ……对。那……很聪明。消息大概已经从，呃，{p} 传开了，对吧……？我们得更好地融入人群。
Overture to Despair#019.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#020.src: And... we don't know how long it'll be until we... find the information we need. So... a place to say, too?
Overture to Despair#020.dst: 而且……我们不知道要过多久才能……找到需要的情报。所以……也要找个住的地方？
Overture to Despair#020.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#021.src: Okay. Find new clothes, and find a place to stay. That's a plan. We can do that.
Overture to Despair#021.dst: 好。找新衣服，再找个住的地方。这就是计划。我们做得到。
Overture to Despair#021.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#025.src: Indeed, I am. I was raised here in {p}.
Overture to Despair#025.dst: 确实。我在 {p} 这里长大。
Overture to Despair#025.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#026.src: Though, in truth... I've never really left. I'm planning on enlisting in the military once I've completed my provincial tour.
Overture to Despair#026.dst: 不过，说实话……我从来没真正离开过。我打算走完全行省之旅后就去参军。
Overture to Despair#026.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#027.src: I've been saving up for years for a round-trip ticket throughout the province... I'd like to see all of the less-fortunate regions firsthand.
Overture to Despair#027.dst: 我存了好几年的钱，买一张环游全行省的来回票……我想亲眼看看那些不那么幸运的地区。
Overture to Despair#027.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#028.src: I'm leaving just after the festival. Exciting, isn't it?
Overture to Despair#028.dst: 我庆典一结束就出发。很令人兴奋，对吧？
Overture to Despair#028.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#029.src: Hotels... hm. I know of several, though most have probably filled entirely for the upcoming festival.
Overture to Despair#029.dst: 酒店……嗯。我知道好几家，不过大部分可能都因为即将到来的庆典订满了。
Overture to Despair#029.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#030.src: There is a fancy hotel north of the bank... The Crown Jewel, I believe? It's probably far too expensive for you, however.
Overture to Despair#030.dst: 银行北边有一家高级酒店……我记得叫王冠明珠？不过对你来说大概太贵了。
Overture to Despair#030.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#031.src: A fine question. I'm not too certain, honestly... growing up here has made me overlook things.
Overture to Despair#031.dst: 好问题。老实说我不太确定……在这里长大让我对很多东西都视而不见。
Overture to Despair#031.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#032.src: I know tourists typically travel here to look at all our mansions and castles, though. Perhaps you'd be interested?
Overture to Despair#032.dst: 不过我知道游客通常是来这里看我们的宅邸和城堡的。也许你会有兴趣？
Overture to Despair#032.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#035.src: How might I help you this fine day?
Overture to Despair#035.dst: 在这美好的一天，有什么能为您效劳的？
Overture to Despair#035.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#036.src: As fine as one may be! Thank you for your inquiry.
Overture to Despair#036.dst: 好得不能再好了！谢谢您的关心。
Overture to Despair#036.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#037.src: I have been graciously afforded an hour off from my work, so I have chosen to take the time and... smell the roses. To admire the beauty of our city.
Overture to Despair#037.dst: 我有幸获准从工作中休息一小时，所以我选择花点时间……停下来闻闻玫瑰。欣赏我们城市的美丽。
Overture to Despair#037.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#038.src: Ah... tourists from the lower districts, I take it? A fine use of your travel allotments.
Overture to Despair#038.dst: 啊……我猜是从下层辖区来的游客？这可真是善用了您的旅行配额。
Overture to Despair#038.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#039.src: You will want to visit the bustling market on the west side, it would be a shame to miss it!
Overture to Despair#039.dst: 您一定要去西边热闹的市场看看，错过就太可惜了！
Overture to Despair#039.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#040.src: And if you wish to leave the bounds of the city, I have heard one may find tour guides which will bring you to see the mountains!
Overture to Despair#040.dst: 如果您想离开城市范围，我听说可以找到带人去看山的导游！
Overture to Despair#040.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#041.src: Yes, {p} is known for its high fashion, isn't it? I'm certain you've heard about it... wherever you come from.
Overture to Despair#041.dst: 是的，{p} 以高级时装闻名，不是吗？我相信您一定听说过……不管您是从哪里来的。
Overture to Despair#041.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#042.src: The famous House Til has placed a pop-up clothes shop to the north, if you're interested.
Overture to Despair#042.dst: 如果您有兴趣，著名的 Til 家族在北边开了一家快闪服装店。
Overture to Despair#042.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#043.src: I wish you the best on your stay! Praise be to her Majesty!
Overture to Despair#043.dst: 祝您住得愉快！赞美女王陛下！
Overture to Despair#043.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#045.src: I should have thought about where I'd be staying... I've never taken a train before, so all my thinking went towards making sure that went well!
Overture to Despair#045.dst: 我应该先想好要住哪里的……我从来没搭过火车，所以所有心思都花在确保那件事顺利上了！
Overture to Despair#045.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#046.src: And now all the hotels except the Crown Jewel are fully booked! Will I... will I have to sleep on the street?
Overture to Despair#046.dst: 结果现在除了王冠明珠之外的酒店全都订满了！我……我是不是得睡大街了？
Overture to Despair#046.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#047.src: Oh, what am I going to do...?
Overture to Despair#047.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#048.src: Oh, thank you, thank you! The Queen herself must have sent you my way!
Overture to Despair#048.dst: 噢，谢谢你，谢谢你！一定是女王本人把你派到我身边来的！
Overture to Despair#048.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#049.src: ...short on emeralds too, are you? Maybe we can share a comfy bush together! Ha...
Overture to Despair#049.dst: ……你也缺绿宝石吗？也许我们可以一起挤一丛舒服的灌木！哈……
Overture to Despair#049.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#050.src: Oh, I'll remember you forever! You've truly made this festival the best one yet!
Overture to Despair#050.dst: 噢，我会永远记得你的！你真的让这次庆典成了最棒的一次！
Overture to Despair#050.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#051.src: I can't wait to tell my old folk all about it! How the Queen had blessed me with this miracle...
Overture to Despair#051.dst: 我等不及要跟家里的老人家说了！说女王怎么赐给我这个奇迹……
Overture to Despair#051.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#052.src: But, it wasn't the Queen that... oh, nevermind.
Overture to Despair#052.dst: 可是，那不是女王……噢，算了。
Overture to Despair#052.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#053.src: Hello, hello! Care to buy any of our fine papers? Perhaps a magazine is up your alley today- quite the juicy bits of gossip I've heard.
Overture to Despair#053.dst: 你好，你好！要买份我们的好报纸吗？或者今天想来本杂志——我听到的八卦可精彩了。
Overture to Despair#053.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#054.src: Hm... Do I want the Crown of Seraphim collection, or the Peacock Couture...
Overture to Despair#054.dst: 嗯……我是要炽天使之冠系列，还是孔雀高定……
Overture to Despair#054.speaker: Roughworks Tourist

Overture to Despair#055.src: Oh, this is important... a whole year's paycheck is going towards this!
Overture to Despair#055.dst: 噢，这很重要……我一整年的薪水都要花在这上面！
Overture to Despair#055.speaker: Roughworks Tourist

Overture to Despair#058.src: Well, it seems you're in luck! Considering this is a pop-up clothes stall, and all.
Overture to Despair#058.dst: 嗯，看来你们运气不错！毕竟这是个快闪服装摊嘛。
Overture to Despair#058.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#059.src: I'm here representing House Til today. The new fashionable spring line has almost sold out, so shop now if you're interested!
Overture to Despair#059.dst: 我今天代表 Til 家族。新款时尚春装快卖完了，有兴趣就赶快买！
Overture to Despair#059.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#060.src: Um... is this the fashion around here?
Overture to Despair#060.dst: 呃……这里流行的是这种吗？
Overture to Despair#060.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#061.src: Oh, yes. People from all across the province come to shop at these pop-up events.
Overture to Despair#061.dst: 噢，是啊。全行省的人都会来这些快闪活动买东西。
Overture to Despair#061.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#062.src: House Til is known for incorporating the designs from peacock feathers into their most extravagant garments!
Overture to Despair#062.dst: Til 家族以把孔雀羽毛的图案融入他们最奢华的服饰而闻名！
Overture to Despair#062.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#063.src: They come in a wide variety of available colours- all from the district's local dye production!
Overture to Despair#063.dst: 而且颜色选择非常多——全都来自本辖区的染料生产！
Overture to Despair#063.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#064.src: We don't need anything fancy. Just... show us the cheapest stuff you have, okay?
Overture to Despair#064.dst: 我们不需要什么花哨的。就……给我们看最便宜的就好，好吗？
Overture to Despair#064.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#065.src: My goodness! You must know fashion does not come cheap, miss! Please, allow me to recommend-
Overture to Despair#065.dst: 天哪！你一定知道时尚可不便宜，小姐！请容我推荐——
Overture to Despair#065.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#066.src: No. Just let us buy the cheapest stuff you have.
Overture to Despair#066.dst: 不用。就让我们买最便宜的。
Overture to Despair#066.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#067.src: Uh huh... well, alright. If you insist...
Overture to Despair#067.dst: 嗯哼……好吧，行。既然你坚持……
Overture to Despair#067.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#068.src: Here, the cheapest I have available. In total, that will cost you... {~} EB.
Overture to Despair#068.dst: 给，这是我这里最便宜的。总共是……{~} EB。
Overture to Despair#068.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#069.src: Very well. Here you are. Now, please leave, your attitude is not good for business!
Overture to Despair#069.dst: 很好。给你。好了，请离开吧，你的态度对生意不好！
Overture to Despair#069.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#070.src: Okay... that's the clothes. Now we just... need a place to, um, stay. A hotel, maybe...
Overture to Despair#070.dst: 好……衣服搞定了。现在只要……找个，呃，住的地方。也许是家酒店……
Overture to Despair#070.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#071.src: Well! As I said, fashion is not cheap!
Overture to Despair#071.dst: 哼！我说过了，时尚可不便宜！
Overture to Despair#071.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#072.src: Ah, you're back. As I said, the clothes will cost you {~} EB.
Overture to Despair#072.dst: 啊，你们回来了。我说过，这些衣服要 {~} EB。
Overture to Despair#072.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#074.src: Ah... Listen, I still need to sell all of my stock, or I won't receive my bonus!
Overture to Despair#074.dst: 啊……听着，我得把存货全部卖掉，不然拿不到奖金！
Overture to Despair#074.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#075.src: So, unless you're interested in buying more clothes... please, leave.
Overture to Despair#075.dst: 所以，除非你们还想买衣服……请离开吧。
Overture to Despair#075.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#077.src: Why, hello and welcome to the Crown Jewel! How may I assist you?
Overture to Despair#077.dst: 哎呀，您好，欢迎光临王冠明珠！有什么能为您效劳的？
Overture to Despair#077.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#079.src: Well, do you have a booking?
Overture to Despair#079.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#081.src: Hm I see. In that case, allow me to quickly check out listings...
Overture to Despair#081.dst: 嗯，我明白了。既然这样，请容我快速查一下房况……
Overture to Despair#081.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#082.src: Aha! You're in luck! It seems we have a spare double room available! But that may not last long- let me tell you, they are selling fast!
Overture to Despair#082.dst: 啊哈！您运气真好！看来我们还有一间空的双人房！不过可能撑不了多久——我跟您说，卖得可快了！
Overture to Despair#082.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#083.src: A... bigger room? You're certain? From where I stand, I only see the two of you, and-
Overture to Despair#083.dst: 一间……更大的房间？您确定吗？就我所见，只有您两位，而且——
Overture to Despair#083.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#084.src: We're... going to have friends with us. They just... haven't, um, arrived yet.
Overture to Despair#084.dst: 我们……会有朋友跟我们一起。他们只是……还没，呃，到。
Overture to Despair#084.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#085.src: I see. I see That certainly complicates things...
Overture to Despair#085.dst: 我明白了。我明白了这下可就麻烦了……
Overture to Despair#085.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#086.src: Company? Well, whatever sort? If you're just looking to socialize, the double room should serve your purposes well en-
Overture to Despair#086.dst: 朋友？嗯，是哪种朋友？如果只是想交际，双人房应该就够用——
Overture to Despair#086.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#087.src: No, they'll... be staying with us.
Overture to Despair#087.dst: 不，他们……会跟我们一起住。
Overture to Despair#087.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#088.src: Mmn. Yes, that would certainly put a damper on things. Hm...
Overture to Despair#088.dst: 嗯。是啊，那确实会扫兴。嗯……
Overture to Despair#088.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#089.src: Well. I suppose we do also have the luxury suite available. Though, it's quite the hefty price...
Overture to Despair#089.dst: 嗯。我想我们还有一间豪华套房。不过，价格可相当不菲……
Overture to Despair#089.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#090.src: We- we'll take it. I'll pay.
Overture to Despair#090.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#091.src: You're certain? Apologies if I am making assumptions here, but you do not seem the sort who would have-
Overture to Despair#091.dst: 您确定吗？如果我妄加揣测还请见谅，不过您看起来不像是会有——
Overture to Despair#091.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#093.src: ...huh. Well, everything seems in order then. Here are your keys, madame.
Overture to Despair#093.dst: ……嗯。好吧，看来一切都没问题。这是您的钥匙，女士。
Overture to Despair#093.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#095.src: {u}, I'm... going up to the room.
Overture to Despair#095.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#096.src: No. We're... not here for pleasure, {u}. We're here to... to... to save our friends.
Overture to Despair#096.dst: 不。我们……不是来享乐的，{u}。我们是来……来……来救我们朋友的。
Overture to Despair#096.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#097.src: I'm, um... not hungry. And I'm, ha, definitely not in the mood for a drink.
Overture to Despair#097.dst: 我，呃……不饿。而且我，哈，绝对没心情喝酒。
Overture to Despair#097.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#098.src: ...you can, um, take a look around though. If- if you want. Just... don't take too long.
Overture to Despair#098.dst: ……不过你可以，呃，四处看看。如——如果你想的话。只是……别太久。
Overture to Despair#098.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#099.src: We're in... room {~}, apparently. I'll... leave the door open for you.
Overture to Despair#099.dst: 我们好像住在……{~} 号房。我……会把门开着等你。
Overture to Despair#099.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#100.src: Head to your room and discuss what to do next.
Overture to Despair#100.dst: 前往你们的房间，讨论接下来该怎么做。

Overture to Despair#101.src: Ah! What can I do for you today?
Overture to Despair#101.dst: 啊！今天有什么能为您效劳的？
Overture to Despair#101.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#102.src: The {p} are known for thier very scenic walks and hikes! I would recommend walking around the lakes or hiking up to the mountains.
Overture to Despair#102.dst: {p} 以风景优美的散步路线和登山步道闻名！我推荐您绕着湖边散步，或是登上山去。
Overture to Despair#102.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#103.src: {p} is also known for their very rich alcohol culture. We brew a lot of different beverages that can be enjoyed at our local taverns.
Overture to Despair#103.dst: {p} 也以浓厚的酒文化闻名。我们酿造各式各样的饮品，可以在本地的酒馆享用。
Overture to Despair#103.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#104.src: We are not hosting any particular events at this moment because of the upcoming festival.
Overture to Despair#104.dst: 因为庆典快到了，我们目前没有举办什么特别的活动。
Overture to Despair#104.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#105.src: Usually, we host game nights and quizzes in our bar!
Overture to Despair#105.dst: 平常我们会在酒吧举办游戏之夜和问答比赛！
Overture to Despair#105.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#106.src: Oh, are things not up to your standard?
Overture to Despair#106.dst: 噢，是有什么不合您的标准吗？
Overture to Despair#106.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#107.src: What have you experienced issues with?
Overture to Despair#107.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#108.src: I apologise for that! We will send in a cleaner later to fluff em up for ya!
Overture to Despair#108.dst: 真是抱歉！我们稍后会派清洁人员去帮您拍松！
Overture to Despair#108.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#110.src: Oh I will let our cleaners know to do a better job.
Overture to Despair#110.dst: 噢，我会跟清洁人员说，让他们做得更好。
Overture to Despair#110.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#112.src: Unfortunately there is nothing we can do to help with that.
Overture to Despair#112.dst: 很遗憾，那方面我们帮不上忙。
Overture to Despair#112.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#114.src: Let me know if there's anything I can do to make your stay better!
Overture to Despair#114.dst: 如果有什么能让您住得更舒适的，请告诉我！
Overture to Despair#114.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#115.dst: * - 晚上 {~} 点后禁止喧哗。
Overture to Despair#115.speaker: Rules of The Crown Jewel

Overture to Despair#116.src: A year of saving... f-finally payed off!
Overture to Despair#116.dst: 存了一年的钱……终、终于值回票价了！
Overture to Despair#116.speaker: Timasca Tourist

Overture to Despair#117.src: A... a giant meal, and a nice hotel... and I have it all to m-myself!! Best! Week!! Ever!!
Overture to Despair#117.dst: 一……一顿大餐，一间好酒店……而且全都是我、我一个人的！！最棒！的一周！！
Overture to Despair#117.speaker: Timasca Tourist

Overture to Despair#121.src: ...I had heard that about the Auburn Festival!
Overture to Despair#121.dst: ……我听说 Auburn 庆典也是这样！
Overture to Despair#121.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#122.src: I can't say I expected word to reach {p} from over there. Though, let me say... so far, I am very impressed by how {p} handles festivities.
Overture to Despair#122.dst: 没想到消息会从那边传到 {p} 来。不过，我得说……到目前为止，{p} 办庆典的方式让我非常惊艳。
Overture to Despair#122.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#123.src: Why, the real festivities haven't even begun! You're in for a treat, my friend.
Overture to Despair#123.dst: 哎呀，真正的庆祝活动还没开始呢！你可有眼福了，我的朋友。
Overture to Despair#123.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#124.src: ...by chance, would you let me show you around when the festival starts in full? I've enjoyed our talks so far.
Overture to Despair#124.dst: ……庆典正式开始的时候，能不能让我带你到处看看？我很喜欢我们到目前为止的聊天。
Overture to Despair#124.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#125.src: I'd love that. I've never been outside the {p} before... so it would be nice to have someone to guide me, wouldn't it?
Overture to Despair#125.dst: 我很乐意。我从来没离开过 {p}……所以有人给我带路会很不错，对吧？
Overture to Despair#125.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#127.src: Ah, I'm so glad we meet again!
Overture to Despair#127.dst: 啊，真高兴我们又见面了！
Overture to Despair#127.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#128.src: Even though you... barged into my room... er, isn't that against hotel policy?
Overture to Despair#128.dst: 虽然你……闯进了我的房间……呃，那不是违反酒店规定吗？
Overture to Despair#128.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#129.src: ...oh, well, I won't tell them. You did help me pay for the room, after all! I wish you all the best.
Overture to Despair#129.dst: ……噢，好吧，我不会告诉他们的。毕竟你帮我付了房钱！祝你一切顺利。
Overture to Despair#129.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#130.src: Maybe we'll meet again! Perhaps I could buy you a drink at the festival?
Overture to Despair#130.dst: 也许我们还会再见面！说不定我能在庆典上请你喝一杯？
Overture to Despair#130.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#131.src: ...oh, you're here. Are you done looking around?
Overture to Despair#131.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#132.src: So, um. I've been... planning our next steps. Finding a place to stay was... a good idea, I guess. You were right. I shouldn't... rush into it.
Overture to Despair#132.dst: 那个，呃。我一直在……计划我们的下一步。找个住的地方是……个好主意，我想。你是对的。我不该……急着冲进去。
Overture to Despair#132.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#133.src: But this is a good place to regroup once we... once we get Rex and Zeph back. We should, ha, act as early as possible, though.
Overture to Despair#133.dst: 不过等我们……等我们救回 Rex 和 Zeph，这里是个重新集合的好地方。不过，哈，我们应该尽早行动。
Overture to Despair#133.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#134.src: Stop that. You k-keep doing that, acting as if... a-as if the worst is inevitable! It's not helpful!
Overture to Despair#134.dst: 别这样。你一——一直这样，表现得好像……好、好像最坏的结果无法避免！那一点帮助都没有！
Overture to Despair#134.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#135.src: Well... don't!! I know already, I know they might be gone, but I- I can't think like that. I can't. I have to believe they're still... fighting!!
Overture to Despair#135.dst: 嗯……那就别说！！我已经知道了，我知道他们可能已经不在了，可是我——我不能那样想。我不能。我必须相信他们还在……奋战！！
Overture to Despair#135.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#136.src: ...um. Anyway, we should... l-look around the town. To try and figure out where they're being held. If we can figure that out, then...
Overture to Despair#136.dst: ……呃。总之，我们应该……四、四处看看这座城。试着找出他们被关在哪里。只要能弄清楚，那……
Overture to Despair#136.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#137.src: Look around the town, I guess... try and figure out where that Sovereign is keeping them. If we can figure that out, then... we can save them.
Overture to Despair#137.dst: 四处看看这座城，我想……试着找出那个统领把他们关在哪里。只要能弄清楚，那……我们就能救他们。
Overture to Despair#137.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#138.src: We should start right away. Come on.
Overture to Despair#138.dst: 我们应该马上开始。走吧。
Overture to Despair#138.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#139.src: I can't, I can't, I can't. If I stop for... for even a second, I'll... I'll shatter. I have to keep moving. I have to.
Overture to Despair#139.dst: 我不能，我不能，我不能。要是我停下来……哪怕一秒，我就会……我就会碎掉。我必须继续前进。我必须。
Overture to Despair#139.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#140.src: What do you think?! NO, I'm not doing alright!! But I have to do something about it, or... or... I'll shatter.
Overture to Despair#140.dst: 你以为呢？！不，我一点都不好！！可是我必须做点什么，不然……不然……我会碎掉。
Overture to Despair#140.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#141.src: You can... stay here and rest if you, um, need to. But I'm going to search the city for clues. By myself if... if I have to.
Overture to Despair#141.dst: 你可以……留在这里休息，如果你，呃，需要的话。不过我要去城里找线索。如果……如果必须的话，我一个人去。
Overture to Despair#141.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#143.src: Meet up with Sui outside the Crown Jewel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#143.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的王冠明珠外面与 Sui 会合。

Overture to Despair#145.src: This... this wind chime. Look at it.
Overture to Despair#145.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#146.src: ...what? No, I'm looking at a wall. What do you think I was looking at?
Overture to Despair#146.dst: ……什么？不，我在看墙。你以为我在看什么？
Overture to Despair#146.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#147.src: These wind chimes. They're... a symbol of resistance in the {p}. S... um, Syndra told us about them.
Overture to Despair#147.dst: 这些风铃。它们是……{p} 的反抗象征。S……呃，Syndra 跟我们说过。
Overture to Despair#147.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#148.src: The wind represents... freedom, and free will. But I wouldn't have expected the chimes to have made it all the way here...?
Overture to Despair#148.dst: 风代表……自由，还有自由意志。可是我没想到风铃会一路传到这里来……？
Overture to Despair#148.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#149.src: Could... could this mean what I think it does?
Overture to Despair#149.dst: 这……这是不是代表我想的那个意思？
Overture to Despair#149.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#150.src: I was right... I was right! It's a symbol of resistance, th-that means {p} must have its own resistance!!
Overture to Despair#150.dst: 我是对的……我是对的！这是反抗的象征，这——这代表 {p} 也有自己的抵抗组织！！
Overture to Despair#150.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#151.src: We... we need to seek them out, {u}!
Overture to Despair#151.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#152.src: ...oh. Right. Um, sorry. I just... got excited.
Overture to Despair#152.dst: ……噢。对。呃，抱歉。我只是……太兴奋了。
Overture to Despair#152.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#153.src: ...oh. Oops. Let's um, hope I wasn't too loud...
Overture to Despair#153.dst: ……噢。糟了。希望我，呃，没说得太大声……
Overture to Despair#153.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#154.src: A-anyway. I think there's... an inscription on the wind chime.
Overture to Despair#154.dst: 总——总之。我觉得风铃上……刻着字。
Overture to Despair#154.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#155.src: "The winds of change blow from the west, crashing waves of truth unto our shores."
Overture to Despair#155.dst: “变革之风自西方吹来，将真相的浪潮拍上我们的海岸。”
Overture to Despair#155.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#156.src: ...that must be where the resistance is! Let's- let's find them!
Overture to Despair#156.dst: ……那一定就是抵抗组织所在的地方！我们——我们去找他们！
Overture to Despair#156.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#157.src: Find the location specified on the wind chime in {p}: The winds of change blow from the west, crashing waves of truth unto our shores.
Overture to Despair#157.dst: 在 {p} 找到风铃上指明的地点：变革之风自西方吹来，将真相的浪潮拍上我们的海岸。

Overture to Despair#158.src: ...oh. There... doesn't seem to be a resistance here. Just another wind chime.
Overture to Despair#158.dst: ……噢。这里……好像没有抵抗组织。只有另一个风铃。
Overture to Despair#158.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#159.src: Does this one also have something written on it?
Overture to Despair#159.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#160.src: Find the next location: Rooted deep atop the house of wealth and greed, the branches hear the whispers on the breeze.
Overture to Despair#160.dst: 找到下一个地点：深植于财富与贪婪之屋顶上，枝条聆听着风中的低语。

Overture to Despair#161.src: Find the next location: The whispers speak of unity, called forth where regions meet through lines of burrowed steel.
Overture to Despair#161.dst: 找到下一个地点：低语诉说着团结，在地区经由掘地钢轨相接之处被唤起。

Overture to Despair#162.src: Find the next location: Day after day, the voices greet the seekers. Identify the truth, and read the secrets printed.
Overture to Despair#162.dst: 找到下一个地点：日复一日，声音迎接着追寻者。辨明真相，阅读印刷的秘密。

Overture to Despair#163.src: Hello, hello! Care to buy any of our fine papers? Perhaps a magazine is up your alley today- quite the juicy bits of gossip I've heard.
Overture to Despair#163.dst: 你好，你好！要买份我们的好报纸吗？或者今天想来本杂志——我听到的八卦可精彩了。
Overture to Despair#163.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#164.src: What? {u}, what are you doing? That's not...
Overture to Despair#164.dst: 什么？{u}，你在干什么？那不是……
Overture to Despair#164.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#165.src: ...um. We're very interested in your... um, your wind chimes.
Overture to Despair#165.dst: ……呃。我们对你的……呃，你的风铃非常感兴趣。
Overture to Despair#165.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#166.src: Windchimes? I'm sorry? I haven't the foggiest idea what you mean. I've certainly heard of them down in the {p}, but here? What an odd thing to say.
Overture to Despair#166.dst: 风铃？抱歉？我完全不知道你在说什么。我确实听说过 {p} 那边有这种东西，可是这里？真是奇怪的说法。
Overture to Despair#166.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#167.src: But still, perhaps I can get you a paper. Out of curiosity... where might you two be from? I don't think I've seen you around here before!
Overture to Despair#167.dst: 不过，也许我还是能卖你一份报纸。出于好奇……你们两位是从哪里来的？我好像没在这附近见过你们！
Overture to Despair#167.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#168.src: Haha, oh dear. I asked where you were from, not the way you got here. So, let's try that one again! Where are you two from?
Overture to Despair#168.dst: 哈哈，天哪。我问的是你们从哪里来，不是你们怎么来的。那么，我们再试一次！你们两位是从哪里来的？
Overture to Despair#168.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#169.src: Ah, yes, and I found a gold bar in my mailbox today! Haha, you'll have to try harder to pull one over on me like that- no one's lived in the {p} for ages! Now, be serious! I was genuine in asking.
Overture to Despair#169.dst: 啊，是啊，我今天还在信箱里捡到一根金条呢！哈哈，想骗我可得再努力点——{p} 早就好多年没人住了！好了，认真点！我是真心在问。
Overture to Despair#169.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#170.src: So too we all do- from nothing but milk and love, as I've heard it's said, but if we were to talk about the origins of the universe we'd be here all night. So, where are you really from?
Overture to Despair#170.dst: 我们都一样——我听人说，全是从牛奶和爱里来的，不过要是聊起宇宙的起源，我们得聊上一整晚。所以，你们到底是从哪里来的？
Overture to Despair#170.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#171.src: Ahaaa, I see! So you're looking for the people who seek the truth. A noble endeavour, certainly.
Overture to Despair#171.dst: 啊哈——我明白了！所以你们在找追寻真相的人。当然，这是崇高的志向。
Overture to Despair#171.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#172.src: We'd, um, love to meet some more of these... truth... seekers...?
Overture to Despair#172.dst: 我们，呃，很想认识更多这些……真相……追寻者……？
Overture to Despair#172.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#173.src: There's many a like-minded individual if you know where to look. So allow me to catch your eye with the Aelumia Times! It's the best way to keep up with current events.
Overture to Despair#173.dst: 只要知道往哪里找，志同道合的人可多了。所以请容我向你们推荐《Aelumia 时报》！这是掌握时事的最佳方式。
Overture to Despair#173.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#174.src: Column {~} will often print the phrase of the day. Read up, and pay close attention! Things will kick off here at midnight.
Overture to Despair#174.dst: 第 {~} 栏通常会刊登每日一句。好好读，仔细留意！午夜时分这里就会开始。
Overture to Despair#174.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#175.src: I wish you two good luck on your endeavours. May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change.
Overture to Despair#175.dst: 祝你们两位追寻顺利。愿我们发掘久埋的真相，带来变革。
Overture to Despair#175.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#176.src: Th-thank you. Um... may we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change!
Overture to Despair#176.dst: 谢——谢谢你。呃……愿我们发掘久埋的真相，带来变革！
Overture to Despair#176.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#177.src: Leave the shop and discuss the next steps.

Overture to Despair#178.src: May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change. Never forget that.
Overture to Despair#178.dst: 愿我们发掘久埋的真相，带来变革。永远别忘了。
Overture to Despair#178.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#179.src: Finally! Finally, finally, something good is happening!
Overture to Despair#179.dst: 终于！终于，终于，有好事发生了！
Overture to Despair#179.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#180.src: I didn't even think there'd be a resistance in {p}... it just seems so... idyllic, here. Like... um, like they don't really have... issues.
Overture to Despair#180.dst: 我根本没想到 {p} 会有抵抗组织……这里看起来那么……田园诗般美好。就好像……呃，就好像他们根本没有……问题。
Overture to Despair#180.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#181.src: But... I guess we don't know what life is like here... um, either way, if they're a resistance, they have to have intel.
Overture to Despair#181.dst: 不过……我想我们也不知道这里的生活是什么样子……呃，不管怎样，既然他们是抵抗组织，就一定有情报。
Overture to Despair#181.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#182.src: Here, hand me that newspaper. Okay... Column {~}... looks like today's phrase of the day is... "No such thing as a green Squirmle Pot?"
Overture to Despair#182.dst: 来，把那份报纸给我。好……第 {~} 栏……看来今天的每日一句是……“绿色的蠕蠕罐根本不存在？”
Overture to Despair#182.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#183.src: Weird. But... I guess nobody's going to guess it!
Overture to Despair#183.dst: 好奇怪。不过……我想没人猜得到吧！
Overture to Despair#183.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#184.src: Okay. Okay... th-this is happening! Majin Thalas, "number one" Sovereign, we're coming for you...
Overture to Despair#184.dst: 好。好……这——这真的要发生了！Majin Thalas，“第一”统领，我们来找你了……
Overture to Despair#184.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#185.src: I'm feeling a lot better now. Um... what should we do now, then? While we... wait for midnight.
Overture to Despair#185.dst: 我现在感觉好多了。呃……那我们现在该做什么呢？在我们……等午夜的时候。
Overture to Despair#185.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#186.src: Yes... um, thinking about it now, I guess I am kind of starving...
Overture to Despair#186.dst: 对……呃，现在想想，我好像有点饿坏了……
Overture to Despair#186.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#187.src: I remember seeing a restaurant earlier! Follow me.
Overture to Despair#187.dst: 我记得之前看到过一家餐厅！跟我来。
Overture to Despair#187.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#188.src: I... I guess I could use a nap...
Overture to Despair#188.dst: 我……我想我可以小睡一下……
Overture to Despair#188.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#189.src: Okay. I'll meet you in our room.
Overture to Despair#189.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#190.src: Head to the restaurant and wait at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#191.src: Oh... this is quite cozy, actually. It... it, ha, doesn't really... compare to the Red Fox... but it works.
Overture to Despair#191.dst: 噢……其实这里挺舒适的。它……它，哈，没法……跟赤狐比……不过也还行。
Overture to Despair#191.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#192.src: Maybe it's... better that it, isn't the same. I'm not sure I could...
Overture to Despair#192.dst: 也许……不一样，反而比较好。我不确定我能不能……
Overture to Despair#192.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#193.src: Hello, hello! Welcome to the Peacock Inn! What can I get started for you this evening?
Overture to Despair#193.dst: 你好，你好！欢迎光临孔雀旅馆！今晚要先帮您点些什么？
Overture to Despair#193.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#194.src: Today's special dishes are fish tacos, fish miso soup, and yak curry! All locally sourced from our lovely {p}, naturally.
Overture to Despair#194.dst: 今天的特色菜是鱼肉塔可、鱼肉味噌汤和牦牛咖喱！当然全都产自我们美丽的 {p}。
Overture to Despair#194.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#195.src: Um... I'll take the tacos, please.
Overture to Despair#195.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#196.src: Coming right up! It'll just be a few minutes.
Overture to Despair#196.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#197.src: ...it's nice here, isn't it? I hadn't... really let myself notice that before. I can see why people talk about the {p} so much...
Overture to Despair#197.dst: ……这里很好，对吧？我之前……一直没让自己注意到。我能明白为什么大家都那么爱谈论 {p} 了……
Overture to Despair#197.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#198.src: I'm... ugh. I'm still so angry. At... everything! The crown, the sovereigns, the... the people of {p}, too!! For... for still living their lives, even, even when it feels like the world's ended.
Overture to Despair#198.dst: 我……唉。我还是好生气。气……一切！王室、统领们、那……还有 {p} 的人们！！气他们……还照常过日子，即使，即使感觉世界已经末日了。
Overture to Despair#198.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#199.src: ...but we have some hope. F-finally. Rex and Zeph... there's still a chance we'll get to see them again.
Overture to Despair#199.dst: ……不过我们有希望了。终、终于。Rex 和 Zeph……我们还有机会再见到他们。
Overture to Despair#199.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#200.src: And... is it weird that I kind of miss the Canopy, too? Even though they were... annoying, and overbearing, and- and kind of... scary?
Overture to Despair#200.dst: 而且……我竟然有点想念树冠会，这奇怪吗？虽然他们……很烦、很强势，而——而且有点……吓人？
Overture to Despair#200.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#201.src: ...and Yusanu. I hope he's alright. I- I, ha, I really hope he can free his family too. I... I, um, don't want him to lose anyone either.
Overture to Despair#201.dst: ……还有 Yusanu。希望他没事。我——我，哈，我真的希望他也能救出他的家人。我……我，呃，不想他也失去任何人。
Overture to Despair#201.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#202.src: ...I hope he doesn't hate me. After what I said to him.
Overture to Despair#202.dst: ……希望他不恨我。在我对他说了那些话之后。
Overture to Despair#202.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#204.src: Um... while we wait. Is there anything you want to talk about?
Overture to Despair#204.dst: 趁我们在等。你有什么想聊的吗？
Overture to Despair#204.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#205.src: ...it's weird. It feels like the ocean is... raging. Thundering storms and crashing waves, and... and still, it doesn't feel like it's at risk of drowning me?
Overture to Despair#205.dst: ……好奇怪。感觉海洋在……狂暴翻腾。雷雨交加、巨浪拍打，而……而且，它却不像是会把我淹没？
Overture to Despair#205.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#206.src: Like... like I could take as much as I want and it wouldn't change a thing. And, ha, it scares me, a little. It's so... different, to how it was before, but...
Overture to Despair#206.dst: 就好像……好像我想取多少都行，而它一点都不会变。而且，哈，这让我有点害怕。跟以前那么……不一样，可是……
Overture to Despair#206.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#207.src: ...it feels right. Like this is how it always was supposed to be, and I just... didn't realize.
Overture to Despair#207.dst: ……感觉是对的。就好像它本来就该是这样，只是我……一直没发现。
Overture to Despair#207.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#208.src: Once it's... over...? I... I hadn't... let myself think about that...
Overture to Despair#208.dst: 等一切……结束之后……？我……我一直没……让自己去想那件事……
Overture to Despair#208.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#209.src: I, um. I actually... had a dream last night. But, ha, it was- it was just that. Just a dream.
Overture to Despair#209.dst: 我，呃。我昨晚其实……做了一个梦。不过，哈，那只是——只是个梦而已。
Overture to Despair#209.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#211.src: All of us... Rex, Zeph, the- the Roughworks boys... um, Mora, a-and Syndra... we were all laughing and, and having a good time at the Auburn Festival.
Overture to Despair#211.dst: 我们所有人……Rex、Zeph、那——那几个 Roughworks 的男孩……呃，Mora、还、还有 Syndra……我们都在 Auburn 庆典上笑着，玩，玩得很开心。
Overture to Despair#211.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#212.src: We ate good food... Yuman played music, while Rex and Zeph were b-bickering... Yusanu and Mora were t-talking about his latest invention, and...
Overture to Despair#212.dst: 我们吃着好吃的……Yuman 在弹音乐，Rex 和 Zeph 在拌、拌嘴……Yusanu 和 Mora 在聊、聊他最新的发明，然后……
Overture to Despair#212.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#214.src: When I... when I woke up, I- ha, I was c-crying. I- I know, I know! It's... stupid. It's stupid.
Overture to Despair#214.dst: 等我……等我醒来，我——哈，我在哭、哭。我——我知道，我知道！这……很蠢。这很蠢。
Overture to Despair#214.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#215.src: ...it's, um, hard to pick out one moment. She's been like a mother to me ever since I was... {~} years old.
Overture to Despair#215.dst: ……呃，很难挑出某一个时刻。从我……{~} 岁起，她就像我妈妈一样。
Overture to Despair#215.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#216.src: M-maybe the first time I really met her. After I discovered my... my gift, I thought my life was over.
Overture to Despair#216.dst: 也、也许是我第一次真正见到她的时候。在我发现了我的……我的天赋之后，我以为我的人生完了。
Overture to Despair#216.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#217.src: I- I was cursed! And I knew what h-happened to the cursed. Taken away, never to be seen again... or, or killed outright. I had nowhere to go.
Overture to Despair#217.dst: 我——我是受诅者！而我知道受诅者会发、发生什么事。被带走，再也不会出现……或者，或者直接被杀。我无处可去。
Overture to Despair#217.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#218.src: I, um... I'd seen Syndra around before. I... I knew she talked to Mora, before he... l-left our family. So... I, ha, I guess I thought... maybe she'd help me too.
Overture to Despair#218.dst: 我，呃……我以前见过 Syndra。我……我知道她跟 Mora 说过话，在他……离、离开我们家之前。所以……我，哈，我想说……也许她也会帮我。
Overture to Despair#218.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#219.src: A-and she did! She wasn't scared, she didn't report me. She just... embraced me in a hug and welcome me to her home.
Overture to Despair#219.dst: 而、而她真的帮了！她不害怕，她没有举报我。她只是……抱住了我，欢迎我到她家。
Overture to Despair#219.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#220.src: She, um, reunited me with Mora again. After... f-five long years alone. She... she saved me, and now... and now she's...
Overture to Despair#220.dst: 她，呃，让我跟 Mora 重逢了。在……五、五年孤零零的日子之后。她……她救了我，而现在……而现在她……
Overture to Despair#220.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#221.src: ...I never got to tell her how much she meant to me.
Overture to Despair#221.dst: ……我从来没机会告诉她，她对我有多重要。
Overture to Despair#221.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#225.src: And here we are with your orders! You fish tacos, young lady - sturgeon head packed with tangy cabbage, tossed in rice vinegar, crispy seaweed, and punchy umami sauce.
Overture to Despair#225.dst: 您点的餐来了！您的鱼肉塔可，小姐——鲟鱼头塞满酸甜包菜，拌上米醋、脆海苔，还有浓烈的鲜味酱汁。
Overture to Despair#225.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#226.src: And another order of fish tacos for you! Please, enjoy!
Overture to Despair#226.dst: 这里还有一份鱼肉塔可是您的！请慢用！
Overture to Despair#226.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#227.src: And for you, the Bubble Heckel Miso Soup! A hearty broth simmered with today's catch and miso paste that ties all the flavours together! Enjoy!
Overture to Despair#227.dst: 而这是您的泡泡赫克尔味噌汤！用今日渔获和味噌慢炖的浓郁汤底，把所有味道都融合在一起！请慢用！
Overture to Despair#227.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#228.src: And for you, the Yak Potato Curry! A rich, aromatic dish seasoned with wild heather. Tender yak meat and new potatoes! You're in for a treat!
Overture to Despair#228.dst: 而这是您的牦牛马铃薯咖喱！用野生石南花调味的浓郁香料料理。鲜嫩的牦牛肉配上新鲜马铃薯！您有口福了！
Overture to Despair#228.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#229.src: Um... so this is a taco...?
Overture to Despair#229.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#230.src: I, I guess I don't know what I expected, but... um. Not this.
Overture to Despair#230.dst: 我，我想我也不知道自己期待的是什么，不过……呃。不是这样。
Overture to Despair#230.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#232.src: Head back to your hotel room at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and get some rest before the meeting later.
Overture to Despair#232.dst: 回到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的酒店房间，在稍后的会议前休息一下。

Overture to Despair#233.src: Um... before we go to sleep... Is there anything you want to talk about?
Overture to Despair#233.dst: 呃……睡觉之前……你有什么想聊的吗？
Overture to Despair#233.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#250.dst: ……我从来没机会告诉她，她对我有多重要。
Overture to Despair#250.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#254.src: Return to the newspaper shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Overture to Despair#256.src: Oh, is it night time already...? We should get back to the newspaper merchant then.
Overture to Despair#256.dst: 噢，已经到晚上了吗……？那我们该回报贩那里了。
Overture to Despair#256.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#257.src: {u}, before we head in. Let's just... observe, a-and not ask too many questions.
Overture to Despair#257.dst: {u}，进去之前。我们就……观察就好，别、别问太多问题。
Overture to Despair#257.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#258.src: Ah, terribly sorry! We're just closing out for the day was on my way out the door. Oh did you find the paper to be enlightening?
Overture to Despair#258.dst: 啊，真是抱歉！我们今天正要收摊我正要出门。噢，你们觉得那份报纸有启发吗？
Overture to Despair#258.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#259.src: No such thing as a green Squirmle Pot.
Overture to Despair#259.dst: 绿色的蠕蠕罐根本不存在。
Overture to Despair#259.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#260.src: Good, good! Glad to hear you're interested in cutting through the weeds, hearing the stories that matter.
Overture to Despair#260.dst: 很好，很好！很高兴听到你们有兴趣拨开杂草，听听真正重要的故事。
Overture to Despair#260.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#261.src: The meeting will be shortly starting- take the stairs behind me, and head downwards.
Overture to Despair#261.dst: 会议马上就要开始了——走我后面的楼梯，往下走。
Overture to Despair#261.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#262.src: The meeting will be shortly starting- take the stairs behind me, and head downwards.
Overture to Despair#262.dst: 会议马上就要开始了——走我后面的楼梯，往下走。
Overture to Despair#262.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#263.src: That ought to be all of us. Let's begin, everyone!
Overture to Despair#263.dst: 应该都到齐了。我们开始吧，各位！
Overture to Despair#263.speaker: Resistance Member

Overture to Despair#264.src: We have some new members joining us today. Please welcome them to our society, The Blossom of Blades.
Overture to Despair#264.dst: 今天有新成员加入我们。请欢迎他们加入我们的团体，刃之花会。
Overture to Despair#264.speaker: Resistance Member

Overture to Despair#265.src: Now, Bleeding Rose. You were so excited to start us off earlier. You've been so quiet normally- how about you share first today?
Overture to Despair#265.dst: 那么，泣血玫瑰。你刚才那么想先开始。你平常都那么安静——今天你先分享怎么样？
Overture to Despair#265.speaker: Resistance Member

Overture to Despair#266.src: ...thank you, Dusk Garden. I...I think this is pretty alarming, actually... Comparing the prices day to day, bread suddenly spiked. {~} more than just a week ago, with no word of warning.
Overture to Despair#266.dst: ……谢谢你，黄昏庭园。我……我觉得这其实挺令人担忧的……逐日比较价格，面包突然涨了。比一周前贵了 {~}，完全没有预警。
Overture to Despair#266.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#267.src: I'm not sure what we can...really do about that, but shouldn't we...y-y'know... ... ...do... ...something...?
Overture to Despair#267.dst: 我不确定我们能……真的怎么办，可是我们不是应该……那个……………做点……………什么吗……？
Overture to Despair#267.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#268.src: Ugh, again? It isn't an unlivable increase yet, but the poorer among us will definitely be feeling that. Thank you for speaking up, now it's someone else's turn.
Overture to Despair#268.dst: 唉，又来了？现在还不算涨到活不下去，不过我们之中比较穷的人肯定会有感觉。谢谢你说出来，现在换别人了。
Overture to Despair#268.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#270.src: Psst. What the hell is going on here?
Overture to Despair#270.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#272.src: Oh, oh! The news from {p}!! It's- well, I don't know if it's a disaster, or a good thing, really!
Overture to Despair#272.dst: 噢，噢！{p} 那边的消息！！那是——嗯，我也不知道那算是灾难还是好事！
Overture to Despair#272.speaker: Thorn Blade

Overture to Despair#273.src: Well, I barely had time to read the Aelumia Times to get the passcode. Fill me in, would you?
Overture to Despair#273.dst: 嗯，我差点来不及读《Aelumia 时报》拿暗号。跟我说说，好吗？
Overture to Despair#273.speaker: Crimson Dagger

Overture to Despair#274.src: This wasn't in the Aelumia Times... Anonymous sources have stated that Sovereign Soosu defied Her Majesty, openly!!
Overture to Despair#274.dst: 这可不在《Aelumia 时报》上……匿名消息来源称，Soosu 统领公然违抗了女王陛下！！
Overture to Despair#274.speaker: Thorn Blade

Overture to Despair#276.src: What- What do you mean?! Defied, like...went off-script during a speech, or-
Overture to Despair#276.dst: 什——什么意思？！违抗，是像……在演讲时脱稿，还是——
Overture to Despair#276.speaker: Crimson Dagger

Overture to Despair#277.src: She allowed terrorists to escape! At least three of them, according to my sources! Word is, too, that... That she was... Executed!!
Overture to Despair#277.dst: 她放走了恐怖分子！根据我的消息来源，至少有三个！还有传言说，她……她被……处决了！！
Overture to Despair#277.speaker: Thorn Blade

Overture to Despair#278.src: I- You guys! A Sovereign went against the Queen! What...what do you think that means, for us? what do you think we should do? If she can do something that big-
Overture to Despair#278.dst: 我——你们！有统领违抗了女王！那……那对我们来说代表什么？你们觉得我们该怎么做？如果她都能做出那么大的事——
Overture to Despair#278.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#279.src: And get executed for it?! Then who would do the work we do? Soosu has always been a bit of a loose cannon anyways. It isn't that surprising.
Overture to Despair#279.dst: 然后被处决？！那谁来做我们做的事？Soosu 本来就有点不受控。这也不怎么让人意外。
Overture to Despair#279.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#281.src: In other news! Sovereign Majin was supposedly seen with an unknown man this Saturday. They were out on a walk, but we all know what that really means.
Overture to Despair#281.dst: 还有其他消息！据说有人看到 Majin 统领这个星期六跟一个陌生男子在一起。他们在散步，不过我们都知道那代表什么。
Overture to Despair#281.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#282.src: -up for you next time, Rose- Ah. That- I heard that was just a new servant. Nothing too important.
Overture to Despair#282.dst: ——下次换你，玫瑰——啊。那个——我听说那只是个新来的仆人。没什么大不了的。
Overture to Despair#282.speaker: Wilted Camellia

Overture to Despair#283.src: Well, I'll be publishing it in the Majin Monthly anyways. Maybe I could spin a scandal out of this one! ...probably not, but you never know.
Overture to Despair#283.dst: 嗯，反正我还是会登在《Majin 月刊》上。说不定能炒出个丑闻！……大概不行，不过谁知道呢。
Overture to Despair#283.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#284.src: Um... I actually had a question about Sovereign Majin.
Overture to Despair#284.dst: 呃……其实我有个关于 Majin 统领的问题。
Overture to Despair#284.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#285.src: Oh, absolutely! I keep tabs on him, so you could consider me an expert on all things Majin, uh...miss...what was your code name again?
Overture to Despair#285.dst: 噢，当然！我一直在关注他，所以你可以把我当成 Majin 百事通，呃……小姐……你的代号是什么来着？
Overture to Despair#285.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#286.src: Oh, my... code... name... um. Right. It's- Water Grass. That's my name.
Overture to Despair#286.dst: 噢，我的……代……号……呃。对。是——水草。那是我的名字。
Overture to Despair#286.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#287.src: ...alright. That... That doesn't follow our naming scheme perfectly but- You know, whatever. What's your question?
Overture to Despair#287.dst: ……好吧。那……那不太符合我们的命名规则，不过——你知道吗，随便啦。你的问题是什么？
Overture to Despair#287.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#288.src: I... um, I heard a rumor that he'd picked up some prisoners from the {p}.
Overture to Despair#288.dst: 我……呃，我听说他从 {p} 带走了一些囚犯。
Overture to Despair#288.speaker: "Water Grass"

Overture to Despair#289.src: Ah! You spoiled my juicy scoop for tomorrow's edition! Yes, the rumour is true.
Overture to Despair#289.dst: 啊！你把我明天那期的独家爆料剧透了！对，传言是真的。
Overture to Despair#289.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#290.src: Supposedly, he took these prisoners to his castle in the east. There is, according to other rumour, a dungeon underneath it. It'd make sense- why wouldn't a dictator have a dungeon for dissidents?
Overture to Despair#290.dst: 据说他把那些囚犯带到了他东边的城堡。根据另一个传言，城堡底下有座地牢。说得通——独裁者怎么会没有关异见者的地牢？
Overture to Despair#290.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#291.src: R-really? What else do you know?
Overture to Despair#291.dst: 真、真的吗？你还知道什么？
Overture to Despair#291.speaker: "Water Grass"

Overture to Despair#292.src: That there were specifically two prisoners, and, to bring it back around to Thorn Blade's news, that they're part of the {p} Terrorists! Because of that, the guard around House Thalas is particularly tight recently.
Overture to Despair#292.dst: 具体来说有两个囚犯，而且，回到荆棘之刃的消息，他们是 {p} 恐怖分子的一员！因此，Thalas 家族最近的守卫特别森严。
Overture to Despair#292.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#293.src: Incidentally, I was planning on selling this piece to the Aelumia Times. So, don't any of you go writing in before me.
Overture to Despair#293.dst: 顺带一提，我本来打算把这篇卖给《Aelumia 时报》。所以，你们谁都别抢在我前面投稿。
Overture to Despair#293.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#294.src: Well, ah, I heard one of them was that runaway House Athassa girl! Remember the tabloids a few years ago? It was a whole scandal.
Overture to Despair#294.dst: 嗯，啊，我听说其中一个是那个离家出走的 Athassa 家族女孩！还记得几年前的小报吗？闹得满城风雨。
Overture to Despair#294.speaker: Wilted Camellia

Overture to Despair#295.src: Goodness, Boundless Cherry's sister? I hadn't realized she was involved! Tsk, what a shame that reason doesn't run in the family.
Overture to Despair#295.dst: 天哪，无垠樱桃的妹妹？我都不知道她也有份！啧，可惜理智不是家族遗传啊。
Overture to Despair#295.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#296.src: What does it matter?! You never shut up about the "one that got away," and- and there's so much more important to b-
Overture to Despair#296.dst: 那有什么关系？！你老是说个不停那个“跑掉的那个”，而——而明明还有那么多更重要的事要——
Overture to Despair#296.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#297.src: I do not! Crimson Dagger, please, back me up-
Overture to Despair#297.dst: 我才没有！猩红匕首，拜托，帮我说句话——
Overture to Despair#297.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#298.src: What are we going to DO?! We just- I came here because I thought together we-
Overture to Despair#298.dst: 我们到底要怎么做？！我们就只是——我来这里是因为我以为大家一起——
Overture to Despair#298.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#299.src: Ah! Ah ah!! Did you guys hear that we aren't getting any freebies this festival? This is absolutely appalling.
Overture to Despair#299.dst: 啊！啊啊！！你们听说这次庆典没有免费赠品了吗？这简直太离谱了。
Overture to Despair#299.speaker: Wilted Camellia

Overture to Despair#302.src: ...shoot! Me and... um, Shadow Bush... forgot to turn off the stove! We'll, um, see you guys at the next meeting! May we reveal secrets buried and bring change!
Overture to Despair#302.dst: ……糟了！我跟……呃，暗影灌木……忘了关炉子！我们，呃，下次会议见！愿我们揭开埋藏的秘密，带来变革！
Overture to Despair#302.speaker: "Water Grass"

Overture to Despair#303.src: Uhm- it's "May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change..." People never get it right-
Overture to Despair#303.dst: 呃——是“愿我们发掘久埋的真相，带来变革……”大家老是说错——
Overture to Despair#303.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#304.src: She's going to do something! I, I know she's going to- I have to- Guys, can't you see th-
Overture to Despair#304.dst: 她要去做点什么了！我，我知道她要去——我得——大家，你们难道看不出——
Overture to Despair#304.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#305.src: You don't know that! And if you try and convince her to, we won't be having you here anymore! Enough about this, do you have any kind of plan?
Overture to Despair#305.dst: 你又不知道！要是你想劝她那么做，我们就不欢迎你来了！这件事说够了，你到底有没有什么计划？
Overture to Despair#305.speaker: Crimson Dagger

Overture to Despair#306.src: Every time I try and think of one, I get shut down! I know I don't have much, but...but, if we work toge-
Overture to Despair#306.dst: 每次我想提出计划就被驳回！我知道我没什么，可是……可是，如果我们齐心协——
Overture to Despair#306.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#307.src: Enough of that already, Bleeding Rose! We can't reveal the secrets of the monarchy if we're imprisoned! And don't even try to say "what secrets?" This is big news!!
Overture to Despair#307.dst: 够了，泣血玫瑰！要是被关起来，我们就没法揭露君主统治的秘密了！而且别想说“什么秘密？”这可是大新闻！！
Overture to Despair#307.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#308.src: Speak with Sui outside the Newspaper Shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#308.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的报摊外面与 Sui 交谈。

Overture to Despair#310.src: I... wanted to stay for the whole meeting. But after that, I... I couldn't.
Overture to Despair#310.dst: 我……本来想待到会议结束的。可是那之后，我……我实在待不下去。
Overture to Despair#310.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#311.src: We know where they are. We know where to find them!
Overture to Despair#311.dst: 我们知道他们在哪里了。我们知道去哪里找他们了！
Overture to Despair#311.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#312.src: I didn't realize all their names would be so... weird and edgy. I had to come up with something! Just be glad it wasn't something worse, okay?
