Queen's Recruit#378.src: If you're looking for the tournament arena, go down this corridor then turn to the left.
Queen's Recruit#378.dst: 如果你在找锦标赛的竞技场，沿着这条走廊走，然后左转。
Queen's Recruit#378.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#379.src: The tournament arena is further down the corridor.
Queen's Recruit#379.dst: 锦标赛的竞技场在走廊更里面。
Queen's Recruit#379.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#380.src: This area is unfortunately not accessible at this moment.
Queen's Recruit#380.dst: 很抱歉，这个区域目前无法进入。
Queen's Recruit#380.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#381.src: This is Her Majesty's own personal quarter.
Queen's Recruit#381.dst: 这里是女王陛下的私人寝宫。
Queen's Recruit#381.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#382.src: I'm afraid I can't let you in just yet. Not until
Queen's Recruit#382.dst: 恐怕我现在还不能让你进去。要等到——
Queen's Recruit#382.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#383.src: Yes, yes, my research notes, I am aware. It has been sorted already. May I visit the library now?
Queen's Recruit#383.dst: 是，是，我的研究笔记，我知道。已经处理好了。我现在可以去图书馆了吗？
Queen's Recruit#383.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#384.src: Don't interrupt me. You can't enter until this round of tournament matches concludes. Her Majesty's orders.
Queen's Recruit#384.dst: 别打断我。这一轮锦标赛比赛结束之前，你不能进去。这是女王陛下的命令。
Queen's Recruit#384.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#385.src: Pah. Fine! Fine, yes, I'll wait. Good grief.
Queen's Recruit#385.dst: 哼。好吧！好吧，行，我等。真是的。
Queen's Recruit#385.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#386.src: You'd think I would have some level of freedom, but no! What does it matter if I don't want to watch the matches if there's nothing else to do?!
Queen's Recruit#386.dst: 你还以为我能有点自由，结果没有！如果没别的事可做，我不想看比赛又有什么关系？！
Queen's Recruit#386.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#387.src: Oh, just go and get your match over with. Quit stalling.
Queen's Recruit#387.dst: 哦，快去把你的比赛打完吧。别拖拖拉拉的。
Queen's Recruit#387.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#389.src: Just head down these stairs to find the tournament arena.
Queen's Recruit#389.dst: 沿着这道楼梯下去，就能找到锦标赛的竞技场。
Queen's Recruit#389.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#390.src: The match ups will be announced once everyone is present.
Queen's Recruit#390.dst: 等所有人到齐后，就会公布对战组合。
Queen's Recruit#390.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#391.src: Uh. Sovereign... Majin? Sovereign Majin. We're all here.
Queen's Recruit#391.dst: 呃。统领……Majin？Majin 统领。我们都到了。
Queen's Recruit#391.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#392.src: My, it's about time! As guests of the crown, it would do you well to arrive on time for such things, hm? Tardiness is not a good look.
Queen's Recruit#392.dst: 哎呀，也该到了！身为王室的宾客，这种场合准时到场才得体，嗯？迟到可不好看。
Queen's Recruit#392.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#393.src: Our apologies, Sovereign. It would seem we were not given the time to be here in advance a humble mistake, I'm certain.
Queen's Recruit#393.dst: 非常抱歉，统领。看来我们事先没被告知时间——我相信只是个无心之失。
Queen's Recruit#393.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#394.src: Ah, the incompetence of our lessers... it never ceases to amaze! Nevertheless, the duty of arriving on schedule remains on your shoulders. Do better next time, would you?
Queen's Recruit#394.dst: 啊，底下人的无能……真是永远令人叹为观止！不过，准时到场的责任仍然在你们肩上。下次做好一点，行吗？
Queen's Recruit#394.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#395.src: Now, I am a very busy man, so I will keep this brief. As Her Majesty has already explained, this tournament will consist of multiple duels! You are not required to watch each match.
Queen's Recruit#395.dst: 好了，我是个大忙人，所以长话短说。正如女王陛下所说，这场锦标赛由多场决斗组成！你们不必每场都看。
Queen's Recruit#395.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#396.src: The standard rules apply. No killing, no maiming, no attacking anyone outside the arena - though, do try, I'd find much pleasure in watching you fail!
Queen's Recruit#396.dst: 规则照旧。不准杀人，不准致残，不准攻击竞技场外的任何人——不过，尽管试试吧，看着你们失败会让我非常愉快！
Queen's Recruit#396.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#397.src: With that settled, are there any questions? I would certainly hope not, I have much to return to once this is
Queen's Recruit#397.dst: 那就这么定了，还有问题吗？我当然希望没有，等这里结束我还有一大堆事要——
Queen's Recruit#397.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#398.src: Ah, I do I am not participating in the tournament. I had been told to expect some alternative today.
Queen's Recruit#398.dst: 啊，我有——我不参加锦标赛。有人跟我说今天会有别的安排。
Queen's Recruit#398.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#399.src: Oh, yes... you. What did you say you were again, a... researcher?
Queen's Recruit#399.dst: 哦，对……你。你说你是干什么的来着，一个……研究员？
Queen's Recruit#399.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#400.src: Ahahaha! Oh, and they selected you as one of your province's greatest? Don't make me laugh! Ahahahahaha!
Queen's Recruit#400.dst: 啊哈哈哈！哦，他们居然把你选为你们行省最优秀的人之一？别逗我笑了！啊哈哈哈哈哈！
Queen's Recruit#400.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#401.src: Ah, but it's just as well, I suppose. Nine certainly doesn't fit cleanly for such a tournament. Better a researcher than a ninth fighter!
Queen's Recruit#401.dst: 啊，不过这样也好吧。九个人办这种锦标赛本来就不好分组。与其来个第九名战士，还不如来个研究员！
Queen's Recruit#401.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#402.src: Yes, someone will be with you shortly. Just sit on the sidelines and twiddle your thumbs, or whatever you do you certainly aren't my problem anymore.
Queen's Recruit#402.dst: 是的，很快就会有人来找你。你就坐在场边玩玩手指，或者随便做什么——反正你已经不关我的事了。
Queen's Recruit#402.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#405.src: Excellent! The first match up appears to be... {u} and Mel. Step forward, the two of you.
Queen's Recruit#405.dst: 太好了！第一场对战组合是……{u} 和 Mel。你们两个上前来。
Queen's Recruit#405.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#408.src: Well, hurry up now, get prepared! Choose a corridor each, north or south, and get to fighting already!
Queen's Recruit#408.dst: 好了，快点，去准备！各选一条走廊，北边或南边，然后赶快开打！
Queen's Recruit#408.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#409.src: As for the rest of you... oh, I can't be bothered. Read your matchups on the board yourselves.
Queen's Recruit#409.dst: 至于你们其他人……哦，我懒得管了。自己去看板子上的对战组合。
Queen's Recruit#409.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#410.src: Uh... alrighty then. I guess I'll choose this one.
Queen's Recruit#410.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#411.src: Begin your fight against Mel in the southern waiting room.
Queen's Recruit#411.dst: 在南边的等候室开始与 Mel 的战斗。

Queen's Recruit#413.src: Just 'cause we've got a mission here, doesn't mean I'll go easy on ya!
Queen's Recruit#413.dst: 别以为我们有任务在身，我就会手下留情！
Queen's Recruit#413.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#414.src: Ready to go?! Let's show them what we're made of!
Queen's Recruit#414.dst: 准备好了吗？！让他们看看我们的本事！
Queen's Recruit#414.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#415.src: Phew! What a fight! Got my blood rushin'!
Queen's Recruit#415.dst: 呼！好一场战斗！打得我热血沸腾！
Queen's Recruit#415.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#416.src: What'd you think of my trick? Pretty good, right? Makes me less of a sittin' duck in combat!
Queen's Recruit#416.dst: 你觉得我那招怎么样？挺不错吧？这样打起来我就不会是个活靶子了！
Queen's Recruit#416.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#417.src: Ah, I didn't think I was gonna be winnin' anything, really. But it was fun givin' it a shot.
Queen's Recruit#417.dst: 啊，我本来就没想过要赢什么啦。不过试试看还挺好玩的。
Queen's Recruit#417.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#418.src: {u} has bested Mel in the first round, and will progress to the next!
Queen's Recruit#418.dst: {u} 在第一轮击败了 Mel，晋级下一轮！
Queen's Recruit#418.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#420.src: You will be permitted to remain in the palace for the duration of the tournament. You will be paid for your participation at the end of your stay.
Queen's Recruit#420.dst: 锦标赛期间，你可以留在皇宫。参赛的报酬会在你离开时支付。
Queen's Recruit#420.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#421.src: I figure that makes sense. I wonder when Lanu's match is...
Queen's Recruit#421.dst: 我想这也说得通。不知道 Lanu 的比赛是什么时候……
Queen's Recruit#421.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#422.src: {u}, congratulations on your victory. You will be notified when your next match is. In the meantime, feel free to rest.
Queen's Recruit#422.dst: {u}，恭喜你获胜。下一场比赛的时间会另行通知。在此期间，请随意休息。
Queen's Recruit#422.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#423.src: Leave the arena waiting room and find Picard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#423.dst: 离开竞技场等候室，到 [-{~}, {~}, {~}] 找 Picard。

Queen's Recruit#424.src: It was a good fight! But you'd better win in my honor now, y'hear?
Queen's Recruit#424.dst: 打得真好！不过你现在可得替我赢下去，听到没？
Queen's Recruit#424.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#425.src: We will announce your next match later. Please feel free to rest or enjoy the palace in the meantime.
Queen's Recruit#425.dst: 我们稍后会公布你的下一场比赛。在此期间，请随意休息或在皇宫里走走。
Queen's Recruit#425.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#426.src: Ah, {u}, I saw the match! Very good technique, better than many soldiers I've seen pass through {p} in my time.
Queen's Recruit#426.dst: 啊，{u}，我看了比赛！技巧非常好，比我这些年在 {p} 看过的许多士兵都强。
Queen's Recruit#426.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#427.src: I suppose I'm not surprised! When the tournament was announced, you came to mind as a potential winner. You, and one other person, that is.
Queen's Recruit#427.dst: 我想我并不意外！锦标赛一宣布，我就想到你可能会夺冠。你，还有另外一个人。
Queen's Recruit#427.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#428.src: Hm... maybe I could start taking bets on who will win... ah, no, no, I'm far too busy. Stay focused, Picard.
Queen's Recruit#428.dst: 嗯……也许我可以开个赌局，赌谁会赢……啊，不，不，我太忙了。专心点，Picard。
Queen's Recruit#428.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#429.src: Hm? Oh dear, I'd forgotten you were here! Yes, I was going to do something...
Queen's Recruit#429.dst: 嗯？哎呀，我都忘了你在这儿！对，我本来要去做件事……
Queen's Recruit#429.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#430.src: Oh! The library! Can you believe it, that damnable guard finally stepped away! It's ridiculous, really who even cares to guard a library of all things?!
Queen's Recruit#430.dst: 哦！图书馆！你敢相信吗，那个该死的守卫终于走开了！真是荒唐——到底谁会去守一座图书馆啊？！
Queen's Recruit#430.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#431.src: But. But but but. The way is open, and although the tournament round is still ongoing, I'd like to take the opportunity while I can!
Queen's Recruit#431.dst: 不过。不过不过不过。路已经通了，虽然这一轮锦标赛还在进行，我还是想趁机会去看看！
Queen's Recruit#431.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#432.src: Care to join me? I'm sure there's something you'll find interesting in there. What sorts of knowledge have the Frumans kept hidden in these walls...
Queen's Recruit#432.dst: 要一起来吗？我相信里面一定有你会感兴趣的东西。Fruma 人在这些墙里藏了些什么知识……
Queen's Recruit#432.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#433.src: Well, are you coming? Come now, quickly, before the guard returns!
Queen's Recruit#433.dst: 怎么样，你来不来？快来，快点，趁守卫还没回来！
Queen's Recruit#433.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#434.dst: 跟着 Picard 进入图书馆。

Queen's Recruit#435.src: Goodness, where to even begin? There's so much here...
Queen's Recruit#435.dst: 天哪，从哪里开始才好？这里的东西太多了……
Queen's Recruit#435.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#436.src: I hereby introduce to you The Evermoving Zephyr, the ruler of the {p}, the latest in the line of one of Fruma's great noble houses! His lordship, Sovereign Zhiraok Nasin!
Queen's Recruit#436.dst: 在此向各位介绍永动之风、{p} 的统治者、Fruma 名门望族之一的最新继承人！大人阁下，君主 Zhiraok Nasin！

Queen's Recruit#437.src: ...and that we're rifling through the Cursed instead of our own citizens is an incalculable risk!
Queen's Recruit#437.dst: ……而且我们在受诅者里翻找，而不是在自己的国民里找，这是个无法估算的风险！

Queen's Recruit#438.src: What was that?! Quickly, quickly now, follow me!
Queen's Recruit#438.dst: 那是什么？！快，快点，跟我来！
Queen's Recruit#438.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#439.src: Do you have eyes on the speaker? Who is it?
Queen's Recruit#439.dst: 你看得到说话的人吗？是谁？
Queen's Recruit#439.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#440.src: I can't find her angle for this hunt.
Queen's Recruit#440.dst: 我算不出她这次物色人选的角度。
Queen's Recruit#440.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#441.src: Ah, it's like I'm talking with her again! It's so nostalgic to speak with a clueless Nasin trying their hardest, in spite of their incompe
Queen's Recruit#441.dst: 啊，就好像我又在跟她说话一样！看一个毫无头绪的 Nasin 拼尽全力，却还是那么无能，真让人怀念——
Queen's Recruit#441.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#442.src: I'M SORRY, YOU IGNORANT INTEGRAND? You really think now is the time for- Rrgh... Why. Do I even bother.
Queen's Recruit#442.dst: 你说什么，你这个无知的被积函数？你真以为现在是——啧……我到底何必呢。
Queen's Recruit#442.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#443.src: Why, indeed! It truly is a bad habit. Something to work on while your seniors do the important work, hm?
Queen's Recruit#443.dst: 说得是啊，何必呢！这真是个坏习惯。趁你的前辈在做重要工作的时候，好好改一改吧，嗯？
Queen's Recruit#443.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#444.src: Speaking of, I must put forth that I do find this all a bit strange. We most certainly aren't lacking in strength here, so why bother with the exiles?
Queen's Recruit#444.dst: 说到这个，我得说我确实觉得这一切有点奇怪。我们这里显然不缺战力，何必去找那些流放者？
Queen's Recruit#444.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#445.src: ...sigh... The risk factor is much greater than I'd bet on. She has to know more than we do, so maybe we'll get a summation later.
Queen's Recruit#445.dst: ……唉……这风险系数比我愿意押注的高多了。她一定知道得比我们多，也许之后我们会拿到一份总结。
Queen's Recruit#445.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#447.src: Ah, there she is. Fashionably late as always!
Queen's Recruit#447.dst: 啊，她来了。一如往常地姗姗来迟！
Queen's Recruit#447.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#448.src: Hm. If anything, I was early.
Queen's Recruit#448.dst: 嗯。要说的话，我还早到了。

Queen's Recruit#449.src: I'd say your timing was golden- if you're here for that summation I mentioned, and this isn't anything else.
Queen's Recruit#449.dst: 如果你是来给我刚才说的那份总结，而不是别的事，那我得说你的时机抓得正好。
Queen's Recruit#449.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#450.src: It's the former. But first, have you been watching the battles? Do any of the contestants stick out to you?
Queen's Recruit#450.dst: 是前者。不过首先，你们一直在看比赛吗？参赛者里有谁让你们印象深刻的？

Queen's Recruit#451.src: Stick out? Hardly. Thus far, I have been thoroughly unimpressed.
Queen's Recruit#451.dst: 印象深刻？几乎没有。到目前为止，我完全不为所动。
Queen's Recruit#451.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#452.src: Naturally you would be. I've seen some generally promising things, but I need to know the expected solution to narrow the pool
Queen's Recruit#452.dst: 你当然会这么说。我看到了一些大体上有潜力的东西，但我需要知道期望解，才能缩小范围——
Queen's Recruit#452.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#453.src: Ah, ah! Settle down, Nasin, your betters are speaking. Calculate yourself out of dead last, first.
Queen's Recruit#453.dst: 啊，啊！冷静点，Nasin，你的前辈在说话。先把自己从倒数第一算出来再说。
Queen's Recruit#453.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#454.src: Later, then. We have problems. The contestants have been sneaking around. And the doctor has been taking meticulous notes.
Queen's Recruit#454.dst: 那就之后再说。我们有麻烦了。参赛者一直在偷偷摸摸地四处活动。而那位博士一直在一丝不苟地做笔记。

Queen's Recruit#455.src: ...looks like you letting him sit out the problem was a miscalculation, huh?
Queen's Recruit#455.dst: ……看来你让他不用参赛，是个计算失误啊？
Queen's Recruit#455.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#456.src: For once, we appear to be in agreement. What a pity, what a hassle... it hardly seems worth the effort to me.
Queen's Recruit#456.dst: 难得我们意见一致。真可惜，真麻烦……在我看来根本不值得费这个劲。
Queen's Recruit#456.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#457.src: It will be. But I've spent too much time here already. You'll have to wait for answers.
Queen's Recruit#457.dst: 会值得的。但我在这里已经待太久了。答案你们得等。

Queen's Recruit#458.src: Of course. How much more irrational can we get, I wonder.
Queen's Recruit#458.dst: 当然。不知道还能多不合理。
Queen's Recruit#458.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#459.src: If you'd like something to look out for, one of the more promising candidates is set to have a match soon. Go watch it.
Queen's Recruit#459.dst: 如果你们想找点东西留意，有位比较有潜力的人选很快就有一场比赛。去看看吧。

Queen's Recruit#460.src: A joy as always. Well, you heard her, Nasin! Chop chop, off to the stands we go!
Queen's Recruit#460.dst: 一如往常地令人愉快。好了，你听到她说的了，Nasin！快快快，我们去看台！
Queen's Recruit#460.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#461.src: ...so not even the Sovereigns know what's happening. Fascinating. Very fascinating.
Queen's Recruit#461.dst: ……所以连统领都不知道是怎么回事。有意思。非常有意思。
Queen's Recruit#461.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#462.src: And there was a third! Who were they? Another Sovereign...? Damn it, damn it all, how did I not notice?
Queen's Recruit#462.dst: 而且还有第三个人！那是谁？另一位统领……？该死，全都该死，我怎么会没注意到？
Queen's Recruit#462.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#463.src: Well, they appear to be onto us. No matter. We'll need to be more careful.
Queen's Recruit#463.dst: 好吧，他们似乎已经盯上我们了。无所谓。我们得更加小心。
Queen's Recruit#463.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#464.src: You'd best get back to the arena. In the meantime, I'll keep searching here... there must be something useful!
Queen's Recruit#464.dst: 你最好回竞技场去。在此期间，我会继续在这里找……一定有什么有用的东西！
Queen's Recruit#464.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#466.src: ...hm? Oh, yes, fine, I'll tell the rest about what we heard. After I'm done here, of course.
Queen's Recruit#466.dst: ……嗯？哦，对，好，我会把我们听到的事告诉其他人。当然，等我在这里忙完之后。
Queen's Recruit#466.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#467.src: The first round of the tournament has concluded!
Queen's Recruit#467.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#468.src: The names that will proceed to the next round... {u}! Tasim! Reynauld! Kymer!
Queen's Recruit#468.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#469.src: {u}, your match will begin shortly. Your opponent is already in the waiting room.
Queen's Recruit#469.dst: {u}，你的比赛马上就要开始了。你的对手已经在等候室了。
Queen's Recruit#469.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#470.src: Make your way to the arena.
Queen's Recruit#470.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#471.src: Begin your next duel in the arena down the stairs.
Queen's Recruit#471.dst: 在楼梯下方的竞技场开始你的下一场决斗。

Queen's Recruit#472.src: Please make your way to the arena by following the stairs down.
Queen's Recruit#472.dst: 请沿着楼梯往下走，前往竞技场。
Queen's Recruit#472.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#473.src: Please go to the waiting room and prepare for the battle.
Queen's Recruit#473.dst: 请前往等候室，为战斗做好准备。
Queen's Recruit#473.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#475.src: Well, you'll likely prove more of a challenge than Linton, that's for sure.
Queen's Recruit#475.dst: 嗯，你肯定会比 Linton 更难对付，这是确定的。
Queen's Recruit#475.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#476.src: You've come a long way since {p}, haven't you? Well, so have I! Let's battle.
Queen's Recruit#476.dst: 从 {p} 那时到现在，你进步了很多，对吧？嗯，我也是！开战吧。
Queen's Recruit#476.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#477.src: The battle is decided! {u} has come out victorious.
Queen's Recruit#477.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#478.src: Ah... good fighting, {u}. I even used some of my most powerful arrows.
Queen's Recruit#478.dst: 啊……打得好，{u}。我连一些最强的箭都用上了。
Queen's Recruit#478.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#480.src: I know, I know. You were a worthy opponent, {u}. Now, you'll be winning this whole thing, yes?
Queen's Recruit#480.dst: 我知道，我知道。你是个值得尊敬的对手，{u}。现在，你会赢下整个锦标赛的，对吧？
Queen's Recruit#480.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#481.src: {u}, congratulations on reaching the finals. All other opponents have been defeated, except for you and your fellow finalist.
Queen's Recruit#481.dst: {u}，恭喜你进入决赛。除了你和另一位决赛选手，其他对手都已经被击败。
Queen's Recruit#481.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#482.src: Hmph. That will be announced shortly. Please make your way to the courtyard and await further instructions.
Queen's Recruit#482.dst: 哼。那会很快公布。请前往庭院，等候进一步指示。
Queen's Recruit#482.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#483.src: Return to the courtyard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}] and find other contestants.
Queen's Recruit#483.dst: 回到 [-{~}, {~}, {~}] 的庭院，找到其他参赛者。

Queen's Recruit#484.src: I did well enough, I suppose. I'll be glad for this to all be over, anyway.
Queen's Recruit#484.dst: 我想我表现得还算可以。不管怎样，我会很高兴这一切结束。
Queen's Recruit#484.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#485.src: Please make your way to the courtyard and await further instructions.
Queen's Recruit#485.dst: 请前往庭院，等候进一步指示。
Queen's Recruit#485.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#486.src: {u}, you return! Well, how did your match go?
Queen's Recruit#486.dst: {u}，你回来了！怎么样，你的比赛打得如何？
Queen's Recruit#486.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#487.src: You? I suppose that would make sense. No offense intended, Reynauld, but I would have bet on {u} if I had the chance.
Queen's Recruit#487.dst: 你？我想这也说得通。无意冒犯，Reynauld，但要是有机会，我也会押 {u}。
Queen's Recruit#487.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#488.src: Ha. For me, certainly! It felt like I could barely make a dent in your stamina.
Queen's Recruit#488.dst: 哈。赢我的话，那当然！感觉我根本没法消耗你多少体力。
Queen's Recruit#488.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#489.src: Yes, yes, congratulations are in order, and all that we have problems.
Queen's Recruit#489.dst: 是，是，是该恭喜，诸如此类——我们有麻烦了。
Queen's Recruit#489.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#490.src: It was problem enough that he was called here in the first place... to think, he could
Queen's Recruit#490.dst: 他一开始被叫来这里就已经够麻烦了……想想看，他居然可能——
Queen's Recruit#490.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#491.src: That is enough about the tournament. I don't want to hear about it anymore. The doctor is right.
Queen's Recruit#491.dst: 锦标赛的事说够了。我不想再听了。博士说得对。
Queen's Recruit#491.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#492.src: Yes, well, it's not your honour on the line... but fine, I admit, this third Sovereign is... troubling.
Queen's Recruit#492.dst: 是啊，嗯，赌上的又不是你的荣誉……但好吧，我承认，这第三位统领……令人不安。
Queen's Recruit#492.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#493.src: Hm. Have we been able to find the information we needed?
Queen's Recruit#493.dst: 嗯。我们找到需要的情报了吗？
Queen's Recruit#493.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#494.src: No! And that is precisely our problem we are missing something, and we are running out of time! One final match, and then it's done.
Queen's Recruit#494.dst: 没有！这正是我们的问题——我们漏掉了什么，而时间快不够了！再一场决赛，然后就结束了。
Queen's Recruit#494.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#495.src: ...truthfully, I'm surprised you were on my side for that match.
Queen's Recruit#495.dst: ……说实话，那场比赛你站在我这边，我挺意外的。
Queen's Recruit#495.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#496.src: Ah, well, someone had t' take him down a peg! Guess that someone was you.
Queen's Recruit#496.dst: 啊，这个嘛，总得有人挫挫他的锐气！看来那个人就是你。
Queen's Recruit#496.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#497.src: Oh, give me a break, lieutenant. Him? Of all people to
Queen's Recruit#497.dst: 哦，饶了我吧，中尉。他？偏偏是他——
Queen's Recruit#497.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#498.src: Hey, everyone's here! Is... this where they wanted everyone to gather up?
Queen's Recruit#498.dst: 嘿，大家都在！这……就是他们要大家集合的地方吗？
Queen's Recruit#498.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#499.src: Seems that way. You won your match?
Queen's Recruit#499.dst: 看起来是。你赢了你的比赛？
Queen's Recruit#499.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#500.src: I did. It seems I'm a finalist now. So, who's the other one?
Queen's Recruit#500.dst: 赢了。看来我现在是决赛选手了。那么，另一位是谁？
Queen's Recruit#500.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#501.src: Oh! Well, congratulations! Though, I guess we'll be facing each other soon.
Queen's Recruit#501.dst: 哦！嗯，恭喜！不过，我想我们很快就要对上了。
Queen's Recruit#501.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#502.src: Good grief... yes, the tournament has happened, congratulations to the finalists, whatever where are Mel and Linton? We need to discuss what's next, before
Queen's Recruit#502.dst: 真是的……对，锦标赛是打了，恭喜决赛选手，随便啦——Mel 和 Linton 在哪？我们得先讨论下一步，在……之前——
Queen's Recruit#502.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#503.src: ...and so, what, I'm not allowed to take a nap now? I wasn't even fighting!! Mel, back me up, come on!
Queen's Recruit#503.dst: ……所以怎样，我现在连睡个午觉都不行？我又没参赛！！Mel，帮我说句话啊！
Queen's Recruit#503.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#504.src: He's right, this hardly seems fair! We were told we could stay in our rooms until the tournament had concluded, so why the change?!
Queen's Recruit#504.dst: 他说得对，这太不公平了！他们说我们可以待在房间里直到锦标赛结束，为什么突然变了？！
Queen's Recruit#504.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#506.src: Any competitors who have lost in the tournament are to be escorted out of Fruma, effective immediately.
Queen's Recruit#506.dst: 所有在锦标赛中落败的参赛者，即刻起将被护送出 Fruma。
Queen's Recruit#506.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#507.src: what is the meaning of this?!
Queen's Recruit#507.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#508.src: SILENCE! These are new orders from Her Majesty.
Queen's Recruit#508.dst: 安静！这是女王陛下的新命令。
Queen's Recruit#508.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#509.src: Only {u} and Tasim are permitted to remain in the palace. Any defiance will be seen as an official threat against Fruma from the Wynn province.
Queen's Recruit#509.dst: 只有 {u} 和 Tasim 可以留在皇宫。任何违抗都将被视为 Wynn 行省对 Fruma 的正式威胁。
Queen's Recruit#509.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#510.src: Comply, and no one will be hurt. You will still receive your promised reward for participation.
Queen's Recruit#510.dst: 服从命令，就不会有人受伤。你们仍会收到承诺的参赛报酬。
Queen's Recruit#510.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#512.src: Enough, Kymer. What's done is done. We have no choice.
Queen's Recruit#512.dst: 够了，Kymer。事已至此。我们别无选择。
Queen's Recruit#512.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#514.src: You two. Stay safe, and be on guard. I'll report back to the King with this news. If you're not released safely...
Queen's Recruit#514.dst: 你们两个。注意安全，保持警惕。我会回去向国王报告这件事。如果你们没能平安被放出来……
Queen's Recruit#514.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#515.src: ...{u}. Tasim. I've gotten what I came here for originally, but... I don't know what they're planning. You'll have to handle it on your own.
Queen's Recruit#515.dst: ……{u}。Tasim。我本来要找的东西已经到手了，但……我不知道他们在打什么主意。你们只能靠自己了。
Queen's Recruit#515.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#517.src: Remaining finalists, you are expected in the dining hall shortly. Attend your last meal before the finals.
Queen's Recruit#517.dst: 剩下的决赛选手，你们稍后要到宴会厅。去吃决赛前的最后一餐吧。
Queen's Recruit#517.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#519.src: What was that? What just happened?
Queen's Recruit#519.dst: 刚才那是怎么回事？到底发生了什么？
Queen's Recruit#519.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#520.src: They've changed the rules on us, and now... ugh, we have no choice... We need to see it through.
Queen's Recruit#520.dst: 他们临时改了规则，现在……唉，我们别无选择……只能撑到最后。
Queen's Recruit#520.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#521.src: Well... come on. Let's attend our final dinner here.
Queen's Recruit#521.dst: 嗯……走吧。我们去吃在这里的最后一顿晚餐。
Queen's Recruit#521.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#523.src: What are we supposed to do...?
Queen's Recruit#523.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#524.src: They'll let us out. They have to. It'd be a diplomatic disaster if they didn't.
Queen's Recruit#524.dst: 他们会放我们走的。他们必须放。不然会是一场外交灾难。
Queen's Recruit#524.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#526.src: If you were not already aware, your fellow soldiers have been returned to Wynn. Safely.
Queen's Recruit#526.dst: 你们也许还不知道，你们的士兵同伴已经被送回 Wynn 了。平安无事。
Queen's Recruit#526.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#527.src: ...if you don't mind me asking, Your Majesty, I thought we had an agreement? We would all remain here until the tournament concluded with the finals.
Queen's Recruit#527.dst: ……恕我冒昧，女王陛下，我以为我们有过约定？我们所有人都会留在这里，直到锦标赛以决赛落幕。
Queen's Recruit#527.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#528.src: Oh? And would you like to join the rest of them? That could certainly be arranged we could simply select a victor here and now, and be done with this whole
Queen's Recruit#528.dst: 哦？你想跟他们一起走吗？那当然可以安排——我们大可以现在就选出一个冠军，然后把这整件——
Queen's Recruit#528.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#529.src: What is your problem, Thalas?! They're guests of Her Majesty! How irrational are you, trying to subtract them without her appr
Queen's Recruit#529.dst: 你到底有什么毛病，Thalas？！他们是女王陛下的宾客！你到底有多不理智，没经过她同意就想把他们减——
Queen's Recruit#529.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#531.src: To answer your question, the circumstances have changed. There is no need for the rest of your group to remain here.
Queen's Recruit#531.dst: 回答你的问题，情况有变。你们其他同伴已经没有必要留在这里了。
Queen's Recruit#531.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#532.src: The remainder of the tournament will proceed as expected.
Queen's Recruit#532.dst: 锦标赛剩下的部分会照常进行。
Queen's Recruit#532.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#534.src: Good. Now, let us enjoy the meal!
Queen's Recruit#534.dst: 很好。那么，让我们享用这顿饭吧！
Queen's Recruit#534.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#535.src: Another taste of Fruman cuisine... the meat was imported the {p}, and the vegetables came from the royal garden.
Queen's Recruit#535.dst: 再尝一次 Fruma 的佳肴……肉是从 {p} 进口的，蔬菜则来自皇家花园。
Queen's Recruit#535.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#536.src: Now, to business. The final will take place tomorrow morning. But first, I would like to speak to each of you individually.
Queen's Recruit#536.dst: 那么，谈正事。决赛将在明天早上举行。但首先，我想分别跟你们每个人谈谈。
Queen's Recruit#536.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#537.src: Let us begin with... {u}. Please come to the north-eastern wing when you are ready.
Queen's Recruit#537.dst: 我们就从……{u} 开始。准备好之后，请到东北翼来。
Queen's Recruit#537.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#539.src: Talk to Her Majesty in the north-eastern wing of the palace at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#539.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, {~}] 的皇宫东北翼与女王陛下谈话。

Queen's Recruit#542.src: Well. I suppose congratulations are in order, finalist.
Queen's Recruit#542.dst: 好。我想该恭喜你，决赛选手。
Queen's Recruit#542.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#543.src: You're curious, surely? For what purpose would I call you soldiers back to our province?
Queen's Recruit#543.dst: 你一定很好奇吧？我为什么要把你们这些士兵召回我们的行省？
Queen's Recruit#543.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#544.src: Certainly not for a vanity tournament. A meaningless celebration.
Queen's Recruit#544.dst: 当然不是为了一场虚荣的锦标赛。一场毫无意义的庆典。
Queen's Recruit#544.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#545.src: Oh, let us drop the facade. I know what you have been doing in secret. I am not blind.
Queen's Recruit#545.dst: 哦，我们就别再装了。我知道你们一直在暗中做什么。我又不瞎。
Queen's Recruit#545.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#546.src: You chose this opportunity to seek out information on our province. What little you have learned, we have deemed an acceptable cost.
Queen's Recruit#546.dst: 你们借这个机会打探我们行省的情报。你们打听到的那点东西，我们认为是可以接受的代价。
Queen's Recruit#546.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#547.src: Given the circumstances, I would have sacrificed much, much more if necessary.
Queen's Recruit#547.dst: 照当前的情况，必要的话，我愿意牺牲的远不止这些。
Queen's Recruit#547.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#548.src: The greatest that Wynn has... a broad category. We had to thin the numbers a contest of strength did the job nicely.
Queen's Recruit#548.dst: Wynn 最优秀的人……这个范围太广了。我们得削减人数——比试实力正好能办到。
Queen's Recruit#548.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#549.src: And now... two candidates remain. You have done well to make it this far. I have been watching the duels intently, and you are certainly not unimpressive.
Queen's Recruit#549.dst: 而现在……只剩两位人选。你能走到这一步，表现得很好。我一直专注地看着那些决斗，你绝对称得上令人刮目相看。
Queen's Recruit#549.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#550.src: Yet of the two of you... you certainly leave a lesser impression than him. You are one amongst hundreds, thousands... indistinguishable.
Queen's Recruit#550.dst: 但你们两个之中……你给人的印象确实不如他深刻。你只是成百上千人之中的一个……毫无分别。
Queen's Recruit#550.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#551.src: And still, here you stand. It intrigues me. What is so special about you? What strength has led you here?
Queen's Recruit#551.dst: 而你依然站在这里。这让我很好奇。你有什么特别之处？是什么力量把你带到了这里？
Queen's Recruit#551.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#552.src: But no matter. Answers will come with time... should you be selected. I can tell you have a question. Speak it.
Queen's Recruit#552.dst: 不过无所谓。答案会随着时间到来……如果你被选中的话。我看得出你有个问题。说吧。
Queen's Recruit#552.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#553.src: Hm. A blank slate... to be able to see the outside world, for all its splendor and all its faults, to witness firsthand the deep rooted seeds of its inevitable destruction... there is value to that.
Queen's Recruit#553.dst: 嗯。一张白纸……能够亲眼见识外面的世界，见识它一切的壮丽与一切的缺陷，亲身见证它注定毁灭的那些深植的种子——那是有价值的。
Queen's Recruit#553.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#554.src: You have seen it, haven't you? Forces beyond any of us vie for control of our world, caring not for what destruction they instill.
Queen's Recruit#554.dst: 你已经见过了，不是吗？超越我们所有人的力量在争夺我们世界的控制权，丝毫不在乎自己带来了多少毁灭。
Queen's Recruit#554.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#555.src: And it truly is a beautiful world, isn't it? To think, it could be destroyed, taken for their ceaseless war which holds no meaning, no purpose...
Queen's Recruit#555.dst: 而这真的是个美丽的世界，不是吗？想想看，它可能会被摧毁，被卷入他们那场毫无意义、毫无目的的无尽战争……
Queen's Recruit#555.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#556.src: Then you have seen firsthand the benefits. The province is unburdened by those who may cause problems, and Wynn's front in its war is bolstered.
Queen's Recruit#556.dst: 那你已经亲眼见过它的好处了。行省摆脱了那些可能制造麻烦的人，而 Wynn 在战争中的前线也得到了加强。
Queen's Recruit#556.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#557.src: Of course, many will refuse the call. Many more will grow stagnant in their newfound roles. Yet, in a select few... there is potential for much, much more.
Queen's Recruit#557.dst: 当然，许多人会拒绝这份召唤。许多人在新的角色中停滞不前。然而，在少数人身上……蕴藏着远远更多的潜力。
Queen's Recruit#557.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#559.src: That will be all. Return to your chambers for the night. I will be sending for the other finalist shortly.
Queen's Recruit#559.dst: 就这样吧。今晚回你的房间去。我很快就会派人去叫另一位决赛选手。
Queen's Recruit#559.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#560.src: Return to room W-{~} and talk to Tasim at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#560.dst: 回到 W-{~} 号房，到 [-{~}, {~}, {~}] 跟 Tasim 谈谈。

Queen's Recruit#562.src: You're back! Still in one piece?
Queen's Recruit#562.dst: 你回来了！还完好无损吧？
Queen's Recruit#562.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#563.src: ...I was getting a little worried. You were up there a while.
Queen's Recruit#563.dst: ……我有点担心了。你在上面待了好一阵子。
Queen's Recruit#563.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#565.dst: ……好吧。那么，是一场很怪的谈话？
Queen's Recruit#565.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#566.src: Ha. Well, now I'm a little nervous.
Queen's Recruit#566.dst: 哈。嗯，现在我有点紧张了。
Queen's Recruit#566.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#568.src: I'll... need to ask some follow-up questions.
Queen's Recruit#568.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#570.src: Oh, this is a disaster. We've been separated, and now we're stuck in here.
Queen's Recruit#570.dst: 哦，这真是场灾难。我们被分开了，现在又被困在这里。
Queen's Recruit#570.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#571.src: We need to come up with a plan... is there a way we could
Queen's Recruit#571.dst: 我们得想个计划……有没有办法能——
Queen's Recruit#571.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#572.src: Tasim! Her Majesty will speak with you now.
Queen's Recruit#572.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#574.src: Okay, wish me luck. I'll be back.
Queen's Recruit#574.dst: 好，祝我好运吧。我会回来的。
Queen's Recruit#574.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#575.src: Don't... stay up waiting for me. You can go rest. I'll be... fine, probably.
Queen's Recruit#575.dst: 别……熬夜等我。你可以先去休息。我会……没事的，大概吧。
Queen's Recruit#575.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#580.src: It went... fine, I guess. She probably said... most of the same things to you.
Queen's Recruit#580.dst: 谈得……还行吧，我想。她大概跟你说的……差不多都一样。
Queen's Recruit#580.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#583.src: Could I ask you a favor?
Queen's Recruit#583.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#584.src: Could we spar? A test match, before... before tomorrow. Just like old times.
Queen's Recruit#584.dst: 我们能切磋一下吗？一场练习赛，在……在明天之前。就像以前那样。
Queen's Recruit#584.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#585.src: Just, get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#585.dst: 就，准备好，到竞技场找我。好吗？
Queen's Recruit#585.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#586.src: I yes. I'm okay. Just... could we spar? A test match, before... tomorrow. For old times' sake.
Queen's Recruit#586.dst: 我——是的。我没事。只是……我们能切磋一下吗？一场练习赛，在……明天之前。就当是为了过去的时光。
Queen's Recruit#586.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#587.src: Just... get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#587.dst: 就……准备好，到竞技场找我。好吗？
Queen's Recruit#587.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#590.src: It went... fine, I guess. She probably said... most of the same things to you.
Queen's Recruit#590.dst: 谈得……还行吧，我想。她大概跟你说的……差不多都一样。
Queen's Recruit#590.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#593.src: I was going to ask if I could ask you a favor.
Queen's Recruit#593.dst: 我本来想问，能不能请你帮个忙。
Queen's Recruit#593.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#594.src: Could we spar? A test match, before... before tomorrow. Just like old times.
Queen's Recruit#594.dst: 我们能切磋一下吗？一场练习赛，在……在明天之前。就像以前那样。
Queen's Recruit#594.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#595.src: Just, get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#595.dst: 就，准备好，到竞技场找我。好吗？
Queen's Recruit#595.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#596.src: I yes. I'm okay. Just... could we spar? A test match, before... tomorrow. For old times' sake.
Queen's Recruit#596.dst: 我——是的。我没事。只是……我们能切磋一下吗？一场练习赛，在……明天之前。就当是为了过去的时光。
Queen's Recruit#596.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#597.src: Just... get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#597.dst: 就……准备好，到竞技场找我。好吗？
Queen's Recruit#597.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#603.src: He's... what what happened? How do you know? How how could you know?
Queen's Recruit#603.dst: 他……发生——发生了什么？你怎么知道？你怎——你怎么会知道？
Queen's Recruit#603.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#611.src: I... Gods. And, you you've been tr-trying to
Queen's Recruit#611.dst: 我……天啊。而你——你一直想、想要——
Queen's Recruit#611.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#613.src: I I need to go. I need some space. I'll I'm going to the arena. I need to... to...
Queen's Recruit#613.dst: 我——我得走了。我需要一点空间。我——我要去竞技场。我需要……需要……
Queen's Recruit#613.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#614.src: No. No, d-don't. Don't do that. Not now, not not now. If... if you need me... you'll you'll know where I am.
Queen's Recruit#614.dst: 不。不，别、别这样。别这样。不是现在，不——不是现在。如果……如果你需要我……你——你知道我在哪里。
Queen's Recruit#614.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#615.src: Head to the arena for a training match against Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#615.dst: 前往竞技场，与 Tasim 进行练习赛。

Queen's Recruit#616.src: Get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#616.dst: 准备好，到竞技场找我。好吗？
Queen's Recruit#616.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#617.src: It's... quiet. No guards in sight.
Queen's Recruit#617.dst: 这里……好安静。一个守卫都没有。
Queen's Recruit#617.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#619.src: Sigh. There's no point in trying to get out of here. We have to just see it through to the end.
Queen's Recruit#619.dst: 唉。想逃出去也没有意义。我们只能撑到最后。
Queen's Recruit#619.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#621.src: What do you think? About what she said? About... forces destroying the world.
Queen's Recruit#621.dst: 你怎么想？关于她说的那些？关于……那些正在摧毁世界的力量。
Queen's Recruit#621.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#622.src: She's right. I've seen it I know you've seen it. It's... getting worse.
Queen's Recruit#622.dst: 她说得对。我见过——我知道你也见过。情况……越来越糟了。
Queen's Recruit#622.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#623.src: But... the recruits. The recruits. I can't get over that. It's so...
Queen's Recruit#623.dst: 但是……那些新兵。那些新兵。我就是没办法释怀。那太……
Queen's Recruit#623.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#625.src: Let's just get down there and fight. Usual spots, right?
Queen's Recruit#625.dst: 我们就下去打吧。老位置，对吧？
Queen's Recruit#625.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#628.src: No words. Let's fight. Just just a training battle. To... test our skills.
Queen's Recruit#628.dst: 什么都别说。开打吧。只是——只是一场练习赛。试试……我们的身手。
Queen's Recruit#628.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#632.src: I guess we know how tomorrow will turn out, then.
Queen's Recruit#632.dst: 看来明天会怎样，我们都知道了。
Queen's Recruit#632.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#633.src: No don't deny it. We both know I'm right.
Queen's Recruit#633.dst: 别——别否认。我们都知道我说得对。
Queen's Recruit#633.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#635.src: She gave me a choice, you know?
Queen's Recruit#635.dst: 她给了我一个选择，你知道吗？
Queen's Recruit#635.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#636.src: A choice. I don't know what to do with it. And... I'm afraid of taking either option.
Queen's Recruit#636.dst: 一个选择。我不知道该怎么办。而且……两个选项我都怕选。
Queen's Recruit#636.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#637.src: I... I need to think over it some more. And we both need to rest.
Queen's Recruit#637.dst: 我……我需要再想想。而且我们都需要休息。
Queen's Recruit#637.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#638.src: Huh? I... yes. I think I am. I just have a lot on my mind.
Queen's Recruit#638.dst: 嗯？我……是的。我想我是。我只是心里有很多事。
Queen's Recruit#638.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#639.src: I'll... tell you in the morning. I just have a lot on my mind.
Queen's Recruit#639.dst: 我……明天早上再告诉你。我只是心里有很多事。
Queen's Recruit#639.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#640.src: Ha. You're you're good. Oof. I'll be feeling that one for... for a while.
Queen's Recruit#640.dst: 哈。你——你真行。唔。这一下我得……得痛上好一阵子了。
Queen's Recruit#640.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#642.src: Why did it have to come to this? Why couldn't why couldn't we all have just been happy?
Queen's Recruit#642.dst: 为什么会走到这一步？为什么——为什么我们就不能都幸福快乐？
Queen's Recruit#642.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#643.src: He he sent me a letter for that mission, you know. Did I tell you that? It's why I went back to Wynn.
Queen's Recruit#643.dst: 他——他为了那个任务寄了封信给我，你知道吗？我跟你说过吗？所以我才回到 Wynn。
Queen's Recruit#643.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#644.src: And, it turns out he was already... already gone. And you were there, and I wasn't.
Queen's Recruit#644.dst: 结果，原来他那时已经……已经不在了。而你在那里，我却不在。
Queen's Recruit#644.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#646.src: I want to blame you for it. I want to be able to be mad, to hate you. But... I can't. I just can't.
Queen's Recruit#646.dst: 我想怪你。我想能够生气，能够恨你。但是……我做不到。我就是做不到。
Queen's Recruit#646.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#647.src: I wish I could've been there. I wish I could've done it better. Maybe I could have or maybe it would've just gone the same way.
Queen's Recruit#647.dst: 我真希望我当时在场。真希望我能做得更好。也许我能——又或者结果还是一样。
Queen's Recruit#647.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#649.src: And now we're both here in the place we were all exiled from! But he's he isn't. He's gone, and and we're still here.
Queen's Recruit#649.dst: 而现在我们两个都在这里，在我们全都被流放出来的地方！可他——他不在。他走了，而——而我们还在这里。
Queen's Recruit#649.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#650.src: ...what am I supposed to do? What are we supposed to do? About all of this?
Queen's Recruit#650.dst: ……我该怎么办？我们该怎么办？面对这一切？
Queen's Recruit#650.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#653.src: I asked a lot of questions. I didn't like all the answers, but... she left me with a choice.
Queen's Recruit#653.dst: 我问了很多问题。我不喜欢所有的答案，但是……她留给我一个选择。
Queen's Recruit#653.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#655.src: I don't know what to do. I need to... to... I need to think.
Queen's Recruit#655.dst: 我不知道该怎么办。我需要……需要……我需要想一想。
Queen's Recruit#655.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#656.src: Give me some space, please. I'll see you in the morning.
Queen's Recruit#656.dst: 请给我一点空间。明天早上见。
Queen's Recruit#656.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#657.src: Return to your room and sleep for the night.

Queen's Recruit#659.src: Read the note Tasim left you before heading out.
Queen's Recruit#659.dst: 出发前，先读 Tasim 留给你的纸条。

Queen's Recruit#660.src: Head to Her Majesty's office for her decision.
Queen's Recruit#660.dst: 前往女王陛下的办公室，听取她的决定。

Queen's Recruit#662.src: You've already failed, you know. You did not meet her criteria for selection.
Queen's Recruit#662.dst: 你知道吗，你已经失败了。你不符合她的选拔标准。

Queen's Recruit#663.src: But is dismissing you outright an error? Certainly, you're powerful. Perhaps even more so than you should be, given the circumstances.
Queen's Recruit#663.dst: 但直接把你打发掉会是个错误吗？毫无疑问，你很强大。以你的处境来说，也许强大得有点过头了。

Queen's Recruit#664.src: Still. You lack the drive, the perspective. The dedication. The understanding.
Queen's Recruit#664.dst: 但是。你缺乏动力、眼界。缺乏奉献。缺乏理解。

Queen's Recruit#665.src: And, most critically - you're unpredictable. And that makes you dangerous.
Queen's Recruit#665.dst: 而最关键的是——你难以预测。这让你很危险。

Queen's Recruit#666.src: Ah! It seems Her Majesty and I have come to the same conclusion. Wonderful.
Queen's Recruit#666.dst: 啊！看来女王陛下和我得出了同样的结论。太好了。

Queen's Recruit#667.src: So, where does that leave you? Cast out, discarded?
Queen's Recruit#667.dst: 那么，这让你落得什么下场？被驱逐，被抛弃？

Queen's Recruit#668.src: All the unanswered questions. Will you choose to let go? Dismiss the possibilities?
Queen's Recruit#668.dst: 所有那些没有答案的问题。你会选择放手吗？放弃那些可能性？

Queen's Recruit#669.src: And if not? What would you do for a glimpse of the truth? For a chance of receiving answers?
Queen's Recruit#669.dst: 如果不会呢？为了一窥真相，你愿意做什么？为了一个得到答案的机会？

Queen's Recruit#670.src: Hm. Whatever the case, the choice is yours. Perhaps you'll surprise me, after all! Wouldn't that be exciting?
Queen's Recruit#670.dst: 嗯。不管怎样，选择在你。说不定你终究会让我惊喜呢！那岂不是很令人兴奋？

Queen's Recruit#671.src: {u}, under order of Her Majesty, you are to be escorted out of Fruma, effective immediately.
Queen's Recruit#671.dst: {u}，奉女王陛下之命，你即刻起将被护送出 Fruma。
Queen's Recruit#671.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#672.src: Any defiance will be seen as an official threat against Fruma from the Wynn province. Comply, and no one will be hurt.
Queen's Recruit#672.dst: 任何违抗都将被视为 Wynn 行省对 Fruma 的正式威胁。服从命令，就不会有人受伤。
Queen's Recruit#672.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#673.src: You hold no power here. This choice is not yours. You will follow orders, or face the consequences.
Queen's Recruit#673.dst: 你在这里没有任何权力。这个选择不属于你。你要么服从命令，要么承担后果。
Queen's Recruit#673.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Recipe For Disaster#000.src: Meet up with Chef Hamsey in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recipe For Disaster#000.dst: 在 {p} [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与 Hamsey 主厨会合。

Recipe For Disaster#001.src: Ah, bonjour! Welcome to my restaurant, allow me to lead you to your seat-
Recipe For Disaster#001.dst: 啊，bonjour！欢迎来到我的餐厅，请让我带您入座——
Recipe For Disaster#001.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#002.src: Oh do my eyes deceive me? Serais-ce possible?!
Recipe For Disaster#002.dst: 噢，我没看错吧？这怎么可能？！
Recipe For Disaster#002.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#003.src: It is you... the novice soldier turned hero of legends! Who would have thought?!
Recipe For Disaster#003.dst: 是你……那个从新兵变成传奇英雄的人！谁想得到呢？！
Recipe For Disaster#003.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#004.src: I have heard tales of your exploits across the lands, mon ami! Je suis honore! Someone like you sitting in my restaurant!
Recipe For Disaster#004.dst: 我听说过你在各地的事迹，mon ami！我真是荣幸！像你这样的人居然坐在我的餐厅里！
Recipe For Disaster#004.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#005.src: Je suis, bien sur... Le Chef Hamsey! Famed across the lands for my flavors, as you are for your weapon!
Recipe For Disaster#005.dst: 我当然就是……Hamsey 主厨！我以美味闻名天下，就像你以武器闻名一样！
Recipe For Disaster#005.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#006.src: I boast, I boast. Je peu t'offrir un plat... but perhaps I have a different proposition for us both.
Recipe For Disaster#006.dst: 我吹牛了，我吹牛了。我可以请你吃一道菜……不过也许我有个对我们俩都更有意思的提议。
Recipe For Disaster#006.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#007.src: You may have mastered the art of battle, my friend, but what of... L'Art de la Cuisine?!
Recipe For Disaster#007.dst: 你也许精通了战斗的艺术，我的朋友，那么……料理的艺术呢？！
Recipe For Disaster#007.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#008.src: Follow me into the kitchen behind me, and I will tell you more.
Recipe For Disaster#008.dst: 跟我到后面的厨房来，我再跟你多说。
Recipe For Disaster#008.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#009.src: Find Chef Hamsey in his kitchen.
Recipe For Disaster#009.dst: 在厨房里找到 Hamsey 主厨。

Recipe For Disaster#010.src: Welcome to my kitchen! C'est beau, non?
Recipe For Disaster#010.dst: 欢迎来到我的厨房！很美吧？
Recipe For Disaster#010.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#011.src: It may be on fire, but... que serais la Cuisine sans une touche de danger, eh?!
Recipe For Disaster#011.dst: 它可能着火了，不过……料理没有一点危险，那还叫料理吗，嗯？！
Recipe For Disaster#011.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#012.src: So, back to the challenge. What do you say to a bit of friendly competition, hehe?
Recipe For Disaster#012.dst: 那么，回到挑战。来点友谊赛怎么样，嘿嘿？
Recipe For Disaster#012.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#013.src: You can work with one of my three best chefs on a dish and present it to me once you're done!
Recipe For Disaster#013.dst: 你可以跟我手下三位最棒的厨师之一合作做一道菜，做好之后端来给我！
Recipe For Disaster#013.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#014.src: I, of course, will judge your dish based on the twenty-nine Principes de Cuisine - texture, presentation, originality...
Recipe For Disaster#014.dst: 当然，我会按照二十九项料理原则来评判你的菜——口感、摆盘、创意……
Recipe For Disaster#014.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#015.src: ... aroma, magical ability... oh, and flavour!
Recipe For Disaster#015.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#016.src: S'il te plait! Go introduce yourself to each of my chefs and return once you have decided who to work with!
Recipe For Disaster#016.dst: 拜托了！去跟我的每位厨师自我介绍一下，决定好要跟谁合作再回来！
Recipe For Disaster#016.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#017.src: Speak to all three chefs in Hamsey's kitchen.
Recipe For Disaster#017.dst: 与 Hamsey 厨房里的三位厨师交谈。

Recipe For Disaster#018.src: Heya! You must be the adventurer that Hamsey told me about. You know, he was almost ecstatic, but don't tell him I said that!
Recipe For Disaster#018.dst: 嗨！你一定就是 Hamsey 跟我说的那位冒险者。你知道吗，他差点乐疯了，不过别告诉他是我说的！
Recipe For Disaster#018.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#019.src: Oh, a cook-off? How exciting! I'll gladly help you out. Maybe this way I can prove myself a bit more to the others...?
Recipe For Disaster#019.dst: 噢，厨艺比赛？好刺激！我很乐意帮你。说不定这样我能在其他人面前多证明一下自己……？
Recipe For Disaster#019.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#020.src: If we work together, we can make a Seasoned Voidroot Stew, how does that sound?
Recipe For Disaster#020.dst: 如果我们合作，可以做一道调味虚空根炖菜，你觉得怎么样？
Recipe For Disaster#020.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#021.src: You need to talk to the other chefs before deciding what to make, though!
Recipe For Disaster#021.dst: 不过决定做什么之前，你得先跟其他厨师聊聊！
Recipe For Disaster#021.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#022.src: Good friend of Hamsey's, are you? I'll believe it when - no, if - you somehow win this competition.
Recipe For Disaster#022.dst: 你是 Hamsey 的好朋友？等你——不，是万一你——赢了这场比赛，我再相信。
Recipe For Disaster#022.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#023.src: I don't need any amateurs like yourself getting in my way when I'm cooking up a storm!
Recipe For Disaster#023.dst: 我大显身手的时候，可不需要你这种外行来碍事！
Recipe For Disaster#023.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#024.src: Are you still here? Just... go chitchat to someone else, please.
Recipe For Disaster#024.dst: 你还在这里？去……去跟别人闲聊吧，拜托。
Recipe For Disaster#024.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#025.src: Yo, dawg. Name's Frank. Hamsey said you guys go waaay back. Any friend of Hamsey's is good with me, man.
Recipe For Disaster#025.dst: 哟，兄弟。我叫 Frank。Hamsey 说你们认识好久了。Hamsey 的朋友就是我的朋友，老兄。
Recipe For Disaster#025.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#026.src: Nothin' too sure on what we're gonna cook yet, figure I'll dream somethin' up before the time comes.
Recipe For Disaster#026.dst: 还不太确定我们要做什么，我想到时候再随便想一个吧。
Recipe For Disaster#026.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#027.src: Thinkin' a pie, maybe? Not too much effort there, can't go far wrong, right?
Recipe For Disaster#027.dst: 我在想，做个派怎么样？不用太费劲，也不太会出错，对吧？
Recipe For Disaster#027.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#028.src: Talk to Hamsey and choose a chef to work with.
Recipe For Disaster#028.dst: 与 Hamsey 交谈，选一位厨师合作。

Recipe For Disaster#029.src: Ah, you have introduced yourself to tous mes cuisiners? Who do you want to work with?!
Recipe For Disaster#029.dst: 啊，你跟我所有的厨师都打过招呼了？你想跟谁合作？！
Recipe For Disaster#029.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#030.src: Ah, Brie! An excellent chef... and an even better cheese! I jest, I jest. You will work well together, I am certain.
Recipe For Disaster#030.dst: 啊，Brie！一位出色的厨师……跟她同名的奶酪更出色！开玩笑的，开玩笑的。我相信你们会合作愉快。
Recipe For Disaster#030.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#031.src: Ah, Kale. One of my most talented chefs, though he can be stubborn at times!
Recipe For Disaster#031.dst: 啊，Kale。我最有才华的厨师之一，不过他有时候挺固执的！
Recipe For Disaster#031.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#032.src: Frank! Whilst he may seem rather... relaxed, at times, I assure you he is a most capable chef!
Recipe For Disaster#032.dst: Frank！他有时候看起来也许有点……散漫，但我向你保证，他是个非常能干的厨师！
Recipe For Disaster#032.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#033.src: Maitenant, mon ami, head over to your chef and start cooking!
Recipe For Disaster#033.dst: 那么，mon ami，去找你的厨师，开始做菜吧！
Recipe For Disaster#033.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#034.src: Talk to your chosen chef about the dish.
Recipe For Disaster#034.dst: 跟你选的厨师谈谈要做的菜。

Recipe For Disaster#035.src: Heya again! So you decided to make the Seasoned Voidroot Stew with me? Hurray!
Recipe For Disaster#035.dst: 又见面啦！所以你决定跟我一起做调味虚空根炖菜？太好了！
Recipe For Disaster#035.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#036.src: It's not quite as easy as it might seem, but I think together we'll be able to handle it.
Recipe For Disaster#036.dst: 它没有看起来那么简单，不过我想我们一起应该能搞定。
Recipe For Disaster#036.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#037.src: Like I said before, about proving myself... I'm the newest chef here at the kitchen and some of the other chefs disapprove of my ideas. This could be my chance!
Recipe For Disaster#037.dst: 就像我之前说的，关于证明自己……我是这个厨房里最新来的厨师，有些厨师不认同我的想法。这可能是我的机会！
Recipe For Disaster#037.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#038.src: I've been perfecting the recipe for Voidroot Stew for months now and I finally have a chance to show everyone what I'm worth!
Recipe For Disaster#038.dst: 我已经琢磨虚空根炖菜的配方好几个月了，终于有机会让大家看看我的本事！
Recipe For Disaster#038.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#039.src: The first one is some [Snail Slime] available on Snail Island! We only need one for this dish.
Recipe For Disaster#039.dst: 第一样是 [蜗牛黏液]，在蜗牛岛上就有！这道菜只需要一份。
Recipe For Disaster#039.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#040.src: Next up, we need some [Voidroot], a super rare root found deep in the Void. I've heard someone in the {p} can take you down there.
Recipe For Disaster#040.dst: 接下来，我们需要一些 [虚空根]，那是一种长在虚空深处的超稀有根茎。我听说 {p} 有人能带你下去。
Recipe For Disaster#040.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#041.src: Lastly, we need some [Moonsalt], which is famously hard to obtain. Luckily, self-proclaimed 'Space Wizard' Astralaus should have some, so you can just pop over to his tower and ask for some!
Recipe For Disaster#041.dst: 最后，我们需要一些 [月盐]，出了名的难弄到。幸好自称“太空巫师”的 Astralaus 应该有一些，你直接去他的塔里找他要一点就行！
Recipe For Disaster#041.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#042.src: And that should do it! I'll give you a Recipe Book, just right-click to open it up and track your ingredients. Good luck!
Recipe For Disaster#042.dst: 这样应该就齐了！我给你一本食谱，右键打开就能追踪材料。祝你好运！
Recipe For Disaster#042.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#043.src: Ugh. Stay out of my way, and we'll get along just fine.
Recipe For Disaster#043.dst: 呃。别挡我的路，我们就相安无事。
Recipe For Disaster#043.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#044.src: Make yourself useful and get me everything we need. I'm not in the mood for chit-chat.
Recipe For Disaster#044.dst: 做点有用的事，把我们需要的东西全弄来。我没心情闲聊。
Recipe For Disaster#044.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#045.src: I don't want my reputation tarnished by the likes of you...
Recipe For Disaster#045.dst: 我可不想让我的名声被你这种人给毁了……
Recipe For Disaster#045.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#046.src: Listen up, I'm *not* going to say this again. Take notes.
Recipe For Disaster#046.dst: 给我听好，我不会说第二遍。记笔记。
Recipe For Disaster#046.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#047.src: The key ingredient in my amazing omelette is obviously the [Blue-Ring Grook Egg], which of course you didn't know.
Recipe For Disaster#047.dst: 我那道绝妙煎蛋卷的关键材料显然是 [蓝环 Grook 蛋]，这你当然不知道。
Recipe For Disaster#047.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#048.src: Secondly what we need is some [Snail Slime], which is at Snail Island, obviously. Any seasoned chef could tell you that.
Recipe For Disaster#048.dst: 第二样我们需要的是 [蜗牛黏液]，显然在蜗牛岛上。任何经验丰富的厨师都知道。
Recipe For Disaster#048.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#049.src: Lastly you need a [Talking Mushroom] which is found on the swamp Sky Island, provided you have a functioning sense of sight.
Recipe For Disaster#049.dst: 最后你需要一朵 [会说话的蘑菇]，在沼泽天空岛上就找得到，前提是你的眼睛还能用。
Recipe For Disaster#049.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#050.src: YOU FORGOT ALREADY?? I TOLD YOU TO TAKE NOTES!
Recipe For Disaster#050.dst: 你已经忘了？？我叫你记笔记了！
Recipe For Disaster#050.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#051.src: Lucky for you, at least one of us here is competent. I wrote everything down in this recipe book. Right-click to open it. Now get me my ingredients and scram!
Recipe For Disaster#051.dst: 算你走运，我们之中至少有一个人能干。我把所有东西都写在这本食谱里了。右键打开。现在去把我的材料弄来，快滚！
Recipe For Disaster#051.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#052.src: Thrilled to be workin' with you, dude! We'll blow Hamsey's mind.
Recipe For Disaster#052.dst: 能跟你一起干活真是太爽了，老兄！我们会把 Hamsey 惊呆的。
Recipe For Disaster#052.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#053.src: Hmmm, now what kinda pie should we be bakin', here?
Recipe For Disaster#053.dst: 嗯……那我们该烤哪种派呢？
Recipe For Disaster#053.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#054.src: Well, I might be a lil' lazy, but when it comes to cookin', I've got the eye. And to me, dude? You look like a real Skyhigh Pie kind of guy! Heheh.
Recipe For Disaster#054.dst: 嗯，我可能有点懒，但说到做菜，我可是很有眼光的。而在我看来，老兄？你看起来就是个冲天派类型的人！嘿嘿。
Recipe For Disaster#054.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#055.src: Welp, guess you know how to cook up a simple Skyhigh Pie, right? Off you go, I'll be waiting here when you have the ingredients.
Recipe For Disaster#055.dst: 好啦，我猜你知道怎么做个简单的冲天派吧？去吧，等你拿到材料我就在这里等你。
Recipe For Disaster#055.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#056.src: Hehe, just messin' with you, man! Shoulda seen your face.
Recipe For Disaster#056.dst: 嘿嘿，逗你玩的，老兄！你真该看看你刚才那表情。
Recipe For Disaster#056.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#057.src: First, we're gonna need some kinda flour. A lil' [Sunrise Flour] aughtta do.
Recipe For Disaster#057.dst: 首先，我们需要某种面粉。来点 [日出面粉] 应该就行。
Recipe For Disaster#057.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#058.src: A good-sized [Blue-Ring Grook Egg] should give us a lil' kick. Not as much as those grooks'll give you a kick if they see you pilfering their eggs, though!
Recipe For Disaster#058.dst: 一颗个头不错的 [蓝环 Grook 蛋] 应该能给我们来点劲。不过肯定比不上那些 Grook 看到你偷它们的蛋时给你的那一脚！
Recipe For Disaster#058.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#059.src: Finally, the secret ingredient - A [Skyhigh Raspberry]. Real good stuff, but it's a fair way out. Guess a lil' walking never hurt anyone, huh? Not that I've ever bothered.
Recipe For Disaster#059.dst: 最后，秘密材料——一颗 [冲天覆盆子]。真是好东西，不过要走挺远的。我想走点路也伤不了人吧？虽然我从来懒得走。
Recipe For Disaster#059.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#060.src: Huh, you've got a bad memory? Yeah, me too, man. Here's a Recipe Book, just right-click to open it up and check where to grab the ingredients!
Recipe For Disaster#060.dst: 嗯，你记性不好？是啊，我也是，老兄。给你一本食谱，右键打开就能查到去哪里拿材料！
Recipe For Disaster#060.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#061.src: Return here once you've got them all. Peace out, dude!
Recipe For Disaster#061.dst: 东西都拿到了就回来这里。回头见，老兄！
Recipe For Disaster#061.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#062.src: Collect [{~} {Ingredient}] at [X, Y, Z] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#062.dst: 在 [X, Y, Z] 收集 [{~} {Ingredient}]，或查看你的食谱。

Recipe For Disaster#063.src: Welcome to Astralus' Astral House! Can you get to the top by flipping gravity?
Recipe For Disaster#063.dst: 欢迎来到 Astralus 的星界之屋！你能靠翻转重力爬到顶上吗？
Recipe For Disaster#063.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#064.src: Astronomical progress! But this is just the beginning!
Recipe For Disaster#064.dst: 天文级的进步！但这才刚开始！
Recipe For Disaster#064.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#065.src: ...And why did you come to my tower?
Recipe For Disaster#065.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#066.src: My Moonsalt? How absurd! I collected mine myself, you collect yours! It's only fair.
Recipe For Disaster#066.dst: 我的月盐？太荒唐了！我的是我自己收集的，你的就自己去收集！这样才公平。
Recipe For Disaster#066.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#067.src: Darn humans, you never listen! I said... Get. It. Yourself.
Recipe For Disaster#067.dst: 该死的人类，你们从来不听！我说了……自。己。去。拿。
Recipe For Disaster#067.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#068.src: What takes you here, strangeling? What namings do you have? Hu-man? We claim Humyn! Bad choose, pick elsewhere strangeling!
Recipe For Disaster#068.dst: 什么带你来这里，陌生物？你有什么名叫？人——类？我们自称 Humyn！选错了，去别处挑，陌生物！
Recipe For Disaster#068.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#069.src: Investigating for helping? How many conveniences! Humyns requires assistancing! You observers, humyns failflies into large crater-rock!
Recipe For Disaster#069.dst: 调查为了帮忙？好多方便！Humyn 需要协助着！你们观察者，Humyn 失飞进了大坑坑石！
Recipe For Disaster#069.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#070.src: Burnmilk run out and one direction to retrieve it is moonsalt! We strike lucknugget and discover moonsalt on crater-rock!
Recipe For Disaster#070.dst: 焚乳用完了，拿回来的一个方向是月盐！我们撞到好运块，在坑坑石上发现月盐！
Recipe For Disaster#070.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#071.src: Refined moonsalt gives burnmilk for spacezoom! Inconveniencing, spacezoom destroyed. Humyns create miniscule Spacezoom!
Recipe For Disaster#071.dst: 精炼月盐给太空飞飞焚乳！不方便着，太空飞飞毁掉了。Humyn 造出超小太空飞飞！
Recipe For Disaster#071.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#072.src: Only singular humyn can fit in current spacezoom. If strangeling helps humyns will let strangeling in spacezoom. Humyns can create new spacezoom in given time!
Recipe For Disaster#072.dst: 现在的太空飞飞只能塞得下单个 Humyn。如果陌生物帮忙，Humyn 就让陌生物坐进太空飞飞。Humyn 能在给定时间里造新太空飞飞！
Recipe For Disaster#072.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#073.src: Humyns currently residing on crater-rock, meaning waiting is not result of death!
Recipe For Disaster#073.dst: Humyn 现在住在坑坑石上，意思是等待不是死亡的结果！
Recipe For Disaster#073.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#074.src: Moonsalt discovered in saltcave in north, strangeling follow path!
Recipe For Disaster#074.dst: 月盐在北边的盐洞发现，陌生物跟着路走！
Recipe For Disaster#074.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#075.src: Just [{~} Unrefined Moonsalt] need for burnmilk, strangeling can grab any left over!
Recipe For Disaster#075.dst: 焚乳只需要 [{~} 未精炼月盐]，剩下的陌生物随便拿！
Recipe For Disaster#075.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#076.src: When strangeling has moonsalt, refine at device beside humyn and go zoom in spacezoom!
Recipe For Disaster#076.dst: 陌生物拿到月盐时，在 Humyn 旁边的装置精炼，然后坐太空飞飞飞飞！
Recipe For Disaster#076.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#077.src: Hello aaand welcome to the Racetrack of the Century!
Recipe For Disaster#077.dst: 你好～欢迎来到世纪赛道！
Recipe For Disaster#077.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#078.src: One winner, one loser. And Usnail Bolt eats losers for breakfast.
Recipe For Disaster#078.dst: 一个赢家，一个输家。而 Usnail Bolt 早餐就拿输家当饭吃。
Recipe For Disaster#078.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#079.src: Breakfast? Wait, did I have breakfast? A little breckkie could be good fo-
Recipe For Disaster#079.dst: 早餐？等等，我吃早餐了吗？来点小早饭也不错——
Recipe For Disaster#079.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#080.src: Well, no matter. What do you say, adventurer? Enter the race against Usnail Bolt. The grand prize is some Snail Slime!
Recipe For Disaster#080.dst: 算了，不重要。你怎么说，冒险者？来跟 Usnail Bolt 比一场吧。大奖是一些蜗牛黏液！
Recipe For Disaster#080.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#082.src: Shame, could've been a great race. See you around, adventurer!
Recipe For Disaster#082.dst: 真可惜，本来会是场精彩的比赛。回头见，冒险者！
Recipe For Disaster#082.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#083.src: Well well well... looks like Usnail Bolt has won this one. Again.
Recipe For Disaster#083.dst: 哎呀呀……看来这场又是 Usnail Bolt 赢了。又一次。
Recipe For Disaster#083.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#084.src: Not your lucky day, human. Oh well, you know the price for losing. Guards!
Recipe For Disaster#084.dst: 今天不是你的幸运日，人类。唉，你知道输了的代价。守卫！
Recipe For Disaster#084.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#085.src: Wowee! In what turned out to be an amazing race, the human has managed to steal the lead right out from Usnail Bolt's nose!
Recipe For Disaster#085.dst: 哇哦！这场比赛精彩绝伦，人类居然从 Usnail Bolt 眼皮底下抢走了领先！
Recipe For Disaster#085.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#086.src: Here, human. Take this slime as your prize.
Recipe For Disaster#086.dst: 给你，人类。收下这份黏液作为奖品。
Recipe For Disaster#086.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#087.src: ISN'T THIS JUST ABSOLUTELY FANTASTIC. A HUMAN?! WHO WOULD HAVE GUESSED.
Recipe For Disaster#087.dst: 这可真是太美妙了。一个人类？！谁猜得到啊。
Recipe For Disaster#087.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#088.src: YOU'RE THE SEVENTH ONE PASSING ME TODAY AND YOU'RE NO DIFFERENT FROM THE OTHERS.
Recipe For Disaster#088.dst: 你是今天第七个从我旁边经过的，跟其他人没有任何不同。
Recipe For Disaster#088.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#089.src: EVERY SINGLE ONE WITH THAT DOPEY SHEEPISH LOOK ON THEIR FACE, AS IF A TALKING MUSHROOM IS OUT OF THE BLUE.
Recipe For Disaster#089.dst: 每一个脸上都挂着那副呆头呆脑的傻样，好像会说话的蘑菇是什么晴天霹雳似的。
Recipe For Disaster#089.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#090.src: GIVE ME A BREAK, I'VE HAD ENOUGH OF JERKS PICKING ME UP AND DISRESPECTING ME LIKE THAT. PRIVATE SPACE, EVER HEARD OF IT?
Recipe For Disaster#090.dst: 饶了我吧，我受够了那些混蛋把我拔起来还那样不尊重我。私人空间，听说过吗？
Recipe For Disaster#090.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#091.src: WHY DO I EVEN TRY. JUST LOOK AT YOU! THE EPITOME OF CLUELESS. WHAT NOW, GONNA TAKE ME ON SOME LOONEY ADVENTURE ACROSS THE SKY ISLANDS?
Recipe For Disaster#091.dst: 我干嘛还费劲。看看你！蠢到极点的典范。接下来呢，要带我去天空群岛来一趟疯疯癫癫的冒险吗？
Recipe For Disaster#091.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#092.src: I HOPE NOT, IF YOU WERE THINKING THAT. I'VE ALREADY LOST A STEM TODAY BECAUSE SOME DIMWIT TRIED TAKING A BITE OUT OF ME... LIVE!
Recipe For Disaster#092.dst: 如果你是那么想的，我希望不是。今天我已经少了一截菌柄，因为有个白痴想咬我一口……活生生地！
Recipe For Disaster#092.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#093.src: DON'T TELL ME, ARE YOU TAKING ME ON SOME LOONEY ADVENTURE ACROSS THE SKY ISLANDS? HOW LOVELY.
Recipe For Disaster#093.dst: 别告诉我，你要带我去天空群岛来一趟疯疯癫癫的冒险？真是太好了。
Recipe For Disaster#093.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#094.src: A KITCHEN YOU SAY, WELL, IF IT'LL PUT ME OUT OF MY MISERY AS SOON AS POSSIBLE, THEN WHY NOT.
Recipe For Disaster#094.dst: 你说去厨房，好吧，如果那能让我尽快解脱，那有何不可。
Recipe For Disaster#094.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#095.src: WAIT, WHY ARE YOU STUFFING ME INTO YOUR BAG? HOW DO YOU EXPECT ME TO BREATHE IN HERE?!
Recipe For Disaster#095.dst: 等等，你为什么把我塞进你的包里？你要我在这里面怎么呼吸？！
Recipe For Disaster#095.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#096.src: Hello there! I can see you knead you some sunrise flour, don't you?
Recipe For Disaster#096.dst: 你好啊！我看你“面”临缺日出面粉的状况，对吧？
Recipe For Disaster#096.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#097.src: It's needed rye away? Well no worries, friend!
Recipe For Disaster#097.dst: 马上就要？没“麦”问题，朋友！
Recipe For Disaster#097.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#098.src: Well butter me up and call me toast, it seems I ran out of the stuff, there's none left.
Recipe For Disaster#098.dst: 哎呀，给我抹上黄油叫我吐司吧，我好像把存货用光了，一点都不剩。
Recipe For Disaster#098.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#099.src: I'm sorry if I see to just be loafing around, but at yeast I know how to make some more.
Recipe For Disaster#099.dst: 抱歉我看起来像是在“面”包游手好闲，不过至少我还知道怎么再“酵”出一些来。
Recipe For Disaster#099.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#100.src: Can you see that wheat field over there, next to the bakery? You can farm up some wheat and pop it on the mill.
Recipe For Disaster#100.dst: 看到面包店旁边那片麦田了吗？你可以去收些小麦，放进磨坊里磨。
Recipe For Disaster#100.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#101.src: Grab a scythe from the tool merchant next dough and get to work!
Recipe For Disaster#101.dst: 去隔壁的工具商人那里拿把镰刀，开工吧！
Recipe For Disaster#101.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#102.src: Make as much as you want, I've made all the bread I need for today already.
Recipe For Disaster#102.dst: 想做多少就做多少，我今天需要的面包已经都做好了。
Recipe For Disaster#102.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#103.src: Howdy, pal! Looking for some Skyhigh Raspberries? They work great in a pie!
Recipe For Disaster#103.dst: 你好啊，朋友！在找冲天覆盆子吗？拿来做派棒极了！
Recipe For Disaster#103.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#104.src: If you're interested, it's just a small fee of {~} Emeralds to get access to the island.
Recipe For Disaster#104.dst: 如果你有兴趣，只要付 {~} 绿宝石的小额费用就能上岛。
Recipe For Disaster#104.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#105.src: A man's gotta make a living somehow, so I've set up a system of cannons to take you right up to the island they grow on!
Recipe For Disaster#105.dst: 人总得想办法谋生嘛，所以我架了一套大炮系统，直接把你送上它们生长的那座岛！
Recipe For Disaster#105.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#106.src: So, whaddya say? Small price for a little adventure, and as many raspberries as you can eat!
Recipe For Disaster#106.dst: 所以，你怎么说？小小的代价换一场小冒险，覆盆子还任你吃到饱！
Recipe For Disaster#106.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#107.src: Alrighty! Just head on over to that island beside me and jump in the cannon - it's perfectly safe, I promise!
Recipe For Disaster#107.dst: 好嘞！去我旁边那座岛，跳进大炮里——绝对安全，我保证！
Recipe For Disaster#107.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#108.src: Find your way up the island and grab as many raspberries as you want! When you're done just jump in the big cannon and come back to shore!
Recipe For Disaster#108.dst: 想办法爬上岛，覆盆子想摘多少就摘多少！弄完了就跳进大炮，回到岸上来！
Recipe For Disaster#108.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#109.src: Alrighty, no worries. Feel free to come back if you're ever in the mood for some!
Recipe For Disaster#109.dst: 好嘞，没关系。哪天想吃了随时欢迎回来！
Recipe For Disaster#109.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#110.src: Present the ingredients to your chosen chef.
Recipe For Disaster#110.dst: 把材料交给你选的厨师。

Recipe For Disaster#111.src: Have you got all the ingredients? Amazing!
Recipe For Disaster#111.dst: 材料都拿到了吗？太棒了！
Recipe For Disaster#111.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#112.src: Okay you set back and let me work on the cooking, just pass over the ingredients!
Recipe For Disaster#112.dst: 好，你往后站，让我来下厨，把材料递给我就行！
Recipe For Disaster#112.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#113.src: Aha! That should do it! Hopefully I've done everything correctly... but wow, would you look at the color of that soup!
Recipe For Disaster#113.dst: 啊哈！这样应该好了！希望我每一步都做对了……不过哇，你看看这汤的颜色！
Recipe For Disaster#113.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#114.src: You should bring it over to Hamsey to see what he thinks!
Recipe For Disaster#114.dst: 你该端去给 Hamsey，看看他怎么说！
Recipe For Disaster#114.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#115.src: You got everything? Took you long enough.
Recipe For Disaster#115.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#116.src: Let's get started. Everyone else already finished. Stay back while I work my magic.
Recipe For Disaster#116.dst: 开始吧。其他人都已经做完了。往后站，看我施展魔法。
Recipe For Disaster#116.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#117.src: Mwah! My masterdish is finished. Present this to the chef, I'm sure he'll love it!
Recipe For Disaster#117.dst: 么啊！我的杰作完成了。端去给主厨，我相信他会喜欢的！
Recipe For Disaster#117.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#118.src: And be CAREFUL taking it over. That food could be worth HUNDREDS once I'm famous!
Recipe For Disaster#118.dst: 端过去的时候给我小心点。等我出名了，这道菜可值好几百！
Recipe For Disaster#118.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#119.src: You got everything? Awesome stuff, dude.
Recipe For Disaster#119.dst: 东西都拿到了？太棒了，老兄。
Recipe For Disaster#119.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#120.src: I'll just take a smallll bit of this raspberry - chef's commission, eh? And let's get started!
Recipe For Disaster#120.dst: 这覆盆子我就拿一点点——算厨师的佣金，嗯？我们开始吧！
Recipe For Disaster#120.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#121.src: And we're all done. Hamsey's gonna love this.
Recipe For Disaster#121.dst: 全都做好了。Hamsey 肯定会爱死这个。
Recipe For Disaster#121.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#122.src: Here you go, dawg. Pleasure working with you - show this to Hamsey and we'll see what he thinks. Make sure you don't "lose" any of it on the way over - you know what they say about your own supply!
Recipe For Disaster#122.dst: 给你，兄弟。跟你合作很愉快——拿给 Hamsey 看，看他怎么说。路上可别“弄丢”了哪一块——你知道大家怎么说偷吃自家货的！
Recipe For Disaster#122.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#123.src: Talk to Hamsey with your finished dish.
Recipe For Disaster#123.dst: 带着做好的菜去找 Hamsey 谈谈。

Recipe For Disaster#124.src: Ah, you have finished your dish? Well, then, il est temps de goûter!
Recipe For Disaster#124.dst: 啊，你的菜做好了？那么，是时候品尝了！
Recipe For Disaster#124.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#125.src: Let us retreat to my private dining room... this way!
Recipe For Disaster#125.dst: 我们去我的私人餐厅吧……这边请！
Recipe For Disaster#125.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#126.src: Meet Hamsey in the dining room at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recipe For Disaster#126.dst: 在 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的餐厅与 Hamsey 会合。

Recipe For Disaster#127.src: Welcome back, mon ami! I see you've return with a dish in hand!
Recipe For Disaster#127.dst: 欢迎回来，mon ami！我看到你端着一道菜回来了！
Recipe For Disaster#127.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#128.src: A stew? Seems simple, but even the simplest things in life can be le meilleur!
Recipe For Disaster#128.dst: 炖菜？看起来简单，但人生中最简单的东西也可能是最棒的！
Recipe For Disaster#128.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#129.src: Adventurer, are you sure you made this dish? It is so good I might as well close the restaurant!
Recipe For Disaster#129.dst: 冒险者，这道菜真的是你做的吗？好吃到我干脆把餐厅关了算了！
Recipe For Disaster#129.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#130.src: You never fail to surprise me, friend. Here, take this apron, an essential of any true chef.
Recipe For Disaster#130.dst: 你总是能让我惊喜，朋友。来，收下这条围裙，真正的厨师必备的东西。
Recipe For Disaster#130.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#131.src: I cannot help but notice that your dish is ready!
Recipe For Disaster#131.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#132.src: Let me taste your dish and I will present you mine! Mon dieu, une omelette?
Recipe For Disaster#132.dst: 让我尝尝你的菜，我也会把我的菜端给你！我的天，煎蛋卷？
Recipe For Disaster#132.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#133.src: Je suis déçu, ami. I would prefer biting into a mule derrière! This thing... a Gert wouldn't touch it!
Recipe For Disaster#133.dst: 我太失望了，朋友。我宁可去啃骡子的屁股！这东西……连 Gert 都不会碰！
Recipe For Disaster#133.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#134.src: I see you haven't improved in the art of cuisine. Leave me be, and come back when you have learned what good food is!
Recipe For Disaster#134.dst: 看来你的厨艺一点长进都没有。别烦我，等你学会什么是好菜再回来！
Recipe For Disaster#134.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#135.src: I see you've returned, and not empty handed. Please, show me what you've created!
Recipe For Disaster#135.dst: 我看你回来了，而且不是空着手。请给我看看你做了什么！
Recipe For Disaster#135.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#136.src: A pie? Why, you must have been helped by Frank. He always has a thing for making pie!
Recipe For Disaster#136.dst: 派？哎呀，一定是 Frank 帮了你。他一向爱做派！
Recipe For Disaster#136.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#137.src: I can see that your compétences culinaires are very well developed!
Recipe For Disaster#137.dst: 我看得出你的烹饪本领相当纯熟！
Recipe For Disaster#137.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#138.src: Though I will not truly call you a chef quite yet, you are très bien! Have this reward as congratulations!
Recipe For Disaster#138.dst: 虽然我还不会真的称你为厨师，但你做得非常好！收下这份奖励，作为祝贺！
Recipe For Disaster#138.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Reclaiming the House#000.src: Join Elphaba on a mission in the Temporary Camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Reclaiming the House#000.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的临时营地加入 Elphaba 的任务

Reclaiming the House#001.src: Oh, a Wynnic soldier out here in the boondocks? Honestly, you're just what we need- I could use your help, if you're able?
Reclaiming the House#001.dst: 噢，这种穷乡僻壤竟然有 Wynn 的士兵？说真的，你正是我们需要的人——如果可以的话，能帮我个忙吗？
Reclaiming the House#001.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#002.src: Good, thank you. Let me lock down the camp before I give you the briefing, though.
Reclaiming the House#002.dst: 很好，谢谢。不过先让我把营地封锁好，再给你做简报。
Reclaiming the House#002.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#003.src: My name is Elphaba. I've been working with the Gavellian army for a good few years now.
Reclaiming the House#003.dst: 我叫 Elphaba。我在 Gavel 军队服役好几年了。
Reclaiming the House#003.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#004.src: I'm the commander of the {p} Outpost down ahead. It's a strategic fortress, placed to monitor the Orcish capital.
Reclaiming the House#004.dst: 我是前面 {p} 前哨站的指挥官。那是一座战略要塞，用来监视兽人的首都。
Reclaiming the House#004.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#005.src: It was safe for a long while, but especially in the past while the Orcs have gotten far bolder, more aggressive.
Reclaiming the House#005.dst: 那里安全了很长一段时间，但尤其是最近，兽人变得大胆得多，也更有攻击性。
Reclaiming the House#005.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#006.src: They overwhelmed the outpost- we had to retreat and set up this camp to watch over the place we used to watch over them with!
Reclaiming the House#006.dst: 他们攻陷了前哨站——我们只好撤退，建起这个营地，来监视我们原本用来监视他们的地方！
Reclaiming the House#006.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#007.src: I need more firepower if I'm going... to get...
Reclaiming the House#007.dst: 如果我要……夺回……我需要更多火力……
Reclaiming the House#007.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#008.src: ...oh no. See, this is what I mean! The orcs are coming!
Reclaiming the House#008.dst: ……噢不。你看，我说的就是这个！兽人来了！
Reclaiming the House#008.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#009.src: Brace yourself, soldier! Protect the camp!
Reclaiming the House#009.dst: 做好准备，士兵！保护营地！
Reclaiming the House#009.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#010.src: Kill the mobs raiding the Camp.

Reclaiming the House#011.src: This is the third attack in three days! How many reinforcements have they got?!
Reclaiming the House#011.dst: 这是三天里的第三次袭击了！他们到底有多少援军？！
Reclaiming the House#011.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#012.src: Gah! Their casters are strong, careful!
Reclaiming the House#012.dst: 啊！他们的施法者很强，小心！
Reclaiming the House#012.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#013.src: Talk to Elphaba for information on the upcoming attack.
Reclaiming the House#013.dst: 与 Elphaba 对话，了解即将到来的进攻。

Reclaiming the House#014.src: Ugh, I think that was all of them... Come here now, I'll start up where we left off.
Reclaiming the House#014.dst: 呃，我想那是最后一批了……过来吧，我接着刚才说。
Reclaiming the House#014.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#015.src: Not sure I could have done that myself. I'm lucky you came around when you did, soldier.
Reclaiming the House#015.dst: 我不确定我一个人能不能撑过去。幸好你来得正是时候，士兵。
Reclaiming the House#015.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#016.src: Anyway, it's clear I'm going to need more firepower if I'm going to have a shot at reclaiming that outpost.
Reclaiming the House#016.dst: 总之，很明显，如果我想有机会夺回那个前哨站，就需要更多火力。
Reclaiming the House#016.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#017.src: You've certainly got the fighting chops, so I'd appreciate the aid, but we've got to come up with a plan, fast.
Reclaiming the House#017.dst: 你的战斗本领肯定没问题，所以我很感激你的帮忙，但我们得赶快想个计划。
Reclaiming the House#017.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#018.src: There's an old tower near the outpost- some old storage silo. It was built taller than the fort, so we might be able to spy on them from there.
Reclaiming the House#018.dst: 前哨站附近有一座旧塔——是个旧仓储筒仓。它盖得比要塞还高，所以我们也许能从那里侦察他们。
Reclaiming the House#018.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#019.src: It's a risk though, since it's so close by, but we have no other options. Meet me at the tower southeast of here so we can survey the situation.
Reclaiming the House#019.dst: 不过那里离得很近，有风险，但我们别无选择。在这里东南边的塔跟我会合，我们去看看情况。
Reclaiming the House#019.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#020.src: Go to the watch tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to plan the attack.

Reclaiming the House#021.src: Soldier! I'm right behind you. You can see our outpost- and the tower I mentioned.
Reclaiming the House#021.dst: 士兵！我就在你后面。你看得到我们的前哨站——还有我说的那座塔。
Reclaiming the House#021.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#022.src: We need to find a way in. A lot of soldiers were caught unaware during the Orcs' assault, too.
Reclaiming the House#022.dst: 我们得想办法进去。兽人突袭的时候，也有很多士兵措手不及。
