Shattered Minds#013.src: I will be around! Or asquare, as it were. Technically amultiplesquares, replete with alines! And abevels! And other some such things like-
Shattered Minds#013.dst: 我会在附近！或者说附方，严格来说是附好多方，还带附线！附斜角！还有别的诸如此类——
Shattered Minds#013.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#014.src: The punks scramble like eggs, and your skillet is sizzling! Certainly the heat in the kitchen is too much- so where is the fire extinguisher?
Shattered Minds#014.dst: 小混混像鸡蛋一样被打散，你的平底锅正滋滋作响！厨房里肯定太热了——灭火器在哪？
Shattered Minds#014.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#015.src: It won't rocket you! The hole in the shape of a door looms out of your transparent grasp- frogs can't skip leg day, so be froggy! Bounce and jump!
Shattered Minds#015.dst: 它不会把你当火箭发射！门形状的洞在你透明的掌握之外隐隐浮现——青蛙可不能不练腿，所以当只青蛙吧！弹跳吧！
Shattered Minds#015.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#016.src: Swoosh and sprint! Speed and non-slip shoes! With a CLICK upon me I give you all but one, as much as you need!
Shattered Minds#016.dst: 咻咻冲刺！速度和防滑鞋！在我身上咔哒一下，我就给你除了一个以外的全部，要多少有多少！
Shattered Minds#016.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#017.src: The colors! Shimmering as a prism- oh, no one likes those things. The writing is on the wall, but the window mugs it for pocket change! The inhumanity!
Shattered Minds#017.dst: 颜色！像棱镜一样闪闪发光——噢，没人喜欢那种东西。字就写在墙上，可窗户为了零钱把它抢了！太没人性了！
Shattered Minds#017.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#018.src: Use your eyes as ears and hear what I shall write! The cockpit is missing ground control and the cornfields all look the same in endless rows!
Shattered Minds#018.dst: 用你的眼睛当耳朵，听我要写的东西！驾驶舱没了地面指挥，玉米田一排排无穷无尽，看起来全都一样！
Shattered Minds#018.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#019.src: So Eih, esquire professor PhD, will provide the coordinates in helpfully non-literal fashion, and one's joystick shall lead the holder to bliss!
Shattered Minds#019.dst: 所以，Eih，尊贵的教授博士，将以非常不字面的方式提供坐标，而握着操纵杆的人就会被引向极乐！
Shattered Minds#019.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#020.src: At one's boots, the colors paint themselves towards an orientation. Above one's head, the lights match and fling you the same!
Shattered Minds#020.dst: 在人的靴子下，颜色自己朝着某个方向画过去。在人的头顶上，灯光对上了，也会把你照样甩出去！
Shattered Minds#020.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#021.src: I'm all out of airplane food, but the goal is more than peanuts- it's progress, just opposite our position. Fly well!
Shattered Minds#021.dst: 我的飞机餐吃完了，但目标可不只是花生——那是进展，就在我们位置的反方向。飞得好点！
Shattered Minds#021.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#022.src: WOW. Just, WOW! Your brain being frazzled doesn't excuse this failure! Time is money and we're swimming in a river called DEBT!
Shattered Minds#022.dst: 哇。真的，哇！脑子被搅糊了也不能为这种失败开脱！时间就是金钱，而我们正泡在一条叫负债的河里！
Shattered Minds#022.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#023.src: I'm just going to stand here and you're gonna go into the teleporters I'm NOT in, and you're gonna like it!
Shattered Minds#023.dst: 我就站在这里，而你要走进我不在的那些传送门，而且你会喜欢的！
Shattered Minds#023.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#024.src: Explore the strange forest to find Likeru.
Shattered Minds#024.dst: 探索这片奇怪的森林，找到 Likeru。

Shattered Minds#025.src: Hey, look to your left for a moment.

Shattered Minds#026.src: I hope you've got a note pad with you, if you want me to teach you the ways of a master you'll need to write a lot down!
Shattered Minds#026.dst: 希望你带了笔记本，如果你想让我教你大师之道，就得记很多东西！
Shattered Minds#026.speaker: Steve

Shattered Minds#027.src: It doesn't matter that we're on a {~}-match losing streak, we'll never give up!
Shattered Minds#027.dst: 就算我们已经连输 {~} 场也无所谓，我们永不放弃！
Shattered Minds#027.speaker: Erd

Shattered Minds#028.src: C'mon Beakmeister, we've ventured together for years now! Why won't you listen to me?
Shattered Minds#028.dst: 拜托，Beakmeister，我们一起冒险好多年了！你为什么不听我的？
Shattered Minds#028.speaker: Flamingo Rider

Shattered Minds#029.src: I don't think she's even listening to me anymore. She's a free spirit!
Shattered Minds#029.dst: 我觉得她根本已经不听我说话了。她是个自由的灵魂！
Shattered Minds#029.speaker: Flamingo Rider

Shattered Minds#030.src: Familiar to the nursing home, with no IV in sight! Phenomenal, and now my gambling metaphors will be apropos!
Shattered Minds#030.dst: 像养老院一样熟悉，却看不到点滴！太妙了，现在我的赌博比喻终于恰到好处了！
Shattered Minds#030.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#031.src: A solid, {~} pure, statue-made-out-of-tons-of-things what looks like me! I call it, “Ill Of The Ooze, Young!” And it begets your path amongst the lilypads.
Shattered Minds#031.dst: 一座实心的、{~} 纯度的、由好多好多东西做成的雕像，长得像我！我叫它“年轻人，淤泥之病！”它为你在荷叶之间开出一条路。
Shattered Minds#031.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#032.src: Likeru? No, no, she can’t find you here- her eyes deceive her. But I won't! Not any more than the film reel degrades, and the theater is ahead!
Shattered Minds#032.dst: Likeru？不不，她在这里找不到你——她的眼睛骗了她。但我不会！只要胶片不老化就不会，而剧院就在前面！
Shattered Minds#032.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#033.src: Now, don't tell the kids about this one either! The way forward is through my masterpiece- but I can't imagine a gullet glorious!
Shattered Minds#033.dst: 好了，这件事也别跟小孩说！前进的路要穿过我的杰作——可我想象不出比这更辉煌的喉咙了！
Shattered Minds#033.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#034.src: Enter the giant frog and escape.
Shattered Minds#034.dst: 进入巨大的青蛙体内，逃出去。

Shattered Minds#035.src: Don't come any closer... I don't want to have to fight...

Shattered Minds#036.src: I-I'm warning you. You'll stand no match against me...
Shattered Minds#036.dst: 我、我警告你。你不是我的对手……

Shattered Minds#038.src: There we are! Snapped out of it! Though perhaps writing in the mud was better- Soon it will dry.
Shattered Minds#038.dst: 这就对了！清醒过来了！不过也许写在泥巴里比较好——它很快就会干。
Shattered Minds#038.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#039.src: Without the static of the fungal caps, the radio station will be off-air- and the device unplugged!
Shattered Minds#039.dst: 没有了菌盖的杂音，电台就会停播——而且装置会被拔掉插头！
Shattered Minds#039.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#040.src: Scratch it in your eyelids- the lightbulb screwed between the arches, and the feather-duster's sunset shades will reveal my deepest compatriot. Quick now, wake!
Shattered Minds#040.dst: 把它刻在你的眼皮上——拱门之间拧着的灯泡，和羽毛掸子的日落色调，会揭示我最深的同伴。快，醒来！
Shattered Minds#040.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#041.src: Ugh. Rats chewing the roots. They've their place, it simply isn't here. Neither is your place in the koi pond, stranger.
Shattered Minds#041.dst: 唉。老鼠在啃树根。它们有它们该待的地方，只是不在这里。你该待的地方也不是锦鲤池，陌生人。
Shattered Minds#041.speaker: Elder Berusia

Shattered Minds#042.src: I believe Likeru tossed you into the deep end without meaning, so to speak. I understand your being overwhelmed, but still...
Shattered Minds#042.dst: 我相信 Likeru 是一不小心就把你扔进了深水区，可以这么说。我理解你一下子应付不过来，但即便如此……
Shattered Minds#042.speaker: Elder Berusia

Shattered Minds#043.src: Speaking of which, it might behoove you to let her know you've recovered. Though, should you need rest, you may take it here.
Shattered Minds#043.dst: 说到这个，你最好让她知道你已经恢复了。不过，如果你需要休息，可以在这里歇一会儿。
Shattered Minds#043.speaker: Elder Berusia

Shattered Minds#044.dst: 回到 {p} [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Likeru 那里。

Shattered Minds#045.src: Ehm. Okay, that was...a bad idea. Should NOT have done that with a human. Uh, noted for the futu- oh, you're actually alright?!
Shattered Minds#045.dst: 呃。好吧，那真是……个坏主意。不该拿人类做那个实验的。呃，下次记住——噢，你真的没事？！
Shattered Minds#045.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#046.src: You came back and just leapt into the koi pond! I thought you'd drowned down there!
Shattered Minds#046.dst: 你回来之后直接就跳进了锦鲤池！我还以为你淹死在下面了！
Shattered Minds#046.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#047.src: I guess the spores from the Bluecaps got to you before you could bring them back. I wonder what you saw?
Shattered Minds#047.dst: 我猜是蓝帽蘑菇的孢子在你带回来之前就影响到你了。真好奇你看到了什么？
Shattered Minds#047.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#048.src: You reacted like you were crazy when I tried to talk with you... You were supposed to get visions of the light! A deep connection!
Shattered Minds#048.dst: 我想跟你说话的时候，你的反应就像疯了一样……你本来应该看到光的幻象的！一种深刻的连结！
Shattered Minds#048.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#049.src: Wait, maybe it's cause of that portal...the signals got mixed? I'll have to look into this more...but hey, I got the Bluecap, anyways, so...
Shattered Minds#049.dst: 等等，也许是因为那个传送门……信号混在一起了？我得再研究研究……不过嘿，反正我拿到蓝帽蘑菇了，所以……
Shattered Minds#049.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#050.src: Here, your payment- and a little extra I whipped up too. Um, really sorry about all that!
Shattered Minds#050.dst: 给，你的报酬——还有我顺手做的一点额外的东西。呃，真的很抱歉搞成那样！
Shattered Minds#050.speaker: Likeru

Shrouded in Mist#000.src: New Chapter Started: Amongst the Canopy

Shrouded in Mist#001.src: There's a thin layer of dust on top of the bed.

Shrouded in Mist#002.src: The monitor is keeping the machine running.
Shrouded in Mist#002.dst: 监视器维持着机器的运转。

Shrouded in Mist#003.src: Maybe something sharp can break it...
Shrouded in Mist#003.dst: 也许尖锐的东西能把它弄破……

Shrouded in Mist#004.src: - Entry {~}: Stayed in and slept all day. Was very tired.
Shrouded in Mist#004.dst: - 第 {~} 篇：待在家里睡了一整天。非常累。

Shrouded in Mist#005.src: - Entry {~}: Slept in. Boss wasn't happy with me, has me working extra shifts next week.
Shrouded in Mist#005.dst: - 第 {~} 篇：睡过头了。老板很不满，下周让我加班。

Shrouded in Mist#008.src: The entries stop after this point...

Shrouded in Mist#009.src: This must be where Nisen lives...
Shrouded in Mist#009.dst: 这里一定就是 Nisen 住的地方……

Shrouded in Mist#010.src: Group up with the remaining members at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#015.src: About what? What could you possibly be thinking about right-
Shrouded in Mist#015.dst: 想什么？这种时候你能想什么——
Shrouded in Mist#015.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#016.src: I don't know, Yusanu! Maybe about what to do next? How we can- h-how we-
Shrouded in Mist#016.dst: 我不知道，Yusanu！也许是想接下来该怎么办？我们要怎么——我、我们要怎么——
Shrouded in Mist#016.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#017.src: There's nothing we can do! We're stuck in unfamiliar territory, all lone, our family and friends all captured, or- or worse-
Shrouded in Mist#017.dst: 我们什么都做不了！我们困在陌生的地方，孤零零的，家人朋友全被抓了，或者——或者更糟——
Shrouded in Mist#017.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#019.src: Urgh! I can't believe I let her convince me stealing this... this thing was worth it! If I hadn't, then... then our agreement wouldn't have fallen through, and none of this would have-
Shrouded in Mist#019.dst: 呃！真不敢相信我居然被她说服，觉得偷这……这东西值得！要是我没偷，那……那我们的协议就不会破裂，这一切也不会——
Shrouded in Mist#019.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#020.src: Don't you dare pin this on Rex. You heard what that Sovereign said, they- th-they knew what we were planning for ages!
Shrouded in Mist#020.dst: 你敢把这件事怪到 Rex 头上试试。你也听到那个统领说的了，他们——他、他们早就知道我们在计划什么了！
Shrouded in Mist#020.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#021.src: ...then maybe it'd have been best if you left us out of it.
Shrouded in Mist#021.dst: ……那也许你当初别把我们卷进来最好。
Shrouded in Mist#021.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#023.dst: 有入侵者！猫头鹰队，拿起武器！

Shrouded in Mist#026.src: Woah woah woah woah woah! Alright, let's all take a step back, shall we?
Shrouded in Mist#026.dst: 哇哇哇哇哇！好了，大家都先退一步，好吗？

Shrouded in Mist#027.src: Owls! Step down! Bit of a leap, jumping straight to violence- we reserve that for the obviously crown-aligned, eheheh.
Shrouded in Mist#027.dst: 猫头鹰队！退下！一上来就动手有点太急了——那是留给明摆着投靠王室的人的，嘿嘿嘿。

Shrouded in Mist#028.src: Allow me to introduce myself! The name's Rurie, member of the Canopy, captain of the Owls division! Apologies for the roughhousing, seems everyone's a little enthusiastic today, eh?
Shrouded in Mist#028.dst: 请容我自我介绍！我叫 Rurie，树冠会成员，猫头鹰队队长！刚才动手动脚的，抱歉啦，今天大家好像都有点太热情了，嗯？
Shrouded in Mist#028.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#030.src: Questions, questions! I'm afraid it's our turn first- I've called the owls off for a time, but don't think you're off the hook just yet, young lady!
Shrouded in Mist#030.dst: 问题，问题！恐怕得先轮到我们问——我暂时叫猫头鹰队收手了，但可别以为你已经脱身了，小姑娘！
Shrouded in Mist#030.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#031.src: ...captain, are you certain about this? For all we know, they could be spies-
Shrouded in Mist#031.dst: ……队长，你确定要这样？说不定他们是间谍——
Shrouded in Mist#031.speaker: Owl Fighter

Shrouded in Mist#032.src: Ah ah ah! Trust in the process, my friend. Spies or not, information is valuable.
Shrouded in Mist#032.dst: 啊啊啊！相信流程，我的朋友。不管是不是间谍，情报都很宝贵。
Shrouded in Mist#032.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#033.src: Besides! We know how to... ah, deal with spies, as it were. Risk factor is minimal!
Shrouded in Mist#033.dst: 再说了！我们知道怎么……呃，处理间谍，你懂的。风险微乎其微！
Shrouded in Mist#033.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#034.src: So... what, are you also resisting-
Shrouded in Mist#034.dst: 所以……怎样，你们也在反抗——
Shrouded in Mist#034.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#035.src: Hold it there, mister! Didn't you hear me? We'll be asking the questions here first.
Shrouded in Mist#035.dst: 打住，先生！你没听到我说的吗？这里先由我们来问问题。
Shrouded in Mist#035.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#036.src: Seems you're the only one who hasn't spoken yet! Well now, don't be shy. Tell me - where are you lot from?
Shrouded in Mist#036.dst: 看来就剩你还没开口了！好啦，别害羞。告诉我——你们这群人是从哪来的？
Shrouded in Mist#036.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#037.src: Really? Quite far afield, aren't you? Finding your way from there to here is quite an endeavor.
Shrouded in Mist#037.dst: 真的？那可真是远道而来啊？从那里一路找到这里，可不是件容易的事。
Shrouded in Mist#037.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#038.src: Ahhh! Now the pieces are clicking together! I think I get it now.
Shrouded in Mist#038.dst: 啊啊！现在拼图拼起来了！我想我明白了。
Shrouded in Mist#038.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#039.src: Ohoho? Really now? How very, very curious. You're either a verrrry clever spy, or...
Shrouded in Mist#039.dst: 哦呵呵？真的吗？真是非常、非常有意思。你要么是个非——常聪明的间谍，要么……
Shrouded in Mist#039.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#040.src: H... hey! Listen! I don't know who, or, or what you guys are, but--
Shrouded in Mist#040.dst: 嘿……嘿！听着！我不知道你们是谁，或者，或者是什么东西，但是——
Shrouded in Mist#040.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#041.src: How many times must I repeat myself? I said no que-
Shrouded in Mist#041.dst: 我到底要重复几遍？我说了不准问——
Shrouded in Mist#041.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#042.src: Shut UP! We just BARELY escaped {p} after we- after we tried to KILL the Queen! The rest of our friends are... captured, or d- dead!
Shrouded in Mist#042.dst: 闭嘴！我们刚刚才好不容易逃出 {p}，因为我们——因为我们想杀了女王！我们其他的朋友都……被抓了，或者死、死了！
Shrouded in Mist#042.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#043.src: So- so either leave us alone, or I'll- I'll make sure you never see your loved ones a- again!
Shrouded in Mist#043.dst: 所以——所以你们要么别来烦我们，要么我——我会让你们再、再也见不到你们爱的人！
Shrouded in Mist#043.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#046.src: Ohoho, she's sure got some temper, huh?
Shrouded in Mist#046.dst: 哦呵呵，她脾气可真不小，是吧？
Shrouded in Mist#046.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#047.src: Rurie... her story could explain what-
Shrouded in Mist#047.speaker: Owl Fighter

Shrouded in Mist#048.src: Yes, my friend, I was just thinking the very same thing. Well well, new folk, if what you're saying is true, the Canopy might just be able to assist!
Shrouded in Mist#048.dst: 是啊，我的朋友，我也正想着一样的事。好啦好啦，新来的，如果你们说的是真的，树冠会说不定能帮上忙！
Shrouded in Mist#048.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#049.src: I may have information regarding your allies.
Shrouded in Mist#049.dst: 我可能有关于你们同伴的情报。
Shrouded in Mist#049.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#051.src: Ah- but! But but but, see- trust is a currency here in the {p}. I can't just spill all my secrets at once, can I?
Shrouded in Mist#051.dst: 啊——不过！不过不过不过，你看——在 {p}，信任是一种货币。我总不能一口气把所有秘密都抖出来吧？
Shrouded in Mist#051.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#052.src: And if you'd like to earn our trust... I'll need you to, ah, deal with some things for me.
Shrouded in Mist#052.dst: 如果你们想赢得我们的信任……我需要你们帮我，呃，处理几件事。
Shrouded in Mist#052.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#054.src: Oh, nothing too difficult... I'll tell you on one condition! I'll be taking one of you with me as leverage! Eenie, meenie, money... you, little man!
Shrouded in Mist#054.dst: 噢，没什么太难的……我有一个条件才会告诉你们！我要带你们其中一个走当筹码！点点兵，点到谁……就是你，小伙子！
Shrouded in Mist#054.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#056.src: You, indeed! Worry not, for I'll be sure to keep you safe, but... well, you understand the need, yes?
Shrouded in Mist#056.dst: 没错，就是你！别担心，我一定会保你平安，不过……嗯，你明白这是必要的吧？
Shrouded in Mist#056.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#057.src: We can't! We can't lose... we can't lose anyone else. Please, there has to be something-
Shrouded in Mist#057.dst: 不行！我们不能失去……我们不能再失去任何人了。求求你，一定还有别的——
Shrouded in Mist#057.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#058.src: Sui... it's... fine. I don't think we have a choice. Just... do what they ask of you.
Shrouded in Mist#058.dst: Sui……没……关系。我想我们没得选。就……照他们说的做吧。
Shrouded in Mist#058.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#060.src: Goodness, so melodramatic! Come on, I'm a trustworthy fella! You've got nothing to worry about from me.
Shrouded in Mist#060.dst: 天哪，这么煽情！拜托，我可是个值得信赖的家伙！我这边你完全不用担心。
Shrouded in Mist#060.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#062.src: Ah-mazing! I'm glad you chose to be reasonable. In that case - I'll need the remaining two of you to go and sabotage three military structures.
Shrouded in Mist#062.dst: 太——棒了！很高兴你们这么通情达理。既然这样——剩下你们两个，去破坏三座军事设施。
Shrouded in Mist#062.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#063.src: Now, go and say your goodbyes, then come grab the list from me!
Shrouded in Mist#063.dst: 好了，去道个别，然后来我这里拿清单！
Shrouded in Mist#063.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#064.src: Talk to Rurie before heading out at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#064.dst: 出发前到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与 Rurie 交谈。

Shrouded in Mist#065.src: Hey. You'll be fine. I'll be fine.
Shrouded in Mist#065.dst: 嘿。你会没事的。我也会没事的。
Shrouded in Mist#065.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#066.src: I think we can trust them for now, at least. Not like we have an alternative...
Shrouded in Mist#066.dst: 我想至少目前我们可以信任他们。反正我们也没别的选择……
Shrouded in Mist#066.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#068.src: We really... don't have a choice, do we? We, we need their support.
Shrouded in Mist#068.dst: 我们真的……没得选，对吧？我们，我们需要他们的支持。
Shrouded in Mist#068.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#069.src: I just... hope Yusanu will be safe.
Shrouded in Mist#069.dst: 我只是……希望 Yusanu 平安。
Shrouded in Mist#069.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#070.src: Ugh... Captain's being reckless as usual...
Shrouded in Mist#070.dst: 唉……队长又跟平常一样乱来……
Shrouded in Mist#070.speaker: Owl Fighter

Shrouded in Mist#071.src: Have we finished with the heartfelt goodbyes? Excellent. Truly, I am glad you took me up on this generous offer.
Shrouded in Mist#071.dst: 感人的道别结束了吗？太好了。真的，我很高兴你们接受了这么慷慨的提议。
Shrouded in Mist#071.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#072.src: Don't worry about your little friend over there! He'll be safe and sound amongst our Canopy.
Shrouded in Mist#072.dst: 别担心你们那边那个小朋友！他在我们树冠会里会平平安安的。
Shrouded in Mist#072.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#073.src: ...and how can we trust you? To not... hurt him?
Shrouded in Mist#073.dst: ……我们要怎么相信你？相信你不会……伤害他？
Shrouded in Mist#073.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#074.src: Ah, isn't that the issue at the heart of it all? You can't. But as I said, trust is valuable in these woods. That must go both ways!
Shrouded in Mist#074.dst: 啊，这不正是问题的核心吗？你们没法相信。但就像我说的，在这片树林里信任很宝贵。那一定是双向的！
Shrouded in Mist#074.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#075.src: Well, newbies! You've a list of the structures I need you to sabotage, so it really should be a simple task.
Shrouded in Mist#075.dst: 好啦，新人们！你们手上有我需要你们破坏的设施清单，所以这应该是件很简单的任务。
Shrouded in Mist#075.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#076.src: Just find a way to... disable them! However you manage it, I can't say I really care - so long as it gets done!
Shrouded in Mist#076.dst: 只要想办法……让它们瘫痪就行！你们怎么做到的，我倒是不太在乎——只要做到就好！
Shrouded in Mist#076.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#078.src: Why, because it's a golden opportunity! The work needs doing, and you need a way to prove yourselves...
Shrouded in Mist#078.dst: 为什么？因为这是个大好机会啊！活儿需要人干，而你们需要证明自己……
Shrouded in Mist#078.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#079.src: So why not? It's less work for me to do, so I'm not complaining!
Shrouded in Mist#079.dst: 那为什么不呢？我少干点活，我可没什么好抱怨的！
Shrouded in Mist#079.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#080.src: Newbies! That's what you are, isn't it? New to the woods, new to the world...
Shrouded in Mist#080.dst: 新人！你们就是新人，不是吗？初来这片树林，初来这个世界……
Shrouded in Mist#080.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#081.src: ...maybe new to Fruma, even? Ah ah, wipe that expression of shock off your face! I won't tell if you don't either.
Shrouded in Mist#081.dst: ……说不定甚至是刚离开 Fruma？啊啊，把脸上那副震惊的表情收一收！你们不说，我也不会说。
Shrouded in Mist#081.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#082.dst: 一如往常地干劲十足！很好！
Shrouded in Mist#082.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#083.src: Once you're done, find me back here! Just don't take too long, eh? Wouldn't want to get bored!
Shrouded in Mist#083.dst: 完成之后回来这里找我！只是别拖太久，嗯？我可不想无聊死！
Shrouded in Mist#083.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#084.src: Ta ta, newbies! Good luck out there! And just a word of advice - stay on your guard. You never know what the mists may be hiding.
Shrouded in Mist#084.dst: 拜拜啦，新人们！祝你们好运！还有一句忠告——保持警惕。你永远不知道迷雾里藏着什么。
Shrouded in Mist#084.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#085.src: Select the structure to sabotage using the checklist.
Shrouded in Mist#085.dst: 用清单选择要破坏的设施。

Shrouded in Mist#086.src: Still a bit lost? Just use your taskbook to find the things I need broken!
Shrouded in Mist#086.dst: 还是有点摸不着头绪？用你的任务书去找我要你们弄坏的东西就行！
Shrouded in Mist#086.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#087.src: Head to the watchtower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and sabotage it using a spell.
Shrouded in Mist#087.dst: 前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的瞭望塔，用法术破坏它。

Shrouded in Mist#088.src: So is this... the place? "Military... Watchtower..." I guess so.
Shrouded in Mist#088.dst: 所以这里就是……那个地方？“军事……瞭望塔……”应该是吧。
Shrouded in Mist#088.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#089.src: Those supports look rather unstable, don't they? I wonder...
Shrouded in Mist#089.dst: 那些支架看起来挺不稳的，对吧？不知道……
Shrouded in Mist#089.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#090.src: C-can you deal with them, please?
Shrouded in Mist#090.dst: 你、你能处理一下它们吗，拜托？
Shrouded in Mist#090.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#091.src: Huh?! We're under attack - it must be the Canopy!
Shrouded in Mist#091.dst: 什么？！我们遭到攻击了——一定是树冠会！
Shrouded in Mist#091.speaker: Watchtower Guard

Shrouded in Mist#093.src: Let's just get this over with.
Shrouded in Mist#093.dst: 我们赶快把这件事做完吧。
Shrouded in Mist#093.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#095.src: Check the book, where should we go next?
Shrouded in Mist#095.dst: 看看清单，我们下一个该去哪？
Shrouded in Mist#095.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#097.src: Head to the water pump at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and sabotage it.

Shrouded in Mist#099.src: I think we can work together for this one. Go, um, blast some weak spots on the structure, and I'll... see if I can reverse the water flow.
Shrouded in Mist#099.dst: 我想这个我们可以合作。你去，呃，轰掉设施上的几个弱点，我来……看看能不能让水倒流。
Shrouded in Mist#099.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#100.src: Let's just... get rid of this hunk of junk.
Shrouded in Mist#100.dst: 我们就……把这堆破铜烂铁弄掉吧。
Shrouded in Mist#100.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#101.src: You, um, should try to blast some of the weak points with your magic.
Shrouded in Mist#101.dst: 你，呃，试着用魔法轰掉几个弱点。
Shrouded in Mist#101.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#102.src: Did you manage to apply some pressure on the pipes?
Shrouded in Mist#102.dst: 你有在管子上施加压力了吗？
Shrouded in Mist#102.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#103.src: Good, then it's... time for my part, I guess. Um, come talk to me when you're ready.
Shrouded in Mist#103.dst: 很好，那就……轮到我了吧。呃，准备好了就来跟我说。
Shrouded in Mist#103.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#105.src: Okay... okay. Breathe. I need to... focus.
Shrouded in Mist#105.dst: 好……好。呼吸。我得……集中精神。
Shrouded in Mist#105.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#106.src: After... after, um, everything that- that's happened, I've been... struggling with my cur-... ugh. You get what I mean.
Shrouded in Mist#106.dst: 发生了……发生了，呃，那么多事之后，我一直……很难控制我的诅——……唉。你懂我的意思。
Shrouded in Mist#106.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#107.src: It all feels so... so... hopeless! We've lost everyone, and now- now we've lost Yusanu too, and I... I couldn't do anything!
Shrouded in Mist#107.dst: 一切都感觉好……好……绝望！我们失去了所有人，现在——现在连 Yusanu 也失去了，而我……我什么都做不了！
Shrouded in Mist#107.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#108.src: And the last thing we did before was... argue! And now, he's... he's safe, probably, but... I don't know. I wish we hadn't.
Shrouded in Mist#108.dst: 而我们之前做的最后一件事是……吵架！现在，他……他大概是安全的，但是……我不知道。真希望我们没吵。
Shrouded in Mist#108.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#109.src: Every time I think about- about any of it, I get so... angry! And the swirling ocean around me starts raging more and more and more, and... and...
Shrouded in Mist#109.dst: 每次我一想到——想到这些事，我就好……生气！我身边翻涌的海水就越来越、越来越汹涌，然后……然后……
Shrouded in Mist#109.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#110.src: I'm scared, {u}. I'm scared for Mora... Syndra... Rex, Zeph, the whole Steel Feather- for all of them! And I... there's nothing I can do...
Shrouded in Mist#110.dst: 我好怕，{u}。我为 Mora……Syndra……Rex、Zeph，整个钢羽——为他们所有人害怕！而我……我什么都做不了……
Shrouded in Mist#110.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#111.src: What if... what if they're all gone? And, and, and it's just us, forever...?
Shrouded in Mist#111.dst: 要是……要是他们全都不在了呢？而，而，而就只剩我们，永远……？
Shrouded in Mist#111.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#112.src: I... I know, {u}, I know! I'm... I'm trying, okay?!
Shrouded in Mist#112.dst: 我……我知道，{u}，我知道！我……我在努力了，好吗？！
Shrouded in Mist#112.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#115.src: I don't know if I, ha, have any left. Everything's... moving so fast...
Shrouded in Mist#115.dst: 我不知道我，哈，还剩不剩。一切都……变得好快……
Shrouded in Mist#115.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#116.src: I... I never wanted any of this. I just... I just wanted to live...
Shrouded in Mist#116.dst: 我……我从来都不想要这些。我只是……我只是想好好活着……
Shrouded in Mist#116.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#117.src: Sigh... okay. Sui, focus. You can do this.
Shrouded in Mist#117.dst: 唉……好。Sui，集中精神。你做得到的。
Shrouded in Mist#117.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#119.src: That's... I don't... how did I...
Shrouded in Mist#119.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#120.src: It... the ocean, it... stopped. I pulled at it, and it... it stopped moving, and...
Shrouded in Mist#120.dst: 它……海水，它……停了。我拉了它一下，它就……它就不动了，然后……
Shrouded in Mist#120.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#121.src: There's... there's no time to, to think about it. It worked, so... so that's good.
Shrouded in Mist#121.dst: 没……没时间去，去想这个了。成功了，所以……所以那样很好。
Shrouded in Mist#121.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#122.src: Just... check the book, what's our next stop?
Shrouded in Mist#122.dst: 就……看看清单，我们下一站是哪？
Shrouded in Mist#122.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#123.src: I... I think that was the last one. Let's go tell Rurie that it's, um, done.
Shrouded in Mist#123.dst: 我……我想那是最后一个了。我们去告诉 Rurie，呃，完成了吧。
Shrouded in Mist#123.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#124.src: Head to the mining drill at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#126.src: It looks... durable. Like, um, it'll be hard to just... break. We need to find another way...
Shrouded in Mist#126.dst: 它看起来……很耐用。就是，呃，没那么容易……弄坏。我们得找别的办法……
Shrouded in Mist#126.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#127.src: There- there isn't any water nearby. So, so if any soldiers show up... please, can you deal with them?
Shrouded in Mist#127.dst: 这——这附近没有水。所以，所以要是有士兵出现……拜托，你能处理他们吗？
Shrouded in Mist#127.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#128.src: Aha, saboteurs! You won't get away with damaging the crown's property, not on my watch!
Shrouded in Mist#128.dst: 啊哈，破坏分子！有我在，你们休想损坏王室的财产还全身而退！
Shrouded in Mist#128.speaker: Mistwoods Captain

Shrouded in Mist#129.src: Um... good job, {u}. I didn't think about breaking the controls...
Shrouded in Mist#129.dst: 呃……干得好，{u}。我没想到可以弄坏控制装置……
Shrouded in Mist#129.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#130.src: We should check the book, and find our next stop.
Shrouded in Mist#130.dst: 我们该看看清单，找下一站。
Shrouded in Mist#130.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#131.src: Was that the last one? Let's head back to Rurie and... and tell him it's done.
Shrouded in Mist#131.dst: 那是最后一个了吗？我们回去找 Rurie……告诉他完成了吧。
Shrouded in Mist#131.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#132.src: Return to Rurie at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and discuss the next step.
Shrouded in Mist#132.dst: 回到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Rurie 那里，讨论下一步。

Shrouded in Mist#133.src: Well well! So the newbies return! Tell me, how did you find your trial?
Shrouded in Mist#133.dst: 好啦好啦！新人们回来了！跟我说说，你们觉得这次考验怎么样？
Shrouded in Mist#133.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#134.src: We did what you asked, so... so tell us about our friends, already!
Shrouded in Mist#134.dst: 你要我们做的都做了，所以……所以快告诉我们朋友的消息！
Shrouded in Mist#134.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#135.src: Ah ah ah! Not so fast! I'm afraid you're not done quite yet!
Shrouded in Mist#135.dst: 啊啊啊！别急！恐怕你们还没完呢！
Shrouded in Mist#135.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#137.src: Deadly serious, I fear! That, dear friends, was but the first part of your task.
Shrouded in Mist#137.dst: 恐怕是非常认真的！亲爱的朋友们，那只是你们任务的第一部分。
Shrouded in Mist#137.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#138.src: Oh, but on the contrary! I received word immediately once you had done the deed.
Shrouded in Mist#138.dst: 噢，恰恰相反！你们一得手，我马上就收到消息了。
Shrouded in Mist#138.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#139.src: Ugh... we had an agreement! You can't just-
Shrouded in Mist#139.dst: 唉……我们说好了的！你不能就这样——
Shrouded in Mist#139.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#140.src: But I can. If you want our support, you'll do what we ask. If it is any consolation, this is the last I will ask of you before our deal is concluded.
Shrouded in Mist#140.dst: 但我能。如果你们想要我们的支持，就照我们说的做。如果能让你们好受点的话，这是我们交易完成前我要你们做的最后一件事。
Shrouded in Mist#140.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#142.src: I would ask of you to kindly... ehm, transport an {p} citizen here. Do make sure you aren't spotted by anyone else! That could cause... issues.
Shrouded in Mist#142.dst: 我想请你们好心地……呃，把一位 {p} 的居民运到这里来。千万别被任何其他人看到！那可能会引起……麻烦。
Shrouded in Mist#142.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#144.src: Ah! Allow me to rephrase. You need to kidnap them.
Shrouded in Mist#144.dst: 啊！容我换个说法。你们得绑架他。
Shrouded in Mist#144.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#146.src: Yes, indeed! Kidnap them, bring them here, and we will deal with the rest.
Shrouded in Mist#146.dst: 没错，就是这样！绑架他，把他带到这里，剩下的交给我们处理。
Shrouded in Mist#146.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#147.src: You want us to just... just snatch a random citizen from their home? And, and what do you mean "deal with the rest?"
Shrouded in Mist#147.dst: 你要我们就……就这样从家里抓走一个无关的居民？还有，还有你说的“剩下的交给我们处理”是什么意思？
Shrouded in Mist#147.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#148.src: No questions, young lady! Not if you'd like to ensure the safety of your friend, that is.
Shrouded in Mist#148.dst: 不准问问题，小姑娘！除非你不想确保你朋友的安全。
Shrouded in Mist#148.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#150.src: You didn't even tell us who we're looking for!
Shrouded in Mist#150.dst: 你连我们要找谁都没说！
Shrouded in Mist#150.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#151.src: Ahaha, apologies, my mistake! You'll be looking for the man named Nisen. Bring him here, but don't take too long!
Shrouded in Mist#151.dst: 啊哈哈，抱歉，是我疏忽了！你们要找一个叫 Nisen 的男人。把他带来，但别拖太久！
Shrouded in Mist#151.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#152.src: Nisen. Fine. {u}, let's... talk about this outside the cave.
Shrouded in Mist#152.dst: Nisen。好吧。{u}，我们……出洞穴再谈吧。
Shrouded in Mist#152.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#153.src: Leave the cave and discuss the plan with Sui at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#153.dst: 离开洞穴，到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与 Sui 讨论计划。

Shrouded in Mist#155.src: This... this is just getting ridiculous.
Shrouded in Mist#155.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#156.src: We, we need to find a way to get Yusanu back, and... and get out of here.
Shrouded in Mist#156.dst: 我们，我们得想办法把 Yusanu 救回来，然后……然后离开这里。
Shrouded in Mist#156.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#157.src: I know, I know, I know! And if we start looking, they'll, they'll notice.
Shrouded in Mist#157.dst: 我知道，我知道，我知道！要是我们开始找，他们，他们会发现的。
Shrouded in Mist#157.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#158.src: I'm... sick and tired of following that clown's orders. But you're right...
Shrouded in Mist#158.dst: 我……受够听那个小丑的命令了。但你说得对……
Shrouded in Mist#158.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#159.src: It's just... weird. This last task. I don't get it.
Shrouded in Mist#159.dst: 只是……很奇怪。这最后一个任务。我搞不懂。
Shrouded in Mist#159.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#160.src: Even if Rurie's out of his mind... I don't see him just- just killing an innocent person. Especially if they're, um, a resistance group.
Shrouded in Mist#160.dst: 就算 Rurie 疯疯癫癫的……我也不觉得他会就这样——就这样杀死一个无辜的人。尤其他们，呃，还是个抵抗组织。
Shrouded in Mist#160.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#161.src: Ugh. I don't know. Maybe if we investigate this Nisen person, we'll... figure out Rurie's reasoning.
Shrouded in Mist#161.dst: 唉。我不知道。也许我们调查一下这个 Nisen，就能……弄懂 Rurie 的用意。
Shrouded in Mist#161.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#163.src: Head to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and locate Nisen.

Shrouded in Mist#165.src: Phew. Getting up here really wasn't the easiest... the Red Fox back in Auburn really, ha, pales in comparison.
Shrouded in Mist#165.dst: 呼。爬上来真的不太容易……Auburn 的赤狐跟这比，哈，简直不值一提。
Shrouded in Mist#165.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#166.src: I've been trying to get information on Nisen, but... people don't seem to like me much.
Shrouded in Mist#166.dst: 我一直在打听 Nisen 的消息，可是……大家好像不太喜欢我。
Shrouded in Mist#166.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#167.src: Maybe you'll have some better luck?
Shrouded in Mist#167.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#182.src: ...I don't...see it. You haven't got one- Er. I. I mean. Nothing. No. Definitely, uh...definitely not.
Shrouded in Mist#182.dst: ……我没……看到。你没有徽章呃。我。我是说。没什么。没有。绝对，呃……绝对没有。
Shrouded in Mist#182.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#183.src: I can't look, I'm really not supposed to be talking to you at all, and Wait, that counts as urgh!
Shrouded in Mist#183.dst: 我不能看，我真的不应该跟你说话，而且等等，这样也算吧呃啊！
Shrouded in Mist#183.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#184.src: ...I'm. I. You. ...ugh, I'm no good at this.
Shrouded in Mist#184.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#185.src: ...well. ...sorry. Nisen... I. I do know. I shouldn't be telling you, but I do know. Please don't hurt me.
Shrouded in Mist#185.dst: ……好吧。……抱歉。Nisen……我。我确实知道。我不该告诉你，但我确实知道。求你别伤害我。
Shrouded in Mist#185.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#186.src: You need to take the zipline north-west. Not the one that goes upwards, though.
Shrouded in Mist#186.dst: 你得往西北方搭滑索。不过不是往上的那条。
Shrouded in Mist#186.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#190.src: Search Nisen's house for any [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] clues regarding him.
Shrouded in Mist#190.dst: 搜查 Nisen 的家，寻找任何 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与他有关的线索。

Shrouded in Mist#191.src: Um, let's hope he's not home...
Shrouded in Mist#191.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#192.src: That's odd... the latest entry's dated from weeks ago.
Shrouded in Mist#192.dst: 真奇怪……最新一篇的日期是几个星期前。
Shrouded in Mist#192.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#193.src: It's like they stopped writing them abruptly...
Shrouded in Mist#193.dst: 就好像突然停笔不写了……
Shrouded in Mist#193.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#194.dst: 快离开位于 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Nisen 家。

Shrouded in Mist#196.src: Eep! That must be Nisen! We need to think of an excuse...
Shrouded in Mist#196.dst: 咿！那一定是 Nisen！我们得想个借口……
Shrouded in Mist#196.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#197.src: Excuse me? What are you doing in my abode?
Shrouded in Mist#197.dst: 不好意思？你们在我的住所里做什么？
Shrouded in Mist#197.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#198.src: If I am not mistaken, stumbling into other people's abodes is not a custom.
Shrouded in Mist#198.dst: 如果我没弄错的话，闯进别人的住所可不是什么习俗。
Shrouded in Mist#198.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#199.src: Oh... I- I'm so sorry! I- I- we- we thought this was the... bakery.
Shrouded in Mist#199.dst: 噢……我——我真的很抱歉！我——我——我们——我们以为这里是……面包店。
Shrouded in Mist#199.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#201.src: Oh. Yes, wrong building. The bakery is down at ground level.
Shrouded in Mist#201.dst: 噢。对，走错房子了。面包店在底层。
Shrouded in Mist#201.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#202.src: Oh! Thank you for the directions. We are... so sorry for the misunderstanding.
Shrouded in Mist#202.dst: 噢！谢谢你指路。真的……非常抱歉造成误会。
Shrouded in Mist#202.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#203.src: Regroup with Sui at the main square at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#203.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的主广场与 Sui 会合。

Shrouded in Mist#205.src: That was close... I'm, um, surprised he believed us.
Shrouded in Mist#205.dst: 好险……我，呃，真意外他居然信了。
Shrouded in Mist#205.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#206.src: I- I panicked, okay! But it worked, didn't it?
Shrouded in Mist#206.dst: 我——我慌了嘛，好吗！但有用啊，不是吗？
Shrouded in Mist#206.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#207.src: He was... surprisingly chatty. That's a nice change compared to everyone else.
Shrouded in Mist#207.dst: 他……话多得出奇。跟其他人比起来还挺难得的。
Shrouded in Mist#207.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#208.src: Though, um, he was a bit... odd. He didn't seem too certain about his answers...
Shrouded in Mist#208.dst: 不过，呃，他有点……怪。他对自己的回答好像不太确定……
Shrouded in Mist#208.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#209.src: I don't know. What are you thinking? Any theories?
Shrouded in Mist#209.dst: 我不知道。你怎么想？有什么推测吗？
Shrouded in Mist#209.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#210.src: I... was thinking the same thing. It'd explain the diary entries stopping abruptly...
Shrouded in Mist#210.dst: 我……也在想一样的事。这就能解释日记为什么突然断掉了……
Shrouded in Mist#210.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#211.src: Maybe... I guess he could be. I might just be jumping to conclusions.
Shrouded in Mist#211.dst: 也许……我想他有可能是。我可能只是太快下结论了。
Shrouded in Mist#211.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#212.src: Uh... let's workshop that one a little.
Shrouded in Mist#212.dst: 呃……那个我们再琢磨琢磨吧。
Shrouded in Mist#212.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#213.src: Look, I managed to snag a schedule off his bedside table.
Shrouded in Mist#213.dst: 你看，我从他床头柜上顺来了一张日程表。
Shrouded in Mist#213.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#214.src: Listen to this. "Deliver hunting tools from weaponsmith through southern exit at noon."
Shrouded in Mist#214.dst: 听听这个。“中午从南边出口运送武器匠的狩猎工具。”
Shrouded in Mist#214.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#215.src: It's weird, right? Something's definitely off with him... but still, kidnapping him and handing him off to some... some random bird-man! I don't like it.
Shrouded in Mist#215.dst: 很奇怪，对吧？他肯定有什么不对劲……但就算这样，绑架他再把他交给某个……某个莫名其妙的鸟人！我不喜欢。
Shrouded in Mist#215.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#216.src: But... we don't have much of a choice. Let's camp outside the southern gate and wait...
Shrouded in Mist#216.dst: 可是……我们没什么选择。我们去南门外面埋伏着等吧……
Shrouded in Mist#216.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#219.src: Guess we'll just have to wait...
Shrouded in Mist#219.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#221.src: I... ha, I've been feeling really out of my depth, here. I've never had to do this much without... um, without their support.
Shrouded in Mist#221.dst: 我……哈，我在这里一直觉得力不从心。我从来没有在没有……呃，没有他们支持的情况下做过这么多事。
Shrouded in Mist#221.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#222.src: But... you're here to help, so. Um. Thanks for- for sticking with me. I... I don't think I'd have made it this far without you.
Shrouded in Mist#222.dst: 不过……你在这里帮忙，所以。呃。谢谢你——谢谢你一直陪着我。我……我不觉得没有你我能走到这一步。
Shrouded in Mist#222.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#226.src: Um... I think it worked, though. Can you help me?
Shrouded in Mist#226.dst: 呃……不过我想成功了。你能帮我一下吗？
Shrouded in Mist#226.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#228.src: That was... easier than I expected it to be.
Shrouded in Mist#228.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#229.src: I kind of just, um, landed on top of him? And... and here we are.
Shrouded in Mist#229.dst: 我就只是，呃，正好落在他身上？然后……然后就这样了。
Shrouded in Mist#229.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#230.src: We should... probably get moving. I don't want anyone to- to see us!
Shrouded in Mist#230.dst: 我们应该……赶快走了。我不想让任何人——看到我们！
Shrouded in Mist#230.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#231.src: Um! Control is... maybe not the right word. I... ha, I tried to freeze him. So... still working on it. I guess.
Shrouded in Mist#231.dst: 呃！控制……可能不是那个词。我……哈，我想把他冻住。所以……还在练习中。我想。
Shrouded in Mist#231.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#232.src: ......how are we going to move him?
Shrouded in Mist#232.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#233.src: Um! I... didn't think about that.
Shrouded in Mist#233.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#234.src: Well well, newbies! Looks like you could use a hand!
Shrouded in Mist#234.dst: 好啦好啦，新人们！看来你们需要帮把手！
Shrouded in Mist#234.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#235.src: Aah! Wh- where did you come from?!
Shrouded in Mist#235.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#236.src: Why, from the trees, of course! I see you've managed to subdue the good mister Nisen over here, well done, well done.
Shrouded in Mist#236.dst: 当然是从树上啦！看来你们成功制服了这位好 Nisen 先生，干得好，干得好。
Shrouded in Mist#236.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#237.src: ...we've done everything you've asked for. Now- now tell us what you know!!
Shrouded in Mist#237.dst: ……你要我们做的全都做了。现在——现在告诉我们你知道的！！
Shrouded in Mist#237.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#238.src: Oh, dear, you thought you two were done? Ha! Ahahaha!
Shrouded in Mist#238.dst: 噢，亲爱的，你们以为已经完了？哈！啊哈哈哈！
Shrouded in Mist#238.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#240.src: Kidding! Kidding, kidding- goodness, the looks on your faces! What's a little practical joke between friends, eh?
Shrouded in Mist#240.dst: 开玩笑的！开玩笑，开玩笑——天哪，瞧瞧你们的表情！朋友之间开个小玩笑有什么，嗯？
Shrouded in Mist#240.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#241.src: Fine! Fine, fine, I get it! Jeez, lady...
Shrouded in Mist#241.dst: 好！好好好，我懂了！天哪，这位小姐……
Shrouded in Mist#241.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#242.src: I'll cut it with the jokes... for now. Good news! You've passed the test!
Shrouded in Mist#242.dst: 我不开玩笑了……暂时。好消息！你们通过考验了！
Shrouded in Mist#242.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#244.src: Yes, yes, settle down, I will tell you. Give me a moment! Goodness. You're an impatient one, aren't you?
Shrouded in Mist#244.dst: 会，会，冷静点，我会告诉你们的。给我一点时间！天哪。你还真是没耐心，是吧？
Shrouded in Mist#244.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#245.src: I'll be bringing you two to the Canopy! But, ah, one little precaution- I'll have to blindfold you till we arrive, Just a security measure!
Shrouded in Mist#245.dst: 我要带你们两个去树冠会！不过，呃，有个小小的预防措施——到之前我得蒙住你们的眼睛，只是安全措施而已！
Shrouded in Mist#245.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#246.src: Ugh... you know what, I don't even care anymore. Just... bring us to Yusanu.
Shrouded in Mist#246.dst: 唉……你知道吗，我已经不在乎了。就……带我们去找 Yusanu。
Shrouded in Mist#246.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#248.src: Ugh! Fine fine fine! But hurry up.
Shrouded in Mist#248.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#249.src: Rurie, care to explain yourself? Why did you bring these outsiders here?
Shrouded in Mist#249.dst: Rurie，能解释一下吗？你为什么把这些外人带来这里？
Shrouded in Mist#249.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#251.src: Ah, you know how it is, Fuhue! I was oh so bored on patrol this morning! You lot aren't exactly the life of the party..
Shrouded in Mist#251.dst: 啊，你知道的嘛，Fuhue！我今天早上巡逻无聊得要命！你们这些人又不怎么会炒热气氛……
Shrouded in Mist#251.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#252.src: You know Azael has clear rules on recruiting. Did you file the necessary paperwork? Because I didn't see anything on my desk regarding this.
Shrouded in Mist#252.dst: 你知道 Azael 对招募有明确的规定。必要的文书你填了吗？因为我桌上没看到任何相关的东西。
Shrouded in Mist#252.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#253.src: The... ah, the paperwork was real? I always thought it was something you were making up for the fun of it.
Shrouded in Mist#253.dst: 那……呃，那些文书是真的？我一直以为那是你为了好玩编出来的。
Shrouded in Mist#253.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#254.src: No. We have the protocols in place for a reason, Captain Rurie. Will you find the time to review them yourself, or must I have Captain Cileon run you through them?
Shrouded in Mist#254.dst: 不是。我们订下这些规程是有原因的，Rurie 队长。你是会自己抽时间看一遍，还是得让 Cileon 队长带你过一遍？
Shrouded in Mist#254.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#255.src: Yes, yes, I understand the importance- though, I believe Cileon shares my views on the protocols. Isn't that right, Cileon?
Shrouded in Mist#255.dst: 是，是，我明白它们的重要性——不过，我相信 Cileon 对规程的看法跟我一样。对吧，Cileon？
Shrouded in Mist#255.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#257.src: H- hey! Don't just act like, like we aren't right here!
Shrouded in Mist#257.dst: 嘿——嘿！别当，当作我们不在这里一样！
Shrouded in Mist#257.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#258.src: Cileon! That is also against our protocols. We wouldn't want to leave a body for the crown to find, we have far simpler forms of disposal.
Shrouded in Mist#258.dst: Cileon！那也违反我们的规程。我们可不想留下尸体让王室找到，我们有简单得多的处理方式。
Shrouded in Mist#258.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#259.src: And of course, we need to torture any necessary information out of them first - I have heard this a dozen times over.
Shrouded in Mist#259.dst: 当然啦，我们还得先严刑逼问出所有必要的情报——这我已经听了几十遍了。
Shrouded in Mist#259.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#260.src: Ah! You were listening! Good, Captain Rurie. We'll knock some sense into you yet.
Shrouded in Mist#260.dst: 啊！你有在听嘛！很好，Rurie 队长。我们迟早会让你开窍的。
Shrouded in Mist#260.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#261.src: I did have some deerlings bring Nisen into our processing room earlier. Thank you for your service, Captain.
Shrouded in Mist#261.dst: 我刚才已经让几只小鹿把 Nisen 带进我们的处理室了。辛苦了，队长。
Shrouded in Mist#261.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#262.src: Ah, no problem! Hardly even broke a sweat!
Shrouded in Mist#262.dst: 啊，小事一桩！连汗都没怎么流！
Shrouded in Mist#262.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#263.src: Well, I'll be catching up with you later! I suppose if we're following protocols, I'll need to hand these kids off to Azael.
Shrouded in Mist#263.dst: 好啦，回头再找你聊！既然要遵守规程，我想我得把这两个孩子交给 Azael。
Shrouded in Mist#263.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#264.src: Hey hey, friends! I'm a bit thirsty, so I'll be leaving you now! Think you'll manage to find Azael yourselves?
Shrouded in Mist#264.dst: 嘿嘿，朋友们！我有点渴了，所以我先走啦！你们自己找得到 Azael 吧？
Shrouded in Mist#264.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#265.src: Find the leader inside the Canopy at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#266.src: Hm. Rurie told you to find Azael.
Shrouded in Mist#266.dst: 嗯。Rurie 叫你们去找 Azael。
Shrouded in Mist#266.speaker: Cileon

Shrouded in Mist#275.src: The schedule's always so busy... and now I have even more to deal with.
Shrouded in Mist#275.dst: 日程总是这么满……现在我要处理的事又更多了。
Shrouded in Mist#275.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#276.src: But I suppose I can squeeze you in for questions.
Shrouded in Mist#276.dst: 不过我想可以挤点时间回答你们的问题。
Shrouded in Mist#276.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#277.src: I am Fuhue, Team Captain of the Deer clan.
Shrouded in Mist#277.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#278.src: I also function as the overall manager of the Canopy, not just the Deer operations.
Shrouded in Mist#278.dst: 我同时也是整个树冠会的总管，不只负责鹿队的行动。
Shrouded in Mist#278.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#279.src: Master Azael can be found in his hut... it's just to the south-west of here.
Shrouded in Mist#279.dst: Azael 大人在他的小屋里……就在这里的西南边。
Shrouded in Mist#279.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#280.src: From what I've heard, your friend is over there as well.
Shrouded in Mist#280.dst: 据我所知，你们的朋友也在那边。
Shrouded in Mist#280.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#281.src: I'm afraid so. Insufferable as always...
Shrouded in Mist#281.dst: 恐怕是的。一如往常地让人受不了……
Shrouded in Mist#281.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#282.src: But he's incredibly talented at what he does. No one else could run the Owls like he does.
Shrouded in Mist#282.dst: 但他在自己的领域非常有才华。没有别人能像他那样带领猫头鹰队。
Shrouded in Mist#282.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#284.src: Or not! It's Master Azael's decision as to whether you stay or not. Just hope you manage to impress him.
Shrouded in Mist#284.dst: 也可能见不到！你们能不能留下，由 Azael 大人决定。只希望你们能让他刮目相看。
Shrouded in Mist#284.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#285.src: I have heard about your adventures in the {p} thus far. Very impressive work.
Shrouded in Mist#285.dst: 我已经听说了你们到目前为止在 {p} 的经历。非常了不起。
Shrouded in Mist#285.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#286.src: Not to interrupt you, but we've been running around all day, and I'm tired. Where's Yusanu?
Shrouded in Mist#286.dst: 不是想打断你，但我们跑了一整天，我累了。Yusanu 在哪？
Shrouded in Mist#286.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#289.src: Oh, you're okay... I'm so glad.
Shrouded in Mist#289.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#290.src: Yes, reunited at last. But now that you are here, it is time for business.
Shrouded in Mist#290.dst: 是啊，终于重逢了。不过既然你们来了，该谈正事了。
Shrouded in Mist#290.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#291.src: I had Yusanu inform me of your adventures in the {p}.
Shrouded in Mist#291.dst: 我让 Yusanu 告诉了我你们在 {p} 的经历。
Shrouded in Mist#291.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#292.src: And it would appear our causes are in alignment... to dismantle the crown. We here in the Canopy have taken a very active approach to this end.
Shrouded in Mist#292.dst: 看来我们的目标是一致的……推翻王室。我们树冠会在这件事上采取了非常主动的做法。
Shrouded in Mist#292.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#293.src: We had established three teams, each with their own responsibility. Each team attacks the crown on different fronts.
Shrouded in Mist#293.dst: 我们建立了三支队伍，各有各的职责。每支队伍从不同的方面打击王室。
Shrouded in Mist#293.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#294.src: The Owls are our eyes and ears. They are also our most efficient assassins. Captain Rurie, who you have already had the pleasure of meeting, is one of our most lethal members.
Shrouded in Mist#294.dst: 猫头鹰队是我们的耳目。他们也是我们效率最高的刺客。你们已经有幸见过的 Rurie 队长，是我们最致命的成员之一。
Shrouded in Mist#294.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#295.src: The Foxes are our assault team. They are skilled swordsmen utilizing techniques native to the {p}. They are trained to never lose a duel.
Shrouded in Mist#295.dst: 狐狸队是我们的突击队。他们是运用 {p} 本地剑术的精湛剑士。他们受的训练是永远不输任何一场决斗。
Shrouded in Mist#295.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#296.src: The Deers are our command team, the brains behind the operation. They are also responsible for... taking care of spies within {p}.
Shrouded in Mist#296.dst: 鹿队是我们的指挥队，是行动背后的大脑。他们也负责……处理 {p} 里的间谍。
Shrouded in Mist#296.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#298.src: Spies. That man you brought in, Nisen... I fear that is no longer Nisen. Weeks ago, he had been replaced by one of the crown's elite spies. We know them as Changelings.
Shrouded in Mist#298.dst: 间谍。你们带来的那个男人，Nisen……恐怕他已经不是 Nisen 了。几个星期前，他就被王室的一名精英间谍取代了。我们称他们为易形者。
Shrouded in Mist#298.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#299.src: The {p} have been plagued for years by these masterful creatures of disguise. Whenever one is recognized, we capture them and hold them for questioning.
Shrouded in Mist#299.dst: {p} 多年来一直饱受这些伪装大师之苦。每当认出一个，我们就会抓起来审问。
Shrouded in Mist#299.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#300.src: The people of our region have developed a form of identification, the medallions. If you do not possess one, many will refuse to speak with you.
Shrouded in Mist#300.dst: 我们这一带的人发展出了一种身份证明，就是徽章。如果你没有徽章，很多人都会拒绝跟你说话。
Shrouded in Mist#300.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#301.src: Um... Azael, sir, I don't mean to come off as rude, but... Rurie told us there were news on our friends from the Roughworks.
Shrouded in Mist#301.dst: 呃……Azael 先生，我不是想失礼，但是……Rurie 跟我们说有我们在 Roughworks 那些朋友的消息。
Shrouded in Mist#301.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#302.src: In a sense, there are. However, we still are processing the information the Owls have returned with from the festival. I cannot offer anything just yet.
Shrouded in Mist#302.dst: 某种意义上，是有的。不过，猫头鹰队从庆典带回来的情报我们还在整理。我暂时还没办法告诉你们什么。
Shrouded in Mist#302.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#303.src: Rest assured, we will not withhold anything once we have gone through everything.
Shrouded in Mist#303.dst: 请放心，等我们把一切都整理完，绝不会有任何隐瞒。
Shrouded in Mist#303.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#304.src: I give you my word that we will continue searching for any word of your friends.
Shrouded in Mist#304.dst: 我向你们保证，我们会继续打听你们朋友的任何消息。
Shrouded in Mist#304.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#305.src: It... it finally feels like we have a second to breath.
Shrouded in Mist#305.dst: 终……终于感觉可以喘口气了。
Shrouded in Mist#305.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#306.src: I'll stay with Yusanu and wait for them to sort through the information.
Shrouded in Mist#306.dst: 我会跟 Yusanu 待在一起，等他们整理情报。
Shrouded in Mist#306.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#307.src: I'm going to focus on figuring out what this device is used for.
Shrouded in Mist#307.dst: 我要专心弄清楚这个装置是做什么用的。
Shrouded in Mist#307.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#308.src: It must have be worth stealing it... somehow.
Shrouded in Mist#308.dst: 偷它一定……总有值得的地方吧。
Shrouded in Mist#308.speaker: Sui

Skittering Spiders#000.src: You should report back to Yahya and tell him the spiders have been cleared out.
Skittering Spiders#000.dst: 你应该回去告诉 Yahya，蜘蛛已经清理干净了。

Skittering Spiders#001.src: I-is it done? S-s-spiders... No more spiders? Is my m-mushroom patch cl-... cleared?
Skittering Spiders#001.dst: 解、解决了吗？蜘、蜘、蜘蛛……没有蜘蛛了？我的蘑、蘑菇地清……清理干净了？

Skittering Spiders#003.src: Well, it looks cleared to me. These are... uh... some fine mushrooms!
Skittering Spiders#003.dst: 嗯，在我看来已经清理干净了。这些是……呃……挺不错的蘑菇！

Skittering Spiders#004.src: Th-thank you soldiers! That was-... I mean. It was f-fine, I g-... guess.
Skittering Spiders#004.dst: 谢、谢谢你们，士兵们！那真是——……我是说。还、还行吧，我、我想。

Skittering Spiders#006.src: I am everywhere. M-mushroom soup, stew, soup m-makes me fast!
Skittering Spiders#006.dst: 我无处不在。蘑、蘑菇汤、炖菜，汤让我变、变快！

Solidarity of Steel#000.src: That's what we call the {p} sewers and waterworks. Maze of pipes and brickwork, some of it old old. Vagrants and criminals been settling there for years.
Solidarity of Steel#000.dst: 我们就是这么称呼 {p} 的下水道和水利设施的。管道和砖墙组成的迷宫，有些地方老得不能再老。流浪汉和罪犯在那里落脚好多年了。

Solidarity of Steel#002.src: You need to pack something that will help Aihan sleep, something to remind her of home, and something to entertain her at the station.
Solidarity of Steel#002.dst: 你需要给 Aihan 打包三样东西：一样帮她入睡的，一样让她想起家的，还有一样让她在车站解闷的。

Solidarity of Steel#003.src: Wh-what?! H-how did you fit my whole m-mattress in here? Was... was there not anything smaller?
Solidarity of Steel#003.dst: 什、什么？！你、你是怎么把我整张床、床垫塞进来的？就……就没有小一点的东西吗？

Solidarity of Steel#004.src: Regroup with your friends outside {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#004.dst: 到 {p} 外面 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与你的朋友们会合。

Solidarity of Steel#005.src: ...that's everyone, then. Good. Good, you're all safe. I wasn't certain, after...
Solidarity of Steel#005.dst: ……那就是所有人了。很好。很好，你们都平安。我原本不确定，经过……
Solidarity of Steel#005.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#006.src: Are you just going to ignore what happened back there?
Solidarity of Steel#006.dst: 你就打算这样无视刚才发生的事吗？
Solidarity of Steel#006.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#008.src: Zhiraok's blessing... it gives him the power to revive himself. It takes some time, though.
Solidarity of Steel#008.dst: Zhiraok 的祝福……让他有复活自己的能力。不过需要一些时间。
Solidarity of Steel#008.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#009.src: If we wanted any chance to get away, I had to- I had to kill him.
Solidarity of Steel#009.dst: 如果我们想有机会逃走，我就必须——我必须杀了他。
Solidarity of Steel#009.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#010.src: Well, in any case, we're all here! We'll be meeting with my contact soon, after which we'll certainly be safe, but...
Solidarity of Steel#010.dst: 好了，不管怎样，我们都到了！我们很快就会跟我的联络人会合，到时候就一定安全了，不过……
Solidarity of Steel#010.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#012.src: We have some time to spare. You've had a few days to acclimate to the Roughworks - any thoughts?
Solidarity of Steel#012.dst: 我们还有点时间。你们已经花了几天适应 Roughworks——有什么想法吗？
Solidarity of Steel#012.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#013.src: It is, isn't it? It's much busier, less open, and yet... it carries a certain nostalgia for me.
Solidarity of Steel#013.dst: 是啊，对吧？这里繁忙得多、没那么开阔，然而……对我来说却带着某种怀旧感。
Solidarity of Steel#013.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#014.src: Nostalgic? This place, really? What's so nostalgic about loud factories and urban sprawl?
Solidarity of Steel#014.dst: 怀旧？这地方，真的假的？吵死人的工厂和到处蔓延的城区有什么好怀念的？
Solidarity of Steel#014.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#016.src: Well, I'm with Rex on th- this- this one! I wouldn't want to s- st- stay here for long, it's s- so... smoggy.
Solidarity of Steel#016.dst: 嗯，这——这——这件事我站 Rex 那边！我可不想在这里待、待太久，好……好多烟雾。
Solidarity of Steel#016.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#017.src: Certainly, it is not as... clean, I suppose, as the {p}. The smell of the morning dew shall be sorely missed!
Solidarity of Steel#017.dst: 当然，这里不像 {p} 那么……干净，我想。清晨露水的气味会让人非常怀念的！
Solidarity of Steel#017.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#018.src: Alright, children, get it out of your system. Please refrain from speaking poorly of the Roughworks once we meet with my contact... I'd like to make a good first impression.
Solidarity of Steel#018.dst: 好了，孩子们，发泄完就算了。等见到我的联络人，请别再说 Roughworks 的坏话……我想留个好的第一印象。
Solidarity of Steel#018.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#019.src: Oh, you wouldn't think so if you actually had to live here.
Solidarity of Steel#019.dst: 噢，你要是真的得住在这里，就不会这么想了。
Solidarity of Steel#019.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#021.src: What?! Most of them would agree with me!
Solidarity of Steel#021.dst: 干嘛？！这里大部分人都会同意我的！
Solidarity of Steel#021.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#022.src: I think I'm with Rex on this- this one! I can't im-imagine- imagine living here, it's s- so... smoggy.
Solidarity of Steel#022.dst: 我觉得这——这件事我站 Rex 那边！我无法想、想象——想象住在这里，好……好多烟雾。
Solidarity of Steel#022.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#023.src: Certainly, it is not as... clean, I suppose, as the {p}. The smell of the morning dew shall be sorely missed!
Solidarity of Steel#023.dst: 当然，这里不像 {p} 那么……干净，我想。清晨露水的气味会让人非常怀念的！
Solidarity of Steel#023.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#024.src: Alright, children, get it out of your system. Please refrain from speaking poorly of the Roughworks once we meet with my contact... no matter how much they may or may not agree.
Solidarity of Steel#024.dst: 好了，孩子们，发泄完就算了。等见到我的联络人，请别再说 Roughworks 的坏话……不管他们同不同意。
Solidarity of Steel#024.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#025.src: In any case, I was told to meet them in the city at noon - {p} is usually empty during the daytime.
Solidarity of Steel#025.dst: 总之，对方要我中午在城里跟他们会合——白天的 {p} 通常没什么人。
Solidarity of Steel#025.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#026.src: What? It's empty during the day? Th- that doesn't make a lot of sense.
Solidarity of Steel#026.dst: 什么？白天没人？那——那不太合理啊。
Solidarity of Steel#026.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#027.src: I'm afraid the lives of the citizens of the Roughworks revolve entirely around their work. The work day starts at sunrise, and ends with sunset. So, let's just wait...
Solidarity of Steel#027.dst: 恐怕 Roughworks 居民的生活完全围绕着工作转。工作日从日出开始，到日落结束。所以，我们就等着吧……
Solidarity of Steel#027.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#029.src: Maybe they, um, just read time differently, here...? Or maybe we-
Solidarity of Steel#029.dst: 也许他们，呃，看时间的方式不一样……？或者也许我们——
Solidarity of Steel#029.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#031.src: Hello, Quill. It's been a while since we've met face to face, hasn't it?
Solidarity of Steel#031.dst: 你好，Quill。我们好久没当面见了，对吧？
Solidarity of Steel#031.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#032.src: Indeed, indeed... I hope your journey to cross to the Roughworks wasn't too difficult.
Solidarity of Steel#032.dst: 确实，确实……希望你们越境到 Roughworks 的路上没太辛苦。
Solidarity of Steel#032.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#033.src: Could have been better, could have been worse. We expected difficulties going in.
Solidarity of Steel#033.dst: 可能更好，也可能更糟。出发前我们就预料到会有困难。
Solidarity of Steel#033.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#034.src: I see... You'll have to tell me more later. Now, which of you is the cursed one? I'd like a look at you.
Solidarity of Steel#034.dst: 我明白了……你之后得多跟我说说。那么，你们谁是受诅者？我想看看你。
Solidarity of Steel#034.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#035.src: Mmhm! So you're the one, eh? What I'd heard in correspondence had me thinking you'd be different than us. Seems like I was right!
Solidarity of Steel#035.dst: 嗯哼！所以就是你，嗯？从书信里听到的让我觉得你会跟我们不一样。看来我猜对了！
Solidarity of Steel#035.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#036.src: There's a look in your eyes, something to your gait. In all my years I've seen quite a lot, and everything that shouts "promise" is there in you.
Solidarity of Steel#036.dst: 你的眼神、你的步态，都有点东西。这些年我见识过不少，而一切透着“前途无量”的特质，你身上都有。
Solidarity of Steel#036.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#037.src: Ha! Yes, yes, I suppose that would be the correct response to that question. You'd do well to stick to that script.
Solidarity of Steel#037.dst: 哈！是啊，是啊，我想这是那个问题的正确回答。你最好一直照这个剧本说。
Solidarity of Steel#037.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#038.src: But Syndra has already written much about you in our correspondence. No need to be shy.
Solidarity of Steel#038.dst: 不过 Syndra 在我们的书信里已经写了很多关于你的事。不用害羞。
Solidarity of Steel#038.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#039.src: Blessed, cursed... They're two sides of the same coin, in my eyes. I've seen my fair share of both in my time leading this group, heh heh...
Solidarity of Steel#039.dst: 受祝福、受诅咒……在我看来，不过是同一枚硬币的两面。领导这个组织这些年，两种人我都见过不少，嘿嘿……
Solidarity of Steel#039.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#040.src: I see no reason not to celebrate differences, and what better difference could there be?
Solidarity of Steel#040.dst: 我看不出有什么理由不去赞美差异，而还有什么差异比这更好呢？
Solidarity of Steel#040.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#041.src: ... Ah, we'll have more time to speak later. We'd best make our way down to the station, we can sort out arrangements there-
Solidarity of Steel#041.dst: ……啊，我们之后有的是时间聊。我们最好先下去车站，到那边再安排——
Solidarity of Steel#041.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#042.src: Hey, hey! We're leaving before we even get our introductions in? Why'd we even come here then, man?
Solidarity of Steel#042.dst: 嘿，嘿！连自我介绍都还没做就要走？那我们干嘛来这里，老兄？
Solidarity of Steel#042.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#043.src: Yes, Yuman, why did we come here? You're the one who dragged us all along.
Solidarity of Steel#043.dst: 是啊，Yuman，我们为什么要来？是你硬把我们拖来的。
Solidarity of Steel#043.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#044.src: Well, hey, I just thought this old man could use some help, that's all! Six people's a lot for one guy to greet, you know?
Solidarity of Steel#044.dst: 嗯，嘿，我只是觉得这个老头需要点帮忙，就这样！一个人要招呼六个人可不少，你懂吧？
Solidarity of Steel#044.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#045.src: Yes, yes... Well, alright, since you all are here, we may as well handle introductions now.
Solidarity of Steel#045.dst: 是，是……好吧，既然你们都来了，我们不如现在就做个介绍。
Solidarity of Steel#045.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#046.src: I'm Yuman! I'm the greatest musician of our age, man! And I'm super muscular and cool, and-
Solidarity of Steel#046.dst: 我是 Yuman！我是这个时代最伟大的音乐家，老兄！而且我超有肌肉、超酷，还——
Solidarity of Steel#046.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#047.src: Alright, Yuman, that's enough. I'm Yulie, oldest of three. I work as a detective in {p}.
Solidarity of Steel#047.dst: 好了，Yuman，够了。我是 Yulie，三兄弟里的老大。我在 {p} 当侦探。
Solidarity of Steel#047.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#048.src: Booooring! Come on, bro, have some-
Solidarity of Steel#048.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#049.src: And I'm Yusanu! I'm a mechanic. Quill's told us a lot about you, it's a pleasure to finally meet you.
Solidarity of Steel#049.dst: 我是 Yusanu！我是机械师。Quill 跟我们说了很多你们的事，终于见到你们真高兴。
Solidarity of Steel#049.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#050.src: Uh... S- same, I guess. This is all s- st- still a bit new.
Solidarity of Steel#050.dst: 呃……我——我也是，大概吧。这一切对我来说还——还有点新。
Solidarity of Steel#050.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#051.src: Eh, you'll get used to it. This place has a way of growing on you.
Solidarity of Steel#051.dst: 嗯，你会习惯的。这地方会慢慢让你喜欢上。
Solidarity of Steel#051.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#052.src: Ah, if I may - I don't suppose you'd have anything prepared for us to be able to blend in better? I'd imagine we stick out a fair bit right now.
Solidarity of Steel#052.dst: 啊，容我问一句——你们该不会准备了什么能让我们更好融入的东西吧？我想我们现在应该挺显眼的。
Solidarity of Steel#052.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#053.src: Hm... I hadn't quite considered that. Boys, why don't you handle that while Syndra and I go ahead to sort out living arrangements?
Solidarity of Steel#053.dst: 嗯……这我倒没考虑到。孩子们，你们去处理这件事，我跟 Syndra 先去安排住处，怎么样？
Solidarity of Steel#053.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#055.src: Leaves, why don't you join them? It'll be a good opportunity to get to know each other.
Solidarity of Steel#055.dst: 叶子们，你们要不要跟他们一起去？这是互相认识的好机会。
Solidarity of Steel#055.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#056.src: Um... I think I'd rather go with you. I'd like to rest a bit.
Solidarity of Steel#056.dst: 呃……我想我还是跟你一起去。我想休息一下。
Solidarity of Steel#056.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#057.src: ... Then I'll tag along as well. Perhaps I could be of use at the station!
Solidarity of Steel#057.dst: ……那我也跟着去吧。说不定我在车站能派上用场！
Solidarity of Steel#057.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#058.src: Very well. Follow me, we have an access point this way.
Solidarity of Steel#058.dst: 很好。跟我来，我们这边有个入口。
Solidarity of Steel#058.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#059.src: Well. I'm afraid I can't stay either... the station doesn't exactly run by itself. We'll have to catch up later!
Solidarity of Steel#059.dst: 嗯。恐怕我也不能留下……车站可不会自己运转。我们之后再聊！
Solidarity of Steel#059.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#060.src: Ugh, boring as usual... Oh well! Yulie and I can show you around just fine by ourselves.
Solidarity of Steel#060.dst: 唉，一如往常地无聊……算了！我跟 Yulie 自己带你们逛就行了。
Solidarity of Steel#060.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#061.src: We should start with getting you all some new clothes.
Solidarity of Steel#061.dst: 我们应该先给你们弄些新衣服。
Solidarity of Steel#061.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#062.src: Hey! Wh- what's wrong with our cur- current ones!
Solidarity of Steel#062.dst: 喂！我——我们现、现在穿的有什么问题！
Solidarity of Steel#062.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#063.src: They make you look like poor forest people, man!
Solidarity of Steel#063.dst: 穿得跟森林里的穷人一样啊，老兄！
Solidarity of Steel#063.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#064.src: Yuman! Don't be rude to our guests.
Solidarity of Steel#064.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#065.src: What, I'm just saying! Am I wrong?
Solidarity of Steel#065.dst: 干嘛，我只是实话实说！我说错了吗？
Solidarity of Steel#065.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#066.src: Well! At l- lea- at least we don't smell bad!
Solidarity of Steel#066.dst: 哼！至——至——至少我们身上不臭！
Solidarity of Steel#066.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#067.src: Alright, boys, settle down, play nice. You're both pretty. So, Yulie, what's the plan?
Solidarity of Steel#067.dst: 好了，男孩们，冷静点，好好相处。你们都很漂亮。那么，Yulie，计划是什么？
Solidarity of Steel#067.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#068.src: I'll have to swing by some shops... Yuman, in the meantime, why don't you see if you can find any clothes around here?
Solidarity of Steel#068.dst: 我得去几家店一趟……Yuman，这段时间你去看看这附近能不能找到衣服？
Solidarity of Steel#068.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#069.src: Great, I'll join you. I need to get re-acquainted with things around here.
Solidarity of Steel#069.dst: 好，我跟你一起去。我得重新熟悉一下这里。
Solidarity of Steel#069.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#070.src: Sure, that works. Any complaints, Yuman?
Solidarity of Steel#070.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#071.src: If I had 'em, you'd hear it loud and clear. The plan's good, bro.
Solidarity of Steel#071.dst: 我要是有意见，你早就听得一清二楚了。计划不错，哥。
Solidarity of Steel#071.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#072.src: Okay, we'll meet back at the Steel Feather once we're done. See you then!
Solidarity of Steel#072.dst: 好，等事情办完我们在钢羽会合。到时见！
Solidarity of Steel#072.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#073.src: ...Well! I've got a plan of my own in mind. Not exactly what Yulie had in mind, but... heh, what he doesn't know won't hurt him. Follow me, leaf people!
Solidarity of Steel#073.dst: ……好啦！我自己心里也有个计划。跟 Yulie 想的不太一样，不过……嘿，他不知道就伤不到他。跟我来，叶子人们！
Solidarity of Steel#073.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#074.src: Find clothes in the city by following Yuman at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#074.dst: 跟着 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Yuman，在城里找衣服。

Solidarity of Steel#075.src: Hey! Hold- h- hold up! What's your p- p- plan?
Solidarity of Steel#075.dst: 喂！等——等一下！你的计——计——计划是什么？
Solidarity of Steel#075.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#076.src: Oh! Right. We're going to steal from the clotheslines, of course.
Solidarity of Steel#076.dst: 噢！对。当然是去晾衣绳上偷啊。
Solidarity of Steel#076.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#077.src: ... I'm no stranger to st- stealing, but... isn't it a bit r- r-... a bit risky to do that in the m- middle of the city?
Solidarity of Steel#077.dst: ……偷东西我不陌——陌生，但是……在城里正中央这么干，不会有点冒——冒——……有点冒险吗？
Solidarity of Steel#077.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#078.src: Man, haven't you noticed how empty {p} is?
Solidarity of Steel#078.dst: 老兄，你没发现 {p} 有多空吗？
Solidarity of Steel#078.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#079.src: Figures you wouldn't know, since you're not from around here! It's pretty simple.
Solidarity of Steel#079.dst: 你不知道也难怪，你又不是这里人！很简单。
Solidarity of Steel#079.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#080.src: It's the middle of the workday! People are out at their jobs, they don't have time to stroll around the city! Got to make a living somehow, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#080.dst: 现在是工作日正中间！大家都在上班，没空在城里闲逛！总得想办法谋生嘛，对吧？
Solidarity of Steel#080.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#081.src: A- and since they're out at their jobs, they're n- n- not home... you want us to just walk th- through someone's apartment, then?
Solidarity of Steel#081.dst: 所——所以既然他们都在上班，就不——不——不在家……你是要我们就这样穿过别人的公寓？
Solidarity of Steel#081.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#082.src: Yep, yep, exaaaactly! You get it. I think you and I are gonna get along great.
Solidarity of Steel#082.dst: 对，对，完——全正确！你懂了。我觉得我们俩会处得很好。
Solidarity of Steel#082.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#083.src: Yeah... sure. L- let- let's get going! I think we can rea- reach the rooftops from this house. We'll find some clothes up there.
Solidarity of Steel#083.dst: 是啊……当然。我——我——我们走吧！我想从这栋房子可以上、上到 。我们去那上面找衣服。
Solidarity of Steel#083.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#084.src: Ha! Really? You should... you should pay more attention, man. The moment you stop keeping an eye on things is the moment things go wrong, y'know? Jeez.
Solidarity of Steel#084.dst: 哈！真的假的？你该……你该多注意点，老兄。一旦你不盯着事情，事情就会出错，懂吧？天哪。
Solidarity of Steel#084.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#085.src: What I was gonna say is that it's the middle of the workday. People are out at their jobs! No time to stroll around the city, or anything.
Solidarity of Steel#085.dst: 我刚才要说的是，现在是工作日正中间。大家都在上班！没空在城里闲逛什么的。
Solidarity of Steel#085.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#086.src: A- and since they're out at their jobs, they're n- not home... you want us to just walk th- through someone's apartment, then?
Solidarity of Steel#086.dst: 所——所以既然他们都在上班，就不——不在家……你是要我们就这样穿过别人的公寓？
Solidarity of Steel#086.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#087.src: Mhm, yep, you get it. They won't mind! Cause they won' know we were there, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#087.dst: 嗯，对，你懂了。他们不会介意的！因为他们根本不会知道我们来过，对吧？
Solidarity of Steel#087.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#088.src: I- I- I guess. Okay, let's get going! I think we can rea- reach the rooftops from this house. We'll find some clothes up there.
Solidarity of Steel#088.dst: 我——我——我想是吧。好，我们走吧！我想从这栋房子可以上、上到 。我们去那上面找衣服。
Solidarity of Steel#088.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#089.src: Climb up the apartment at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and jump across the roofs.

Solidarity of Steel#090.src: Try n-not to fall off the roof...
Solidarity of Steel#090.dst: 尽——尽量别从屋顶上掉下去……
Solidarity of Steel#090.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#091.src: Jump across the roofs to the first spot at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Solidarity of Steel#091.dst: 跳过屋顶，前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的第一个地点

Solidarity of Steel#092.src: I'll be right be- behind you! Let's get up to the rooftops. I think we can rea- reach them through this building.
Solidarity of Steel#092.dst: 我会紧跟在你后——后面！我们上屋顶吧。我想从这栋楼可以上、上去。
Solidarity of Steel#092.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#093.src: ...what the hell are you doin' jumpin' around?
Solidarity of Steel#093.dst: ……你们在那边跳来跳去干什么鬼？
Solidarity of Steel#093.speaker: Timaca Mason

Solidarity of Steel#094.src: Buzz off, some've us got jobs.
Solidarity of Steel#094.dst: 滚开，我们有些人还得干活。
Solidarity of Steel#094.speaker: Timaca Mason

Solidarity of Steel#095.src: Here we are! Best clothes in the entire province, man! Take your pick!
Solidarity of Steel#095.dst: 到了！全行省最好的衣服，老兄！随便挑！
Solidarity of Steel#095.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#096.src: ... Wait a mi- min- minute. There are only dr- dresses here?
Solidarity of Steel#096.dst: ……等一——一——一下。这里只有裙——裙子？
Solidarity of Steel#096.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#097.src: Oh, yeah. My bad, man! Bet you could pull it off though, eh?
Solidarity of Steel#097.dst: 噢，对啊。我的错，老兄！不过我打赌你穿起来也挺好看的，嗯？
Solidarity of Steel#097.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#098.src: I- y- you- wh- wh- what- h- huh? Ev- even- even if I could, Rex and Mora would- w- would never wear- wear these. A- and- and they're n- n- not-
Solidarity of Steel#098.dst: 我——你——你——什——什——什么——嗯？就——就算——就算我能穿，Rex 和 Mora 也——也绝对不会穿——穿这些。而——而——而且他们不——不——不是——
Solidarity of Steel#098.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#099.src: Relax, I'm just messing with you, man! We'll find some more. But, hey, grab one if you want, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#099.dst: 放轻松，我逗你玩的，老兄！我们再去找找。不过，嘿，想要的话就拿一件，嗯？
Solidarity of Steel#099.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#101.src: I'll take one for Sui, just in c- cas- just in case. And let's hurry after him. I'm getting sick a- and-... s- sick and tired of this place already.
Solidarity of Steel#101.dst: 我帮 Sui 拿一件，以——以防——以防万一。然后我们赶快追上他。我已经开始受够——受——……受够这地方了。
Solidarity of Steel#101.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#102.src: Continue looking for clothes on the rooftops at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#103.src: It's g-going to be a long c- couple of days, huh?
Solidarity of Steel#103.dst: 接下来这几天会很、很漫长，对吧？
Solidarity of Steel#103.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#104.src: Careful there, princess! Wouldn't want to fall, eh?
Solidarity of Steel#104.dst: 小心点，公主！可别摔下去啊，嗯？
Solidarity of Steel#104.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#106.src: Anyway, these clothes should work, yeah? Looks like enough for all of you!
Solidarity of Steel#106.dst: 总之，这些衣服应该可以吧？看起来够你们所有人穿了！
Solidarity of Steel#106.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#107.src: ...yes, this sh- sh- should be fine. Thank you f- for showing us. Let's just grab them a- and go.
Solidarity of Steel#107.dst: ……嗯，这——这——这些应该可以。谢谢你带、带我们来。我们拿了就走吧。
Solidarity of Steel#107.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#108.src: Sounds good! You saw the big statue in the river when you were entering the city, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#108.dst: 听起来不错！你们进城的时候有看到河里那座大雕像吧？
Solidarity of Steel#108.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#109.src: The one to the s- south- {u}, yes.
Solidarity of Steel#109.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#110.src: That's the one! I'll wait for you there, then we can head to the station. And hurry up, would ya?
Solidarity of Steel#110.dst: 就是那座！我在那里等你们，然后我们去车站。动作快点，好吗？
Solidarity of Steel#110.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#111.src: Find the statue in the water at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#112.src: Ugh... How can one guy be s- s- so annoying?
Solidarity of Steel#112.dst: 唉……一个人怎么能烦、烦、烦成这样？
Solidarity of Steel#112.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#113.src: Whatever... Let's just go to that s- st- statue. It's in the river t- to the southwest.
Solidarity of Steel#113.dst: 随便啦……我们去那座雕、雕像吧。在西南边的河、河里。
Solidarity of Steel#113.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#114.src: Ey, there you are! What's with the holdup?
Solidarity of Steel#114.dst: 嘿，你们来了！怎么拖这么久？
Solidarity of Steel#114.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#115.src: I was just telling Zeph all about our base of operations! Here, I can start over if you-
Solidarity of Steel#115.dst: 我刚才正在跟 Zeph 讲我们的行动基地！来，我可以从头再讲一遍，如果你——
Solidarity of Steel#115.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#116.src: Let's just h- head in! Even if the city's empty, the longer we stay out here, the more we ri- risk getting seen.
Solidarity of Steel#116.dst: 我们直接进、进去吧！就算城里没人，我们在外面待得越久，越冒、冒着被看到的风险。
Solidarity of Steel#116.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#117.src: Yeah, yeah, you're right. Okay, follow me! It's just down here.
Solidarity of Steel#117.dst: 对，对，你说得对。好，跟我来！就在下面。
Solidarity of Steel#117.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#119.src: Sorry if our secret base isn't up to your high standards, princess! We've got to stay hidden somehow, eh?
Solidarity of Steel#119.dst: 抱歉我们的秘密基地不合你的高标准啊，公主！我们总得想办法藏起来嘛，嗯？
Solidarity of Steel#119.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#121.src: Follow Yuman and Zeph into the sewer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#121.dst: 跟着 Yuman 和 Zeph 进入 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的下水道。

Solidarity of Steel#123.src: Catch up with Zeph and Rex.

Solidarity of Steel#125.src: Welcome to the station, man! There's a bunch of abandoned train lines down here. Dunno how we first found it, but it's where the Steel Feather operates.
Solidarity of Steel#125.dst: 欢迎来到车站，老兄！这下面有一堆废弃的铁路线。不知道我们当初是怎么发现的，不过钢羽就在这里运作。
Solidarity of Steel#125.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#127.src: Good to see you've made it down here too. Yuman, you weren't rude to our guests, were you?
Solidarity of Steel#127.dst: 很高兴你们也到下面来了。Yuman，你没对客人没礼貌吧？
Solidarity of Steel#127.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#128.src: What? Screw you, man, of course I was nice! When have I ever not been nice and kind and awesome?
Solidarity of Steel#128.dst: 什么？去你的，老兄，我当然很友善！我什么时候不友善、不亲切、不帅气了？
Solidarity of Steel#128.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#129.src: Well, either way, I'm sure you've tired them out by now. Let's go on ahead and give them time to catch up, alright?
Solidarity of Steel#129.dst: 好吧，不管怎样，我相信你已经把他们累坏了。我们先走，给他们时间叙叙旧，好吗？
Solidarity of Steel#129.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#131.src: So... how've you been finding Yuman so far?
Solidarity of Steel#131.dst: 那么……到目前为止你觉得 Yuman 怎么样？
Solidarity of Steel#131.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#132.src: Ugh. He's f- fi- fine. We got the clothes, at least.
Solidarity of Steel#132.dst: 唉。他还、还行。至少我们拿到衣服了。
Solidarity of Steel#132.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#133.src: Hm. You don't sound fine. Spill.
Solidarity of Steel#133.dst: 嗯。听起来可不像还行。说吧。
Solidarity of Steel#133.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#134.src: Oh, that's it? He's just like that.
Solidarity of Steel#134.dst: 噢，就这样？他就是那种人。
Solidarity of Steel#134.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#135.src: He's just... very p- per- persistent.
Solidarity of Steel#135.dst: 他就是……非常纠、纠、纠缠不休。
Solidarity of Steel#135.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#136.src: Well, that says more about you than it does about him. Have you tried making it less easy for him?
Solidarity of Steel#136.dst: 嗯，那更能说明你的问题，而不是他的。你有试过别让他那么容易得逞吗？
Solidarity of Steel#136.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#137.src: Ha ha. Very hel- hel- helpful, Rex.
Solidarity of Steel#137.dst: 哈哈。真是帮——帮——帮了大忙啊，Rex。
Solidarity of Steel#137.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#138.src: Makes sense, I guess. It's been a few days since we've been able to relax, hasn't it?
Solidarity of Steel#138.dst: 说得通，我想。我们已经好几天没办法放松了，对吧？
Solidarity of Steel#138.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#139.src: Yeah... it'll be n- n- nice to slow down, for a while.
Solidarity of Steel#139.dst: 是啊……能慢、慢、慢下来一阵子会很好。
Solidarity of Steel#139.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#140.src: Not sure how long we'll be slowed down... but sure. I think Syndra's got some plans in the works, but she hasn't shared them yet.
Solidarity of Steel#140.dst: 不确定我们能慢下来多久……不过好吧。我觉得 Syndra 已经有些计划在酝酿了，但她还没说出来。
Solidarity of Steel#140.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#141.src: She's been getting... more ambitious lately. {u}, I think having you around has had something to do with that.
Solidarity of Steel#141.dst: 她最近变得……更有野心了。{u}，我觉得这跟你在身边有点关系。
Solidarity of Steel#141.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#142.src: We- we- well, how about you? Is the Roughworks just how you r- remember it?
Solidarity of Steel#142.dst: 那——那——那你呢？Roughworks 还是你记、记忆中的样子吗？
Solidarity of Steel#142.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#143.src: Yeah... pretty much. Things don't tend to change a lot around here, so... it's just like slotting back into place.
Solidarity of Steel#143.dst: 是啊……差不多。这里的事情不太会变，所以……就像重新回到原位一样。
Solidarity of Steel#143.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#145.src: Ha. No, it really isn't. The few months I spent here before Quill sent me off to Syndra were... rough.
Solidarity of Steel#145.dst: 哈。不，一点都不好。Quill 把我送去 Syndra 那里之前，我在这里待的那几个月……很难熬。
Solidarity of Steel#145.speaker: Rex
