Solidarity of Steel#146.src: Oh... h- how come? You've never really talked about the R- R- Rough-... about the R- Roughworks.
Solidarity of Steel#146.dst: 噢……为、为什么？你从来没真正提过 R-R-Rough——……提过 R-Roughworks。
Solidarity of Steel#146.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#147.src: Uh... Hey, so about those clothes- let's take a look at what you got!
Solidarity of Steel#147.dst: 呃……嘿，说到那些衣服——来看看你们拿了什么！
Solidarity of Steel#147.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#148.src: R- right... right! Well, here are th- the- the, uh, workers' clothes we got f- for me, Mora, and {u}... And this is a dr- dress for Sui...
Solidarity of Steel#148.dst: 对……对！嗯，这是给我、Mora 和 {u} 的，呃，工——工——工人服……还有这件是给 Sui 的裙、裙子……
Solidarity of Steel#148.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#149.src: And, of- of- of course, a simple dress for you!
Solidarity of Steel#149.dst: 还——还——还有，当然，给你的一件简单的裙子！
Solidarity of Steel#149.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#150.src: Oh... that's funny, I don't think I've ever worn one of those! Hey, maybe I'll just take your set and you can wear the dress?
Solidarity of Steel#150.dst: 噢……真好笑，我好像从来没穿过那种东西！嘿，不如我拿你那套，你来穿裙子？
Solidarity of Steel#150.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#151.src: Woah, ha, we- well, let's not g- g- get too hasty, haha- oh, l- look here, an extra set of re- reg- regular workers' clothes! What a c- co- coincidence!
Solidarity of Steel#151.dst: 哇，哈，那——那个，我们别太、太、太心急，哈哈——噢，看、看这里，多出一套普——普——普通工人服！真是太、太巧了！
Solidarity of Steel#151.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#152.src: ...don't, uh, m- m- make me wear the dress, please?
Solidarity of Steel#152.dst: ……拜托，呃，别、别、别让我穿裙子，好吗？
Solidarity of Steel#152.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#153.src: Yeah, yeah. Well, that's enough fooling around - we should find Mora and Sui, see what they've figured out. I'll race you there!
Solidarity of Steel#153.dst: 好啦，好啦。好了，闹够了——我们该去找 Mora 和 Sui，看看他们弄清楚了什么。比赛谁先到！
Solidarity of Steel#153.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#154.src: Hey! Oh, you're going d- down!
Solidarity of Steel#154.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#155.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 找到 Sui 和 Mora。

Solidarity of Steel#158.src: Indeed! Tell us, friends, how go the escapades? Has anything of interest transpired up in the city?
Solidarity of Steel#158.dst: 正是！告诉我们，朋友们，冒险进行得如何？城里有发生什么有趣的事吗？
Solidarity of Steel#158.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#159.src: No, Mora, nothing very exciting. Yulie and I did a quick supply run in {p} while we were there.
Solidarity of Steel#159.dst: 没有，Mora，没什么刺激的。我跟 Yulie 在 {p} 顺便补了点货。
Solidarity of Steel#159.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#160.src: And {u} and I found some cl- cl- clothes! They might not fit perfectly, but...
Solidarity of Steel#160.dst: 我和 {u} 找到了一些衣、衣、衣服！可能不太合身，不过……
Solidarity of Steel#160.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#161.src: Ah, well, we'll take what we can get. Besides, I have to imagine they have someone around here who knows their way around modifying clothes!
Solidarity of Steel#161.dst: 啊，嗯，有什么就用什么吧。再说，我想这里应该有人懂得怎么改衣服！
Solidarity of Steel#161.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#162.src: Speaking of, have you had time to explore this place yet? It's far larger than I could have anticipated! So many people with so many skillsets; Syndra wasn't lying when she said they had resources here, hoho!
Solidarity of Steel#162.dst: 说到这个，你们有时间逛逛这个地方了吗？比我预想的大太多了！这么多人、这么多技能；Syndra 说他们这里有资源可没骗人，嚯嚯！
Solidarity of Steel#162.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#163.src: Yes... everyone chips in, too. I got put to work quite fast. Had an opportunity to chat with some of the people here.
Solidarity of Steel#163.dst: 是啊……而且每个人都会出一份力。我很快就被分配工作了。也有机会跟这里的一些人聊聊。
Solidarity of Steel#163.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#164.src: They, um... a lot of them don't have anywhere else to go... so they work hard to keep this place running.
Solidarity of Steel#164.dst: 他们，呃……很多人都没有别的地方可去……所以他们很努力让这里运转下去。
Solidarity of Steel#164.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#166.src: Hey, do you know where Yusanu is? I haven't had the chance to catch up with him yet.
Solidarity of Steel#166.dst: 嘿，你们知道 Yusanu 在哪吗？我还没机会跟他叙叙旧。
Solidarity of Steel#166.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#167.src: Oh, he seemed to have disappeared into his study some time ago, though not before I could have a chat with him! Did you know he singlehandedly repaired much of the abandoned infrastructure here?
Solidarity of Steel#167.dst: 噢，他好一阵子前好像就钻进他的工作室不见了，不过在那之前我跟他聊了几句！你们知道这里大部分废弃的设施都是他一个人修好的吗？
Solidarity of Steel#167.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#168.dst: 真的吗？那……真了、了、了不起。
Solidarity of Steel#168.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#169.src: Apparently, um, the crown was working on building this, central station, but they... abandoned the project, for, some reason. Nobody... really knows why.
Solidarity of Steel#169.dst: 听说，呃，王室本来在建这个，中央车站，但他们……因为，某种原因，放弃了这个项目。没人……真的知道为什么。
Solidarity of Steel#169.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#170.src: Hm... so what are Syndra and Quill ta- talk- talking about over there?
Solidarity of Steel#170.dst: 嗯……那 Syndra 和 Quill 在那边聊、聊、聊什么？
Solidarity of Steel#170.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#171.src: An excellent question! Nobody knows! Attempting to interject has only resulted in failure thus far.
Solidarity of Steel#171.dst: 好问题！没人知道！到目前为止，想插话的尝试都失败了。
Solidarity of Steel#171.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#172.src: I mean... should we even interrupt? I haven't seen her this... happy... in a long time.
Solidarity of Steel#172.dst: 我是说……我们该去打断吗？我好久没看到她这么……开心了。
Solidarity of Steel#172.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#173.src: It is a sweet moment, isn't it?
Solidarity of Steel#173.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#175.src: Well, I nominate {u} to go interrupt them. It needs to be done eventually.
Solidarity of Steel#175.dst: 好，我提名 {u} 去打断他们。这件事早晚得有人做。
Solidarity of Steel#175.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#176.src: Oh, yes, I second that notion. If it must be anyone, {u} is the one to sacrifice for the cause.
Solidarity of Steel#176.dst: 噢，是的，我附议。如果非得有人去，那 {u} 就是为大业牺牲的人选。
Solidarity of Steel#176.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#177.src: Oh! Uh... sure, I'll... th- third it? That sounds right.
Solidarity of Steel#177.dst: 噢！呃……好啊，我……第三个附议？这样说对吧。
Solidarity of Steel#177.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#179.src: Well! Three for, one against. It seems the decision has been made!
Solidarity of Steel#179.dst: 好！三票赞成，一票反对。看来决定已经做出来了！
Solidarity of Steel#179.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#180.src: Yeah, yeah! Come on, what are you waiting for? Go {u}, and find out what they're talking about.
Solidarity of Steel#180.dst: 对对！快点，你还在等什么？去吧 {u}，查出他们在说什么。
Solidarity of Steel#180.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#181.src: Good luck, my friend! You'll certainly need it.
Solidarity of Steel#181.dst: 祝你好运，我的朋友！你肯定会需要的。
Solidarity of Steel#181.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#182.src: Your sacrifice will not be in vain.
Solidarity of Steel#182.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#183.src: I had no p- pa- part in this!
Solidarity of Steel#183.dst: 这件事我可没参、参、参与！
Solidarity of Steel#183.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#184.src: Don't try to get out of this, Zeph. You're just as complicit in this as the rest of us.
Solidarity of Steel#184.dst: 别想撇清，Zeph。你跟我们其他人一样都是共犯。
Solidarity of Steel#184.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#185.src: Wh- I- fine... {u}, just get it o- over with. Go {u}, and find out what th- they- wh- what they're talking about.
Solidarity of Steel#185.dst: 什——我——好吧……{u}，快、快点搞定。去吧 {u}，查出他、他们——他们在说什么。
Solidarity of Steel#185.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#186.src: I will remember you fondly, my friend.
Solidarity of Steel#186.dst: 我会怀着深情怀念你的，我的朋友。
Solidarity of Steel#186.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#190.src: H-hey! Don't you have a m-mission to do?
Solidarity of Steel#190.dst: 喂、喂！你不是还有任、任务要做吗？
Solidarity of Steel#190.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#191.src: Ah, {u}! I see you have all returned. Welcome to our home.
Solidarity of Steel#191.dst: 啊，{u}！看来你们都回来了。欢迎来到我们的家。
Solidarity of Steel#191.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#192.src: I hope the brothers weren't too much of a nuisance. Yuman, especially... he's a good lad, but he tends towards
Solidarity of Steel#192.dst: 希望那几兄弟没给你们添太多麻烦。尤其是 Yuman……他是个好孩子，但他总是有点
Solidarity of Steel#192.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#193.src: Speaking of nuisances... I can't help but notice the rest of our group looking onwards at our conversation with excitement.
Solidarity of Steel#193.dst: 说到麻烦……我不禁注意到我们其他人正兴致勃勃地往这边看。
Solidarity of Steel#193.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#194.src: Ah! Understood. A noble one, at that.
Solidarity of Steel#194.dst: 啊！明白了。还是个高尚的任务呢。
Solidarity of Steel#194.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#195.src: In any case, Quill and I have been trying to plan out our next moves... but, if I'm being honest, most of that time has been spent catching up.
Solidarity of Steel#195.dst: 不管怎样，Quill 和我一直在试着规划下一步……不过，老实说，大部分时间都花在叙旧上了。
Solidarity of Steel#195.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#196.src: Don't be fooled. All of these people here are resisting to some extent, but very few are ready to go up against a God.
Solidarity of Steel#196.dst: 别被骗了。这里所有人都在某种程度上反抗，但很少有人准备好去对抗一位神。
Solidarity of Steel#196.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#197.src: Hah! Goodness, how long has it been since we met face to face? It must have been... {~} years? Not since before you-
Solidarity of Steel#197.dst: 哈！天哪，我们多久没当面见了？一定有……{~} 年了吧？自从你——
Solidarity of Steel#197.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#199.src: ...Ahem. Yes, of course. As Syndra said, we haven't truly started planning yet... You must be surprised by our numbers, yes? More members in the Steel Feather than you'd have expected.
Solidarity of Steel#199.dst: ……咳咳。是的，当然。就像 Syndra 说的，我们还没真正开始规划……你一定对我们的人数很惊讶吧？钢羽的成员比你预想的多。
Solidarity of Steel#199.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#200.src: In truth, looks may be deceiving. Everyone here is resisting in whatever ways they can manage, but few are willing to put as much of themselves into it as your group.
Solidarity of Steel#200.dst: 说真的，外表可能会骗人。这里每个人都在尽自己所能反抗，但很少有人像你们这群人一样愿意投入这么多。
Solidarity of Steel#200.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#201.src: Most of them are simply trying to live without the watchful eye of the monarchy. Our safe haven takes in people who are at risk. People who can't work, who have been thrown out of their homes...
Solidarity of Steel#201.dst: 他们大多只是想在君主统治的监视之外生活。我们的避风港收留那些处境危险的人。无法工作的人、被赶出家门的人……
Solidarity of Steel#201.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#202.src: But we are not helpless. The brothers and I are all ready to help, however we can. And the rest of the Steel Feather will still offer support from the sidelines. We have infrastructure, and we have resources.
Solidarity of Steel#202.dst: 但我们并非无能为力。我和那几兄弟都随时准备好尽力帮忙。钢羽其他人也会在后方提供支援。我们有设施，也有资源。
Solidarity of Steel#202.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#203.src: I've also suggested that you might offer to teach the basics of magic to those who are interested-
Solidarity of Steel#203.dst: 我也提议过，你可以教有兴趣的人一些魔法基础——
Solidarity of Steel#203.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#204.src: Yes, yes, but I do not believe we need curses or blessings to resist. As I've told you several times before in our correspondences, Syndra!
Solidarity of Steel#204.dst: 是，是，但我不认为我们需要诅咒或祝福来反抗。这我在书信里跟你说过好几次了，Syndra！
Solidarity of Steel#204.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#205.src: And as I've told you in response, I see no reason not to make use of all the tools available!
Solidarity of Steel#205.dst: 而我也回过你，我看不出有什么理由不善用所有能用的工具！
Solidarity of Steel#205.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#206.src: Syndra, I have been firm on this point for a reason. We have done well for ourselves thus far.
Solidarity of Steel#206.dst: Syndra，我在这点上这么坚持是有原因的。到目前为止我们一直做得不错。
Solidarity of Steel#206.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#207.src: As an example- Yusanu has grown quite proficient with machinery. He has constructed weaponry, tools- even my leg is his creation!
Solidarity of Steel#207.dst: 举个例子——Yusanu 对机械已经相当精通了。他造过武器、工具——连我的腿都是他做的！
Solidarity of Steel#207.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#208.src: ... I simply think that-... Sigh. Fine. Quill, we should get to discussing the reason we came here.
Solidarity of Steel#208.dst: ……我只是觉得——……唉。算了。Quill，我们该来谈谈我们来这里的原因了。
Solidarity of Steel#208.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#209.src: Yes, I rather think we should. {u}, in the meantime, why don't you take a look around the station? Familiarize yourself with the area and the people.
Solidarity of Steel#209.dst: 是的，我也觉得该谈了。{u}，这段时间你何不在车站四处看看？熟悉一下这个地方和这里的人。
Solidarity of Steel#209.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#210.src: Explore the Steel Feather train station at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#211.src: Take a look around the station! Familiarize yourself with the area and the people.
Solidarity of Steel#211.dst: 在车站四处看看吧！熟悉一下这个地方和这里的人。
Solidarity of Steel#211.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#212.src: Hoho! So they return! Tell us, how did it go?
Solidarity of Steel#212.dst: 嚯嚯！他们回来了！告诉我们，怎么样了？
Solidarity of Steel#212.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#214.src: Ah, we all knew the stakes going in! Worry not, friend, your sacrifice will not be forgotten any time soon!
Solidarity of Steel#214.dst: 啊，我们一开始就知道风险有多大！别担心，朋友，你的牺牲不会很快就被遗忘的！
Solidarity of Steel#214.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#215.src: Hey! E- e- enough with the theatrics!
Solidarity of Steel#215.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#216.src: Excellent! You have successfully defied the odds, friend!
Solidarity of Steel#216.dst: 太好了！你成功战胜了命运，朋友！
Solidarity of Steel#216.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#217.src: Zeph didn't believe you'd make it, you know.
Solidarity of Steel#217.dst: 你知道吗，Zeph 本来不相信你能活着回来。
Solidarity of Steel#217.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#218.src: Wh- what, n- no I- I didn't- Sui!! D- don't- don't believe a word- a word she says, o- okay?
Solidarity of Steel#218.dst: 什——什么，没——没有，我——我才没——Sui！！别——别——别信她说的一个字——一个字，好——好吗？
Solidarity of Steel#218.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#219.src: Wh- what were they talking about, anyway?
Solidarity of Steel#219.dst: 那——那他们到底在聊什么？
Solidarity of Steel#219.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#220.src: Oh, so it was as boring as I predicted.
Solidarity of Steel#220.dst: 噢，所以就跟我猜的一样无聊。
Solidarity of Steel#220.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#221.src: Don't call that boring, Rex! It's... nice for her to relax for a little, isn't it?
Solidarity of Steel#221.dst: 别说那很无聊，Rex！她能稍微放松一下……很好啊，不是吗？
Solidarity of Steel#221.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#222.src: It can be both boring and a nice thing, can it not? The nice things often tend towards the boring end of the spectrum, in any case.
Solidarity of Steel#222.dst: 既无聊又是好事，也不矛盾吧？无论如何，美好的事往往偏向无聊那一端。
Solidarity of Steel#222.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#223.src: So, still n- nothing about the plans... when is she go- go- going to tell us anything?
Solidarity of Steel#223.dst: 所以，还是没提到计、计划……她到底什——什——什么时候才要告诉我们？
Solidarity of Steel#223.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#224.src: Have patience, young Leaf. She will tell us when it is time! Now, Sui and I have had the opportunity to explore, but you three have not! So, go on! Look around, talk to people.
Solidarity of Steel#224.dst: 耐心点，年轻的叶子。时候到了她自然会告诉我们！现在，Sui 和我已经有机会探索过了，但你们三个还没有！所以，去吧！四处看看，跟大家聊聊。
Solidarity of Steel#224.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#226.src: Ah. You're all back already? Man, I totally lost track of time there... there's so much to do.
Solidarity of Steel#226.dst: 啊。你们已经回来了？天哪，我完全忘了时间……要做的事实在太多了。
Solidarity of Steel#226.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#227.src: So, what's up? Sorry I couldn't talk to you more earlier- I'm the one who makes sure everything runs smoothly here.
Solidarity of Steel#227.dst: 那么，怎么了？抱歉刚才没能多聊——这里的一切能顺利运转都靠我在打理。
Solidarity of Steel#227.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#228.src: Most of the infrastructure was here already, but I basically fixed it all up myself... with some help, of course. But now I'm in charge of maintaining all of it!
Solidarity of Steel#228.dst: 大部分设施本来就在这里，但基本上都是我自己修好的……当然也有人帮忙。不过现在全部都归我维护！
Solidarity of Steel#228.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#229.src: It's not usually this... hectic. We had some stuff break down recently, and I'm the oooonly one who can deal with it!
Solidarity of Steel#229.dst: 平常没这么……手忙脚乱的。最近有些东西坏了，而能处理的只——有我一个！
Solidarity of Steel#229.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#231.src: ... Still don't have time to chat, sorry! I'm nearly done, though, I'll be out in a bit.
Solidarity of Steel#231.dst: ……还是没时间聊，抱歉！不过我快弄完了，等一下就出来。
Solidarity of Steel#231.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#234.src: Hah! Yeah, yeah, maybe. I was hoping to tease him some more.
Solidarity of Steel#234.dst: 哈！是啊，是啊，也许吧。我本来还想再多逗逗他。
Solidarity of Steel#234.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#235.src: He's a fun guy! But the boy's gotta learn how to tease back... it's no fun if it's one-side, y'know?
Solidarity of Steel#235.dst: 他很好玩！不过这小子得学会回嘴……只有单方面逗人就不好玩了，懂吧？
Solidarity of Steel#235.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#236.src: ...what? Ey, don't look at me like that! It's all for fun at the end of the day. If he tells me to quit it, I'll quit it.
Solidarity of Steel#236.dst: ……干嘛？嘿，别那样看我！说到底都只是好玩而已。要是他叫我停，我就停。
Solidarity of Steel#236.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#238.src: I'll... go over there later. Eventually! ... Maybe.
Solidarity of Steel#238.dst: 我……晚点再过去。总会去的！……也许吧。
Solidarity of Steel#238.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#239.src: Eheh. Wouldn't want to overstay my welcome, y'know? I've got things to do, anyway...
Solidarity of Steel#239.dst: 嘿嘿。可不想待太久惹人嫌，懂吧？反正我也有事要做……
Solidarity of Steel#239.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#240.src: ...so, you exploring? That's good! I'd show you around, but... eheh, I'm uh, working on a little something right now.
Solidarity of Steel#240.dst: ……所以，你在四处探索？那很好！我本来想带你逛逛，不过……嘿嘿，我，呃，现在正在弄一个小东西。
Solidarity of Steel#240.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#241.src: Yo, quit trying to sneak a peak at it! No spoilers! You'll see it tonight, if I get it done.
Solidarity of Steel#241.dst: 喂，别想偷看！不准剧透！如果我弄完了，今晚你就会看到。
Solidarity of Steel#241.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#243.src: Hm. I suppose you're used to invading personal space?
Solidarity of Steel#243.dst: 嗯。我想你习惯侵犯别人的私人空间了？
Solidarity of Steel#243.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#244.src: Don't worry, I'm not upset. I appreciate the effort in familiarizing yourself with this place.
Solidarity of Steel#244.dst: 别担心，我没生气。很感谢你努力熟悉这个地方。
Solidarity of Steel#244.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#245.src: Did you have a question, or are you just looking around?
Solidarity of Steel#245.dst: 你有什么问题，还是只是四处看看？
Solidarity of Steel#245.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#246.src: Oh, has he done something again? Of course he has... I apologize for my brother's actions.
Solidarity of Steel#246.dst: 噢，他又干了什么吗？当然了……我替我弟弟的行为向你道歉。
Solidarity of Steel#246.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#247.src: He's... hard to keep a handle on. Energetic, impulsive... I do love him, but do I ever wish he would cause less trouble.
Solidarity of Steel#247.dst: 他……很难管得住。精力旺盛、冲动……我是爱他，但真希望他能少惹点麻烦。
Solidarity of Steel#247.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#249.src: Ah. Then I apologize for my assumption.
Solidarity of Steel#249.dst: 啊。那我为我的揣测道歉。
Solidarity of Steel#249.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#250.src: He's... I might be too hard on him sometimes. He does help out a lot around here, he does- just... like I said. Energetic and impulsive.
Solidarity of Steel#250.dst: 他……我有时候可能对他太严格了。他确实在这里帮了很多忙，确实——只是……就像我说的。精力旺盛又冲动。
Solidarity of Steel#250.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#251.src: You'll get used to his personality, with time. Everyone does.
Solidarity of Steel#251.dst: 时间久了你就会习惯他的个性。每个人都是。
Solidarity of Steel#251.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#252.src: But in any case, I'll speak with him about it. He should know better than to bother our guests.
Solidarity of Steel#252.dst: 不过不管怎样，我会跟他谈谈这件事。他应该知道不该去烦我们的客人。
Solidarity of Steel#252.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#253.src: I have to get back to work. I'll see you around.
Solidarity of Steel#253.dst: 我得回去工作了。回头见。
Solidarity of Steel#253.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#254.src: Hm? My role? That's a bit of a complex question, actually. In the Steel Feather... I don't do much.
Solidarity of Steel#254.dst: 嗯？我的角色？这其实是个有点复杂的问题。在钢羽里……我做的事不多。
Solidarity of Steel#254.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#255.src: But I work as a consulting detective for the crown, in the city. I perform investigations for them, but I also gather information for us - keeping tabs on the military, and such.
Solidarity of Steel#255.dst: 不过我在城里担任王室的顾问侦探。我替他们调查案件，但也为我们收集情报——盯着军方之类的。
Solidarity of Steel#255.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#256.src: Besides, the pay's... decent enough. A few emeralds in my pocket helps all of us down here. Unfortunately, we can't produce everything ourselves.
Solidarity of Steel#256.dst: 况且，薪水……还算过得去。口袋里有几个绿宝石，对这下面的所有人都有帮助。可惜我们没法什么都自己生产。
Solidarity of Steel#256.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#257.src: But speaking of my work, I... am actually busy preparing for a meeting right now. {p}'s Commander wants us on the lookout for... something, he hasn't told us yet.
Solidarity of Steel#257.dst: 不过说到我的工作，我……其实现在正在准备一场会议。{p} 的指挥官要我们留意……某样东西，他还没告诉我们是什么。
Solidarity of Steel#257.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#258.src: But it's my duty to find out, so into the city I will go. If you'll excuse me, I'll get back to preparing now.
Solidarity of Steel#258.dst: 但查清楚是我的职责，所以我得进城一趟。失陪了，我要回去准备了。
Solidarity of Steel#258.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#259.src: Return to the main room at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#261.src: Nothing beyond what I'd written in our letters.
Solidarity of Steel#261.dst: 除了我在信里写的，没有别的了。
Solidarity of Steel#261.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#262.src: Alright... thank you, Quill. Just a little longer, then I-
Solidarity of Steel#262.dst: 好吧……谢谢你，Quill。再过一阵子，我就——
Solidarity of Steel#262.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#263.src: Ah, {u}! What do you think of our home? It took a great deal of planning to get the station up and running, but I feel we've done a good-
Solidarity of Steel#263.dst: 啊，{u}！你觉得我们的家怎么样？让车站运转起来花了大量心思规划，不过我觉得我们做得挺——
Solidarity of Steel#263.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#266.src: I overheard... an altercation... between a woma-... and a- ...dier...
Solidarity of Steel#266.dst: 我听到……一场冲突……一个女……和一个……兵……
Solidarity of Steel#266.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#267.src: Calm yourself, Jiro. Take a breath, and repeat
Solidarity of Steel#267.dst: 冷静点，Jiro。深呼吸，再说一遍
Solidarity of Steel#267.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#268.src: A woman is being kicked out... again! I don't know the details, but I think she didn't reach her quota for the month.
Solidarity of Steel#268.dst: 有个女人被赶出去……又一个！我不知道细节，但我想她没达到这个月的配额。
Solidarity of Steel#268.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#270.src: Living Block {~} - through the southwestern tunnel.
Solidarity of Steel#270.dst: 第 {~} 居住区——穿过西南边的隧道。
Solidarity of Steel#270.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#274.src: We're heading out. Rescue mission. Yuman, where's Yulie?
Solidarity of Steel#274.dst: 我们要出发了。救援任务。Yuman，Yulie 呢？
Solidarity of Steel#274.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#275.src: He has a meeting in the city today, remember? He told all of us this morning.
Solidarity of Steel#275.dst: 他今天在城里有会议，记得吗？他今天早上跟我们所有人说过了。
Solidarity of Steel#275.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#276.src: ...Right. Right, he did say- alright. We'll have to go in blind, then. Not ideal, but it can't be helped-
Solidarity of Steel#276.dst: ……对。对，他是说过——好吧。那我们只能摸黑行动了。不理想，但也没办法——
Solidarity of Steel#276.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#277.src: Damn it! Not now, of all times to-
Solidarity of Steel#277.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#278.src: What's going on? Is something wrong?
Solidarity of Steel#278.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#279.src: No, no, nothing's- it's nothing bad... I hope. I just need to... check what triggered the alarm. Ugh, can anything go right today...
Solidarity of Steel#279.dst: 没，没事，没什么——不是坏事……我希望。我只是需要……去看看是什么触发了警报。唉，今天就不能有一件事顺利吗……
Solidarity of Steel#279.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#280.src: Hey, bro, don't worry about it. I'll handle it! You take care of whatever you need to, 'kay?
Solidarity of Steel#280.dst: 嘿，哥，别担心。我来处理！你去处理你要处理的事，好吗？
Solidarity of Steel#280.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#281.src: ...Okay. Okay, thanks, Yuman. I owe you one.
Solidarity of Steel#281.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#282.src: Hey, one of these days I'll collect on all those ones you owe me! Don't think you can dodge that just cause you're my bro!
Solidarity of Steel#282.dst: 嘿，总有一天我会把你欠我的那些次全讨回来！别以为你是我哥就能赖掉！
Solidarity of Steel#282.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#283.src: Will you n- ne- need help? {u} and I can join if y- if you need us.
Solidarity of Steel#283.dst: 你们需——需要帮忙吗？如——如果你们需要，{u} 和我可以一起去。
Solidarity of Steel#283.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#284.src: Was just about to ask the same thing! Jiro, Zeph, {u}, you all listen to my orders 'till this is sorted! Got it?
Solidarity of Steel#284.dst: 我正要问一样的事！Jiro、Zeph、{u}，在这件事处理完之前，你们全都听我的命令！懂了吗？
Solidarity of Steel#284.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#286.src: You forgot the "sir" at the end, there! Anyway, let me grab my guitar, and let's head out!
Solidarity of Steel#286.dst: 你最后忘了加“长官”！总之，让我去拿我的吉他，然后我们出发！
Solidarity of Steel#286.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#288.src: Don't ask, you'll find out later. We need to get moving now.
Solidarity of Steel#288.dst: 别问，你之后就知道了。我们现在得出发了。
Solidarity of Steel#288.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#290.src: Follow Yuman to the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#290.dst: 跟着 Yuman 前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的隧道。

Solidarity of Steel#292.src: I hope Yuman doesn't annoy them to death...
Solidarity of Steel#292.dst: 希望 Yuman 别把他们烦死……
Solidarity of Steel#292.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#293.src: Th- through here! Yuman and Jiro are s- sc- scouting up ahead.
Solidarity of Steel#293.dst: 从——从这里走！Yuman 和 Jiro 在前面侦、侦察。
Solidarity of Steel#293.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#294.src: Find the woman in trouble at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#295.src: I see them up a- a- ahead... Let's join up with them. Fo- follow me!
Solidarity of Steel#295.dst: 我看到他们在前、前、前面……我们去跟他们会合吧。跟——跟我来！
Solidarity of Steel#295.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#297.src: Alright, lady! Time's up! It's time to get going.
Solidarity of Steel#297.dst: 好了，女士！时间到了！该走了。
Solidarity of Steel#297.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#298.src: We need to clean up this filthy apartment of yours for whoever's next in line. We've got a tight schedule, so don't make this harder than it needs to be, alright?
Solidarity of Steel#298.dst: 我们得把你这间脏公寓收拾干净，留给下一位排队的人。我们的时间很紧，所以别把事情弄得比必要的更难，好吗？
Solidarity of Steel#298.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#299.src: W-w-wait! I still need to pack! You haven't given me enough time!
Solidarity of Steel#299.dst: 等、等、等一下！我还得收拾东西！你们给的时间不够！
Solidarity of Steel#299.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#300.src: You received an eviction notice last night, detailing the protocol, didn't you? You've had plenty of time already, lady.
Solidarity of Steel#300.dst: 你昨晚已经收到驱逐通知了，上面写了流程，不是吗？你已经有很多时间了，女士。
Solidarity of Steel#300.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#301.src: Unless what you mean to say is you take issue with the system? We've got a formal complaints department, lady, but I don't think you'd enjoy paying them a visit.
Solidarity of Steel#301.dst: 还是说你的意思是，你对这个制度有意见？我们有正式的投诉部门，女士，不过我想你不会喜欢去那里拜访的。
Solidarity of Steel#301.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#302.src: N-n-no! No, it- it's fine! I-I-I just- I'm just saying th-that- I just need a couple of minutes... Please!
Solidarity of Steel#302.dst: 不、不、不！不，没——没关系！我、我、我只是——我只是说——我只需要几分钟……求求你们！
Solidarity of Steel#302.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#303.src: Sigh. I did warn you, lady. Guess we're doing things the hard way, then.
Solidarity of Steel#303.dst: 唉。我警告过你了，女士。看来我们只好来硬的了。
Solidarity of Steel#303.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#305.src: I'm sorry! I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm-
Solidarity of Steel#305.dst: 对不起！对不起，对不起，我——
Solidarity of Steel#305.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#306.src: Disrespecting the crown is a serious crime, y'know. Alright, boys, you know what to do.
Solidarity of Steel#306.dst: 不尊重王室可是重罪，懂吧。好了，兄弟们，你们知道该怎么做。
Solidarity of Steel#306.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#307.src: Hey! We n- ne- need to hel- help her!
Solidarity of Steel#307.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#308.src: Quiet! It's not protocol, we need to wait until the coast's clear, or else-
Solidarity of Steel#308.dst: 安静！这不合规矩，我们得等到没人再说，不然——
Solidarity of Steel#308.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#309.src: But th- they're going to beat her! We c- can- we c- can't just let that-
Solidarity of Steel#309.dst: 可——可是他们要打她了！我们不——不能——我们不——不能就这样让——
Solidarity of Steel#309.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#310.src: You're new here, so you get a pass for not knowing, but we cannot draw attention towards us.
Solidarity of Steel#310.dst: 你是新来的，所以不知道情有可原，但我们不能引人注意。
Solidarity of Steel#310.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#311.src: Yeah, man! If the guards get a whiff of what we're doing, we're toast! The only reason we have the station is 'cause they don't know about it!
Solidarity of Steel#311.dst: 对啊，老兄！要是守卫察觉到我们在干什么，我们就完蛋了！我们能保住车站，唯一的原因就是他们不知道它的存在！
Solidarity of Steel#311.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#313.src: M- m- maybe hiding is enough f- f- for you, but I c- ca- can't just let someone get h- hur- hurt!
Solidarity of Steel#313.dst: 也、也、也许躲着对你们来说就够、够、够了，但我不、不、不能就这样看着别人受——受——受伤！
Solidarity of Steel#313.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#314.src: S- so-... so sc- screw your cover! She n- n- needs help, so I- I'm going to h- he- help!
Solidarity of Steel#314.dst: 所——所——……所以去、去你的掩护！她需、需、需要帮助，所以我——我要去帮、帮——帮她！
Solidarity of Steel#314.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#315.src: Hey, don't!-... Damn it. Man, how am I gonna explain this to...
Solidarity of Steel#315.dst: 喂，别去！——……该死。老兄，我要怎么跟他们解释……
Solidarity of Steel#315.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#316.src: Defeat the soldiers attacking the woman at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#316.dst: 击败 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 攻击那个女人的士兵。

Solidarity of Steel#317.src: Fine, man! Can't just let you fight alone, can we? Let's just get this over with...
Solidarity of Steel#317.dst: 好啦，老兄！总不能让你一个人打吧？赶快了结吧……
Solidarity of Steel#317.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#319.src: ..Okay. I th- th- I think the coast is clear. She sh- sh- should be-
Solidarity of Steel#319.dst: ……好。我想——想——我想现在安全了。她应——应——应该——
Solidarity of Steel#319.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#320.src: What the hell was that? What were you thinking?!
Solidarity of Steel#320.dst: 刚才那到底是怎么回事？你在想什么？！
Solidarity of Steel#320.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#322.src: No, I really think I should-
Solidarity of Steel#322.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#323.src: Jiro. We've got other things to worry about, man. Cool it till we're back at the station, 'kay?
Solidarity of Steel#323.dst: Jiro。我们还有别的事要操心，老兄。回车站之前先冷静，好吗？
Solidarity of Steel#323.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#326.src: Wh-who are you people? What are- what are you doing here?
Solidarity of Steel#326.dst: 你——你们是什么人？你们在——你们在这里干什么？
Solidarity of Steel#326.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#327.src: One can learn so much of the community's spirit by surveying the boards. See what they're worried of, see the way they support each other, see their culture...
Solidarity of Steel#327.dst: 看看这些公告板，就能了解一个社区的精神。看他们在担心什么，看他们如何互相扶持，看他们的文化……

Solidarity of Steel#328.src: Donated {~} IA by Sovereign Zhiraok after vandalization of previous noticeboard.
Solidarity of Steel#328.dst: 前一块公告板遭到破坏后，由君主 Zhiraok 捐赠 {~} IA。

Solidarity of Steel#329.src: Said it was the Sovereign's problem, but I know the real reason. He just didn't want to go into The Flush.
Solidarity of Steel#329.dst: 他说那是君主的问题，但我知道真正的原因。他只是不想进冲刷道罢了。

Solidarity of Steel#330.src: You don't know us, and we don't know you. But we're here to help. I'm Yuman, and these are-
Solidarity of Steel#330.dst: 你不认识我们，我们也不认识你。但我们是来帮忙的。我是 Yuman，这几位是——
Solidarity of Steel#330.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#331.src: Why... why would you... help me...?
Solidarity of Steel#331.dst: 为什么……你们为什么要……帮我……？
Solidarity of Steel#331.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#332.src: 'Cause... that's what people like us should do.
Solidarity of Steel#332.dst: 因为……那是像我们这样的人该做的事。
Solidarity of Steel#332.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#333.src: No! N-n-no... people like us should just do as we're told and not get involved in things that aren't ours!
Solidarity of Steel#333.dst: 不！不、不、不……像我们这样的人就该乖乖听话，别去管不关自己的事！
Solidarity of Steel#333.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#335.src: If I just follow orders, at least I'll survive! I might lose my apartment, and maybe everything I've built for myself, and all the things I've managed to keep for myself, but- but- but at least I'll be alive!
Solidarity of Steel#335.dst: 只要我乖乖听命令，至少我能活下去！我可能会失去我的公寓，也许还有我为自己打拼来的一切，还有我好不容易留下来的所有东西，但是——但是——但是至少我还活着！
Solidarity of Steel#335.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#336.src: ...I hear you. Trust me, Aihan, I really do.
Solidarity of Steel#336.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#337.src: Can I tell you a story?
Solidarity of Steel#337.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#339.src: Long, long ago, when I was just a little kid, I lost my ma. Dad's out of the picture, so... my bros had to put in the work to take care of me, even though they were just kids too.
Solidarity of Steel#339.dst: 很久很久以前，我还是个小屁孩的时候，我没了妈。老爸早就不在了，所以……我的哥哥们只能拼命照顾我，虽然他们也只是孩子。
Solidarity of Steel#339.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#340.src: But, y'know, being kids... they couldn't do enough. Failed to meet their quotas, just like you. Got kicked out, had to live on the streets.
Solidarity of Steel#340.dst: 可是，你懂的，毕竟是孩子……他们做得不够。没达到配额，就跟你一样。被赶了出去，只能流落街头。
Solidarity of Steel#340.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#341.src: You want to know the reason we made it through that? It was 'cause someone reached out a helping hand. Gave us a place to stay, to work without the threat of not meeting expectations. To live, man.
Solidarity of Steel#341.dst: 你想知道我们是怎么熬过来的吗？是因为有人伸出了援手。给了我们一个落脚的地方，一个不用担心达不到要求的工作。让我们活下去，老兄。
Solidarity of Steel#341.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#342.src: So... please. Accept the hand that's offered to you, 'kay? You can come with us and talk to the boss, and if what we have isn't enough for you... no one will force you to stay. But give it a try, please?
Solidarity of Steel#342.dst: 所以……拜托。接受别人向你伸出的手，好吗？你可以跟我们走，去跟老大谈谈，如果我们那里的东西不够你用……没人会逼你留下。但试试看，好吗？
Solidarity of Steel#342.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#344.src: Not to ruin the moment, Yuman, but we've got more soldiers coming our way! We've got to get moving soon!
Solidarity of Steel#344.dst: 不是想破坏气氛，Yuman，但更多士兵往这边来了！我们得赶快走！
Solidarity of Steel#344.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#345.src: Damn... alright. Aihan, will you trust me?
Solidarity of Steel#345.dst: 该死……好吧。Aihan，你愿意相信我吗？
Solidarity of Steel#345.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#347.src: Okay... okay. Thank you. {u}, could you help her pack her stuff? Zeph, Jiro, help me prepare an escape route.
Solidarity of Steel#347.dst: 好……好。谢谢你。{u}，你能帮她收拾东西吗？Zeph、Jiro，帮我准备逃跑路线。
Solidarity of Steel#347.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#348.src: W-wait! I... I don't know what I'm packing!
Solidarity of Steel#348.dst: 等、等一下！我……我不知道要收拾什么！
Solidarity of Steel#348.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#349.src: Right. Uh... don't bring anything heavy. We have food and cookware where we're going...
Solidarity of Steel#349.dst: 对。呃……别带重的东西。我们要去的地方有食物和厨具……
Solidarity of Steel#349.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#350.src: Bring something to with, something that ... and maybe some form of {u}, if you've got any.
Solidarity of Steel#350.dst: 带上一样用来……的东西、一样能……的东西，如果有的话，也许再带点 {u}。
Solidarity of Steel#350.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#352.src: I... I can't think straight... this is all moving so fast... please- please, can you help me?
Solidarity of Steel#352.dst: 我……我没法好好思考……一切都发生得太快了……拜托——拜托，你能帮帮我吗？
Solidarity of Steel#352.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#353.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 帮 Aihan 收拾东西。

Solidarity of Steel#354.src: Grab that and... pick whatever you think works...
Solidarity of Steel#354.dst: 拿那个，然后……挑你觉得合适的……
Solidarity of Steel#354.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#355.src: We have to hurry but I just can't think!
Solidarity of Steel#355.dst: 我们得快点，可是我就是没法思考！
Solidarity of Steel#355.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#356.src: Pack something to help Aihan some form of a piece of and something to
Solidarity of Steel#356.dst: 帮 Aihan 打包能 的东西、某种 、一件 ，以及能 的东西

Solidarity of Steel#357.src: {u}, h- h- hurry! We don't have m- mu- much time!
Solidarity of Steel#357.dst: {u}，快、快、快点！我们没多、多少时间了！
Solidarity of Steel#357.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#359.src: Where- where are you going? D-d-don't leave me here!
Solidarity of Steel#359.dst: 你——你要去哪？别、别、别把我丢在这里！
Solidarity of Steel#359.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#360.src: Did you get everything? Can we go?
Solidarity of Steel#360.dst: 东西都拿好了吗？我们可以走了吗？
Solidarity of Steel#360.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#361.src: Okay... No one's here yet. Let's go!
Solidarity of Steel#361.dst: 好……还没有人来。我们走吧！
Solidarity of Steel#361.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#363.src: We're out of time, we have to get moving! Come on, come on!
Solidarity of Steel#363.dst: 没时间了，我们得走了！快点，快点！
Solidarity of Steel#363.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#364.src: Up the ladder, into the tunnel! Go, go, go!
Solidarity of Steel#364.dst: 爬上梯子，进隧道！快，快，快！
Solidarity of Steel#364.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#365.src: Yuman... c- co- come on. Let's go.
Solidarity of Steel#365.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#368.src: Man... that was a really stupid thing for you to do. Like, astronomically stupid, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#368.dst: 老兄……你刚才干的事真的超蠢的。就是，蠢到天上去了，懂吗？
Solidarity of Steel#368.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#370.src: But I get it. I get it, y'know? If I didn't have to be a leader there, I'd've probably done the same thing!
Solidarity of Steel#370.dst: 不过我懂。我懂，你知道吗？要是我那时候不用当领头的，我大概也会做一样的事！
Solidarity of Steel#370.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#371.src: Difference is, my bros can hold me back from that impulse. Guess I wasn't able to do that, here...
Solidarity of Steel#371.dst: 差别在于，我哥哥们能拉住我那股冲动。看来这次我没能拉住你……
Solidarity of Steel#371.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#372.src: Hate to disappoint 'em, y'know? Bit late now, though. What's done is done, can't take it back.
Solidarity of Steel#372.dst: 真不想让他们失望，懂吧？不过现在说也晚了。做了就做了，收不回来的。
Solidarity of Steel#372.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#373.src: It'll be alright. Worse things've happened. Aihan's safe, that's all that matters! We'll deal with the rest as it comes.
Solidarity of Steel#373.dst: 会没事的。更糟的事都发生过。Aihan 安全了，这才是最重要的！其他的事来了再处理。
Solidarity of Steel#373.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#374.src: I- I should've... I should've l-lis- listened to you. But, s- s- seeing the way they- they were treating her... I was j- j- just so... angry. How dare th- they look down on p- p- people like that?!
Solidarity of Steel#374.dst: 我——我应该……我应该听、听、听你的。可是，看、看、看到他们那样——那样对待她……我就、就、就是好……生气。他们怎么敢那样瞧不起人、人、人？！
Solidarity of Steel#374.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#375.src: Yeah... I hear you. Hear you loud and clear. It's not right, is it? But that's what we're working to fix down here, man. Gotta do what little you can, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#375.dst: 是啊……我懂。听得一清二楚。这不对，是吧？但这正是我们在这下面努力要改变的，老兄。能做多少算多少，对吧？
Solidarity of Steel#375.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#376.src: Let's get going. They'll be expecting us. Wouldn't want to keep 'em waiting.
Solidarity of Steel#376.dst: 我们走吧。他们在等我们。可不想让他们久等。
Solidarity of Steel#376.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#377.src: ...We should f- f- follow them in.
Solidarity of Steel#377.dst: ……我们应、应、应该跟着他们进去。
Solidarity of Steel#377.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#378.src: Head back to the Steel Feather through the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#379.src: Report what happened to The Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#381.src: Would- w- would it be weird to say it's a r- r- relief to find out he has a ser- a- a serious side to him?
Solidarity of Steel#381.dst: 如——如——如果我说，发现他也有认——认——认真的一面让我松了口气，会不会很奇怪？
Solidarity of Steel#381.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#382.src: Not- n- not that this is how I'd have w- w- wanted to find out...
Solidarity of Steel#382.dst: 不——不——不是说我想以这种方——方——方式发现……
Solidarity of Steel#382.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#384.src: Jiro and I got her settled. Quill's giving her the rundown as we speak.
Solidarity of Steel#384.dst: Jiro 跟我把她安顿好了。Quill 正在跟她说明情况。
Solidarity of Steel#384.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#385.src: You should... probably avoid Jiro for now, yeah? He's not exactly... happy.
Solidarity of Steel#385.dst: 你……暂时最好躲着 Jiro 点，好吗？他不太……高兴。
Solidarity of Steel#385.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#386.src: Right... Got it. So- s- so... how does it wor- work now? Should we re- record this mission s- somewhere?
Solidarity of Steel#386.dst: 好……知道了。所——所以……现在要怎么做？我们应该把这次任务记、记录在哪里吗？
Solidarity of Steel#386.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#387.src: Yep, yep! Normally I'd go to Quill, but he's busy. Let's see if we can find Yusanu first- he'll... understand. Probably. More than Yulie, at least. I trust him to keep it quiet for now, at least... y'know?
Solidarity of Steel#387.dst: 对，对！平常我会去找 Quill，不过他在忙。我们先去找 Yusanu——他会……理解的。大概吧。至少比 Yulie 理解。我相信他会暂时保密……至少，懂吧？
Solidarity of Steel#387.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#389.src: Yuman, I swear. Yusanu should know better than to let you take the lead on these sorts of things! What were you thinking?
Solidarity of Steel#389.dst: Yuman，我发誓。Yusanu 应该知道不该让你带头做这种事！你在想什么？
Solidarity of Steel#389.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#390.src: Woah, woah, woah! That's a lot of accusations out of nowhere, bro! What gives?
Solidarity of Steel#390.dst: 哇，哇，哇！突然冒出这么多指控啊，哥！怎么回事？
Solidarity of Steel#390.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#391.src: What gives? You know what gives- a whole squadron of housing enforcers turns up dead on the job, and you expect that to go over quietly?
Solidarity of Steel#391.dst: 怎么回事？你心知肚明怎么回事——整整一个小队的住房执法队在执勤时丧命，你以为这能悄悄过去？
Solidarity of Steel#391.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#392.src: Ahhh. That. Well, you know how it is. Things happen, right?
Solidarity of Steel#392.dst: 啊——那个。嗯，你懂的嘛。事情总会发生，对吧？
Solidarity of Steel#392.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#393.src: You-... at least pretend to take this seriously, would you? Of all people, you should know what this is going to lead to.
Solidarity of Steel#393.dst: 你——……至少装得认真一点，好吗？你比谁都该知道这会导致什么后果。
Solidarity of Steel#393.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#394.src: It- it was- was- it wasn't his f- f- fault, I-
Solidarity of Steel#394.dst: 那——那是——是——那不是他的错、错、错，我——
Solidarity of Steel#394.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#395.src: Hey, princess, it's alright. Don't need you to cover for me, 'kay?
Solidarity of Steel#395.dst: 嘿，公主，没关系。不需要你替我掩护，好吗？
Solidarity of Steel#395.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#396.src: So what's the plan then, Yulie? Meeting to talk about it, as always?
Solidarity of Steel#396.dst: 那计划是什么，Yulie？跟往常一样开会讨论？
Solidarity of Steel#396.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#397.src: Sigh... as soon as Quill gets Aihan sorted, yes. It shouldn't take long, so everyone's gathered in advance.
Solidarity of Steel#397.dst: 唉……等 Quill 安顿好 Aihan 就开，对。应该不会太久，所以大家已经提前集合了。
Solidarity of Steel#397.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#399.src: Hey! What happened out there? Everyone's acting weird about it.
Solidarity of Steel#399.dst: 嘿！外面发生什么事了？大家对这件事都怪怪的。
Solidarity of Steel#399.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#400.src: We ended up f- fight- fighting some soldiers to save the w- w- the woman we went there for...
Solidarity of Steel#400.dst: 我们最后跟一些士兵打、打、打了起来，为了救我们去救的那——那——那个女人……
Solidarity of Steel#400.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#401.src: Huh. Is that all? I thought it'd be way worse.
Solidarity of Steel#401.dst: 嗯。就这样？我还以为会糟得多。
Solidarity of Steel#401.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#402.src: Yeah... they- th- they're worried about it dr- draw- drawing attention...
Solidarity of Steel#402.dst: 是啊……他——他——他们担心这会引、引、引起注意……
Solidarity of Steel#402.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#404.src: Still helping out in the kitchen, preparing for dinner! Worry not, I will catch her up once the meeting concludes.
Solidarity of Steel#404.dst: 还在厨房帮忙准备晚饭！别担心，会议结束后我会跟她说明的。
Solidarity of Steel#404.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#405.src: Ah, hello everybody. Apologies for the delay.
Solidarity of Steel#405.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#407.src: She hasn't quite decided yet, but she has agreed to stay the night. She's in a bad state of mind, the poor woman. Some rest will do her good.
Solidarity of Steel#407.dst: 她还没完全决定，不过她同意先住一晚。她的精神状态很差，可怜的女人。休息一下对她有好处。
Solidarity of Steel#407.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#408.src: But that leads us well to the reason this meeting was called. The retrieval process went... poorly, I take it?
Solidarity of Steel#408.dst: 不过这正好引出召开这次会议的原因。救援过程……不太顺利，我猜？
Solidarity of Steel#408.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#409.src: Poorly is an understatement. The military is on high alert now! Everyone entering or leaving {p} this evening was questioned- if I hadn't used our tunnel, I'd still be stuck in line there!
Solidarity of Steel#409.dst: 不太顺利还是说轻了。军方现在高度戒备！今晚所有进出 {p} 的人都被盘问——要不是我走了我们的隧道，我现在还卡在那边排队！
Solidarity of Steel#409.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#410.src: This is an unmitigated disaster. Yuman, what do you have to say for yourself? You should know better by now, we need to-
Solidarity of Steel#410.dst: 这是彻头彻尾的灾难。Yuman，你有什么话要说？你现在早该懂事了，我们需要——
Solidarity of Steel#410.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#411.src: H- hey! It- it- it's not- it's n- not his f- f- fault! I'm the- the one who-
Solidarity of Steel#411.dst: 喂——喂！这——这——这不是——这不、不是他的错、错、错！是我——是我——
Solidarity of Steel#411.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#412.src: Nah, the blame falls on me. I was the leader, so anything that happened is my responsibility. I should've... been more firm about it.
Solidarity of Steel#412.dst: 不，责任在我。我是领头的，所以发生的一切都是我的责任。我应该……态度更坚决一点。
Solidarity of Steel#412.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#413.src: None of this would have happened if I'd been there... damn it. The timing couldn't have been worse. This is all my-
Solidarity of Steel#413.dst: 要是我在场，这一切都不会发生……该死。时机真是糟透了。这全都是我的——
Solidarity of Steel#413.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#414.src: Okay, that's enough. You're all acting stupid! Who cares whose fault it was? Either way, it already happened, so let's figure out what we're going to do about it.
Solidarity of Steel#414.dst: 好了，够了。你们全都在犯傻！谁在乎是谁的错？反正事情已经发生了，我们来想想要怎么处理吧。
Solidarity of Steel#414.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#416.src: And I'm not done! You're all acting like it's the end of the world that some soldiers are dead. So what? Soldiers die all the time.
Solidarity of Steel#416.dst: 我还没说完！你们全都表现得好像死了几个士兵就是世界末日一样。那又怎样？士兵天天都在死。
Solidarity of Steel#416.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#417.src: They don't die like this, though. We don't have the luxury of being able to wave off the crown's attention! If they find out what we're doing down here, we're done for.
Solidarity of Steel#417.dst: 但他们不是这样死的。我们没有无视王室注意的本钱！要是他们发现我们在这下面做的事，我们就完了。
Solidarity of Steel#417.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#418.src: But they haven't found out yet, have they? You have options still. For example- you're on the detective force! If suspicions arise, couldn't you just lead them elsewhere?
Solidarity of Steel#418.dst: 可是他们还没发现，不是吗？你们还有选择。比如说——你在侦探队里！如果有人起疑，你不能把他们引到别处去吗？
Solidarity of Steel#418.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#419.src: Besides. If staying hidden means having to look away as innocent people get harmed- what kind of a resistance does that make you? What's the point of any of it?
Solidarity of Steel#419.dst: 再说。如果保持隐蔽就代表得对无辜的人受伤视而不见——那你们算什么抵抗组织？这一切还有什么意义？
Solidarity of Steel#419.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#420.src: Rex... take care with your words. Don't say anything you'll-
Solidarity of Steel#420.dst: Rex……说话小心点。别说出会让你——
Solidarity of Steel#420.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#421.src: What's the POINT?! The POINT is all the people we ALREADY have down here who we need to protect! Quill, please, back me up here.
Solidarity of Steel#421.dst: 什么意义？！意义就是我们这下面已经有的所有需要保护的人！Quill，拜托，帮我说句话。
Solidarity of Steel#421.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#422.src: ... No, Yulie, Rex has a point. Even if it was phrased harshly... we have been rather passive in our battle thus far. We've let people get hurt, even if only for the sake of our safety.
Solidarity of Steel#422.dst: ……不，Yulie，Rex 说得有道理。就算话说得很难听……我们到目前为止的战斗确实相当被动。我们让人受了伤，就算只是为了我们自己的安全。
Solidarity of Steel#422.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#423.src: We have had our reasons... and we have done good work, to the best of our ability. But if we are afraid to act, how will anything ever change for the better?
Solidarity of Steel#423.dst: 我们有我们的理由……而且我们尽了最大的努力，做了很多好事。但如果我们害怕行动，事情又怎么可能变好？
Solidarity of Steel#423.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#425.src: You are not wrong to feel frustration, Yulie. I, too, wish this had been handled with more care... but something like this was bound to happen eventually. We will survive this, as we have survived other hardships before.
Solidarity of Steel#425.dst: 你感到沮丧并没有错，Yulie。我也希望这件事能处理得更小心……但这种事早晚会发生。我们会撑过去的，就像我们撑过以前其他难关一样。
Solidarity of Steel#425.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#427.src: ...But let's lighten the mood a little! Dinner should almost be ready. Yuman, you told me earlier today you were working on a new song. Would you still like to perform it tonight?
Solidarity of Steel#427.dst: ……不过我们来缓和一下气氛吧！晚饭应该快好了。Yuman，你今天早上跟我说你在写一首新歌。今晚还想表演吗？
Solidarity of Steel#427.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#428.src: Huh? Oh, yeah, yeah man! I can do that, for sure.
Solidarity of Steel#428.dst: 嗯？噢，想啊，想啊老兄！我可以，没问题。
Solidarity of Steel#428.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#429.src: Ahem. Before we depart, if I may- while we are all gathered here, I believe it could be beneficial to lay out some relevant information.
Solidarity of Steel#429.dst: 咳咳。在我们散会之前，容我说一句——既然大家都聚在这里，我想整理一些相关的情报会有帮助。
Solidarity of Steel#429.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#430.src: Most of us are new to the Roughworks, so getting to know the lay of the land could help.
Solidarity of Steel#430.dst: 我们大部分人都是初来 Roughworks，所以了解一下这里的情况会有帮助。
Solidarity of Steel#430.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#431.src: Right, of course. I'd been meaning to suggest something similar earlier, before... this situation came up.
Solidarity of Steel#431.dst: 对，当然。我本来早就想提类似的建议，只是……后来发生了这件事。
Solidarity of Steel#431.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#432.src: Certainly, we could do that! What would you like to know?
Solidarity of Steel#432.dst: 当然，可以！你们想知道什么？
Solidarity of Steel#432.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#433.src: Ah, yes. Her name is Soosu. It's hard to say much about her... she's rather reclusive, staying cooped up in her mansion, working away.
Solidarity of Steel#433.dst: 啊，是的。她叫 Soosu。关于她很难说太多……她相当孤僻，一直窝在她的宅邸里埋头工作。
Solidarity of Steel#433.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#434.src: She's the opposite of Zhiraok, in that way. Ideally, we'll avoid drawing her attention. We'll have plenty to worry about already without adding her to the list.
Solidarity of Steel#434.dst: 在这方面，她跟 Zhiraok 正好相反。最理想的情况是我们别引起她的注意。我们要操心的事已经够多了，不需要再把她加进清单。
Solidarity of Steel#434.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#435.src: That'd be for the best, yeah. She's... kind of a genius. She singlehandedly brought forth the Industrial Age, over a century ago! Most of the machinery you see in Fruma probably traces its origin back to her in some way.
Solidarity of Steel#435.dst: 那样最好，对。她……算是个天才。一个多世纪前，她单枪匹马开启了工业时代！你在 Fruma 看到的大部分机械，追根溯源多半都跟她有关。
Solidarity of Steel#435.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#436.src: Ha! Yeah, yeah, figures you'd know all that, bro. Nerd.
Solidarity of Steel#436.dst: 哈！是啊，是啊，就知道你会知道这些，哥。书呆子。
Solidarity of Steel#436.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#437.src: Wh- that's just written history, Yuman. If you're going to make fun of me, at least do it right.
Solidarity of Steel#437.dst: 什——那只是有记载的历史，Yuman。要取笑我，至少取笑得有点水平。
Solidarity of Steel#437.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#438.src: How about her blessing? If we do run into her, we'll want to know what to watch out for.
Solidarity of Steel#438.dst: 那她的祝福呢？要是真的碰上她，我们得知道要提防什么。
Solidarity of Steel#438.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#439.src: I don't know the specifics... but what I do know is that it allows her to mold matter at will. To what extent, or with what limits... hard to say. Still, that uncertainty is dangerous. Be careful.
Solidarity of Steel#439.dst: 具体的我不清楚……但我知道的是，那能让她随心所欲地塑造物质。能做到什么程度、有什么限制……很难说。不过，这种不确定本身就很危险。要小心。
Solidarity of Steel#439.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#440.src: Very well! Then let us adjourn for dinner.
Solidarity of Steel#440.dst: 很好！那我们散会去吃晚饭吧。
Solidarity of Steel#440.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#441.src: Speak to Sui at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and watch Yuman's performance.
Solidarity of Steel#441.dst: 与 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Sui 交谈，观看 Yuman 的表演。

Solidarity of Steel#442.src: Yuman's performance is about to start. You should grab a bite from Sui!
Solidarity of Steel#442.dst: Yuman 的表演快开始了。你该去 Sui 那里吃点东西！
Solidarity of Steel#442.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#443.src: Oh, {u}! I feel like I've barely seen you around here...
Solidarity of Steel#443.dst: 噢，{u}！我觉得我在这里几乎没怎么见到你……
Solidarity of Steel#443.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#444.src: I, um... Mora told me about what happened. On your mission. I'm... glad you were able to help that woman.
Solidarity of Steel#444.dst: 我，呃……Mora 跟我说了发生的事。你们任务里的事。我……很高兴你们帮到了那个女人。
Solidarity of Steel#444.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#445.src: I, ha, kind of wish I could've been there, to help. Though, I don't... really know what I could have done, there.
Solidarity of Steel#445.dst: 我，哈，有点希望我也能在场，帮上忙。不过，我也不……真的知道我在那里能做什么。
Solidarity of Steel#445.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#446.src: S-so maybe it's a good thing! That I've been, um, busy, cooking. For the Steel Feather. There's, ha, a lot of people here!
Solidarity of Steel#446.dst: 所、所以也许这是好事！我一直，呃，忙着，做饭。为钢羽。这里有，哈，好多人！
Solidarity of Steel#446.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#447.src: But I've been learning new recipes, and getting to know new people! Oh, right, you're probably here for, um, the food. Here! Please have some.
Solidarity of Steel#447.dst: 不过我一直在学新食谱，也在认识新的人！噢，对了，你大概是来，呃，吃东西的。来！请吃点吧。
Solidarity of Steel#447.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#448.src: ...oh, hi! Are you here for some food?
Solidarity of Steel#448.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#449.src: Ah, n-no, I- well, yes, I'd love some food, but I'm here to- to thank {u}.
Solidarity of Steel#449.dst: 啊，不、不是，我——嗯，是的，我很想吃点东西，不过我是来——来谢谢 {u} 的。
Solidarity of Steel#449.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#450.src: Don't- don't sell yourself short! I don't... f-fully understand yet, but, fighting the guards like... like that is dangerous, and- and I know why some people wouldn't want to...
Solidarity of Steel#450.dst: 别——别妄自菲薄！我……还不完、完全明白，但是，像……像那样跟守卫打起来很危险，而——而且我知道为什么有些人不愿意……
Solidarity of Steel#450.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#451.src: But you did anyway, and- and- and it means a lot.
Solidarity of Steel#451.dst: 但你还是做了，而——而——而且这对我意义重大。
Solidarity of Steel#451.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#452.src: It, um, sounds like it was a really bad situation. So I'm glad you got out alright.
Solidarity of Steel#452.dst: 那，呃，听起来真的是很糟的情况。所以我很高兴你平安逃出来了。
Solidarity of Steel#452.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#453.src: H-ha... yes. They've been... p-pushy before, but they've never been this- this- this, ah, violent.
Solidarity of Steel#453.dst: 哈、哈……是啊。他们以前也……很强、强硬，但从来没有这么——这么——这么，啊，暴力过。
Solidarity of Steel#453.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#454.src: Y-yes, I am. It's... new, and- and different, but everyone here has been so kind, and...
Solidarity of Steel#454.dst: 是、是的，我是。这里……很新，而——而且不一样，但这里每个人都好亲切，而且……
Solidarity of Steel#454.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#455.src: It's a little- a little strange... It almost feels like- like- like I don't deserve it! Because, I- I- I haven't... w-worked for it.
Solidarity of Steel#455.dst: 有点——有点奇怪……感觉就像——就像——就像我不配得到这些！因为，我——我——我没有……为、为此工作过。
Solidarity of Steel#455.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#456.src: Um... I don't really, know, what it's like to live here... but where I'm from, people help each other. You shouldn't have to earn the right to live.
Solidarity of Steel#456.dst: 呃……我其实不太，知道，住在这里是什么感觉……不过在我来的地方，人们会互相帮助。你不应该需要去挣得活下去的权利。
Solidarity of Steel#456.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#457.src: Y-you must be from a much n-nicer place than- than here.
Solidarity of Steel#457.dst: 你、你一定是从比——比这里好、好得多的地方来的。
Solidarity of Steel#457.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#458.src: Ha... it's k-kind of ridiculous, looking back. Stupid- s-stupid quotas... ouch...
Solidarity of Steel#458.dst: 哈……回头想想，真有点荒谬。愚蠢——愚、愚蠢的配额……好痛……
Solidarity of Steel#458.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#459.src: You want to know my story?

Solidarity of Steel#461.src: Oh, it- it's nothing. Just, heavy m-machinery. Hurt my shoulder when- when I went in. It- it's r-really my fault, I, I, I sh-should have been m-more careful...
Solidarity of Steel#461.dst: 噢，没——没什么。只是，重、重型机械。我进去的时候——的时候伤到了肩膀。其——其实是我的错，我，我，我应、应该更、更小心的……
Solidarity of Steel#461.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#462.src: Um... I- I can, ha, I can help you.
Solidarity of Steel#462.dst: 呃……我——我可以，哈，我可以帮你。
Solidarity of Steel#462.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#464.src: Just... sigh. Follow me, and- and trust me.
Solidarity of Steel#464.dst: 就……唉。跟我来，然后——然后相信我。
Solidarity of Steel#464.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#467.src: H-hey! I- I only have this shirt, I c- I can't- I-
Solidarity of Steel#467.dst: 嘿、嘿！我——我就只有这件衣服，我不——我不能——我——
Solidarity of Steel#467.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#470.src: How did- how did you do that?
Solidarity of Steel#470.dst: 你是怎么——你是怎么做到的？
Solidarity of Steel#470.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#471.dst: 我……我是受诅者。就是这样。
Solidarity of Steel#471.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#473.src: I-... th-thank you. I didn't... I didn't know cursed ones could be- could be nice.
Solidarity of Steel#473.dst: 我——……谢、谢谢你。我不……我不知道受诅者也可以——也可以这么好。
Solidarity of Steel#473.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#474.src: Um... I sh-should go. Thank you for- for the food, and- and- and for... healing my shoulder. I- I really appreciate it.
Solidarity of Steel#474.dst: 呃……我、我该走了。谢谢你的——你的食物，还——还——还有……治好我的肩膀。我——我真的很感激。
Solidarity of Steel#474.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#477.src: It's fine. It's what I expected. I'm... glad I could help.
Solidarity of Steel#477.dst: 没关系。这在我预料之中。我……很高兴能帮上忙。
Solidarity of Steel#477.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#478.src: I- I guess so! Ha... at least she, um, wasn't scared. Just... nervous.
Solidarity of Steel#478.dst: 我——我想是吧！哈……至少她，呃，没有害怕。只是……紧张。
Solidarity of Steel#478.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#479.src: I'll, um, catch up with the rest of you, later.
Solidarity of Steel#479.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#480.src: Go join the others. Uh, I'll join you in a bit.
Solidarity of Steel#480.dst: 去跟其他人会合吧。呃，我等一下就过去。
Solidarity of Steel#480.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#481.src: {u}, it's nice of you to join us. Have you had dinner yet?
Solidarity of Steel#481.dst: {u}，很高兴你来了。吃过晚饭了吗？
Solidarity of Steel#481.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#482.src: It's good, isn't it? Quill tells me she's managed to fit right in with the other cooks here.
Solidarity of Steel#482.dst: 很好吃，对吧？Quill 跟我说她已经跟这里其他厨师处得很好了。
Solidarity of Steel#482.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#483.src: So, {u}, are you also w- wait- waiting for Yuman's performance?
Solidarity of Steel#483.dst: 那么，{u}，你也在等——等——等 Yuman 的表演吗？
Solidarity of Steel#483.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#484.src: I have heard great things about his musical talents! Though, ah, I have also heard this his variety, ah, leaves something to be desired.
Solidarity of Steel#484.dst: 我听说他的音乐才华非常出色！不过，啊，我也听说他的曲目，啊，有点不够多样。
Solidarity of Steel#484.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#485.src: Then worry not, for you have been reminded just now, hoho!
Solidarity of Steel#485.dst: 那别担心，现在你已经被提醒了，嚯嚯！
Solidarity of Steel#485.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#486.src: Hey, maybe he's written a song about you, Zeph!
Solidarity of Steel#486.dst: 嘿，说不定他写了一首关于你的歌，Zeph！
Solidarity of Steel#486.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#487.src: Wh- wh- what?! R- Rex, no h- he-... that's n- not-... wh- why would he ev- even-
Solidarity of Steel#487.dst: 什——什——什么？！R-Rex，不，他——……那不——……他为什——为什么要——
Solidarity of Steel#487.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#488.src: Ha! Relax, relax, I'm just teasing ya.
Solidarity of Steel#488.dst: 哈！放轻松，放轻松，我逗你的。
Solidarity of Steel#488.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#489.src: Ahem... Attention, attention! Everyone, gather around!
Solidarity of Steel#489.dst: 咳咳……注意，注意！大家，都过来！
Solidarity of Steel#489.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#490.src: I am heartened to see so many of you joining us for dinner today. It feels as though it has been a while since we've had such a large attendance!
Solidarity of Steel#490.dst: 看到今天有这么多人来一起吃晚饭，我深受鼓舞。感觉已经好久没有这么多人出席了！
Solidarity of Steel#490.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#491.src: There is of course news to deliver... but first! We begin by thanking our cooks for the meal.
Solidarity of Steel#491.dst: 当然有消息要宣布……不过首先！我们先感谢厨师们准备的这顿饭。
Solidarity of Steel#491.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#492.src: We're all familiar with Fletch's talents, but dinner wouldn't have been possible without the help of one of our new arrivals: Sui!
Solidarity of Steel#492.dst: 大家都知道 Fletch 的手艺，但如果没有我们一位新成员的帮忙，这顿晚饭是做不出来的：Sui！
Solidarity of Steel#492.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#493.src: Oh...! It, ha, it- um. It was nothing. T'was my pleasure! To- to help.
Solidarity of Steel#493.dst: 噢……！那，哈，那——呃。那没什么。是我的荣幸！能——能帮忙。
Solidarity of Steel#493.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#494.src: No need to be shy, my dear!
Solidarity of Steel#494.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#495.src: Dinner aside, let's get to the announcements!
Solidarity of Steel#495.dst: 晚饭说完了，我们来宣布事项！
Solidarity of Steel#495.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#496.src: Today, we have had not one, but seven new arrivals! In addition to Sui, please welcome Aihan, Mora, Rex, Zeph, {u}, and Syndra!
Solidarity of Steel#496.dst: 今天，我们迎来的新成员不是一位，而是七位！除了 Sui，请欢迎 Aihan、Mora、Rex、Zeph、{u} 和 Syndra！
Solidarity of Steel#496.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#497.src: Now, I'm certain news has spread of our... altercation, shall we say, with the crown's military. I assure you, all is under control! The Steel Feather remains secure and hidden.
Solidarity of Steel#497.dst: 那么，我相信大家都已经听说了我们跟王室军队的……冲突，姑且这么说吧。我向大家保证，一切都在掌控之中！钢羽依然安全隐蔽。
Solidarity of Steel#497.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#498.src: It does mean expeditions out of the station will be at higher risk for a time. We will have updated guidelines available in the morning for those of you who volunteer.
Solidarity of Steel#498.dst: 这确实代表一段时间内离开车站的外出行动风险会更高。明天早上我们会为自愿外出的人提供更新后的准则。
Solidarity of Steel#498.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#499.src: But in lighter news, we have restocked candy bars and sodas at the ticket shops! Make sure to trade for some before they run out - remember the rules, one of each per person.
Solidarity of Steel#499.dst: 不过来点轻松的消息，售票处的糖果棒和汽水补货了！趁还没卖完赶快去换——记住规矩，每人每样限一份。
Solidarity of Steel#499.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#500.src: Well then! Barring any surprises at this very moment, that is all for today's report. As he has volunteered himself today, I will hand over the stage to Yuman.
Solidarity of Steel#500.dst: 好了！除非这一刻突然出什么意外，今天的报告就到此为止。既然 Yuman 今天自告奋勇，我就把舞台交给他。
Solidarity of Steel#500.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#501.src: Heeeeeelllllooooo people of the Steel Feather!
Solidarity of Steel#501.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#502.src: Good to see you all as always- ey, Taio, lookin' good! Mei, love what you've done with the hair! Jin, my man!
Solidarity of Steel#502.dst: 一如往常见到大家真好——嘿，Taio，气色不错嘛！Mei，发型超赞！Jin，我的好兄弟！
Solidarity of Steel#502.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#503.src: Ah... I guess I can introduce my song. It's a new one! You guys won't be able to tease me for being an artist with only one song anymore, haha!
Solidarity of Steel#503.dst: 啊……我想我可以介绍一下我的歌。这是首新歌！你们再也不能笑我是只有一首歌的艺人了，哈哈！
Solidarity of Steel#503.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#504.src: I've been working on this one for a while. Never could find a way to end it, though... 'till now, that is. Finally managed to find some inspiration.
Solidarity of Steel#504.dst: 这首我写了好一阵子。一直想不出该怎么结尾……直到现在。终于找到了一些灵感。
Solidarity of Steel#504.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#505.src: Well, enough talking from me. Here it goes!
Solidarity of Steel#505.dst: 好了，我不多说了。开始啦！
Solidarity of Steel#505.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#507.src: Hm hm hm! Look who it is!
Solidarity of Steel#507.speaker: ??? (Sovereign Soosu)

Solidarity of Steel#510.src: Happy to see you again, Flowers.
Solidarity of Steel#510.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solidarity of Steel#512.src: You need to subtract some of this security. It shouldn't need to take twenty minutes to get through just the gate. We need to talk, an hour ago.
Solidarity of Steel#512.dst: 你得减掉一些安保。光是通过大门就不该花二十分钟。我们得谈谈，而且早该谈了。
Solidarity of Steel#512.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solidarity of Steel#513.src: Wow, mister loudmouth, big words for someone who wasn't supposed to be here for a few more weeks! What gives?! You're interrupting my flow!
Solidarity of Steel#513.dst: 哇，大嘴巴先生，本来还要再过几个星期才会来的人，口气倒是不小！怎么回事？！你打断我的灵感了！
Solidarity of Steel#513.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Solidarity of Steel#514.src: Your sche- Are you taking lessons from Oru? This provincial emergency has a much greater value than your charter, Sovereign, so I'm summing to the equatio- nnh.
Solidarity of Steel#514.dst: 你的日——你是在跟 Oru 学吗？这场全行省的紧急事态比你的特许项目价值大得多，统领，所以我要把自己代入这个方程——嗯。
Solidarity of Steel#514.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solidarity of Steel#515.src: I've changed my schedule to come here early and track down a defector- Syndra, and her set of insurgents. You've heard the name, right?
Solidarity of Steel#515.dst: 我改了日程提前来这里，是为了追捕一名叛逃者——Syndra，还有她那群叛乱分子。你听过这个名字吧？
Solidarity of Steel#515.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Stable Story#000.dst: 与 {p} 外 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Enkser 对话

Stable Story#001.src: Looking for able-bodied adventurers! Preferably with no friends or family, but I'm not picky!
Stable Story#001.dst: 招募身强体壮的冒险者！最好没有朋友或家人，不过我不挑！
Stable Story#001.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#002.src: You see, I'm a horse merchant. Make my living selling these beauties to adventurers like you.
Stable Story#002.dst: 你看，我是个马贩子。靠把这些小美人卖给你这样的冒险者过活。
Stable Story#002.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#003.src: I work at this barn, selling the horses I raise in {p} out here to rich {p} folk.
Stable Story#003.dst: 我在这个马厩干活，把我在 {p} 养的马卖给 {p} 的有钱人。
Stable Story#003.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#004.src: Until these rabble-rousing troublemakers blew a tunnel through my barn and smuggled MY horses out.
Stable Story#004.dst: 直到那群惹是生非的捣蛋鬼在我的马厩里炸出一条隧道，把我的马偷运了出去。
Stable Story#004.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#005.src: Usually, I'd be charging a high price for these horses Not to be rude, but one you couldn't afford.
Stable Story#005.dst: 平常这些马我是要高价卖的——不是我说话难听，是你买不起的价钱。
Stable Story#005.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#006.src: So, let's cut a deal They stole my stable key. If you can go to my barn in {p}...
Stable Story#006.dst: 所以，我们做个交易吧——他们偷走了我的马厩钥匙。如果你能去我在 {p} 的马厩……
Stable Story#006.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#007.src: And return the key to me, I'll so charitably bestow upon you one of my horses. This deal is sweeter than you realize, too...
Stable Story#007.dst: 把钥匙还给我，我就大发慈悲送你一匹马。这笔交易比你想的还划算……
Stable Story#007.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#008.src: Betty'll be there to help! Strong as she is, don't you DARE let them touch her!
Stable Story#008.dst: Betty 会在那里帮忙！她是很壮没错，但你敢让他们碰她一下试试！
Stable Story#008.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#009.src: I'll be making my way to {p} myself to ensure Betty's safety.
Stable Story#009.dst: 我自己也会赶去 {p}，确保 Betty 的安全。
Stable Story#009.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#010.src: Now, best be on your way. {p} is a fair bit down the {p} from here, off to the east.
Stable Story#010.dst: 好了，你最好快上路。{p} 离这里有好一段路，沿着 {p} 往东走。
Stable Story#010.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#011.src: Bring back [{~} Stable Key] to Enkser from the tunnel at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Stable Story#011.dst: 从 [{~2}, {~3}, -{~4}] 的隧道把 [{~1} Stable Key] 带回给 Enkser

Stable Story#012.src: Hey, have you found my [{~} Stable Key] yet? It should be somewhere in {p} to the east.
Stable Story#012.dst: 嘿，找到我的 [{~} 马厩钥匙] 了吗？应该在东边的 {p} 某处。
Stable Story#012.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#013.src: Looking for able-bodied adventurers, preferably with no friends or
Stable Story#013.dst: 招募身强体壮的冒险者，最好没有朋友或
Stable Story#013.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#014.src: Hey, it's you! Got my barn key yet?
Stable Story#014.dst: 嘿，是你！拿到我的马厩钥匙了吗？
Stable Story#014.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#015.src: Ah, god bless. And I presume Betty did all the work while you just lounged around.
Stable Story#015.dst: 啊，谢天谢地。我猜活都是 Betty 干的，你就在旁边闲着吧。
Stable Story#015.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#016.src: Hm. Cows, huh? Ah who knows!? Life is full of mysterious, huh?
Stable Story#016.dst: 嗯。牛，是吧？啊，谁知道呢！？人生充满了神秘，是吧？
Stable Story#016.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#017.src: Either way. As the great bovine above is my witness if I see the smallest bruise I will
Stable Story#017.dst: 不管怎样。伟大的天上神牛为我作证——要是让我看到一丁点瘀伤，我就——
Stable Story#017.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#018.src: Nevermind all that. A horse I promised, and a horse you shall have. Much thanks to you.
Stable Story#018.dst: 那些都不提了。答应你的马，你一定会拿到。非常感谢你。
Stable Story#018.speaker: Enkser

Star Thief#000.src: Look into the rumors of strange weather near the Imal Inn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Star Thief#000.dst: 调查 Imal 旅店 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 附近天气异常的传闻。

Star Thief#001.src: Find the meteor's crash site at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Star Thief#002.src: Hey you! Human. What are you doing here?
Star Thief#002.dst: 嘿，你！人类。你在这里干什么？
Star Thief#002.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#003.src: Under Villager law any extra terrestrial or extra voidal entities are prohibited and owned by the state.
Star Thief#003.dst: 根据村民法律，任何地外或虚空外的物体都是违禁品，归国家所有。
Star Thief#003.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#004.src: Seeing as you are new to the land, I can't see you being prosecuted, especially a {p} Guard.
Star Thief#004.dst: 考虑到你是初来乍到，我想你不会被起诉，更何况你还是 {p} 的守卫。
Star Thief#004.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#005.src: This meteor is different to what we've seen before. We suspect that direct contact with the meteor is dangerous.
Star Thief#005.dst: 这颗陨石跟我们以前见过的都不一样。我们怀疑直接接触陨石很危险。
Star Thief#005.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#006.src: The magical radiation doesn't seem to be affecting you at all though. Do you not feel anything? Perhaps you could help me locate it.
Star Thief#006.dst: 不过魔法辐射好像对你完全没有影响。你一点感觉都没有吗？也许你能帮我找到它。
Star Thief#006.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#007.src: Explore the cave that the meteor crashed into.

Star Thief#010.src: Follow the trail leading off to the east from the cave.
Star Thief#010.dst: 沿着从洞窟往东延伸的痕迹走。

Star Thief#011.src: Explore the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and defeat the insane thief.
Star Thief#011.dst: 探索 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的洞窟，击败发疯的小偷。

Star Thief#012.src: .̸.̴.̵.̴ I can't control myself...f̸j̷f̴j̵f̵j̴ This rock...
Star Thief#012.dst: .̸.̴.̵.̴ 我控制不住自己……f̸j̷f̴j̵f̵j̴ 这块石头……
Star Thief#012.speaker: Thief

Star Thief#013.src: What is... this feeling… No I won't listen..
Star Thief#013.dst: 这是……什么感觉…… 不，我不会听的..
Star Thief#013.speaker: Thief

Star Thief#014.src: I can't... control... my mind... e̴n̴d̴ ̷m̶e̷.̷
Star Thief#014.dst: 我控制不了……我的……脑子…… 了̴结̴ ̷我̷.̷
Star Thief#014.speaker: Thief

Star Thief#015.src: Bring back the piece of meteor to the secret agent at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Star Thief#015.dst: 把陨石碎片带回给 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的秘密特工。

Star Thief#016.src: Hello again. Did you find the meteor down there? Why on earth are you holding some?!
Star Thief#016.dst: 又见面了。你在下面找到陨石了吗？你手里怎么会拿着一块？！
Star Thief#016.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#017.src: I see. This material is incredibly rare and magically powerful. Meteors fall all over Gavel and come in a variety of colours and potency.
Star Thief#017.dst: 我明白了。这种材料极其稀有，魔法力量也很强。陨石会落在 Gavel 各地，颜色和威力各不相同。
Star Thief#017.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#018.src: We don't fully understand them, but we know they are dangerous. Every scientist who has studied them has lost their minds.
Star Thief#018.dst: 我们对它们了解得并不透彻，但我们知道它们很危险。研究过它们的科学家全都疯了。
Star Thief#018.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#019.src: The meteors hold many secrets and powers, maybe the ones we need to end your war. Thank you, here's a small reward for helping us.
Star Thief#019.dst: 陨石藏着许多秘密和力量，也许正是结束你们那场战争所需要的。谢谢你，这是帮忙的一点小小报酬。
Star Thief#019.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#020.src: Hello again. Did you find the meteor down there? No? Maybe go back and try to find it?
Star Thief#020.dst: 又见面了。你在下面找到陨石了吗？没有？也许回去再找找？
Star Thief#020.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#021.src: Remember... Just follow the white trail leading to the cave!
Star Thief#021.dst: 记住……沿着通往洞窟的白色痕迹走就行！
Star Thief#021.speaker: Agent

Supply and Delivery#001.src: Oh, man... What am I going to do now...
Supply and Delivery#001.dst: 噢，天哪……我现在该怎么办……
Supply and Delivery#001.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#002.src: O-oh! H-hello soldier! Wow, what a coincidence that we're both here... in {p}... today...
Supply and Delivery#002.dst: 噢、噢！你、你好，士兵！哇，真巧，我们今天……都在……{p}……
Supply and Delivery#002.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#003.src: What? Don't look at me like that! We had a perfectly fair interaction which we both benefitted from. I got the plant, and you... well. You gained experience?
Supply and Delivery#003.dst: 什么？别那样看我！我们那是一次完全公平、双方都有好处的交流。我拿到了植物，而你……嗯。你获得了经验？
Supply and Delivery#003.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#004.src: Look, alright, I get it! But I can't pay you back either way. The mayor sent me here to pick up a crate of supplies for the village.
Supply and Delivery#004.dst: 好啦，好啦，我懂了！但反正我也还不了你钱。镇长派我来这里给村子领一箱补给。
Supply and Delivery#004.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#005.src: The issue is... I've already run out of money on- uh, unrelated purchases. And even if I had the money, I couldn't buy the supply crate anyway...
Supply and Delivery#005.dst: 问题是……我的钱已经花在——呃，一些不相干的东西上了。而且就算我有钱，我也买不了那箱补给……
Supply and Delivery#005.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#006.src: Those two over there who run the market banned me from ever using it after I tried to buy out the world's supplies of magical powders.
Supply and Delivery#006.dst: 那边管市场的那两个人，在我试图买光全世界的魔法粉末之后，就永久禁止我使用市场了。
Supply and Delivery#006.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#007.src: Look, it's not my fault I'm making big market moves. I'm just, you know- smarter than all these other folks!
Supply and Delivery#007.dst: 听着，我在市场上大展拳脚又不是我的错。我只是，你知道的——比其他人都聪明而已！
Supply and Delivery#007.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#008.src: ... The point is. I could really use your help right now! I- I promise, I'll pay you back for it this time.
Supply and Delivery#008.dst: ……重点是。我现在真的很需要你帮忙！我——我保证，这次我一定会还你。
Supply and Delivery#008.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#009.src: All you need to do is go over to the Trade Market, and buy the supply crate for me. Please?
Supply and Delivery#009.dst: 你只要去交易市场，帮我买那箱补给就行。拜托？
Supply and Delivery#009.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#010.src: Oh, man... What am I going to do now...
Supply and Delivery#010.dst: 噢，天哪……我现在该怎么办……
Supply and Delivery#010.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#011.src: O-oh! H-hello soldier! Wow, what a coincidence that we're both here... in {p}... today...
Supply and Delivery#011.dst: 噢、噢！你、你好，士兵！哇，真巧，我们今天……都在……{p}……
Supply and Delivery#011.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#012.src: What? Don't look at me like that! We had a perfectly fair interaction which we both benefitted from. I got the plant, and you... well. You gained experience?
Supply and Delivery#012.dst: 什么？别那样看我！我们那是一次完全公平、双方都有好处的交流。我拿到了植物，而你……嗯。你获得了经验？
Supply and Delivery#012.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#013.src: Look, alright, I get it! But I can't pay you back either way. The mayor sent me here to pick up a crate of supplies for the village.
Supply and Delivery#013.dst: 好啦，好啦，我懂了！但反正我也还不了你钱。镇长派我来这里给村子领一箱补给。
Supply and Delivery#013.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#014.src: The issue is... I've already run out of money on- uh, unrelated purchases. And even if I had the money, I couldn't buy the supply crate anyway...
Supply and Delivery#014.dst: 问题是……我的钱已经花在——呃，一些不相干的东西上了。而且就算我有钱，我也买不了那箱补给……
Supply and Delivery#014.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#015.src: Those two over there who run the market banned me from ever using it after I tried to buy out the world's supplies of magical powders.
Supply and Delivery#015.dst: 那边管市场的那两个人，在我试图买光全世界的魔法粉末之后，就永久禁止我使用市场了。
Supply and Delivery#015.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#016.src: Look, it's not my fault I'm making big market moves. I'm just, you know- smarter than all these other folks!
Supply and Delivery#016.dst: 听着，我在市场上大展拳脚又不是我的错。我只是，你知道的——比其他人都聪明而已！
Supply and Delivery#016.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#017.src: ... What? They also banned you from the market?! Well, great. What are we supposed to do now?
Supply and Delivery#017.dst: ……什么？他们也禁止你使用市场？！好极了。那我们现在该怎么办？
Supply and Delivery#017.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#018.src: Well, do you have any other friends we could get involved? There was... that other soldier guy, right? His name was... Tim. Or something.
Supply and Delivery#018.dst: 嗯，你还有别的朋友能拉进来帮忙吗？好像有……另一个士兵，对吧？他叫……Tim。还是什么的。
Supply and Delivery#018.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#019.src: Look- alright, I get it, I'm a jerk who doesn't remember peoples' names! Could you just ask him to buy the supplies for us?? He's our last hope... probably.
Supply and Delivery#019.dst: 好啦——好啦，我懂了，我就是个记不住别人名字的混蛋！你就不能请他帮我们买补给吗？？他是我们最后的希望了……大概吧。
Supply and Delivery#019.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#020.src: Purchase the supply crate from the Trade Market at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Supply and Delivery#020.dst: 在 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的交易市场购买补给箱。

Supply and Delivery#021.src: Hey, good work! Now you'll need to pick up the supply crate.
Supply and Delivery#021.dst: 嘿，干得好！现在你得去领取补给箱。
Supply and Delivery#021.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#022.src: Find Tasim at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and convince him to buy the supply crate for you.
Supply and Delivery#022.dst: 找到 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Tasim，说服他帮你买补给箱。

Supply and Delivery#023.src: Oh, hey {u}! Are you just here to hang out? Or- that look on your face tells me you're here for something else.
Supply and Delivery#023.dst: 噢，嘿 {u}！你只是来这里闲晃的吗？还是——看你的表情，是有别的事吧。
Supply and Delivery#023.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#076.src: [{~}] Can you buy something from the Trade Market for me?
Supply and Delivery#076.dst: [{~}] 你能帮我在交易市场买样东西吗？

Supply and Delivery#024.src: I... guess so? Is there a reason you can't do it yourself?
Supply and Delivery#024.dst: 我……应该可以吧？你有什么原因不能自己买吗？
Supply and Delivery#024.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#025.src: ...You're banned from the market? How did you even manage that? We haven't even been in {p} for that long!
Supply and Delivery#025.dst: ……你被禁止使用市场了？你到底是怎么做到的？我们来 {p} 也没多久啊！
Supply and Delivery#025.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#026.src: You- what!? Nevermind, I don't actually want to know. Come on, lead the way. I'll buy... whatever it is you need.
Supply and Delivery#026.dst: 你——什么！？算了，我其实不想知道。来吧，带路。我帮你买……不管你要的是什么。
Supply and Delivery#026.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#027.src: ...Oh. Well, that explains that. Though- is there a reason you can't get it yourself?
Supply and Delivery#027.dst: ……噢。好吧，这就说得通了。不过——你有什么原因不能自己去买吗？
