The Canary Calls#145.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#146.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#146.dst: 太棒了。你是人类的巅峰。
The Canary Calls#146.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#148.src: Kill me now or I'll destroy {p}.
The Canary Calls#148.dst: 现在杀了我，不然我就毁掉 {p}。
The Canary Calls#148.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#149.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#149.dst: 太棒了。你是人类的巅峰。
The Canary Calls#149.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#151.src: Kill me now or I'll destroy Gavel.
The Canary Calls#151.dst: 现在杀了我，不然我就毁掉 Gavel。
The Canary Calls#151.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#152.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#152.dst: 太棒了。你是人类的巅峰。
The Canary Calls#152.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#154.src: Kill me now or I'll ruin every single province.
The Canary Calls#154.dst: 现在杀了我，不然我就毁掉每一个行省。
The Canary Calls#154.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#155.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#155.dst: 太棒了。你是人类的巅峰。
The Canary Calls#155.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#157.src: Kill me now or I'll destroy the world.
The Canary Calls#157.dst: 现在杀了我，不然我就毁灭世界。
The Canary Calls#157.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#158.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#158.dst: 太棒了。你是人类的巅峰。
The Canary Calls#158.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#160.src: Okay so you don't care about the world. In that case, kill me now or I'll kill your friends.
The Canary Calls#160.dst: 好吧，所以你不在乎这个世界。既然如此，现在杀了我，不然我就杀了你的朋友。
The Canary Calls#160.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#161.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#161.dst: 太棒了。你是人类的巅峰。
The Canary Calls#161.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#163.src: Kill me now or I'll kill everyone in {Your Guild}.
The Canary Calls#163.dst: 现在就杀了我，不然我就把 {Your Guild} 里的人全杀光。
The Canary Calls#163.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#164.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#164.dst: 太棒了。你是人类的巅峰。
The Canary Calls#164.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#166.src: Kill me now or I'll do LITERALLY ANYTHING!
The Canary Calls#166.dst: 现在杀了我，不然我什么事都干得出来！
The Canary Calls#166.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#167.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#167.dst: 太棒了。你是人类的巅峰。
The Canary Calls#167.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#169.src: No no. No no no no no. No. It's too late.
The Canary Calls#169.dst: 不不。不不不不不。不。太迟了。
The Canary Calls#169.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#170.src: I just wanted to play again. Oh well.
The Canary Calls#170.dst: 我只是想再玩一次。算了。
The Canary Calls#170.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#171.src: At least I'll be in your memories. Forever. And ever.
The Canary Calls#171.dst: 至少我会留在你的记忆里。永远。永永远远。
The Canary Calls#171.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#174.src: Keep performing CPR, they're almost awake!
The Canary Calls#174.dst: 继续做心肺复苏，他们快醒了！
The Canary Calls#174.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#175.src: No way! I actually did it! I saved their life!
The Canary Calls#175.dst: 不会吧！我真的做到了！我救了他们一命！
The Canary Calls#175.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#176.src: We better get a raise for this!
The Canary Calls#176.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#177.src: What the?! Who the hell let you in my house?
The Canary Calls#177.dst: 搞什么？！谁他妈让你们进我家的？
The Canary Calls#177.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#179.src: No, you can't. Get outta here before I start lowering your salary.
The Canary Calls#179.dst: 不，你不能。趁我还没开始扣你工钱，快滚出去。
The Canary Calls#179.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#182.src: Well then, lad! Despite their incompetence, they still managed to save your skin.
The Canary Calls#182.dst: 好了，年轻人！虽然他们很无能，还是救了你一命。
The Canary Calls#182.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#183.src: Come speak to me for a quick debriefing.
The Canary Calls#183.dst: 过来跟我简单汇报一下。
The Canary Calls#183.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#185.src: I sent my miners down to save you as soon as we felt that earthquake. It was so strong that I genuinely thought the world was ending.
The Canary Calls#185.dst: 我们一感觉到那场地震，我就派矿工下去救你。震得那么厉害，我真心以为世界末日到了。
The Canary Calls#185.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#186.src: I'm jolly sorry for forcing you to take on this job. This whole situation was completely unexpected.
The Canary Calls#186.dst: 硬逼你接下这份活，我真的非常抱歉。整件事完全出乎意料。
The Canary Calls#186.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#187.src: Typically, gases are cleared up almost instantly. This time, however, it seemed to have been a lot more potent... But how?
The Canary Calls#187.dst: 一般来说，毒气几乎马上就会散掉。可这一次，它似乎强烈得多……但为什么？
The Canary Calls#187.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#188.src: ...{p}. It stirs once more. That thing... It has already caused too much hardship for this area to handle.
The Canary Calls#188.dst: ……{p}。它又开始躁动了。那东西……已经给这一带带来太多苦难了。
The Canary Calls#188.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#189.src: It must be destroyed, once and for all. How will that happen, I do not know. But you...
The Canary Calls#189.dst: 必须一劳永逸地摧毁它。要怎么做到，我不知道。但是你……
The Canary Calls#189.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#190.src: ...No, it's nothing. Until that thing is dealt with, deeper parts of this mine must be closed down. The supply of coal will decrease, but it must be done.
The Canary Calls#190.dst: ……不，没什么。在那东西被解决之前，矿坑的深处必须封闭。煤的供应会减少，但必须这么做。
The Canary Calls#190.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#191.src: Tell you what, lad! I'll give you, and only you, permission to access parts of the mine, right where we mine our world-famous {p} coal.
The Canary Calls#191.dst: 这样吧，年轻人！我给你，也只给你，进入矿坑某些区域的许可，就是我们开采举世闻名的 {p} 煤的地方。
The Canary Calls#191.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#192.src: Consider yourself a part-time {p} coal miner. You've earned it, lad.
The Canary Calls#192.dst: 就当你是 {p} 的兼职煤矿工吧。这是你应得的，年轻人。
The Canary Calls#192.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#195.src: Is this the height of your skill?
The Canary Calls#195.dst: 这就是你的最高水准吗？
The Canary Calls#195.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#197.src: Are you even playing the game?
The Canary Calls#197.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#198.src: Go ahead. Run right into it.
The Canary Calls#198.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#199.src: Was that you, or will you blame that on lag?
The Canary Calls#199.dst: 那是你自己的问题，还是你要怪到网络延迟上？
The Canary Calls#199.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#201.src: Even a snail could dodge that.
The Canary Calls#201.dst: 连蜗牛都躲得开那一下。
The Canary Calls#201.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#203.src: Nice going bozo, you fell off.
The Canary Calls#203.dst: 干得好啊笨蛋，你掉下去了。
The Canary Calls#203.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#204.dst: 有意思的战术！再来一次。
The Canary Calls#204.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#205.src: Nice try, but that won't work.
The Canary Calls#205.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#206.src: Hey up! Aren't you that Wynn soldier we've heard about? You look proper tough, is all.
The Canary Calls#206.dst: 嘿！你不就是我们听说的那个 Wynn 士兵吗？你看起来真够强悍的。
The Canary Calls#206.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#207.src: No, this is definitely them! The name's {u}, right?
The Canary Calls#207.dst: 不，绝对就是他们！名字叫 {u}，对吧？
The Canary Calls#207.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#208.src: Woah, this kid's a soldier? I wish I had that kind of job... I'd imagine it's much better than this crap.
The Canary Calls#208.dst: 哇，这小子是士兵？真希望我也有那种工作……我猜比这破活好多了。
The Canary Calls#208.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#209.src: Yeah, I really hate this job, man. That and the chief makes me pull my hair out... In fact, I already went bald because of it!
The Canary Calls#209.dst: 是啊，我真的很讨厌这份工作，老兄。再加上工头让我烦到想拔头发……事实上，我已经因为他秃了！
The Canary Calls#209.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#210.src: Dude, the chief scares the crap out of me. I'm surprised that I still have this job. Looks like we might lose it if the mines ain't restored fast enough.
The Canary Calls#210.dst: 兄弟，工头吓死我了。我居然还没丢掉这份工作，真意外。看来如果矿坑没有尽快恢复，我们可能就要丢饭碗了。
The Canary Calls#210.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#211.src: I-I don't want to lose this job, man! I've got a wife and two goldfish!
The Canary Calls#211.dst: 我、我不想丢掉这份工作，老兄！我有老婆，还有两条金鱼！
The Canary Calls#211.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#212.src: Easy, Ryan. We won't lose it. We're in this together. will take care of it.
The Canary Calls#212.dst: 别急，Ryan。我们不会丢掉的。我们同舟共济。 会处理好的。
The Canary Calls#212.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#213.src: Our very lives are in your hands, soldier. Good luck, and be careful. The mines are quite treacherous even for people like you.
The Canary Calls#213.dst: 我们的身家性命就交到你手上了，士兵。祝你好运，千万小心。就算是你这样的人，矿坑也相当险恶。
The Canary Calls#213.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#214.src: We still can't believe we found you. I'm proper shocked.
The Canary Calls#214.dst: 我们到现在还不敢相信找到了你。我真的吓坏了。
The Canary Calls#214.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#215.src: We had to use that blasted archaic minecart system because the elevator was still busted.
The Canary Calls#215.dst: 因为升降梯还是坏的，我们只好用那套该死的老矿车系统。
The Canary Calls#215.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#216.src: Everyone was exhausted from it. But just when all hope was seemingly lost, we found you laying on the ground.
The Canary Calls#216.dst: 大家都累坏了。可就在似乎一切希望都破灭的时候，我们发现你倒在地上。
The Canary Calls#216.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#217.src: You were violently twitching about, as if you were possessed by something. It was scary.
The Canary Calls#217.dst: 你在剧烈地抽搐，好像被什么东西附身了一样。太吓人了。
The Canary Calls#217.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#218.src: Whatever the effects of that gas are, we want absolutely none of it. I'm never stepping foot inside of that bloody mine ever again.
The Canary Calls#218.dst: 不管那毒气有什么效果，我们一点都不想沾上。我再也不会踏进那该死的矿坑一步了。
The Canary Calls#218.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#219.src: For the sake of our jobs and {p}, the Colossus must be stopped.
The Canary Calls#219.dst: 为了我们的饭碗，也为了 {p}，巨像必须被阻止。
The Canary Calls#219.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canyon Guides#001.src: Welcome to the Bantisu Temple, wandering human. We aid travelers such as yourself in navigating the capricious canyon walls.
The Canyon Guides#001.dst: 欢迎来到 Bantisu 神殿，流浪的人类。我们帮助像你这样的旅人穿越变幻莫测的峡谷岩壁。
The Canyon Guides#001.speaker: Gana

The Canyon Guides#002.src: We commune with the wind, and she gives us her sight. Wherever the breeze blows, we may see.
The Canyon Guides#002.dst: 我们与风交流，而她赐予我们她的视野。风吹到哪里，我们就看得到哪里。
The Canyon Guides#002.speaker: Gana

The Canyon Guides#003.src: You appear to be quite strong, and well-kept by your wits. Might we ask you to aid us, then?
The Canyon Guides#003.dst: 你看起来相当强壮，头脑也清醒。那么，我们能请你帮忙吗？
The Canyon Guides#003.speaker: Gana

The Canyon Guides#004.src: You see, a lost man is staking out in a camp on the nearby cliff faces. It pains us to see him, but we are unable to reach him.
The Canyon Guides#004.dst: 是这样的，有个迷路的人待在附近悬崖上的一个营地里。看到他我们很难过，但我们没法到他那里。
The Canyon Guides#004.speaker: Gana

The Canyon Guides#005.src: The canyon creatures there are ruthless, and we are not suited to physical combat. We would be able to reach him, but we would be stranded ourselves.
The Canyon Guides#005.dst: 那里的峡谷生物很凶残，而我们不擅长近身战斗。我们能到他身边，但我们自己也会被困住。
The Canyon Guides#005.speaker: Gana

The Canyon Guides#006.src: We ask you to guide Seluc to us. We shall send you to him, and you will bring him here. If you wish to help, you will be rewarded for your time.
The Canyon Guides#006.dst: 我们请你把 Seluc 带到我们这里来。我们会把你送到他身边，你把他带回来。如果你愿意帮忙，你付出的时间会得到回报。
The Canyon Guides#006.speaker: Gana

The Canyon Guides#007.src: Find Seluc in his camp at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Canyon Guides#007.dst: 在 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的营地找到 Seluc。

The Canyon Guides#008.src: Who's that? Am I finally being rescued!?
The Canyon Guides#008.dst: 是谁？我终于要得救了吗！？
The Canyon Guides#008.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#009.src: Wait, a human! Ugh, I shouldn't have gotten my hopes up. What did you do, take a day off cliff diving?
The Canyon Guides#009.dst: 等等，是个人类！呃，我不该抱什么希望的。你干了什么，今天休假不跳崖了？
The Canyon Guides#009.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#010.src: If you really did intend to rescue me, you've assuredly wasted both our time.
The Canyon Guides#010.dst: 如果你真的是来救我的，那你肯定是在浪费我们俩的时间。
The Canyon Guides#010.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#011.src: If you really want to make yourself useful, get a Bantisu monk over here! You're good at that, right? Fetching things and people?
The Canyon Guides#011.dst: 如果你真想派上用场，就去找个 Bantisu 僧侣过来！你很擅长这个吧？跑腿找东西找人？
The Canyon Guides#011.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#013.src: You're trying to kill me, aren't you?! What, can't take hearing the truth? Now my coat is drenched, and! AND!
The Canyon Guides#013.dst: 你是想杀了我，对吧？！怎么，听不得实话？现在我的外套全湿了，而且！而且！
The Canyon Guides#013.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#014.src: These Jinko are going to pounce any second now!! I haven't got a weapon, were you expecting me to rush off and get into a rumble?!
The Canyon Guides#014.dst: 这些 Jinko 随时都会扑上来！！我没有武器，你还指望我冲上去跟它们打一架吗？！
The Canyon Guides#014.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#015.src: Kill them! Kill then now! And get me OUT OF HERE! You got me into this mess, now get me out!!
The Canyon Guides#015.dst: 杀了它们！马上杀了它们！然后把我弄出这里！是你害我落到这步田地的，现在把我弄出去！！
The Canyon Guides#015.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#016.dst: 护送 Seluc 回到 Gana 那里。

The Canyon Guides#017.src: Ugh, all that danger got me flustered. I'm sweating in this coat...and it's all soaked already. Let me just...
The Canyon Guides#017.dst: 呃，刚才那么危险，把我弄得心慌意乱。穿着这件外套我都出汗了……而且它已经湿透了。让我先……
The Canyon Guides#017.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#018.src: ...set that aside. Congratulations, human! I'm probably never getting that coat back, and it cost me a pretty sum. Thanks for nothing.
The Canyon Guides#018.dst: ……把它放一边。恭喜你，人类！那件外套我大概再也拿不回来了，它可花了我不少钱。谢谢你什么都没帮上。
The Canyon Guides#018.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#019.src: All this walking...I'm taking a break here. You forced me to jump off a cliff, I get to force you to slow down. It's only fair! Besides that...
The Canyon Guides#019.dst: 走了这么久……我要在这里休息一下。你逼我跳崖，我就逼你放慢脚步。这很公平！再说……
The Canyon Guides#019.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#020.src: I only even came here just to see the view. At least that can't be ruined. Still, some vacation this turned out to be...
The Canyon Guides#020.dst: 我来这里本来只是想看看风景。至少这个不会被毁掉。不过，这趟假期可真够呛的……
The Canyon Guides#020.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#021.src: Wait, what in the world- What's going on?!
The Canyon Guides#021.dst: 等等，这到底是——怎么回事？！
The Canyon Guides#021.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#023.src: NO ONE TELLS ME ANYTHING! The brochure didn't mention earthquakes, YOU didn't tell me either, but what was I expecting from a human anyways?!
The Canyon Guides#023.dst: 什么都没人告诉我！宣传册上没提到地震，你也没告诉我，不过我还能指望人类什么呢？！
The Canyon Guides#023.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#024.src: I'm not a carrot! You'd better get me out of h- ...wait, wait, those...
The Canyon Guides#024.dst: 我又不是胡萝卜！你最好把我弄出——……等等，等等，那些……
The Canyon Guides#024.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#025.src: H-Hobgoblins. Hobgoblins HOBGOBLINS THERE'S HOBGOBLINS!! KILL THEM! AAAAH! AAH! AAAAAAH!
The Canyon Guides#025.dst: 大、大地精。大地精，大地精，有大地精啊！！杀了它们！啊啊啊！啊啊！啊啊啊啊啊！
The Canyon Guides#025.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#026.src: Sweet baby bovine I just saw my life flash before my eyes. Ugh...now pull me up. I'm stuck. But easy on the goods, I'm NOT a carrot I'll remind you!
The Canyon Guides#026.dst: 我的小牛宝宝啊，我刚才看到走马灯了。呃……现在把我拉上来。我卡住了。不过轻点，我再提醒你一次，我不是胡萝卜！
The Canyon Guides#026.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#027.src: Great. I'm SO grateful to be covered in mud and hobgoblin blood, and to be lacking my coat, AND to be stuck with a human.
The Canyon Guides#027.dst: 太好了。浑身沾满泥巴和大地精的血，外套也没了，还跟个人类困在一起，我真是感激不尽。
The Canyon Guides#027.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#028.src: Just get me out of here already. See, if an actual Bantisu monk had come down I'd probably be at home already, sipping tea by the fire!
The Canyon Guides#028.dst: 赶快把我弄出去。你看，要是真的来了个 Bantisu 僧侣，我现在大概已经在家里，坐在火炉边喝茶了！
The Canyon Guides#028.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#029.src: I know you humans are reckless, but I'd have expected you to have SOME concern, since you supposedly wanted to rescue me.
The Canyon Guides#029.dst: 我知道你们人类很鲁莽，但我本以为你至少会有一点顾虑，毕竟你说是来救我的。
The Canyon Guides#029.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#030.src: Ugh, my feet are killing me. Maybe this hike wouldn't be so bad if SOMEONE hadn't knocked me into the lake and made me lose my shoes!
The Canyon Guides#030.dst: 呃，我的脚痛死了。要不是某人把我撞进湖里害我鞋子都丢了，这趟路也许还没那么糟！
The Canyon Guides#030.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#034.src: ...perfect. Just GREAT! The only available path to the temple, and now it's blocked off! Just my luck!!
The Canyon Guides#034.dst: ……好极了。简直太棒了！唯一一条通往神殿的路，现在被堵住了！我真是走运！！
The Canyon Guides#034.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#035.src: ...wait. You're reckless and willing to endanger your life, right? There's no way that I could possibly use them, but I see some ledges.
The Canyon Guides#035.dst: ……等等。你很鲁莽，也愿意拿命冒险，对吧？我是绝对不可能用得上，不过我看到了一些岩架。
The Canyon Guides#035.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#036.src: See, just to the side of the rockslide? There's some ledges to jump around on.
The Canyon Guides#036.dst: 你看，就在落石旁边？那里有些岩架可以跳过去。
The Canyon Guides#036.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#037.src: Find a way to get Seluc past the blockage.
The Canyon Guides#037.dst: 想办法带 Seluc 越过堵塞处。

The Canyon Guides#038.src: ...of course it's a ladder. I'm going to be feeling this climb for weeks...
The Canyon Guides#038.dst: ……当然是梯子了。这次爬完我得酸痛好几个星期……
The Canyon Guides#038.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#039.src: Huff...puff... Well...huff... Wait, there's...there's no way down to the other side! Huff...what a waste!!
The Canyon Guides#039.dst: 呼……呼……嗯……呼……等等，那边……那边根本没有路下去！呼……白爬了！！
The Canyon Guides#039.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#040.src: Can you do ANYTHING right?! There's no way I'm jumping down there, you maniac!
The Canyon Guides#040.dst: 你到底能不能做对一件事？！我绝对不会从那里跳下去，你这疯子！
The Canyon Guides#040.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#042.src: You...had better count yourself lucky I haven't broken any bones over this. Agh...but that doesn't mean I'm not aching all over!!
The Canyon Guides#042.dst: 你……最好庆幸我没因为这个摔断骨头。啊……但这不代表我没浑身痛！！
The Canyon Guides#042.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#043.src: When I said you were reckless, I was hoping that maybe you'd keep that side of yourself away from other people!!
The Canyon Guides#043.dst: 我说你鲁莽的时候，是希望你能把那一面留给自己，别用在别人身上！！
The Canyon Guides#043.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#044.dst: 护送 Seluc 回到 Gana 那里。

The Canyon Guides#045.src: At least we're nearly at the temple now. Come on Seluc, silver linings, silver linings. You're nearly away from this freak...
The Canyon Guides#045.dst: 至少我们快到神殿了。加油 Seluc，往好处想，往好处想。你快摆脱这个怪胎了……
The Canyon Guides#045.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#046.src: Okay, you know what? No. You've put me through QUITE a lot here, human, so you're going to do me a favor and I'm not going to move another step til it's done.
The Canyon Guides#046.dst: 好，你知道吗？不行。你让我吃了这么多苦头，人类，所以你得帮我个忙，不办好我一步都不走。
The Canyon Guides#046.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#047.src: I paid two weeks wages for that coat you soaked. I'm not leaving here without it, and I'm way too tired to walk back down.
The Canyon Guides#047.dst: 你弄湿的那件外套花了我两个星期的工钱。不拿回来我不走，而我累得根本走不回去。
The Canyon Guides#047.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#048.src: So you're going back down to the bottom of the ridge, and you're going to get me my coat. It's the least you could do.
The Canyon Guides#048.dst: 所以你给我回山脊底下，把我的外套拿来。这是你最起码该做的。
The Canyon Guides#048.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#049.src: And be quick about it! I feel like these quakes are going to make the whole mountain collapse. That looks like it opened up a hole straight to the bottom!
The Canyon Guides#049.dst: 而且动作快点！我感觉这些地震会让整座山都塌下来。看起来那里裂开了一个直通底部的洞！
The Canyon Guides#049.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#050.src: Retrieve the coat Seluc left behind at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Canyon Guides#050.dst: 取回 Seluc 留在 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的外套。

The Canyon Guides#051.dst: 与 Gana 和 Seluc 对话。

The Canyon Guides#052.src: Took you long enough, coat-fetcher! I'm practically frostbitten up here!
The Canyon Guides#052.dst: 磨蹭了这么久，拿外套的！我在上面都快冻伤了！
The Canyon Guides#052.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#053.src: You see, I was just speaking to Gana about your dirt-poor imitation of their job! You ought to be ashamed- I had to get up here all on my own!
The Canyon Guides#053.dst: 你看，我刚才还在跟 Gana 说你那拙劣到极点的模仿！你真该感到羞愧——我可是全靠自己爬上来的！
The Canyon Guides#053.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#054.src: ...hm. I will say, there are many lost around the canyon, Seluc- it may have been a long time before we were able to help you.
The Canyon Guides#054.dst: ……嗯。我得说，Seluc，峡谷里迷路的人很多——我们可能要过很久才能帮到你。
The Canyon Guides#054.speaker: Gana

The Canyon Guides#055.src: Anyway! Give me that coat. The monks here are going to provide me some hospitality then guide me out of these wretched canyon walls.
The Canyon Guides#055.dst: 总之！把外套给我。这里的僧侣会好好招待我，然后带我离开这些该死的峡谷岩壁。
The Canyon Guides#055.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#056.src: This is goodbye then, human, I won't be missing you. Shoo!
The Canyon Guides#056.dst: 那就再见了，人类，我不会想你的。走开走开！
The Canyon Guides#056.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#057.src: ...He did not really guide himself here. Did he.
The Canyon Guides#057.dst: ……他并不是自己走到这里的。对吧。
The Canyon Guides#057.speaker: Gana

The Canyon Guides#058.src: ...uh. ...dang it, why you gotta did that.
The Canyon Guides#058.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#059.src: Let this be a lesson to you, Seluc. You cannot lie to those who see with the wind. Now show your gratitude towards this kind human.
The Canyon Guides#059.dst: 让这件事给你个教训，Seluc。你骗不了能借风而视的人。现在向这位好心的人类表达你的感激吧。
The Canyon Guides#059.speaker: Gana

The Canyon Guides#060.src: That's right! See, Gana? After all that, at least the human isn't a liar.
The Canyon Guides#060.dst: 没错！你看，Gana？闹了这么一场，至少人类不是个骗子。
The Canyon Guides#060.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#061.src: ...Well, 'coat fetcher', getting this man his coat is still a fine deed. And for that, you shall be rewarded.
The Canyon Guides#061.dst: ……那么，“拿外套的”，帮这个人拿回外套仍是一件善举。为此，你将获得奖励。
The Canyon Guides#061.speaker: Gana

The Canyon Guides#062.src: As thanks, we will also grant you access to our Bantisu Air Boosters. Magical clouds of air found around the canyon. I hope they are of assistance to you.
The Canyon Guides#062.dst: 为了表示感谢，我们也允许你使用 Bantisu 气流助推器。那是峡谷各处的魔法气团。希望它们能帮上你。
The Canyon Guides#062.speaker: Gana

The Corrupted Village#000.src: Speak to Orikal outside the {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Corrupted Village#000.dst: 与 {p} 外 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Orikal 交谈。

The Corrupted Village#001.src: Go away! I know you're angry but there's nothing to gain her-
The Corrupted Village#001.dst: 走开！我知道你很生气，但在这里什么也得不——
The Corrupted Village#001.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#002.src: Oh, you seem calm. What are you doing here? Bit close to the portal for a soldier isn't it?
The Corrupted Village#002.dst: 噢，你看起来很冷静。你在这里干什么？对士兵来说，离传送门有点太近了吧？
The Corrupted Village#002.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#003.src: I see, you were sent to aid the public. Perfect.
The Corrupted Village#003.dst: 我明白了，你是被派来帮助民众的。太好了。
The Corrupted Village#003.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#004.src: I am Orikal, I'm trying to stop everyone here from killing each other.
The Corrupted Village#004.dst: 我是 Orikal，我正在想办法阻止这里的人自相残杀。
The Corrupted Village#004.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#005.src: Do you see all these spikes? I believe they are the thing spreading corruption.
The Corrupted Village#005.dst: 你看到这些尖刺了吗？我相信就是它们在散播腐化。
The Corrupted Village#005.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#006.src: Corruption does not affect humans like other beings. It’s much much slower, more like an infection of the mind to us.
The Corrupted Village#006.dst: 腐化对人类的影响跟对其他生物不一样。慢得多得多，对我们来说更像是一种心智上的感染。
The Corrupted Village#006.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#007.src: Could you inspect the peak of the spike in the village for me? It might give me valuable insight. Thanks!
The Corrupted Village#007.dst: 你能帮我去检查一下村子里那根尖刺的顶端吗？也许能给我很有价值的线索。谢谢！
The Corrupted Village#007.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#008.src: Examine the nearby corrupted spike to the northeast at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Corrupted Village#008.dst: 检查东北方 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 附近的腐化尖刺。

The Corrupted Village#009.src: Climb the spike to see if you can find anything useful about it's existance.
The Corrupted Village#009.dst: 爬上尖刺，看看能不能找到有关它存在的有用线索。

The Corrupted Village#010.src: Report back to Orikal about your observations.
The Corrupted Village#010.dst: 回去向 Orikal 报告你观察到的情况。

The Corrupted Village#011.src: That was quick... did you find anything?
The Corrupted Village#011.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#012.src: Really, nothing? You didn't even feel anything?
The Corrupted Village#012.dst: 真的，什么都没有？你连一点感觉都没有？
The Corrupted Village#012.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#013.src: How can it be just a spike? It must be spreading corruption somehow.
The Corrupted Village#013.dst: 怎么可能只是一根尖刺？它一定是用某种方式在散播腐化。
The Corrupted Village#013.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#014.src: Then perhaps my second theory was correct. I will have to send you underground.
The Corrupted Village#014.dst: 那么也许我的第二个推测是对的。我得把你送到地下去了。
The Corrupted Village#014.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#015.src: There are old cave systems around here from the mining days. I sent two men down to excavate the spike, can you go down and help?
The Corrupted Village#015.dst: 这一带有采矿时期留下的旧洞穴系统。我派了两个人下去挖那根尖刺，你能下去帮忙吗？
The Corrupted Village#015.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#016.src: The entrance is a little to the northeast. In fact, you should have passed it on your way to the spike.
The Corrupted Village#016.dst: 入口在东北边一点。其实你去尖刺的路上应该经过了。
The Corrupted Village#016.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#017.src: Find the excavators inside the nearby cave to the northeast at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Corrupted Village#017.dst: 在东北方 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 附近的洞窟里找到挖掘工。

The Corrupted Village#018.src: Find the excavators inside the cave.

The Corrupted Village#019.src: This is insane, why are we here?! We're looking for corruption you know that right?
The Corrupted Village#019.dst: 这太疯狂了，我们为什么在这里？！我们是在找腐化，你知道吧？
The Corrupted Village#019.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#020.src: Calm down. All we have to do is keep digging. Besides, he did say he'd pay us a lot, so stop being mad.
The Corrupted Village#020.dst: 冷静点。我们只要继续挖就行。再说，他说过会付我们很多钱，别生气了。
The Corrupted Village#020.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#021.src: Forget it, I don't care anymore, just prime the explosive and get clear of the blast!
The Corrupted Village#021.dst: 算了，我不管了，赶快把炸药装好，然后离爆炸远一点！
The Corrupted Village#021.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#022.src: Well, that did the trick. Let's take a look.
The Corrupted Village#022.dst: 好了，成功了。我们去看看。
The Corrupted Village#022.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#024.src: It almost looks like a giant spike... Woah. How deep does this thing go?
The Corrupted Village#024.dst: 看起来简直像一根巨大的尖刺……哇。这东西到底有多深？
The Corrupted Village#024.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#025.src: Well, you know what? We did our job, so honestly I don't care. Let's get out of he-
The Corrupted Village#025.dst: 好吧，你知道吗？我们的活干完了，老实说我不在乎了。我们离开这——
The Corrupted Village#025.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#026.src: Orikal? We’re done! Pay up! I want out. This place is getting to me.
The Corrupted Village#026.dst: Orikal？我们干完了！给钱！我要走了。这地方让我受不了。
The Corrupted Village#026.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#027.src: I came when I heard the explosion. I thought you'd hurt yourselves.
The Corrupted Village#027.dst: 我听到爆炸声就过来了。还以为你们受伤了。
The Corrupted Village#027.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#028.src: Well, I'll be darned. The spike goes this far down? And it looks like it goes even deeper than this!
The Corrupted Village#028.dst: 好吧，真没想到。尖刺竟然延伸到这么深？而且看起来还往更深处去了！
The Corrupted Village#028.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#029.src: Well, I don't know about you, but I say we blow it to shreds! That oughta get rid of this spike!
The Corrupted Village#029.dst: 好吧，我不知道你怎么想，但我说我们把它炸个粉碎！那样应该就能除掉这根尖刺了！
The Corrupted Village#029.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#030.src: For once, I agree. I'll do it, you guys just get clear.
The Corrupted Village#030.dst: 难得一次，我同意。我来炸，你们离远点。
The Corrupted Village#030.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#031.src: ...Wow, that did nothing. We're going to need something MUCH more powerful than TNT...
The Corrupted Village#031.dst: ……哇，一点用都没有。我们需要比 TNT 强得多得多的东西……
The Corrupted Village#031.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#032.src: Oh yeah? And just what would you have in mind?
The Corrupted Village#032.dst: 噢是吗？那你打算用什么？
The Corrupted Village#032.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#033.src: Well, it's sorta complicated. That's why I've decided to give our new friend here the job of acquiring this explosive.
The Corrupted Village#033.dst: 嗯，有点复杂。所以我决定让我们这位新朋友负责弄到这种炸药。
The Corrupted Village#033.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#034.src: Oh yeah, we were so busy with this spike, we forgot to address you! Sorry about that.
The Corrupted Village#034.dst: 噢对，我们忙着对付这根尖刺，都忘了跟你打招呼了！抱歉。
The Corrupted Village#034.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#035.src: Well if you don't need us anymore then we'll just be on our way... WITH our money! So hand it over please.
The Corrupted Village#035.dst: 好吧，既然你不需要我们了，那我们就走了……带着我们的钱！所以请把钱交出来。
The Corrupted Village#035.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#036.src: Alright, fine. Here's your pay. Thank you for your help.
The Corrupted Village#036.dst: 好吧，好吧。这是你们的工钱。谢谢你们的帮忙。
The Corrupted Village#036.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#037.src: Gah! That's hardly anything! I'm not even surprised. Let's just go.
The Corrupted Village#037.dst: 啊！这也太少了！我一点都不意外。我们走吧。
The Corrupted Village#037.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#038.src: Anyway, come meet me back at my tent, friend. We will discuss what to do then.
The Corrupted Village#038.dst: 总之，朋友，回我的帐篷找我吧。我们到时候再商量怎么办。
The Corrupted Village#038.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#039.src: Exit the cave and speak to Orikal in his tent about his plan for destroying the spike.
The Corrupted Village#039.dst: 离开洞窟，到 Orikal 的帐篷里跟他谈谈摧毁尖刺的计划。

The Corrupted Village#040.src: Okay. I happen to know a recipe for creating an extremely lethal magical explosive.
The Corrupted Village#040.dst: 好。我碰巧知道一个配方，能做出威力极强的魔法炸药。
The Corrupted Village#040.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#041.src: There are {~} main ingredients you will need to get me: [Stabilized Corrupted Ore], [Incendiary Fluid], and a [Switch Fuse] to activate it.
The Corrupted Village#041.dst: 你需要帮我弄到 {~} 种主要材料：[稳定腐化矿石]、[燃烧液]，还有用来引爆的 [开关引信]。
The Corrupted Village#041.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#042.src: There used to be a small mining camp a little east of this town. It's abandoned now, but you should still be able to find what you need there.
The Corrupted Village#042.dst: 这座镇子东边一点以前有个小型采矿营地。现在废弃了，不过你应该还能在那里找到需要的东西。
The Corrupted Village#042.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#043.src: It's not the big ol' abandoned mines, mind you. It's a smaller camp, in fact you should be able to see it from this village.
The Corrupted Village#043.dst: 不是那座废弃的大矿坑，注意。是个比较小的营地，其实从这个村子就看得到。
The Corrupted Village#043.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#044.src: Best of luck! Oh, and also, try not to die please. These ingredients do indeed promote environmental hazards.
The Corrupted Village#044.dst: 祝你好运！噢，还有，请尽量别死。这些材料确实会造成环境危害。
The Corrupted Village#044.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#045.src: Find [Stabilized Corrupted Ore], [Incendiary Fluid], and [Switch Fuse] for the TNT at the mining camp at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Corrupted Village#045.dst: 在 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的采矿营地找到做 TNT 用的 [稳定腐化矿石]、[燃烧液] 和 [开关引信]。

The Corrupted Village#047.src: You got 'em all! Excellent, this is exactly what we need.
The Corrupted Village#047.dst: 你全都拿到了！太好了，这正是我们需要的。
The Corrupted Village#047.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#048.src: Alright, stand back. I have actually never made this before, so let's hope I don't cause a disaster.
The Corrupted Village#048.dst: 好，退后。其实我从来没做过这个，希望我别闯下大祸。
The Corrupted Village#048.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#049.src: Phew, glad nothing tragic happened there. This should be it, now go take it back down to the spike and destroy it once and for all!
The Corrupted Village#049.dst: 呼，还好没发生什么惨事。应该就是这个了，现在把它拿回下面的尖刺那里，彻底摧毁它！
The Corrupted Village#049.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#050.src: Bring the explosive to the spike in the cave and use it to destroy the spike.
The Corrupted Village#050.dst: 把炸药带到洞窟里的尖刺那里，用它摧毁尖刺。

The Corrupted Village#051.src: Report to Orikal about your success.
The Corrupted Village#051.dst: 向 Orikal 报告你成功了。

The Corrupted Village#052.src: Oh, do you feel that? It's like a buzzing in my ears I never knew about has just vanished.
The Corrupted Village#052.dst: 噢，你感觉到了吗？就像我耳朵里一直有种我从没察觉的嗡嗡声，刚刚消失了。
The Corrupted Village#052.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#053.src: I think that worked you know. It seems the power of the spike comes from the root...
The Corrupted Village#053.dst: 我想这招真的奏效了。看来尖刺的力量来自它的根……
The Corrupted Village#053.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#054.src: But what is it connected to? That's for another day. The main thing is the village is safe.
The Corrupted Village#054.dst: 可是它连着什么呢？那是以后的事了。重要的是村子安全了。
The Corrupted Village#054.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#055.src: Here, take this for your help. I found this potato in one of the houses around here, and I sure as heck don't want it!
The Corrupted Village#055.dst: 来，这个给你，谢谢你的帮忙。我在附近一栋房子里找到这个马铃薯，我可一点都不想要！
The Corrupted Village#055.speaker: Orikal

The Cursed One#000.src: For all that the festival revolves around the crown, I've always appreciated its representation of our culture.
The Cursed One#000.dst: 虽然这个节日处处围绕着王室，但我一直很欣赏它所体现的我们的文化。

The Cursed One#001.src: Good job friend! You showed those mudkins!
The Cursed One#001.dst: 干得好，朋友！你给那些 Mudkin 点颜色瞧瞧了！

The Cursed One#002.src: As of late, I have felt a distinct lack of impact in our actions. Certainly- we've done good for the downtrodden and overlooked! But we have failed to make any real change.
The Cursed One#002.dst: 最近，我明显感到我们的行动缺乏影响力。当然——我们为受压迫、被忽视的人做了好事！但我们没能带来任何真正的改变。

The Cursed One#003.src: Yeah, curses, blessings - whatever. So, what, you think all of us could just... use "magic"? What would that even look like?
The Cursed One#003.dst: 是啊，诅咒、祝福——随便吧。所以呢，你觉得我们所有人都能……用“魔法”？那会是什么样子？

The Cursed One#004.src: However, the traditional "cursed one" mythos has the afflicted wielding such power without the use of any blessed artifacts.
The Cursed One#004.dst: 不过在传统的“受诅者”传说里，受诅的人无需借助任何受祝福的器物就能驾驭这种力量。

The Cursed One#005.src: As an example- I learned that I have an affinity for the fire element, but I didn't know what form that would take until I actually received my blessing.
The Cursed One#005.dst: 举个例子——我知道自己与火元素相合，但直到真正受到祝福，我才知道它会以什么形式呈现。

The Cursed One#006.src: Return to the resistance camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#007.src: {u}, it's good to see you. Have you been well?
The Cursed One#007.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#008.src: ...no one has recognized you in {p}, have they?
The Cursed One#008.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#009.src: Good, good. Be sure to tell me if it does happen, and we'll figure out what to do from there.
The Cursed One#009.dst: 很好，很好。要是真的发生了，一定要告诉我，我们再想办法。
The Cursed One#009.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#010.src: Anyway, since you're here, I'd like to follow up on our earlier discussion. About... magic.
The Cursed One#010.dst: 总之，既然你来了，我想接着聊聊我们之前的话题。关于……魔法。
The Cursed One#010.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#011.src: I would like for you to describe what you know of it, how you use it, and how most people in your province can wield it.
The Cursed One#011.dst: 我希望你说说你对它的了解、你是怎么使用它的，以及你们行省的大多数人是怎么驾驭它的。
The Cursed One#011.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#012.src: I've informed the Leaves about our plans, and those interested will join us. Though, I will not force anyone to attend if they do not wish to. Are you ready?
The Cursed One#012.dst: 我已经把计划告诉叶子们了，有兴趣的人会来参加。不过，不想来的人我不会勉强。你准备好了吗？
The Cursed One#012.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#014.src: Teach the Leaves in the Wind magic.

The Cursed One#015.src: Hello, everyone. Hm... has anyone seen Sui?
The Cursed One#015.dst: 大家好。嗯……有人看到 Sui 吗？
The Cursed One#015.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#016.src: She told me she did not feel particularly comfortable listening in on this discussion, so I did not push her further.
The Cursed One#016.dst: 她跟我说她不太想旁听这场讨论，所以我就没再勉强她。
The Cursed One#016.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#017.src: I see. I think it would be good for her to hear this, though. Could someone fetch her for me?
The Cursed One#017.dst: 我明白了。不过我觉得她听听这些会比较好。谁能帮我去找她来？
The Cursed One#017.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#018.src: I can go find her, ma'am.
The Cursed One#018.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#020.src: It... isn't something you need to worry about. Not yet, at least.
The Cursed One#020.dst: 那……不是你需要担心的事。至少现在还不是。
The Cursed One#020.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#021.src: Magic... or, rather, curses have a tendency to be associated with bad memories.
The Cursed One#021.dst: 魔法……或者说，诅咒，往往跟不好的回忆联系在一起。
The Cursed One#021.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#022.src: It's not my place to tell you why. Sui can share more if she wants to, later.
The Cursed One#022.dst: 原因不该由我来说。如果 Sui 愿意，之后她可以自己多说一些。
The Cursed One#022.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#024.src: I have my reasons for it. I believe it would be better for her to hear this now, rather than later.
The Cursed One#024.dst: 我有我的理由。我相信她现在听到这些，会比以后才听到要好。
The Cursed One#024.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#025.src: It's not my place to tell you why. Sui can share more if she wants to, later.
The Cursed One#025.dst: 原因不该由我来说。如果 Sui 愿意，之后她可以自己多说一些。
The Cursed One#025.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#026.src: Here we are! So, could we get started already? Some of us actually have responsibilities.
The Cursed One#026.dst: 我们来了！那么，可以开始了吗？我们有些人可是真的有事要做。
The Cursed One#026.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#027.src: Seeing as everyone is here, yes, Rex, we may. {u}, let us start with the basics.
The Cursed One#027.dst: 既然大家都到了，可以，Rex，我们开始吧。{u}，我们从基础讲起。
The Cursed One#027.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#028.src: Ah, yes, such as the cursed... the stories do tell of the original evil lurking within us. It would follow that it exists in all things.
The Cursed One#028.dst: 啊，是的，就像受诅者……故事里确实讲过潜伏在我们体内的原初之恶。照这样说，它存在于万物之中也说得通。
The Cursed One#028.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#029.src: Indeed. So {u}, how do you wield your magic?
The Cursed One#029.dst: 没错。那么 {u}，你是怎么驾驭你的魔法的？
The Cursed One#029.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#030.src: Similar to the blessed implements of the crown's commanders, yes? I remember hearing of this from the military recruiters.
The Cursed One#030.dst: 就像王室指挥官们受过祝福的器具那样，对吧？我记得听军队的征兵官提过这个。
The Cursed One#030.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#031.src: Don't those usually only have one specific blessing attached to them? I don't remember them being as... uh, flexible, I guess.
The Cursed One#031.dst: 那些东西通常不是只附带一种特定的祝福吗？我不记得它们有那么……呃，灵活，大概吧。
The Cursed One#031.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#032.src: You'd be correct, Rex, though the same principle applies. A blessed weapon is referred to as a "focus" by the crown. They allow the wielder to more easily access the blessing placed within.
The Cursed One#032.dst: 你说得对，Rex，不过原理是一样的。受过祝福的武器，王室称之为“法器”。它们能让持有者更容易调用其中蕴含的祝福。
The Cursed One#032.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#033.src: Ah, I do have experience with this. We call it mana. Once one receives a blessing, it takes time to learn how to draw from your own source of mana.
The Cursed One#033.dst: 啊，这个我确实有经验。我们称之为法力。一个人接受祝福之后，需要时间学习如何汲取自身的法力之源。
The Cursed One#033.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#034.src: This is where foci come into play they are crafted or forged from mana-dense materials, and so provide a more easily accessible source to power one's blessing.
The Cursed One#034.dst: 这就是法器派上用场的地方它们是用法力浓密的材料制作或锻造而成，因此能为施展祝福提供更容易调用的来源。
The Cursed One#034.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#035.src: And, so... what? You think any of us could just... do it? That's hard to believe.
The Cursed One#035.dst: 所以……怎样？你觉得我们任何人都能就这样……做到？那很难让人相信。
The Cursed One#035.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#036.src: Ha! If it were truly the case, would there not be many, many more cursed ones running around? I concur with Rex, it seems outlandish.
The Cursed One#036.dst: 哈！要是真是这样，岂不是会有多得多的受诅者到处跑？我同意 Rex，这听起来太离谱了。
The Cursed One#036.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#037.src: I d- d- don't know... {u} doesn't seem like they're l- ly- like they're lying. What- wh- what if it is true?
The Cursed One#037.dst: 我不、不、不知道……{u} 看起来不像在说、说、说谎。万——万一是真的呢？
The Cursed One#037.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#038.src: It would explain certain aspects of the crown's response to cursed ones...
The Cursed One#038.dst: 那就能解释王室对受诅者的某些反应了……
The Cursed One#038.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#039.src: But... if you didn't receive a blessing, doesn't it still make you cursed?
The Cursed One#039.dst: 可是……如果你没有接受祝福，那不还是会让你成为受诅者吗？
The Cursed One#039.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#040.src: Yes, precisely! My sister is correct. Any... "magic" not sourced from the crown is innately tainted, from my understanding.
The Cursed One#040.dst: 是的，正是如此！我妹妹说得对。据我所知，任何不是源自王室的……“魔法”，本质上都是被玷污的。
The Cursed One#040.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#041.src: Yeah, curses, blessings whatever. So, what, you think all of us could just... use "magic"? What would that even look like?
The Cursed One#041.dst: 对啦，诅咒、祝福随便啦。所以，怎样，你觉得我们所有人都能就这样……用“魔法”？那会是什么样子？
The Cursed One#041.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#042.src: Ha. Right, sure. "Belief." So if I think hard enough, I can just start calling down lightning strikes?
The Cursed One#042.dst: 哈。对啦，是啦。“信念”。所以只要我想得够用力，就能开始召唤闪电了？
The Cursed One#042.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#043.src: Ugh. This was a waste of time.
The Cursed One#043.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#044.src: Now, now, Rex. Don't be so hasty in writing it off entirely. You have seen with your own eyes what {u} can do!
The Cursed One#044.dst: 好了，好了，Rex。别这么急着全盘否定。你亲眼见过 {u} 能做到什么！
The Cursed One#044.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#045.src: Belief... I- I- I can do that.
The Cursed One#045.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#046.src: Oh, come on Zeph, really? You can't seriously
The Cursed One#046.dst: 噢，拜托 Zeph，真的假的？你不会真的
The Cursed One#046.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#047.src: We're getting off track. {u}, what else is there?
The Cursed One#047.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#048.src: So... s- so you don't even know what your m- ma- magic will look like?
The Cursed One#048.dst: 所以……所、所以你们连自己的魔、魔法会是什么样子都不知道？
The Cursed One#048.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#049.src: Correct. There are aptitude tests which the crown uses before giving out blessings, but those only provide an idea of the general typing.
The Cursed One#049.dst: 没错。王室在授予祝福之前会做资质测试，但那只能大致看出类型。
The Cursed One#049.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#050.src: As an example I learned that I have an affinity for the fire element, but I didn't know what form that would take until I actually received my blessing.
The Cursed One#050.dst: 举个例子我知道自己对火元素有亲和力，但在真正接受祝福之前，我并不知道它会以什么形式出现。
The Cursed One#050.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#051.src: Oh! S- s- so, what type of magic do you think I w- would- I would have?
The Cursed One#051.dst: 噢！那、那、那你觉得我会、会——我会有什么类型的魔法？
The Cursed One#051.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#052.src: Something with wind, probably. You have that sort of... feel to you. Hey we'll be the Leaves, and you can be the Wind!
The Cursed One#052.dst: 大概跟风有关吧。你就是有那种……感觉。嘿我们是叶子，你可以当那阵风！
The Cursed One#052.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#053.src: He- hey! That... oh, that would be c- c- cool, actually...
The Cursed One#053.dst: 喂——喂！那……噢，其实那样挺酷、酷、酷的……
The Cursed One#053.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#054.src: If I may interrupt thus far, you have spoken at length on casting through the use of a focus.
The Cursed One#054.dst: 容我打断一下，到目前为止，你们一直在详谈借助法器施法。
The Cursed One#054.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#055.src: However, the traditional "cursed one" mythos has afflicted wielding such power without the use of any blessed artifacts.
The Cursed One#055.dst: 然而，传统的“受诅者”传说，讲的是不借助任何受祝福的器物就能驾驭那种力量的人。
The Cursed One#055.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#056.src: Aha. Of course, then those must be the dangerous ones.
The Cursed One#056.dst: 啊哈。当然，那么那些人一定就是危险的那一类。
The Cursed One#056.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#058.src: Uncommon, but still common enough to maintain the reputation the cursed have... It would make sense.
The Cursed One#058.dst: 不常见，但也常见到足以维持受诅者的名声……说得通。
The Cursed One#058.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#059.src: Well, thank you for your time, {u}. I think we'll call it there. You're all dismissed.
The Cursed One#059.dst: 好，谢谢你抽出时间，{u}。我想今天就到这里。大家解散吧。
The Cursed One#059.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#060.src: ...So what, is- is that it? We talk about th- th- theory for a while, and th- a- and then do nothing?
The Cursed One#060.dst: ……所以怎样，就——就这样？我们谈了一阵子理、理、理论，然——然后什么都不做？
The Cursed One#060.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#061.src: Zeph, even if {u}'s information is true, it doesn't mean it's immediately applicable.
The Cursed One#061.dst: Zeph，就算 {u} 说的是真的，也不代表马上就能派上用场。
The Cursed One#061.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#062.src: If I could be certain that experimenting with cur... magic... would be safe, maybe there could be an opportunity here. As it stands... it's too risky.
The Cursed One#062.dst: 如果我能确定尝试诅……魔法……是安全的，也许这里会有机会。但就目前来看……风险太大了。
The Cursed One#062.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#063.src: R- ris- risky... maybe the reason we've been stuck is because we d- d- we don't take risks!
The Cursed One#063.dst: 风——风、风险……也许我们一直原地踏步，就是因为我们不、不、我们不敢冒险！
The Cursed One#063.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#064.src: The per- perfect opportunity to be a- a- able to hold our own against the c- cr- crown, a- and- and we're gonna do n- no- nothing? Are you h- hear- hearing yourself?
The Cursed One#064.dst: 这是能跟王、王、王室抗衡的完——完美机会，而——而——而我们什么都、都不做？你有听、听到自己在说什么吗？
The Cursed One#064.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#066.src: No, I- I'm gonna ta- take the chance. Even- e- even if no- nobody else will. Come- c- come on, {u}, let's go.
The Cursed One#066.dst: 不，我——我要试、试一试。就——就算没、没有别人愿意。来——来吧，{u}，我们走。
The Cursed One#066.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#068.src: Sigh. I suppose I should have expected something like this. Of all the children, he's the one with the most to prove...
The Cursed One#068.dst: 唉。我早该料到会这样。在所有孩子里，他是最想证明自己的那一个……
The Cursed One#068.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#069.src: You may as well go with him, {u}. Maybe you'll be able to prove my worries wrong.
The Cursed One#069.dst: 你还是跟他去吧，{u}。也许你能证明我是杞人忧天。
The Cursed One#069.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#070.src: Hum... I suppose the pieces fit together, yet...
The Cursed One#070.dst: 嗯……我想这些线索确实拼得起来，然而……
The Cursed One#070.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#072.src: I... I may have gotten a bit h- he- heated there...
The Cursed One#072.dst: 我……我刚才可能有点激、激动了……
The Cursed One#072.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#073.src: It's just... all so- s- so frustrating! So often, people are h- hur- hurt by the crown, and- and th- there's nothing we can do about it! If we had m- m- if we had m- magic, we'd be able to- to sta- stand up to them!
The Cursed One#073.dst: 只是……这一切真、真的太让人沮丧了！人们总是被王室伤、伤、伤害，而——而我们对此却无能为力！要是我们有魔、魔——要是我们有魔法，我们就能——就能对、对抗他们！
The Cursed One#073.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#074.src: But they don't... eugh. What- wh- whatever. We can just
The Cursed One#074.dst: 可是他们不……唉。算——算了。随便啦。我们可以
The Cursed One#074.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#077.src: Well, I can't just let you go off and do this on your own. Even if I think it's stupid and reckless.
The Cursed One#077.dst: 嗯，我总不能让你一个人跑去干这种事。就算我觉得这又蠢又鲁莽。
The Cursed One#077.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#078.src: So, what's the plan? You didn't just run off without one, right?
The Cursed One#078.dst: 那么，计划是什么？你总不会连个计划都没有就跑出来了吧？
The Cursed One#078.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#081.src: Hey! I know that I- I need a f- fo- focus, right? We just need to find some... s- some magical materials to ma- make it out of. Even if I- I- I don't know where to... look.
The Cursed One#081.dst: 喂！我知道我——我需要一个法、法、法器，对吧？我们只要找些……一、一些魔法材料来做就行。就算我——我——我不知道该去哪……找。
The Cursed One#081.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#082.src: Sigh. Okay. Well, luckily for you, I know a spot. Remember that cave to the west of the festival grounds? Soldiers were swarming the place a week or two ago. Blocked it off 'cause of... cursed activity, or something.
The Cursed One#082.dst: 唉。好吧。算你运气好，我知道一个地方。记得庆典场地西边那个洞穴吗？一两个星期前那里全是士兵。因为……受诅者活动还是什么的，把那里封起来了。
The Cursed One#082.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#083.src: And... y- you- you think there might be s- some- something there?
The Cursed One#083.dst: 然后……你——你觉得那里可能有什、什么东西？
The Cursed One#083.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#084.src: Yep! Why else would they prevent people from going there for so long? There's gotta be something.
The Cursed One#084.dst: 对啊！不然他们为什么要这么久都不让人进去？一定有什么东西。
The Cursed One#084.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#085.src: Okay. It's w- worth a shot... Thanks for the help, Rex.
The Cursed One#085.dst: 好。值、值得一试……谢谢你帮忙，Rex。
The Cursed One#085.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#086.src: Don't mention it. We'll just have to follow those blue flowers, they'll lead us right to the cave. I'll stand guard outside while you two search it.
The Cursed One#086.dst: 不客气。我们只要跟着那些蓝色的花走，它们会直接带我们到洞穴。你们两个进去找的时候，我在外面放哨。
The Cursed One#086.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#088.src: Head to the blocked off cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#089.src: ...Hm? What? I'm not here for you, just to be clear.
The Cursed One#089.dst: ……嗯？干嘛？先说清楚，我可不是为你来的。
The Cursed One#089.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#090.src: You should stop wasting time talking to me, and hurry up after Zeph already.
The Cursed One#090.dst: 你别再浪费时间跟我说话了，赶快去追 Zeph 吧。
The Cursed One#090.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#091.src: He's probably trying to compete with you to see who can get to the end fastest, and every second you spend here is not doing you any favors in beating him.
The Cursed One#091.dst: 他大概正想跟你比谁先到尽头，你在这里多待一秒，就多一分输给他的可能。
The Cursed One#091.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#092.src: Heh. Not that you'd win anyway!
The Cursed One#092.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#093.src: Hah! Too s- sl- slow! I guess I probably sh- should- should've warned you about the r- roly-bugs...
The Cursed One#093.dst: 哈！太、太、太慢了！我想我大概该、该——该先提醒你球、球球虫的事……
The Cursed One#093.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#094.src: If you're quiet en- enough, they usually don't bother you. I th- th- I think you even woke up the lea- leader of the colony!
The Cursed One#094.dst: 只要你够、够安静，它们通常不会来烦你。我觉、觉、我觉得你连虫群的首、首领都吵醒了！
The Cursed One#094.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#095.src: Anyway... I think Rex was right. Lo- look at these crystals! If- if a- any- anything's magical, it's got to be them!
The Cursed One#095.dst: 总之……我想 Rex 说对了。看——看这些水晶！如果——如果有什——什么东西是有魔法的，那一定就是它们！
The Cursed One#095.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#096.src: Let's grab some and g- get- get out of here. We don't want to get c- cau- caught in a res- restricted area.
The Cursed One#096.dst: 我们拿一些就赶快离——离开这里。我们可不想在禁区被、被、被抓到。
The Cursed One#096.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#097.src: I'll take one... M- may- maybe we should take some more? In ca- c- in case anyone else wants to- y- you know. Co- coming back here again later would be da- dangerous.
The Cursed One#097.dst: 我拿一块……也、也许我们该多拿一些？以、以防——以防别人也想要——你、你懂的。之后再回来这、这里会很危、危险。
The Cursed One#097.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#098.src: Grab a crystal before you leave.

The Cursed One#099.src: Took you long enough! So, who won the race?
The Cursed One#099.dst: 拖得可真久！那么，谁赢了比赛？
The Cursed One#099.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#100.src: You say that like you don't a- al- already know, Rex!
The Cursed One#100.dst: 你说得好像你不——不、不是早就知道了一样，Rex！
The Cursed One#100.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#101.src: Excuses, excuses. You should always have your guard up around Zeph. You never know when he'll strike with a surprise race.
The Cursed One#101.dst: 借口，借口。在 Zeph 身边你得时刻提防。你永远不知道他什么时候会突然发起比赛。
The Cursed One#101.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#105.src: Sure, Zeph. Well, what'd you find? I haven't seen anybody out here, so I think we're in the clear to go if we're done here.
The Cursed One#105.dst: 是啦，Zeph。那么，你们找到了什么？我没看到有人来，所以如果你们这边弄完了，我想我们可以安全离开了。
The Cursed One#105.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#106.src: We fou- found some crystals growing at the end of the cave. They f- fe- feel magical to me, so... they should w- wor- work. Let's get going back.
The Cursed One#106.dst: 我们在洞穴尽头找——找到了一些长出来的水晶。我感、感、感觉它们带着魔法，所以……应该有、有、有用。我们回去吧。
The Cursed One#106.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#107.src: Return to the resistance camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#108.src: Come on. Just because we're in the clear now doesn't mean we can dilly-dally. Let's go.
The Cursed One#108.dst: 快点。现在安全了，不代表我们可以磨磨蹭蹭。走吧。
The Cursed One#108.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#109.src: Let's get going back. I r- really hope these crystals w- wor- work.
The Cursed One#109.dst: 我们回去吧。真、真希望这些水晶有、有、有用。
The Cursed One#109.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#110.src: ...Ah! You return! I'd best inform miss Syndra of your arrival.
The Cursed One#110.dst: ……啊！你们回来了！我最好去通知 Syndra 小姐你们到了。
The Cursed One#110.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#111.src: You were wai- waiting for us? Why?
The Cursed One#111.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#112.src: Hrm... I suppose your words resonated with me, in the end. Having taken some time to mull it over while you were gone... I must admit, you make a solid point.
The Cursed One#112.dst: 嗯……我想，你的话最终还是打动了我。你们不在的时候，我花时间好好想了想……我必须承认，你说得很有道理。
The Cursed One#112.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#113.src: As of late, I have felt a distinct lack of impact in our actions. Certainly we've done good for the downtrodden and overlooked! But we have failed to make any real change.
The Cursed One#113.dst: 最近，我明显感觉到我们的行动缺乏影响力。我们当然为受压迫、被忽视的人做了好事！但我们没能带来任何真正的改变。
The Cursed One#113.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#114.src: Well, you're not the only one feeling that way, if it makes you feel any better. I think Syndra's the same.
The Cursed One#114.dst: 嗯，如果能让你好受点的话，有这种感觉的不只你一个。我觉得 Syndra 也是。
The Cursed One#114.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#115.src: Even more reason to try something new, then! This... magic, as you call it if indeed it is what you have described, though I still have my doubts
The Cursed One#115.dst: 那就更有理由尝试新东西了！这个……魔法，照你们的叫法如果它真如你所描述的那样，虽然我还是有些怀疑
The Cursed One#115.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#117.src: Yes, Rex, I appreciate the encouragement as I was saying, it could be just what we need to truly make a difference.
The Cursed One#117.dst: 是的，Rex，谢谢你的鼓励就像我刚才说的，它可能正是我们真正带来改变所需要的。
The Cursed One#117.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#118.src: ...I h- ho- hope so. Um... you were g- go- going to tell Syndra we were back?
The Cursed One#118.dst: ……我希、希、希望如此。呃……你不、不、不是要去告诉 Syndra 我们回来了吗？
The Cursed One#118.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#119.src: So I was! Allow me one moment, please.
The Cursed One#119.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#120.src: ...You're really sure you want to go through with this, Zeph?
The Cursed One#120.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#121.src: I- I am. I w- wa- I want to try it! Maybe then, I could...
The Cursed One#121.dst: 我——我确定。我想——想——我想试试看！也许那样，我就能……
The Cursed One#121.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#122.src: Okay! Okay. It's your choice. I just worry sometimes!
The Cursed One#122.dst: 好！好。那是你的选择。我只是有时候会担心嘛！
The Cursed One#122.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#123.src: I... I ne- need to get into the r- r- right mood for it, I thi- I- I think. I'm... kind of ner- nervous, actually.
The Cursed One#123.dst: 我……我觉得我需、需要先进入状、状、状态，我想——我——我觉得。其实我……有点紧、紧张。
The Cursed One#123.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#124.src: ...Hey, {u}, could you... do- d- do some magic. As a- a d- dem- demonstration!
The Cursed One#124.dst: ……嘿，{u}，你能不能……施、施——施点魔法。当作示——示——示范！
The Cursed One#124.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#126.src: N- no, she- she's just paranoid. It'll be f- f- fine! You were casting sp- spells in the cave a- and- and nothing bad happened!
The Cursed One#126.dst: 不——不，她——她只是太多疑了。不、不、不会有事的！你在洞穴里施过法、法术，而——而——而什么坏事都没发生！
The Cursed One#126.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#127.src: Sigh. If you insist, Zeph. Whatever you do had better be cool though, {u}.
The Cursed One#127.dst: 唉。既然你坚持的话，Zeph。不过不管你做什么，最好够酷，{u}。
The Cursed One#127.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#128.src: Hm, I don't quite like the sound of "probably".
The Cursed One#128.dst: 嗯，我不太喜欢“大概”这个词。
The Cursed One#128.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#129.src: Good- g- good enough for me! Come on, {u}, sh- show- show me a spell!
The Cursed One#129.dst: 对——对我来说够——够好了！来吧，{u}，给、给——给我看个法术！
The Cursed One#129.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#130.src: Showcase magic by casting spells in the resistance camp.
The Cursed One#130.dst: 在抵抗组织营地施展法术，示范魔法。

The Cursed One#131.src: Woah! That w- was cool! Can you d- do- do it again?
The Cursed One#131.dst: 哇！那好、好酷！你能再、再——再来一次吗？
The Cursed One#131.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#133.src: What's going on out here? I heard
The Cursed One#133.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#134.src: {u} is show- sh- showing me some magic!
The Cursed One#134.dst: {u} 在示、示——示范魔法给我看！
The Cursed One#134.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#135.src: ... I take it you found what you were looking for then?
The Cursed One#135.dst: ……看来你们找到要找的东西了？
The Cursed One#135.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#136.src: Yup. Cursed crystals from the roly-nest.
The Cursed One#136.dst: 对啊。球球虫巢里的受诅水晶。
The Cursed One#136.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#137.src: The... of all places, you went to the roly-nest?! Did you even consider the risk?!
The Cursed One#137.dst: 那……那么多地方，你们偏偏去了球球虫巢？！你们有没有想过风险？！
The Cursed One#137.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#138.src: What if you were caught? We are only able to operate here because we avoid drawing attention to ourselves. If you had been seen
The Cursed One#138.dst: 要是被抓到怎么办？我们之所以能在这里活动，就是因为我们不引人注意。要是你们被看到了
The Cursed One#138.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#139.src: But we weren't. I know the shift schedule of the guards, nobody was going to stop by while we were there.
The Cursed One#139.dst: 可是我们没被看到。我知道守卫的换班时间，我们在那里的时候不会有人过来。
The Cursed One#139.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#140.src: ...sigh. You children, you'll be the death of me. Fine. You found the crystals, and you weren't spotted good.
The Cursed One#140.dst: ……唉。你们这些孩子，迟早会要了我的命。好吧。你们找到了水晶，而且没被发现很好。
The Cursed One#140.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#141.src: Um... not to interrupt, or, anything, but... I missed the c magic. Could you... show us some more?
The Cursed One#141.dst: 呃……不是想打断，还是，什么的，可是……我错过了那个魔、魔法。你能……再给我们看一些吗？
The Cursed One#141.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#143.src: Indeed. Thank you for the demonstration, {u}. Now, we should
The Cursed One#143.dst: 确实。谢谢你的示范，{u}。现在，我们应该
The Cursed One#143.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#144.src: Oh! Syndra, do- d- do you think you could show us something t- t- too? You're b- bl- blessed, so maybe it'd be
The Cursed One#144.dst: 噢！Syndra，你——你能不能也给我们看点什么？你是受——受祝福的，所以也许会
The Cursed One#144.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#146.src: ... O- o- okay! If- if you s- say- say so...
The Cursed One#146.dst: ……好——好、好吧！既然你——你这么——这么说……
The Cursed One#146.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#147.src: If we're done with the demonstrations, we should discuss
The Cursed One#147.dst: 如果示范结束了，我们应该讨论一下
The Cursed One#147.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#148.src: But- b- but I want to tr- try now! I have a- a fo- focus, so I sh- should- I should be able to do... something.
The Cursed One#148.dst: 可——可是我现在就想试试！我有法——法器了，所以我应——应该——我应该能做到……点什么。
The Cursed One#148.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#149.src: Sigh. Yes, alright, Zeph. But let me guide you through it, would you?
The Cursed One#149.dst: 唉。好吧，Zeph。不过让我来引导你，好吗？
The Cursed One#149.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#150.dst: 观看 Zeph 尝试施展魔法。

The Cursed One#151.src: Take your position, Zeph. Everyone else, let's move out of the way.
The Cursed One#151.dst: 站好位置，Zeph。其他人，我们让开一点。
The Cursed One#151.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#152.src: Yes, indeed, it would not do well for us to be injured, unintentionally or otherwise. Come on, Sui!
The Cursed One#152.dst: 是的，确实，我们可不能受伤，不管是不是故意的。来吧，Sui！
The Cursed One#152.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#153.src: And we're sure this is safe?
The Cursed One#153.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#154.src: We have all seen {u} in action, and they appear to be unharmed, no?
The Cursed One#154.dst: 我们都见过 {u} 施法，他们看起来毫发无伤，不是吗？
The Cursed One#154.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#155.src: Okay, sure, but what if someone sees? It's not like we're especially hidden here.
The Cursed One#155.dst: 好吧，是没错，但要是有人看到怎么办？我们在这里又不是特别隐蔽。
The Cursed One#155.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#156.src: You know as well as I that the only ones showing up in these parts are outcasts and drunks!
The Cursed One#156.dst: 你跟我一样清楚，会跑到这一带来的只有流浪汉和醉鬼！
The Cursed One#156.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#157.src: In any case, we can make it quick. Zeph, are you ready?
The Cursed One#157.dst: 不管怎样，我们可以速战速决。Zeph，准备好了吗？
The Cursed One#157.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#159.src: Close your eyes, and hold the crystal close to your chest. Concentrate on the points of contact. Your hands, your chest. Do you feel anything?
The Cursed One#159.dst: 闭上眼睛，把水晶紧贴在胸前。专注在接触的地方。你的双手，你的胸口。有感觉到什么吗？
The Cursed One#159.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#160.src: ...oh! I- I do! It's l- l- like... st- static electricity, li- little sparks bouncing around...
The Cursed One#160.dst: ……噢！我——我有！就、就、就像……静、静电，小小的火花在跳来跳去……
The Cursed One#160.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#161.src: Good. Now, you'll try to draw your focus inwards. Imagine the sparks being pulled towards the center of your body. Feel them gathering together.
The Cursed One#161.dst: 很好。现在，试着把你的注意力往内收。想象那些火花被拉向你身体的中心。感受它们聚集在一起。
The Cursed One#161.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#163.src: Now, finally, try releasing that energy. Concentrate on the crystal again, the points of contact. Imagine pushing the sparks back into it, and then further, sending them out through the crystal
The Cursed One#163.dst: 现在，最后，试着释放那股能量。再次专注在水晶上，专注在接触的地方。想象把火花推回水晶里，再往前推，让它们穿过水晶送出去
The Cursed One#163.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#165.src: Hey! Are you okay? Not hurt? I don't see anything visible, but
The Cursed One#165.dst: 嘿！你还好吗？没受伤吧？我没看到什么明显的伤，但是
The Cursed One#165.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#166.src: W- would you s- st- stop, already? I'm fine!
The Cursed One#166.dst: 你能不能别、别、别再这样了？我没事！
The Cursed One#166.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#167.src: Ow! What- wh- what was that for?!
The Cursed One#167.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#169.src: Well done, Zeph. You've done just as well as any of the soldiers I've seen receive blessings. Just... as well...
The Cursed One#169.dst: 做得好，Zeph。你表现得跟我见过的任何一个接受祝福的士兵一样好。就……一样好……
The Cursed One#169.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#170.src: ...was it really that easy all this time?
The Cursed One#170.dst: ……难道一直以来真的就这么简单吗？
The Cursed One#170.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#172.src: Yes... yes, I'm alright. {u}, I apologize for doubting you. It would seem... you were right all along.
The Cursed One#172.dst: 是……是的，我没事。{u}，抱歉之前怀疑你。看来……你从一开始就是对的。
The Cursed One#172.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#173.dst: 或者 Zeph 本来就是受诅者……
The Cursed One#173.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#175.src: Sorry! Sorry. No, you're right. It was... cool, I guess. It's just... weird.
The Cursed One#175.dst: 抱歉！抱歉。不，你说得对。那……挺酷的，大概吧。只是……很奇怪。
The Cursed One#175.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#176.src: A- a little, I guess. But if f- f- felt right. Like- l- like I always co- could have done it. Even if it was just sp- spark- sparkles.
The Cursed One#176.dst: 有——有一点吧，我想。但感、感、感觉很对。就像——就、就像我一直都能、能做到。就算只是冒、冒、冒出点火花。
The Cursed One#176.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#177.src: That's part of the process. You'll need a proper focus to do more... specially-forged weapons have always done the trick, in my experience.
The Cursed One#177.dst: 那是过程的一部分。你需要一个像样的法器才能做得更多……照我的经验，特别锻造的武器一向管用。
The Cursed One#177.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#178.src: Specially-forged weapons, you say? Miss, is there anything in particular one would need to create one? With the right materials, I'm certain I could forge Zeph what he needs.
The Cursed One#178.dst: 特别锻造的武器，你说？小姐，做一件需要什么特别的东西吗？只要有合适的材料，我相信我能为 Zeph 锻造出他需要的东西。
The Cursed One#178.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#179.src: A- a new weapon? That I ca- can cast ma- magic with?
The Cursed One#179.dst: 一、一件新武器？一件我能用来施、施、施展魔法的武器？
The Cursed One#179.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#180.src: I could see it coming in use. We'll want more sturdy materials than usual- preferably something that is magical in and of itself... Zeph, do you think you could-
The Cursed One#180.dst: 我看得出它会派上用场。我们需要比平常更坚固的材料最好是本身就带着魔法的东西……Zeph，你觉得你能不能
The Cursed One#180.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#181.src: Yes!!! I- I mean, uh, y- yes, I can do that.
The Cursed One#181.dst: 能！！！我——我是说，呃，能——能，我可以。
The Cursed One#181.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#182.src: ...Okay! {u}, I kn- I- I know where to start! Me- meet me by the big tree to the n- nor- northeast! The one for the riddle!
The Cursed One#182.dst: ……好！{u}，我知——我——我知道从哪开始了！在东——东、东北边的大树旁跟我会合！就是谜语里那棵！
The Cursed One#182.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#183.src: Head to the big tree and find Zeph at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Cursed One#183.dst: 前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的大树找到 Zeph。

The Cursed One#184.src: I suppose I should get around to firing up the forge... Sui, will you need me for anything?
The Cursed One#184.dst: 我想我该去把熔炉生起火来了……Sui，你需要我帮什么吗？
The Cursed One#184.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#185.src: Um... n-no, I don't think so.
The Cursed One#185.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#186.src: He's taken to it remarkably well, hasn't he? Better than I could have hoped.
The Cursed One#186.dst: 他适应得非常好，对吧？比我所希望的还要好。
The Cursed One#186.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#187.src: {u}... you have opened a path for me that I never could have imagined. Thank you.
The Cursed One#187.dst: {u}……你为我开辟了一条我从未想象过的道路。谢谢你。
The Cursed One#187.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#192.src: Never in my life did I expect to have my whole world view challenged, hoh!
The Cursed One#192.dst: 我这辈子都没想过，自己的整个世界观会受到挑战，嚯！
The Cursed One#192.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#193.src: Admittedly, this information will take some time to progress...
The Cursed One#193.dst: 得承认，要消化这些信息需要一些时间……
The Cursed One#193.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#194.src: I'll most likely seek you out later with some follow up questions.
The Cursed One#194.dst: 我之后很可能会去找你，问几个后续问题。
The Cursed One#194.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#195.src: ...well, Synny, don't suppose any of this changes your usual approach?
The Cursed One#195.dst: ……嗯，Synny，我想这些事不会改变你平常的做法吧？
The Cursed One#195.speaker: Kaio

The Cursed One#196.src: Sigh... You know it does, Kaio. If there's a possibility more of our members could wield magic, then...
The Cursed One#196.dst: 唉……你知道会的，Kaio。如果我们有更多成员可能驾驭魔法，那么……
The Cursed One#196.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#198.src: ... I don't know. I don't know if it'll work, yet.
The Cursed One#198.dst: ……我不知道。我还不知道这行不行得通。
The Cursed One#198.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#201.src: Yes, well, I especially don't like this. Don't like the ideas you're gettin' all up there in your head. It's a risk.
The Cursed One#201.dst: 是啊，嗯，我特别不喜欢这个。不喜欢你脑袋里冒出来的那些念头。那有风险。
The Cursed One#201.speaker: Kaio

The Cursed One#202.src: Everything is a risk. But it doesn't matter yet. It'll depend on what Quill has to tell me during the festival.
The Cursed One#202.dst: 什么事都有风险。不过现在还不重要。要看 Quill 在庆典期间会跟我说什么。
The Cursed One#202.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#204.src: When I m- ma- when I make my weapon... do you think I'll be a- a- able to cast real spells? And not just... poofs of sp- s- sparkles?
The Cursed One#204.dst: 等我做、做——等我做出我的武器……你觉得我能——能——能施展真正的法术吗？而不只是……冒、冒、冒出点火花？
The Cursed One#204.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#207.src: Sigh... I was h- h- hoping that- that- that I could do... I- I don't know! Something! A- any- anything to help. But... you're right.
The Cursed One#207.dst: 唉……我原本希、希、希望我——我——我能做点……我——我也不知道！做点什么！任——任何能帮上忙的事。可是……你说得对。
The Cursed One#207.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#208.src: Oh. O- okay! That means it- it m- might help me, too. Thank you.
The Cursed One#208.dst: 噢。好——好！那代表它可——可能也能帮到我。谢谢你。
The Cursed One#208.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#209.src: Oh! R- ri- right! Well, Syndra said we sh- should find something magical, right? Well, I- I don't know for- f- for sure if it's magical or not, but...
The Cursed One#209.dst: 噢！对——对、对了！Syndra 说我们应、应该找个带魔法的东西，对吧？嗯，我——我不确定这——这算不算带魔法，但是……
The Cursed One#209.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#210.src: A long, long time ago, th- this- this tree was more than just a stump! It had long arms st- str- stretching out over the whole forest, watching over th- the people and w- wi- wildlife.
The Cursed One#210.dst: 很久很久以前，这——这——这棵树不只是个树桩！它有长长的手臂伸——伸、伸展到整片森林上空，守护着人——人们和野——野、野生动物。
The Cursed One#210.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#211.src: When anyone was hurt, o- or- or unwell, the tree would reach out with its br- branches and grow fruit- fruit that was said to he- h- heal all injuries and illnesses.
The Cursed One#211.dst: 每当有人受伤，或——或——或生病，这棵树就会伸出树——树枝，结出果实——据说能治——治愈一切伤病的果实。
The Cursed One#211.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#212.src: It took care of the people, and the p- people took care of the tree. But then- then the c- cur- curse took hold of the people.
The Cursed One#212.dst: 它照顾人们，人们也照顾这棵树。可是后来——后来诅、诅、诅咒控制了人们。
The Cursed One#212.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#213.src: In the chaos and d- des- destruction caused by the cursed ones, the tree was hurt. It stopped gr- grow- growing its gifts, and went to sleep... f- forever.
The Cursed One#213.dst: 在受诅者造成的混乱和破——破、破坏中，这棵树受了伤。它不再结——结、结出它的恩赐，然后睡着了……永、永远地。
The Cursed One#213.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#214.src: Even after the Queen arrived a- and blessed the people, the tree di- didn't- didn't wake up. Its trust had been broken...
The Cursed One#214.dst: 就算后来女王来了，为——为人们带来祝福，这棵树也没——没有——没有醒来。它的信任已经被打破了……
The Cursed One#214.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#215.src: Ev- even though it's just a story... I hope s- some- someday the tree can trust us again. We could- c- could- we could really use its help, these days...
The Cursed One#215.dst: 就——就算这只是个故事……我希望有——有一天这棵树能再次信任我们。这些日子，我们真——真的——真的很需要它的帮助……
The Cursed One#215.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#216.src: ... A- a- anyway! The cavern you met Syndra in is also said to be s- sa- sacred. And the feel of the crystals reminds me of h- how I feel there.
The Cursed One#216.dst: ……总——总——总之！你遇见 Syndra 的那个洞窟据说也是神——神、神圣的。那些水晶给我的感觉，就跟我在那里的感、感觉一样。
The Cursed One#216.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#217.src: So- s- so if we can find our way into the tree... we co- could find some m- ma- s- some magical wood. Follow me!
The Cursed One#217.dst: 所——所以，所以如果我们能找到办法进入这棵树……我们就能——能——我们就能找到一些魔——魔——一些带魔法的木头。跟我来！
The Cursed One#217.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#218.src: Head to the top of the giant tree at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#219.src: Hey! F- faster than last time! Keep up the im- im- improvement, and maybe soon I'll have to put in mo- more than {~}!
The Cursed One#219.dst: 嘿！比上次快！继续进——进、进步下去，也许很快我就得付出比 {~} 更多的力气了！
The Cursed One#219.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#220.src: Ha... yeah... Um, earlier you m- me- mentioned that magic can be found in- in everything.
The Cursed One#220.dst: 哈……是啊……呃，你之前提——提——提到魔法存在于——于万物之中。
The Cursed One#220.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#221.src: So... so ma- maybe we didn't need to come to- to- to this old tree... But- b- but it feels right to me.
The Cursed One#221.dst: 所以……所以也——也许我们根本不用来这——这——这棵老树……可——可是，这感觉对我来说是对的。
The Cursed One#221.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#222.src: ... Thank you for c- c- coming along.
The Cursed One#222.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#223.src: It's a breath of fresh air, having someone n- n- new around! I don't know, having you around just f- fe- feels... good! Like- like anything is possible!
The Cursed One#223.dst: 有个新、新、新面孔在身边，就像呼吸到新鲜空气一样！我也说不上来，有你在就是感、感、感觉……很好！就像——就像什么都有可能！
The Cursed One#223.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#224.src: ... Oh, I- I- I'm getting too sappy. Sorry, sorry!
The Cursed One#224.dst: ……噢，我——我——我太肉麻了。抱歉，抱歉！
The Cursed One#224.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#225.src: Well... my h- h- my heart is telling me that this wood is what I w- w- what I want!
The Cursed One#225.dst: 嗯……我的心、心、我的心告诉我，这块木头就是我想——想、就是我想要的！
The Cursed One#225.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#226.src: That old tale... it's one of the o- o- only things I still remember from my childhood.
The Cursed One#226.dst: 那个古老的传说……是我童年记忆里仅——仅、仅剩的几件事之一。
The Cursed One#226.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#227.src: So, s- so this is definitely what I want my w- we- weapon to be made out of.
The Cursed One#227.dst: 所以，所、所以我绝对要用这个来做我的武——武、武器。
The Cursed One#227.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#228.src: Oh... y- y- yeah. Maybe you're right...
The Cursed One#228.dst: 噢……对——对、对啊。也许你说得对……
The Cursed One#228.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#229.src: I just thought... choosing s- some- something special to me would- would be b- best.
The Cursed One#229.dst: 我只是觉得……选一——一、一样对我有特别意义的东西会——会比较好。
The Cursed One#229.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#230.src: B- but we're here now any- a- anyway, aren't we? So we can just use the- the- the wood here...
The Cursed One#230.dst: 不——不过反正我们都——都、都已经来了，不是吗？所以我们就用这——这——这里的木头吧……
The Cursed One#230.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#231.src: So, we've gotta find a way into the tr- the tree...
The Cursed One#231.dst: 那么，我们得找到办法进到树——进到这棵树里……
The Cursed One#231.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#232.src: Ha, I- I'm not exactly a wood- woodcutting expert... maybe it'd have been smart to ask Mora t- to- to join us?
The Cursed One#232.dst: 哈，我——我不太算是伐——伐木专家……也许请 Mora 跟——跟——跟我们一起来会比较聪明？
The Cursed One#232.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#233.src: ... Do- do you have any ideas? May- maybe you could break through with a sp- spe- spell?
The Cursed One#233.dst: ……你——你有什么主意吗？也——也许你可以用法——法、法术打穿？
The Cursed One#233.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#234.src: Cast a spell ontop of the tree at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#235.src: Maybe you could break through with a sp- spe- spell?
The Cursed One#235.dst: 也许你可以用法——法、法术打穿？
The Cursed One#235.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#237.src: ... Do- do you think the t- tr- the tree heard me earlier? Is it...
The Cursed One#237.dst: ……你——你觉得这——这——这棵树刚才听到我说的话了吗？它是不是……
The Cursed One#237.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#238.src: This- th- this has to be a sign! Come on, let's go in!
The Cursed One#238.dst: 这——这——这一定是个征兆！来吧，我们进去！
The Cursed One#238.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#239.src: Find the wood Zeph wants at the end of the root system.
The Cursed One#239.dst: 在树根系统的尽头找到 Zeph 想要的木头。

The Cursed One#240.src: Th- th- there! That should- sh- should be a big enough chunk for Mora... right?
The Cursed One#240.dst: 那——那——那里！这块应——应该够大，够 Mora 用了……对吧？
The Cursed One#240.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#241.src: A- and- you're still not fast enough to beat me to th- th- to the end!
The Cursed One#241.dst: 而——而且——你还是没快到能比我先到——到——先到尽头！
The Cursed One#241.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#242.src: Okay, next... We- weapons are usually made of m- me- metal, right? That's why Mora has a f- fo- a forge.
The Cursed One#242.dst: 好，接下来……武——武器通常是用金——金、金属做的，对吧？所以 Mora 才有熔——熔——才有熔炉。
The Cursed One#242.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#243.src: ...I have a- an- an idea! Let's meet up near {p}, wh- where we first met.
The Cursed One#243.dst: ……我有——有——有个主意！我们在 {p} 附近会合吧，就——就是我们第一次见面的地方。
The Cursed One#243.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#245.src: O- okay, so. The crown usually uses t- ti- titanium for their equipment. Th- that's what Mora says, at least.
The Cursed One#245.dst: 好——好，那么。王室的装备通常用钛——钛——钛。至少 Mora 是这么说的。
The Cursed One#245.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#246.src: But- b- but, it can be hard to come by, b- be- because the crown keeps most of it for themselves.
The Cursed One#246.dst: 可——可是，钛很难弄到，因——因——因为王室把大部分都留给自己了。
The Cursed One#246.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#247.src: Luckily, it's F- F- Festival time, so a bunch of m- merchants are in town! And they're fr- from all over the p- pr- province, not just here!
The Cursed One#247.dst: 幸好现在是庆——庆——庆典时期，所以城里来了一大堆商、商人！而且他们来自整、整——整个行省，不只是这里！
The Cursed One#247.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#248.src: So someone m- must have titanium, somewhere... we'll j- just- just have to look around.
The Cursed One#248.dst: 所以一定有人有、有钛……我们只——只——只要四处找找就行。
The Cursed One#248.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#249.src: Ah! Th- that- that's the Sovereign!
The Cursed One#249.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#250.src: ...and alongside that, does she really think it's safe to hold the festival right now, sir? That opens up a really big risk!
The Cursed One#250.dst: ……除此之外，她真的觉得现在举办庆典安全吗，大人？那会带来很大的风险！
The Cursed One#250.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#251.src: What do you th- th- think they're t- talking about? Come on, let- l- let's shadow them.
The Cursed One#251.dst: 你觉——觉——觉得他们在说什么？来，我——我、我们跟上去。
The Cursed One#251.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#252.src: If the cursed thinks they can get past both myself and Her Majesty, they're out of their vector. You don't need to worry about the people.
The Cursed One#252.dst: 如果那个受诅者以为能同时越过我和女王陛下，那他们的矢量就算错了。你不必担心民众。
The Cursed One#252.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#253.src: I was more worried about... ...um... W-well, never mind that! If you think we'll all be safe, sir, I'll take you at your word!
The Cursed One#253.dst: 我比较担心的是……呃……那、那个，算了！既然您觉得大家都会安全，大人，我就相信您的话！
The Cursed One#253.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#254.src: Let me rephrase- you don't need to worry about anyone. ...heh. Any- wait. What's that noise?
The Cursed One#254.dst: 我换个说法你谁都不用担心。……嘿。任何等等。那是什么声音？
The Cursed One#254.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#255.src: Just someone out on a random walk? Back to the point is everything for the festival shaping up according to schedule?
The Cursed One#255.dst: 只是有人随机漫步吧？回到重点庆典的一切都照日程进行吗？
The Cursed One#255.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#256.src: Oh yes! Yes it is, sir! The vendors have all been assigned, the game stands have all been constructed, we've commissioned a local band... The one you liked last year!
The Cursed One#256.dst: 噢是的！是的，大人！摊贩都分配好了，游戏摊都搭好了，我们还请了一支本地乐队……就是您去年喜欢的那支！
The Cursed One#256.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#257.src: Golden. That rendition of "CHASE" is what really sold me on them.
The Cursed One#257.dst: 完美。他们演奏的那首“CHASE”才是真正打动我的原因。
The Cursed One#257.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#258.src: That just leaves your speech, sir! Have you Oh, who am I kidding, you already have it memorized.
The Cursed One#258.dst: 那就只剩您的演讲了，大人！您有噢，我在说什么呢，您肯定早就背熟了。
The Cursed One#258.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#259.src: Naturally, Xao. We have the whole festival set down to the last point, it looks like. Any more business to factor out?
The Cursed One#259.dst: 当然，Xao。看来整个庆典已经精确到小数点后最后一位了。还有什么事要提出来的吗？
The Cursed One#259.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#260.src: Yes, sir! I've received word that Inquisitor Renn will be arriving tonight, as you sent me to request for!
The Cursed One#260.dst: 有的，大人！我收到消息，Renn 审问官今晚会到，就是您让我去请的！
The Cursed One#260.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#261.src: Fantastic job. I have to remember that the Inquisitors aren't like me. When they're busy they can't just go triple-time... Still, good to have that problem solved.
The Cursed One#261.dst: 干得漂亮。我得记住审问官跟我不一样。他们忙的时候没法直接三倍速运转……不管怎样，这个问题解决了就好。
The Cursed One#261.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#262.src: You know, they should check your work. This is proof positive they can keep pace with me like you can.
The Cursed One#262.dst: 你知道吗，他们应该看看你的工作成果。这就是正定的证明，证明他们也能像你一样跟上我的步调。
The Cursed One#262.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#263.src: Well! Sir! You know I've had to insist you stop and rest sometimes, and Inquisitors do serve the whole of the province, so...
The Cursed One#263.dst: 嗯！大人！您也知道我有时候得坚持让您停下来休息，而且审问官要服务整个行省其他地方，所以……
The Cursed One#263.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#264.src: Hmm... ev- even with us r- r- raiding Nixeph, he isn't concerned...
