The Mercenary#019.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#020.src: Anyhow, if you can, head on over to the Admiral's office. It's just by the bank, you can't miss it.
The Mercenary#020.dst: 总之，可以的话，就去上将的办公室吧。就在银行旁边，你不会找不到的。
The Mercenary#020.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#021.src: With that, I'm off! There are many more soldiers to find. Good luck, if you choose to heed the summons!
The Mercenary#021.dst: 就这样，我走了！还有很多士兵要找。如果你决定响应召集，祝你好运！
The Mercenary#021.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#022.dst: 与 {p} [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Amerigo 交谈。

The Mercenary#023.src: Ugh, for crying out loud- I'm busy, can't you see that? I don't have time to...
The Mercenary#023.dst: 呃，拜托——我很忙，你看不出来吗？我没时间……
The Mercenary#023.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#024.src: Ah. You're a soldier. Good, that's one more to add to the list. You met the scout, I'm sure.
The Mercenary#024.dst: 啊。你是士兵。很好，名单上又多一个。我想你见过斥候了。
The Mercenary#024.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#025.src: Not as many of you lot as I would have hoped for, but it'll have to do. Come down here, the others are in the briefing room already.
The Mercenary#025.dst: 你们这些人没我希望的那么多，不过也只能这样了。下来吧，其他人已经在简报室了。
The Mercenary#025.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#026.src: Hmph. I suppose this is as many soldiers as we'll be able to get. Very well!
The Mercenary#026.dst: 哼。我想我们能召集到的士兵也就这么多了。很好！
The Mercenary#026.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#027.src: To begin with - the situation. Commander Takan of {p} has abandoned his post, and has taken the lead of a group of local bandits.
The Mercenary#027.dst: 首先——现在的情况。{p} 的 Takan 指挥官擅离职守，还当上了一群本地强盗的头目。
The Mercenary#027.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#028.src: Under his command, they were able to strike our forces in the dead of night, and have taken over the barracks to the northeast.
The Mercenary#028.dst: 在他的指挥下，他们趁深夜袭击了我们的部队，占领了东北边的兵营。
The Mercenary#028.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#029.src: Our entire military force, captured or killed! What a disgrace. We've sent messengers to {p}, and they have promised their support...
The Mercenary#029.dst: 我们整支军队，不是被俘就是被杀！真是奇耻大辱。我们已经派信使去 {p}，他们也答应支援……
The Mercenary#029.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#030.src: But I would like this dealt with quickly and quietly. That's where you five come in.
The Mercenary#030.dst: 但我希望这件事能快速、低调地解决。这就是你们五个的任务。
The Mercenary#030.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#031.src: You will attack and infiltrate the barracks, and assassinate our treasonous commander. I will leave the strategizing to you, as there is much I still must handle here.
The Mercenary#031.dst: 你们要进攻并潜入兵营，刺杀我们那个叛国的指挥官。策略就交给你们了，我这边还有很多事要处理。
The Mercenary#031.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#032.src: A question, if I may. Do we know the commander's reasoning for this attack? It seems out of character.
The Mercenary#032.dst: 请问可以提个问题吗？我们知道指挥官发动这次袭击的原因吗？这不像他会做的事。
The Mercenary#032.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#033.src: ...No. There is nothing that I can recall that would motivate such an attack. Will that be all?
The Mercenary#033.dst: ……不知道。我想不出任何会促使他发动这种袭击的事。还有别的问题吗？
The Mercenary#033.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#035.src: Then I must be off! Good luck, soldiers. I hope for a swift end to this disaster.
The Mercenary#035.dst: 那我得走了！祝你们好运，士兵们。希望这场灾难能尽快结束。
The Mercenary#035.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#036.src: ...Well, darn. Bandits sound like trouble. Do we know what sort?
The Mercenary#036.dst: ……嗯，糟糕。强盗听起来很麻烦。我们知道是哪一种吗？
The Mercenary#036.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#037.src: Does it matter? We'll probably be fighting them no matter what kind they are.
The Mercenary#037.dst: 有差吗？不管是哪种，我们大概都得跟他们打。
The Mercenary#037.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#038.src: It might, actually... Some bandit groups are stronger than others. If we know which group we're dealing with ahead of time, it might-
The Mercenary#038.dst: 其实可能有差……有些强盗团比其他的强。如果我们事先知道对付的是哪一伙，也许——
The Mercenary#038.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#039.src: We've been standing around here for too long. Come on, let's make our way closer to the barracks. We can come up with a plan there.
The Mercenary#039.dst: 我们在这里站太久了。走吧，我们靠近兵营一点。到了那里再想计划。
The Mercenary#039.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#044.src: Well, darn. The place is swarming with bandits...
The Mercenary#044.dst: 嗯，糟糕。这地方到处都是强盗……
The Mercenary#044.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#045.src: I don't see how that's a problem! We can just launch explosives into the crowd, and boom, problem solved.
The Mercenary#045.dst: 我看不出这有什么问题！我们直接把炸药扔进人堆里，砰，问题解决。
The Mercenary#045.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#047.src: We can't do that. You'd almost certainly damage the structure in the process!
The Mercenary#047.dst: 不能那样做。那样几乎肯定会炸坏建筑！
The Mercenary#047.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#048.src: Ah, true. Can't forget about the historical value. Good catch.
The Mercenary#048.dst: 啊，也对。可不能忘了它的历史价值。提醒得好。
The Mercenary#048.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#049.src: ...Right. Well, anyway, I don't think we can get through those bandits with brute force. We'll have to try to find a way around them...
The Mercenary#049.dst: ……好吧。总之，我不认为我们能靠蛮力突破那些强盗。我们得想办法绕过他们……
The Mercenary#049.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#050.src: Well, if I may interject- I reckon I won't be of much use in proper combat! Injured leg, 'n all. Makes moving a little hard!
The Mercenary#050.dst: 那个，我插句话——我想正面打起来我帮不上什么忙！腿受伤了嘛。行动有点不方便！
The Mercenary#050.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#051.src: So, if we think goin' right in won't work, I could try to create a distraction? I've got the magic for it, and I'd be of much more use out here.
The Mercenary#051.dst: 所以，如果我们觉得直接冲进去行不通，我可以试着制造点混乱引开他们？我有这方面的魔法，在外面我能派上更多用场。
The Mercenary#051.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#052.src: It could work... if I join you, we'd be able to draw attention towards us while the others sneak in from a different angle.
The Mercenary#052.dst: 行得通……如果我跟你一起，我们就能把注意力吸引过来，让其他人从别的方向溜进去。
The Mercenary#052.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#053.src: Good idea. But, how do we get in? I don't think there is another entrance, other than that one in front.
The Mercenary#053.dst: 好主意。可是我们要怎么进去？除了前面那个入口，我不认为还有别的入口。
The Mercenary#053.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#055.src: This had better not be going where I think it is, Linton.
The Mercenary#055.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#056.src: Okay, maybe it is. But, listen! We don't have any entrances, right? What if we made our own... by blowing a hole through a wall?
The Mercenary#056.dst: 好吧，也许就是。但是，听着！我们没有入口，对吧？如果我们自己造一个……在墙上炸个洞呢？
The Mercenary#056.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#057.src: ...Alright, fine. That sounds like it could work.
The Mercenary#057.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#059.src: Exactly! You need to have more faith in the experts, Aledar.
The Mercenary#059.dst: 正是！你得多相信专家一点，Aledar。
The Mercenary#059.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#060.src: We all need to make sacrifices, Lanu.
The Mercenary#060.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#061.src: Hm. No, I don't think I do. Either way, that sounds like a plan. {u}, Linton, and I will break into the barracks then.
The Mercenary#061.dst: 嗯。不，我不觉得我需要。不管怎样，这听起来是个计划。那就由 {u}、Linton 和我闯进兵营。
The Mercenary#061.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#063.src: And Lanu and I can distract 'em while you do so. Sounds like a plan! Let's get goin'.
The Mercenary#063.dst: 我和 Lanu 在你们行动的时候引开他们。听起来是个好计划！我们出发吧。
The Mercenary#063.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#065.src: Well, well. This looks like a good place to break our way in, wouldn't you say, Aledar?
The Mercenary#065.dst: 哎呀呀。这看起来是个炸开进去的好地方，你说是吧，Aledar？
The Mercenary#065.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#066.src: Yes, Linton, it looks fine. {u}, we'll be looking for Takan. I think the two of us could take him out.
The Mercenary#066.dst: 是，Linton，看起来不错。{u}，我们去找 Takan。我想我们俩能解决他。
The Mercenary#066.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#067.src: And I'll be looking for the captured soldiers! I stole a map of the barracks from Amerigo's desk, so I'll be able to find them easily enough!
The Mercenary#067.dst: 我去找被俘的士兵！我从 Amerigo 的桌上偷了一张兵营的地图，所以我能轻松找到他们！
The Mercenary#067.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#068.src: You-... nevermind, I don't care. Just do your job, please?
The Mercenary#068.dst: 你——……算了，我不在乎。拜托你做好你的工作就行？
The Mercenary#068.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#070.src: See you two on the other side!
The Mercenary#070.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#073.src: Damn it... damn it, damn it, damn it ALL! Couldn't give me a MOMENT of peace, could he, that rat Amerigo...
The Mercenary#073.dst: 该死……该死，该死，全都该死！就不能让我清静一下吗，那只老鼠 Amerigo……
The Mercenary#073.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#074.src: ...do I really need to do everything myself?! It's almost as though-
The Mercenary#074.dst: ……难道什么事都得我自己来吗？！简直就像——
The Mercenary#074.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#075.src: Oh, I see. I see what's going on. More of Amerigo's dogs, here to take care of his business, huh?! Get out here where I can see you.
The Mercenary#075.dst: 噢，我明白了。我明白是怎么回事了。又是 Amerigo 派来替他办事的走狗，是吧？！给我出来，让我看看你们。
The Mercenary#075.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#076.src: You look new... haven't been around long enough to really see the face of War up close and personal yet, have you?
The Mercenary#076.dst: 你看起来是新来的……还没待够久，没亲眼近距离见识过战争的真面目吧？
The Mercenary#076.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#077.src: You think this is right? You think it's right that those DAMNED admirals get all the wealth and fame, when WE'RE the ones out fighting in the trenches?!
The Mercenary#077.dst: 你觉得这样对吗？你觉得那些该死的上将坐拥所有财富和名声，而在战壕里拼命的是我们，这样对吗？！
The Mercenary#077.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#078.src: I've seen soldiers fall and fall and fall, then rise back up again. I've lived through the chaos and death of battle more times than I could count.
The Mercenary#078.dst: 我看过士兵倒下、倒下、再倒下，然后又重新站起来。我经历过的战场混乱与死亡，多到我数都数不清。
The Mercenary#078.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#079.src: And these IDIOTS think they deserve their power? Their authority?!
The Mercenary#079.dst: 而这些白痴觉得他们配得上他们的权力？他们的权威？！
The Mercenary#079.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#080.src: ...You've killed dozens, and you're keeping dozens more captured.
The Mercenary#080.dst: ……你杀了几十个人，还关押着另外几十个人。
The Mercenary#080.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#081.src: And I'd do all that and more, just to prove my point! They think they hold power?! I'll show them power...
The Mercenary#081.dst: 为了证明我的观点，我还会做得更多！他们以为自己掌握权力？！我就让他们见识什么是权力……
The Mercenary#081.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#082.src: I suppose I'll start with you. What are two more compared to dozens?
The Mercenary#082.dst: 我想就从你们开始吧。跟几十个人比起来，多两个又算什么？
The Mercenary#082.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#083.src: Step aside, Shadow Spears. I'd like to deal with these dogs myself.
The Mercenary#083.dst: 让开，暗影之矛。我要亲自对付这两条走狗。
The Mercenary#083.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#084.src: ...We won't make it easy for you.
The Mercenary#084.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#089.src: This tower can only go up... Come on, we need to chase after him! We can't let him get away!
The Mercenary#089.dst: 这座塔只能往上走……快，我们得追上他！不能让他跑了！
The Mercenary#089.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#090.src: Continue up the stairs in the barracks.

The Mercenary#093.src: Look, it's obvious we've lost here. Even if that idiot escapes, you military folk will find him.
The Mercenary#093.dst: 听着，很明显我们在这里输了。就算那个白痴逃了，你们军队的人也会找到他。
The Mercenary#093.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#094.src: So, I surrender! Don't see the point in fightin' a pointless battle. Not like we're gonna be paid after this mess, anyhow.
The Mercenary#094.dst: 所以，我投降！没必要打一场毫无意义的仗。反正经过这场乱子，我们也拿不到钱了。
The Mercenary#094.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#095.src: Here, take the key to the tower. A sign of good faith. Do what you will with him, I really don't care.
The Mercenary#095.dst: 来，拿去塔的钥匙。算是表示诚意。你们想怎么处置他都行，我真的不在乎。
The Mercenary#095.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#096.src: I always preferred his brother anyway. Much quieter.
The Mercenary#096.dst: 反正我一直比较喜欢他哥哥。安静多了。
The Mercenary#096.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#097.src: Ugh, more bandits... I'll hold them off here.
The Mercenary#097.dst: 呃，又是强盗……我在这里挡住他们。
The Mercenary#097.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#098.src: Keep going after Takan! I'll be fine!
The Mercenary#098.dst: 继续去追 Takan！我不会有事的！
The Mercenary#098.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#099.src: Head up the tower and take out Takan.

The Mercenary#100.src: Urgh... Why did I even come up here?! There's nowhere for me to-
The Mercenary#100.dst: 呃……我到底为什么要跑上来？！我根本无处可——
The Mercenary#100.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#101.src: ...Oh. L-listen. We can talk this out-
The Mercenary#101.dst: ……噢。听、听着。我们可以好好谈谈——
The Mercenary#101.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#104.src: ...and so then, I had to free them somehow! So I shouted at them to brace for it, and-
The Mercenary#104.dst: ……然后呢，我得想办法放他们出来！所以我就大喊叫他们做好准备，然后——
The Mercenary#104.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#105.src: {u}! There you are! I'm glad you made it out safely. It looks like the bandits are dispersing.
The Mercenary#105.dst: {u}！你在这里！很高兴你平安出来了。看来强盗们正在散去。
The Mercenary#105.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#106.src: And so is my train of thought for my story. So! Did you get him?
The Mercenary#106.dst: 我讲故事的思路也跟着散了。那么！你们抓到他了吗？
The Mercenary#106.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#107.src: That's good to hear. At least something good came of this whole situation...
The Mercenary#107.dst: 那真是好消息。至少这整件事总算有件好事……
The Mercenary#107.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#108.src: I'm glad we managed to take him out after all. The things he was saying... he seemed like a dangerous man.
The Mercenary#108.dst: 我很高兴我们最后还是解决了他。他说的那些话……他看起来是个危险的人。
The Mercenary#108.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#109.src: Oh, not this again. You're still on that?
The Mercenary#109.dst: 噢，又来了。你还在想那件事？
The Mercenary#109.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#110.src: I caught a few of the things he was shoutin' from outside. It didn't sound very pleasant.
The Mercenary#110.dst: 我在外面听到了一些他喊的话。听起来不太好。
The Mercenary#110.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#111.src:
Lanu:
Some of us care about history, Mel.
The Mercenary#111.dst: 我们之中有些人是在乎历史的，Mel。
The Mercenary#111.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#112.src: Well, I didn't hear a thing. Probably on account of the ringing in my ears. It seems to me we're done here, though, right?
The Mercenary#112.dst: 嗯，我什么都没听到。大概是因为我耳朵还在嗡嗡响。不过我看我们这边已经搞定了，对吧？
The Mercenary#112.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#113.src: It looks like it, yes. I think I'll stay behind to help the soldiers clear out the remaining bandits.
The Mercenary#113.dst: 看来是的。我想我会留下来帮士兵清理剩下的强盗。
The Mercenary#113.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#114.src: I figure I'll stick around too. Don't got anythin' better to do right now, anyway!
The Mercenary#114.dst: 我想我也留下来。反正现在也没什么更好的事可做！
The Mercenary#114.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#115.src: Well, I'm out of here. I've got places to be! Things to do! Explosives to return! Goodbye!
The Mercenary#115.dst: 嗯，我要走了。我有地方要去！有事要做！有炸药要还！再见！
The Mercenary#115.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#116.src: {u}, I guess that leaves the two of us to return to {p} with the news! Let's get going.
The Mercenary#116.dst: {u}，看来只剩我们两个回 {p} 报信了！出发吧。
The Mercenary#116.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#117.src: Bring Takan's badge to Amerigo at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Mercenary#117.dst: 把 Takan 的徽章带给 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Amerigo。

The Mercenary#118.src: Soldiers! Report! Don't tell me you're the only two survivors, damn it all...
The Mercenary#118.dst: 士兵们！报告！别跟我说只有你们两个活下来，该死……
The Mercenary#118.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#119.src: No, sir, the mission was a success. Takan is dead.
The Mercenary#119.dst: 不，长官，任务成功了。Takan 死了。
The Mercenary#119.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#120.src: You're certain of this? You have his badge, surely...?
The Mercenary#120.dst: 你确定吗？你们一定拿到他的徽章了吧……？
The Mercenary#120.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#121.src: I see... satisfactory work, soldiers. You two, and the others, have {p}'s gratitude.
The Mercenary#121.dst: 我明白了……干得还算可以，士兵们。你们两个，还有其他人，{p} 都感谢你们。
The Mercenary#121.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#122.src: Admiral, sir. Some of what Takan is saying, it was-
The Mercenary#122.dst: 上将，长官。Takan 说的一些话，那是——
The Mercenary#122.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#123.src: I wouldn't put too much stock in those traitor's words. People like him, who spit vitriol with no merit, riling up the masses against the order we hold.
The Mercenary#123.dst: 我不会太把那个叛徒的话当回事。像他那种人，满口毫无根据的恶言，煽动群众反抗我们维持的秩序。
The Mercenary#123.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#124.src: He is an angry man holding a grudge for an imagined wrongdoing. There is nothing more to it than that. I would suggest putting it out of your mind.
The Mercenary#124.dst: 他只是个为想象出来的冤屈怀恨在心的愤怒之人。仅此而已。我建议你们别再想了。
The Mercenary#124.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#125.src: You will all be well-compensated for your work today. Now, run along. I have to collect my honorary badge for taking out Ex-Commander Takan.
The Mercenary#125.dst: 你们今天的工作都会得到丰厚的报酬。好了，走吧。我得去领我因为解决前指挥官 Takan 而获得的荣誉徽章了。
The Mercenary#125.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#127.src: I'm starting to see why Takan hated him so much.
The Mercenary#127.dst: 我开始明白 Takan 为什么那么恨他了。
The Mercenary#127.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#128.src: I'll... probably try to speak to Admiral Aegis about that the next time I'm in {p}.
The Mercenary#128.dst: 下次去 {p} 的时候……我大概会试着跟 Aegis 上将谈谈这件事。
The Mercenary#128.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#129.src: Anyway! What an adventure, right? I can't wait to tell Tasim about it.
The Mercenary#129.dst: 总之！真是一场冒险，对吧？我等不及要跟 Tasim 说了。
The Mercenary#129.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#130.src: ...Speaking of. Have you heard from him recently? I can't seem to get ahold of him at all.
The Mercenary#130.dst: ……说到这个。你最近有他的消息吗？我好像怎么都联系不上他。
The Mercenary#130.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#131.src: It's weird. Last I heard, he was at {p}, but he's not there anymore.
The Mercenary#131.dst: 真奇怪。我上次听说他在 {p}，可他已经不在那里了。
The Mercenary#131.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#132.src: He- what? Really? And he didn't even tell me...
The Mercenary#132.dst: 他——什么？真的？他居然都没告诉我……
The Mercenary#132.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#133.src: ...I guess it must have slipped his mind. That's alright. We're all busy around here, right?
The Mercenary#133.dst: ……我想他大概是忘了吧。没关系。这里大家都很忙，对吧？
The Mercenary#133.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#134.src: A general location is useful, though. I'll see if I can get any letters to him. Thanks for telling me.
The Mercenary#134.dst: 不过知道个大概的位置还是有用的。我看看能不能寄几封信给他。谢谢你告诉我。
The Mercenary#134.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#135.src: Yeah, that makes two of us...
The Mercenary#135.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#136.src: Well, it's probably fine. I'm sure he'll pop up eventually! We just need to wait.
The Mercenary#136.dst: 嗯，大概没事吧。我相信他迟早会冒出来的！我们只要等着就行。
The Mercenary#136.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#137.src: I wonder where he's gone off to? Some kind of assignment in {p}, maybe? Or could he have gone off to Gavel...?
The Mercenary#137.dst: 不知道他去哪了？也许是在 {p} 执行什么任务？还是说他去了 Gavel……？
The Mercenary#137.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#138.src: Well, whatever. It was good to see you again! Even if... well. Even if it was strange.
The Mercenary#138.dst: 嗯，算了。很高兴又见到你！就算……嗯。就算有点怪。
The Mercenary#138.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#140.src: Well, I guess I'm going to head off. I'll see you around, {u}!
The Mercenary#140.dst: 好了，我想我该走了。回头见，{u}！
The Mercenary#140.speaker: Aledar

The Missing Piece#000.src: After knocking them out,  RIGHT-CLICK to search workers.
The Missing Piece#000.dst: 把他们打晕后，右键搜查工人。

The Missing Piece#001.src: Now, how to get up from here...
The Missing Piece#001.dst: 好了，要怎么从这里上去……

The Missing Piece#002.src: This must be the pipe Bush was talking about...
The Missing Piece#002.dst: 这一定就是 Bush 说的那根管子……

The Missing Piece#003.src: Hm... There's no sender... Are these all from the same person?
The Missing Piece#003.dst: 嗯……没有寄件人……这些都是同一个人寄的吗？

The Missing Piece#004.src: Pick up your post in the Post Office at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#006.src: Don't you see I'm busy!? Take a ticket and wait in line as you're supposed to! I don't care if no one else is here, follow protocol!
The Missing Piece#006.dst: 你没看到我很忙吗！？去取号，照规矩排队！我才不管这里有没有别人，按流程来！
The Missing Piece#006.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#007.src: You could get across this gap by arranging the suspended beams into a path.
The Missing Piece#007.dst: 把悬空的横梁排成一条路，就能越过这道缺口。

The Missing Piece#008.src: Oh, yes! The letters. Silly me, I almost forgot.
The Missing Piece#008.dst: 哦，对了！那些信。瞧我这记性，差点忘了。

The Missing Piece#010.src: Take a ticket from the Ticket Machine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#011.src: You have to take a ticket, just like everyone else!
The Missing Piece#011.dst: 你得取号，跟其他人一样！
The Missing Piece#011.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#012.src: Return to the Post Office at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#015.src: I'll be with you in one second! Gosh, so impatient these days...
The Missing Piece#015.dst: 马上就轮到你！天哪，现在的人真没耐心……
The Missing Piece#015.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#016.src: Tired of waiting already? Well, someone decided to leave this place a mess for when I returned!
The Missing Piece#016.dst: 已经等烦了？哼，有人在我回来的时候把这地方弄得一团糟！
The Missing Piece#016.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#017.src: I come back to the office yesterday from a well-deserved, brief, eighteen week, vacation. And this is how I'm thanked?!
The Missing Piece#017.dst: 我昨天刚结束一场应得的、短暂的、十八周的假期回到办公室。结果就得到这种回报？！
The Missing Piece#017.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#018.src: Do you see the mess my substitute left this place in? And now I have to clean it up, or the Royal Inspector will have my head!
The Missing Piece#018.dst: 你看到我的代班把这里弄得多乱了吗？现在我得收拾干净，不然皇家督察会要我的脑袋！
The Missing Piece#018.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#019.src: I'll have you know I graduated with honours from the Royal University of Aelumia.
The Missing Piece#019.dst: 我告诉你，我可是以优等成绩毕业于 Aelumia 皇家大学的。
The Missing Piece#019.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#020.src: Frankly, it's demeaning they stuck me out here with the... ugh... peasants! Oh, and don't even get me started on the smell!
The Missing Piece#020.dst: 说真的，把我丢到这里跟这些……呃……平民待在一起，简直是羞辱！噢，更别跟我提那股味道！
The Missing Piece#020.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#021.src: But anyway, that is all besides the point. What did you want again?
The Missing Piece#021.dst: 不过总之，那些都不是重点。你刚才要什么来着？
The Missing Piece#021.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#022.src: It's you! You're the one I left in charge over my vacation, you scoundrel!
The Missing Piece#022.dst: 是你！我放假的时候就是把这里交给了你，你这无赖！
The Missing Piece#022.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#023.src: I knew it! A university graduate like me couldn't possibly be wrong!
The Missing Piece#023.dst: 我就知道！像我这样的大学毕业生怎么可能会错！
The Missing Piece#023.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#024.src: Don't try to weasel your way out of it! A university graduate like me couldn't possibly be wrong!
The Missing Piece#024.dst: 别想狡辩！像我这样的大学毕业生怎么可能会错！
The Missing Piece#024.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#027.src: It's not just me who's going to be in trouble when the inspection comes, surely you realize that?
The Missing Piece#027.dst: 检查来的时候，惹上麻烦的可不只我一个，你应该明白吧？
The Missing Piece#027.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#029.src: If you fix this mess you made... Then no one ever has to hear a word of what happened.
The Missing Piece#029.dst: 如果你把你弄出来的烂摊子收拾好……那就没人会听到发生过什么。
The Missing Piece#029.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#030.src: You don't get in trouble, the Royal Inspector is happy, I'm happy. Everyone is happy!
The Missing Piece#030.dst: 你不会惹上麻烦，皇家督察满意，我也满意。皆大欢喜！
The Missing Piece#030.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#033.src: Then I'll have you sorting post like your life depends on it, scoundrel!
The Missing Piece#033.dst: 那我就让你拼了命地分拣邮件，无赖！
The Missing Piece#033.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#034.dst: 因为你的命确实就靠这个了。
The Missing Piece#034.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#037.src: Sorting is so easy even someone like you should be able to do it.
The Missing Piece#037.dst: 分拣简单到连你这种人都应该做得来。
The Missing Piece#037.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#038.src: All you do is take the packages from the conveyor over there.
The Missing Piece#038.dst: 你只要从那边的传送带上拿包裹。
The Missing Piece#038.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#039.src: And put them where they're supposed to go over there.
The Missing Piece#039.dst: 然后把它们放到那边该放的地方。
The Missing Piece#039.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#040.src: {p} packages to the {p}, Auburn packages to the {p}, and so on.
The Missing Piece#040.dst: {p} 的包裹放到 {p}，Auburn 的包裹放到 {p}，以此类推。
The Missing Piece#040.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#042.src: Fantastic! Just don't make a mess of it, okay?
The Missing Piece#042.dst: 太棒了！只是别搞砸了，好吗？
The Missing Piece#042.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#046.src: Well, that was just the warmup! There's more to come, so don't go slacking off now!
The Missing Piece#046.dst: 哼，那只是热身！后面还多着呢，所以别偷懒！
The Missing Piece#046.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#047.src: Hmm... You did fine this time, but watch out, because these last packages come fast!
The Missing Piece#047.dst: 嗯……这次你做得还行，不过小心，最后这批包裹来得很快！
The Missing Piece#047.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#048.src: Don't think you're somebody just because you can sort some packages!
The Missing Piece#048.dst: 别以为会分拣几个包裹就了不起了！
The Missing Piece#048.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#049.src: What are you doing over there!?
The Missing Piece#049.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#050.src: Agh! Try again, but you better do it right this time!
The Missing Piece#050.dst: 啊！再来一次，这次你最好给我做对！
The Missing Piece#050.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#051.src: Agh! Try again, but you better do it right this time!
The Missing Piece#051.dst: 啊！再来一次，这次你最好给我做对！
The Missing Piece#051.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#052.src: Don't bother me while I'm working! I didn't go to university just to slack off with people like you!
The Missing Piece#052.dst: 我工作的时候别来烦我！我上大学可不是为了跟你这种人一起偷懒的！
The Missing Piece#052.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#054.src: Ah, perfect! You sorted the packages!
The Missing Piece#054.dst: 啊，完美！你把包裹分拣好了！
The Missing Piece#054.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#055.src: But wait, what's this then? Why are there so many packages to the {p}?
The Missing Piece#055.dst: 等等，这又是什么？为什么有这么多包裹要寄去 {p}？
The Missing Piece#055.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#056.src: Did you mess up the sorting, you fool!?
The Missing Piece#056.dst: 你是不是分拣错了，你这笨蛋！？
The Missing Piece#056.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#057.src: What's up with these packages! They're filled with letters?
The Missing Piece#057.dst: 这些包裹是怎么回事！里面装满了信？
The Missing Piece#057.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#058.src: Hmph... all of them to the woman on the hill... Whatever that means!
The Missing Piece#058.dst: 哼……全都是寄给山丘上的女人……天知道那是什么意思！
The Missing Piece#058.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#059.src: Hey you, scoundrel. This is part of your duty too, you know!
The Missing Piece#059.dst: 喂你，无赖。这也是你的职责，你知道吧！
The Missing Piece#059.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#060.src: Go deliver these letters! Or... or I'll tell the Royal Inspector about what you did! That's right, don't mess with me!
The Missing Piece#060.dst: 去把这些信送了！不然……不然我就跟皇家督察说你干的好事！没错，别惹我！
The Missing Piece#060.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#061.src: How should I know! That's your job to figure out. See, it says here 'to the woman on the hill', that should be enough shouldn't it?
The Missing Piece#061.dst: 我怎么会知道！那是你的工作。你看，这上面写着“寄给山丘上的女人”，这样应该够了吧？
The Missing Piece#061.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#062.src: Oh, but you are! I have very many friends, in very high places! Met them in university, makes sure to remember that!
The Missing Piece#062.dst: 噢，你当然得去！我有很多朋友，身居高位的朋友！在大学认识的，给我记住了！
The Missing Piece#062.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#063.src: Great! Now with that settled I can finally go back to my very important work.
The Missing Piece#063.dst: 太好了！这下事情解决了，我终于可以回去做我非常重要的工作了。
The Missing Piece#063.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#064.src: Oh, yes. Very important. University graduate, did I mention that?
The Missing Piece#064.dst: 噢，是的。非常重要。大学毕业生，我提过吗？
The Missing Piece#064.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#065.src: Now now, off you go. And don't come back crying if you can't find this mysterious woman!
The Missing Piece#065.dst: 好了好了，快去吧。要是找不到这个神秘女人，可别哭着回来！
The Missing Piece#065.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#066.src: But if you lose the letter I can always give you another, they seem to be practically infinite anyhow!
The Missing Piece#066.dst: 不过要是你把信弄丢了，我随时可以再给你一封，反正这些信几乎多到数不完！
The Missing Piece#066.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#067.src: Find out about the woman on the hill around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#067.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 附近打听山丘上的女人。

The Missing Piece#068.src: Are you trying to slack off? You still have the letter on you, go deliver it!
The Missing Piece#068.dst: 你想偷懒吗？信还在你身上，快去送！
The Missing Piece#068.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#070.src: Hmm, you lost the letter? Already!?
The Missing Piece#070.dst: 嗯，你把信弄丢了？这么快！？
The Missing Piece#070.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#071.src: Don't think you're getting out of this! I have spares!
The Missing Piece#071.dst: 别以为这样就能逃掉！我有备份！
The Missing Piece#071.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#072.src: Now go on and sort this out for me, won't you? I have enough to worry about as is without you bungling about!
The Missing Piece#072.dst: 好了，快去帮我把这件事处理好，好吗？我要操心的事已经够多了，别再添乱！
The Missing Piece#072.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#074.src: Looking for someone, huh? 'round these parts it's usually the tin cans who do that.
The Missing Piece#074.dst: 在找人，是吧？在这一带找人的通常是那些铁罐头。
The Missing Piece#074.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#075.src: A visit from one of those and you get an all-expenses-paid vacation on the Crown, if you catch my drift.
The Missing Piece#075.dst: 被他们找上门，你就能享受一趟王室全额买单的度假，懂我的意思吧。
The Missing Piece#075.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#076.src: Safe to say, if it were Lars you were looking for I'd be happy to rat him out, but you haven't told me who it is yet.
The Missing Piece#076.dst: 说真的，要是你找的是 Lars，我很乐意把他供出来，不过你还没说是谁。
The Missing Piece#076.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#077.src: PLenty of hills 'round these parts, women too. But they're in the factories, slaving away, not on any hills 'sfar as I'm aware.
The Missing Piece#077.dst: 这一带山丘多的是，女人也不少。不过她们都在工厂里做牛做马，据我所知可没待在什么山丘上。
The Missing Piece#077.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#078.src: Sorry bud, don't think I can help you with this one. Try asking Lars, he's usually hogging the fire in the alley here behind me. Hate that guy...
The Missing Piece#078.dst: 抱歉，老兄，这件事我帮不上忙。去问问 Lars 吧，他通常霸着我后面这条巷子里的火堆。我讨厌那家伙……
The Missing Piece#078.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#080.src: Already told you everythin', didn't I? Go harass Lars instead, I have nothing more to say.
The Missing Piece#080.dst: 我知道的都跟你说了，不是吗？去烦 Lars 吧，我没什么好说的了。
The Missing Piece#080.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#082.src: I'm looking for someone called 'the woman on the hill'. I have a letter I need to deliver to her.
The Missing Piece#082.dst: 我在找一个叫“山丘上的女人”的人。我有封信要交给她。
The Missing Piece#082.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#083.src: A letter? Don't know nuthin' about no woman on the hill, but maybe Bush over there would know.
The Missing Piece#083.dst: 信？我可不知道什么山丘上的女人，不过那边的 Bush 或许知道。
The Missing Piece#083.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#084.src: He usually knows things... He's a knower.
The Missing Piece#084.dst: 他通常知道一些事……他是个知道者。
The Missing Piece#084.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#085.src: Don't talk to him for too long though, or he'll start putting strange ideas in your head...
The Missing Piece#085.dst: 不过别跟他聊太久，不然他会开始往你脑子里塞奇怪的念头……
The Missing Piece#085.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#087.src: Ask Bush. I told you I don't know nuthin'.
The Missing Piece#087.dst: 去问 Bush。我说了我什么都不知道。
The Missing Piece#087.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#088.src: I'm Bush, nice to meet you. Is there something you wish to know?
The Missing Piece#088.dst: 我是 Bush，很高兴认识你。有什么想知道的吗？
The Missing Piece#088.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#089.src: Oh, yes, her... This bush knows her all too well!
The Missing Piece#089.dst: 噢，是的，她……这丛灌木再清楚她不过了！
The Missing Piece#089.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#090.src: Without her this bush would wilt! Yes, a bush requires water to grow. I know, I know!
The Missing Piece#090.dst: 没有她，这丛灌木就会枯萎！是的，灌木需要水才能生长。我知道，我知道！
The Missing Piece#090.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#091.src: But first, I must know why you must know! Do you know?
The Missing Piece#091.dst: 不过首先，我必须知道你为什么必须知道！你知道吗？
The Missing Piece#091.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#092.src: A letter! If only this Bush could know its contents... Alas, it would be rude to know...
The Missing Piece#092.dst: 一封信！要是这丛灌木能知道里面写了什么就好了……唉，知道了就太失礼了……
The Missing Piece#092.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#093.src: The mail-deliverer, truly a noble profession. I will share with you her location, but in exchange you must tell her: her friend is back in town.
The Missing Piece#093.dst: 送信的人，真是个高尚的职业。我会告诉你她在哪，不过作为交换，你得告诉她：她的朋友回镇上了。
The Missing Piece#093.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#094.src: Here, let me write it down for you!
The Missing Piece#094.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#095.src: Now you know! Now you know!
The Missing Piece#095.dst: 现在你知道了！现在你知道了！
The Missing Piece#095.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#096.src: To know why I must know? Not even I know... All I know is that I must know!
The Missing Piece#096.dst: 要知道我为什么必须知道？连我自己都不知道……我只知道我必须知道！
The Missing Piece#096.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#097.src: Again, tell me why you must know.
The Missing Piece#097.dst: 再告诉我一次，你为什么必须知道。
The Missing Piece#097.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#098.src: Nothing? That such people existed, I did not know! Now I know, now I know!
The Missing Piece#098.dst: 什么都没有？原来还有这样的人，我以前不知道！现在我知道了，现在我知道了！
The Missing Piece#098.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#100.src: Now you know! Now you know!
The Missing Piece#100.dst: 现在你知道了！现在你知道了！
The Missing Piece#100.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#102.src: Post? You must be at the wrong house, dear.
The Missing Piece#102.dst: 邮件？你一定是找错房子了，亲爱的。
The Missing Piece#102.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#103.src: No one is sending me any of that...
The Missing Piece#103.dst: 没有人会给我寄那种东西……
The Missing Piece#103.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#104.src: Well, if it says so on the letter...
The Missing Piece#104.dst: 嗯，既然信上是这么写的……
The Missing Piece#104.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#105.src: Come in and we'll talk about it.
The Missing Piece#105.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#107.src: I don't usually get a lot of visitors up on the hill.
The Missing Piece#107.dst: 山丘上这里平常没什么访客。
The Missing Piece#107.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#112.src: Place the letters on the table at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#115.src: I think I'll need a closer look at this.
The Missing Piece#115.dst: 我想我得仔细看看这个。
The Missing Piece#115.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#116.src: Please, have a seat. I'll make you something to drink.
The Missing Piece#116.dst: 请坐。我去给你弄点喝的。
The Missing Piece#116.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#118.src: You don't look like you're from around these parts, do you?
The Missing Piece#118.dst: 你看起来不像是这一带的人，对吧？
The Missing Piece#118.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#119.src: Hmm? Well, I shouldn't pry into my guest's secrets. Better to let the unexplained rest, ha. Wouldn't you agree?
The Missing Piece#119.dst: 嗯？好吧，我不该打探客人的秘密。说不清的事就让它过去吧，哈。你不觉得吗？
The Missing Piece#119.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#120.src: Here in the Roughworks, we don't have any secrets. At least that's what Her Majesty wants to believe, ha.
The Missing Piece#120.dst: 在 Roughworks，我们没有任何秘密。至少女王陛下是这么希望的，哈。
The Missing Piece#120.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#121.src: That's why I chose to live here. In the neighborhoods, the walls are thinner than paper. Nothing goes unheard.
The Missing Piece#121.dst: 所以我才选择住在这里。住宅区里的墙比纸还薄。什么都藏不住。
The Missing Piece#121.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#122.src: Up here on the hill, it's much more peaceful. As long as the Water Authority doesn't come knocking, ha.
The Missing Piece#122.dst: 山丘上这里就清静多了。只要水务局别来敲门就好，哈。
The Missing Piece#122.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#123.src: Well, if you're already here, why don't we have a little chat? Not a lot of people to talk to up here!
The Missing Piece#123.dst: 好了，既然你都来了，我们何不聊聊？这上面可没什么人能说话！
The Missing Piece#123.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#124.src: Pick up the Watering Can outside at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#125.src: The watering can is just outside in the garden. There are three plants inside and three plants outside.
The Missing Piece#125.dst: 浇水壶就在外面的花园里。屋里有三株植物，屋外也有三株。
The Missing Piece#125.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#126.src: Water Elise's plants while she reads the letters.
The Missing Piece#126.dst: 趁 Elise 读信的时候帮她浇花。

The Missing Piece#128.src: Oh, what a mess... trying to make sense of this is making my head hurt.
The Missing Piece#128.dst: 噢，真是一团乱……想弄懂这些让我头都疼了。
The Missing Piece#128.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#129.src: So many letters, over so many years... who would possibly be so insistent on reaching me?
The Missing Piece#129.dst: 这么多信，跨越了这么多年……到底会是谁这么执着地想联系我？
The Missing Piece#129.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#130.src: Hm? Oh, you finished watering the plants already? That was quick!
The Missing Piece#130.dst: 嗯？噢，你已经浇完花了？真快！
The Missing Piece#130.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#131.src: Well, I certainly won't make any progress like this, and it seems we both are in need of a break.
The Missing Piece#131.dst: 嗯，这样下去我肯定理不出头绪，看来我们都需要休息一下。
The Missing Piece#131.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#132.src: Oh, it's such a lovely day today... Why don't we go outside and enjoy the garden for a bit?
The Missing Piece#132.dst: 噢，今天天气真好……我们何不去外面享受一下花园？
The Missing Piece#132.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#133.src: Follow Elise outside and take a seat at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#133.dst: 跟着 Elise 到外面，在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 坐下。

The Missing Piece#135.src: It really is beautiful today, isn't it?
The Missing Piece#135.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#136.src: Ah... freshly watered flowers. Nothing beats that smell.
The Missing Piece#136.dst: 啊……刚浇过水的花。没有什么比得上这股气味。
The Missing Piece#136.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#137.src: Hm. Do you see that tree over there?
The Missing Piece#137.dst: 嗯。你看到那边那棵树了吗？
The Missing Piece#137.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#138.src: It's the only one of its kind in the whole of the Roughworks. Isn't it beautiful?
The Missing Piece#138.dst: 整个 Roughworks 只有这么一棵。是不是很美？
The Missing Piece#138.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#139.src: It was a gift, but from who... It's another thing I've forgotten.
The Missing Piece#139.dst: 那是别人送的礼物，可是是谁送的……又是一件我忘了的事。
The Missing Piece#139.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#140.src: It's frustrating, so frustrating... All these precious memories...
The Missing Piece#140.dst: 真令人沮丧，好沮丧……这些珍贵的回忆……
The Missing Piece#140.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#142.src: It isn't much now, that is for certain.

The Missing Piece#143.src: Well. It's beautiful already, don't you think?
The Missing Piece#143.dst: 嗯。它现在就已经很美了，你不觉得吗？
The Missing Piece#143.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#145.src: Ha! Of course it will, it's a tree!
The Missing Piece#145.dst: 哈！当然会啊，它是棵树嘛！
The Missing Piece#145.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#146.src: Oh, you know I didn't mean it like that.
The Missing Piece#146.dst: 噢，你知道我不是那个意思。

The Missing Piece#147.src: For each year that passes... this tree will grow taller, and ever more beautiful.
The Missing Piece#147.dst: 每过一年……这棵树就会长得更高、更美。

The Missing Piece#148.src: It'll have to weather many storms, and on some days it might even have to go without water. And still, it will continue growing.
The Missing Piece#148.dst: 它得熬过许多风暴，有些日子甚至得忍受没有水。即使如此，它还是会继续生长。

The Missing Piece#150.src: And then in ten, fifteen, maybe even twenty-five years... we'll finally be able to rest in its shade.
The Missing Piece#150.dst: 然后再过十年、十五年，也许甚至二十五年……我们终于就能在它的树荫下休息了。

The Missing Piece#151.src: Twenty-five years!? We'll be old by then!
The Missing Piece#151.dst: 二十五年！？到时候我们都老了！
The Missing Piece#151.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#152.src: Oh, I know! We could have a picnic underneath its canopy Doesn't that sound nice, {u}?
The Missing Piece#152.dst: 噢，我知道了！我们可以在它的树荫下野餐听起来不错吧，{u}？
The Missing Piece#152.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#153.src: ... It does. It does sound nice, Elise. Perhaps we could.
The Missing Piece#153.dst: ……是啊。听起来很不错，Elise。也许我们可以。

The Missing Piece#154.src: Go on, give it some more water. Or it'll never grow an inch!
The Missing Piece#154.dst: 去吧，再给它浇点水。不然它一寸都长不高！

The Missing Piece#159.src: I was just thinking... If I were to die some day, I'd like to be buried here, under the tree.
The Missing Piece#159.dst: 我只是在想……如果我哪天死了，我想葬在这里，在这棵树下。

The Missing Piece#160.src: Huh? What could possibly make you think about such silly things? We still have a long life left ahead of us, don't we?
The Missing Piece#160.dst: 嗯？你怎么会想这种傻事？我们还有很长的日子要过，不是吗？
The Missing Piece#160.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#161.src: Of course, you're right. I'm sorry, I'm just not used to this...
The Missing Piece#161.dst: 当然，你说得对。抱歉，我只是还不习惯这样……

The Missing Piece#164.src: Let's just enjoy the sun, for a bit. There's still work tomorrow.
The Missing Piece#164.dst: 我们就好好晒一会儿太阳吧。明天还得上工呢。
The Missing Piece#164.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#167.src: Hm. I shall leave the worrying for another day, I think. Today is a good day... not a day for worrying.
The Missing Piece#167.dst: 嗯。我想这些烦恼就留到改天再说吧。今天是个好日子……不是烦恼的日子。
The Missing Piece#167.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#168.src: In fact, today is too nice a day to waste it... by not going anywhere, that is. Wouldn't you agree?
The Missing Piece#168.dst: 事实上，今天天气这么好，要是哪都不去……就太浪费了。你不觉得吗？
The Missing Piece#168.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#170.src: Follow Elise to the roof at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#170.dst: 跟着 Elise 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的屋顶。

The Missing Piece#171.src: Ah... Do you see that factory off that way? I used to work there, back when I was younger...
The Missing Piece#171.dst: 啊……你看到那边那座工厂了吗？我年轻的时候在那里工作过……
The Missing Piece#171.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#172.src: We mass-produced bread for the higher regions... Tedious work, and thankless too.
The Missing Piece#172.dst: 我们为上层地区大量生产面包……工作乏味，还没人感激。
The Missing Piece#172.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#173.src: I'm sure you have noticed, but things around here aren't too easy. Some people even go as far as stealing when times are tough...
The Missing Piece#173.dst: 你一定注意到了，这一带的日子不太好过。有些人日子难熬的时候甚至会去偷……
The Missing Piece#173.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#174.src: Fortunately... I never had to. They would let us take some home, every once in a while.
The Missing Piece#174.dst: 幸好……我从来不需要偷。他们偶尔会让我们带一些回家。
The Missing Piece#174.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#175.src: Those were good days. On those occasions, we'd go and have ourselves a picnic, me and- hm. Just me, I suppose.
The Missing Piece#175.dst: 那是段美好的日子。每逢那种时候，我们就会去野餐，我和——嗯。我想，只有我一个人吧。
The Missing Piece#175.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#176.src: A shame it's so hard to come by... the thefts became a real problem, you know. The Crown ended up building a vault down under the factory to keep it all secure!
The Missing Piece#176.dst: 可惜那东西太难弄到了……偷窃成了个大问题，你知道吗。王室最后在工厂底下盖了一座金库，把面包全都锁起来！
The Missing Piece#176.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#177.src: How long, since I last had some? Years, surely... not like any of that bread ever makes it to us poor folk, ha!
The Missing Piece#177.dst: 上次吃到是多久以前了？肯定好几年了……那些面包从来就不会落到我们这些穷人手里，哈！
The Missing Piece#177.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#178.src: But it'd be nice to have some again, I suppose... reminisce on old times.
The Missing Piece#178.dst: 不过要是能再吃一次就好了，我想……缅怀一下往日时光。
The Missing Piece#178.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#180.dst: 很贵，但只要价钱合适……我相信你弄得到。你看起来不像是会被这种事难倒的人，对吧，送信的？

The Missing Piece#181.src: Ha! Well, do your best, either way. Once you come back, I have a plan for what we can do today. How's that sound?

The Missing Piece#182.src: Try to enter the Bread Factory at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#183.src: Oh, no... You know! You know! Speak to that constable first, and perhaps, I'll tell you more.
The Missing Piece#183.dst: 噢，不……你知道！你知道！先去跟那个治安官谈谈，然后，也许，我会告诉你更多。

The Missing Piece#184.src: If you've come to beg, you might as well leave.
The Missing Piece#184.dst: 如果你是来讨东西的，那还是走吧。
The Missing Piece#184.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#185.src: Huh? Alright, bud. We all do.
The Missing Piece#185.dst: 嗯？好吧，老兄。我们都一样。
The Missing Piece#185.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#187.src: Do I look like a vending machine to you? Go find somewhere else. We just make bread here, we don't sell it.
The Missing Piece#187.dst: 我看起来像自动贩卖机吗？去别处吧。我们这里只做面包，不卖面包。

The Missing Piece#188.src: Get out of here pal, you shouldn't be loitering around under a Constable's watch.
The Missing Piece#188.dst: 滚吧，伙计，在治安官眼皮底下可不该到处闲晃。
The Missing Piece#188.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#189.src: But, but, but! No buts. Don't make me have to do something! The paperwork is always such a hassle...
The Missing Piece#189.dst: 可是，可是，可是！没有可是。别逼我采取行动！文书工作总是很麻烦……
The Missing Piece#189.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#191.src: Obviously not... We have enough problems as it is, what with that stolen barrel last week... And the production quotas...
The Missing Piece#191.dst: 当然不是……我们的麻烦已经够多了，上周才被偷了一桶……还有生产配额……
The Missing Piece#191.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#192.src: Don't you have something better to do anyway?
The Missing Piece#192.dst: 你难道没有更好的事可做吗？
The Missing Piece#192.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#194.src: Over here, friend of a friend!

The Missing Piece#196.dst: 你知道吗？你知道吗？进入任何建筑都不只一种方法。
The Missing Piece#196.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#197.src: I'll tell you! But, stealing is unethical, you must know!
The Missing Piece#197.dst: 我告诉你！不过，偷东西是不道德的，你一定要知道！
The Missing Piece#197.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#198.src: As long as she doesn't know! She won't know! Do you understand?
The Missing Piece#198.dst: 只要她不知道！她就不会知道！明白吗？
The Missing Piece#198.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#206.dst: 嗯？那不算回答！现在，告诉我你是谁，不然我就自己来看看！而且我从不忘记长相，记住这点！

The Missing Piece#222.src: At my factory? What are you implying!?
The Missing Piece#222.dst: 在我的工厂？你这是在暗示什么！？
The Missing Piece#222.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#223.dst: 我什么都没暗示。需要我提醒你你的身份吗？我今天来这里是奉女王陛下的旨意。你真的想违抗吗？

The Missing Piece#224.dst: 我……我深表歉意……我不是那个意——

The Missing Piece#227.src: Enough aimless rambling. My time is limited. Pull up those records on this Elise, immediately.
The Missing Piece#227.dst: 别再东拉西扯了。我的时间有限。立刻调出这个 Elise 的记录。

The Missing Piece#228.src: U-understood, ma'am... I'll get them right away.
The Missing Piece#228.dst: 明、明白，女士……我马上去拿。

The Missing Piece#236.dst: 我倒想知道……你来这里是为了什么？

The Missing Piece#237.src: I know better than to expect an answer. But it does not matter, in the end. We will get it out of you eventually.
The Missing Piece#237.dst: 我知道不该指望你回答。不过到头来那并不重要。我们迟早会从你嘴里问出来。

The Missing Piece#245.dst: 快开门！我们知道你在里面！

The Missing Piece#246.dst: 真的，你应该躲起来。没关系，我以前对付过他们这种人。我会把他们打发走。

The Missing Piece#248.dst: 很好。快，找个地方躲起来！

The Missing Piece#249.dst: 等一下！我躲到那株植物后面！

The Missing Piece#253.dst: 你说是朋友？那你应该能告诉我她为什么不应门！

The Missing Piece#323.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#324.src: How quaint. Doesn't it get lonely, living up here all by your lonesome?
The Missing Piece#324.dst: 真有意思。一个人孤零零地住在这上面，不寂寞吗？
The Missing Piece#324.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#326.src: Anyhow, I am required to inform you that you are in breach of the ordinance on water usage and will have to-
The Missing Piece#326.dst: 总之，我必须通知你，你违反了用水条例，必须——
The Missing Piece#326.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#327.src: Inspector. A message from the Authority.
The Missing Piece#327.dst: 督察员。水务局传来的消息。
The Missing Piece#327.speaker: Sentinel

The Missing Piece#331.src: There you go. Now, what business could Her Majesty's authorities possibly have with little old me?
The Missing Piece#331.dst: 请进。好了，女王陛下的官员找我这个小老太婆能有什么事？
The Missing Piece#331.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#332.src: We are here to execute a search. You water usage levels have exceeded you authorized allotment.
The Missing Piece#332.dst: 我们是来执行搜查的。你的用水量已经超出了你的核定配额。
The Missing Piece#332.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#337.src: We'll be done here after we've finished our inspection.
The Missing Piece#337.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#338.src: Say, would you prefer us searching the lower or upper floor first?
The Missing Piece#338.dst: 说说看，你希望我们先搜楼下还是楼上？
The Missing Piece#338.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#340.src: Well, seems you're in luck this time, subject.
The Missing Piece#340.dst: 嗯，看来这次你运气好，对象。
The Missing Piece#340.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#341.src: Some higher authority has overruled our command... we're being recalled.
The Missing Piece#341.dst: 某个更高层的机关推翻了我们的命令……我们被召回了。
The Missing Piece#341.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#342.src: But don't be mistaken. We'll be back!
The Missing Piece#342.dst: 不过别搞错了。我们还会回来的！
The Missing Piece#342.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#343.src: Well, you won't be welcome next time!
The Missing Piece#343.dst: 哼，下次你们可不会受欢迎！
The Missing Piece#343.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#344.src: Nuisances, all of them... Well, it worked out in the end, didn't it?
The Missing Piece#344.dst: 一群讨厌鬼……嗯，最后还是解决了，对吧？
The Missing Piece#344.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#345.src: They're gone, you can come out now.
The Missing Piece#345.dst: 他们走了，你可以出来了。
The Missing Piece#345.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#346.src: Come, let's sit down and have a talk.
The Missing Piece#346.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#349.src: Right! The bread! So forgetful these days...
The Missing Piece#349.dst: 对了！面包！最近真是健忘……
The Missing Piece#349.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#350.src: Well? How did it go? Did you get any? I hope it wasn't too much trouble...
The Missing Piece#350.dst: 怎么样？顺利吗？拿到了吗？希望没给你添太多麻烦……
The Missing Piece#350.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#351.src: Oh, wonderful. Thank you. That should be everything we need...
The Missing Piece#351.dst: 噢，太好了。谢谢你。这样我们需要的东西就齐了……
The Missing Piece#351.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#352.src: Well, if there was no other way... If the Authority is going to stomp in here looking for plants, taking a loaf of bread in return seems like a fair deal!
The Missing Piece#352.dst: 嗯，既然没有别的办法……既然水务局要闯进来找植物，那拿一条面包作为回报似乎也挺公平的！
The Missing Piece#352.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#354.src: Ah... How nostalgic. It really does bring me back to those good old days.
The Missing Piece#354.dst: 啊……好怀念。真的让我想起那些美好的往日。
The Missing Piece#354.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#355.src: There was one time though... We... No, I bought it... Argh, why can't I remember!
The Missing Piece#355.dst: 不过有一次……我们……不，是我买的……啊，为什么我就是想不起来！
The Missing Piece#355.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#356.src: How strange... Again, this feeling... As if- as if there's something I should be remembering... but can't.
The Missing Piece#356.dst: 真奇怪……又是这种感觉……好像——好像有什么我应该记得……却想不起来。
The Missing Piece#356.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#357.dst: 要是我能想起来就好了……
The Missing Piece#357.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#358.src: Do you remember how we first met? All those years ago?
The Missing Piece#358.dst: 你还记得我们第一次见面吗？那么多年前？

The Missing Piece#359.src: Of course I do! But... thinking about it now, maybe I was a bit... cold.
The Missing Piece#359.dst: 当然记得！不过……现在想想，我那时候可能有点……冷淡。
The Missing Piece#359.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#360.src: You were fine! You were the only one who...
The Missing Piece#360.dst: 你很好啊！你是唯一一个……

The Missing Piece#362.src: You were the only one who even noticed I was there.
The Missing Piece#362.dst: 你是唯一一个注意到我在那里的人。

The Missing Piece#363.src: Ah- hello. I'm {u}, I'm new here. Nice to meet you.
The Missing Piece#363.dst: 啊——你好。我是 {u}，刚来这里。很高兴认识你。

The Missing Piece#364.src: The name's Elise, do a good job and I'm sure we'll get along.
The Missing Piece#364.dst: 我叫 Elise，好好干，我相信我们会处得来的。
The Missing Piece#364.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#365.src: Right, yes. Of course... I'll try my best!
The Missing Piece#365.dst: 好，好的。当然……我会尽力的！

The Missing Piece#366.src: ... You know what, have this. It'll help you get through the day.
The Missing Piece#366.dst: ……你知道吗，这个给你。能帮你撑过今天。
The Missing Piece#366.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#370.src: Really? I was only working there for a month!
The Missing Piece#370.dst: 真的吗？我在那里才工作了一个月！

The Missing Piece#371.src: Oh, sure... but it was a good month, wasn't it?
The Missing Piece#371.dst: 噢，是啊……不过那是很好的一个月，不是吗？
The Missing Piece#371.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#372.src: And even after you were transferred away... I had something to look forward to at the end of my shifts.
The Missing Piece#372.dst: 就算后来你被调走了……我下班后也还是有盼头。
The Missing Piece#372.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#373.src: Ah... well... now you have something to look forward to when you come home, as well.
The Missing Piece#373.dst: 啊……嗯……现在你回家的时候也有盼头了。

The Missing Piece#374.src: Ha! I guess I do, don't I...
The Missing Piece#374.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#375.src: But it all seems so small from up here... doesn't it? Just look at the view!
The Missing Piece#375.dst: 不过从这上面看，一切都显得好渺小……对吧？看看这风景！
The Missing Piece#375.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#376.src: It really is beautiful... up here, it's like nothing else matters except for us.
The Missing Piece#376.dst: 真的很美……在这上面，好像除了我们，其他一切都不重要了。

The Missing Piece#377.src: ...I wish we could stay like this forever...
The Missing Piece#377.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#378.src: ...oh. So do I, Elise... so do I...

The Missing Piece#379.src: Ha, but why do you sound so sad?
The Missing Piece#379.dst: 哈，可你为什么听起来这么难过？
The Missing Piece#379.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#381.src: It's nothing... we'll stay like this... forever. I promise.
The Missing Piece#381.dst: 没什么……我们会永远……这样。我保证。

The Missing Piece#382.src: Her, again... Who is she? Why am I remembering these things?
The Missing Piece#382.dst: 又是她……她是谁？我为什么会想起这些事？
The Missing Piece#382.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#384.src: Well, there's nothing that can be done about it now, is there? Say, why don't we head out?
The Missing Piece#384.dst: 嗯，现在也拿它没办法，不是吗？说起来，我们何不出去走走？
The Missing Piece#384.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#385.src: Oh, dear. Did I forget to tell you? The bread is for a picnic!
The Missing Piece#385.dst: 噢，天哪。我没告诉你吗？面包是要拿去野餐的！
The Missing Piece#385.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#386.src: I know the perfect place... in fact, you reminded me of it. It has a view over the entire Roughworks, can you believe that?
The Missing Piece#386.dst: 我知道一个完美的地方……其实，是你让我想起来的。在那里能俯瞰整个 Roughworks，你相信吗？
The Missing Piece#386.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#387.src: Although... Thinking about it, it's a bit far... I don't know if my old legs will carry me all the way there, ha!
The Missing Piece#387.dst: 不过……想想，那里有点远……我不知道这双老腿能不能撑到那里，哈！
The Missing Piece#387.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#388.src: Someone around here has to have the code to this...
The Missing Piece#388.dst: 这附近一定有人知道这个的密码……

The Missing Piece#389.src: Now all you have to do is get out of this place somehow...
The Missing Piece#389.dst: 现在你只需要想办法离开这个地方……

The Missing Piece#390.src: Maybe if you hit those bottles, it will move the beam.
The Missing Piece#390.dst: 也许打中那些瓶子，就能让光束移动。

The Missing Piece#394.src: Well, what do you say, then? Just talk to me when you want to head out.
The Missing Piece#394.dst: 嗯，那你怎么说？想出发的时候跟我说一声。
The Missing Piece#394.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#396.src: Well, what do you say? Shall we head out?
The Missing Piece#396.dst: 嗯，你怎么说？我们出发吗？
The Missing Piece#396.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#399.src: Oh, you can really see a lot from up here... Let's go!
The Missing Piece#399.dst: 噢，从这上面真的能看到好多……走吧！
The Missing Piece#399.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#400.src: Where to? I know just the place for this! Let's see, it's...
The Missing Piece#400.dst: 去哪？我知道一个再合适不过的地方！我想想，是在……
The Missing Piece#400.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#401.src: Hm... I think... Forward! Yes, I think it was straight forward from here. Although, my memory might be a little hazy...
The Missing Piece#401.dst: 嗯……我想……往前！对，我想从这里一直往前走就是了。不过，我的记性可能有点模糊……
The Missing Piece#401.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#403.src: Ah, hm... I think we turn left here...
The Missing Piece#403.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#404.src: No, wait... It's right, we definitely have to turn right!
The Missing Piece#404.dst: 不，等等……是右边，我们肯定得右转！
The Missing Piece#404.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#406.src: That house feels familiar... I think... yes, turn right here!
The Missing Piece#406.dst: 那栋房子感觉好熟悉……我想……对，这里右转！
The Missing Piece#406.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#408.src: Stop! Hmm... I don't think it's across this bridge, at least. Then that must mean...
The Missing Piece#408.dst: 停！嗯……至少我不觉得是过这座桥。那就代表……
The Missing Piece#408.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#409.src: Oh, what's the matter! We'll find it eventually, right? I'm pretty sure it's to the left!
The Missing Piece#409.dst: 噢，有什么关系！我们总会找到的，对吧？我很确定是在左边！
The Missing Piece#409.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#411.src: Yes, this is it! It's just around this corner, I'm sure of it!
The Missing Piece#411.dst: 对，就是这里！就在这个转角后面，我很确定！
The Missing Piece#411.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#413.src: Here! I remember now... it's in here!
The Missing Piece#413.dst: 这里！我想起来了……就在这里面！
The Missing Piece#413.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#414.src: I don't remember it being so overgrown, though...
The Missing Piece#414.dst: 不过我不记得这里长得这么茂密……
The Missing Piece#414.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#415.src: How long has it been? I can't recall the last time I was here...
The Missing Piece#415.dst: 多久了？我想不起上次来这里是什么时候了……
The Missing Piece#415.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#417.src: Ah, it's blocked... Well. I didn't want to bring it up, but it seems we're out of options.
The Missing Piece#417.dst: 啊，被挡住了……嗯。我本来不想提的，不过看来我们没别的办法了。
The Missing Piece#417.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#418.src: Oh, there's no need to pretend anymore. I know what you are. You're one of them, aren't you?
The Missing Piece#418.dst: 噢，不必再装了。我知道你是什么人。你是他们其中之一，对吧？
The Missing Piece#418.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#419.src: The cursed, as the Crown calls them. Not that I care!
The Missing Piece#419.dst: 受诅者，王室是这么称呼他们的。我可不在乎！
The Missing Piece#419.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#420.src: Why should I? I'm old! I have enough to worry about as is...
The Missing Piece#420.dst: 我为什么要在乎？我老了！我要操心的事已经够多了……
The Missing Piece#420.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#421.src: Besides, it's certainly useful in situations like this, isn't it? Be a dearie and do one of your little tricks, won't you?
The Missing Piece#421.dst: 况且，在这种情况下还挺有用的，不是吗？乖，亲爱的，变个你的小戏法吧？
The Missing Piece#421.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#423.src: That's it... Let me down now, I can walk the rest of the way myself.
The Missing Piece#423.dst: 就是这样……放我下来吧，剩下的路我可以自己走。
The Missing Piece#423.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#425.src: It's a little more... well, deserted, than I remember. But that's fine.
The Missing Piece#425.dst: 这里比我记忆中……嗯，荒凉了一点。不过没关系。
The Missing Piece#425.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#426.src: We can take this elevator to the top. You'll have to find a way into the control room though... It shouldn't be too hard to reach!
The Missing Piece#426.dst: 我们可以搭这个升降梯到顶上。不过你得想办法进控制室……应该不会太难到！
The Missing Piece#426.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#427.src: It's that thing up over there. The tunnel on the right will get you to it.
The Missing Piece#427.dst: 就是那边那个。右边的隧道能带你过去。
The Missing Piece#427.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#431.src: Can you hear me? I'm down here!
The Missing Piece#431.dst: 你听得到我吗？我在下面！
The Missing Piece#431.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#432.src: Use the controls to get me up! You know how it works, right?
The Missing Piece#432.dst: 用控制器把我升上去！你知道怎么操作吧？
The Missing Piece#432.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#433.src: Use the controls at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to bring Elise up.
The Missing Piece#433.dst: 使用 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的控制器把 Elise 升上来。

The Missing Piece#436.src: Maybe if... oh, I know. Put something on the up button, then you can clear the blockage... and we'll go up.
The Missing Piece#436.dst: 也许要是……噢，我知道了。在上升按钮上放个东西，然后你去清除堵塞……我们就能上去了。
The Missing Piece#436.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#437.src: Perfect! Now it will move, if only we can get it unstuck...
The Missing Piece#437.dst: 完美！现在它会动了，只要我们能让它不再卡住……
The Missing Piece#437.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#438.src: If you could get up there, somehow...
The Missing Piece#438.dst: 要是你能想办法上到那里……
The Missing Piece#438.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#440.src: Oh well, this place seems abandoned anyhow! Who cares about a little destruction?
The Missing Piece#440.dst: 噢，算了，反正这地方好像荒废了！谁在乎一点破坏？
The Missing Piece#440.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#441.src: Go up there and see if you can find a way to get this thing going again.
The Missing Piece#441.dst: 上去那里看看能不能想办法让这东西重新动起来。
The Missing Piece#441.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#443.src: Throw a brick at the blockage at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#444.src: How's it going? Can you see anything?
The Missing Piece#444.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#451.src: Follow Elise to the cliff at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#451.dst: 跟着 Elise 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的悬崖边。

The Missing Piece#452.src: Ah, isn't this place nice. The breeze, the view, everything.
The Missing Piece#452.dst: 啊，这地方真好。微风、风景，一切都好。
The Missing Piece#452.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#453.src: You can even see the trees of the {p} swaying from up here...
The Missing Piece#453.dst: 从这上面甚至能看到 {p} 的树在摇曳……
The Missing Piece#453.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#454.src: And finally! A place to sit! I'm sorely in need of some relaxation after this eventful day.
The Missing Piece#454.dst: 终于！有地方坐了！经历了这么多事的一天，我实在需要好好放松一下。
The Missing Piece#454.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#455.src: Please, let's sit down and enjoy the view for a bit.
The Missing Piece#455.dst: 来，我们坐下来欣赏一会儿风景吧。
The Missing Piece#455.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#457.src: Hm. It's strange. All day, I've been... reminiscing, I suppose. And now, seeing this view... it fills me with that same, nostalgic feeling.
The Missing Piece#457.dst: 嗯。真奇怪。一整天，我都在……缅怀过去，我想。而现在，看着这片风景……又让我充满了同样的怀旧感。
The Missing Piece#457.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#458.src: All day, I've been having these... visions of the past. Of these things I can't recall ever happening.
The Missing Piece#458.dst: 一整天，我都看到这些过去的画面。那些我不记得发生过的事。
The Missing Piece#458.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#459.src: And I... well, truthfully, I'm not sure how to feel about it...
The Missing Piece#459.dst: 而我……嗯，老实说，我不知道该怎么看待这些……
The Missing Piece#459.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#460.src: But I know- I know in my heart, that there's something missing... a piece that would make it all fit.
The Missing Piece#460.dst: 可是我知道——我心里知道，缺了什么……缺了一块，能让一切拼凑完整的那一块。
The Missing Piece#460.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#462.src: In every dream she's there beside me... but I don't even remember her name. I can't even recall her face...
The Missing Piece#462.dst: 每个梦里她都在我身边……可我连她的名字都不记得。我甚至想不起她的脸……
The Missing Piece#462.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#463.src: If she was this important to me... then how could I forget?
The Missing Piece#463.dst: 如果她对我这么重要……我怎么可能会忘记？
The Missing Piece#463.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#466.src: Hurgh... hurgh... One second, I need to catch my breath.
The Missing Piece#466.dst: 呼……呼……等一下，我得喘口气。
The Missing Piece#466.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#467.src: Hm... Do you know this person? They're not an inspector... are they?
The Missing Piece#467.dst: 嗯……你认识这个人吗？他不是督察员……吧？
The Missing Piece#467.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#468.src: So, as I was going to say-
The Missing Piece#468.dst: 那么，就像我刚才要说的——
The Missing Piece#468.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#469.src: Okay, fine! I'll get straight to the point.
The Missing Piece#469.dst: 好啦，好啦！我直接说重点。
The Missing Piece#469.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#470.src: I found more letters to deliver, and I was on my way to deliver them when I saw you two running out! Can you imagine how shocked I was?
The Missing Piece#470.dst: 我又找到了一些要送的信，我正要去送的时候就看到你们两个跑出去！你能想象我有多震惊吗？
The Missing Piece#470.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#471.src: That being that, I naturally decided to follow you, the good postmaster that I am. You sure didn't make it easy though! I barely managed to make it up here... It's a nice spot, by the way.
The Missing Piece#471.dst: 既然这样，身为一个好邮政局长，我自然决定跟上你们。你们可真没让我轻松！我差点就上不来……顺带一提，这地方不错。
The Missing Piece#471.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#472.src: But... how could you have possibly made it up here...?
The Missing Piece#472.dst: 可是……你到底是怎么上来的……？
The Missing Piece#472.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#473.src: Getting up here is nothing to a university graduate like me!
The Missing Piece#473.dst: 上到这里对我这种大学毕业生来说不算什么！
The Missing Piece#473.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#476.src: Well, that was all that I came for I suppose. So...
The Missing Piece#476.dst: 嗯，我想我来就只是为了这个。所以……
The Missing Piece#476.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#477.src: You came all this way just for that!? At least have a piece of bread, or something...!
The Missing Piece#477.dst: 你大老远跑来就只为了这个！？至少吃块面包什么的吧……！
The Missing Piece#477.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#478.src: No, no. I couldn't possibly! Duty calls, the post isn't going to sort itself, and all that... Oh, by Her Majesty, the backlog...
The Missing Piece#478.dst: 不，不。我怎么好意思！职责在身，邮件可不会自己分拣，诸如此类……噢，女王陛下在上，那堆积压的邮件……
The Missing Piece#478.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#479.src: Right! You! I hate to admit it, but it seems you've done your job well enough.
The Missing Piece#479.dst: 对了！你！我很不想承认，不过看来你的工作做得还算可以。
The Missing Piece#479.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#480.src: I happened to double check the records and it seems like my substitute, well, may have been someone else entirely!
The Missing Piece#480.dst: 我刚好又核对了一遍记录，看来我的代班，嗯，可能完全是另一个人！
The Missing Piece#480.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#481.src: No harm, no foul, right? The work's already done! No takesies-backsies! Okay?
The Missing Piece#481.dst: 没什么损失，对吧？工作都已经做完了！不准反悔！好吗？
The Missing Piece#481.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#483.src: Huh, what was that? I couldn't hear you! Okay, bye!
The Missing Piece#483.dst: 嗯，你说什么？我听不到！好，再见！
The Missing Piece#483.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#485.src: But it was certainly nice of them to deliver this letter. Let me take a look.
The Missing Piece#485.dst: 不过他特地把这封信送来，真是好心。让我看看。
The Missing Piece#485.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#487.src: Oh, I don't understand... What would she have to apologize for?
The Missing Piece#487.dst: 噢，我不明白……她有什么需要道歉的？
The Missing Piece#487.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#488.src: Please... {u}, take a breath. You're shaking.
The Missing Piece#488.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#490.src: Getting caught in a storm like that... really, I could have waited a few hours! You didn't need to push yourself to get here.
The Missing Piece#490.dst: 在那种暴风雨里被困住……说真的，我可以多等几个小时的！你不需要逼自己赶过来。
The Missing Piece#490.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#492.src: Yes, I know the weather's bad now... but eventually, it'll get better again. The clouds will clear and the sun will shine again. Right?
The Missing Piece#492.dst: 是啊，我知道现在天气很糟……不过总会好转的。云会散开，太阳会再出来。对吧？
The Missing Piece#492.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#494.src: You know, it's not so bad with rain once in a while. Means we don't have to water the flowers, at least! And nothing beats the smell of wet grass after rain, don't you agree?
The Missing Piece#494.dst: 你知道吗，偶尔下场雨也不坏。至少不用浇花了！而且没有什么比雨后湿草的气味更好闻了，你不觉得吗？
The Missing Piece#494.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#495.src: We could do something after it clears up. It's been a while since you visited, so why not go to our spot? I should still have some leftover bread lying around...
The Missing Piece#495.dst: 等雨停了我们可以做点什么。你好久没来了，何不去我们的老地方？我应该还有些剩下的面包……
The Missing Piece#495.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#496.src: Elise. You're- please, forgive me- you're in danger. I-
The Missing Piece#496.dst: Elise。你——求你，原谅我——你有危险。我——

The Missing Piece#497.src: I'm in danger? I'm just an ordinary worker, what reason would anyone have to harm me? I'll be fine.
The Missing Piece#497.dst: 我有危险？我只是个普通工人，谁会有理由伤害我？我不会有事的。
The Missing Piece#497.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#498.src: {u}, you're the one pushing herself through this weather, clearly panicking...
The Missing Piece#498.dst: {u}，冒着这种天气硬撑的人是你，而且明显很慌乱……
The Missing Piece#498.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#499.src: I barely get to see you anymore. And now, out of nowhere, you're here in this state... What's going on? Please, just talk to me.
The Missing Piece#499.dst: 我现在几乎见不到你了。结果现在，你突然这副样子跑来……到底怎么了？拜托，跟我说说。
The Missing Piece#499.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#500.src: ...ha. I- I haven't been truthful with you, Elise, and- I can explain later. We need to get out of here, before they-
The Missing Piece#500.dst: ……哈。我——我一直没对你说实话，Elise，而且——我之后再解释。我们得离开这里，在他们——

The Missing Piece#503.src: Why would they... no, this doesn't make any sense...
The Missing Piece#503.dst: 他们为什么会……不，这说不通……

The Missing Piece#504.src: Hm. Well, then maybe it's nothing. I'll go see who it is.
The Missing Piece#504.dst: 嗯。好吧，那也许没什么。我去看看是谁。
The Missing Piece#504.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#505.src: As if one wasn't enough... who could possibly be foolish enough to brave a storm just to come visit this little place? Whatever it is, it can wait.
The Missing Piece#505.dst: 一个还不够似的……到底谁会傻到冒着暴风雨来这个小地方？不管是什么事，都可以等。
The Missing Piece#505.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#508.src: No... No... What are you... Why are you-
The Missing Piece#508.dst: 不……不……你们在……你们为什么——
The Missing Piece#508.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#509.src: Apologies for the disturbance, madam. But I'm afraid we have business to attend to.
The Missing Piece#509.dst: 抱歉打扰了，女士。不过恐怕我们有公务要处理。
The Missing Piece#509.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#511.src: {u}, {u}, why are they here? Why... why won't you answer me...?
The Missing Piece#511.dst: {u}，{u}，他们为什么在这里？为什么……你为什么不回答我……？
The Missing Piece#511.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#512.src: What have you done? I... Please, just explain... I- I...
The Missing Piece#512.dst: 你做了什么？我……拜托，解释一下……我——我……
The Missing Piece#512.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#513.src: I... how did I overlook this...?
The Missing Piece#513.dst: 我……我怎么会忽略了这一点……？

The Missing Piece#514.src: Seems you're not quite the strategic mastermind you though yourself, Lioness.
The Missing Piece#514.dst: 看来你并不是自以为的那种谋略大师啊，母狮。
The Missing Piece#514.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#516.src: Elise... if you... if you just cooperate...

The Missing Piece#517.src: Then... everything will be fine. It... it will.
The Missing Piece#517.dst: 那……一切都会没事的。一定……一定会的。

The Missing Piece#520.src: She... What did she do? Why did she wrap me up in it?
The Missing Piece#520.dst: 她……她做了什么？她为什么要把我卷进去？
The Missing Piece#520.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#521.src: Everything I remember... it just leaves me with more questions than answers. Why can't I remember her...? Why!?
The Missing Piece#521.dst: 我记得的一切……只留给我更多的疑问，而不是答案。为什么我想不起她……？为什么！？
The Missing Piece#521.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#522.src: I- I'm just an ordinary factory worker! I woke up early, worked late, slept late... then did it all over again the next day.
The Missing Piece#522.dst: 我——我只是个普通的工厂工人！早早起床、工作到很晚、很晚才睡……然后隔天再重来一遍。
The Missing Piece#522.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#523.src: I've never said a word about the Crown! Why would they possibly care about... me...?
The Missing Piece#523.dst: 我从来没说过王室一句坏话！他们怎么可能会在乎……我……？
The Missing Piece#523.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#524.src: They... they took everything from me. My youth, my body, my time, and... and I never demanded anything in return.
The Missing Piece#524.dst: 他们……他们夺走了我的一切。我的青春、我的身体、我的时间，而……而我从来没要求过任何回报。
The Missing Piece#524.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#525.src: So, why... why can't I just have this? This one little thing? Why can't I remember her...?
The Missing Piece#525.dst: 所以，为什么……为什么我就不能拥有这个？这一件小小的东西？为什么我想不起她……？
The Missing Piece#525.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#526.src: ...oh, it might sound sad... but, looking back at it all like this...
The Missing Piece#526.dst: ……噢，这听起来可能很可悲……不过，像这样回头看这一切……
The Missing Piece#526.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#527.src: My life doesn't seem all that great, does it? Ha. Toiling away in a factory for someone else's bread...
The Missing Piece#527.dst: 我的人生看起来也没那么好，是吧？哈。在工厂里为别人的面包辛苦劳作……
The Missing Piece#527.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#528.src: But I can feel her. Even if... even if I can't remember her face, or her name, or her touch... I still feel her. Lingering in my heart. Shining.
The Missing Piece#528.dst: 可是我感觉得到她。就算……就算我想不起她的脸、她的名字、她的触碰……我还是感觉得到她。萦绕在我心里。闪闪发光。
The Missing Piece#528.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#529.src: ...it's all some sort of sick joke, isn't it?
The Missing Piece#529.dst: ……这一切都是个恶劣的玩笑，对吧？
The Missing Piece#529.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#530.src: They weren't content with all I sacrificed... they had to take even my memories? Is that it...?
The Missing Piece#530.dst: 我牺牲了那么多他们还不满足……连我的记忆都要夺走？是这样吗……？
The Missing Piece#530.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#532.src: Wherever you are now... whatever you did... whatever secrets you kept... I hope it was worth it.
The Missing Piece#532.dst: 无论你现在在哪里……无论你做了什么……无论你守着什么秘密……我希望那都值得。
The Missing Piece#532.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#533.src: I hope you burn this entire place to the ground.
The Missing Piece#533.dst: 我希望你把这整个地方烧成灰烬。
The Missing Piece#533.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#535.src: I just wish... we could have spent more time together.
The Missing Piece#535.dst: 我只是希望……我们能有更多时间在一起。
The Missing Piece#535.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#536.src: For a long time, I went along the path that had been laid before me. I did what was right.
The Missing Piece#536.dst: 很长一段时间，我都走在别人为我铺好的路上。做着正确的事。

The Missing Piece#537.src: But then... I met you, Elise.

The Missing Piece#538.src: I... I don't know what to say, {u}...
The Missing Piece#538.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#541.src: I see... a bird. A pigeon, it's old and gray. Its wings no longer work like they used to...
The Missing Piece#541.dst: 我看到……一只鸟。一只鸽子，又老又灰。它的翅膀已经不像以前那样好使了……
The Missing Piece#541.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#542.src: It wants to fly, but it can't... It's struggling...
The Missing Piece#542.dst: 它想飞，却飞不起来……它在挣扎……
The Missing Piece#542.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#544.src: No, I can't! It's too sad...
The Missing Piece#544.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#546.src: It's sitting beneath the shade of a canopy, singing. Like a cry, almost, mourning.
The Missing Piece#546.dst: 它坐在树荫下，在唱歌。几乎像是在哭，在哀悼。
The Missing Piece#546.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#547.src: The clouds, dark clouds are gathering. A storm is coming. The bird is looking around, frantically searching. It's scared.
The Missing Piece#547.dst: 云，乌云正在聚集。暴风雨要来了。那只鸟四处张望，拼命地寻找。它很害怕。
The Missing Piece#547.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#548.src: It... It calls out, for something... or someone...
The Missing Piece#548.dst: 它……它在呼唤，呼唤某样东西……或是某个人……
The Missing Piece#548.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#549.src: Who is it calling for, Elise?

The Missing Piece#554.src: I won't forget! I won't forget! I won't! I promised! I promised I'd never forget you!
The Missing Piece#554.dst: 我不会忘记！我不会忘记！我不会！我答应过！我答应过永远不会忘记你！
The Missing Piece#554.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#557.src: You are an ordinary worker from the Roughworks. You work an ordinary job, and lead an ordinary but solitary life.
The Missing Piece#557.dst: 你是 Roughworks 的一名普通工人。你做着普通的工作，过着普通而孤单的生活。
The Missing Piece#557.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#559.src: She is nothing to you. You have never met her. You will never meet her.
The Missing Piece#559.dst: 她对你来说什么都不是。你从没见过她。你永远不会见到她。
The Missing Piece#559.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#562.src: You are nothing to her! She is nothing to you! Soon you'll forget she ever existed.
The Missing Piece#562.dst: 你对她来说什么都不是！她对你来说什么都不是！很快你就会忘记她曾经存在过。
The Missing Piece#562.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#563.src: No, I will never forget! She was everything to me! She is everything to me! I will never forget her!
The Missing Piece#563.dst: 不，我永远不会忘记！她曾经是我的一切！她现在也是我的一切！我永远不会忘记她！
The Missing Piece#563.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#564.src: She is nothing to you. You have never met her. You will never meet her.
The Missing Piece#564.dst: 她对你来说什么都不是。你从没见过她。你永远不会见到她。
The Missing Piece#564.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#565.src: You do not know her face, nor her voice, nor her touch.
The Missing Piece#565.dst: 你不知道她的脸，不知道她的声音，也不知道她的触碰。
The Missing Piece#565.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#567.src: She is nothing to you. You have never met her. You will never meet her. You have always been ordinary, you will always be ordinary.
The Missing Piece#567.dst: 她对你来说什么都不是。你从没见过她。你永远不会见到她。你一直都很普通，你永远都会很普通。
The Missing Piece#567.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#570.src: I will ask once more. Is your directive understood?
The Missing Piece#570.dst: 我再问一次。你的指令，明白了吗？
The Missing Piece#570.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#581.src: And I'll never forget it, Elise.
The Missing Piece#581.speaker: Syndra

The Missing Piece#584.src: My legs... feel funny... I think... I think I'm in need of some rest. A long, long rest... I deserve that... don't I?
The Missing Piece#584.dst: 我的腿……感觉怪怪的……我想……我想我需要休息一下了。好好地、长长地休息……这是我应得的……对吧？
The Missing Piece#584.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#585.src: You'll take me home... won't you? I want to see it, at least once more... The tree.
The Missing Piece#585.dst: 你会带我回家的……对吧？我想再看一眼，至少再一次……那棵树。
The Missing Piece#585.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#589.src: It's grown so tall... and so beautiful. Hasn't it, Syndra...?
The Missing Piece#589.dst: 它长得好高了……而且好美。对吧，Syndra……？
The Missing Piece#589.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#590.src: If... If only... you could have seen it... like this...
The Missing Piece#590.dst: 要是……要是……你能看到它……现在的样子……
The Missing Piece#590.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#593.src: Pick some of Elise's flowers around her house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#593.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 附近摘一些 Elise 家周围的花。

The Olmic Rune#000.src: It has no fuel left, maybe you can start it again?
The Olmic Rune#000.dst: 它没有燃料了，也许你能让它重新启动？

The Olmic Rune#001.src: The crystalized magic on the floor seems unstable. Maybe something can shatter it...
The Olmic Rune#001.dst: 地上结晶化的魔法似乎很不稳定。也许有什么东西能把它打碎……

The Olmic Rune#003.src: The strange shard is reacting to the floor...
The Olmic Rune#003.dst: 那块奇怪的碎片对地面产生了反应……

The Olmic Rune#007.src: The loud noise is bound to attract creatures of the expanse.
The Olmic Rune#007.dst: 这么大的动静，一定会引来荒原上的生物。

The Olmic Rune#008.src: It looks like the machine is about to break through!
The Olmic Rune#008.dst: 看起来机器马上就要钻穿了！

The Olmic Rune#010.src: Find some sort of fuel in the Ruined City.
The Olmic Rune#010.dst: 在废墟之城里找些燃料。

The Olmic Rune#011.src: Explore the cave for the fuel

The Olmic Rune#012.src: Collect [{~} Fuel Sprites] and bring it back to the machine.
The Olmic Rune#012.dst: 收集 [{~} 燃料精灵]，带回机器那里。

The Olmic Rune#013.src: Head back to the machine at [{~},-{~}]

The Olmic Rune#014.src: Defend the machine from the incoming attackers.
The Olmic Rune#014.dst: 保护机器，抵挡来袭的敌人。

The Order of the Grook#000.src: Talk to Seasum in a tower on {p}.
The Order of the Grook#000.dst: 与 {p} 一座塔里的 Seasum 交谈。

The Order of the Grook#001.src: Ugh... I really, really, reeeeally don't want to go...
