The Price of Ingenuity#133.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#135.src: It's an expression, dumbass. Like you're one to talk. Why are you half-naked?
The Price of Ingenuity#135.dst: 那是个比喻，蠢蛋。你还好意思说。你干嘛半裸？
The Price of Ingenuity#135.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#136.src: To show off my abs? Obviously. Anyway, {u}, why don't you decide who goes first?
The Price of Ingenuity#136.dst: 为了炫耀我的腹肌？当然啦。总之，{u}，你来决定谁先上吧？
The Price of Ingenuity#136.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#138.src: Who, me? Sorry, but I'll sit this one out until you're all done.
The Price of Ingenuity#138.dst: 谁，我？抱歉，你们全部表演完之前我先不上。
The Price of Ingenuity#138.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#139.src: Got to save the best for last, right? Heh.
The Price of Ingenuity#139.dst: 好戏总要留到最后，对吧？嘿。
The Price of Ingenuity#139.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#140.src: I'll have to add arrows until my bowstring runs out of space next time...
The Price of Ingenuity#140.dst: 下次我得多加几支箭，加到弓弦上放不下为止……
The Price of Ingenuity#140.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#141.src: I'll h-have to come back here a-again tonight!
The Price of Ingenuity#141.dst: 我今、今晚得再来这里一、一趟！
The Price of Ingenuity#141.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#142.src: It's like there's ripples gently spreading within me...
The Price of Ingenuity#142.dst: 就像有涟漪在我体内轻轻扩散……
The Price of Ingenuity#142.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#143.src: To see my powers growing this clearly...
The Price of Ingenuity#143.dst: 能这么清楚地看到我的力量在成长……
The Price of Ingenuity#143.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#145.src: Dang, I think I overloaded it. I'll have to put it through a charge cycle...
The Price of Ingenuity#145.dst: 糟糕，我想我让它过载了。得让它跑一轮充电循环……
The Price of Ingenuity#145.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#147.src: So. Magic, curses, blessings... whatever you want to call it, it hasn't worked for me. It just doesn't... click.
The Price of Ingenuity#147.dst: 所以。魔法、诅咒、祝福……随便你怎么叫，在我身上就是没用。就是……开不了窍。
The Price of Ingenuity#147.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#148.src: Ah, not to worry, Rex! Even without it, none in the province could match your accuracy with a bow.
The Price of Ingenuity#148.dst: 啊，别担心，Rex！就算没有魔法，全行省也没人比得上你的弓箭准头。
The Price of Ingenuity#148.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#149.src: Y- yeah! And if you d- did get magic, it'd j- jus- just be unfair for the rest of us!
The Price of Ingenuity#149.dst: 对——对啊！要是你也有了魔、魔法，那对我、我们其他人就太不公平了！
The Price of Ingenuity#149.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#150.src: Yeah, yeah, sure. Either way, I've been practicing a new technique... let's see if I can pull it off.
The Price of Ingenuity#150.dst: 是啦，是啦，当然。不管怎样，我一直在练一种新技巧……看看能不能成功。
The Price of Ingenuity#150.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#152.src: Yep! I just place every arrow on the string at once, which lets me shoot at a much larger area!
The Price of Ingenuity#152.dst: 确定！我只是把每一支箭同时搭在弦上，这样就能射到大得多的范围！
The Price of Ingenuity#152.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#153.src: But... how'd you manage to hit each arrow right on target?! That's... insane!
The Price of Ingenuity#153.dst: 可是……你是怎么让每支箭都正中目标的？！那……太疯狂了！
The Price of Ingenuity#153.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#154.src: Ha. Go on, keep praising my skill. That was actually the first time I tried that many arrows at once... glad it worked out!
The Price of Ingenuity#154.dst: 哈。继续，继续夸我的技术。其实那是我第一次一次射这么多支……还好成功了！
The Price of Ingenuity#154.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#155.src: The... first... You said you'd practiced it, man! What do you mean that was the first time?!
The Price of Ingenuity#155.dst: 第……一次……你不是说你练过吗，老兄！什么叫那是第一次？！
The Price of Ingenuity#155.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#156.src: Yeah? I practiced theoretically. In my head. Keep up, Yulie.
The Price of Ingenuity#156.dst: 对啊？我是理论上练过。在脑子里。跟上啊，Yulie。
The Price of Ingenuity#156.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#158.src: Couldn't even make a spark, eh?
The Price of Ingenuity#158.dst: 连个火花都弄不出来，嗯？
The Price of Ingenuity#158.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#159.src: Alright, alright! I've been proven wrong.
The Price of Ingenuity#159.dst: 好啦，好啦！我承认我错了。
The Price of Ingenuity#159.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#161.src: So... I w-want to first say that I've been c-coming here every night.
The Price of Ingenuity#161.dst: 那个……我想先说，我每、每天晚上都会来这里。
The Price of Ingenuity#161.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#162.src: I was e-embarrassed that I just didn't g-get it.
The Price of Ingenuity#162.dst: 我很不、不好意思，因为我就是学、学不会。
The Price of Ingenuity#162.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#163.src: I mean, j-just look at how fast your m-magic developed, Mora!
The Price of Ingenuity#163.dst: 我是说，就、就看看你的魔、魔法进步得多快，Mora！
The Price of Ingenuity#163.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#164.src: And you, S-sui! You are a natural, a-after all.
The Price of Ingenuity#164.dst: 还有你，S-Sui！你毕、毕竟是天生的。
The Price of Ingenuity#164.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#165.src: I still don't know any form of magic. Why feel so embarassed?
The Price of Ingenuity#165.dst: 我到现在还一种魔法都不会。有什么好不好意思的？
The Price of Ingenuity#165.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#166.src: Rex, you don't even n-need magic to be a valuable asset! You're the best archer in the w-world!
The Price of Ingenuity#166.dst: Rex，你根本不、不需要魔法就很有价值了！你是世界上最、最好的弓箭手！
The Price of Ingenuity#166.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#167.src: I don't h-have that skill! My blade skills a-aren't good enough! You've h-had to save me time and time a-again.
The Price of Ingenuity#167.dst: 我没、没有那种本事！我的剑术也不、不够好！你已经救了我一次又一、一次。
The Price of Ingenuity#167.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#168.src: And {u}, I felt like I had l-let you down after all the k-knowledge you had given me.
The Price of Ingenuity#168.dst: 还有 {u}，你教了我那么多知识，我却觉、觉得让你失望了。
The Price of Ingenuity#168.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#169.src: I may not have talked to you a lot, Zeph. But from what I know of the science behind magic, you don't have to blame yourself for not getting it.
The Price of Ingenuity#169.dst: 我可能没怎么跟你聊过，Zeph。不过就我对魔法背后科学的了解，学不会也不用怪自己。
The Price of Ingenuity#169.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#170.src: A lot of people study magic their whole lives. I'm sure you'll get there eventually.
The Price of Ingenuity#170.dst: 很多人一辈子都在研究魔法。我相信你总有一天会学会的。
The Price of Ingenuity#170.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#171.src: Thank y-you, Yusanu. However, I think I f-finally figured it out...
The Price of Ingenuity#171.dst: 谢、谢谢你，Yusanu。不过，我想我终、终于弄懂了……
The Price of Ingenuity#171.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#173.src: I think I'm finally g-getting this magic thing somewhat down!
The Price of Ingenuity#173.dst: 我想我终于算、算是掌握这个魔法了！
The Price of Ingenuity#173.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#174.src: I will n-not stop practicing! N-not until I can m-m-match you all!
The Price of Ingenuity#174.dst: 我不、不会停止练习！不、不练到能跟上你、你、你们大家绝不停！
The Price of Ingenuity#174.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#176.src: Come on, man! Show us what you've got!
The Price of Ingenuity#176.dst: 来嘛，老兄！秀一下你的本事！
The Price of Ingenuity#176.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#177.src: ...okay. I've tried to, um, practice a bit, now that I'm... yeah.
The Price of Ingenuity#177.dst: ……好吧。我试着，呃，稍微练习了一下，既然我现在……嗯。
The Price of Ingenuity#177.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#178.src: I haven't fully developed it, but, I have this new skill...
The Price of Ingenuity#178.dst: 我还没完全练成，不过，我有个新技能……
The Price of Ingenuity#178.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#179.src: Okay! I'm going to try it!
The Price of Ingenuity#179.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#180.src: W- woah! It's like you ma- made that out of n- n- nothing!
The Price of Ingenuity#180.dst: 哇——哇！就好像你凭、凭、凭空变出来的！
The Price of Ingenuity#180.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#181.src: ...ugh! It takes so much concentration... even a word makes me fail...
The Price of Ingenuity#181.dst: ……唉！要花好多专注力……连一个字都会让我失败……
The Price of Ingenuity#181.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#182.src: Also. It's not, um, out of nothing.
The Price of Ingenuity#182.dst: 还有。那不是，呃，凭空变出来的。
The Price of Ingenuity#182.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#183.src: It's like... there's an ocean of swirling energy, all around me. If I can get a bit, in, like... a bucket, I can use it. But... I don't know how to get it without, um, falling into it and getting overwhelmed.
The Price of Ingenuity#183.dst: 那就像是……我周围有一片翻涌着能量的海洋。如果我能舀一点，放进，像是……一个桶里，我就能用。可是……我不知道怎么在不，呃，掉进去被淹没的情况下舀到。
The Price of Ingenuity#183.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#185.src: Uh... n- not- not really, but-
The Price of Ingenuity#185.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#190.src: I... I'm fine. No, even... more than that...
The Price of Ingenuity#190.dst: 我……我没事。不，甚至……不只是没事……
The Price of Ingenuity#190.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#191.src: It's like... I finally felt this power's ebb and flow, not just... it pouring out, I...
The Price of Ingenuity#191.dst: 就好像……我终于感觉到这股力量的潮起潮落，而不只是……一股脑地涌出来，我……
The Price of Ingenuity#191.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#192.src: ...ah! Is everyone fine? You... you all seem fine. Okay...
The Price of Ingenuity#192.dst: ……啊！大家都还好吗？你……你们看起来都没事。好……
The Price of Ingenuity#192.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#193.src: I think... I think that's all from me.
The Price of Ingenuity#193.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#194.src: Very well! This is as good an opportunity as any to show off my progress!
The Price of Ingenuity#194.dst: 很好！正是展示我进步的好机会！
The Price of Ingenuity#194.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#195.src: Although I am proficient in combat with my hammer, that is... standard. So, allow me to show my magic instead, as that is what I have been training!
The Price of Ingenuity#195.dst: 虽然我擅长用锤子战斗，但那……很普通。所以，请容我展示我的魔法，毕竟那才是我一直在训练的！
The Price of Ingenuity#195.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#196.src: ...oh, dear. I did not expect it to have become so powerful! It seems I must still master control over it...
The Price of Ingenuity#196.dst: ……噢，天哪。没想到它变得这么强了！看来我还得学会控制它……
The Price of Ingenuity#196.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#197.src: I apologize for the damage I have caused. If you would ask for compensation, I would gladly provide it.
The Price of Ingenuity#197.dst: 我为造成的损坏道歉。如果需要赔偿，我很乐意赔。
The Price of Ingenuity#197.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#198.src: Eh, don't worry about it. It's just a training room. Besides, all this junk in here doesn't even work anymore.
The Price of Ingenuity#198.dst: 嗯，别在意。这只是个训练室。况且，这里的破烂早就都坏了。
The Price of Ingenuity#198.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#200.src: Yo, that was badass, man! Your curse is awesome.
The Price of Ingenuity#200.dst: 哟，太帅了，老兄！你的诅咒超棒的。
The Price of Ingenuity#200.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#201.src: Is it! I suppose it is, haha! I am glad to have had the oppurtunity to learn to use it.
The Price of Ingenuity#201.dst: 是吗！我想是吧，哈哈！我很高兴有机会学会使用它。
The Price of Ingenuity#201.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#202.src: That is all, then. Who will go next?
The Price of Ingenuity#202.dst: 那我就到这里。下一个是谁？
The Price of Ingenuity#202.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#203.src: Lemme show you just what I can really do, man.
The Price of Ingenuity#203.dst: 让我给你们看看我真正的本事，老兄。
The Price of Ingenuity#203.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#204.src: Watch and learn, princess. Not every day you get to see me shred.
The Price of Ingenuity#204.dst: 看好学着，公主。可不是每天都能看我大秀一手。
The Price of Ingenuity#204.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#206.src: Yuman But wait! That's not all!
The Price of Ingenuity#206.dst: Yuman 可是，等等！还没完呢！
The Price of Ingenuity#206.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#207.src: My Sonic Boomer can help out with defense too! I'm no one trick pony - I can cover every genre of combat!
The Price of Ingenuity#207.dst: 我的音爆者也能帮忙防守！我可不是只会一招的——各种战斗曲风我全都拿手！
The Price of Ingenuity#207.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#208.src: And bam! That's it from me and Sonic Boomer for today.
The Price of Ingenuity#208.dst: 砰！今天我跟音爆者的表演就到这里。
The Price of Ingenuity#208.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#211.src: I'll say, I'm not as... direct... as Yuman. But I can hold my own in a fight.
The Price of Ingenuity#211.dst: 我得说，我不像 Yuman 那么……直接。不过打起架来我也不输人。
The Price of Ingenuity#211.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#213.src: I mean... yeah? Yusanu made this thing for me, and he calls it the Electric Blaster.
The Price of Ingenuity#213.dst: 我是说……对啊？这东西是 Yusanu 帮我做的，他管它叫电击枪。
The Price of Ingenuity#213.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#214.src: It's also able to fire a much larger blast with way more power, but that does make it less... precise.
The Price of Ingenuity#214.dst: 它也能发射威力大得多的巨型冲击，不过那样就没那么……准。
The Price of Ingenuity#214.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#215.src: That's all from me. Next one!
The Price of Ingenuity#215.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#216.src: Alrighty! Let's see... where to start...
The Price of Ingenuity#216.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#217.src: Oh, you have gotta be... again?! Really?! Ugh!
The Price of Ingenuity#217.dst: 噢，你一定是在……又来？！真的假的？！唉！
The Price of Ingenuity#217.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#218.src: Yulie, Yuman, can you check the tunnels for any intruders?
The Price of Ingenuity#218.dst: Yulie、Yuman，你们能去隧道里查查有没有入侵者吗？
The Price of Ingenuity#218.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#219.src: If you need us to. Keep us updated, would you?
The Price of Ingenuity#219.dst: 你需要的话就去。随时跟我们报告，好吗？
The Price of Ingenuity#219.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#220.src: Sure. Get the others to help you, I gotta run and check on things!
The Price of Ingenuity#220.dst: 好。叫其他人帮你们，我得跑去检查一下！
The Price of Ingenuity#220.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#221.src: Of course we can help, just tell us what to do!
The Price of Ingenuity#221.dst: 我们当然可以帮忙，告诉我们要做什么就行！
The Price of Ingenuity#221.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#222.src: {u} and I actually have some important tasks Syndra needed done!! Will you be okay without us?
The Price of Ingenuity#222.dst: {u} 跟我其实有 Syndra 交代的重要任务要做！！你们没有我们没问题吧？
The Price of Ingenuity#222.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#223.src: We will. It shouldn't be too hard for us, anyway- just routine check ups.
The Price of Ingenuity#223.dst: 没问题。对我们来说应该不难——只是例行检查。
The Price of Ingenuity#223.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#224.src: Yep, yep! Alright guys, follow papa!
The Price of Ingenuity#224.dst: 对，对！好了各位，跟着爸爸走！
The Price of Ingenuity#224.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#225.src: Wh- what? Ugh... put some c- cl- clothes on, a- at- at least.
The Price of Ingenuity#225.dst: 什——什么？唉……至少穿、穿、穿件衣服吧。
The Price of Ingenuity#225.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#229.src: I needed a way to get everyone else out of here so we could talk!
The Price of Ingenuity#229.dst: 我需要想办法把其他人都支开，这样我们才能谈谈！
The Price of Ingenuity#229.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#230.src: Yeah, obviously! It was the best excuse I could come up with in the moment.
The Price of Ingenuity#230.dst: 对啊，当然！那是我当下能想到最好的借口了。
The Price of Ingenuity#230.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#231.src: So, look. Yusanu's been really hard to get a read of! He's barely ever around- I'm honestly surprised he even showed up today!
The Price of Ingenuity#231.dst: 那么，听着。Yusanu 这个人真的很难看透！他几乎都不在——说实话我很意外他今天居然会出现！
The Price of Ingenuity#231.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#232.src: But anyway, when you and Zeph headed out with Yuman during the last alarm, I wanted to check in with Yusanu and see what he was up to.
The Price of Ingenuity#232.dst: 不过总之，上次警报响的时候你跟 Zeph 跟着 Yuman 出去了，我想去看看 Yusanu 在干嘛。
The Price of Ingenuity#232.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#233.src: But guess what? He was gone! Walked into his workshop and never walked out. Isn't that weird?
The Price of Ingenuity#233.dst: 结果你猜怎么着？他不见了！走进他的工作室就再也没出来。是不是很奇怪？
The Price of Ingenuity#233.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#234.src: I don't know what it means, and I don't know if he's a risk to us or not. But what I do know is that he's suspicious!
The Price of Ingenuity#234.dst: 我不知道那代表什么，也不知道他对我们是不是威胁。但我知道的是，他很可疑！
The Price of Ingenuity#234.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#235.src: Because they'd all probably tell me not to do anything impulsive right now. Which isn't even true, I've thought this plan out extensively!
The Price of Ingenuity#235.dst: 因为他们大概都会叫我现在别冲动行事。这根本不是真的，这个计划我可是深思熟虑过的！
The Price of Ingenuity#235.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#236.src: Come on, meet me outside his workshop! I just want to look. If it's nothing, then it's nothing! But I don't think it's nothing.
The Price of Ingenuity#236.dst: 来吧，在他的工作室外面跟我会合！我只是想看看。如果没什么，那就没什么！但我不觉得没什么。
The Price of Ingenuity#236.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#238.src: I'll meet up with you at the workshop.
The Price of Ingenuity#238.dst: 我在工作室那边跟你会合。
The Price of Ingenuity#238.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#241.src: See? I told you! He's just... gone.
The Price of Ingenuity#241.dst: 看吧？我就说！他就这样……不见了。
The Price of Ingenuity#241.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#242.src: Not even a trace... Seems like I wasn't distrustful for nothing. But how?
The Price of Ingenuity#242.dst: 连一点痕迹都没有……看来我没白怀疑他。可是怎么做到的？
The Price of Ingenuity#242.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#243.src: He has to have gone somewhere! He couldn't have just... vanished.
The Price of Ingenuity#243.dst: 他一定是去了什么地方！他不可能就这样……消失了。
The Price of Ingenuity#243.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#244.src: There has to be something else going on here! Do you see why I suspect him now?
The Price of Ingenuity#244.dst: 这里一定还有别的事！现在你明白我为什么怀疑他了吧？
The Price of Ingenuity#244.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#245.src: Let's snoop around a bit and make sure he's not posing a threat to us.
The Price of Ingenuity#245.dst: 我们稍微搜一搜，确定他对我们没有威胁。
The Price of Ingenuity#245.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#246.src: I'm glad you feel that way. Makes me feel less... horrible... about it.
The Price of Ingenuity#246.dst: 很高兴你也这么想。让我觉得没那么……糟糕。
The Price of Ingenuity#246.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#247.src: I guess we can be horrible people together, then.
The Price of Ingenuity#247.dst: 那我想我们可以一起当坏人了。
The Price of Ingenuity#247.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#248.src: I get it, trust me. They've taken us in and given us a place to stay, and now...
The Price of Ingenuity#248.dst: 我懂，相信我。他们收留了我们，给了我们住的地方，而现在……
The Price of Ingenuity#248.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#249.src: If we're wrong, if I'm wrong, then we both might get thrown out.
The Price of Ingenuity#249.dst: 要是我们错了，要是我错了，那我们俩可能都会被赶出去。
The Price of Ingenuity#249.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#250.src: The blame will land squarely on us both. I really hope that even if we are kicked out, the rest can still stay here...
The Price of Ingenuity#250.dst: 责任会完完全全落在我们俩身上。我真心希望就算我们被赶出去，其他人还是能留下来……
The Price of Ingenuity#250.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#251.src: ...no time to dwell on that. He must have left the workshop through an exit somewhere. Let's look around and see what we can find.
The Price of Ingenuity#251.dst: ……没时间想那个了。他一定是从工作室某个出口离开的。我们四处看看能找到什么。
The Price of Ingenuity#251.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#252.src: Try and find Yusanu in his workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#252.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的工作室里寻找 Yusanu。

The Price of Ingenuity#253.src: Aha! And you thought I was just being paranoid.
The Price of Ingenuity#253.dst: 啊哈！你还以为我只是疑神疑鬼。
The Price of Ingenuity#253.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#254.src: But you were thinking it, I could tell!
The Price of Ingenuity#254.dst: 可你就是这么想的，我看得出来！
The Price of Ingenuity#254.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#255.src: Okay, fine, maybe a little. But I was right to be!
The Price of Ingenuity#255.dst: 好吧，好吧，也许有一点。但我怀疑得没错！
The Price of Ingenuity#255.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#256.src: That's confirmation. Though, not like we needed it...
The Price of Ingenuity#256.dst: 这就证实了。不过，我们也不需要证实就是了……
The Price of Ingenuity#256.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#259.src: Yusanu's really puulling out all the stops to make sure nobody follows him!
The Price of Ingenuity#259.dst: Yusanu 真是想尽办法不让人跟踪他！
The Price of Ingenuity#259.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#260.src: Too bad we're persistent, though. There's got to be some way to open it, we just need to find it!
The Price of Ingenuity#260.dst: 可惜我们很执着。一定有什么办法能打开，我们只要找到就行！
The Price of Ingenuity#260.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#261.src: Whatever you did seems to have worked, the door's open!
The Price of Ingenuity#261.dst: 不管你做了什么好像都奏效了，门开了！
The Price of Ingenuity#261.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#263.src: Dead end? No, I see something on the other side...
The Price of Ingenuity#263.dst: 死路？不，我看到另一边有东西……
The Price of Ingenuity#263.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#264.src: How do we get across? I guess you could try to use your magic... but I don't want you to put yourself at risk just cause I dragged you along for this.
The Price of Ingenuity#264.dst: 我们要怎么过去？我想你可以试试用你的魔法……但我不想因为我拖你来这趟就让你冒险。
The Price of Ingenuity#264.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#267.src: Oh! Yusanu has to have taken this way, there aren't any other options. So, there's a trick to it...
The Price of Ingenuity#267.dst: 噢！Yusanu 一定是走这条路的，没有其他选择了。所以，一定有什么窍门……
The Price of Ingenuity#267.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#268.src: Look, over there! Do you see the button on the other side? I bet he uses it to close off this path whenever he takes it.
The Price of Ingenuity#268.dst: 看，那边！你看到另一边的按钮了吗？我打赌他每次走这条路都用它把路封起来。
The Price of Ingenuity#268.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#269.src: It's a good thing you have the best sharpshooter in all of Fruma on your side! A shot like that is nothing to me.
The Price of Ingenuity#269.dst: 还好你身边有全 Fruma 最厉害的神射手！那种距离对我来说小菜一碟。
The Price of Ingenuity#269.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#270.src: Just a moment... need to line it up... just right...
The Price of Ingenuity#270.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#271.src: Got it! Oh, that's more precarious than I expected. Be careful!
The Price of Ingenuity#271.dst: 中了！噢，比我想的还要悬。小心点！
The Price of Ingenuity#271.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#273.src: ...okay, why are we right outside the Sovereign's mansion?!
The Price of Ingenuity#273.dst: ……好，我们为什么就在统领的宅邸外面？！
The Price of Ingenuity#273.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#274.src: This place is so heavily guarded, and he just has a secret tunnel directly to the front door?!
The Price of Ingenuity#274.dst: 这地方戒备那么森严，他居然有一条秘密隧道直通大门口？！
The Price of Ingenuity#274.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#276.src: We can't just leave it here, obviously, but we're definitely not getting through the front door...
The Price of Ingenuity#276.dst: 我们显然不能就这样放着不管，但我们肯定没法从大门进去……
The Price of Ingenuity#276.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#277.src: Look, up there. The arch connects to the main structure, and probably has a way inside.
The Price of Ingenuity#277.dst: 看，上面。那座拱门连着主建筑，大概有路能进去。
The Price of Ingenuity#277.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#278.src: Maybe we can get up by climbing this building over here!
The Price of Ingenuity#278.dst: 也许我们可以爬上这边这栋楼上去！
The Price of Ingenuity#278.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#279.src: Travel up the nearby building at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and enter Soosu's mansion.
The Price of Ingenuity#279.dst: 爬上 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 附近的建筑，进入 Soosu 的宅邸。

The Price of Ingenuity#280.src: Sneak through Soosu's mansion looking for Yusanu at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#280.dst: 潜入 Soosu 的宅邸，在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 寻找 Yusanu。

The Price of Ingenuity#281.src: ... Hey, stay on your guard. We don't want to get caught in here.
The Price of Ingenuity#281.dst: ……嘿，保持警惕。我们可不想在这里被抓到。
The Price of Ingenuity#281.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#282.src: Though... it's kind of quiet in here. Weird.
The Price of Ingenuity#282.dst: 不过……这里面有点安静。真奇怪。
The Price of Ingenuity#282.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#283.src: Okay. Okay okay. That's a lot of buttons.
The Price of Ingenuity#283.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#284.src: So these two say up and down... over here it looks like a list...? Office, Workshop, Quarters, Workshop {~}, Roof Workshop... And why is there a lever? It's not even labeled.
The Price of Ingenuity#284.dst: 所以这两个写着上跟下……这边看起来像是清单……？办公室、工作室、宿舍、工作室 {~}、屋顶工作室……还有为什么会有拉杆？连个标签都没有。
The Price of Ingenuity#284.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#285.src: Ugh, I can never figure out Roughworks machines. Always overly complicated...
The Price of Ingenuity#285.dst: 唉，我永远搞不懂 Roughworks 的机器。总是复杂得要命……
The Price of Ingenuity#285.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#286.src: Well, what about you? Any thoughts?
The Price of Ingenuity#286.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#287.src: Okay. Sure! As good a suggestion as any.
The Price of Ingenuity#287.dst: 好。行！跟其他建议一样好。
The Price of Ingenuity#287.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#288.src: ...so, which one of these is up?
The Price of Ingenuity#288.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#289.src: Okay. Thanks for the input. I'm... not going to do that! That sounds like an awful idea- has Zeph been rubbing off on you?
The Price of Ingenuity#289.dst: 好。谢谢你的意见。我……不会那样做的！那听起来是个糟透了的主意——你是不是被 Zeph 传染了？
The Price of Ingenuity#289.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#290.src: And I thought one of him was bad enough...
The Price of Ingenuity#290.dst: 我还以为一个他就够受了……
The Price of Ingenuity#290.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#291.src: Oh, whatever! Let's just try something.
The Price of Ingenuity#291.dst: 噢，随便啦！我们就试试看吧。
The Price of Ingenuity#291.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#295.src: That was... I don't want to talk about it.
The Price of Ingenuity#295.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#296.src: Wait! {u}, quietly, come look at this.
The Price of Ingenuity#296.dst: 等等！{u}，小声点，过来看这个。
The Price of Ingenuity#296.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#297.src: Shoot, they're coming this way! Follow me!
The Price of Ingenuity#297.dst: 糟糕，他们往这边来了！跟我来！
The Price of Ingenuity#297.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#300.dst: 要是——那是——一个——鬼怎么办？！
The Price of Ingenuity#300.speaker: Sparkles

The Price of Ingenuity#301.src: N-O-O-O!!! Mother w-o-o-o-ould know what to do!
The Price of Ingenuity#301.dst: 不——不——不！！！妈妈一——一——一定知道该怎么办！
The Price of Ingenuity#301.speaker: Glitter

The Price of Ingenuity#303.src: Those "guards" don't seem very normal, do they? Isn't this supposed to be the Sovereign's mansion?
The Price of Ingenuity#303.dst: 那些“守卫”看起来不太正常，对吧？这里不是统领的宅邸吗？
The Price of Ingenuity#303.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#304.src: They didn't even see us... oh, whatever. Let's keep moving.
The Price of Ingenuity#304.dst: 他们甚至没看到我们……噢，随便啦。我们继续走。
The Price of Ingenuity#304.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#306.src: Why did you call me here again so soon? I was just here yesterday.
The Price of Ingenuity#306.dst: 你为什么这么快又叫我来？我昨天才来过。
The Price of Ingenuity#306.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#307.src: Oh, don't play dumb! Dead soldiers! Killed on the job! Sound familiar??
The Price of Ingenuity#307.dst: 噢，别装傻！死了的士兵！执勤时被杀！听起来耳熟吗？？
The Price of Ingenuity#307.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#309.src: Well, it better! Again - dead soldiers!! We had an agreement, Yus, and you've clearly gone and broken it!
The Price of Ingenuity#309.dst: 嗯，最好是耳熟！再说一次——死了的士兵！！我们说好了的，Yus，而你显然违约了！
The Price of Ingenuity#309.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#310.src: I- I know. And I'm sorry that it happened. But- it happened while I was here, working! What do you expect me to have done about it?!
The Price of Ingenuity#310.dst: 我——我知道。发生这种事我很抱歉。可是——事情发生的时候我在这里，在工作！你要我能怎么办？！
The Price of Ingenuity#310.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#311.src: Hmph! You're smart, aren't you? Smart enough to be able to grasp the fundamentals of conductivity and electrical currents! You could have found a way.
The Price of Ingenuity#311.dst: 哼！你很聪明，不是吗？聪明到能掌握导电性和电流的基本原理！你本来可以想出办法的。
The Price of Ingenuity#311.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#312.src: It's such a shame... you were one of my favorites, Yus. And now you've really let me down.
The Price of Ingenuity#312.dst: 真可惜……你本来是我最喜欢的人之一，Yus。现在你真的让我失望了。
The Price of Ingenuity#312.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#313.src: ...I know. I- I'll find a way to fix it. Tell me what to do, and- and I can. Whatever I need to- so I can keep them safe- I'll, I'll do it.
The Price of Ingenuity#313.dst: ……我知道。我——我会想办法补救。告诉我该做什么，然后——然后我就能做到。不管要我做什么——只要能保护他们安全——我、我都会做。
The Price of Ingenuity#313.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#314.src: Oh, Yus, you're so silly. There's nothing you can do to fix this now. The damage is done, and nobody around here will shut! Up! About it!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#314.dst: 噢，Yus，你真傻。事到如今你什么都补救不了了。损害已经造成，这里的人全都停！不！下！来！一直在讲这件事！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#314.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#315.src: I let you live in that abandoned trainyard because I thought you'd be quiet. But this isn't quiet! I can't focus now that everyone is-
The Price of Ingenuity#315.dst: 我让你住在那个废弃的铁路调车场，是因为我以为你会安安静静的。可这一点都不安静！现在大家都在——我根本没法专心——
The Price of Ingenuity#315.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#317.src: A GHO–O–O–OST! SPARKLES HEARD A GHO–O–O–O–OST! WHAT DO WE–E–E–E DO???
The Price of Ingenuity#317.dst: 有——鬼——鬼——鬼——啊！闪闪听到——有——鬼——鬼——鬼——鬼——啊！我——们——们——们——该怎么办？？？
The Price of Ingenuity#317.speaker: Glitter

The Price of Ingenuity#318.src: Ugh! Not now!! Can't you see mommy's busy?!
The Price of Ingenuity#318.dst: 唉！不是现在！！没看到妈妈在忙吗？！
The Price of Ingenuity#318.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#320.src: ...They'll be fine. I'll just bring them back later!
The Price of Ingenuity#320.dst: ……他们不会有事的。我晚点再把他们弄回来就好！
The Price of Ingenuity#320.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#321.src: You know, they've been getting better and better at replicating human behavior! My latest constructs were at an estimated {~} accuracy-
The Price of Ingenuity#321.dst: 你知道吗，他们模仿人类行为越来越像了！我最新的造物估计准确率达到了 {~}——
The Price of Ingenuity#321.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#323.src: Right! Here's what you can do for me, Yus. This isn't going to go away. I need someone to pin this on, so they'll all shut up and move on from it!
The Price of Ingenuity#323.dst: 对了！你能为我做的是这个，Yus。这件事不会就这样过去的。我需要找个人来背锅，这样他们才会闭嘴，然后翻篇！
The Price of Ingenuity#323.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#324.src: Especially that loudmouth from the north! Would it kill him to leave me alone and stop meddling in my business??
The Price of Ingenuity#324.dst: 尤其是北边那个大嘴巴！他离我远一点、别插手我的事会死吗？？
The Price of Ingenuity#324.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#326.src: Don't answer that. Look, this is the only way. You need to hand over whoever is responsible for this whole thing. That's the only way we can keep our peace and keep being friends.
The Price of Ingenuity#326.dst: 别回答。听着，只有这个办法。你得把这整件事的负责人交出来。只有这样我们才能保持和平，继续当朋友。
The Price of Ingenuity#326.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#327.src: Wh- you can't be serious! I can't do that, Soosu! You- you really expect me to give up one of my friends or family?!
The Price of Ingenuity#327.dst: 什——你不是认真的吧！我不能那样做，Soosu！你——你真的指望我出卖我的朋友或家人？！
The Price of Ingenuity#327.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#328.src: No, Yus, what I expected from you was to keep your "friends and family" quiet! But we're past that point now. Something needs to happen.
The Price of Ingenuity#328.dst: 不，Yus，我指望你做的是让你的“朋友和家人”保持安静！可我们已经过了那个阶段了。总得有事情发生才行。
The Price of Ingenuity#328.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#329.src: I-... I understand. I need to think. I'll... I'll let you know soon.
The Price of Ingenuity#329.dst: 我——……我明白了。我需要想想。我……我很快就会告诉你。
The Price of Ingenuity#329.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#330.src: What is he doing?! Sneaking around, meeting with the Sovereign?!
The Price of Ingenuity#330.dst: 他在干什么？！偷偷摸摸地跑来见统领？！
The Price of Ingenuity#330.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#331.src: We need to cut him off. I'm not letting him get away with this. Follow me, quickly!
The Price of Ingenuity#331.dst: 我们得截住他。我不会让他就这样逃过去。跟我来，快！
The Price of Ingenuity#331.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#332.src: Come on! Let's see if we can cut him off before he enters the tunnel!
The Price of Ingenuity#332.dst: 快点！看看能不能在他进隧道之前截住他！
The Price of Ingenuity#332.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#334.src: Okay. This is as good a place as any to hide out and wait...
The Price of Ingenuity#334.dst: 好。这里跟其他地方一样适合躲起来等……
The Price of Ingenuity#334.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#335.src: I can't believe this! I can't believe him! How long has he been doing this?
The Price of Ingenuity#335.dst: 我真不敢相信！真不敢相信他！他这样多久了？
The Price of Ingenuity#335.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#336.src: I... uh, I'll see you guys later, I... guess.
The Price of Ingenuity#336.dst: 我……呃，那我晚点再见你们，我……想是吧。
The Price of Ingenuity#336.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#340.src: Not a word, Yusanu. You are in no position to be asking questions!
The Price of Ingenuity#340.dst: 一个字都别说，Yusanu。你现在没资格问问题！
The Price of Ingenuity#340.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#341.src: Secretly meeting with the Sovereign? Really? Are you insane?!
The Price of Ingenuity#341.dst: 偷偷跟统领见面？真的假的？你疯了吗？！
The Price of Ingenuity#341.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#342.src: You- you... followed me... oh, no... no no no, no... you weren't seen, were you? You're going to ruin ev-
The Price of Ingenuity#342.dst: 你——你们……跟踪我……噢，不……不不不，不……你们没被看到吧？你们会毁了一——
The Price of Ingenuity#342.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#343.src: We're going to ruin everything?! And not you, the guy always sneaking off to meet the Sovereign?!
The Price of Ingenuity#343.dst: 我们会毁了一切？！而不是你这个老是偷偷溜去见统领的家伙？！
The Price of Ingenuity#343.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#344.src: You don't understand! The only reason we're safe down there is BECAUSE I struck a deal with her!!
The Price of Ingenuity#344.dst: 你们不明白！我们在下面之所以安全，就是因为我跟她做了交易！！
The Price of Ingenuity#344.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#346.src: I work as her assistant in her workshop, help her with whatever projects she's working on, and in exchange she allows us to live in the station!
The Price of Ingenuity#346.dst: 我在她的工作室当她的助手，帮她做她手上的任何项目，作为交换，她允许我们住在车站！
The Price of Ingenuity#346.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#347.src: As long as we don't cause any trouble with soldiers, at least- which, might I remind you, you people caused? So don't- don't act like...
The Price of Ingenuity#347.dst: 只要我们不跟士兵惹麻烦就行——而那个，容我提醒一下，是你们这些人惹出来的？所以别——别装得好像……
The Price of Ingenuity#347.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#348.src: Oh my god, you idiot. How long were you planning to keep this a secret? Were you ever going to tell anyone?
The Price of Ingenuity#348.dst: 噢我的天，你这个白痴。你打算瞒多久？你到底有没有打算告诉任何人？
The Price of Ingenuity#348.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#350.src: You were just gonna let it sit until, inevitably , someone was going to piss off the soldiers? Because, trust me, that would have happened eventually. With or without us.
The Price of Ingenuity#350.dst: 你就打算这样一直拖着，直到不可避免地有人惹毛那些士兵？因为，相信我，那迟早会发生的。有没有我们都一样。
The Price of Ingenuity#350.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#351.src: Status: On Hold. She needs my attention elsewhere.
The Price of Ingenuity#351.dst: 状态：暂停。她需要我把注意力放在别处。

The Price of Ingenuity#353.src: Ack! You- you heard that part too?
The Price of Ingenuity#353.dst: 啊！你——你连那部分也听到了？
The Price of Ingenuity#353.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#355.src: Ughhh.... I don't know! I don't know. I don't want to, obviously! You're all good people, and it'd break every single one of our guidelines to throw someone out like that!
The Price of Ingenuity#355.dst: 唉……我不知道！我不知道。我当然不想！你们都是好人，而且像那样把人赶出去违反我们所有的准则！
The Price of Ingenuity#355.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#356.src: But... I don't think I have a choice. The Steel Feather's safety is on the line, and I could fix it by just- just- handing someone over, but- I- I can't. I can't do that.
The Price of Ingenuity#356.dst: 可是……我觉得我没有选择。钢羽的安危悬于一线，而我只要——只要——交出一个人就能解决，可是——我——我做不到。我做不到。
The Price of Ingenuity#356.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#358.src: Okay. You were doing what you thought was right. I can understand that. But this - keeping secrets, following their rules - it was never going to end well!
The Price of Ingenuity#358.dst: 好。你做的是你认为对的事。这我能理解。可是这样——保守秘密、遵守他们的规矩——永远不会有好结果的！
The Price of Ingenuity#358.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#359.src: We can get past this choice by doing what we were already doing - trying to take down the crown! If we succeed, there won't be any more risk for you all.
The Price of Ingenuity#359.dst: 我们可以用我们本来就在做的事来跳过这个选择——想办法推翻王室！只要我们成功了，你们就不会再有任何风险。
The Price of Ingenuity#359.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#361.src: This is your chance to make it right, Yusanu! You have information. Tell us what you and the Sovereign were working on. Is it important?
The Price of Ingenuity#361.dst: 这是你弥补的机会，Yusanu！你有情报。告诉我们你跟统领在研究什么。重要吗？
The Price of Ingenuity#361.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#362.src: ...I don't know much about... what it is. I know it's not a weapon, at least- Soosu was clear on that. It's... an important assignment from the Queen.
The Price of Ingenuity#362.dst: ……我对……它是什么不太清楚。我至少知道它不是武器——Soosu 在这点上说得很清楚。那是……女王交代的重要任务。
The Price of Ingenuity#362.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#363.src: It's- it's strange. Very, very strange. It uses science that sounds... impossible. I think we're building over an existing device, something the Queen already had.
The Price of Ingenuity#363.dst: 那——那很奇怪。非常、非常奇怪。它用的科学听起来……不可能。我想我们是在一个现有的装置上继续打造，某个女王本来就有的东西。
The Price of Ingenuity#363.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#364.src: Soosu... she's stressed about the project. She needs to get it done, but it- it seems like an impossible task. There's something on the line for her.
The Price of Ingenuity#364.dst: Soosu……她为这个项目压力很大。她必须完成它，可它——看起来像是不可能的任务。她身上押着什么东西。
The Price of Ingenuity#364.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#365.src: ...mysterious device, important to the crown... got it. {u}, Yusanu- we need to steal it. If it's important to the crown... whatever it does, it's better if they don't have it.
The Price of Ingenuity#365.dst: ……神秘装置，对王室很重要……懂了。{u}、Yusanu——我们得把它偷走。如果它对王室很重要……不管它是做什么的，最好都别让他们拿到。
The Price of Ingenuity#365.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#366.src: Wh- what?! You can't be serious! We can't just-
The Price of Ingenuity#366.dst: 什——什么？！你不是认真的吧！我们不能就这样——
The Price of Ingenuity#366.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#367.src: We can, and we should! The Sovereigns aren't your friends, Yusanu, they're complicit in and responsible for everything wrong with Fruma!!
The Price of Ingenuity#367.dst: 我们能，而且应该！统领们不是你的朋友，Yusanu，他们是 Fruma 一切问题的共犯和元凶！！
The Price of Ingenuity#367.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#368.src: If we can hurt them, then we can hurt the crown. And if we can hurt the crown... we might actually stand a chance.
The Price of Ingenuity#368.dst: 如果我们能打击他们，就能打击王室。而如果我们能打击王室……我们说不定真的有机会。
The Price of Ingenuity#368.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#369.src: ...okay. Okay, fine! You're right. You're... right.
The Price of Ingenuity#369.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#370.src: I can get you to it. Uh... how did you get in, anyway?
The Price of Ingenuity#370.dst: 我可以带你们过去。呃……你们到底是怎么进来的？
The Price of Ingenuity#370.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#371.src: We'll show you. Come on, back in we go.
The Price of Ingenuity#371.dst: 我们带你看。来吧，我们回里面去。
The Price of Ingenuity#371.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#374.dst: 跟着 Yusanu 前往 Soosu 的工作室。

The Price of Ingenuity#375.src: Right, we'll need to be fast. Soosu tends to spend most of her time in the workshops...
The Price of Ingenuity#375.dst: 好，我们得动作快。Soosu 大部分时间都待在工作室……
The Price of Ingenuity#375.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#377.src: I... would probably be fine. But if she sees you two, then...
The Price of Ingenuity#377.dst: 我……大概不会有事。但要是她看到你们两个，那……
The Price of Ingenuity#377.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#378.src: So don't get caught, got it. I'm guessing we wouldn't stand a chance fighting her?
The Price of Ingenuity#378.dst: 所以别被抓到，懂了。我猜跟她打我们一点胜算都没有？
The Price of Ingenuity#378.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#379.src: No!! No, no, absolutely not. Her blessing... I haven't seen her use it in combat, but knowing what it can do...
The Price of Ingenuity#379.dst: 没有！！没有，没有，绝对没有。她的祝福……我没见过她在战斗中使用，但我知道它能做到什么……
The Price of Ingenuity#379.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#380.src: Being able to mold matter... it means more than just putting together machines. So...
The Price of Ingenuity#380.dst: 能塑造物质……那意味着的可不只是组装机器。所以……
The Price of Ingenuity#380.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#381.src: It won't come to that. Come on, let's get going.
The Price of Ingenuity#381.dst: 不会走到那一步的。来吧，我们走。
The Price of Ingenuity#381.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#382.src: The door to the workshop has already been unlocked...

The Price of Ingenuity#385.dst: 量子位移模块 - 研究笔记

The Price of Ingenuity#386.src: Alright, before we descend - Soosu has a bunch of golems walking around her workshop.
The Price of Ingenuity#386.dst: 好，下去之前——Soosu 的工作室里有一堆魔像在走来走去。
The Price of Ingenuity#386.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#387.src: They're more... uh, advanced than Sparkles and Glitter. If they see us, they'll sound the alarms. So don't get caught!
The Price of Ingenuity#387.dst: 它们比闪闪和亮亮……呃，高级。如果被它们看到，它们会拉警报。所以别被抓到！
The Price of Ingenuity#387.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#388.src: How did you two even manage to find me?
The Price of Ingenuity#388.dst: 你们两个到底是怎么找到我的？
The Price of Ingenuity#388.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#389.src: Really? I'm... surprised the system held together long enough for that.
The Price of Ingenuity#389.dst: 真的吗？我……很意外那套系统居然撑得了那么久。
The Price of Ingenuity#389.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#390.src: Look, it's not our fault this... thing doesn't come with an instruction manual!
The Price of Ingenuity#390.dst: 听着，这……东西没附说明书又不是我们的错！
The Price of Ingenuity#390.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#391.src: Ha! Okay, it's a little hard to figure out. You have to pick the destination, then hit up or down, and then pull the lever to turn it on! Simple.
The Price of Ingenuity#391.dst: 哈！好吧，是有点难搞懂。你得先选目的地，然后按上或下，再拉拉杆启动！很简单。
The Price of Ingenuity#391.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#392.src: That... sounds right, but the way you say that is concerning. What actually happened?
The Price of Ingenuity#392.dst: 那……听起来没错，不过你说的方式让人有点担心。到底发生了什么？
The Price of Ingenuity#392.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#393.src: Ugh, it doesn't matter what happened. What matters is this stupid box is overly complicated and annoying!
The Price of Ingenuity#393.dst: 唉，发生了什么不重要。重要的是这个蠢箱子复杂得要命又烦人！
The Price of Ingenuity#393.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#394.src: Okay, okay! It is... a little hard to figure out. You have to pick the destination, then hit up or down, and then pull the lever to turn it on! Simple.
The Price of Ingenuity#394.dst: 好，好！它是……有点难搞懂。你得先选目的地，然后按上或下，再拉拉杆启动！很简单。
The Price of Ingenuity#394.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#395.src: ...I chose the music, by the way.
The Price of Ingenuity#395.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#397.src: Oh... I forgot how much of a mess it was down here.
The Price of Ingenuity#397.dst: 噢……我都忘了这下面有多乱了。
The Price of Ingenuity#397.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#398.src: Sneak through the mansion avoiding the guards.

The Price of Ingenuity#399.src: Alright! That's our goal, over there.
The Price of Ingenuity#399.dst: 好！那就是我们的目标，在那边。
The Price of Ingenuity#399.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#400.src: It's the most important sector of Soosu's workshop.
The Price of Ingenuity#400.dst: 那是 Soosu 工作室里最重要的区域。
The Price of Ingenuity#400.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#401.src: Look around Soosu's workshop for the device.
The Price of Ingenuity#401.dst: 在 Soosu 的工作室里寻找那个装置。

The Price of Ingenuity#402.src: And you're sure she won't be coming down here?
The Price of Ingenuity#402.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#403.src: Uh... mostly. {~} sure. We should be fine today, if we move quickly.
The Price of Ingenuity#403.dst: 呃……差不多吧。{~} 确定。只要我们动作快，今天应该没问题。
The Price of Ingenuity#403.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#405.src: The festival's coming up, so she has a lot to handle. She'll be busy cleaning up the other workshops, building whatever contraptions she needs for this year's festival... that sort of stuff.
The Price of Ingenuity#405.dst: 庆典快到了，所以她有很多事要处理。她会忙着清理其他工作室、打造今年庆典需要的各种装置……诸如此类的事。
The Price of Ingenuity#405.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#406.src: She only comes down here for the big projects. Well, or when she needs to let out some steam. But she doesn't have anything going on today, so... we're safe.
The Price of Ingenuity#406.dst: 她只有做大项目的时候才会下来。嗯，或是需要发泄一下的时候。不过她今天没什么事，所以……我们很安全。
The Price of Ingenuity#406.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#407.src: ...if you say so, Yusanu. Still, I'd rather be out of here quickly.
The Price of Ingenuity#407.dst: ……既然你这么说，Yusanu。不过，我还是想尽快离开这里。
The Price of Ingenuity#407.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#408.src: Yeah... same. Let's take the device and go.
The Price of Ingenuity#408.dst: 是啊……我也是。我们拿了装置就走。
The Price of Ingenuity#408.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#409.src: This is Soosu's favorite room in the workshop. Her golem creation room.
The Price of Ingenuity#409.dst: 这是 Soosu 在工作室里最喜欢的房间。她的魔像制作室。
The Price of Ingenuity#409.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#410.src: She... told me once that she likes working with plants. It's why a lot of her golems are built off of flower pots and soil.
The Price of Ingenuity#410.dst: 她……有一次跟我说她喜欢跟植物打交道。所以她很多魔像都是用花盆和泥土做的。
The Price of Ingenuity#410.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#411.src: Hm. Well, good thing she's using her blessing on this, and not... I don't know. Reshaping the whole world?
The Price of Ingenuity#411.dst: 嗯。好吧，还好她是把祝福用在这上面，而不是……我也不知道。重塑整个世界？
The Price of Ingenuity#411.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#412.src: A-another golem? Should we turn back?
The Price of Ingenuity#412.dst: 又、又一个魔像？我们该回头吗？
The Price of Ingenuity#412.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#413.src: Oh, hey, it's Flowers! That's Soosu's favourite golem! Wonder why he's sleeping here and not on his Flowersbed, though. ... I wasn't the one that named that.
The Price of Ingenuity#413.dst: 噢，嘿，是 Flowers！那是 Soosu 最喜欢的魔像！不知道他为什么睡在这里，而不是睡在他的 Flowers 床上。……那个名字可不是我取的。
The Price of Ingenuity#413.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#414.src: Finally!!! He said yes!!! Uncle T finally let me visit his workshop, I'm so excited!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#414.dst: *** 终于！！！他答应了！！！T 叔叔终于让我去参观他的工作室了，我好兴奋！！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#414.speaker: 125 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#415.src: He's real!! Flowers is REAL NOW!!!! I showed Ma my drawing, and she helped me sew him together!! Now I can match with Fiona! She has Daruma, and I have... Flowers!
The Price of Ingenuity#415.dst: *** 他是真的！！Flowers 现在是真的了！！！！我给妈看了我的画，她帮我把他缝了出来！！现在我可以跟 Fiona 配对了！她有 Daruma，而我有……Flowers！
The Price of Ingenuity#415.speaker: 125 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#416.src: Hmph. Hmph!!!!!!!! Fiona's old enough now, she's gotta work too... she's always so tired now, she won't play with me anymore!!!! This sucks. This sucks!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#416.dst: *** 哼。哼！！！！！！！！Fiona 现在够大了，也得去工作了……她现在总是好累，都不跟我玩了！！！！好烂。好烂！！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#416.speaker: 126 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#417.src: Uncle T agreed to help me make the super ultra cow milker o-matic!!
The Price of Ingenuity#417.dst: *** T 叔叔答应帮我做超级无敌自动挤牛奶机！！
The Price of Ingenuity#417.speaker: 126 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#419.src: Grrrrrr............ I haven't written in AGES......... and it's because I gotta WORK!!!! In the FIELDS!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#419.dst: *** 呜呜呜呜…………我已经好久好久没写了………因为我得去工作！！！！在田里！！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#419.speaker: 127 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#420.src: I've been READING!! Reading so so many books... about FARMING!
The Price of Ingenuity#420.dst: *** 我一直在读书！！读了好多好多书……关于种田的！
The Price of Ingenuity#420.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#421.src: It's that time of year again!! The FESTIVAL OF THE CROWN!!! Just a week away!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#421.dst: *** 又到了一年的这个时候！！王冠节！！！只剩一个星期了！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#421.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#422.src: Weird thing happened today. Uncle T came home with a strange man from the military, big ol fancy uniform and all!
The Price of Ingenuity#422.dst: *** 今天发生了一件怪事。T 叔叔带了一个军队的怪人回家，穿着又大又花哨的制服！
The Price of Ingenuity#422.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#423.src: It turns out, the Crown really liked my super duper farmer!! Cause it makes it easier to harvest crops and stuff, they want us to make more of them, so everyone can do their work faster!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#423.dst: *** 原来王室超喜欢我的超级无敌农夫机！！因为它能让收割庄稼之类的更轻松，他们想要我们多做一些，让大家都能更快做完工作！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#423.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#424.src: Ugh...... ughhhhhhhh......... UGHHHHHHH...... I'm so TIRED!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#424.dst: *** 呃……呃呃呃呃………呃啊啊啊啊啊……我好累！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#424.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#425.src: Uncle T got really hurt today. Really, really, really hurt.
The Price of Ingenuity#425.dst: *** T 叔叔今天受了很重的伤。很重、很重、很重的伤。
The Price of Ingenuity#425.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#426.src: Ma says Uncle T's gonna be okay. He will.
The Price of Ingenuity#426.dst: *** 妈说 T 叔叔会没事的。他会的。
The Price of Ingenuity#426.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#427.dst: *** 也许截止期限其实很简单？
The Price of Ingenuity#427.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#429.src: The Citadel was AWESOME!!! I've always dreamed of going up there, someday... and now I HAVE!!
The Price of Ingenuity#429.dst: *** 王城太棒了！！！我一直梦想着有一天能去那上面……现在我去过了！！
The Price of Ingenuity#429.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#430.src: Work on project E-lec-tricity is ongoing (yes, the name changed... the Sovereign didn't like what I called it before...... bleh.), and it's going really well!!
The Price of Ingenuity#430.dst: *** 电——力项目还在进行中 (对，名字改了……统领不喜欢我之前取的名字……哼。)，而且进展得超顺利！！
The Price of Ingenuity#430.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#431.src: OKAY!!! DO NOT PANIC!!!! BUT THINGS! ARE! HAPPENING!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#431.dst: *** 好！！！不要慌！！！！但是事情！正在！发生！！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#431.speaker: 130 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#433.src: Looking back at these entries, I... I feel hollow.
The Price of Ingenuity#433.dst: *** 回头看这些日记，我……我觉得空荡荡的。
The Price of Ingenuity#433.speaker: 3 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#434.src: Mother passed away from her illness, a few days ago. They knew it was coming for a while, apparently, but... it was still a shock.
The Price of Ingenuity#434.dst: *** 母亲几天前因病去世了。显然他们早就知道会这样，可是……还是很震惊。
The Price of Ingenuity#434.speaker: 4 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#435.src: What's the point in writing these, anymore? I don't know what to say. I could talk about my projects, about all the progress I've been making, but it all feels so hollow.
The Price of Ingenuity#435.dst: *** 再写这些还有什么意义？我不知道该说什么。我可以写我的项目、写我取得的所有进展，但一切都感觉好空洞。
The Price of Ingenuity#435.speaker: 10 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#436.src: How many years has it been? I can check the dates, but... I don't want to.
The Price of Ingenuity#436.dst: *** 已经过了多少年了？我可以去查日期，可是……我不想。
The Price of Ingenuity#436.speaker: 40 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#437.src: Never forget, never stop creating, never give in!
The Price of Ingenuity#437.dst: *** 永远别忘记，永远别停止创造，永远别屈服！
The Price of Ingenuity#437.speaker: 45 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#438.src: And there it is... looking at it like this, it really is impressive.
The Price of Ingenuity#438.dst: 就是它了……这样看着它，真的很了不起。
The Price of Ingenuity#438.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#439.src: Again, you really don't know what this is for? And more importantly, which of us will carry it out?
The Price of Ingenuity#439.dst: 再问一次，你真的不知道这是做什么用的？还有更重要的是，我们谁来把它搬出去？
The Price of Ingenuity#439.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#440.src: I'd say until we're in the clear, {u} should carry it. And no... I really, absolutely do not. Every time I've asked Soosu to elaborate, she's just blown me off.
The Price of Ingenuity#440.dst: 我觉得在安全之前，{u} 应该拿着它。至于用途……我真的、完全不知道。每次我请 Soosu 详细说明，她都敷衍过去。
The Price of Ingenuity#440.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#441.src: Well. Whatever this is, it can't be any good if the Crown wants it. {u}, are you ready?
The Price of Ingenuity#441.dst: 嗯。不管这是什么，只要王室想要，就不可能是好东西。{u}，准备好了吗？
The Price of Ingenuity#441.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#442.src: Wait. Do you also hear that sound? Are those footsteps?
The Price of Ingenuity#442.dst: 等等。你们也听到那个声音了吗？那是脚步声吗？
The Price of Ingenuity#442.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#443.src: Can't be anything else - and there's two pairs of them. So Soosu is here, but with whom...?
The Price of Ingenuity#443.dst: 不可能是别的——而且有两个人的。所以 Soosu 在这里，可是她跟谁在一起……？
The Price of Ingenuity#443.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#444.src: ...are you sure this is the best idea? Dividing your attention between the discussion, and your...projects... It hasn't worked out in the past.
The Price of Ingenuity#444.dst: ……你确定这是最好的主意吗？一边讨论一边分心去做你的……项目……以前可没成功过。
The Price of Ingenuity#444.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#445.src: Well, you know, Zhiraok, not eeeveryone seems to have the time to drop everything and leave their region. Sometimes, we have a job to do.
The Price of Ingenuity#445.dst: 嗯，你知道吗，Zhiraok，可不是每——个人都有时间抛下一切离开自己的地区。有时候，我们也有工作要做。
The Price of Ingenuity#445.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#446.src: Ah, there you are, Flowers! Wakey wakey, sleepyhead - you've got some guarding to get back to!
The Price of Ingenuity#446.dst: 啊，你在这里，Flowers！醒醒，小懒虫——你该回去站岗了！
The Price of Ingenuity#446.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#448.src: Awareness, Soosu! A bit of warning before you stop like that?
The Price of Ingenuity#448.dst: 注意点，Soosu！你要那样停下来之前能不能先说一声？
The Price of Ingenuity#448.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#449.src: Hm? Ah, sorry, sorry, but an unexpected run-in with a close friend is just sooo nice! Surely there's space somewhere in your mind to know that, hmm?
The Price of Ingenuity#449.dst: 嗯？啊，抱歉，抱歉，不过突然碰到亲近的朋友真是太——开心了！你脑袋里总有地方能明白这点吧，嗯？
The Price of Ingenuity#449.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#450.src: Soosu... This is a solved problem! How many times have I told you that? ...Alright, look, that's a tangent. What I really need to tell you-
The Price of Ingenuity#450.dst: Soosu……这是个已经解决的问题！我跟你说过多少遍了？……好吧，听着，那是题外话。我真正需要告诉你的是——
The Price of Ingenuity#450.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#451.src: Escape the workshop without being spotted.
The Price of Ingenuity#451.dst: 不被发现地逃出工作室。

The Price of Ingenuity#452.src: Soosu's here? And with Zhiraok, of all people?! We have to get out, now!
The Price of Ingenuity#452.dst: Soosu 在这里？而且还跟 Zhiraok 在一起？！我们得马上离开！
The Price of Ingenuity#452.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#453.src: Yeah, but I bet Soosu's got Flowers on high alert! Don't use your magic, and whatever you do, don't get spotted!
The Price of Ingenuity#453.dst: 对，不过我打赌 Soosu 已经让 Flowers 高度戒备了！别用你的魔法，而且不管怎样，千万别被发现！
The Price of Ingenuity#453.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#454.src: Wait- What's that, Flowers? Intruders?! Right by the device room?!
The Price of Ingenuity#454.dst: 等等——什么，Flowers？入侵者？！就在装置室旁边？！
The Price of Ingenuity#454.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#455.src: ...!! The Cursed!! You're not laying one digit on her, you hear me?!
The Price of Ingenuity#455.dst: ……！！受诅者！！你休想动她一根手指头，听到没有？！
The Price of Ingenuity#455.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#456.src: Wh-what the helix Infiltrators! You aren't getting away this time!
The Price of Ingenuity#456.dst: 什——什么鬼螺旋入侵者！你们这次别想跑！
The Price of Ingenuity#456.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#457.src: Yusanu?! Who is that with you? Wait, are you trying to steal the device?!
The Price of Ingenuity#457.dst: Yusanu？！跟你在一起的是谁？等等，你们是想偷装置吗？！
The Price of Ingenuity#457.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#458.src: Hello, we're meant to run! Are you even taking this seriously?!
The Price of Ingenuity#458.dst: 喂，我们该跑了吧！你到底有没有认真？！
The Price of Ingenuity#458.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#459.src: ...you're smart enough that I shouldn't need to reiterate this! I know you are! Please, take the problem seriously!
The Price of Ingenuity#459.dst: ……你够聪明，我不该需要再重复一遍！我知道你够聪明！拜托，认真对待这个问题！
The Price of Ingenuity#459.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#460.src: A set of criminals is in your quadrant, the Cursed behind the Torann massacre is with them, they're infil-
The Price of Ingenuity#460.dst: 一群罪犯在你的象限里，造成 Torann 惨案的受诅者跟他们在一起，他们在渗——
The Price of Ingenuity#460.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#461.src: Oh my god, Z, I get it!!! All you do is yap yap yap yap YAP!!! Give me some room to think!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#461.dst: 噢我的天，Z，我知道了！！！你就只会叨叨叨叨叨叨！！！给我点空间思考！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#461.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#462.src: Bla bla criminals, bla bla cursed one!!!! Yes, I know how important it is! Flowers, hold this steady for me, won't you?
The Price of Ingenuity#462.dst: 巴拉巴拉罪犯，巴拉巴拉受诅者！！！！对，我知道这有多重要！Flowers，帮我扶稳这个，好吗？
The Price of Ingenuity#462.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#463.src: As long as your focus is on the solutions, not your... But, Soosu, I haven't heard anything from you. There was key information I had to learn offhand!
The Price of Ingenuity#463.dst: 只要你专注在解决方案上，而不是你的……可是，Soosu，我没从你那里听到任何消息。关键情报我还得从别处听说！
The Price of Ingenuity#463.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#464.src: One of your commanders summarized the topic for me. I should've heard it from you! So...what's your angle? It feels like you're ignoring the issue.
The Price of Ingenuity#464.dst: 是你的一个指挥官跟我汇总了情况。我应该从你这里听到才对！所以……你的角度是什么？感觉你在无视这个问题。
The Price of Ingenuity#464.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#465.src: ...Soosu? Soosu, are you listening? I asked you a question!
The Price of Ingenuity#465.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#466.src: Hm? Yeah, yeah, sure. Hey, could you fetch me some bolts?
The Price of Ingenuity#466.dst: 嗯？是是是，当然。嘿，能帮我拿些螺栓吗？
The Price of Ingenuity#466.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#467.src: ...fine, sure- But please, we have to round this out, Soosu. You have to get involved.
The Price of Ingenuity#467.dst: ……好，行——不过拜托，我们得把这件事凑个整，Soosu。你得参与进来。
The Price of Ingenuity#467.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#469.src: Oh, right, about Flowers. Could you go check if his body picked up any parts while walking that I could use?
The Price of Ingenuity#469.dst: 噢，对了，关于 Flowers。你能去看看他的身体走来走去的时候有没有捡到什么我能用的零件吗？
The Price of Ingenuity#469.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#471.src: I knew letting you work in here was irrational. There's such a greater sum of problems than your toys! You're acting like a child, but you aren't one!
The Price of Ingenuity#471.dst: 我就知道让你在这里工作不理智。问题的总和比你的玩具大多了！你表现得像个小孩，可你不是！
The Price of Ingenuity#471.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#472.src: I know you can do such good work if you just apply yourself! Why are you just ignoring a high-ranking defector and a Cursed exponentiating each others' threat?!
The Price of Ingenuity#472.dst: 我知道只要你用心，就能做出很好的成果！为什么你要无视一个高层叛逃者和一个受诅者正在让彼此的威胁呈指数级增长？！
The Price of Ingenuity#472.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#474.src: Do you think you're better than me, Zhiraok?
The Price of Ingenuity#474.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#475.src: Oh, look at Soosu, always so inattentive and clueless, always ignoring the needs of her district, always cooped up in her laboratory.
The Price of Ingenuity#475.dst: 噢，看看 Soosu，总是那么心不在焉、什么都不懂，总是无视她辖区的需求，总是窝在她的实验室里。
The Price of Ingenuity#475.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#476.src: Who even cares about the work she does? The projects she's assigned?! Who even cares that she knows, she knows, she KNOWS!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#476.dst: 谁在乎她做的工作？她被指派的项目？！谁在乎她知道、她知道、她知道！！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#476.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#477.src: ...Hm! Maybe you are better, Z. If you weren't, maybe we wouldn't be here right now!!
The Price of Ingenuity#477.dst: ……哼！也许你真的比较强，Z。要是你不强，也许我们现在就不会在这里了！！
The Price of Ingenuity#477.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#478.src: I... ... ...I'm sorry Soosu. That...that wasn't my angle, I didn't mean t-
The Price of Ingenuity#478.dst: 我……………我很抱歉，Soosu。那……那不是我的角度，我不是那个意——
The Price of Ingenuity#478.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#479.src: But you did! Hand me cog C-{~}, would you?
The Price of Ingenuity#479.dst: 可你就是！把 C-{~} 号齿轮递给我，好吗？
The Price of Ingenuity#479.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#480.src: ...alright. I just want to reach the end of this sequence as fast as possible.
The Price of Ingenuity#480.dst: ……好吧。我只想尽快走完这个序列。
The Price of Ingenuity#480.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#481.src: That makes two of us. I'm working on it. You can stop bugging me about it!!
The Price of Ingenuity#481.dst: 我们俩都这么想。我在弄了。你可以别再烦我了！！
The Price of Ingenuity#481.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#482.src: ...maybe I should've been paying more attention. I didn't realize her project was putting so much weight on your shoulders. And I promised to help, too...
The Price of Ingenuity#482.dst: ……也许我该多注意一点。我没发现她的项目让你的士兵承受了这么大的压力。而且我还答应过要帮忙……
The Price of Ingenuity#482.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#484.src: Return to the Steel Feather through Yusanu's tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#484.dst: 穿过 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Yusanu 隧道回到钢羽。

The Price of Ingenuity#485.src: ...what was that?! What were they DOING there?!
The Price of Ingenuity#485.dst: ……刚才那是怎么回事？！他们在那里干什么？！
The Price of Ingenuity#485.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#486.src: I- I- I don't know! A surprise visit? I didn't... I didn't think...
The Price of Ingenuity#486.dst: 我——我——我不知道！突击视察？我没……我没想到……
The Price of Ingenuity#486.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#487.src: So, "letting off some steam", huh?! Oh, sure, bring Sovereign Zhiraok along with you!! Why not!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#487.dst: 所以，“发泄一下”，是吧？！噢，当然，还把 Zhiraok 统领一起带来！！有何不可！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#487.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#488.src: We almost got caught! We- oh god, we... we almost got caught...
The Price of Ingenuity#488.dst: 我们差点就被抓到了！我们——噢天哪，我们……差点就被抓到了……
The Price of Ingenuity#488.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#489.src: ...what are we doing? Why did- why did we do that? That was so...
The Price of Ingenuity#489.dst: ……我们在干什么？为什么——为什么我们要那样做？那太……
The Price of Ingenuity#489.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#490.src: You're asking ME?! Yeah, Rex, why did we do that?!
The Price of Ingenuity#490.dst: 你问我？！是啊，Rex，我们为什么要那样做？！
The Price of Ingenuity#490.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#491.src: Stop. Just... stop, for a second. I need to... think.
The Price of Ingenuity#491.dst: 停。先……停一下。我需要……想想。
The Price of Ingenuity#491.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#492.src: ...damn it. Damn it, damn it, damn it! Stupid, impulsive... ugh!!
The Price of Ingenuity#492.dst: ……该死。该死，该死，该死！又蠢又冲动……唉！！
The Price of Ingenuity#492.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#494.src: No, I... I'm not. I'm sorry, I- I should know better by now...
The Price of Ingenuity#494.dst: 不，我……我不好。对不起，我——我早该学乖了……
The Price of Ingenuity#494.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#495.src: It... doesn't matter. It's too late to take it back. We can... we can use it as a trump card. Yusanu, please tell me you can figure out what it is.
The Price of Ingenuity#495.dst: 那……不重要了。现在收回也来不及了。我们可以……我们可以把它当王牌。Yusanu，拜托告诉我你能弄清楚它是什么。
The Price of Ingenuity#495.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#496.src: I... I don't know. I never got to work too closely with it, so... I have no idea what it is. If I work with it, maybe I can get somewhere. But...
The Price of Ingenuity#496.dst: 我……我不知道。我从来没机会近距离研究它，所以……我完全不知道它是什么。如果我去研究，也许能有些进展。可是……
The Price of Ingenuity#496.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#497.src: Good enough, I guess. Come on, let's get back. I need to... find Mora. And you need to tell everyone what you've been up to.
The Price of Ingenuity#497.dst: 我想也够了。来吧，我们回 吧。我得……去找 Mora。而你得告诉大家你一直在干什么。
The Price of Ingenuity#497.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#498.src: ...so just hiding what we did today isn't an option?
The Price of Ingenuity#498.dst: ……所以把我们今天做的事瞒下来不是个选项？
The Price of Ingenuity#498.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#499.src: And let it come back to bite us later down the line? No thanks. Let's go.
The Price of Ingenuity#499.dst: 然后让它之后反咬我们一口？不了，谢谢。走吧。
The Price of Ingenuity#499.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#500.src: Really, Rex, are you... alright? I don't think I've ever seen-
The Price of Ingenuity#500.dst: 说真的，Rex，你……还好吗？我好像从来没见过——
The Price of Ingenuity#500.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#501.src: Don't. Don't push it. Not right now.
The Price of Ingenuity#501.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#502.src: Hey! You three, where the heck have you been all day?!
The Price of Ingenuity#502.dst: 嘿！你们三个，一整天都跑哪去了？！
The Price of Ingenuity#502.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#504.src: Yes, it's rather curious! I happened to speak to Syndra, and apparently there were no such "important tasks" assigned to you! She seemed rather clueless about the whole matter!
The Price of Ingenuity#504.dst: 是啊，这可真稀奇！我刚好跟 Syndra 聊了一下，看来根本没有什么交给你们的“重要任务”！她看起来对整件事一头雾水！
The Price of Ingenuity#504.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#506.src: You know what happened, Mora. I- I messed up. Again.
The Price of Ingenuity#506.dst: 你知道发生了什么，Mora。我——我搞砸了。又一次。
The Price of Ingenuity#506.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#507.src: Huh? What do you mean, agai-
The Price of Ingenuity#507.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#508.src: Ah, Yuman, would you mind taking Yusanu along with you to go tell the others we'll be a little late to the meeting? I believe there will be some additional news today.
The Price of Ingenuity#508.dst: 啊，Yuman，能不能麻烦你带 Yusanu 一起去告诉其他人，我们开会会晚一点到？我相信今天会有一些额外的消息。
The Price of Ingenuity#508.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#509.src: Uh... sure, I guess. Yus, can you tell me what's up while we walk?
The Price of Ingenuity#509.dst: 呃……好吧，我想。Yus，边走边跟我说是怎么回事好吗？
The Price of Ingenuity#509.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#512.src: It's... bad. We stole something important from the Sovereign's workshop. It's... a long story. Yusanu should tell his part of it. But...
The Price of Ingenuity#512.dst: 很……糟。我们从统领的工作室偷了一个重要的东西。说来……话长。Yusanu 应该自己讲他那部分。可是……
The Price of Ingenuity#512.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#513.src: I see. I apologize, Rex, I should have been more attentive.
The Price of Ingenuity#513.dst: 我明白了。我很抱歉，Rex，我应该更留意的。
The Price of Ingenuity#513.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#514.src: No! No, it's not your fault, I should have- I should have known I was being impulsive, I... I wasn't thinking straight.
The Price of Ingenuity#514.dst: 不！不，不是你的错，我应该——我应该知道自己在冲动，我……我那时候脑子不清楚。
The Price of Ingenuity#514.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#515.src: Ah. Of course, you don't know. I should have informed you the last time this happened...
The Price of Ingenuity#515.dst: 啊。当然，你还不知道。上次发生这种事的时候我就该告诉你的……
The Price of Ingenuity#515.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#516.src: Rex has these... ah, "moods," sometimes, wherein she gets... overly excitable and impulsive. Many a time have they led her into trouble.
The Price of Ingenuity#516.dst: Rex 有时候会有这些……啊，“情绪”，那时候她会……过度兴奋又冲动。好多次都让她惹上了麻烦。
The Price of Ingenuity#516.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#517.src: Ugh, I should know better by now! Especially here, especially now, when...
The Price of Ingenuity#517.dst: 唉，我现在早该学乖了！尤其是在这里，尤其是现在，明明……
The Price of Ingenuity#517.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#518.src: Well, what is done is done, and nevertheless, we must press on. Let's join the others for the meeting. Syndra has something important to tell us.
The Price of Ingenuity#518.dst: 嗯，做了就做了，无论如何，我们都得继续前进。我们去跟其他人开会吧。Syndra 有重要的事要告诉我们。
The Price of Ingenuity#518.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#519.src: Attend the meeting in the Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#520.src: There you are! Mora, Rex, what's going-
The Price of Ingenuity#520.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#521.src: Syndra, I believe that can wait. We've, ah, held up dinner long enough, I believe. If everyone is here, we should begin. First- Yusanu, what was it you had to tell us?
The Price of Ingenuity#521.dst: Syndra，我想那可以等等。我们，啊，已经耽搁晚饭够久了。如果大家都到齐了，就开始吧。首先——Yusanu，你有什么要跟我们说的？
The Price of Ingenuity#521.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#522.src: ...sigh. Before I begin, I need to make it clear- I was doing what I thought was best for the Steel Feather.
The Price of Ingenuity#522.dst: ……唉。开始之前，我得先说清楚——我做的是我认为对钢羽最好的事。
The Price of Ingenuity#522.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#523.src: Yeah, man, good start... really instills confidence.
The Price of Ingenuity#523.dst: 对啊，老兄，开场白真不错……真让人放心。
The Price of Ingenuity#523.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#524.src: Yuman, please... let me get through this. Don't interrupt.
The Price of Ingenuity#524.dst: Yuman，拜托……让我说完。别打断我。
The Price of Ingenuity#524.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#525.src: So. So, so,so... The... the reason the crown has left us alone down here is because I have been working with Sovereign Soosu.
The Price of Ingenuity#525.dst: 所以。所以，所以，所以……王室之所以一直没来找我们麻烦……是因为我一直在跟 Soosu 统领合作。
The Price of Ingenuity#525.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#528.src: The reason we've been able to stay under the radar for so long is because of this, Yulie.
The Price of Ingenuity#528.dst: 我们之所以能这么久不被发现，就是因为这个，Yulie。
The Price of Ingenuity#528.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#529.src: The reason we can live here, leave our home, make use of the city's electricity... it's because of my collaboration.
The Price of Ingenuity#529.dst: 我们能住在这里、离开家、使用城里的电……都是因为我跟她合作。
The Price of Ingenuity#529.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#530.src: She said she saw potential in me. Told me that if I helped her in her workshops, then... then you all would be safe down here.
The Price of Ingenuity#530.dst: 她说她看到了我的潜力。告诉我如果我在她的工作室帮忙，那……那你们在下面就会安全。
The Price of Ingenuity#530.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#531.src: I didn't tell anybody because I knew you wouldn't get it. You'd think it was stupid, and risky, and a bad idea. Working with... with someone responsible for our problems.
The Price of Ingenuity#531.dst: 我没告诉任何人，因为我知道你们不会理解。你们会觉得那很蠢、很冒险、是个烂主意。跟……跟造成我们这些问题的人合作。
The Price of Ingenuity#531.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#532.src: And I knew it was risky. I did. But I thought that if I were to mess up, only I would be punished. You all would be safe.
The Price of Ingenuity#532.dst: 而我也知道很冒险。我知道。但我以为要是我搞砸了，受惩罚的只会是我。你们都会安全。
The Price of Ingenuity#532.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#533.src: ...now. I understand emotions are running high right now. I would ask everyone to take a step back, think through it logically, and remain c-
The Price of Ingenuity#533.dst: ……好了。我明白现在大家情绪都很激动。我请大家先退一步，理性地想清楚，保持冷——
The Price of Ingenuity#533.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#534.src: Are you insane, Yusanu?! Of all the secrets you could have been keeping-
The Price of Ingenuity#534.dst: 你疯了吗，Yusanu？！你能瞒的秘密那么多——
The Price of Ingenuity#534.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#536.src: No, I don't think I will! Is that what the alarms were about? How long has this been going on? What was running through your head when you decided-
The Price of Ingenuity#536.dst: 不，我不觉得我会！警报就是因为这个吗？这种事多久了？你决定这么做的时候脑子里到底在想什么——
The Price of Ingenuity#536.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#537.src: As if you haven't been doing the same thing this whole time! Trying to put all the weight on your own shoulders, not getting help from anyone else!!
The Price of Ingenuity#537.dst: 说得好像你一直以来没在做一样的事！把所有担子都扛在自己肩上，谁的帮忙都不要！！
The Price of Ingenuity#537.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#538.src: So- so, y'know, I'm a little mad. He should have talked to us about it! But... he's telling us now. He's asking for help now.
The Price of Ingenuity#538.dst: 所以——所以，你懂的，我是有点生气。他应该跟我们商量的！可是……他现在告诉我们了。他现在在请我们帮忙。
The Price of Ingenuity#538.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#542.src: After yesterday's run-in with the soldiers... Soosu is demanding I hand over whoever's responsible. I... I can't do that.
The Price of Ingenuity#542.dst: 昨天跟士兵起冲突之后……Soosu 要我交出负责的人。我……我做不到。
The Price of Ingenuity#542.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#543.src: Rex and {u} caught me talking to her today. That's why... that's why I'm telling you.
The Price of Ingenuity#543.dst: Rex 和 {u} 今天撞见我跟她说话。所以……所以我才告诉你们。
The Price of Ingenuity#543.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#544.src: ...yeah. I convinced him to stop working with her, and to tell you all about it.
The Price of Ingenuity#544.dst: ……对。我说服他别再跟她合作，把事情告诉你们大家。
The Price of Ingenuity#544.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#545.src: We also... stole an important gadget she and Yusanu were working on. Something the Queen was very invested in.
The Price of Ingenuity#545.dst: 我们还……偷了一个她跟 Yusanu 在研究的重要装置。女王非常看重的东西。
The Price of Ingenuity#545.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#546.src: I don't know what it is or what it does. I don't know what it's for. All I know is that the Queen needs it finished. It's all she's had Soosu working on for... months.
The Price of Ingenuity#546.dst: 我不知道它是什么、有什么用。我不知道它是做什么的。我只知道女王需要它完成。好几个月来她就只让 Soosu 做这个。
The Price of Ingenuity#546.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#547.src: I'll try to figure out what it is in my spare time. Maybe it'll help us! I... hope it will.
The Price of Ingenuity#547.dst: 我会利用空闲时间弄清楚它是什么。也许能帮上我们！我……希望能。
The Price of Ingenuity#547.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#548.src: Yulie, Yuman... I owe you a better apology. I can talk to you in private later, but... right now, we should continue with the meeting.
The Price of Ingenuity#548.dst: Yulie、Yuman……我欠你们一个更好的道歉。我可以之后私下跟你们谈，不过……现在，我们应该继续开会。
The Price of Ingenuity#548.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#550.src: ...that was certainly a lot. Fortunately, angering the Sovereign may not ultimately matter. If all goes according to plan... the crown will fall at the end of the festival.
The Price of Ingenuity#550.dst: ……这确实信息量很大。幸运的是，惹怒统领最终可能不重要。如果一切照计划进行……王室会在庆典结束时倒台。
The Price of Ingenuity#550.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#551.src: My goal, as always, has been to find a way to destroy the crown's influence and to free our province. I believe this upcoming festival is an opportunity to do just that.
The Price of Ingenuity#551.dst: 我的目标一直都是找到办法摧毁王室的影响力，解放我们的行省。我相信即将到来的这场庆典正是实现这件事的机会。
The Price of Ingenuity#551.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#552.src: During the Crown Festival, Her Majesty will die.
The Price of Ingenuity#552.dst: 王冠节期间，女王陛下会死。
The Price of Ingenuity#552.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#553.src: Settle down, everyone, settle down! Please, allow Syndra to continue.
The Price of Ingenuity#553.dst: 安静，大家，安静！拜托，让 Syndra 说下去。
The Price of Ingenuity#553.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#554.src: It will not be easy. But if we strike when her guard is down, and catch her by surprise, I believe it is possible.
The Price of Ingenuity#554.dst: 这不会容易。不过如果我们趁她松懈的时候出击、打她个措手不及，我相信是有可能的。
The Price of Ingenuity#554.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#555.src: I'll be splitting you all into several groups, and will assign tasks that must be completed before the festival.
The Price of Ingenuity#555.dst: 我会把你们分成几组，分配庆典前必须完成的任务。
The Price of Ingenuity#555.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#556.src: The decision Quill and I have come to is that I alone will be going for the kill. That way, if anything goes wrong... no one else faces the consequences.
The Price of Ingenuity#556.dst: Quill 和我的决定是，由我一个人去下手。这样一来，要是出了什么差错……就不会有其他人承担后果。
The Price of Ingenuity#556.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#557.src: I'll go over the details tomorrow. I think... we've had enough excitement today. Please, hold your complaints until then, as well.
The Price of Ingenuity#557.dst: 细节我明天再讲。我想……今天的刺激已经够多了。也请把你们的不满留到那时候再说。
The Price of Ingenuity#557.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#558.src: Ahem. Yes, indeed. I suppose we should be getting to dinner, as well.
The Price of Ingenuity#558.dst: 咳咳。是的，确实。我想我们也该吃晚饭了。
The Price of Ingenuity#558.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#559.src: Yuman... this may be unfair of me to ask, but would you be willing to play us a song tonight? We will not have many days left together.
The Price of Ingenuity#559.dst: Yuman……这么要求可能对你不太公平，不过你愿意今晚为我们弹一首歌吗？我们在一起的日子不多了。
The Price of Ingenuity#559.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#560.src: Yeah... yeah, man, of course. I can do that.
The Price of Ingenuity#560.dst: 好……好啊，老兄，当然。我可以。
The Price of Ingenuity#560.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#561.src: Then let us enjoy the remainder of our company!
The Price of Ingenuity#561.dst: 那就让我们享受剩下的相聚时光吧！
The Price of Ingenuity#561.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#562.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 观看 Yuman 的表演。

The Price of Ingenuity#563.src: Hey, everyone! Man, uh... small crowd today, huh?
The Price of Ingenuity#563.dst: 嘿，大家好！老兄，呃……今天人有点少，是吧？
The Price of Ingenuity#563.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#564.src: Oh, man, is that Jiro I see? Hey, man! I didn't, uh... expect to see ya.
The Price of Ingenuity#564.dst: 噢，老兄，那是 Jiro 吗？嘿，老兄！我没，呃……想到会看到你。
The Price of Ingenuity#564.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#566.src: Uh, just, you didn't seem super happy with me after... after yesterday. With the- soldier thing.
The Price of Ingenuity#566.dst: 呃，就是，你之后……昨天之后好像不太高兴。就是——士兵那件事。
The Price of Ingenuity#566.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#567.src: ... Oh! Yeah. No worries. Water under the bridge.
The Price of Ingenuity#567.dst: ……噢！对啊。没关系。过去就过去了。
The Price of Ingenuity#567.speaker: Jiro

The Price of Ingenuity#568.src: If... if you say so! Don't think you've heard this one before, so tell me how you like it!
The Price of Ingenuity#568.dst: 如……如果你这么说的话！我想你还没听过这首，所以跟我说说你觉得怎么样！
The Price of Ingenuity#568.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#569.src: But first... Yus. Yusanu. Look, I... I'm not one to hold grudges. So I don't need any more apologies from you! I get it.
The Price of Ingenuity#569.dst: 不过首先……Yus。Yusanu。听着，我……我不是会记仇的人。所以我不需要你再道歉了！我懂。
The Price of Ingenuity#569.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#570.src: I just... want you to trust us more, 'kay? You and Yulie both, haha! 'Cause... I want to help!
The Price of Ingenuity#570.dst: 我只是……希望你多信任我们一点，好吗？你跟 Yulie 都是，哈哈！因为……我想帮忙！
The Price of Ingenuity#570.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#571.src: I had a think, and yeah. It sucks you didn't tell us. But your deal with Soosu- it saved us! Gave us a home, gave us a future!
The Price of Ingenuity#571.dst: 我想过了，嗯。你没告诉我们是很烂。可是你跟 Soosu 的交易——它救了我们！给了我们一个家，给了我们一个未来！
The Price of Ingenuity#571.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#572.src: So... this song's dedicated to you. Hope you like it.
The Price of Ingenuity#572.dst: 所以……这首歌献给你。希望你喜欢。
The Price of Ingenuity#572.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#573.src: No... no no no no no, where is it, where IS IT?! I can't... I need to find it, I-
The Price of Ingenuity#573.dst: 不……不不不不不，在哪，到底在哪？！我没办法……我得找到它，我——
The Price of Ingenuity#573.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#574.dst: 这副样子可不好看，统领。
The Price of Ingenuity#574.speaker: Her Majesty
